articles.title: If AI cannot be trusted in a classroom, why should it be trusted in orbit?
articles.author: Qurat-Ul-Ain Shabbir

paras.en: On September 9, 2026, Evan Hubinger, Anthropic’s alignment science lead, said on social media that he personally believed there was a greater than 10% chance that artificial intelligence could kill all of humanity within the next decade. He was responding to Jacob Coxon, a researcher who had just resigned from Anthropic after working on pretraining at both that company and OpenAI, and who wrote in his own resignation thread that “the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” Hubinger did not walk the claim back. He confirmed it, while noting that the danger he had in mind was not today’s models but a future superintelligence for which the industry does not yet have a solved alignment plan.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 9 日，Anthropic 的对齐科学负责人 Evan Hubinger 在社交媒体上表示，他个人认为人工智能在未来十年内杀死全人类的可能性超过 10%。他是在回应雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon)，这位研究员在 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 从事预训练工作后刚刚从 Anthropic 辞职，他在自己的辞职帖子中写道，“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人。”胡宾格没有收回索赔。他证实了这一点，同时指出，他想到的危险不是今天的模型，而是未来的超级智能，而业界尚未制定出解决的协调计划。

paras.en: Coming from the safety lead at one of the two or three companies most responsible for the technology’s current trajectory, this was not a fringe warning. It was, in effect, an admission from inside the room.
paras.zh: 来自对当前技术发展轨迹负有最大责任的两三家公司之一的安全主管，这并不是一个边缘警告。实际上，这是房间内部的承认。

paras.en: The exchange was framed almost entirely around AI in the abstract: chatbots, agents, the eventual arrival of self-improving systems. But the domain where this risk is least abstract and most immediate is not a hypothetical future superintelligence. It is the set of systems already being integrated into nuclear early warning satellites, missile-tracking constellations and the command and control architecture that decides, in minutes, whether a detected launch is real. If a company’s own safety researchers are willing to say on the record that current AI development carries a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe, the question that follows is not academic: What happens when systems built by that same industry, with that same acknowledged uncertainty, are the ones watching for nuclear launches from orbit and feeding what they see directly into the decision loop of nuclear-armed states?
paras.zh: 这场交流几乎完全围绕抽象的人工智能展开：聊天机器人、代理、自我改进系统的最终到来。但这种风险最不抽象、最直接的领域并不是假设的未来超级智能。这套系统已经集成到核预警卫星、导弹跟踪星座以及指挥和控制架构中，可以在几分钟内决定检测到的发射是否真实。如果一家公司自己的安全研究人员愿意公开表示，当前的人工智能发展带来文明灾难的可能性达到两位数，那么接下来的问题就不是学术问题了：当同一行业构建的系统具有同样公认的不确定性时，如果那些在轨道上监视核发射并将其看到的信息直接反馈到核武器国家的决策循环中，会发生什么？

paras.en: The nuclear-space nexus is where AI safety debate stops being abstract
paras.zh: 核与太空的联系是人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方

paras.en: This is the nuclear space nexus, and it is where the abstract AI safety debate stops being abstract.
paras.zh: 这就是核空间的联系，也是抽象人工智能安全争论不再抽象的地方。

paras.en: The mechanism runs through space architecture itself. Satellite constellations, orbital processing units and ground relay stations are the physical layer that decides what a nuclear armed state believes is happening in the world. The AI systems currently doing that work are narrow, frozen weight models, convolutional networks for image classification, sensor fusion algorithms for combining radar and satellite feeds, nothing resembling the self improving superintelligence Coxon and Hubinger were warning about. That distinction is precisely what makes the space layer worth examining rather than dismissing.
paras.zh: 这一机制贯穿于空间建筑本身。卫星星座、轨道处理单元和地面中继站是决定核武器国家认为世界上正在发生什么的物理层。目前从事这项工作的人工智能系统是狭窄的、冻结重量的模型、用于图像分类的卷积网络、用于结合雷达和卫星馈送的传感器融合算法，与考克森和胡宾格警告的自我改进的超级智能完全不同。正是这种区别使得空间层值得研究而不是忽视。

paras.en: For decades, that layer worked on a simple “bent pipe” model: satellites captured raw infrared and radar data and beamed it down to Earth for human analysts to interpret. That model is being replaced. Modern space architecture is shifting toward onboard edge AI, with computer vision models embedded directly into satellite payloads deciding, in orbit, what counts as a missile plume before a human ever sees the raw image. At the same time, the shift from a handful of large geostationary satellites to proliferated low Earth orbit constellations of thousands of smaller satellites means no human team can parse the feeds directly. Data fusion platforms now do that work, aggregating radar, imagery and signals intelligence into a single real time track. Even a narrow, well tested model compresses the time available for human judgment, since the entire argument for automating this layer is that orbital and hypersonic threats move faster than people can react to.
paras.zh: 几十年来，该层工作在一个简单的“弯管”模型上：卫星捕获原始红外和雷达数据，并将其传送到地球供人类分析人员解释。该模型正在被替换。现代太空架构正在向机载边缘人工智能转变，计算机视觉模型直接嵌入卫星有效载荷中，在人类看到原始图像之前，在轨道上决定什么算作导弹羽流。与此同时，从少数大型对地静止卫星到由数千颗小型卫星组成的激增的近地轨道星座的转变意味着没有人类团队可以直接解析馈送。数据融合平台现在可以完成这项工作，将雷达、图像和信号情报聚合到一个实时轨道中。即使是一个经过严格测试的狭窄模型也会压缩人类判断的时间，因为自动化这一层的整个论点是轨道和高超音速威胁的移动速度比人们的反应速度要快。

paras.en: And while today’s systems are not the unaligned frontier models Coxon feared, they still introduce a structural risk: the same edge processing and data fusion architecture being built now is the substrate that a future self improving system, if one ever gained access to military networks, would inherit and exploit. A false positive in this setting is not a chatbot hallucination. It is a satellite misreading a solar flare or a glint of debris as a missile plume, and passing that reading up a chain of command that may have only minutes to decide whether to believe it.
paras.zh: 虽然今天的系统并不是 Coxon 所担心的不统一的前沿模型，但它们仍然引入了结构性风险：现在正在构建的相同边缘处理和数据融合架构是未来自我改进系统（如果能够访问军事网络）将继承和利用的基础。这种情况下的误报并不是聊天机器人的幻觉。它是一颗卫星将太阳耀斑或闪烁的碎片误读为导弹羽流，并将读取的信息传递给指挥链，而指挥链可能只有几分钟的时间来决定是否相信它。

paras.en: A useful, if unlikely, point of comparison arrived days apart from the Hubinger exchange. On September 2, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a one-year moratorium on generative AI for public school students through eighth grade, affecting nearly 600,000 children and disabling AI functions in dozens of previously approved classroom programs. The justification was not that the technology does not work. It was that the city could not yet be confident it belonged in a setting where the cost of getting it wrong, a child’s developing capacity to think for herself, was too important to risk on a technology still being evaluated.
paras.zh: 一个有用的（即使不太可能）比较点在 Hubinger 交易所发生几天后就出现了。 9 月 2 日，纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 宣布，公立学校八年级学生暂停使用生成式人工智能一年，这影响了近 60 万名儿童，并在数十个之前批准的课堂项目中禁用了人工智能功能。理由并不是该技术不起作用。问题是，这座城市还不能确信自己属于这样一种环境，在这种环境中，犯错的代价，即孩子独立思考能力的发展，太重要了，不能冒险冒险一项仍在评估的技术。

paras.en: “Children need teachers and human connection in order to learn and in order to grow,” Mamdani said. “We hold an obligation to do the same” when it comes to AI’s role in that development.
paras.zh: “孩子们需要老师和人际关系才能学习和成长，”马姆达尼说。当谈到人工智能在这一发展中的作用时，“我们有义务做同样的事情”。

paras.en: It is worth sitting with the asymmetry this produces. New York City possesses centralized, enforceable authority over what software runs on its own school-issued devices, and used that authority to pause AI in a setting where the downside of error is developmental, not existential. Nuclear-armed states, by contrast, are integrating comparable AI systems into early warning and command infrastructure where the downside of error is civilizational, and there is no equivalent central authority capable of imposing a comparable pause. If the mere possibility of AI eroding a child’s critical thinking was sufficient grounds for New York City to disable the technology outright pending further study, the far larger and more immediate possibility of AI misreading a satellite feed and compressing a nuclear decision to seconds deserves at least the same precautionary instinct, applied to the domain where a mistake cannot be undone.
paras.zh: 值得坐视由此产生的不对称性。纽约市对在自己学校发行的设备上运行哪些软件拥有集中的、可执行的权力，并利用该权力在错误的负面影响是发展而不是存在的环境中暂停人工智能。相比之下，拥有核武器的国家正在将类似的人工智能系统集成到早期预警和指挥基础设施中，其中错误的负面影响是文明的，而且没有同等的中央机构能够实施类似的暂停。如果人工智能侵蚀儿童批判性思维的可能性足以让纽约市有充分理由在进一步研究之前彻底禁用该技术，那么人工智能误读卫星信号并将核决策压缩到几秒钟的更大、更直接的可能性至少值得同样的预防本能，应用于错误无法挽回的领域。

paras.en: The honest complication is that a school district and the international nuclear order are not remotely comparable in their capacity to act on that instinct. A ban is enforceable when one authority controls the devices in question; it is close to unenforceable when the object being restricted is software that can be updated remotely over an encrypted satellite uplink, and when no state trusts another enough to grant the kind of intrusive access that verifying compliance would require. This is precisely the gap that existing international efforts are now trying, with limited success, to close.
paras.zh: 老实说，复杂之处在于，学区和国际核秩序根据这种本能采取行动的能力根本无法相提并论。当一个机构控制相关设备时，禁令即可强制执行；当受到限制的对象是可以通过加密卫星上行链路远程更新的软件，并且没有一个国家足够信任另一个国家以授予验证合规性所需的侵入性访问权限时，它几乎无法执行。这正是现有国际努力正在试图弥补的差距，但成效有限。

paras.en: International bodies efforts to establish global norms regarding AI and nuclear command
paras.zh: 国际机构努力建立有关人工智能和核指挥的全球规范

paras.en: The most direct attempt sits at the United Nations. On December 1, 2025, the General Assembly adopted Resolution A/RES/80/23 on the risks of integrating artificial intelligence into nuclear command, control, and communications, passing 118 to 9 with 44 abstentions. The resolution calls on states to adopt and publish national policies affirming that AI-enabled NC3 systems will remain under human control and will not be capable of autonomously initiating a nuclear launch decision. That it passed with broad support is meaningful. That nine states voted against it, and that France, a nuclear power that itself insists human control must be preserved at every critical stage of a launch decision, was reportedly among them, says something sharper about how far declaratory consensus is from binding practice.
paras.zh: 最直接的尝试来自于联合国。 2025年12月1日，大会以118票对9票、44票弃权通过了关于将人工智能纳入核指挥、控制和通信的风险的A/RES/80/23号决议。该决议呼吁各国通过并公布国家政策，确认人工智能支持的 NC3 系统将继续处于人类控制之下，并且无法自主发起核发射决定。它得到广泛支持的通过是有意义的。据报道，九个国家投了反对票，而法国这个核大国本身就坚持在发射决定的每个关键阶段都必须保留人类控制，这更清楚地表明了宣言性共识与具有约束力的实践之间的差距。

paras.en: Alongside the UN process, the Summit on Responsible AI in the Military Domain, known as REAIM, has become the closest thing to a running multilateral forum on this question. Its third summit was held in A Coruña, Spain, on February 4 and 5, following earlier summits in The Hague in 2023 and Seoul in 2024. It was explicitly framed as an attempt to move from declared principles to “concrete, practical and realistic steps.” That framing was itself a quiet admission that the first two summits had not managed the transition. The 2026 outcome document was endorsed by only 39 states, down from more than 60 in 2024, a decline several analysts have linked to deteriorating relations among the major AI and nuclear powers rather than to any narrowing of the underlying risk.
paras.zh: 除了联合国进程之外，军事领域负责任人工智能峰会（REAIM）已成为该问题最接近正在运行的多边论坛的机构。第三次峰会于 2 月 4 日至 5 日在西班牙拉科鲁尼亚举行，之前曾于 2023 年在海牙和 2024 年在首尔举行过峰会。这次峰会被明确定位为从宣布的原则转向“具体、实际和现实的步骤”的尝试。这一框架本身就是在悄悄承认前两次峰会未能成功实现过渡。 2026 年成果文件仅获得 39 个国家的认可，低于 2024 年的 60 多个国家，一些分析人士认为，这一下降与主要人工智能国家和核大国之间关系的恶化有关，而不是与潜在风险的任何缩小有关。

paras.en: What both processes share is the same structural weakness: They are norm-setting exercises operating in a domain where the thing being regulated, software, cannot be counted, inspected or verified the way a missile silo can. A state can comply with the letter of a resolution on human control while still deploying an AI system that filters, prioritizes and frames the sensor data a human ultimately sees, shaping the decision long before a human formally makes it. The requirement that a person retain final authority does very little if that person’s picture of reality has already been constructed by a model no outside party can audit.
paras.zh: 这两个流程都有一个相同的结构性弱点：它们是在一个领域内进行的规范制定活动，在该领域中，被监管的东西（软件）无法像导弹发射井那样进行计数、检查或验证。一个国家可以遵守关于人类控制的决议的字面意思，同时仍然部署人工智能系统，对人类最终看到的传感器数据进行过滤、优先排序和框架，从而在人类正式做出决定之前很久就做出决定。如果一个人的现实图景已经由外部各方无法审计的模型构建而成，那么要求一个人保留最终权威的要求就没有什么作用。

paras.en: How independent research bodies evaluate these UN blueprints
paras.zh: 独立研究机构如何评估这些联合国蓝图

paras.en: Independent research bodies evaluating these blueprints have converged on a similar diagnosis. In an assessment of the UNGA resolution published shortly after its adoption, the Observer Research Foundation concluded that the measure signals a genuine and broadly shared anxiety among states, but that it remains constrained by exactly the fault lines one would expect: the divide between nuclear and non-nuclear states, the reluctance of major nuclear powers to accept binding restrictions on capabilities they consider central to deterrence and the fact that the resolution’s core language, human control and oversight, was never defined with enough technical precision to be verified rather than merely declared. The same critique applies to REAIM’s outcome documents, which rely on states to describe their own compliance rather than submitting to any external check. Both processes are, in the assessment of the researchers who study them, aspirational rather than enforceable, useful for establishing that a problem is taken seriously, but not yet capable of constraining the behavior of the states whose behavior actually matters.
paras.zh: 评估这些蓝图的独立研究机构已得出类似的诊断。观察家研究基金会在联合国大会决议通过后不久发表的一份评估报告中得出结论，该措施标志着各国之间真正和广泛共同的焦虑，但它仍然受到人们所期望的断层线的限制：核国家与无核国家之间的分歧，主要核大国不愿接受对其认为对威慑至关重要的能力的有约束力的限制，以及该决议的核心语言，即人类控制和监督，从来没有以足够的技术精确度进行定义，而只是宣布。同样的批评也适用于 REAIM 的结果文件，该文件依赖于各州描述自己的合规性，而不是提交给任何外部检查。根据研究人员的评估，这两个过程都是理想的而非可执行的，有助于确定问题得到认真对待，但尚不能限制其行为真正重要的国家的行为。

paras.en: This is, in effect, the diplomatic community’s answer to the technical impossibility of a blanket prohibition. Recognizing this, the UN General Assembly and allied processes have instead pursued a narrower, more realistic strategy: isolating AI from specific, high-consequence use cases, nuclear launch authority chief among them, rather than attempting to regulate military AI as a single undifferentiated category. Resolution A/RES/80/23 is itself an example of this approach in practice. It does not ban AI from space or defence systems generally; it targets one function, the initiation of a nuclear launch decision and insists that function alone remain exclusively human. The strategy is sound in principle. Its weakness, as the evaluations above make clear, is that use-case segregation only works if the boundary between an isolated function and the surrounding system can actually be verified.
paras.zh: 实际上，这是外交界对全面禁止在技术上不可能的问题的回答。认识到这一点，联合国大会和相关进程转而追求一种更狭隘、更现实的战略：将人工智能与具体的、后果严重的用例（其中最主要的是核发射授权）隔离开来，而不是试图将军事人工智能作为一个单一的、无差别的类别进行监管。 A/RES/80/23 号决议本身就是这种方法在实践中的一个例子。它并不普遍禁止人工智能进入太空或防御系统；它针对一项功能，即发起核发射决定，并坚持认为这一功能完全是人类的。该战略原则上是合理的。正如上面的评估所表明的那样，它的弱点是用例隔离只有在隔离功能与周围系统之间的边界实际上可以得到验证的情况下才有效。

paras.en: None of this means the underlying comparison to Mamdani’s classroom ban should be read too literally. What it usefully exposes is the gap between the precautionary standard a single city was willing to apply to a developmental risk and the precautionary standard the international system has so far been able to apply to an existential one. The nuclear order, by contrast, continues to integrate AI into its most sensitive systems while the very researchers building the underlying technology are, in public, on the record, unable to rule out a double-digit chance of civilizational catastrophe. The core policy question this raises is not whether AI can be kept out of nuclear command systems entirely.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着与马姆达尼课堂禁令的潜在比较应该过于字面解读。它有效地揭示了单个城市愿意应用于发展风险的预防标准与国际体系迄今为止能够应用于生存风险的预防标准之间的差距。相比之下，核秩序继续将人工智能整合到其最敏感的系统中，而构建底层技术的研究人员在公开场合却无法排除文明灾难的两位数可能性。这引发的核心政策问题不是人工智能是否可以完全排除在核指挥系统之外。

paras.en: It is whether the international community can move from resolutions that describe the danger, and use-case boundaries that sound precise on paper, to verification mechanisms that actually constrain it, before the gap between declared principle and deployed practice is tested by a false alarm instead of a vote count.
paras.zh: 问题在于国际社会能否在通过虚假警报而不是计票来检验所宣布的原则与部署的实践之间的差距之前，从描述危险的决议和纸面上听起来精确的用例边界转向实际限制危险的核查机制。

articles.title: NaviGate successfully demonstrates onboard precise orbit determination aboard D-Orbit’s ION Satellite Carrier
articles.author: NaviGate

paras.en: ROME, 30/09/2026 – NaviGate, an Italian space technology company spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, has successfully completed the in-orbit demonstration (IoD) of NaviCode Caravel, its autonomous onboard precise orbit determination software, aboard an ION Satellite Carrier operated by D-Orbit. During the demonstration, NaviCode Caravel ran directly on the satellite’s onboard computer, computing the spacecraft’s position in real time using only the raw data of the GNSS receiver already onboard, with no additional hardware.
paras.zh: 罗马，2026 年 9 月 30 日 – NaviGate 是一家从罗马第一大学衍生出来的意大利空间技术公司，在 D-Orbit 运营的 ION 卫星运载器上成功完成了 NaviCode Caravel（其自主机载精确定轨软件）的在轨演示 (IoD)。在演示过程中，NaviCode Caravel 直接在卫星的机载计算机上运行，​​仅使用卫星上已有的 GNSS 接收器的原始数据实时计算航天器的位置，无需额外的硬件。

paras.en: Today, knowing precisely where a satellite is remains largely a ground-based activity: operators rely on dedicated infrastructure, specialized flight dynamics teams, and repeated ground contacts to accurately reconstruct and predict the orbit of each spacecraft. As constellations grow in size and missions become more responsive, this approach turns into a bottleneck in terms of cost, workload, and reaction time. NaviCode Caravel moves precise orbit determination onboard: a software-only product that transforms the raw measurements of the GNSS receiver a satellite already carries into high-accuracy, real-time knowledge of its own position, available directly where operational decisions are made. Beyond determining where the satellite is now, Caravel can also predict where it will be, together with a measure of how reliable that prediction is, giving the spacecraft the forward-looking awareness it needs to anticipate upcoming events, such as ground station contacts or payload operations, and manage them autonomously onboard.
paras.zh: 如今，准确了解卫星的位置在很大程度上仍然是一项地面活动：运营商依靠专用基础设施、专门的飞行动力学团队以及反复的地面接触来准确重建和预测每个航天器的轨道。随着星座规模的扩大和任务的响应速度越来越快，这种方法在成本、工作量和反应时间方面变成了瓶颈。 NaviCode Caravel 实现机载精确轨道确定：这是一款纯软件产品，可将卫星已携带的 GNSS 接收器的原始测量结果转换为对其自身位置的高精度、实时了解，可直接在做出操作决策时使用。除了确定卫星现在的位置之外，Caravel 还可以预测它将在哪里，并衡量该预测的可靠性，从而为航天器提供预测即将发生的事件（例如地面站接触或有效载荷操作）所需的前瞻性意识，并在船上自主管理它们。

paras.en: The demonstration was carried out through D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service and structured in two phases. NaviCode Caravel was first validated on the ground on an engineering model replicating the in-orbit computing environment. The application was then uploaded to an ION Satellite Carrier already in orbit and executed onboard, processing real flight telemetry from the spacecraft’s GNSS receiver across multiple runs.
paras.zh: 该演示通过 D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务进行，分两个阶段进行。 NaviCode Caravel 首先在复制在轨计算环境的工程模型上进行了地面验证。然后，该应用程序被上传到已在轨道上的 ION 卫星载体并在机上执行，在多次运行中处理来自航天器 GNSS 接收器的真实飞行遥测数据。

paras.en: The software executed nominally onboard and in real time without anomalies. Onboard positioning reached a best-case formal uncertainty of 5.2 cm, with mean values in the decimeter range across the runs, using GPS-only measurements. NaviGate then verified the onboard solutions on the ground, proving them consistent with the reference orbits reconstructed through classical ground-based precise orbit determination performed with GODOT, the European Space Agency’s flight dynamics software. NaviCode Caravel is also designed to process multi-constellation GNSS data and correction services such as SBAS and Galileo HAS, enabling even higher accuracy in operational deployments.
paras.zh: 该软件名义上在船上实时执行，没有出现异常。使用仅 GPS 测量，机载定位的最佳情况形式不确定度达到 5.2 厘米，整个运行的平均值在分米范围内。随后，NaviGate 在地面验证了机载解决方案，证明它们与通过欧洲航天局飞行动力学软件 GODOT 执行的经典地面精确轨道确定重建的参考轨道一致。 NaviCode Caravel 还设计用于处理多星座 GNSS 数据和校正服务，例如 SBAS 和 Galileo HAS，从而在操作部署中实现更高的准确性。

paras.en: “Satellites still depend heavily on the ground to know exactly where they are and where they will be. NaviCode Caravel changes that: it is a software product that lets a satellite compute its own position with high accuracy, in real time, using the GNSS receiver it already carries, with no new hardware,” said Andrea Sesta, Chief Technology Officer and Co-founder at NaviGate. “Seeing it run in orbit without a single anomaly, and produce solutions consistent with the reference orbits computed on the ground, is the validation we were working toward, and a real milestone for the whole NaviGate team. D-Orbit’s Software In-Orbit Demonstration service was key to getting there quickly: we developed and tested our application on the ground in the same containerized environment used in orbit, iterated fast, and flew on real flight data within months, which is exactly what a company like ours needs to bring a flight-proven product to market.”
paras.zh: NaviGate 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrea Sesta 表示：“卫星仍然严重依赖地面来准确了解它们所在的位置和将要到达的位置。NaviCode Caravel 改变了这一点：它是一款软件产品，可以让卫星使用其已携带的 GNSS 接收器实时高精度地计算自己的位置，而无需新硬件。” “看到它在轨道上运行而没有出现任何异常，并生成与地面计算的参考轨道一致的解决方案，是我们正在努力实现的验证，也是整个 NaviGate 团队的一个真正的里程碑。D-Orbit 的软件在轨演示服务是快速实现这一目标的关键：我们在轨道上使用的相同容器化环境中在地面上开发和测试了我们的应用程序，快速迭代，并在几个月内根据真实的飞行数据进行了飞行，这正是像我们这样的公司将经过飞行验证的产品推向市场。”

paras.en: “With five networked Intelligence Nodes in orbit, we can give customers access to space infrastructure that is already up and running. For NaviGate, that means testing their precise orbit determination algorithms ingesting raw GNSS measurements and attitude telemetry in real time from D-Orbit’s ION platform, in-situ directly on-board, with no satellite to develop or launch. It’s a practical way to move from simulation to real flight data in less time and at lower cost,” said Viney Jean-Francois Dhiri, Head of Growth, Sales and Marketing of the Space Cloud Business Unit at D-Orbit.
paras.zh: “通过在轨的五个网络智能节点，我们可以让客户访问已经启动并运行的空间基础设施。对于 NaviGate 来说，这意味着测试他们的精确定轨算法，从 D-Orbit 的 ION 平台实时获取原始 GNSS 测量数据和姿态遥测数据，直接在原位机载，无需开发或发射卫星。这是一种在更短的时间内、以更低的成本从模拟转向真实飞行数据的实用方法，”Viney Jean-Francois 说道。 Dhiri，D-Orbit 太空云业务部增长、销售和营销主管。

paras.en: Caravel is the first release of the NaviCode fleet: subsequent versions will extend these capabilities to multi-sensor resilient navigation and to autonomous maneuver planning for large constellations. NaviCode Caravel was also selected as a winner of the CASSINI Challenges 2026, the European Union’s space entrepreneurship competition run by the EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA).
paras.zh: Caravel 是 NaviCode 舰队的第一个版本：后续版本将把这些功能扩展到多传感器弹性导航和大型星座的自主机动规划。 NaviCode Caravel 还被选为 2026 年 CASSINI 挑战赛的获胜者，这是由欧盟太空计划署 (EUSPA) 主办的欧盟太空创业竞赛。

paras.en: The in-orbit demonstration is the culminating milestone of the proof-of-concept program funded by Galaxia, the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures, which backed NaviGate from its earliest stage. NaviGate was founded by researchers who developed deep expertise in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination through their work on ESA and NASA missions, and originated as a spin-off of Sapienza University of Rome.
paras.zh: 这次在轨演示是概念验证项目的最终里程碑，该项目由 Galaxia 资助，Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持，Obloo Ventures 从最初阶段就支持 NaviGate。 NaviGate 的创始人是罗马第一大学的附属机构，他们通过在欧洲航天局 (ESA) 和美国宇航局 (NASA) 任务中的工作，在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面积累了深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: Following the demonstration, NaviGate is engaging constellation operators and mission integrators for the first pilot deployments. NaviCode Caravel addresses concrete needs across the market: reducing the ground workload and infrastructure required for precise orbit determination in constellation operations, enhancing onboard image processing for Earth observation missions, supporting PNT constellations, and improving orbit knowledge for launch vehicles and orbital transfer applications, with further applications across other mission types and orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 演示结束后，NaviGate 正在与星座运营商和任务集成商合作进行首次试点部署。 NaviCode Caravel 满足整个市场的具体需求：减少星座运行中精确定轨所需的地面工作量和基础设施、增强地球观测任务的机载图像处理、支持 PNT 星座、改善运载火箭和轨道转移应用的轨道知识，以及在其他任务类型和轨道制度中的进一步应用。

paras.en: Spun out of Sapienza University of Rome, NaviGate S.r.l. is an Italian space technology startup founded by researchers with extensive experience in spacecraft navigation and precise orbit determination across ESA and NASA missions including Juno, Cassini, Veritas, BepiColombo, and JUICE, and initiatives such as ESA Moonlight and Marconi constellations. The company develops NaviCode, a modular, data-agnostic software platform that enables satellites and constellations to perform precise orbit determination, orbit prediction, and autonomous maneuvering without continuous ground intervention, leveraging GNSS, radiometric, optical, and other navigation measurements. NaviGate was incorporated in 2026 and is backed by Galaxia, Italy’s national technology transfer hub for aerospace, and supported by the ESA BIC Lazio incubation program.
paras.zh: NaviGate S.r.l. 是从罗马第一大学分离出来的。是一家意大利空间技术初创公司，由在航天器导航和精确轨道确定方面拥有丰富经验的研究人员创立，这些研究人员参与了欧空局和美国宇航局的任务，包括朱诺号、卡西尼号、Veritas、BepiColombo 和 JUICE，以及​​欧空局月光和马可尼星座等计划。该公司开发了 NaviCode，这是一个与数据无关的模块化软件平台，使卫星和星座能够利用 GNSS、辐射、光学和其他导航测量来执行精确的定轨、轨道预测和自主操纵，而无需持续的地面干预。 NaviGate 成立于 2026 年，得到意大利国家航空航天技术转移中心 Galaxia 的支持，并得到 ESA BIC Lazio 孵化计划的支持。

paras.en: More information on www.navigate-space.com
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 www.navigate-space.com

paras.en: D-Orbit develops space logistics systems for orbital transportation, hosted payload operations, and in-orbit data processing. Its ION Satellite Carrier is an orbital transfer vehicle (OTV) used for satellite deployment and hosted payload operations; since 2020 it has flown 23 missions and carried 240+ payloads, including hosted payloads and satellites deployed in orbit. The company also provides space cloud services based on onboard computing for in-orbit data processing and is developing GEA, a servicing spacecraft intended to support autonomous rendezvous, inspection, and refueling, as well as NOX, a synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) Earth observation satellite.
paras.zh: D-Orbit 开发用于轨道运输、托管有效载荷操作和在轨数据处理的空间物流系统。其ION卫星载体是一种轨道传输运载工具（OTV），用于卫星部署和托管有效载荷操作；自 2020 年以来，它已执行 23 次飞行任务，携带 240 多个有效载荷，包括托管有效载荷和部署在轨道上的卫星。该公司还提供基于机载计算的空间云服务，用于在轨数据处理，并正在开发 GEA（一种旨在支持自主交会、检查和加油的服务航天器）以及 NOX（一颗合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 地球观测卫星）。

paras.en: Galaxia is the Italian Technology Transfer Hub on Aerospace, powered by CDP Venture Capital together with Obloo Ventures. Its mission is to promote the development of startups conceived within research laboratories specialized in the aerospace sector. The scientific promoters of Galaxia are Politecnico di Torino and Sapienza University of Rome, together with other leading Italian universities, including the University of Padua and Politecnico di Bari. NEVA SGR, the venture capital company of the Intesa Sanpaolo Group, and Compagnia di San Paolo Foundation are investors in the initiative. Obloo Ventures acts as the entrepreneurial partner and co-investor of the hub, managing the scouting, investment execution and portfolio monitoring. Along with Lazio Innova and the I3P Incubator of the Politecnico di Torino, Obloo Ventures also coordinates the business creation program, dedicated to startups originating from academic research and selected by the hub for seed investments.
paras.zh: Galaxia 是意大利航空航天技术转移中心，由 CDP Venture Capital 和 Obloo Ventures 共同支持。其使命是促进航空航天领域专门研究实验室内构思的初创企业的发展。 Galaxia 的科学推动者是都灵理工大学和罗马第一大学，以及其他意大利领先大学，包括帕多瓦大学和巴里理工大学。 Intesa Sanpaolo 集团的风险投资公司 NEVA SGR 和 Compagnia di San Paolo 基金会是该计划的投资者。 Obloo Ventures 是该中心的创业合作伙伴和联合投资者，负责管理搜寻、投资执行和投资组合监控。 Obloo Ventures 与 Lazio Innova 和都灵理工大学的 I3P 孵化器一起协调企业创建计划，致力于源自学术研究并由种子投资中心选择的初创企业。

paras.en: More information on https://galaxia.vc/it/
paras.zh: 更多信息请访问 https://galaxia.vc/it/

articles.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
articles.author: Galileo Space

paras.en: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected and traced to its source. A ship lost at sea may still broadcast a distress signal. A tumbling satellite may lose contact with the ground while still emitting signals that help locate it. Rescue crews may have only hours to find someone before nightfall.
paras.zh: 伽利略航天公司正在建造旨在将信号转化为轨道上答案的卫星。现代国防和商业运营需要快速了解正在发生的事情和地点。现有系统可能会让分段数据在处理过程中爬行数小时或数天。 FPV 无人机和移动雷达必须被快速检测和跟踪。弹道导弹发射羽流检测可以提供关键的早期预警。必须检测干扰导航频率或关键卫星通信链路的干扰并追踪其来源。在海上失踪的船只仍可能会发出求救信号。翻滚的卫星可能会与地面失去联系，但仍会发出有助于定位的信号。救援人员可能只有几个小时的时间才能在夜幕降临之前找到人。

paras.en: The solution combines innovative sensors with AI fusion at the edge to generate actionable reports directly in orbit. The system is designed to operate fully autonomously for weeks, selecting and carrying out its own sensing tasks. It identifies threats, geolocates signals and delivers actionable intelligence to operators within minutes, not hours or days. The mission is to give defense teams the early warning they need to survive and commercial operators the answers they need to act.
paras.zh: 该解决方案将创新传感器与边缘人工智能融合相结合，直接在轨道上生成可操作的报告。该系统设计为完全自主运行数周，选择并执行自己的传感任务。它可以在几分钟（而不是几小时或几天）内识别威胁、对信号进行地理定位并向操作员提供可采取行动的情报。其使命是为防御团队提供生存所需的早期预警，并为商业运营商提供采取行动所需的答案。

paras.en: Working side by side with government stakeholders, the team has developed a deep understanding of operational needs and critical capability gaps. The company is in the final stages of securing its first government contract. Its first demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch in Q4 of 2027 to prove its capabilities in orbit and open the door to a potential Phase III government contract. Galileo has also deepened relationships with commercial companies that need near live data, creating a path to early revenue alongside its defense business.
paras.zh: 该团队与政府利益相关者并肩工作，对运营需求和关键能力差距有了深入的了解。该公司正处于获得第一份政府合同的最后阶段。其第一颗示范卫星计划于 2027 年第四季度发射，以证明其在轨能力，并为潜在的第三阶段政府合同打开大门。伽利略还加深了与需要近乎实时数据的商业公司的关系，为其国防业务创造了一条早期收入的途径。

paras.en: Galileo was selected for a16z speedrun as one of 80 companies chosen from 30,000 applicants.
paras.zh: Galileo 是从 30,000 名申请者中选出的 80 家公司之一，被选为 a16z speedrun 项目的一员。

paras.en: CEO: Brings a decade of experience in national security space and military systems at Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin. Led testing in orbit for protected military communications satellites and consulted for the U.S. Space Force on acquiring new technology. Combines spacecraft engineering expertise with deep knowledge of defense missions, government procurement and what operators need.
paras.zh: 首席执行官：在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和洛克希德·马丁公司拥有十年的国家安全空间和军事系统经验。领导受保护的军用通信卫星在轨测试，并就获取新技术为美国太空军提供咨询。将航天器工程专业知识与国防任务、政府采购和运营商需求的深入了解相结合。

paras.en: CSO: Was responsible for building machine learning systems for Google, YouTube and Amazon’s Prime Video. Brings expertise in AI, software infrastructure and building systems at global scale. Now leads Galileo’s satellite software, bringing that experience into orbit to turn complex sensor data into clear intelligence that operators can act on.
paras.zh: CSO：负责为谷歌、YouTube 和亚马逊的 Prime Video 构建机器学习系统。在全球范围内带来人工智能、软件基础设施和建筑系统方面的专业知识。现在领导伽利略的卫星软件，将这种经验带入轨道，将复杂的传感器数据转化为操作员可以采取行动的清晰情报。

paras.en: CTO: Designed, tested and delivered all RF radios for SpaceX Starship flights, owning the radios through Flight 10, including first booster catch at the tower. Introduced Starship’s first integrated Starlink phased array antenna and RTK GPS receiver hardware that helped guide the booster back to the tower. Previously worked on electronic warfare for a Navy jammer missile at Raytheon and designed high power RF amplifiers for the Navy and Ka band block upconverters for the Army at two startups.
paras.zh: 首席技术官：为 SpaceX 星舰飞行设计、测试并交付了所有 RF 无线电设备，并拥有 10 号航班的无线电设备，包括塔上的第一个助推器捕获器。推出 Starship 首款集成 Starlink 相控阵天线和 RTK GPS 接收器硬件，帮助引导助推器返回塔楼。此前曾在雷神公司从事海军干扰导弹的电子战工作，并在两家初创公司为海军设计高功率射频放大器，为陆军设计 Ka 频段上变频器。

paras.en: Visit our website: https://galileo-space.com
paras.zh: 访问我们的网站：https://galileo-space.com

articles.title: One day behind bars: Students and incarcerated women break prison stigma in Thailand

paras.en: One day behind bars: Students and incarcerated women break prison stigma in Thailand
paras.zh: 入狱一天：泰国学生和被监禁妇女打破监狱耻辱

paras.en: Weo, a prisoner at the Central Women’s Correctional Institution in Bangkok, prefers to sew by hand. She tried the sewing machine, but noticed that her mind was calmer when threading with her fingers directly. By not using a machine, she can produce a unique pattern that is hard to find in conventional shops.
paras.zh: Weo 是曼谷中央女子惩教所的一名囚犯，她更喜欢手工缝纫。她尝试了缝纫机，但发现直接用手指穿线时，她的头脑更平静。通过不使用机器，她可以制作出在传统商店中很难找到的独特图案。

paras.en: She is explaining this to a group of design students who, sketchbooks in hand, are walking through the rows, observing the women who sew.
paras.zh: 她正在向一群设计专业的学生解释这一点，这些学生手里拿着素描本，走过一排排，观察缝纫女工。

paras.en: As time passes, some lose their initial apprehension and sit across from them, picking up fabric samples. Others ask about the products they are making. Some borrow their needles and, with the women’s guidance, try a bit of sewing themselves. A few sit on the floor in the basket-weaving corner with the women who have, by now, mastered the skill.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，一些人失去了最初的恐惧，坐在他们对面，拿起织物样品。其他人询问他们正在生产的产品。有些人借用针，在妇女的指导下尝试自己缝制一些衣服。一些人坐在编织篮子角落的地板上，与那些现在已经掌握了这项技能的妇女一起。

paras.en: Today, the students have left the classroom behind to spend their morning at Thailand’s first women’s prison, where approximately 150 women learn weaving, knitting and machine sewing to make marketable products.
paras.zh: 今天，学生们离开教室，前往泰国第一所女子监狱度过上午，那里约有 150 名妇女学习编织、针织和机缝，以制作适销对路的产品。

paras.en: The students’ task is to design a product that these women can manufacture during their sentences.
paras.zh: 学生们的任务是设计一种产品，供这些女性在服刑期间制造。

paras.en: The initiative, launched in November 2025 by the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the Thailand Institute of Justice (TIJ) pairs design students with incarcerated women to create modern, sustainable products that can be sold outside prison.
paras.zh: 该倡议由联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 和泰国司法研究所 (TIJ) 于 2025 年 11 月发起，将设计专业的学生与被监禁的女性配对，创造出可在监狱外销售的现代、可持续产品。

paras.en: Earlier this year, 22 students visited the prison and interacted with the women who are now manufacturing new products. Their designs had to appeal to modern consumers, be practical and tell a story linked to rehabilitation that would raise awareness of the critical role vocational training plays in reducing recidivism.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，22 名学生参观了监狱，并与正在制造新产品的女性进行了互动。他们的设计必须吸引现代消费者、实用并讲述与康复相关的故事，以提高人们对职业培训在减少累犯方面所发挥的关键作用的认识。

paras.en: “The stigma surrounding those who have made mistakes has long been a wall in our society. To help them cross that barrier, we must restore their human dignity,” said TIJ’s Chontit Chuenurah.
paras.zh: “长期以来，犯错者的耻辱一直是我们社会的一堵墙。为了帮助他们跨越这道障碍，我们必须恢复他们作为人的尊严，”TIJ 的 Chontit Chuenurah 说。

paras.en: “By weaving their stories into these products, we use the creativity of the youth to build a bridge between the prison and the outside world, replacing fear with understanding.”
paras.zh: “通过将他们的故事编织到这些产品中，我们利用年轻人的创造力在监狱和外界之间架起一座桥梁，用理解取代恐惧。”

paras.en: Under the theme Through the Wall, the initiative seeks to dismantle physical and social barriers, helping incarcerated women return successfully to society, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该倡议以“穿越隔离墙”为主题，旨在消除身体和社会障碍，帮助被监禁的妇女成功重返社会。

paras.en: “The project aims to create prison-made goods that appeal to modern consumers while equipping correctional officers with essential marketing skills,” said Aki Okanan, former prison reform expert at UNODC.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室前监狱改革专家阿基·奥卡南 (Aki Okanan) 表示：“该项目旨在创造能够吸引现代消费者的监狱制造商品，同时为惩教人员提供必要的营销技能。”

paras.en: The project also raises international awareness of the role of rehabilitation and vocational training in reducing re-offending she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该项目还提高了国际社会对康复和职业培训在减少再次犯罪方面作用的认识。

paras.en: A panel of judges evaluated nine projects from 19 students in a competition earlier this year.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候的一次竞赛中，评委会对 19 名学生的 9 个项目进行了评估。

paras.en: The winner was Time-Made, featuring intricately smocked watch straps.
paras.zh: 获胜者是 Time-Made，其表带采用精致的褶皱设计。

paras.en: For the students behind the design, time has a two-fold meaning: the sentence that prisoners can reduce by working in prison, and the time that people outside value, a privilege sometimes taken for granted.
paras.zh: 对于设计背后的学生来说，时间有双重意义：囚犯可以通过在监狱里工作来减少刑期，以及外面的人重视的时间，这种特权有时被认为是理所当然的。

paras.en: “We wanted our product to remind people that we can use time carefully and meaningfully. That we can watch our time,” says Game, 21, co-winner of the competition.
paras.zh: “我们希望我们的产品能够提醒人们，我们可以谨慎而有意义地利用时间。我们可以注意自己的时间，”21 岁的竞赛联合获胜者 Game 说道。

paras.en: All designs received support for product development and marketing, and the winning product, together with a selection of others, will be produced in collaboration with partner correctional facilities.
paras.zh: 所有设计都获得了产品开发和营销的支持，获胜产品以及其他精选产品将与合作伙伴惩教机构合作生产。

paras.en: Natty, also 21, has been studying lifestyle products for three years. She had expected the prison to look gloomy and scary and was surprised to find the workroom bright and airy. Still, she noticed that most prisoners used dark colours.
paras.zh: 同样 21 岁的纳蒂已经研究生活方式产品三年了。她原以为监狱会显得阴暗可怕，但惊讶地发现工作室明亮通风。尽管如此，她注意到大多数囚犯都使用深色。

paras.en: “I want to take the skills they have and show them brighter fabrics and see what happens,” she said.
paras.zh: “我想利用他们拥有的技能，向他们展示更明亮的面料，看看会发生什么，”她说。

paras.en: Sitting by Weo’s side, Ana*, from Latin America, tells the story of how she was caught attempting to smuggle cocaine into Bangkok. After four years in prison, she can produce perfect stuffed animals and is fluent in Thai, although she has never seen Thailand outside prison.
paras.zh: 来自拉丁美洲的安娜*坐在韦奥的身边，讲述了她如何因试图向曼谷走私可卡因而被捕的故事。入狱四年后，她可以制作完美的毛绒玩具，并且能说流利的泰语，尽管她从未在监狱外见过泰国。

paras.en: “I heard it’s beautiful here, but it doesn’t matter. After this, when I manage to get back to Brazil, I will start an import business and sell stuffed animals from Thailand. I know how to do it. I have the connections, and I speak the language.”
paras.zh: “我听说这里很漂亮，但这并不重要。之后，当我设法回到巴西时，我将开始一项进口业务，销售来自泰国的毛绒动物。我知道该怎么做。我有关系，而且我会说这种语言。”

paras.en: As the students pass through the gates and security controls to leave, their enthusiasm wanes. Although the prisoners cannot leave, this collaboration connects them to the outside world, the first step in reintegration.
paras.zh: 当学生们通过大门和安全检查离开时，他们的热情逐渐减弱。尽管囚犯无法离开，但这种合作将他们与外界联系起来，这是重返社会的第一步。

articles.title: Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan

paras.en: Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan
paras.zh: 苏丹：南科尔多凡州救援卡车空袭，司机丧生

paras.en: A driver was killed in the attack, which occurred early on Saturday.
paras.zh: 一名司机在周六早些时候发生的袭击中丧生。

paras.en: The contracted trucks were carrying WFP food commodities and were travelling between the cities of Dilling and Kadugli. They were clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles, the UN agency said in a statement.
paras.zh: 承包的卡车运载粮食计划署粮食商品，在迪林市和卡杜格利市之间行驶。该联合国机构在一份声明中表示，它们被明确标记为人道主义车辆。

paras.en: Additional details regarding the circumstances of the incident, and the extent of the damage to the food cargo, are still being determined.
paras.zh: 有关事件情况以及食品货物损坏程度的更多细节仍在确定中。

paras.en: WFP called for a prompt and impartial investigation into the incident and for those responsible to be held to account.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署呼吁对这一事件进行迅速、公正的调查，并追究责任人的责任。

paras.en: The attack came just one day after a WFP truck hit an explosive device in Dilling after delivering food assistance.
paras.zh: 就在这次袭击发生的一天前，粮食计划署的一辆卡车在运送粮食援助后在迪林撞上爆炸装置。

paras.en: “These incidents underscore the increasingly challenging security environment in Sudan and the risks that aid workers face when delivering life-saving assistance to communities in need,” the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“这些事件凸显了苏丹日益严峻的安全环境，以及援助人员在向有需要的社区提供救生援助时面临的风险。”

paras.en: WFP underlined its committed to safely delivering life-saving assistance to millions across Sudan who depend on humanitarian support.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署强调，其致力于向苏丹各地依赖人道主义支持的数百万人安全地提供救生援助。

paras.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and former allies the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) have been fighting since April 2023. Last year, more than 30 million people needed humanitarian assistance, according to the UN aid coordination office OCHA.
paras.zh: 苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 和前盟友快速支援部队 (RSF) 自 2023 年 4 月以来一直在战斗。根据联合国援助协调办公室 OCHA 的数据，去年有超过 3000 万人需要人道主义援助。

paras.en: WFP urged all those involved in the fighting to respect their obligations under international humanitarian law, protect civilians and civilian infrastructure, and ensure safe and unimpeded access for both humanitarian personnel and cargo.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署敦促所有参与战斗的各方遵守国际人道主义法规定的义务，保护平民和民用基础设施，并确保人道主义人员和货物安全、无障碍地通行。

articles.title: UN upholds housing as a human right on World Habitat Day

paras.en: UN upholds housing as a human right on World Habitat Day
paras.zh: 联合国在世界人居日将住房视为一项人权

paras.en: They gathered to commemorate World Habitat Day which this year focuses on the theme of Adequate Housing for All.
paras.zh: 他们聚集在一起纪念世界人居日，今年的主题是“人人享有适当住房”。

paras.en: “Adequate housing is not a luxury. It is a foundation for a dignified life and for sustainable cities,” said Anacláudia Rossbach, Executive Director of UN-Habitat, the agency that promotes sustainable urbanization.
paras.zh: “充足的住房不是奢侈品。它是有尊严的生活和可持续城市的基础，”促进可持续城市化的联合国人居署执行主任阿纳克劳迪亚·罗斯巴赫 (Anacláudia Rossbach) 表示。

paras.en: She stressed that “housing needs to be treated as a public priority alongside land and basic services”, underlining the need for greater investment in communities and cooperation across government, the private sector and civil society.
paras.zh: 她强调，“住房需要与土地和基本服务一起被视为公共优先事项”，强调需要加大对社区的投资以及政府、私营部门和民间社会之间的合作。

paras.en: In his message for the day, UN Secretary-General António Guterres called adequate housing for all “the foundation of dignity, security, and opportunity.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在当天的致辞中称，为所有人提供充足的住房是“尊严、安全和机会的基础”。

paras.en: He noted, however, that more than three billion people worldwide are denied this universal human right.
paras.zh: 然而，他指出，全世界有超过 30 亿人被剥夺了这项普遍人权。

paras.en: “Over one billion live in informal settlements and slums, and many more experience homelessness or have been displaced by conflict, disasters, and climate change,” he added.
paras.zh: “超过十亿人生活在非正规住区和贫民窟，还有更多人无家可归或因冲突、灾害和气候变化而流离失所，”他补充道。

paras.en: The President of the United Nations Habitat Assembly, Nga Kor Ming, reminded participants that behind the numbers are real people.
paras.zh: 联合国人居大会主席Nga Kor Ming提醒与会者，数字背后是真实的人。

paras.en: Mr. Ming – Malaysia’s Minister of Housing and Local Government – highlighted the plight of families living in homes without legal protection, or even basic sanitation and clean water, whose children suffer preventable diseases.
paras.zh: 马来西亚住房和地方政府部长明先生强调了生活在没有法律保护、甚至没有基本卫生设施和清洁水的家庭中的困境，他们的孩子患有可预防的疾病。

paras.en: “A house without clean water, safety or legal security is not a home. It is a poverty trap,” he said in a video message. “Therefore, to deliver adequate housing for all, we must move away from quick fixes to systemic transformation.”
paras.zh: “没有清洁水、安全或法律保障的房子不是家。这是一个贫困陷阱，”他在视频信息中说。 “因此，为了为所有人提供充足的住房，我们必须从权宜之计转向系统性转型。”

paras.en: Ms. Rossbach explained that under the UN human rights framework, housing is considered adequate when it meets seven criteria that include availability of services, habitability, affordability, location and accessibility.
paras.zh: 罗斯巴赫女士解释说，根据联合国人权框架，住房满足七项标准即被认为是充足的，包括服务的可用性、可居住性、可负担性、位置和可达性。

paras.en: “Adequate housing means much more than a physical structure with four walls and a roof,” she said.
paras.zh: “足够的住房不仅仅意味着有四堵墙和一个屋顶的物理结构，”她说。

paras.en: “A family may have a roof and still spend so much on rent that there is little left for food, education, or healthcare. A home may be affordable, but located far from jobs, schools, or transport.”
paras.zh: “一个家庭可能有屋顶，但仍然在租金上花费大量资金，以至于几乎没有剩下的钱用于食物、教育或医疗保健。房屋可能是负担得起的，但远离工作、学校或交通。”

paras.en: The UN Secretary-General upheld that “investing in adequate housing and transforming informal settlements reduces poverty, tackles inequality, builds climate resilience, and fosters peaceful and inclusive societies.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长坚持认为，“投资适足住房和改造非正规住区可以减少贫困，解决不平等问题，增强气候适应能力，并促进和平和包容的社会。”

paras.en: He called for coordinated action by national and local governments, building stronger partnerships, and better use of data in decision-making.
paras.zh: 他呼吁国家和地方政府采取协调行动，建立更强有力的伙伴关系，并在决策中更好地利用数据。

paras.en: “The international financial architecture must also be reformed to mobilize the adequate, predictable, and affordable financing developing countries need to invest in housing at scale,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“还必须改革国际金融架构，以调动发展中国家大规模住房投资所需的充足、可预测和负担得起的融资。”

paras.en: The Secretary-General ended his message with an appeal to the international community.
paras.zh: 秘书长在致辞最后向国际社会发出呼吁。

paras.en: “On this World Habitat Day, let us treat housing as a public good and build a world where everyone has a place to call home,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在这个世界人居日，让我们将住房视为公共利益，建设一个人人都有家的世界。”

paras.en: World Habitat Day is observed annually on the first Monday in October.
paras.zh: 每年十月的第一个星期一是世界人居日。

paras.en: It marks the start of UN-Habitat’s Urban October – a month-long campaign to advocate for housing and sustainable urban development that concludes on World Cities Day, 31 October.
paras.zh: 它标志着联合国人居署“城市十月”的开始——这是一项为期一个月的倡导住房和可持续城市发展的运动，将于 10 月 31 日世界城市日结束。

articles.title: JJ Gabriel's next club likely to be in Europe

paras.en: JJ Gabriel: Man Utd prodigy yet to make decision on future amid interest from Barcelona, Real Madrid, Bayern Munich and PSG
paras.zh: JJ加布里埃尔：由于巴塞罗那、皇家马德里、拜仁慕尼黑和巴黎圣日耳曼的兴趣，曼联神童尚未就未来做出决定

paras.en: Sky Sports News understands JJ Gabriel and his family are yet to make a decision on his future; Barcelona, Real Madrid, Bayern Munich and PSG all interested; it is likely Gabriel's next club is in Europe; United could consider legal action if he moves to a European club
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻了解到 JJ 加布里埃尔和他的家人尚未就他的未来做出决定；巴塞罗那、皇家马德里、拜仁慕尼黑和巴黎圣日耳曼都有兴趣；加布里埃尔的下一个俱乐部很可能是在欧洲；如果他转会到欧洲俱乐部，曼联可能会考虑采取法律行动

paras.en: JJ Gabriel and his family are yet to make a decision on his future but it is increasingly likely his next club will be in Europe.
paras.zh: JJ加布里埃尔和他的家人尚未就他的未来做出决定，但他的下一个俱乐部很可能会在欧洲。

paras.en: Real Madrid and Barcelona retain a strong interest, while Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich continue to keep a close eye on his situation.
paras.zh: 皇家马德里和巴塞罗那保留了浓厚的兴趣，而巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑继续密切关注他的情况。

paras.en: Gabriel turned 16 on Tuesday, which is the age at which European clubs are allowed to sign him to a professional contract.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔周二就满16岁了，这是欧洲俱乐部可以与他签订职业合同的年龄。

paras.en: Gabriel is eligible to apply for a European passport through his parents.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔有资格通过父母申请欧洲护照。

paras.en: - Transfer Centre LIVE! | Man Utd news & transfers🔴
paras.zh: - 换乘中心上线！ |曼联新闻和转会🔴

paras.en: - Man Utd fixtures & scores | FREE Man Utd highlights▶️
paras.zh: - 曼联赛程和比分|免费曼联精彩集锦▶️

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 PL 比赛📺

paras.en: Sky Sports News reported on Monday evening that United will consider legal action if he moves to a European club.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻周一晚上报道称，如果他转会到欧洲俱乐部，曼联将考虑采取法律行动。

paras.en: However, it is understood that this is not a concern to Gabriel and his camp as they consider their next move for the 16-year-old.
paras.zh: 然而，据了解，这并不是加布里埃尔及其团队所关心的，因为他们正在考虑这位 16 岁球员的下一步行动。

paras.en: Gabriel was pictured in United's squad photo for the 2026/27 season on Monday but is still expected to leave Old Trafford.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔周一出现在曼联2026/27赛季的阵容照片中，但预计仍将离开老特拉福德。

paras.en: Sky Sports News understands the picture was taken on September 8, when Gabriel was still at the club and expected to feature for the first team this season.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻了解到这张照片拍摄于 9 月 8 日，当时加布里埃尔仍在俱乐部，预计本赛季将代表一线队出场。

paras.en: It was just days later that Gabriel and his family put in a formal request to leave.
paras.zh: 几天后，加布里埃尔和他的家人正式提出离开的请求。

paras.en: Gabriel remains registered with United and Sky Sports News understands multiple attempts have been made to reconcile the situation with the 16-year-old and his family, with duty of care being a factor for such a young player, but no progress has been made.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔仍然在曼联注册，天空体育新闻了解到，已经多次尝试与这位 16 岁的球员及其家人调和，照顾义务是这样一位年轻球员的一个因素，但没有取得任何进展。

paras.en: Gabriel has attracted the interest of Europe's biggest clubs and talks have taken place between his camp and the likes of Barcelona and Real Madrid, with PSG and Bayern Munich also interested in the young attacking talent.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔吸引了欧洲最大俱乐部的兴趣，他的阵营与巴塞罗那和皇家马德里等球队进行了谈判，巴黎圣日耳曼和拜仁慕尼黑也对这位年轻的进攻天才感兴趣。

paras.en: From United's perspective, they feel they have done all they can to show Gabriel and his family a clear pathway to their first team while also protecting his long-term development.
paras.zh: 从曼联的角度来看，他们认为自己已尽一切努力向加布里埃尔和他的家人展示一条通往一线队的清晰道路，同时也保护他的长期发展。

paras.en: This involves, for example, featuring in the first-team squad photo that was released on Monday - a message he was to be involved in Michael Carrick's plans this season.
paras.zh: 例如，这包括在周一发布的一线队照片中出现——这是他将参与迈克尔·卡里克本赛季计划的信息。

paras.en: Another action they would point to is having Gabriel train with the first team for pre-season while also making his debut against Atletico Madrid in a friendly during that time.
paras.zh: 他们指出的另一项行动是让加布里埃尔在季前赛中随一线队训练，同时在对阵马德里竞技的友谊赛中首次亮相。

paras.en: However, Gabriel and his family would point to wanting more than the eight to nine minutes off the bench that he got in that particular game.
paras.zh: 然而，加布里埃尔和他的家人表示，他们想要的不仅仅是他在那场比赛中替补出场的八到九分钟。

paras.en: Gabriel's involvement in pre-season came after the then 15-year-old failed to report back with the academy squad at the beginning of pre-season as expected.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔参加季前赛之前，当时15岁的他未能按预期在季前赛开始时随青训队报到。

paras.en: The U21s arrived back at Carrington a week before the first team, and Gabriel was due back at the same time.
paras.zh: U21 队比一线队提前一周回到卡灵顿，加布里埃尔也将在同一时间回归。

paras.en: But his family believed it was beneath him and were of the view he should only be involved in first-team training and so pulled him out of reporting back with the U21s.
paras.zh: 但他的家人认为他这样做有失身份，并认为他应该只参加一线队的训练，因此让他不再随U21队报到。

paras.en: Sky Sports News also understands Gabriel had an individual development plan led by first-team coaches at the club, including the first-team's medical and performance departments - who all engaged with Gabriel and his family to ensure he was receiving the attention they felt he deserved.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻还了解到，加布里埃尔有一个由俱乐部一线队教练领导的个人发展计划，包括一线队的医疗和表现部门，他们都与加布里埃尔和他的家人合作，以确保他得到他们认为应得的关注。

paras.en: However, despite there being a feeling from inside the club the relationship between them and Gabriel's camp was harmonious, there was a difference of opinion over how much he would feature for the first team at the beginning of the season.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管俱乐部内部感觉他们和加布里埃尔阵营之间的关系很融洽，但对于他在赛季初能为一线队出场多少却存在不同意见。

paras.en: Gabriel and his family requested he feature for at least 20 minutes against Sabah in the Champions League, Brighton in the FA Cup and Bournemouth in the Premier League on October 25. This was all before beginning negotiations around a scholarship contract to secure his future at the club.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔和他的家人要求他在10月25日对阵沙巴的冠军联赛、足总杯对阵布莱顿的比赛以及英超联赛对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中出场至少20分钟。这一切都是在开始围绕奖学金合同进行谈判之前进行的，以确保他在俱乐部的未来。

paras.en: Gabriel was ineligible for the first-team tie against Sabah as he was not put in United's A-list. Instead, he played against the Azerbaijani side in the UEFA Youth League that day and scored a hat-trick.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔没有资格参加对阵沙巴的一线队比赛，因为他没有进入曼联的一线队名单。相反，他当天在青年欧足联对阵阿塞拜疆队的比赛中上演了帽子戏法。

paras.en: Now that Gabriel has turned 16, he would automatically be added to the club's B-list and would be eligible for matchday squads going forward - but Gabriel's family will believe that was the opportune moment for him to be involved in first-team action.
paras.zh: 现在加布里埃尔已经年满 16 岁，他将自动被添加到俱乐部的 B 名单中，并且有资格参加接下来的比赛大名单 - 但加布里埃尔的家人会认为这是他参与一线队比赛的最佳时机。

paras.en: As previously reported, despite being registered until the end of the season, there is a belief that due to a FIFA loophole, Gabriel could leave United for a club in Europe after his 16th birthday if he obtains a European passport, which he could through either of his parents.
paras.zh: 正如之前报道的那样，尽管在赛季结束前都已登记，但人们相信，由于国际足联的漏洞，如果加布里埃尔通过父母之一获得欧洲护照，他可以在 16 岁生日后离开曼联前往欧洲的俱乐部。

paras.en: Gabriel has not trained with United since.
paras.zh: 从那以后，加布里埃尔就没有再跟随曼联训练。

paras.en: Club sources believe the tension between the two camps stems from Gabriel's family wanting to chase historical records and United wanting to protect his long-term development.
paras.zh: 俱乐部消息人士认为，两个阵营之间的紧张关系源于加布里​​埃尔的家人想要追逐历史记录，而曼联则想要保护他的长期发展。

paras.en: To this point, no club-to-club contact has been made regarding the availability of Gabriel.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，俱乐部之间还没有就加布里埃尔的可用性进行任何联系。

paras.en: Sky Sports News has been told that if a European club tries to lure him away through a FIFA loophole, United will consider legal action.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻获悉，如果欧洲俱乐部试图利用国际足联的漏洞引诱他离开，曼联将考虑采取法律行动。

paras.en: It is presumed from the club's perspective that the change in attitude from Gabriel's family around the Sabah game revolves around promises made from elsewhere - whether from another European club or potential representation acting on Gabriel and his family's behalf.
paras.zh: 从俱乐部的角度来看，加布里埃尔的家人对沙巴比赛态度的转变是围绕着其他地方做出的承诺——无论是来自另一家欧洲俱乐部还是代表加布里埃尔及其家人的潜在代表。

paras.en: For now the teenager remains a United player and despite the fractured relationship, those at the club still believe they are the best place for Gabriel and his individual development.
paras.zh: 目前，这名少年仍然是曼联球员，尽管关系破裂，但俱乐部的人仍然相信他们是加布里埃尔及其个人发展的最佳场所。

paras.en: However, it remains unlikely we will ever see Gabriel in a United shirt again, with Europe's biggest clubs circling the young star.
paras.zh: 然而，我们仍然不太可能再次看到加布里埃尔身披曼联球衣，欧洲最大的俱乐部都在关注这位年轻球星。

articles.title: Rock bottom to NFL stardom: The rise of London's Jermaine Eluemunor

paras.en: Jermaine Eluemunor: British New York Giants star reveals rise from rock bottom to NFL success story two decades after discovering football in London
paras.zh: 杰梅因·埃卢穆诺 (Jermaine Eluemunor)：英国纽约巨人队球星讲述了在伦敦发现足球二十年后从最低谷到 NFL 的成功故事

paras.en: Britain's Jermaine Eluemunor opens up on his battle with mental health and inspiring the next generation with his journey to NFL stardom; This story covers themes of mental health, which some may find distressing. If you are affected by this story, please visit sky.com/viewersupport
paras.zh: 英国的 Jermaine Eluemunor 讲述了他与心理健康的斗争，并通过他的 NFL 明星之旅激励了下一代；这个故事涵盖了心理健康的主题，有些人可能会觉得令人痛苦。如果您受到此故事的影响，请访问 sky.com/viewersupport

paras.en: Jermaine Eluemunor is a self-confessed simple man, striving to inspire by way of a not-so-simple journey. From London to New York, he is a big man with a big heart and a big message.
paras.zh: Jermaine Eluemunor 自认是一个简单的人，努力通过一次不那么简单的旅程来激发灵感。从伦敦到纽约，他是一个有着宽广胸怀和伟大信息的大人物。

paras.en: The Giants offensive tackle dresses up, hosts pretend tea parties and plays the role of punching bag as a proud girl-dad to his young daughters of a week day, and manhandles the greatest athletes on the planet of a weekend. He enjoys the serenity of fishing and escapism of anime off the field, and flourishes in the art of violence on it.
paras.zh: 巨人队的进攻截锋会盛装打扮，举办假装茶会，并在工作日扮演出气筒的角色，为他年幼的女儿们扮演骄傲的女孩爸爸，并在周末粗暴地对待地球上最伟大的运动员。他享受钓鱼的宁静和场外动漫的逃避现实，并在场上的暴力艺术中蓬勃发展。

paras.en: Eluemunor has bridged a transatlantic chasm, swatted away early rejection and overcome 'rock bottom' amid the fiercest of challenges to his mental health to emerge as one of Britain's most gifted footballing exports and, so too, one of the NFL's premier players in his position.
paras.zh: 埃卢穆诺跨越了大西洋两岸的鸿沟，克服了早期的拒绝，并在心理健康面临最严峻的挑战时克服了“最低谷”，成为英国最有天赋的足球出口之一，同时也是 NFL 中与他一样的顶级球员之一。

paras.en: Life wasn't always going to be this way. He now hopes his story can prescribe immunity to the notion of impossible.
paras.zh: 生活并不总是这样。他现在希望他的故事能够让人们免于“不可能”的概念。

paras.en: - The Chiefs stay perfect thanks to new hero - NFL Sunday Review
paras.zh: - 酋长队凭借新英雄保持完美 - NFL 周日回顾

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "I grew up in Chalk Farm, North West London, right next to Camden Town," Eluemunor tells Sky Sports. "I grew up in a flat on Ferdinand Street, quite small actually, I was just thinking about how small those places were. I went back to see it and I don't even think I fit through the front door now."
paras.zh: “我在伦敦西北部的乔克农场长大，就在卡姆登镇旁边，”埃卢穆诺告诉天空体育。 “我在费迪南街的一套公寓里长大，实际上很小，我只是在想那些地方有多小。我回去看了看，我什至认为我现在连前门都进不去了。”

paras.en: It was around this time in 2007 when Eluemunor first discovered football, a session of channel-flicking on TV seeing him stumble across the first-ever NFL regular-season game to be played in London as the Giants faced the Miami Dolphins at Wembley Stadium. Almost two decades on, he is starting for the team where it all began, for whom his impact was rewarded with a $39m contract extension this past offseason and a role as captain this past weekend.
paras.zh: 大约在 2007 年的这个时候，埃卢穆诺第一次接触到了橄榄球，在一次电视频道切换中，他偶然发现了在伦敦举行的首场 NFL 常规赛，当时巨人队在温布利体育场对阵迈阿密海豚队。近二十年过去了，他为这支一切开始的球队首发，他的影响力在上个休赛期得到了一份价值 3900 万美元的续约合同，并在上周末担任了队长。

paras.en: "It was just spur of the moment luck, honestly," he says. "I think that God intended for me to find that game because he knew that was part of my purpose in life to play this game at the highest level and try to achieve what I'm attempting to achieve."
paras.zh: “老实说，这只是一时的运气，”他说。 “我认为上帝想让我找到这款游戏，因为他知道这是我人生目标的一部分，以最高水平玩这款游戏并努力实现我想要实现的目标。”

paras.en: Eluemunor, now 31, moved to New Jersey with his father at the age of 14 in search of greater opportunities, before first playing American football at Morris Knolls High School. His dwarfing stature made an immediate impression, while also prompting some early book-cover-judgement from one coach who made the assumption of a ready-made monster.
paras.zh: 现年 31 岁的埃卢穆诺在 14 岁时随父亲搬到了新泽西州，寻找更多的机会，之后第一次在莫里斯·诺尔斯高中 (Morris Knolls High School) 踢美式橄榄球。他矮小的身材立刻给人留下了深刻的印象，同时也促使一位教练做出了一些早期的书籍封面判断，他假设他是一个现成的怪物。

paras.en: "I had never touched a weight in my entire life," he says. "I remember them putting 225 up on the bar and I lifted it up and it fell right on my chest because I wasn't strong at all. Now I can bench over 500 pounds. It was a crazy first day for me, and then just walking around, I'm the English kid."
paras.zh: “我一生中从未碰过重物，”他说。 “我记得他们在杠上放了 225 磅，我举起它，它正好落在我的胸口，因为我一点也不强壮。现在我可以卧推超过 500 磅。这对我来说是疯狂的第一天，然后就到处走动，我就是那个英国孩子。”

paras.en: Despite spending half of his life stateside, he will seemingly forever remain the 'British guy' of NFL locker rooms.
paras.zh: 尽管他大半生都在美国度过，但他似乎永远都是 NFL 更衣室里的“英国人”。

paras.en: "People still make fun of me for being British every single day, that's never going to go away," he jokes. "I'm literally made fun of for being English every single day, people do English accents every single day."
paras.zh: “人们仍然每天都取笑我是英国人，这种情况永远不会消失，”他开玩笑说。 “我每天都因为自己是英国人而被取笑，人们每天都带着英国口音。”

paras.en: Still, Eluemunor has never been one to shirk his roots, and this year returned to the UK to stage a four-day camp series that would reach 385 kids. The family of one child notably drove more than two hours each way to attend one of the sessions.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，Eluemunor 从来没有逃避自己的根源，今年他回到英国举办了为期四天的夏令营系列活动，将有 385 名孩子参加。值得注意的是，一个孩子的家庭单程开车两个多小时来参加其中一场活动。

paras.en: "It's about showing kids that it doesn't matter where you live, where you're from, the colour of your skin, tall, short, big, small, it doesn't matter who you are, you can achieve whatever you want in life," he explained. "I try to be a figure that they can look to as inspiration because I wasn't anything growing up.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“这是为了向孩子们表明，无论你住在哪里、来自哪里、肤色、高矮、大、小，无论你是谁，你都可以实现生活中你想要的一切。” “我努力成为一个可以被他们视为灵感的人物，因为我在成长过程中什么都不是。

paras.en: "I had dreams, but I didn't know if they were possible to achieve. I want to show these kids that you may not be where you want to be right now, but if you keep working, there's nothing stopping you from achieving what you want to achieve."
paras.zh: “我有梦想，但我不知道它们是否有可能实现。我想向这些孩子们表明，你现在可能还没有达到你想要的目标，但如果你继续努力，没有什么可以阻止你实现你想要实现的目标。”

paras.en: His tale is one of patience and persistence. Eluemunor, despite the hundreds of emails he sent to schools across the country, was not initially recruited by any college programs out of high school and as a result joined Lackawanna College. Such was his impact on the football field he was eventually recruited by 35 colleges and spent three years with Texas A&M before being selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the fifth round of the 2017 NFL Draft. The transition, as it had been upon arriving in the US, would prove anything but an easy weight to shift.
paras.zh: 他的故事是关于耐心和坚持的故事。尽管埃卢穆诺向全国各地的学校发送了数百封电子邮件，但他最初并没有被任何高中毕业的大学项目招募，因此加入了拉克瓦纳学院。这就是他对足球场的影响，最终他被 35 所大学录取，并在德克萨斯农工大学 (Texas A&M) 工作了三年，然后在 2017 年 NFL 选秀第五轮被巴尔的摩乌鸦队选中。事实证明，这一转变绝非是一件容易转移的重担，就像抵达美国时一样。

paras.en: He made just three starts in his first two seasons with the Ravens, remembering vividly of the fans that had claimed he 'sucked' while suggesting he did not belong in the NFL. Eluemunor was ultimately traded to the New England Patriots in August 2019, prompting the most difficult and yet most defining chapter of his career.
paras.zh: 他在乌鸦队的前两个赛季只首发了三场，他清楚地记得那些声称他“糟糕”并暗示他不属于 NFL 的球迷。埃卢穆诺最终于 2019 年 8 月被交易到新英格兰爱国者队，开启了他职业生涯中最困难但也是最具决定性的一章。

paras.en: "It shaped me completely," he says. "I was the lowest of the lowest in New England, it was pretty tough, really tough.
paras.zh: “它彻底塑造了我，”他说。 “我是新英格兰最低的最低的，这非常艰难，真的很艰难。

paras.en: "I learned a lot about myself. I learned a lot about what it took to really belong in this league. But then also I learned that mentally, I'm a lot stronger than I think I am. If I can get through that, I can get through anything."
paras.zh: “我学到了很多关于自己的知识。我学到了很多关于如何真正属于这个联盟的知识。但后来我也了解到，在精神上，我比我想象的要坚强得多。如果我能克服这些，我就能克服任何困难。”

paras.en: Eluemunor was limited to 29 snaps on offense in his first campaign in New England, his progress hindered by an ankle injury in Week Six before a Patriots teammate fell on his leg upon his return to practice, leaving him in tears amid another setback to his career.
paras.zh: 埃卢埃穆诺在新英格兰的第一个赛季中只在进攻上出手29次，第六周脚踝受伤阻碍了他的进步，之后爱国者队的队友在他返回训练时摔倒在他的腿上，让他在职业生涯的又一次挫折中流下了眼泪。

paras.en: He admits he became guilty of buying into criticism he read on social media and in turn speaking negatively about himself, at one stage crying to Patriots trainer Daryl Nelson amid his troubled efforts to transition to a new role at left tackle.
paras.zh: 他承认，他因接受了社交媒体上的批评而感到内疚，进而对自己进行了负面评价，在他努力过渡到左截锋新角色的过程中，他一度向爱国者队教练达里尔·尼尔森哭泣。

paras.en: "Everyone has a goal and a dream, and when you feel that thing slip away and you feel there's nothing you can do to control that, you kind of just go into a spiral. And before you know, you can hit rock bottom," he explains.
paras.zh: “每个人都有一个目标和梦想，当你感觉那些东西溜走了，你觉得你无能为力来控制它时，你就会陷入螺旋。在你知道之前，你可能会跌入谷底，”他解释道。

paras.en: "In order to get out of rock bottom, it takes certain people to pull you from that, you can't do it alone. You need people to help you along the way. I had great people in my life that truly helped pull me out from rock bottom and put me on the path that I needed to be on.
paras.zh: “为了走出低谷，需要某些人来把你拉出来，你不能独自做到这一点。你需要有人一路帮助你。我生命中有很多伟大的人，他们真正帮助我从低谷中拉出来，让我走上我需要走的道路。

paras.en: "I'm a very lucky person because not a lot of people can get all the way to rock bottom and be able to pull themselves out and make something of themselves. I'm a lucky person, but I also work really, really hard, I worked really hard to get away from that mentally and I worked really hard to get where I'm at now."
paras.zh: “我是一个非常幸运的人，因为没有多少人能够一路跌入谷底，并能够摆脱困境，做出自己的事情。我是一个幸运的人，但我也非常非常努力地工作，我非常努力地摆脱精神上的束缚，我非常努力地工作才达到现在的水平。”

paras.en: At his lowest, he would have to field questions as to whether he ever thought about taking his own life, previously insisting he never quite strayed as far as that idea, largely thanks to a devoted support network led by his wife Christina.
paras.zh: 在他处于最低谷时，他不得不回答自己是否曾想过结束自己的生命，此前他坚称自己从未有过这样的想法，这在很大程度上要归功于由他的妻子克里斯蒂娜领导的忠诚支持网络。

paras.en: "I think that nowadays mental health is such a huge thing, I think the more people are willing to be open about it, the better things will be," he explains.
paras.zh: “我认为现在心理健康是一件大事，我认为越多的人愿意公开谈论它，事情就会越好，”他解释道。

paras.en: "A lot of the times we think that we have to be these strong, tough, imposing figures, especially being an offensive lineman in the NFL, people start to think of you as superhero-esque and they don't think that you're a normal person.
paras.zh: “很多时候，我们认为我们必须成为这些强大、坚韧、令人印象深刻的人物，尤其是作为 NFL 的进攻前锋，人们开始认为你是超级英雄式的，他们不认为你是一个正常人。

paras.en: "But to be able to share the way you feel and what you're going through and show just how normal you really are, I think that goes a long way in shedding light on subjects that are a little bit more sensitive, especially when it comes to mental health.
paras.zh: “但是，能够分享你的感受和正在经历的事情，并展示你到底有多正常，我认为这对于揭示一些更敏感的话题大有帮助，尤其是在心理健康方面。

paras.en: "If you can learn how to control the narrative and just work hard and really be vulnerable and open with people, then you'll see that people are way more accepting than you think and believe. Then you find a great group or team like I've been lucky enough to find with the Giants, then people just fall in love with you and the person you are and you don't have to be someone you're not and you're able to just be yourself."
paras.zh: “如果你能学会如何控制叙事，努力工作，真正表现出脆弱，对人开放，那么你会发现人们比你想象和相信的更容易接受。然后你会找到一个伟大的团体或团队，就像我很幸运地在巨人队找到的那样，然后人们就会爱上你和你这个人，你不必成为别人，你就可以做你自己。”

paras.en: Eluemunor became a free agent following the 2020 season before being cut by both the Miami Dolphins and Jacksonville Jaguars during preseason. He then signed with the Las Vegas Raiders and made three starts at right guard before being benched for the remainder of the season.
paras.zh: 埃卢穆诺在 2020 赛季结束后成为自由球员，但在季前赛期间被迈阿密海豚队和杰克逊维尔美洲虎队裁掉。随后他与拉斯维加斯突袭者队签约，并在右后卫位置上首发了三场，然后在本赛季余下的时间里坐在替补席上。

paras.en: He was handed a one-year $1.3m deal to stay with the team in 2022, paving the way for his most productive year yet as Eluemunor started all 17 games to earn a $3m extension. Criticism of his work ethic and attitude from interim coach Rich Bisaccia had ignited a dogged reply; the physical attributes to dominate and the potential to cement a starting spot in the NFL had always been there to be unlocked, and everybody knew it. Coaches were desperate to see Eluemunor fulfil as much, and put on a smile while doing so.
paras.zh: 他获得了一份为期一年、价值 130 万美元的合同，并在 2022 年留在球队，为他迄今为止最高效的一年铺平了道路，埃卢穆诺首发了全部 17 场比赛，并获得了价值 300 万美元的续约合同。临时教练里奇·比萨恰(Rich Bisaccia)对他的职业道德和态度的批评激起了他顽强的回应。统治联盟的身体素质和巩固 NFL 首发位置的潜力一直都在等待释放，每个人都知道这一点。教练们迫切希望看到埃卢穆诺实现同样的目标，并在这样做时面带微笑。

paras.en: Still, for all his progress, Eluemunor remained conscious to his struggles in New England and the lingering threat of slipping back into the same headspace. He was put in contact with mental health coach Brian Cain, who later made Eluemunor a "mental movie" that he could watch before playing, depicting images of his loved ones along with some of his best moments on the field.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，尽管埃卢穆诺取得了所有的进步，但他仍然意识到自己在新英格兰的挣扎以及重新陷入同样困境的挥之不去的威胁。他与心理健康教练布莱恩·凯恩取得了联系，后者后来将《埃卢穆诺》制作成了一部他可以在比赛前观看的“心理电影”，描绘了他所爱的人的形象以及他在球场上的一些最美好的时刻。

paras.en: "I watch it before every game because it kind of puts perspective into place and shows me why I do what I do and what I need to do to go out there and be successful. he's been a huge person for me," he says.
paras.zh: “我在每场比赛前都会观看它，因为它让我有了正确的视角，并向我展示了为什么我要做我所做的事情以及我需要做什么才能走出去并取得成功。他对我来说是一个重要的人，”他说。

paras.en: "I have my baby girls and I do this for my wife, that's my reason, that's my why. I want them to go back and look at my career and be like, you know, our dad did this for us and he was one of the best players, if not the best player in his position when we were kids.
paras.zh: “我有我的宝贝女儿，我这样做是为了我的妻子，这就是我的原因，这就是我的原因。我希望他们回去看看我的职业生涯，然后说，你知道，我们的父亲为我们做了这件事，他是最好的球员之一，即使不是我们小时候在他的位置上最好的球员。”

paras.en: "I want them to be like, he did everything, accomplished everything he wanted to accomplish, so there's no reason why we can't accomplish what we want to accomplish."
paras.zh: “我希望他们说，他做了一切，完成了他想要完成的一切，所以我们没有理由不能完成我们想要完成的事情。”

paras.en: It is the same message he continues to relay to the children he meets during camps such as the one this past summer in the UK.
paras.zh: 他继续向他在夏令营中遇到的孩子们传达同样的信息，比如去年夏天在英国的夏令营。

paras.en: "Mental health is such a sensitive subject, especially with the younger generation, that you have to be able to be vulnerable and show them who you truly are," he continues. "When I put the face mask on, I'm still the same person. And I want to show them that, just because I'm a professional athlete and make all this money, it doesn't mean I'm different from any of you.
paras.zh: “心理健康是一个非常敏感的话题，尤其是对于年轻一代来说，你必须能够表现出脆弱的一面，并向他们展示你的真实身份，”他继续说道。 “当我戴上口罩时，我还是同一个人。我想向他们展示，仅仅因为我是一名职业运动员并赚了这么多钱，并不意味着我与你们中的任何人不同。

paras.en: "I try to show them every single day that we're not too far apart and we're not any different than each other. It's the person you are deep within you who makes you who you are."
paras.zh: “我每天都努力向他们表明，我们之间的距离并不遥远，也没有什么不同。是你内心深处的那个人造就了你。”

paras.en: The Jermaine Eluemunor of today will tell you he is the best right tackle in the NFL. Of that much he holds zero doubts.
paras.zh: 今天的 Jermaine Eluemunor 将告诉你他是 NFL 中最好的右截锋。对于这一点，他的怀疑为零。

paras.en: He will publicly welcome the prospect of being left one-on-one on an island against the TJ Watts of the world, eager to test himself against the best and equally convinced that he will come out on top. As of Week Four this season, no offensive tackle has been left on an 'island' at a higher rate than Eluemunor's 71.4 per cent, according to Pro Football Focus; what's more, he has won those battles 93.7 per cent of the time.
paras.zh: 他将公开欢迎在一座岛上与世界各地的 TJ Watts 进行一对一的前景，他渴望与最优秀的人较量，并同样坚信自己会取得胜利。据 Pro Football Focus 报道，截至本赛季第四周，“孤岛上”的进攻铲球率没有高于埃卢穆诺的 71.4%；更重要的是，他在这些战斗中的胜率高达 93.7%。

paras.en: "I've grown a lot mentally," he says. "I can look back at that kid in New England and say that I'm a million times the player I was mentally and physically.
paras.zh: “我的心智成长了很多，”他说。 “我可以回顾新英格兰的那个孩子，并说我在精神上和身体上都比以前强了一百万倍。

paras.en: "You have to go through things like that in order to get to where you want to get to and become the person you want to become. I believe that was a trial that I put in my life and to see if I was going to make it through to truly become who I want to become.
paras.zh: “你必须经历这样的事情，才能到达你想去的地方，成为你想成为的人。我相信这是我生命中的一次考验，看看我是否能成功，真正成为我想成为的人。

paras.en: "I've always been driven to be the best. I just didn't do the work that was required to be the best."
paras.zh: “我一直被驱使着要成为最好的。我只是没有做最好的工作。”

paras.en: Eluemunor signed a two-year deal with the Giants back in March 2024 and has since established himself as an instrumental piece to his team's offensive line. It has taken countless trials and obstacles to get here, but there is now a sense of long-awaited stability and momentum capable of inciting the best version of the man from Chalk Farm, London.
paras.zh: 埃卢穆诺早在 2024 年 3 月就与巨人队签订了一份为期两年的合同，此后他就成为了球队进攻线上的重要一员。经历了无数的考验和障碍才到达这里，但现在有一种期待已久的稳定感和动力，能够激发出这位来自伦敦乔克农场的人的最佳版本。

paras.en: "I've had a lot of ups and downs, prior to me getting to New York there was a lot more downs than ups. I've just had to work really, really hard to get to where I'm at," he said.
paras.zh: “我经历了很多起起落落，在我到达纽约之前，起落比起起落落要多得多。我必须非常非常努力地工作才能到达现在的位置，”他说。

paras.en: "I've just kept working my butt off trying to be great. I want to be as great as possible. I want to be the greatest. I want to be the best in my position."
paras.zh: “我一直在竭尽全力，试图变得伟大。我想尽可能地变得伟大。我想成为最伟大的。我想成为我所在位置上最好的。”

articles.title: Furyk reveals USA gameplan: 'We should be thinking Ryder Cup all the time!'

paras.en: Ryder Cup: Jim Furyk urges Team USA veterans to "step up" to boost bid for historic away win over Europe at Adare Manor
paras.zh: 莱德杯：吉姆·福瑞克敦促美国队老将“站出来”，以提高在阿黛尔庄园客场战胜欧洲队的历史性胜利

paras.en: Ryder Cup captains Luke Donald and Jim Furyk spoke to Sky Sports on the latest Sky Sports Golf podcast, recorded at Adare Manor in Ireland ahead of the 2027 contest; Donald chases a third consecutive Ryder Cup win for Team Europe over Team USA, captained by Furyk
paras.zh: 莱德杯队长卢克·唐纳德和吉姆·福瑞克在最新的天空体育高尔夫播客中接受了天空体育的采访，该播客在 2027 年比赛之前在爱尔兰阿黛尔庄园录制；唐纳德带领欧洲队击败由福瑞克担任队长的美国队，力争连续第三次赢得莱德杯

paras.en: Team USA captain Jim Furyk has urged his veterans to "step up" and take players "under their wing" to help them end their Ryder Cup losing streak on European soil.
paras.zh: 美国队队长吉姆·福瑞克敦促他的老将们“挺身而出”，将球员“置于自己的保护之下”，以帮助他们结束在欧洲土地上莱德杯的连败。

paras.en: Furyk captains the United States at Adare Manor next September, live on Sky Sports, having previously guided Team USA to defeat in the 2018 contest at Le Golf National before leading them to 2024 Presidents Cup victory over the Internationals in Montreal.
paras.zh: 福瑞克将于明年 9 月在天空体育直播的阿黛尔庄园担任美国队队长，此前他曾带领美国队在 2018 年国家高尔夫比赛中失利，随后带领美国队在蒙特利尔举行的 2024 年总统杯中战胜了国际队。

paras.en: The former US Open champion has been involved in every American Ryder Cup team in some capacity since 1997, with Team USA heading to Ireland for the centenary edition looking to claim a first away victory over Team Europe in 34 years.
paras.zh: 这位前美国公开赛冠军自 1997 年以来一直以某种身份参加了每一支美国莱德杯球队，美国队前往爱尔兰参加百年纪念赛，希望在 34 年来首次客场战胜欧洲队。

paras.en: - Can Europe win the Ryder Cup again? Dates, format and key info
paras.zh: - 欧洲能否再次赢得莱德杯？日期、格式和关键信息

paras.en: - Ryder Cup 2027: Europe's qualifying schedule for Adare Manor
paras.zh: - 2027 年莱德杯：阿黛尔庄园欧洲预选赛赛程

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW
paras.zh: - 立即获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Furyk's tasks include trying to create a strong team unity within the American team and improving their abysmal foursomes record, having lost 26 of their last 34 matches in the format, although he has already identified other growth areas.
paras.zh: 福瑞克的任务包括努力在美国队内部建立强大的团队团结，并改善他们糟糕的四人二球赛记录，在过去的 34 场比赛中输掉了 26 场，尽管他已经确定了其他增长领域。

paras.en: "If you saw our team room and you see they travel together, these guys get along well and they're fine, but we haven't got it done from a team perspective," Furyk told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “如果你看到我们的团队房间，你会看到他们一起旅行，这些人相处得很好，他们很好，但我们还没有从团队的角度完成这件事，”福瑞克告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "I think we're going to go top to bottom (to improve things). We're going to start with the captains, getting them (the players) in better pairings and getting them more prepared in the way we practice and get ready.
paras.zh: “我认为我们将从上到下（以改进事情）。我们将从队长开始，让他们（球员）更好地配对，并让他们在我们的训练和准备方式中做好更多准备。

paras.en: "The way we look at it throughout the year, it's not like you throw these guys together 12 days out in advance and then you figure it out! This is a process and it's something we need to be thinking about all year long in 2027.
paras.zh: “从我们全年的角度来看，这并不是说你提前 12 天把这些人放在一起，然后你就想出来了！这是一个过程，是我们在 2027 年全年都需要思考的事情。

paras.en: "I need my veterans to step up, take some of the younger players under their wing and play practice rounds with them. Let them know what the Ryder Cup is all about, what they can expect on that first tee and get them excited about making this team.
paras.zh: “我需要我的老将挺身而出，将一些年轻球员纳入麾下，与他们一起打练习轮。让他们知道莱德杯的意义是什么，他们在第一洞发球台上可以期待什么，让他们对加入这支球队感到兴奋。

paras.en: "That process is not a one-month window. For us it needs to be a 24-month window, if that makes sense. We should be thinking about the Ryder Cup all the time and it's something I'd like to put in place."
paras.zh: “这个过程不是一个月的窗口。对我们来说，如果有意义的话，它需要一个 24 个月的窗口。我们应该一直考虑莱德杯，这是我想要落实的事情。”

paras.en: Furyk has served as a vice-captain for the last three Ryder Cups since losing 17.5-10.5 at Le Golf National in 2018, where he admitted his captain's picks left him without "horses for the course".
paras.zh: 自2018年在国家高尔夫俱乐部以17.5-10.5落败以来，福瑞克一直担任过去三届莱德杯的副队长，他承认队长的选择让他“没有马匹”。

paras.en: He said in a pre-Ryder Cup press conference on Tuesday he would "do more than any American team has in the past" to deny counterpart Luke Donald a historic three-peat, with Furyk prepared to draw from past experiences of being involved with Team USA.
paras.zh: 他在周二莱德杯赛前的新闻发布会上表示，他将“比过去任何一支美国球队都做得更多”，以阻止对手卢克·唐纳德获得历史性的三连冠，福瑞克准备从过去与美国队的比赛中吸取经验。

paras.en: "You would have to be arrogant to say 'no, we didn't win, but I do it exactly the same!'," Furyk added when asked about learnings from the 2018 loss. "Of course you wouldn't!
paras.zh: 当被问及从 2018 年失利中吸取的教训时，福瑞克补充道：“你必须傲慢地说‘不，我们没有赢，但我也这么做了！’”。 “你当然不会！

paras.en: "I was getting started in that captaincy career back then. I'd played in a lot of events, but sitting on the other side as a captain is a totally different process and a totally different outlook on teams.
paras.zh: “当时我刚刚开始队长生涯。我参加过很多赛事，但作为队长坐在另一边是一个完全不同的过程，对球队的看法也完全不同。

paras.en: "I think I've grown as a leader. I think I've been a backboard for some of our captains along the way, with the experience I've had.
paras.zh: “我认为我作为一名领导者已经成长。我认为凭借我所拥有的经验，我一路走来一直是我们一些队长的篮板。

paras.en: "To have that opportunity now to come back as captain for a Ryder Cup, and maybe pave the way for the future for this American team, is something I'm very proud to be asked to do. I take it very, very seriously."
paras.zh: “现在有机会以队长身份重返莱德杯，也许可以为这支美国队的未来铺平道路，我很自豪被要求这样做。我非常非常认真地对待它。”

paras.en: Donald: I don't want an American win on my watch!
paras.zh: 唐纳德：我不希望美国队在我的任期内获胜！

paras.en: Furyk claimed in Tuesday's press conference his side were "underdogs" heading to next year's contest, despite likely having a stronger side based on the world rankings, while Donald is keen to lead Europe to more success in the biennial contest.
paras.zh: 福瑞克在周二的新闻发布会上声称，他的球队在明年的比赛中是“失败者”，尽管根据世界排名可能有更强的球队，而唐纳德则热衷于带领欧洲在两年一度的比赛中取得更大的成功。

paras.en: "I think we have a good process in place with a great team, people who work really hard behind the scenes, but every Ryder Cup is different," Donald told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “我认为我们有一个很好的流程，有一支伟大的团队，人们在幕后非常努力，但每一届莱德杯都是不同的，”唐纳德告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "It's a unique course, different players usually and you've got to bring something new, different aspects to make it fun and different aspects to get them in the right frame of mind.
paras.zh: “这是一个独特的球场，通常会有不同的球员，你必须带来一些新的、不同的方面，让它变得有趣，并通过不同的方面让他们处于正确的心态。

paras.en: "Those decisions are ongoing and really churning around the brain, but hopefully we'll be ready. I expect there to be a few changes this year. I think that's good, to have a little bit of freshness, bring on the next generation of players and get them involved.
paras.zh: “这些决定正在进行中，并且确实在大脑中翻腾，但希望我们能做好准备。我预计今年会发生一些变化。我认为这很好，有一点新鲜感，培养下一代球员并让他们参与其中。

paras.en: "As I've said many times, I think home Ryder Cups still offer the most pressure to protect that record that we have - it's no small feat. Someone's American team are bound to win away at some point - I just don't want it to be on my watch!
paras.zh: “正如我多次说过的那样，我认为主场莱德杯仍然为我们提供了最大的压力来保护我们所拥有的记录 - 这不是一件小事。某人的美国队一定会在某个时候客场获胜 - 我只是不希望它在我的监督下！

paras.en: "We've had a lot of success the last four years and we'll take that confidence into this one. We understand that we've defended home soil very well and I think that's something to lean into.
paras.zh: “过去四年我们取得了很多成功，我们将把这种信心带入今年。我们知道我们很好地捍卫了主场，我认为这是值得依靠的。

paras.en: "The underdog is just a mentality thing for us - we want to prove we can beat the might of the United States. "
paras.zh: “失败者对我们来说只是一种心态——我们想证明我们可以击败美国的力量。”
