paras.en: Afrah al-Humaiqani, a sociologist in Aden, said the recent hostilities in different parts of Yemen risk denying thousands of students access to education, which she warned could contribute to creating a “new illiterate generation” in the country.
paras.zh: 亚丁社会学家阿夫拉·胡迈卡尼 (Afrah al-Humaiqani) 表示，最近也门不同地区发生的敌对行动有可能导致数千名学生无法接受教育，她警告说，这可能会导致该国产生“新一代文盲”。

paras.en: However, reducing the impact of this crisis is possible, and the Yemeni government and international organisations can cooperate and coordinate to address it, al-Humaiqani told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 然而，减少这场危机的影响是可能的，也门政府和国际组织可以合作和协调来解决这个问题，胡迈卡尼告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “There is a need for safe camps where students can feel secure,” she said. “This can be followed by the provision of teachers and textbooks, programmes to address learning loss, and provide psychosocial support for children.”
paras.zh: “需要安全的营地，让学生感到安全，”她说。 “随后可以提供教师和教科书、解决学习损失问题的计划，并为儿童提供社会心理支持。”

articles.title: 'They don't invest in us': French students protest for more resources in schools
articles.author: Eleanor Beardsley

paras.en: 'They don't invest in us': French students protest for more resources in schools
paras.zh: “他们不投资我们”：法国学生抗议学校提供更多资源

paras.en: High school students in France are fighting for more resources in schools. Some of the protests have turned violent, but it's not clear whether students or the police are to blame.
paras.zh: 法国的高中生正在争取更多的学校资源。一些抗议活动已经演变成暴力，但尚不清楚学生或警察应该受到指责。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of high school students in France have been protesting for the past two weeks. They say their facilities are decrepit, the classrooms are overcrowded and there aren't enough teachers. The movement started peacefully, but there have been some intense scenes of violence in the past few days. NPR's Eleanor Beardsley is covering this from Paris. Eleanor, why did these protests turn violent?
paras.zh: 过去两周，法国数万名高中生一直在抗议。他们说，他们的设施破旧，教室拥挤，师资不够。这场运动一开始是和平的，但最近几天出现了一些激烈的暴力场面。美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 在巴黎对此进行报道。埃莉诺，为什么这些抗议活动变成了暴力？

paras.en: ELEANOR BEARDSLEY, BYLINE: Well, why they've turned violent depends on who you ask. The far right blames the students and, of course, the government. And it says what's needed is more authority. And we have seen footage on the news of trash cans, vehicles, even schools being set on fire and young people facing off with police, some of them masked. And there are charges also that troublemakers from outside the schools have infiltrated the student movement in many places and turned it more violent.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·比尔兹利连线：嗯，他们为什么变得暴力取决于你问的是谁。极右翼指责学生，当然还有政府。它说我们需要的是更多的权威。我们在新闻中看到了垃圾桶、车辆、甚至学校被纵火以及年轻人与警察对峙的镜头，其中一些警察戴着面具。还有指控称，校外的麻烦分子渗透到许多地方的学生运动中，使学生运动变得更加暴力。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, yeah. Two hundred and fifteen students have been injured since the beginning of the protests, some 6,000 arrested, though most have been let go. Those injuries were mostly accidents like running and falling. But others are blaming the escalation of violence on the police.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，是的。自抗议活动开始以来，已有 215 名学生受伤，约 6,000 人被捕，但大多数已被释放。这些伤害大多是跑步、跌倒等意外事故。但其他人则将暴力升级归咎于警方。

paras.en: And yesterday, there were two events that really shocked the public. A 15-year-old had his hand blown off by a tear gas canister that exploded. And experts say this is a special kind of tear gas that ejects plastic pieces, and it's used when the police are encircled. And according to a criminologist, Alan Bower, who was on television, this type of tear gas is banned in other countries, but not in France.
paras.zh: 而昨天，发生了两件让公众震惊的事情。一名 15 岁少年的手被爆炸的催泪瓦斯罐炸掉。专家表示，这是一种特殊的催泪瓦斯，可以喷射塑料碎片，在警察被包围时使用。根据电视上的犯罪学家艾伦·鲍尔的说法，这种类型的催泪瓦斯在其他国家是被禁止的，但在法国却没有。

paras.en: And another kid whose parents have been interviewed on TV got shot in the face up close by tear gas, and it shattered his teeth. And they're devastated. And they say he's asking - what did he do wrong? And these incidents and eight others since the beginning of the protests are being investigated by authorities who look at police abuse.
paras.zh: 另一个孩子的父母在电视上接受采访，他的脸部被催泪瓦斯近距离击中，牙齿碎裂。他们很伤心。他们说他在问——他做错了什么？这些事件以及抗议活动开始以来的其他八起事件正在接受负责警察滥用职权的当局的调查。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Now, what's happening next for the student movement?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：现在，学生运动接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: Well, everyone is calling for calm, from the right to the left. Today, there's massive student marches around the country, one in central Paris I'm going to go to. And unions are calling on their members to wear white armbands and march with the students to prevent violence. Far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon accuses the police of the mayhem. Here he is speaking.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：嗯，从右到左，每个人都在呼吁保持冷静。今天，全国各地都有大规模的学生游行，我要去的地方是巴黎市中心。工会呼吁其成员戴上白臂章，与学生一起游行，以防止暴力。极左翼领导人让-吕克·梅朗雄指责警方制造了骚乱。他正在说话。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: "They think they incarnate order," he says, "but how is it order to beat people? I'm ashamed when I see this vision of my country." He said, "these are young people, so of course, they do stupid things. But they're just trying to be heard." You know, many people, though, blame Melanchon and his far-left party, France Unbowed, for encouraging the students.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：“他们认为自己是秩序的化身，”他说，“但是秩序怎么能打败人呢？当我看到我的国家的这种愿景时，我感到羞愧。”他说：“这些都是年轻人，所以他们当然会做愚蠢的事情。但他们只是想被听到。”但你知道，许多人指责梅兰雄和他的极左翼政党法国不屈党鼓励学生。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Have you spoken to any of those students?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：你和这些学生谈过吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: I have. I went yesterday to the Lycee Turgot in central Paris, which was closed, along with 500 other schools in the city.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：我有。昨天我去了巴黎市中心的杜尔哥中学 (Lycee Turgot)，该校与市内其他 500 所学校一起关闭。

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: I met a group of 15-year-olds. They had blockaded their school with dozens of plastic trash cans and homemade barriers, as is the tradition. There were signs up saying things like, tear gas criminals, not minors. And I spoke with Emile Varsakin (ph). Here he is. And we called his father, who gave permission for him to be on NPR.
paras.zh: BEARDSLEY：我遇到了一群 15 岁的人。按照传统，他们用数十个塑料垃圾桶和自制屏障封锁了学校。标语上写着催泪瓦斯罪犯，而不是未成年人。我与埃米尔·瓦尔萨金（Emile Varsakin）进行了交谈。他在这里。我们打电话给他的父亲，他同意他上 NPR。

paras.en: EMILE VARSAKIN: The politicians - they're always trying to put money in the weapons, the army and everything. But they don't invest in us. We are the future. They have to invest in us so that we can lead the country, you know?
paras.zh: 埃米尔·瓦尔萨金：政客们总是试图把钱投入武器、军队和一切方面。但他们不投资我们。我们是未来。他们必须投资于我们，这样我们才能领导国家，你知道吗？

paras.en: BEARDSLEY: So anyway, these kids and others in well-off neighborhoods whose schools aren't so bad - they're still blockading. They're still out there protesting - they say in solidarity with students in the suburbs and rural areas where schools are in worse condition. There's a long history of student protest movements in France, and there's a lot of enthusiasm and solidarity for this one.
paras.zh: 比尔兹利：无论如何，这些孩子和其他富裕社区的孩子，他们的学校还不错——他们仍然在封锁。他们仍然在那里抗议——他们说是为了声援学校条件较差的郊区和农村地区的学生。法国的学生抗议运动有着悠久的历史，这次抗议运动充满了热情和团结。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: That's NPR's Eleanor Beardsley in Paris. Eleanor, thanks.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：这是 NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利在巴黎。埃莉诺，谢谢。

paras.en: THIRD EYE BLIND: (Singing) Can I graduate? Can I graduate? Echo fading, we can't let go. She goes walking by...
paras.zh: 第三只眼盲：（唱歌）我可以毕业吗？我可以毕业吗？回声消逝，我们无法放手。她走过...

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of NPR transcripts may vary. Transcript text may be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio on npr.org may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Debra Messing says cost of living, subway violence pushed her to back Trump-endorsed Republican

paras.en: Debra Messing defended her decision to support Trump-backed Republican Bruce Blakeman for governor of New York on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 黛布拉·梅辛周二为她支持特朗普支持的共和党人布鲁斯·布莱克曼竞选纽约州州长的决定进行了辩护。

paras.en: The "Will & Grace" actress wrote in a lengthy Instagram post that while she has been a Democrat her whole life and for years her focus has been on voting rights, the gay community and gun control, she is increasingly concerned about the quality of life in New York City.
paras.zh: 这位《威尔与格蕾丝》的女演员在 Instagram 上发表了一篇长篇文章，称虽然她一生都是民主党人，多年来她一直关注投票权、同性恋社区和枪支管制，但她越来越关心纽约市的生活质量。

paras.en: "I still stand by every one of those principles," the 58-year-old said, adding, "What has changed is how I feel about the city and state I love dearly."
paras.zh: “我仍然坚持这些原则中的每一项，”这位 58 岁的老人说，并补充道，“改变的是我对我深爱的城市和州的看法。”

paras.en: In the past, Messing has supported candidates like former President Joe Biden, Hillary Clinton and Cynthia Nixon before she endorsed the Republican Nassau County executive. And she has frequently criticized President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 过去，梅辛在支持共和党拿骚县行政长官之前，曾支持过前总统乔·拜登、希拉里·克林顿和辛西娅·尼克松等候选人。她还经常批评唐纳德·特朗普总统。

paras.en: "I know I’m not someone choosing between rent and groceries. But many of the people who make New York what it is: small business owners, teachers, nurses, and young people trying to start their lives here, are struggling with the rising cost of living, and policies like congestion pricing are making it difficult to afford," she wrote.
paras.zh: “我知道我不是一个在租金和食品杂货之间做出选择的人。但是，许多使纽约成为现在这个样子的人：小企业主、教师、护士和试图在这里开始自己生活的年轻人，都在与不断上涨的生活成本作斗争，而拥堵收费等政策使人们难以负担，”她写道。

paras.en: She said when the people who live in the city can’t afford to live there, "we risk losing part of what has long made New York an extraordinary place of opportunity."
paras.zh: 她说，当居住在这座城市的人们负担不起那里的生活费用时，“我们就有可能失去部分长期以来使纽约成为一个非凡机会之地的东西。”

paras.en: Messing explained that she has also become "increasingly concerned about public safety," saying that the "violence we see on our streets and subways frightens me.
paras.zh: 梅辛解释说，她也“越来越关心公共安全”，并表示“我们在街道和地铁上看到的暴力事件让我感到害怕。

paras.en: Explaining that she voted for New York Gov. Kathy Hochul for years ago and recently reflected that she didn’t feel better off than she was four years ago, she said, "So I asked myself the question I’d encourage everyone to ask. Not: ‘Which party am I supposed to vote for?’ But: ‘Who do I believe will actually make life better for the people I love and the place I live?’"
paras.zh: 她在解释自己多年前投票给纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）时表示，她感觉自己的生活并不比四年前好，“所以我问了自己一个我鼓励每个人都问的问题。不是：‘我应该投票给哪个政党？’而是：‘我相信谁能让我所爱的人和我居住的地方的生活变得更好？’”

paras.en: She said for her, that was Bruce Blakeman because of his focus on affordability and safety. She noted that his campaign has said he’s pro-choice and supports gay rights.
paras.zh: 她说，对她来说，那是布鲁斯·布莱克曼（Bruce Blakeman），因为他关注负担能力和安全性。她指出，他的竞选团队表示他支持堕胎并支持同性恋权利。

paras.en: "I don’t agree with him on everything, and I don’t expect to," she continued. "No candidate is perfect. But on the issues that are hurting New Yorkers right now, I believe he’s the right choice. Yes, he’s been endorsed by the President. That’s not what my vote is about."
paras.zh: “我并不在所有事情上都同意他的观点，而且我也不希望这样做，”她继续说道。 “没有候选人是完美的。但在目前伤害纽约人的问题上，我相信他是正确的选择。是的，他得到了总统的认可。这不是我投票的目的。”

paras.en: Messing went on to say that she doesn’t believe party affiliation should "determine every vote I cast."
paras.zh: 梅辛接着说，她不认为党派归属应该“决定我投的每一张选票”。

paras.en: "I’m making this decision based on my own conscience and priorities," she added.
paras.zh: “我是根据自己的良心和优先事项做出这个决定的，”她补充道。

articles.title: Alleged killing by Marine prompts US military to restrict off-base liberty in Okinawa

paras.en: The U.S. military in Okinawa, Japan, is beginning an operational pause for 48 hours, prohibiting off-base liberty and ordering training after a Marine was arrested on suspicion of killing and robbing a woman.
paras.zh: 一名海军陆战队员因涉嫌杀害和抢劫一名妇女而被捕后，驻日本冲绳的美军开始暂停行动 48 小时，禁止基地外自由，并下令进行训练。

paras.en: Lt. Gen. Benjamin Watson, Okinawa Area Coordinator and commander of III Marine Expeditionary Force, said in a letter on Tuesday that incidents like this "demand we pause for reflection" and that serving on the island "comes with responsibility."
paras.zh: 冲绳地区协调员兼第三海军陆战队远征军司令本杰明·沃森中将在周二的一封信中表示，此类事件“要求我们停下来反思”，在岛上服役“需要承担责任”。

paras.en: "We speak often about standards and discipline. Standards are what we expect, and my standards are clear: be accountable for your actions; do the right thing, especially when no one is looking; and always be guided by our core values that govern our conduct at every rank," he wrote.
paras.zh: “我们经常谈论标准和纪律。标准是我们所期望的，我的标准很明确：对自己的行为负责；做正确的事，尤其是在没有人注意的情况下；并始终以我们的核心价值观为指导，这些价值观指导着我们各个级别的行为，”他写道。

paras.en: "We live, work, and socialize alongside the people of Okinawa; their home is our home. Every interaction with our neighbors either builds or undermines the trust that is essential to our team. When that trust is damaged, it affects the strength of our alliance and the security of this region. Accordingly, we will take time to think hard about discipline, standards and our alliance responsibilities," Watson added.
paras.zh: “我们与冲绳人民一起生活、工作和社交；他们的家就是我们的家。与邻居的每一次互动都会建立或破坏对我们团队至关重要的信任。当这种信任受损时，就会影响我们联盟的强度和该地区的安全。因此，我们将花时间认真思考纪律、标准和我们的联盟责任，”沃森补充道。

paras.en: The arrest of the Marine has sparked protests against the heavy American military presence on the southern Japanese island and concerns over military-related crime.
paras.zh: 这名海军陆战队员的被捕引发了对美国在日本南部岛屿大量驻军的抗议，以及对军事相关犯罪的担忧。

paras.en: Japanese officials have also lodged a formal protest with the U.S. government. Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi summoned U.S. Ambassador George Glass and called for cooperation with the investigation, stricter discipline among U.S. personnel and measures to prevent similar incidents.
paras.zh: 日本官员也已向美国政府提出正式抗议。日本外相茂木敏充召见美国大使乔治·格拉斯，呼吁美国配合调查，加强美国人员纪律，并采取措施防止类似事件发生。

paras.en: The killing could complicate Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s push to both strengthen the Japanese military on Okinawa and work more closely with the U.S. military to deter China.
paras.zh: 这起杀戮事件可能会让日本首相高市早苗推动加强日本在冲绳的军事力量以及与美军更密切合作以威慑中国的努力变得更加复杂。

paras.en: The pause in operations will last from Wednesday through Friday, during which no "off-base liberty" or alcohol will be allowed. Restricting troops from leaving military bases and interacting with the local community is a common response by military leaders to major crime incidents.
paras.zh: 运营暂停将从周三持续到周五，在此期间不允许“基地外自由”或饮酒。限制部队离开军事基地并与当地社区互动是军方领导人对重大犯罪事件的常见反应。

paras.en: Service members will receive training on standards, discipline and "our responsibilities as members of the Okinawan community," Watson said.
paras.zh: 沃森说，军人将接受有关标准、纪律和“我们作为冲绳社区成员的责任”的培训。

paras.en: "This Period of Training will include discussions on liberty policy, enforcement mechanisms, alcohol awareness, Okinawan culture, and alliance responsibilities. Every member of this force must understand that individual conduct has consequences," he said.
paras.zh: “这一时期的培训将包括对自由政策、执行机制、酒精意识、冲绳文化和联盟责任的讨论。这支部队的每个成员都必须明白个人行为会产生后果，”他说。

paras.en: After the training, which will begin on Friday, troops will transition into a 30-day "Period of Reflection."
paras.zh: 周五开始的训练结束后，部队将进入为期 30 天的“反思期”。

paras.en: During this period, Watson said there will be "restrictions on liberty" to remind all military personnel that "liberty is a privilege and a collective responsibility." These restrictions will include a curfew and enhanced supervision.
paras.zh: 沃森表示，在此期间将“限制自由”，提醒所有军人“自由是一种特权，也是一种集体责任”。这些限制将包括宵禁和加强监管。

paras.en: "Liberty is a mission, and like any other mission it requires discipline, trust and teamwork to complete it successfully," he said. "Take care of your teammates. Hold one another accountable. Live up to the high standards that come with the uniform you wear."
paras.zh: “自由是一项使命，与任何其他使命一样，它需要纪律、信任和团队合作才能成功完成，”他说。 “照顾好你的队友。让彼此承担责任。遵守你所穿制服的高标准。”

paras.en: Okinawa prefectural police said they arrested Lance Cpl. Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, who is stationed at Futenma Air Station, on suspicion of strangling Anna Yagi, 39, at a hotel in the island’s capital city of Naha early Saturday and stealing her wallet and backpack.
paras.zh: 冲绳县警方表示，他们逮捕了兰斯下士。 20 岁的德文·雅各布·巴拉德 (Devin Jacob Ballard) 驻扎在普天间机场，涉嫌周六早些时候在岛首府那霸市的一家酒店勒死 39 岁的安娜·八木 (Anna Yagi)，并偷走了她的钱包和背包。

paras.en: Security camera footage showed a man entering the hotel with the woman and later leaving alone.
paras.zh: 监控录像显示，一名男子与该女子一起进入酒店，随后独自离开。

paras.en: Ballard was arrested after a patrolling officer spotted him walking later on Saturday in an entertainment district in Okinawa City, about 15 miles northeast of Naha. His shaved head and the tattoos on his arms matched those of the man seen in security footage, Kyodo News agency reported.
paras.zh: 周六晚些时候，巴拉德在冲绳市的一个娱乐区（距离那霸东北约 15 英里），一名巡逻警官发现他行走，随后巴拉德被捕。据共同社报道，他的光头和手臂上的纹身与监控录像中看到的男子相符。

paras.en: People in Okinawa have long opposed the heavy U.S. military presence on the island, although some have acknowledged its strategic benefit due to what is seen as a growing threat from China.
paras.zh: 冲绳民众长期以来一直反对美国在岛上大量驻军，尽管一些人承认，由于中国的威胁日益严重，此举具有战略利益。

paras.en: Okinawa was under U.S. occupation from World War II until 1972. Now, the U.S. population on the island is nearly 80,000, with nearly 30,000 being active duty troops from all four branches of the armed forces. The Marines make up most of the service members on the island.
paras.zh: 从第二次世界大战到 1972 年，冲绳一直处于美国占领之下。现在，岛上的美国人口接近 80,000 人，其中近 30,000 人是来自武装部队所有四个军种的现役军人。岛上的大部分军人都是海军陆战队。

paras.en: A rise in crime linked to U.S. military-related personnel has led to renewed protests on the island. The number of criminal cases involving U.S. military-related personnel rose from about 40 in 2020 to 101 in 2025, according to Okinawa prefectural police.
paras.zh: 与美国军事相关人员有关的犯罪率上升导致岛上再次爆发抗议活动。据冲绳县警方称，涉及美军相关人员的刑事案件数量从 2020 年的约 40 起增加到 2025 年的 101 起。

paras.en: After three U.S. service members raped a 12-year-old girl in 1995, huge crowds protested the U.S. military presence on Okinawa. There was also frustration over a U.S. service member's rape of a teenage girl in 2024 and the delayed disclosure of the case.
paras.zh: 1995 年，三名美国军人强奸了一名 12 岁女孩后，大批人群抗议美国在冲绳的军事存在。人们还对 2024 年一名美国军人强奸一名少女以及案件迟迟披露感到沮丧。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: USMNT adds to sports wins over Canada this year with international friendly victory in Minnesota

paras.en: The latest clash between the United States and Canada in sports has led to another victory for the Stars and Stripes.
paras.zh: 美国和加拿大最近的体育冲突为星条旗队带来了另一场胜利。

paras.en: It may have only been an international friendly for the U.S. men’s national soccer team, but victory was had against their rival north of the border during the match in St. Paul, Minnesota on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 这可能只是美国男子国家足球队的一场国际友谊赛，但周二晚上在明尼苏达州圣保罗举行的比赛中，他们战胜了边境以北的对手。

paras.en: The USMNT defeated Canada, 1-0, to complete their international break undefeated in their first stretch since a tough Round of 16 loss to Belgium in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
paras.zh: 美国队以 1-0 击败加拿大队，自 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯 16 强输给比利时以来，首次以不败战绩完成国际比赛。

paras.en: There was no Christian Pulisic on the pitch for the U.S., as he continues to rehab from the bone bruise and microfracture he suffered in that loss to Belgium on home soil during the World Cup. But others stepped up to get the job done against a tough Canadian group that made it out of their Group B and into the knockout stages this summer.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂安·普利西奇没有出现在美国队的比赛中，因为他在世界杯期间在主场输给比利时时遭受的骨挫伤和微骨折仍在继续康复中。但其他人挺身而出，在对阵强硬的加拿大队的比赛中完成了任务，该队今年夏天从 B 组进入淘汰赛阶段。

paras.en: It was Justin Ellis, a 19-year-old from Florida who stars for Orlando City SC in Major League Soccer, who scored the lone goal for the USMNT.
paras.zh: 为美国国家足球队打进唯一进球的是来自佛罗里达州、效力于美国职业足球大联盟奥兰多城队的 19 岁球员贾斯汀·埃利斯 (Justin Ellis)。

paras.en: Ellis was called up to the U.S. senior team by manager Mauricio Pochettino for friendlies against Peru, Chile, and Mexico prior to this meeting with Canada. He was among those called up to get the international experience, but he was notable considering Uruguay head coach Diego Forlán visited him the week prior. Ellis is eligible to also represent Uruguay on the international stage through his mother.
paras.zh: 在与加拿大的比赛之前，埃利斯被主教练毛里西奥·波切蒂诺征召入美国成年队，参加与秘鲁、智利和墨西哥的友谊赛。他是被征召获得国际比赛经验的人之一，但考虑到乌拉圭主教练迭戈·弗兰在一周前拜访了他，他的表现值得关注。埃利斯通过他的母亲也有资格代表乌拉圭参加国际舞台。

paras.en: But the youngster seemed to fit in naturally for the U.S., as he drilled home a cross from World Cup standout Alex Freeman in the 29th minute of the match against Canada. It marked Ellis’ second goal during these friendlies, as he scored in his debut match against Peru on a free kick.
paras.zh: 但这位年轻人似乎很适合美国队，在对阵加拿大队的比赛中，他在第 29 分钟接到了世界杯杰出球员亚历克斯·弗里曼的传中。这是埃利斯在友谊赛中的第二个进球，他在对阵秘鲁的首场比赛中攻入任意球。

paras.en: Ellis has been described as a complete striker and could be a name not to forget as the USMNT eyes some revenge in the 2030 World Cup.
paras.zh: 埃利斯被描述为一名全面的前锋，随着美国队在 2030 年世界杯上复仇，埃利斯可能是一个不可忘记的名字。

paras.en: But before taking down Canada, the U.S. handled their friendly opponents in dominant fashion. They defeated Peru, 4-1, followed by wins over Chile, 4-2, and Mexico, 3-0. These players will head back to their respective clubs across the globe feeling good about the development that continues under Pochettino.
paras.zh: 但在拿下加拿大之前，美国以占主导地位的方式对付了他们的友好对手。他们以4-1击败秘鲁，随后以4-2击败智利和3-0击败墨西哥。这些球员将回到世界各地各自的俱乐部，对波切蒂​​诺领导下的持续发展感到满意。

paras.en: And the U.S. can say they took down Canada in yet another sport this year. Of course, the Winter Olympics gold medals in both men’s and women’s ice hockey are the highlights, but the U.S. also took down Canada, 5-3, in the group stage of the World Baseball Classic just a month after winning gold.
paras.zh: 美国队可以说他们今年在另一项运动中击败了加拿大队。当然，冬奥会男女冰球金牌是亮点，但美国队在夺得金牌一个月后的世界棒球经典赛小组赛中也以5比3击败加拿大队。

articles.title: Plague epidemic risk in Russia low after death of lab technician, WHO says
articles.author: Luke Harding and agencies

paras.en: The World Health Organization has said the risk of an epidemic in Russia is low after the sudden death of a lab technician who worked at a plague research institute in Siberia.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，在西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究所工作的一名实验室技术人员突然死亡后，俄罗斯发生流行病的风险较低。

paras.en: Darya Shipilova, who was 28, died last week, two days after falling ill. Russian media reports suggested she may have become infected after an accident at her workplace, where dangerous pathogens are kept and studied.
paras.zh: 28 岁的达莉亚·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 于上周生病两天后去世。俄罗斯媒体报道称，她可能是在存放和研究危险病原体的工作场所发生事故后被感染的。

paras.en: Russian authorities have downplayed the incident and say Shipilova died of “pneumonia of an unknown aetiology”. Strict quarantine measures have been imposed at the research centre in the city of Irkutsk and in several neighbouring hospitals.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局淡化了这一事件，并称希皮洛娃死于“病因不明的肺炎”。伊尔库茨克市的研究中心和邻近的几家医院已实施严格的检疫措施。

paras.en: Christian Lindmeier, a WHO spokesperson, said on Tuesday that there was no sign of a wider outbreak. “All of the patients’ contacts have reportedly been identified and are being monitored for illness, and none to date have shown symptoms of illness,” he said.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织发言人克里斯蒂安·林德梅尔周二表示，没有迹象表明疫情会出现更广泛的爆发。他说：“据报道，所有患者的接触者都已被确认，并正在接受病情监测，迄今为止没有人表现出患病症状。”

paras.en: Russian officials were still investigating whether viral pneumonic plague caused Shipilova’s death but the WHO had assessed the health risk as “moderate to low” for Irkutsk, “low” for the rest of Russia and “very low” for Europe, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，俄罗斯官员仍在调查病毒性肺鼠疫是否导致希皮洛娃死亡，但世界卫生组织评估伊尔库茨克的健康风险为“中度至低”，俄罗斯其他地区为“低”，欧洲为“非常低”。

paras.en: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged Russia on Tuesday to be transparent about Shipilova’s death.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞周二敦促俄罗斯对希皮洛娃的死亡保持透明。

paras.en: “Timely, complete and transparent information sharing under the International Health Regulations is essential to clarify conflicting reports and enable an accurate assessment of potential public health risks,” he wrote on X.
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“根据《国际卫生条例》，及时、完整和透明的信息共享对于澄清相互矛盾的报告并准确评估潜在的公共卫生风险至关重要。”

paras.en: According to Russian media, 60 of Shipilova’s colleagues have been locked in the institute where she worked since Friday, sleeping on the floors and chairs while tests are carried out. Similar measures have been imposed in five hospitals, with relatives forbidden to see patients.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯媒体报道，自周五以来，希皮洛娃的 60 名同事被锁在她工作的研究所里，在进行测试时睡在地板和椅子上。五家医院也采取了类似措施，禁止亲属探望病人。

paras.en: The Kremlin’s spokesperson, Dmitry Peskov, urged people on Tuesday not to listen to rumours but to rely on statements from Russia’s health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor. It said the situation in Irkutsk was stable, with no new infectious disease cases reported among institute employees.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周二敦促人们不要听信谣言，而要相信俄罗斯卫生监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 的声明。伊尔库茨克市疫情稳定，研究所员工无新增传染病病例。

paras.en: Washington has been watching developments closely. The US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, called on Moscow on Tuesday to release more details about the case. “I think it’s incumbent upon Russia to obviously share more information with the world,” he said. “We’re watching it very closely, hour by hour.”
paras.zh: 华盛顿一直在密切关注事态发展。美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周二呼吁莫斯科公布有关此案的更多细节。 “我认为俄罗斯显然有责任与世界分享更多信息，”他说。 “我们每小时都在密切关注。”

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal reported that the US state department had sent Russia a confidential diplomatic communication known as a demarche warning Moscow that failure to disclose details runs counter to its international health obligations.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，美国国务院已向俄罗斯发送了一份机密外交通讯，称为“外交行动书”，警告莫斯科，不披露细节违反了其国际卫生义务。

paras.en: Trump said on Tuesday that he was due to speak shortly with Russian president Vladimir Putin about the technician’s death.
paras.zh: 特朗普周二表示，他将很快与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就这名技术人员的死亡进行交谈。

paras.en: “I have a call scheduled, yes,” Trump told reporters at the White House when asked if he had spoken to Putin on the issue yet, adding that it would happen “very soon”.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否已与普京就这一问题进行过交谈时，特朗普在白宫对记者表示：“是的，我已经安排了通话。”他补充说，这“很快”就会发生。

paras.en: Trump had said earlier that his administration was willing to offer assistance. “I hate to see them having it. We’ll help. Everybody who has that kind of a problem, we’ll always help,” he told reporters.
paras.zh: 特朗普早些时候曾表示，他的政府愿意提供援助。 “我讨厌看到他们遇到这样的问题。我们会提供帮助。每个遇到此类问题的人，我们都会提供帮助，”他告诉记者。

paras.en: In an apparent mirror response, Rospotrebnadzor announced that Russia was prepared to assist the US in combating its own outbreaks of infectious diseases.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦通讯社（Rospotrebnadzor）宣布，俄罗斯准备协助美国抗击本国爆发的传染病，这显然是镜像反应。

paras.en: “The situation regarding dangerous infectious diseases remains unstable,” it said, highlighting a “significantly worsened” measles situation in three US states and a “fatal case of plague” recorded in New Mexico in June.
paras.zh: 报告称，“危险传染病的形势仍然不稳定”，并强调美国三个州的麻疹疫情“显着恶化”，新墨西哥州 6 月出现“致命鼠疫病例”。

articles.title: EU negotiators head to China hoping to curb cheap imports of hybrid electric cars
articles.author: Lisa O’Carroll in Brussels

paras.en: EU trade negotiators are heading to China for two days of crunch talks aimed at sealing a breakthrough deal tackling Beijing’s record £1bn-a-day trade surplus by curbing its exports of cheap hybrid electric cars into Europe.
paras.zh: 欧盟贸易谈判代表将前往中国进行为期两天的关键谈判，旨在达成一项突破性协议，通过限制中国向欧洲出口廉价混合动力汽车来解决北京创纪录的每日10亿英镑的贸易顺差问题。

paras.en: Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday.
paras.zh: 贸易专员马罗什·塞夫科维奇 (Maroš Šefčovič) 和他的团队将于周三飞出，并将在定于第二天开始并持续到周五晚些时候的谈判中进行最后的谈判。

paras.en: Sources say they hope to achieve “tangible, meaningful and measurable” results before the meeting of EU leaders in Brussels on Thursday next week, where China is high on the agenda.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，他们希望在下周四于布鲁塞尔举行的欧盟领导人会议之前取得“切实、有意义和可衡量”的成果，中国是这次会议的重要议题。

paras.en: The main focus is on what has been described as a “proof of concept” pilot agreement involving one sector, which is expected to be cars, which could be scaled up for other sectors in the coming months.
paras.zh: 主要焦点是所谓的“概念验证”试点协议，涉及一个行业，预计是汽车行业，未来几个月可能会扩大到其他行业。

paras.en: Diplomatic efforts to avert a full-scale trade war started at the end of June, albeit with little hope that China could curb exports to the EU given its historic ability to pivot quickly any time trade barriers are put in its path. For example, after the EU imposed tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles in October 2024 there was a boom in exports of hybrid cars, which were not subject to tariffs.
paras.zh: 避免全面贸易战的外交努力于六月底开始，尽管鉴于中国历史上在贸易壁垒出现时迅速转向的能力，中国限制对欧盟出口的希望渺茫。例如，欧盟于2024年10月对中国电动汽车征收关税后，不受关税影响的混合动力汽车出口激增。

paras.en: Last month, the EU asked China to voluntarily restrict hybrid exports to address soaring sales, warning that if they did not restrict them, safeguards – which could include quotas – could be enacted.
paras.zh: 上个月，欧盟要求中国自愿限制混合动力汽车出口，以应对销量飙升的问题，并警告称，如果中国不限制混合动力汽车，可能会实施包括配额在内的保障措施。

paras.en: It is not known what China’s response was. But sources say the mood in talks has changed as EU member states have hardened demands for protection against Chinese imports that threaten their own industries.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚中国有何反应。但消息人士称，随着欧盟成员国加强了保护其免受威胁其本国产业的中国进口产品的要求，谈判气氛发生了变化。

paras.en: On Monday, Germany’s chancellor, Friedrich Merz, agreed a “historic U-turn” on its policy on China by siding with the French president, Emmanuel Macron, in authorising effective permission for EU leaders to approve a new instrument to allow them to defend trade by cutting access to the single market at short notice.
paras.zh: 周一，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨同意对华政策进行“历史性大转变”，与法国总统马克龙站在一起，授权欧盟领导人批准一项新工具，允许他们通过在短时间内切断单一市场准入来捍卫贸易。

paras.en: In a joint paper with Emmanuel Macron, the two countries spoke of “a massive industrial shock … affecting sectors at the heart of the European industrial model and of systemic relevance [pharmaceuticals, aerospace, automotive, machine tools, chemicals, etc.]”.
paras.zh: 在与埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的联合论文中，两国谈到“一场大规模的工业冲击……影响了欧洲工业模式的核心部门和具有系统相关性的部门[制药、航空航天、汽车、机床、化学品等]”。

paras.en: The paper called for the use of all existing trade defence tools, but also for a new diversification instrument and “possible additional” new measures to allow the bloc to react when “third countries seek to undermine the restoration of a level playing field”.
paras.zh: 该文件呼吁使用所有现有的贸易防御工具，但也呼吁采用新的多元化工具和“可能的额外”新措施，以便欧盟在“第三国试图破坏公平竞争环境的恢复”时做出反应。

paras.en: Andrew Small, a former EU adviser on China, said Šefčovič’s talks will test the resolve of both Beijing and Brussels and will “determine whether China is willing to put sufficiently serious offers on the table”.
paras.zh: 前欧盟中国问题顾问安德鲁·斯莫尔表示，舍夫科维奇的会谈将考验北京和布鲁塞尔的决心，并将“决定中国是否愿意提出足够认真的提议”。

paras.en: Small, who is the Asia director at the European Council on Foreign Relations in Berlin, warned: “China’s most effective tactic may be to draw Europe into a ‘process trap’ offering just enough to delay action, without addressing the forces driving European deindustrialisation.”
paras.zh: 柏林欧洲外交关系委员会亚洲主任斯莫尔警告说：“中国最有效的策略可能是让欧洲陷入‘进程陷阱’，只提供足以推迟行动的措施，而不解决推动欧洲去工业化的力量。”

paras.en: Sources say the Franco-German proposals for a new instrument, dubbed a “kill switch”, were born out of frustration, particularly in Paris, that a so-called “trade bazooka” available to Brussels, officially known as the anti-coercion instrument, has never been used.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，法德提议建立一种被称为“终止开关”的新工具，是出于沮丧，特别是在巴黎，因为布鲁塞尔可用的所谓“贸易火箭筒”（官方称为反胁迫工具）从未被使用过。

paras.en: Paris pushed for the use of the ACI following Trump’s threat of tariffs last year but it never gained traction from others as it could take up to a year to implement.
paras.zh: 去年特朗普发出关税威胁后，巴黎推动使用 ACI，但它从未获得其他国家的支持，因为它可能需要长达一年的时间才能实施。

paras.en: Handlesblatt, the Germany business newspaper, described Monday’s change in policy as “nothing less than an economic turning point”, with chief political reporter Martin Greive concluding in a hard-hitting column that Merz was “putting an end to years of naiveté towards Beijing”.
paras.zh: 德国商业报纸《Handlesblatt》将周一的政策变化描述为“不亚于一个经济转折点”，首席政治记者马丁·格雷夫在一篇强硬的专栏中总结道，默茨“结束了多年来对北京的天真态度”。

paras.en: “Merz has recognised in recent months that Germany is the epicentre of the China shock 2.0; that there might not be much left of German industry if Germany continues to stand by and watch as China gains enormous export advantages through trillions in subsidies, the unilateral siphoning off of knowhow, and a – to put it mildly – questionable monetary policy,” he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“默茨近几个月认识到，德国是中国冲击2.0的震中；如果德国继续袖手旁观，眼睁睁地看着中国通过数万亿美元的补贴、单方面吸走技术知识以及——温和地说——有问题的货币政策获得巨大的出口优势，那么德国工业可能已经所剩无几了。”

articles.title: ‘Lawyers should be running to courts’ to stop coal approvals after landmark ruling, NSW MP says
articles.author: Donna Lu, Lisa Cox, and Adam Morton

paras.en: A landmark decision in Australia’s first climate change high court case has been described as a clear message to governments and fossil fuel companies that exported greenhouse gas emissions “cannot simply be ignored”.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚第一个气候变化高等法院案件的一项具有里程碑意义的判决被描述为向各国政府和化石燃料公司发出了明确的信息，这些公司出口温室气体排放“不能简单地被忽视”。

paras.en: On Wednesday morning, the nation’s highest court ruled that the approval of MACH Energy’s Mount Pleasant coalmine expansion in NSW’s Hunter Valley was invalid, in a judgment that sets a precedent for fossil fuel projects in the state.
paras.zh: 周三上午，该国最高法院裁定，MACH Energy在新南威尔士州猎人谷扩建芒特普莱森特煤矿的批准无效，该判决开创了该州化石燃料项目的先例。

paras.en: The coal company brought the high court case after a local community group, the Denman Aberdeen Muswellbrook Scone Healthy Environment Group (Dams Heg), halted the coalmine expansion on climate grounds in the NSW court of appeal.
paras.zh: 在当地社区团体 Denman Aberdeen Muswellbrook Scone 健康环境组织 (Dams Heg) 以气候为由向新南威尔士州上诉法院停止煤矿扩建后，该煤炭公司向高等法院提起诉讼。

paras.en: In a 3-2 split ruling, the high court found the state’s Independent Planning Commission (IPC) failed to consider imposing conditions to minimise greenhouse gas emissions that would be generated by the mine when the coal is sold and burnt overseas. Known as scope 3 emissions, these are not counted in Australia’s domestic tally.
paras.zh: 在以 3 比 2 的分歧裁决中，高等法院裁定，该州独立计划委员会 (IPC) 未能考虑施加条件，以尽量减少煤矿在海外销售和燃烧时产生的温室气体排放。这些被称为范围 3 排放，不计入澳大利亚国内排放量。

paras.en: Commenting on the judgment, deputy Greens leader Steph Hodgins-May said: “For too long, big coal and gas companies have tried to pretend that the emissions from their products are someone else’s problem once they leave Australian shores. They’re not.
paras.zh: 绿党副党魁斯蒂芬·霍金斯-梅在评论这一判决时表示：“长期以来，大型煤炭和天然气公司一直试图假装一旦离开澳大利亚海岸，其产品的排放就是别人的问题。但事实并非如此。

paras.en: “When Australian coal is burned overseas, the climate damage doesn’t magically disappear at the port. It comes back to communities here through worsening heat, drought, bushfires and floods.
paras.zh: “当澳大利亚煤炭在海外燃烧时，气候损害并不会神奇地在港口消失。它会通过恶化的炎热、干旱、丛林大火和洪水回到这里的社区。

paras.en: “This judgment sends a clear message to governments and fossil fuel companies that the climate impacts of their projects cannot simply be ignored or pushed down the line.”
paras.zh: “这一判决向各国政府和化石燃料公司发出了明确的信息，即不能简单地忽视或推迟其项目对气候的影响。”

paras.en: NSW Greens MP Sue Higginson, formerly a public interest environmental lawyer, also said the high court judgment could lead to “significant legal difficulty” for the Hunter Valley Operations (HVO) coalmine extension, which was approved by the IPC a week ago.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党议员、前公共利益环境律师 Sue Higginson 也表示，高等法院的判决可能会给猎人谷运营 (HVO) 煤矿扩建带来“重大法律困难”，该项目于一周前获得 IPC 批准。

paras.en: In greenlighting the HVO extension – the biggest in the state’s history – the IPC ruled that emissions from the mine would “contribute to climate change impacts on the people, economy and environment of the Hunter region, NSW and globally”, but that their impacts had been outweighed by economic benefits to the region.
paras.zh: 在批准该州历史上最大的 HVO 扩建项目时，IPC 裁定，该矿的排放将“导致气候变化对亨特地区、新南威尔士州和全球的人民、经济和环境产生影响”，但其影响已被该地区的经济效益所抵消。

paras.en: For both the HVO and Mount Pleasant coal developments, 98% of the emissions were scope 3 emissions, Higginson said. “HVO’s environmental impact statement didn’t even account for scope 3 emissions at all, and the high court has been crystal clear that consent authorities must ensure emissions are minimised to the greatest extent practicable. It seems clear that the approval of HVO fails this test.
paras.zh: Higginson 表示，对于 HVO 和 Mount Pleasant 煤炭开发项目，98% 的排放量属于范围 3 排放量。 “HVO 的环境影响报告甚至根本没有考虑范围 3 排放，高等法院已经明确表示，同意当局必须确保在可行的最大范围内最大限度地减少排放。很明显，HVO 的批准未能通过这一测试。

paras.en: “Lawyers should be running to the courts right now with this judgment in hand, ready to stop coal approvals in their tracks,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“律师们应该带着这份判决书立即跑向法院，准备阻止煤炭审批。”

paras.en: In a joint statement, Liberal leader Angus Taylor and Nationals leader Matt Canavan described the decision as a threat to “Australia’s standing as a reliable energy exporter”, and said the federal and NSW governments “must act immediately to fix the law”.
paras.zh: 自由党领袖安格斯·泰勒和国家党领袖马特·卡纳万在一份联合声明中称，这一决定对“澳大利亚作为可靠能源出口国的地位”构成威胁，并表示联邦政府和新南威尔士州政府“必须立即采取行动修改法律”。

paras.en: “A project extension the Independent Planning Commission approved in 2022, after years of assessment, has been sent back to square one,” they said, arguing that the Minns government should amend NSW’s environmental planning and assessment act, to “make clear that overseas emissions from Australia’s exported resources are not a consideration in project approvals”.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“独立规划委员会在经过多年评估后于 2022 年批准的项目延期已回到原点。”他们认为明斯州政府应修改新南威尔士州的环境规划和评估法案，以“明确澳大利亚出口资源的海外排放不是项目批准的考虑因素”。

paras.en: Climate change minister Chris Bowen, in Fiji where he is chairing climate negotiations, said: “The law of the land is law of the land, as interpreted by the high court, and we respect that.
paras.zh: 气候变化部长克里斯·鲍文在斐济主持气候谈判，他表示：“按照高等法院的解释，土地法就是土地法，我们尊重这一点。

paras.en: “If others don’t, if others are so biased in their approach that they don’t respect the law of the land, that’s a matter for them. It says a bit about their approach, but that’s about as all I’m going to say because it’s a court case and I’m not in Australia at the moment.”
paras.zh: “如果其他人不这样做，如果其他人的做法如此偏见，以至于不尊重国家法律，那是他们的事。这说明了他们的做法，但这就是我要说的，因为这是一个法庭案件，而我现在不在澳大利亚。”

paras.en: Murray Watt, the federal environment minister, said on Wednesday afternoon that while he had not had an opportunity to review the judgment in full, “the decision from the high court is in relation to a New South Wales government decision based on New South Wales legislation”.
paras.zh: 联邦环境部长默里·瓦特(Murray Watt)周三下午表示，虽然他没有机会全面审查该判决，但“高等法院的决定与新南威尔士州政府根据新南威尔士州立法做出的决定有关”。

paras.en: “It doesn’t automatically transfer to commonwealth decisions or commonwealth legislation,” he told News24.
paras.zh: “它不会自动转移到联邦决策或联邦立法，”他告诉 News24。

paras.en: The NSW government was contacted for comment.
paras.zh: 我们联系了新南威尔士州政府征求意见。

articles.title: Drinking and consent - Cornell rape allegations expose 'loopholes' in laws

paras.en: A backlash over the handling of a US woman's sexual assault complaint against Cornell University fraternity members has highlighted what experts believe are issues with the current laws in many states regarding sexual assault and drinking.
paras.zh: 一名美国妇女对康奈尔大学兄弟会成员的性侵犯投诉的处理引发了强烈反对，凸显了专家认为许多州有关性侵犯和饮酒的现行法律存在的问题。

paras.en: The woman, known as Jane Doe in legal documents, last month filed a lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped by several men in 2024 at the university in the state of New York.
paras.zh: 这名女子在法律文件中被称为“Jane Doe”，上个月提起诉讼，指控她于 2024 年在纽约州的一所大学被几名男子下药并强奸。

paras.en: Doe said she had been drinking earlier in the evening of the alleged incident and then went to a fraternity house, where several men pressured her to snort the drug ketamine and plied her with alcohol before advertising a "free" sexual encounter with her in a group message.
paras.zh: 多伊称，事件发生当晚早些时候，她一直在喝酒，然后去了一家兄弟会，那里有几名男子向她施压，要求她吸食氯胺酮，并不断向她灌酒，然后在群聊中宣传与她的“免费”性接触。

paras.en: She said she was intoxicated during the alleged incident and could not provide consent.
paras.zh: 她说，她在所谓的事件中喝醉了，无法表示同意。

paras.en: Under current New York law, a person who voluntarily consumes drugs or alcohol - rather than becoming intoxicated without their consent - is not automatically considered unable to consent to sex.
paras.zh: 根据纽约州现行法律，自愿吸毒或酗酒（而不是未经同意而醉酒）的人不会自动被视为无法同意发生性行为。

paras.en: US media has been widely reporting it as the "voluntary intoxication loophole".
paras.zh: 美国媒体广泛报道称其为“自愿中毒漏洞”。

paras.en: New York Governor Kathy Hochul last week said: "Voluntary intoxication is not a license for sexual assault or gang rape" and that she would work with the state legislature to close the "loophole".
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔(Kathy Hochul)上周表示：“自愿中毒并不是性侵犯或轮奸的许可”，她将与州立法机构合作，堵住“漏洞”。

paras.en: But some experts say the law has been misinterpreted and that it does not stop people who choose to consume alcohol or drugs from reporting sexual assault. It does, however, require them to prove they were so incapacitated they could not physically consent - a higher bar than being intoxicated.
paras.zh: 但一些专家表示，该法律被误解了，它并不能阻止选择饮酒或吸毒的人举报性侵犯。然而，它确实要求他们证明自己严重丧失行为能力，无法在身体上表示同意——这比喝醉酒的门槛更高。

paras.en: The distinction reflects an ongoing debate in the US about what counts as consent when someone has been drinking.
paras.zh: 这种区别反映了美国关于饮酒后什么才算是同意的争论。

paras.en: Dan Schorr, a former sex crimes prosecutor, told the BBC that New York law still protects victims of assaults who have chosen to drink or take drugs.
paras.zh: 前性犯罪检察官丹·肖尔 (Dan Schorr) 告诉 BBC，纽约法律仍然保护选择饮酒或吸毒的袭击受害者。

paras.en: "If a person cannot express consent or lack of consent due to the consumption of alcohol or drugs, any sexual activity with them is always non-consensual, whether the ingestion of alcohol or drugs was voluntary or involuntary," said Schorr, who also helps universities review sexual assault cases.
paras.zh: 肖尔说：“如果一个人因饮酒或吸毒而无法表达同意或未表示同意，那么与他们发生的任何性行为总是非自愿的，无论饮酒或吸毒是自愿的还是非自愿的。”他还帮助大学审查性侵犯案件。

paras.en: "I prosecuted many people who sexually assaulted someone who was voluntarily intoxicated," he said, adding: "I got convictions. They went to prison."
paras.zh: “我起诉了许多对自愿喝醉的人进行性侵犯的人，”他说，并补充道：“我被定罪。他们进了监狱。”

paras.en: Some believe issue with the current law is that the bar is set too high with regards to what counts as being too intoxicated to give consent.
paras.zh: 一些人认为，现行法律的问题在于，对于什么是醉酒而不能给予同意的标准设定得太高。

paras.en: At least 19 states, including New York, have a higher bar for the level of intoxication required to deem someone incapacitated and unable to consent.
paras.zh: 包括纽约在内的至少 19 个州对认定某人丧失行为能力和无法同意的醉酒程度设定了更高的标准。

paras.en: The New York law includes a provision that someone cannot consent to sex if they are "unconscious or for any other reason physically unable to communicate an unwillingness to an act".
paras.zh: 纽约法律包括一项规定，如果某人“处于无意识状态或由于身体上的任何其他原因无法表达出不愿意采取某种行为”，则不能同意发生性行为。

paras.en: This applies to people who are too incapacitated from drinking to consent, Schorr said.
paras.zh: 肖尔说，这适用于那些无法饮酒而无法同意的人。

paras.en: But another legal expert the BBC spoke to says that can be difficult to prove.
paras.zh: 但英国广播公司采访的另一位法律专家表示，这可能很难证明。

paras.en: Some prosecutors "may not bring charges or defendants may be acquitted because someone 'gave consent' while intoxicated, but not completely incapacitated", according to Mitchell Epner, a former prosecutor who has handled sex trafficking cases.
paras.zh: 处理过性交易案件的前检察官米切尔·埃普纳 (Mitchell Epner) 表示，一些检察官“可能不会提出指控，或者被告可能会被无罪释放，因为有人在喝醉时‘表示同意’，但并未完全丧失行为能力”。

paras.en: He said that in other states that have lower legal bars for incapacitation, someone who is "impaired" or "significantly impaired" cannot consent, and that being too drunk to drive a car could be considered as being at this level.
paras.zh: 他说，在其他对丧失行为能力的法律门槛较低的州，“身体受损”或“严重受损”的人不能同意，而喝醉了而无法开车也可以被视为处于这个水平。

paras.en: College campuses have different standards for consent than criminal law, including Cornell, which uses a standard of affirmative consent, defined as "a knowing, voluntary, and mutual decision among all participants to engage in sexual activity". Cornell says silence or lack of resistance does not constitute consent.
paras.zh: 大学校园对同意的标准与刑法不同，包括康奈尔大学，它使用肯定同意的标准，定义为“所有参与者参与性活动的知情、自愿和共同的决定”。康奈尔大学表示，沉默或缺乏抵抗并不构成同意。

paras.en: Epner supports a proposed change to New York's law to widen the scope of when someone is too intoxicated to consent. The New York Senate has passed a bill multiple times, but the state Assembly failed to bring it up for a vote.
paras.zh: 埃普纳支持对纽约法律的拟议修改，以扩大某人因醉酒而无法同意的范围。纽约州参议院多次通过一项法案，但州议会未能将其提交表决。

paras.en: That bill states that people cannot give consent if they are under the influence of substances that have rendered them "temporarily incapable of appraising or controlling" their conduct, and "such conduct was known or reasonably should have been known" to the other person.
paras.zh: 该法案规定，如果人们受到某种物质的影响，使他们“暂时无法评估或控制”自己的行为，并且“此类行为是他人已知或合理应该知道的”，则不能表示同意。

paras.en: Pennsylvania has also made efforts to try and change the law to make it easier for victims who were intoxicated to prove they were assaulted.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州还努力尝试修改法律，使醉酒的受害者更容易证明自己受到了袭击。

paras.en: "If somebody's too drunk to drive, they're too drunk to - fill in your verb of choice," Epner said.
paras.zh: 埃普纳说：“如果有人醉得不能开车，他们就醉得不能——填写你选择的动词。”

paras.en: Representative Lea Webb, whose district includes Cornell University, told the BBC News Channel she and her fellow lawmakers were working to push through legislation on the issue, which has gone through several amendments.
paras.zh: 代表莉亚·韦伯（Lea Webb）的选区包括康奈尔大学，她告诉英国广播公司新闻频道，她和她的议员同事正在努力推动有关该问题的立法，该立法已经经过了多次修订。

paras.en: New York's current laws, she said, "puts the onus of proof on the victim".
paras.zh: 她说，纽约现行法律“将举证责任置于受害者身上”。

paras.en: Schorr and criminal defence attorneys, meanwhile, criticised the proposed changes to New York's sexual assault laws.
paras.zh: 与此同时，肖尔和刑事辩护律师批评了纽约性侵犯法的拟议修改。

paras.en: New York's State Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers said in a statement to the BBC New York's current laws were sufficient, and that "people have been convicted of rape in cases involving voluntarily intoxicated victims".
paras.zh: 纽约州刑事辩护律师协会在给BBC的一份声明中表示，纽约州现行法律已经足够，“在涉及自愿喝醉的受害者的案件中，有人被判犯有强奸罪”。

paras.en: The group said using language that a victim was "incapable of appraising or controlling their conduct" was "simply too vague to be fairly enforced", adding that the legislation does not give clear details on what constitutes someone being too intoxicated to engage in sexual conduct.
paras.zh: 该组织表示，使用受害者“无法评价或控制自己的行为”的措辞“过于模糊，无法公平执行”，并补充说，该立法没有详细说明什么构成某人喝得太醉而无法进行性行为。

paras.en: Schorr said it was not easy to answer this question of what exact point someone is too intoxicated to consent.
paras.zh: 肖尔说，要回答这个问题并不容易，即某人喝醉到什么程度而无法同意。

paras.en: He added: "How should the law address that? It is very challenging to find a clear standard that will be evenly applied."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“法律应该如何解决这个问题？找到一个可以均匀应用的明确标准非常具有挑战性。”

paras.en: "It's a conversation we should have as a society, as a state".
paras.zh: “这是我们作为一个社会、一个国家应该进行的对话”。

paras.en: If you are suffering distress or despair and need support, you could speak to a health professional, or an organisation that offers support. Details of help available in many countries can be found at Befrienders Worldwide., external
paras.zh: 如果您正遭受痛苦或绝望并需要支持，您可以与健康专业人士或提供支持的组织联系。有关许多国家/地区提供的帮助的详细信息，请访问 Befrienders Worldwide。，外部

paras.en: A list of UK organisations that can help is available here.
paras.zh: 此处提供了可以提供帮助的英国组织列表。

articles.title: Watch: Riot police clash with school protesters and use tear gas in France

paras.en: Watch: Riot police clash with school protesters and use tear gas in France
paras.zh: 观看：法国防暴警察与学校抗议者发生冲突并使用催泪瓦斯

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of people have taken to the streets across France, as a wave of protests by high-school pupils spread to their parents, university students and unions.
paras.zh: 法国各地数十万人走上街头，高中生的抗议浪潮蔓延至家长、大学生和工会。

paras.en: Crowds of teenagers marched from the Place de la RÃ©publique in Paris, calling for more resources for schools, and what they called less repression from police.
paras.zh: 一群青少年从巴黎的广场游行，呼吁为学校提供更多资源，并减少警察的镇压。

paras.en: Police clashed with demonstrators in Lyon, used tear gas in Paris and Marseille and water cannon in Rennes, but there was little of the serious trouble that marred previous protests.
paras.zh: 警察在里昂与示威者发生冲突，在巴黎和马赛使用催泪瓦斯，在雷恩使用高压水枪，但并没有像之前的抗议活动那样造成严重麻烦。

paras.en: The BBC's Europe correspondent Nick Beake reports from Lille.
paras.zh: BBC 欧洲记者 Nick Beake 从里尔报道。

articles.title: Many Nepalis swept away in the floods aren't officially dead, leaving families in limbo

paras.en: At the Pashupatinath temple, on the banks of the Bagmati River in Kathmandu, Madan Lal Lawat joined other families in honouring loved ones who were lost when a deadly flood tore through the China-Nepal border last month.
paras.zh: 在加德满都巴格马蒂河畔的帕斯帕提那寺，马丹·拉尔·拉瓦特和其他家庭一起悼念上个月在中尼边境发生致命洪水时丧生的亲人。

paras.en: In Hindu tradition, when a body cannot be recovered, a symbolic effigy is made from sacred "kusha" grass to represent the dead, allowing relatives to perform last rites.
paras.zh: 在印度教传统中，当无法找到尸体时，就会用神圣的“kusha”草制作象征性的肖像来代表死者，让亲属进行最后的仪式。

paras.en: With more than 5,000 people still missing and the government ending rescue operations, this is the only way people like Lawat can honour the dead.
paras.zh: 由于仍有 5,000 多人失踪，政府也结束了救援行动，这是像拉瓦特这样的人们缅怀死者的唯一方式。

paras.en: Five of his relatives - including his brother - were caught in the water's onslaught and are still missing. Lawat survived because he was driving his bus outside his village, Betrawati.
paras.zh: 他的五名亲戚——包括他的兄弟——在洪水的袭击中被困，目前仍然失踪。拉瓦特幸免于难，因为他当时正在贝特拉瓦蒂村外驾驶巴士。

paras.en: The last Lawat heard from survivors is that his brother Mangal died while going door-to-door, trying to warn others to leave.
paras.zh: 拉瓦特从幸存者那里听到的最后消息是，他的兄弟曼加尔在挨家挨户试图警告其他人离开时死亡。

paras.en: "I don't know how to start over. Police say they're still searching for the bodies, but I'm not sure they'll ever be found," Lawat says.
paras.zh: “我不知道如何重新开始。警方说他们仍在寻找尸体，但我不确定他们是否会被发现，”拉瓦特说。

paras.en: But legally, their fate is far more complicated. In Nepal, a missing person is only presumed dead after 12 years.
paras.zh: 但从法律上讲，他们的命运要复杂得多。在尼泊尔，失踪者12年后才会被推定死亡。

paras.en: Section 40 of Nepal's Civil Code does allow for some exceptions, but it does not have a provision for disasters like the flood witnessed last month.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔《民法典》第 40 条确实允许一些例外情况，但没有针对上个月发生的洪水等灾难的规定。

paras.en: Families like Lawat's have told the BBC they are struggling to obtain death certificates, affecting everything from accessing flood compensation to the transfer of properties and even inheritance.
paras.zh: 像拉瓦特这样的家庭告诉英国广播公司，他们正在努力获得死亡证明，这影响到从获得洪水补偿到财产转让甚至继承等各个方面。

paras.en: Relatives can receive up to 25,000 rupees (Â£122; $162) for funeral costs, in addition to about 200,000 rupees (Â£981; $1,302) in bereavement compensation for the first relative who died, and 100,000 rupees (Â£491; $651) for each additional death.
paras.zh: 亲属最多可获得 25,000 卢比（122 英镑；162 美元）的丧葬费用，此外，第一个去世的亲属还可获得约 200,000 卢比（981 英镑；1,302 美元）的丧亲赔偿，每增加一名死亡亲属可获得 100,000 卢比（491 英镑；651 美元）的丧葬补偿。

paras.en: But this is only possible once they submit a death certificate. So as families try to rebuild their lives, many are now caught in an administrative nightmare.
paras.zh: 但这只有在他们提交死亡证明后才有可能。因此，当家庭试图重建生活时，许多人现在陷入了行政噩梦。

paras.en: "In view of the current disaster, the law is outdated," says constitutional law expert, Bipin Adhikari.
paras.zh: 宪法专家 Bipin Adhikari 表示：“鉴于当前的灾难，该法律已经过时了。”

paras.en: He explains the law was meant to account for people who travelled abroad and weren't heard from for years. "But technology has advanced now, it isn't as difficult to send or receive information," he argues.
paras.zh: 他解释说，这项法律的目的是为了照顾那些出国旅行却多年杳无音讯的人。 “但现在技术已经进步，发送或接收信息不再那么困难，”他辩称。

paras.en: For Lawat, the legal minefield has made an already devastating loss even harder to navigate.
paras.zh: 对拉瓦特来说，法律雷区让本已毁灭性的损失变得更加难以应对。

paras.en: When he tried to obtain a death certificate last week, officials at the local municipality office turned him away. "They said they're still discussing the death certificate issue. We aren't sure what to do now. There's so much uncertainty," he tells us.
paras.zh: 上周，当他试图获得死亡证明时，当地市政办公室的官员拒绝了他。 “他们说他们仍在讨论死亡证明问题。我们不知道现在该怎么办。有太多的不确定性，”他告诉我们。

paras.en: Even when bodies are recovered, identifying their identities is a slow and challenging task. More than 1,400 bodies have been recovered so far, and Nepal has little experience in processing DNA at such scale. In some cases, authorities have taken DNA samples, then buried the bodies with markers in the ground, should families claim them.
paras.zh: 即使尸体被找到，识别其身份也是一项缓慢且具有挑战性的任务。到目前为止，已经找到了 1400 多具尸体，而尼泊尔在处理如此大规模的 DNA 方面几乎没有经验。在某些情况下，当局会采集 DNA 样本，然后在家属认领时将带有标记的尸体埋在地下。

paras.en: Given the scale of damage and loss, families say compensation is desperately needed.
paras.zh: 鉴于损害和损失的规模，家属表示迫切需要赔偿。

paras.en: Nepal's latest assessment counts 7,570 private buildings damaged or destroyed, home to nearly 33,000 people based on census data.
paras.zh: 根据人口普查数据，尼泊尔最新的评估显示，有 7,570 座私人建筑遭到损坏或毁坏，这些建筑居住着近 33,000 人。

paras.en: The BBC visited Lawat's village Betrawati just days after the disaster, once the roads to the district of Rasuwa had been cleared. For days, this area had been cut off from the capital Kathmandu, and struggling with a shortage of basic supplies including petrol.
paras.zh: 灾难发生几天后，通往拉苏瓦地区的道路已经清理完毕，英国广播公司 (BBC) 访问了拉瓦特 (Lawat) 的贝特拉瓦蒂 (Betrawati) 村。几天来，该地区与首都加德满都的联系被切断，并面临包括汽油在内的基本供应短缺的问题。

paras.en: The damage in the village was staggering. The ground was nothing but hardened mud and silt. Footage of the flood showed it had swallowed most of the village in just minutes. There was no sign of its bustling market, the local Uttargaya School was in ruins, the houses swept away, and school buses were turned over.
paras.zh: 村里的损失是惊人的。地面只剩下硬化的泥土和淤泥。视频显示，洪水在短短几分钟内就吞没了村庄的大部分地区。熙熙攘攘的市场已荡然无存，当地的乌塔加亚学校已成为废墟，房屋被冲走，校车也被翻倒。

paras.en: Betrawati straddles flood-devastated Rasuwa and Nuwakot, and is part of the Bidur municipality, where the government estimates more than 3,000 buildings have been damaged or destroyed. It's the largest amount of any municipality.
paras.zh: Betrawati 横跨遭受洪水破坏的拉苏瓦 (Rasuwa) 和努瓦科特 (Nuwakot)，是 Bidur 市的一部分，政府估计该市有 3,000 多座建筑物遭到损坏或摧毁。这是所有市镇中金额最大的。

paras.en: Local governments are now urging the prime minister's office to figure out a way to resolve the death confirmation issue.
paras.zh: 地方政府目前正在敦促总理办公室找出解决死亡确认问题的方法。

paras.en: "Everything is on hold," Bidur's Mayor, Rajan Shrestha, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 比杜尔市市长拉詹·什雷斯塔 (Rajan Shrestha) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，“一切都暂停了”。

paras.en: He said it could take up to 12 years for relatives to access the funds they are entitled to.
paras.zh: 他说，亲属可能需要长达 12 年的时间才能获得他们有权获得的资金。

paras.en: For one of South Asia's smallest economies, finding money for compensation is a challenge, and the sums on offer are small when compared with the scale of the losses.
paras.zh: 对于南亚最小的经济体之一来说，寻找赔偿资金是一项挑战，而且与损失规模相比，提供的赔偿金额很小。

paras.en: The government puts damage to personal belongings alone at Â£123 million ($165 million) across more than 8,300 households.
paras.zh: 政府估计 8,300 多个家庭仅个人物品损失就达 1.23 亿英镑（1.65 亿美元）。

paras.en: This implies losses of about Â£14,800 ($20,000) on average per household, though this figure is only based on census data and modelling, and doesn't represent the exact cost per family.
paras.zh: 这意味着每个家庭平均损失约 14,800 英镑（20,000 美元），尽管这个数字仅基于人口普查数据和模型，并不代表每个家庭的确切成本。

paras.en: The financial toll makes the death certificates vital for families trying to recover from the disaster.
paras.zh: 经济损失使得死亡证明对于试图从灾难中恢复的家庭至关重要。

paras.en: Shrestha is calling on the federal government to resolve the issue as soon as possible. Until then, he says his hands are tied.
paras.zh: 什雷斯塔呼吁联邦政府尽快解决这一问题。在那之前，他说他的手被绑住了。

paras.en: "We understand the emotional pain for families who have already performed funeral rituals, but officials must work within legal boundaries to avoid future liabilities."
paras.zh: “我们理解已经举行葬礼的家庭所承受的情感痛苦，但官员必须在法律范围内开展工作，以避免未来承担责任。”

paras.en: The government has told the BBC it is trying to find a solution.
paras.zh: 政府告诉英国广播公司，它正在努力寻找解决方案。

paras.en: In a statement, the prime minister's office said it was "aware of the difficulties" the law may cause families in "exceptional circumstances, including disasters". The home ministry said the government was taking the issue seriously and was ready to amend the law, if required.
paras.zh: 总理办公室在一份声明中表示，它“意识到该法律可能给处于“特殊情况，包括灾难”的家庭带来困难。内政部表示，政府正在认真对待这个问题，并准备在需要时修改法律。

paras.en: The legal hurdles families are facing comes as Nepal faces a steep reconstruction bill, which the government says could cost up to Â£3.6bn ($4.8bn).
paras.zh: 尼泊尔家庭面临的法律障碍正值尼泊尔面临巨额重建费用之际，政府称该费用可能高达 36 亿英镑（48 亿美元）。

paras.en: At the UN General Assembly in New York, Prime Minister Balen Shah explained rebuilding the country would require more than 10% of its gross domestic product, an enormous burden on the country's economy.
paras.zh: 在纽约举行的联合国大会上，总理巴伦·沙阿解释说，重建国家需要国内生产总值的 10% 以上，这对国家经济来说是一个巨大的负担。

paras.en: Dozens of public buildings including schools, health clinics and hospitals have been wrecked by the floods. That's in addition to roads, bridges, wastewater treatment plants and hydropower projects.
paras.zh: 包括学校、诊所和医院在内的数十座公共建筑被洪水摧毁。这还不包括道路、桥梁、污水处理厂和水力发电项目。

paras.en: Shah is now pushing for grant-based international support rather than new loans. Nepal is one of the lowest emitters of global greenhouse gas emissions, yet one one of the most vulnerable countries to global warming.
paras.zh: 沙阿现在正在推动基于赠款的国际支持，而不是新的贷款。尼泊尔是全球温室气体排放量最低的国家之一，但却是最容易受到全球变暖影响的国家之一。

paras.en: "When a climate-driven disaster destroys infrastructure of a poor country, the answer cannot simply be another mega-loan or a patchwork of small grants," he told a room full of world leaders.
paras.zh: 他对满屋子的世界领导人说：“当一场气候引发的灾难摧毁了一个贫穷国家的基础设施时，解决办法不能简单地是另一笔巨额贷款或小额赠款的拼凑。”

paras.en: This is not the first time Nepal has had to recover after a devastating natural disaster.
paras.zh: 这并不是尼泊尔第一次在遭受毁灭性自然灾害后不得不进行恢复。

paras.en: For Tisum Ghale, the past month has been painfully familiar.
paras.zh: 对于蒂苏姆·加勒来说，过去的一个月是极其熟悉的。

paras.en: He and his family lost their home in an earthquake in 2015, and became displaced for months. They eventually settled in Betrawati.
paras.zh: 他和家人在 2015 年的地震中失去了家园，并流离失所数月。他们最终在贝特拉瓦蒂定居。

paras.en: But the place that was once a refuge is where 19 of his relatives were killed in last month's flood, including five of his sisters. He survived because he was doing construction work outside of the village.
paras.zh: 但这个曾经是避难所的地方，在上个月的洪水中，有 19 名亲戚丧生，其中包括他的 5 名姐妹。他之所以能活下来，是因为他在村外做建筑工作。

paras.en: So far he has received no compensation. He desperately needs the money after his home was washed away and he looks after eight children left behind by his sisters. He is one of the thousands displaced, living across 37 holding centres in northern Nepal.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，他还没有收到任何赔偿。房屋被冲毁后，他迫切需要这笔钱，并且还要照顾姐姐留下的八个孩子。他是数千名流离失所者之一，居住在尼泊尔北部 37 个收容中心。

paras.en: Like Lawati and thousands of other families, Ghale plans on holding a funeral without his loved ones' bodies.
paras.zh: 与拉瓦蒂和其他数千个家庭一样，盖尔计划在没有亲人遗体的情况下举行葬礼。

paras.en: He hopes the law will eventually recognise what he already knows: his loved ones will not be coming home.
paras.zh: 他希望法律最终能承认他已经知道的事情：他的亲人不会回家。

articles.title: 'She knew she had something really important on her hands': Rosalind Franklin figured out DNA's helical structure before Watson and Crick, study suggests
articles.author: Stephanie Pappas

paras.en: Rosalind Franklin, whose photographs of the molecular structure of DNA led to a 1962 Nobel Prize for three other scientists, knew that her famous images held the secret of the double helix, new research suggests.
paras.zh: 新研究表明，罗莎琳德·富兰克林（ Rosalind Franklin ）的DNA分子结构照片为其他三位科学家带来了1962年的诺贝尔奖，她知道她的着名图像藏有双螺旋的秘密。

paras.en: An examination of archival material reveals that Franklin's Photograph 51, which was taken in May 1952 and later published to show the double-helix structure, was specifically taken for the purpose of publication — not, as some narratives have held, an experimental shot that Franklin believed was insignificant. The new research revealed that Photograph 51 was a new exposure of a sample Franklin had already photographed. She started Photograph 51 the same day she saw that photograph, Photograph 49.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "She took it because she wanted to get a really refined version," said study co-author Alistair Sponsel, a historian of science at the Science History Institute in Philadelphia. Making the effort to take a better photograph of the same sample is "a sign she knew she had something really important on her hands," Sponsel told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、费城科学史研究所的科学史学家阿利斯泰尔·斯蓬塞尔（ Alistair Sponsel ）说： “她接受了，因为她想得到一个非常精致的版本。” Sponsel告诉Live Science ，努力为同一样本拍摄更好的照片是“她知道自己手上有非常重要的东西的标志”。

paras.en: Francis Crick, James Watson and Maurice Wilkins shared the Nobel Prize in Medicine for the discovery of the double-helix structure of DNA in 1962. As Watson told it in his 1968 autobiography, "The Double Helix: A Personal Account of the Discovery of the Structure of DNA," Franklin's photographs were his "aha" moment: "The black cross of reflections which dominated the picture could only arise from a helical structure," he wrote.
paras.zh: 1962年，弗朗西斯·克里克（ Francis Crick ）、詹姆斯·沃森（ James Watson ）和莫里斯·威尔金斯（ Maurice Wilkins ）因发现DNA的双螺旋结构而共同获得诺贝尔医学奖。正如沃森在他1968年的自传《双螺旋： DNA结构发现的个人叙述》中所说，富兰克林的照片是他的“啊哈”时刻： “主导图片的黑色反射十字架只能来自螺旋结构，”他写道。

paras.en: Watson further implied that Franklin was a laboratory automaton, good at the X-ray crystallography techniques used to capture the images of the DNA molecule but bad at interpreting her own data. The new archival work, published Monday (Oct. 5) in the Journal of the History of Biology, suggests otherwise.
paras.zh: 沃森进一步暗示富兰克林是一个实验室自动机，擅长用于捕获DNA分子图像的X射线晶体学技术，但不擅长解释她自己的数据。周一（ 10月5日）发表在《生物学史杂志》（ Journal of the History of Biology ）上的新档案工作表明情况并非如此。

paras.en: Franklin's dearth of published notes about Photograph 51 has been used to suggest she missed a major discovery. But Sponsel said her journals show she noted the possible helical shape and rich structural data in her notes for her first picture of the sample, Photograph 49, which she followed up with the more refined image in Photograph 51.
paras.zh: 富兰克林缺乏关于照片51的已发表笔记，这被用来暗示她错过了一个重大发现。但Sponsel说，她的日记显示，她在她的第一张样本照片Photograph 49的笔记中注意到了可能的螺旋形状和丰富的结构数据，她随后在Photograph 51中拍摄了更精致的图像。

paras.en: "In Franklin's mind, they were two different types of scientific image," Sponsel said. Photograph 49 was the experimental image revealing exciting new data. Photograph 51 was the showpiece to convey these findings with the most clarity and sharpness possible.
paras.zh: “在富兰克林看来，它们是两种不同类型的科学形象，” Sponsel说。照片49是实验图像，揭示了令人兴奋的新数据。照片51是以最清晰和清晰的方式传达这些发现的展示品。

paras.en: This new understanding of the relationship between the two images, and how Franklin perceived them, is the most important feature of the new work, Sponsel said, which he conducted with molecular biophysicist Brian Sutton of King's College London. The project began when the Science History Institute acquired a new collection of archival material from Rosalind Franklin and her graduate student Raymond Gosling. The two researchers also combed through the archives at King’s College London, where Franklin was working when she took the famous photos.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Sponsel and Sutton think that Franklin's notes and actions reveal why she didn't rush to publish Photograph 51 right away. Her scientific goals, laid out in a report she wrote in February 1952, were to understand the two separate structures of DNA, then known as A and B. Structure B, illustrated in Photographs 49 and 51, turned out to be the double helix that occurs in nature. Structure A is a form DNA takes when it's dehydrated in the lab.
paras.zh: Sponsel和Sutton认为，富兰克林的笔记和行动揭示了她为什么不立即出版照片51。她在1952年2月撰写的一份报告中列出了她的科学目标，即理解DNA的两个独立结构，当时称为A和B。如照片49和51所示，结构B被证明是自然界中发生的双螺旋。结构A是DNA在实验室中脱水时的一种形式。

paras.en: Structure A, when photographed, appeared more data-rich, so Franklin decided to characterize that structure first before studying structure B. But while she did this painstaking work, Wilkins showed Watson her photographs of structure B. The two scientists, together with Crick, then built a detailed model of DNA's double helix and scooped the discovery from under her nose.
paras.zh: 结构A在拍摄时，看起来数据更丰富，因此富兰克林决定在研究结构B之前首先描述该结构。但是，在她进行这项艰苦工作的同时，威尔金斯向沃森展示了她的结构B照片。两位科学家与克里克一起，建立了DNA双螺旋的详细模型，并从她的鼻子底下挖掘了这一发现。

paras.en: Those three men shared the Nobel Prize for the work less than a decade later. Franklin died of ovarian cancer in 1958, making her ineligible for the prize — and leaving her insights to come to light only much later.
paras.zh: 不到十年后，这三人共同获得了诺贝尔奖。富兰克林于1958年死于卵巢癌，使她没有资格获得该奖项—并且直到很久以后才曝光她的见解。

paras.en: Editor's note: This article was updated at 3:23 p.m. ET to fix the caption and subhead, noting that Rosalind Franklin had likely discovered DNA's helical, but not double-helix structure. Also, the top photo is not Photograph 51, but another photo taken by Franklin.
paras.zh: 编者按：本文于美国东部时间下午3:23更新，以修复标题和副标题，并指出Rosalind Franklin可能发现了DNA的螺旋结构，但不是双螺旋结构。此外，最上面的照片不是照片51 ，而是富兰克林拍摄的另一张照片。

paras.en: Sponsel, A., & Sutton, B. (2026). Photograph 49 is the Key to Understanding the History of Rosalind Franklin’s DNA Photograph 51. Journal of the History of Biology. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10739-026-09866-7
paras.zh: Sponsel, A., & Sutton, B. (2026)。照片49是理解罗莎琳德·富兰克林DNA历史的关键照片51。生物学史杂志。https://doi.org/10.1007/s10739-026-09866-7

paras.en: Stephanie Pappas is a contributing writer for Live Science, covering topics ranging from geoscience to archaeology to the human brain and behavior. She was previously a senior writer for Live Science but is now a freelancer based in Denver, Colorado, and regularly contributes to Scientific American and The Monitor, the monthly magazine of the American Psychological Association. Stephanie received a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of South Carolina and a graduate certificate in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.

articles.title: Archaeologists discover a child's skull built into the floor of a 2,500-year-old Scandinavian house
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have unearthed evidence that men, women and children were subjected to violence within their communities in ancient Scandinavia — and that these victims were buried in unusual places, such as pits or wells or under a family's house or yard.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现的证据表明，在古代斯堪的纳维亚半岛，男人、女人和儿童在他们的社区内遭受过暴力，而且这些受害者被埋在不寻常的地方，比如坑或井，或者在家庭的房子或院子下面。

paras.en: During the Scandinavian Iron Age and Viking Age (from roughly 500 B.C. to A.D. 1050), violent encounters between individuals and communities steadily increased, resulting in archaeological evidence of elite warrior burials and mass graves from battles.
paras.zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚铁器时代和维京时代（大约从公元前 500 年到公元 1050 年），个人和社区之间的暴力冲突不断增加，考古证据表明精英战士的墓葬和战争造成的万人坑。

paras.en: To better understand the context of violence in the Iron and Viking ages, researchers analyzed 192 human bones from people buried in domestic areas at settlements in what are now Denmark, Norway and Sweden.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解钢铁和海盗时代暴力的背景，研究人员分析了192具人骨，这些人骨来自现在丹麦、挪威和瑞典定居点的家庭居住区。

paras.en: "The fact is that not all bodies ended up in monumental burial mounds in the Iron and Viking Ages, or even in more modest urnfields and cemeteries," the researchers wrote in a study published Sept. 28 in the Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory. Rather, some bodies — or pieces of bodies — were placed in postholes, pits, floors, wells, houses, yards and feasting halls.
paras.zh: 研究人员在9月28日发表在“考古方法与理论杂志”上的一项研究中写道： “事实是，并非所有尸体最终都落入了铁海盗时代的纪念性墓地，甚至是更温和的墓地和墓地。”相反，一些尸体--或尸体碎片--被放置在邮筒、坑、地板、井、房屋、院子和宴会厅中。

paras.en: The archaeologists discovered that at least 12 of the individuals had sustained a violent injury around the time of death. Half of those cases involved head trauma, while four people suffered multiple injuries. Most of the victims of violence were adult males, but there were two females and a child as well.
paras.zh: 考古学家发现，至少有 12 人在死亡时遭受了暴力伤害。其中一半病例涉及头部外伤，四人多处受伤。大多数暴力受害者是成年男性，但也有两名女性和一名儿童。

paras.en: In one Iron Age house in Denmark, built sometime between 500 and 1 B.C., archaeologists discovered a frontal bone from the skull of a child who died between the ages of 2 and 4 years old.
paras.zh: 在丹麦一座建于公元前500年至公元前1年的铁器时代的房子里，考古学家从一名2至4岁儿童的头骨中发现了一块额骨。

paras.en: "Our DNA analyses show that it is a small boy who has been cut with a sword," study first author Marianne Hem Eriksen, an archaeologist at the National Museum of Denmark, said in a translated statement. "The child's skull was placed on the floor of a house where people continued to live. This means that someone has walked over a child's skull day after day."
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、丹麦国家博物馆考古学家玛丽安·海姆·埃里克森 (Marianne Hem Eriksen) 在一份翻译声明中表示：“我们的 DNA 分析显示，这是一名被剑砍伤的小男孩。” “孩子的头骨被放在人们继续居住的房子的地板上。这意味着有人日复一日地走过孩子的头骨。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Radiocarbon dating revealed that the child's skull is significantly older than the house itself, by as many as two centuries, suggesting the bone may have been kept for some time before being placed in the house floor, according to the study.
paras.zh: 根据这项研究，放射性碳测年显示，孩子的头骨比房子本身大得多，长达两个世纪，这表明骨骼可能在放入房屋地板之前已经保存了一段时间。

paras.en: At a Viking Age site dated to around 750 to 1050, archaeologists found a young woman's skull in a well near a cluster of four small houses. "The woman's skull bore traces of blows and was buried in a well," Eriksen said. She may have been cut or slashed with a sword or ax and, like the child, her bones may have been kept for a significant amount of time before being buried in the well. "These glimpses of lives lived from the past show how fascinatingly different people must have thought about life and death," Eriksen said.
paras.zh: 在大约 750 年至 1050 年的维京时代遗址，考古学家在四间小房子附近的一口井里发现了一个年轻女子的头骨。埃里克森说：“这名女子的头骨上有被击打的痕迹，被埋在一口井里。”她可能是被剑或斧头砍伤的，和孩子一样，她的骨头在被埋在井里之前可能已经保存了很长一段时间。埃里克森说：“这些对过去生活的一瞥表明，不同的人对生与死的思考一定是多么令人着迷。”

paras.en: And at the Viking Age site of Gammel Lejre, a royal feasting hall that many experts consider to be the inspiration for the epic Old English poem "Beowulf," archaeologists found the burial of a man whose skeleton bore numerous blunt force injuries, several of which had healed, and which attested to a difficult and likely painful life. His skeleton was discovered directly south of the feasting hall.
paras.zh: 在维京时代的Gammel Lejre遗址，一个被许多专家认为是史诗般的古英语诗歌“Beowulf”的灵感来源的皇家宴会厅，考古学家发现了一个人的埋葬，他的骨骼承受了许多钝器伤害，其中一些已经愈合，并证明了一个艰难而可能痛苦的生活。他的骨架是在宴会厅正南发现的。

paras.en: The study of bones in domestic areas "opens up a completely new understanding of Iron Age society, of the occurrence of violence and of the handling of the dead," Eriksen said. "The results show a much greater complexity in the everyday life and world of imagination of the time than we often attribute to Iron Age people."
paras.zh: 埃里克森说，对国内地区骨骼的研究“开辟了对铁器时代社会，暴力发生和对死者的处理的全新理解”。“结果显示，与我们通常归因于铁器时代的人相比，日常生活和当时的想象力世界要复杂得多。”

paras.en: But it is unclear exactly why these particular people were the victims of violence and why they were buried in such unusual ways. One possible scenario, the researchers wrote in the study, is that these were victims of violent domestic encounters rather than warfare. Their deaths may also have been the result of socially acceptable corporal punishment or some form of aggression within the community.
paras.zh: 但目前尚不清楚这些特定的人为什么是暴力的受害者，以及为什么他们以如此不寻常的方式被埋葬。研究人员在研究中写道，一种可能的情况是，这些人是家庭暴力而不是战争的受害者。他们的死亡也可能是社会可接受的体罚或社区内某种形式的侵略的结果。

paras.en: Given the increase in social inequality and rise in violence in the Iron and Viking ages, the researchers suspect that precarious community members may have been targeted.
paras.zh: 鉴于钢铁和维京时代社会不平等的加剧和暴力的增加，研究人员怀疑不稳定的社区成员可能成为目标。

paras.en: "Not all lives were equally grieved and commemorated in the Iron and Viking Ages of Scandinavia," the researchers wrote. "We may question whether some lives were already considered disposable."
paras.zh: 研究人员写道： “在斯堪的纳维亚半岛的铁器时代和维京时代，并非所有的生命都同样悲伤和纪念。” “我们可能会质疑一些生命是否已经被认为是一次性的。”

paras.en: Eriksen, M.H., Tamorri, V., Louka, V., Tollefsen, E., Kay, K., Appleby, J. (2026). Broken bodies in domestic spaces: Direct and structural violence in an atypical mortuary dataset from Iron and Viking Age Scandinavia. Journal of Archaeological Method and Theory 34. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10816-026-09817-w
paras.zh: Eriksen, M.H.、Tamorri, V.、Louka, V.、Tollefsen, E.、Kay, K.、Appleby, J. (2026)。家庭空间中的破碎尸体：来自铁器和维京时代斯堪的纳维亚半岛的非典型太平间数据集中的直接和结构性暴力。考古方法与理论杂志 34。https://doi.org/10.1007/s10816-026-09817-w

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
