paras.zh: 皮亚库雷尔花了几分钟才拼凑出公告要求撤离。他浪费了时间关掉商店，然后跑回家提醒父母和女儿。在距特里苏里河仅数百米的客厅里，他们花了更重要的几分钟争论是否前往更高的地方。

paras.en: It was too late. At 9:15 a.m., a towering wall of water and debris surged in, forcing the family to the second floor. Then the third, and finally the fourth. Trapped at the top of their home, they could only pray as the flood obliterated the town around them. “We had lost all hope,” Pyakurel says.
paras.zh: 太晚了。上午9点15分，一堵高耸的水墙和瓦砾涌入，迫使一家人逃到二楼。然后是第三个，最后是第四个。他们被困在自家楼顶，只能祈祷，因为洪水淹没了他们周围的城镇。 “我们已经失去了所有希望，”皮亚库雷尔说。

paras.en: After more than an hour of terror, the Pyakurels narrowly survived. Their “miracle green house,” as it came to be called in videos that went viral on social media, somehow remained standing. Thousands of others in towns along an almost 100-kilometer-stretch of the river weren’t as lucky.
paras.zh: 经过一个多小时的恐怖，皮亚库雷尔一家险些生还。他们的“奇迹温室”（在社交媒体上疯传的视频中被称为“奇迹温室”）不知何故仍然屹立不倒。河流近 100 公里长的城镇中的数千人就没那么幸运了。

paras.en: Though the rock-ice avalanche that caused the Himalaya flash flood in late August occurred at 8:37 a.m. local time, many people downriver had only a few minutes of warning or less before the debris flow arrived. The flow destroyed four river gauge sensors before they could signal an alarm. Local authorities who learned of the flow by word of mouth scrambled to send SMS alerts and to reach riverbank towns with handheld megaphones. “The police officer [who made the announcement] was swept away by the floodwaters himself,” Pyakurel says.
paras.zh: 尽管导致8月下旬喜马拉雅山洪爆发的岩冰雪崩发生在当地时间上午8点37分，但在泥石流到来之前，下游的许多人只收到了几分钟或更短的预警。在四个河流压力传感器发出警报之前，水流就摧毁了它们。地方当局通过口口相传得知了水流的情况后，紧急发送短信警报，并用手持扩音器向河岸城镇发出警报。 “（宣布这一消息的）警察本人也被洪水冲走了，”皮亚库雷尔说。

paras.en: The initial avalanche released an energy that equaled an atomic blast, and the resulting debris flow killed at least 1,400 people with more than 5,000 still missing as of September 24. Scientists are calling it one of the most catastrophic geohazards in recorded history.
paras.zh: 截至 9 月 24 日，最初的雪崩释放出的能量相当于原子弹爆炸，由此产生的泥石流造成至少 1,400 人死亡，仍有 5,000 多人失踪。科学家称其为有记录以来最灾难性的地质灾害之一。

paras.en: But despite the magnitude of the event, it didn’t have to be so deadly.
paras.zh: 但尽管事件规模很大，但它并不一定如此致命。

paras.en: Survivors and scientists say that the fragility of Nepal’s early warning systems and the lack of coordinated community responses probably upped the number of lives lost. The disaster is spurring conversations about how Nepal should prepare for future glacier-related failures. Such events are becoming increasingly common across high mountain regions including the European Alps, Andes, Karakoram and the Himalaya. But because of its high slopes and steep valleys, says Christian Huggel, a geographer at the University of Zürich, “everything is much bigger in the Himalaya.”
paras.zh: 幸存者和科学家表示，尼泊尔早期预警系统的脆弱性和缺乏协调一致的社区应对措施可能增加了死亡人数。这场灾难引发了关于尼泊尔应如何为未来与冰川相关的故障做好准备的讨论。此类事件在欧洲阿尔卑斯山、安第斯山脉、喀喇昆仑山脉和喜马拉雅山等高山地区变得越来越普遍。但苏黎世大学地理学家克里斯蒂安·哈格尔表示，由于山坡高、山谷陡，“喜马拉雅山的一切都更大。”

paras.en: Predicting an event like Nepal’s rock-ice avalanche in advance is “likely impossible,” says Ashim Sattar, a cryosphere scientist at the Indian Institute of Technology in Bhubaneswar. Because events of such magnitude are rare, there isn’t a lot of existing data to go on.
paras.zh: 印度布巴内斯瓦尔理工学院的冰冻圈科学家阿希姆·萨塔尔表示，提前预测像尼泊尔岩冰雪崩这样的事件“可能是不可能的”。由于如此大规模的事件很少见，因此没有大量现有数据可供参考。

paras.en: Satellite images taken weeks before the avalanche show signs of cracks opening up, but those cracks are nothing special. “There are probably hundreds of cracks opening in the Himalaya,” Huggel says. It’s not clear which cracks pose a serious risk.
paras.zh: 雪崩前几周拍摄的卫星图像显示了裂缝出现的迹象，但这些裂缝并没有什么特别的。 “喜马拉雅山上可能有数百条裂缝，”胡格尔说。目前尚不清楚哪些裂缝会带来严重风险。

paras.en: Most current glacier monitoring in the Himalaya focuses on the threat of a glacial lake outburst flood, or GLOF. An influx of meltwater is increasing the size of highland lakes, which can suddenly burst and flood downstream villages. A mix of satellite monitoring, which can track the size of lakes, and on-the-ground field stations can warn of such hazards in advance. “If glacial lakes are forming rapidly, scientists can detect that a few weeks before possible outburst,” Huggel says. Even here, though, only 21 of some 40,000 glacial lakes across the Himalaya are actively monitored via on-the-ground stations.
paras.zh: 目前喜马拉雅山的大多数冰川监测都集中在冰川湖溃决洪水（GLOF）的威胁上。融水的涌入正在扩大高原湖泊的规模，这些湖泊可能会突然决堤并淹没下游村庄。卫星监测可以跟踪湖泊的大小，而地面站可以提前警告此类危险。 “如果冰川湖正在迅速形成，科学家们可以在冰川湖可能爆发前几周检测到，”胡格尔说。但即使在这里，喜马拉雅山上约 40,000 个冰川湖中也只有 21 个受到地面站的主动监测。

paras.en: Rock-ice avalanches are harder to predict, largely because it is difficult to study the fracture zone hidden beneath the surface and thus to know what volume of material will break off.
paras.zh: 岩冰雪崩更难预测，主要是因为很难研究隐藏在地表以下的断裂带，从而很难知道有多少物质会断裂。

paras.en: Despite these challenges, scientists have managed some similar avalanche predictions. In May 2025, a massive glacier collapsed in southwestern Switzerland, triggering an ice and rock avalanche that destroyed the village of Blatten. The possibility of the avalanche, which ended up being a tenth the size or smaller of the Nepal avalanche, was recognized by a local hazard observer who was assigned to monitor the mountains and knew them well.
paras.zh: 尽管面临这些挑战，科学家们还是做出了一些类似的雪崩预测。 2025 年 5 月，瑞士西南部的一座巨大冰川崩塌，引发冰雪崩塌，摧毁了布拉滕村。这次雪崩的规模最终只有尼泊尔雪崩的十分之一或更小，一位被派去监测山脉的当地灾害观察员认识到了这一可能性，他对山脉非常了解。

paras.en: “He observed something strange as the mountain seemed to move and alerted the local and district authorities,” Huggel says. They brought in various sensors and monitoring systems to measure the movement of the slope and executed a quick evacuation around a week in advance of the failure, saving hundreds of lives.
paras.zh: “当山似乎在移动时，他观察到了一些奇怪的现象，并向当地和地区当局发出了警报，”胡格尔说。他们引入了各种传感器和监控系统来测量斜坡的移动，并在故障发生前一周左右进行了快速疏散，挽救了数百人的生命。

paras.en: Whether similar local hazard observers could have spotted a potential disaster in Nepal and called on the necessary resources for early evaluation is far from clear. The terrain is difficult to access, and its location near the border between Nepal and China adds a layer of political complexity. “Monitoring these slopes is nobody’s job,” says Kshitij Dahal, a hydrologist at the University of Kansas in Lawrence who is originally from Nepal. Most of the monitoring in Nepal is reactive rather than anticipatory, he adds.
paras.zh: 类似的当地灾害观察员是否能够在尼泊尔发现潜在的灾害并呼吁必要的资源进行早期评估还远不清楚。该地区地形难以进入，而且其位置靠近尼泊尔和中国边境，这增加了政治的复杂性。 “监测这些斜坡不是任何人的工作，”来自尼泊尔的劳伦斯堪萨斯大学水文学家 Kshitij Dahal 说。他补充说，尼泊尔的大部分监测都是被动的，而不是预期的。

paras.en: Without the ability to predict such catastrophes, early warning systems are the primary line of defense. In the Himalaya, river gauge sensors are commonly deployed to warn of coming floods. These sensors monitor the water level in the river and send out an alarm if there is a substantial rise.
paras.zh: 如果没有能力预测此类灾难，早期预警系统就是主要的防线。在喜马拉雅山，通常部署河流测量传感器来警告即将到来的洪水。这些传感器监测河流的水位，如果水位大幅上涨，就会发出警报。

paras.en: But these sensors, including the ones installed in Trishuli River, are primarily used for monsoon season flooding, when the water level tends to increase gradually. They transmit flood data every 10 minutes. Nepal’s flood hit with such sudden intensity that sensors located between nine and 100 kilometers from the avalanche site were wiped out before they could report high water.
paras.zh: 但这些传感器，包括安装在 Trishuli 河上的传感器，主要用于季风季节洪水，此时水位往往会逐渐上升。他们每 10 分钟传输一次洪水数据。尼泊尔的洪水来得如此突然，以至于距离雪崩地点 9 至 100 公里的传感器在报告高水位之前就被摧毁了。

paras.en: Other technologies are available or in development. Early warning systems that rely on seismometers might offer a workable solution. After Nepal’s massive earthquake in 2015, Basanta Raj Adhikari, an engineering geologist at the Tribhuvan University in Kathmandu, Nepal, and his team installed six seismometers along Bhotekoshi River in a nearby valley of Central Nepal.
paras.zh: 其他技术已经可用或正在开发中。依赖地震仪的预警系统可能会提供一个可行的解决方案。 2015 年尼泊尔大地震后，尼泊尔加德满都特里布万大学的工程地质学家 Basanta Raj Adhikari 和他的团队在尼泊尔中部附近山谷的 Bhotekoshi 河沿岸安装了 6 个地震仪。

paras.en: Placed a couple of kilometers above the riverbank, the sensors were intended to assess how long it took for the landscape to become stable again after such a major geological event. In July 2016, when a glacial lake in Tibet burst open, the resulting flood destroyed hydropower stations, highways and buildings — and produced distinct seismic signals picked up by those Bhotekoshi River sensors. Adhikari thinks that if such systems are set up to operate in real-time, they could detect and warn of floods in advance.
paras.zh: 这些传感器放置在河岸上方几公里处，旨在评估在发生如此重大的地质事件后，地貌需要多长时间才能恢复稳定。 2016 年 7 月，西藏的一个冰川湖决堤，由此引发的洪水摧毁了水电站、高速公路和建筑物，并产生了由博特科希河传感器接收到的独特地震信号。 Adhikari 认为，如果此类系统能够实时运行，它们就可以提前检测并警告洪水。

paras.en: Researchers studying seismic signals after historic and deadly flooding in western Germany’s Ahr Valley in 2021 also determined that seismic monitoring could have provided an early warning. The signals revealed details about the likely height of the water, the velocity of the sediment, the spread of the flood and the types of debris. Inexpensive seismic stations can cost somewhere around a couple thousand dollars, the researchers say, with some citizen-science seismographs available for costs below $500.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究 2021 年德国西部阿尔河谷历史性致命洪水后的地震信号时也发现，地震监测可以提供早期预警。这些信号揭示了有关水位可能高度、沉积物速度、洪水蔓延和碎片类型的详细信息。研究人员表示，廉价地震台的成本约为几千美元，一些公民科学地震仪的成本低于 500 美元。

paras.en: Putting eyes on the landscape is another approach. Ólafur Stitelmann, a geomonitoring expert at the Zürich-based company Geoprevent, deploys tools that can scan and monitor glaciers for deformations of millimeters per day or per hour. Some of these tools, including interferometric radars, camera systems and satellite-based navigation sensors, were used to assess the ice before the Blatten collapse, and they could form the basis of early warning systems.
paras.zh: 关注风景是另一种方法。 Ólafur Stitelmann 是苏黎世 Geoprevent 公司的地质监测专家，他部署的工具可以扫描和监测冰川每天或每小时的毫米变形。其中一些工具，包括干涉雷达、摄像系统和卫星导航传感器，被用来在布拉顿塌陷之前评估冰层，它们可以构成早期预警系统的基础。

paras.en: Stitelmann’s team is now working to deploy high-resolution cameras, weather stations, lake level sensors and water temperature sensors at two sites at risk from GLOFs in the state of Sikkim, India. Once a day, the data is sent via satellite to local authorities who can analyze conditions and take timely action if needed.
paras.zh: Stitelmann 的团队目前正致力于在印度锡金州两个面临 GLOF 风险的地点部署高分辨率摄像机、气象站、湖水位传感器和水温传感器。数据每天一次通过卫星发送给地方当局，地方当局可以分析情况并在需要时及时采取行动。

paras.en: Yet early warning systems are far from plug-and-play solutions, and they are too costly to deploy en masse. What works in the Alps may not automatically work in the Himalaya, in part because these systems need to be integrated into the local infrastructure. “If you have very good sensors but suddenly don’t have power to turn it on, then it’s worthless,” Stitelmann says. Similarly, there needs to be a network available to transmit the data that can trigger the warning. And every step needs to have backups, he adds.
paras.zh: 然而，预警系统远非即插即用的解决方案，而且大规模部署成本太高。在阿尔卑斯山有效的系统可能不会自动在喜马拉雅山有效，部分原因是这些系统需要集成到当地基础设施中。 “如果你有非常好的传感器，但突然没有能力打开它，那么它就毫无价值，”斯蒂特曼说。同样，需要有一个网络可用于传输可以触发警告的数据。他补充说，每一步都需要备份。

paras.en: It is important to have more than one sensor, says Huggel, who would complement any seismic stations with wire-based sensors stretching across the river. Installing backup sensors at different elevations could also buy crucial time if primary riverbank stations are wiped out.
paras.zh: 胡格尔说，拥有多个传感器非常重要，他可以用横跨河流的有线传感器来补充任何地震站。如果主要河岸站被摧毁，在不同海拔安装备用传感器也可以赢得关键时间。

paras.en: Such dream systems are expensive, ranging from tens of thousands of dollars to costs in the millions for a multi-sensor set of stations when the necessary infrastructure and backups are included, Stitelmann says. When the World Bank financed the setup of an early warning system downstream of a glacier lake, Tsho Rolpa in Nepal, in 1998, the cost was over a million dollars.
paras.zh: Stitelmann 表示，这样的理想系统非常昂贵，如果包括必要的基础设施和备份，多传感器站的成本从数万美元到数百万美元不等。 1998年，世界银行资助在尼泊尔Tsho Rolpa冰川湖下游建立预警系统，费用超过100万美元。

paras.en: In the case of Nepal, officials are discussing some relatively simple steps. One is putting backup sensors on the cliffs, since systems on bridges were quickly wiped out. Another is changing the design of river gauges so they transmit data once the water reaches a threshold level, rather than after a 10-minute interval.
paras.zh: 就尼泊尔而言，官员们正在讨论一些相对简单的步骤。一是在悬崖上安装备用传感器，因为桥梁上的系统很快就被摧毁了。另一个是改变河流水位计的设计，一旦水位达到阈值，它们就会传输数据，而不是每隔 10 分钟传输一次数据。

paras.en: Even if the technology works perfectly, there are social aspects to consider, including who decides when an alarm is issued, what message is delivered and how, and who coordinates evacuation. False warnings are also a problem, because people who have received them before may not trust that the next warning is genuine. “Technologies alone are no magical solutions,” Stitelmann says.
paras.zh: 即使该技术运行完美，也需要考虑社会方面的问题，包括由谁决定何时发出警报、传递什么消息以及如何传递，以及由谁协调疏散。虚假警告也是一个问题，因为之前收到过警告的人可能不相信下一个警告是真实的。 “仅靠技术并不是神奇的解决方案，”斯蒂特曼说。

paras.en: After GLOF events in the village of Lunana in Bhutan in 2019 and 2023, Sattar and his team interviewed residents about the community response. Although an automated siren had been installed in the region, it wasn’t triggered in either case. Locals instead relied on environmental cues including the sound of the river, ground vibrations and phone calls from friends and family to evacuate.
paras.zh: 2019 年和 2023 年在不丹卢纳纳村发生 GLOF 事件后，萨塔尔和他的团队采访了居民，了解社区的反应。尽管该地区安装了自动警报器，但两种情况都没有触发。相反，当地人依靠环境线索来疏散，包括河流的声音、地面震动以及朋友和家人的电话。

paras.en: Locals also reported being aware of the potential danger because of past flooding and ongoing government outreach. Sattar’s team also learned that disaster response could have been improved if the community had regular mock drills and if families prepacked evacuation bags with medicines, food, lights and warm clothes in case of an emergency.
paras.zh: 当地人还报告说，由于过去的洪水和持续的政府宣传，他们意识到了潜在的危险。萨塔尔的团队还了解到，如果社区定期进行模拟演习，并且家庭在紧急情况下预先装上药品、食物、灯光和保暖衣物的疏散袋，灾难应对能力可能会得到改善。

paras.en: In Nepal, many people probably lost their lives because of confusion and lack of awareness, says Pyakurel, the Dhunge Bazaar shopkeeper. For most, it was the biggest flood that they would have encountered in their lifetime. In July 2025, a glacial lake in Tibet burst open, leaving nine dead and 20 missing in Nepal, but it didn’t affect this area as dramatically. “Last year’s flood barely touched the bridge, so [we] assumed this flood wouldn’t reach high ground,” he adds.
paras.zh: Dunge Bazaar 店主 Pyakurel 表示，在尼泊尔，许多人可能因为混乱和缺乏意识而丧生。对于大多数人来说，这是他们一生中遇到的最大的洪水。 2025年7月，西藏的一个冰湖决裂，导致尼泊尔9人死亡、20人失踪，但对该地区的影响并没有那么严重。 “去年的洪水几乎没有触及桥梁，所以（我们）假设这次洪水不会到达高地，”他补充道。

paras.en: The disaster highlights the need for better education about the potential dangers and preparation so people can act quickly, says Sattar.
paras.zh: 萨塔尔说，这场灾难凸显出需要更好地了解潜在危险和做好准备，以便人们能够迅速采取行动。

paras.en: Stories of survival also offer insights into what matters most in an emergency. On the morning of August 26, Rajendra Dawadi, a principal at the Tribhuvan Trishuli Secondary School, received a verbal warning from another school staffer about rising waters upstream. Even without official confirmation, he acted instantly. He asked to ring the school bell, instructed teachers to evacuate classrooms, and called drivers carrying buses with students to head to higher ground — saving more than 900 students.
paras.zh: 生存故事还让我们深入了解紧急情况下什么才是最重要的。 8月26日上午，特里布万·特里舒利中学校长拉金德拉·达瓦迪收到另一名学校工作人员关于上游水位上涨的口头警告。即使没有得到官方确认，他也立即采取了行动。他要求按响学校钟，指示老师疏散教室，并呼叫载有学生的巴士司机前往地势较高的地方，从而拯救了 900 多名学生。

paras.en: It wasn’t a sophisticated system that made the difference in this case, but a quick decision to evacuate. “I thought that even if the warning turned out to be wrong, the worst it would cost us was one day of study,” Dawadi told the New York Times. “But taking it lightly could mean the loss of hundreds of lives.”
paras.zh: 在这起案件中，发挥作用的并不是复杂的系统，而是快速的疏散决定。达瓦迪告诉《纽约时报》：“我认为，即使这个警告最终被证明是错误的，最糟糕的结果就是让我们损失一天的学习时间。” “但掉以轻心可能意味着数百人丧生。”

articles.title: A medieval remedy could offer ideas for beating antibiotic resistance
articles.author: Hannah Thomasy

paras.en: A look one thousand years into the past is revealing clues about how to develop the bacteria-fighting drugs of the future.
paras.zh: 回顾一千年的过去，揭示了如何开发未来抗菌药物的线索。

paras.en: A concoction from a 10th century medical manuscript damaged cell membranes, altered the expression of disease-promoting genes and interfered with interbacterial communication when added to bacterial cultures, researchers report September 3 in mSphere. What’s more, three kinds of harmful bacteria developed resistance to the medicinal mixture much more slowly compared with conventional single-molecule antibiotics.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 3 日在 mSphere 上报告称，来自 10 世纪医学手稿的混合物在添加到细菌培养物中时会损坏细胞膜，改变致病基因的表达，并干扰细菌间的通讯。此外，与传统的单分子抗生素相比，三种有害细菌对药物混合物产生耐药性的速度要慢得多。

paras.en: “The difference is remarkable,” says Omar El-Halfawy, a microbiologist at the University of Regina in Canada who was not involved in the research. This impaired ability to develop resistance may occur because the medieval medicine affects several bacterial targets, says Freya Harrison, a microbiologist at the University of Warwick in England. For bacterial colonies to survive, “they’ve potentially got to mutate multiple targets, and that’s difficult.”
paras.zh: “差异是显着的，”未参与这项研究的加拿大里贾纳大学微生物学家 Omar El-Halfawy 说道。英国华威大学微生物学家弗雷娅·哈里森 (Freya Harrison) 表示，这种产生耐药性的能力可能会受到损害，因为中世纪药物会影响多种细菌靶标。为了让细菌菌落生存，“它们可能必须突变多个目标，这很困难。”

paras.en: The modern adaptation of the 10th century recipe (shown) involves combining garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine, then brewing the pungent mixture in a brass vessel for nine days.
paras.zh: 现代对 10 世纪配方的改编（如图所示）包括将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和葡萄酒混合，然后在黄铜容器中将这种刺激性混合物酿造九天。

paras.en: Currently, antibiotic-resistant infections kill more than 1 million people each year. But humans have been battling the minuscule enemies that cause diseases like plague, leprosy and tuberculosis for millennia. Sometime in the 10th century, Anglo-Saxon scribes compiled several sometimes-dubious treatments into a medical text known as Bald’s Leechbook.
paras.zh: 目前，抗生素耐药性感染每年导致超过 100 万人死亡。但几千年来，人类一直在与引起鼠疫、麻风病和结核病等疾病的微小敌人作斗争。在 10 世纪的某个时候，盎格鲁撒克逊抄写员将几种有时可疑的治疗方法汇编成一本医学著作，称为《巴尔德的水蛭书》。

paras.en: In 2015, Harrison and a team of microbiologists and historians brewed a remedy from the Leechbook, called Bald’s eyesalve, in the lab. They mixed garlic, onion, bovine bile and wine in a brass vessel, then allowed it to stand for nine days. In laboratory tests, Bald’s eyesalve displayed surprisingly effective antimicrobial activity against both Staphylococcus aureus and its drug-resistant form, MRSA.
paras.zh: 2015年，哈里森和一群微生物学家和历史学家在实验室里根据水蛭书酿造了一种药物，称为秃头眼药水。他们将大蒜、洋葱、牛胆汁和酒混合在一个黄铜容器中，然后静置九天。在实验室测试中，Bald 的眼药对金黄色葡萄球菌及其耐药形式 MRSA 表现出令人惊讶的有效抗菌活性。

paras.en: This time, the scientists set out to determine how the eyesalve affected pathogens, measuring how the brew altered gene expression in bacterial cultures. After eyesalve treatment, hundreds of S. aureus genes were expressed differently, including ones related to cell membrane composition and disease-causing potential.
paras.zh: 这一次，科学家们着手确定眼药如何影响病原体，测量这种饮料如何改变细菌培养物中的基因表达。眼药治疗后，数百个金黄色葡萄球菌基因表达不同，包括与细胞膜组成和致病潜力相关的基因。

paras.en: The remedy also damaged bacterial membranes, a possibly lethal maneuver. Furthermore, very low concentrations of the eyesalve reduced S. aureus’ ability to create hardy antibiotic-resisting colony formations called biofilms. It also inhibited bacterial cell communication, which pathogens use to coordinate activities and become more harmful.
paras.zh: 这种疗法还会破坏细菌膜，这可能是致命的。此外，极低浓度的眼药水会降低金黄色葡萄球菌产生耐抗生素菌落形成（称为生物膜）的能力。它还抑制细菌细胞通讯，病原体利用这种通讯来协调活动并变得更加有害。

paras.en: Finally, the team dosed cultures of S. aureus and two other pathogens with increasing concentrations of the eyesalve or commonly used antibiotics to see how quickly resistance developed. After two weeks, the microbes often flourished despite exposure to eight to sixteen times the amount of the traditional antibiotic that had stymied their growth at the beginning. In contrast, they could only tolerate slightly higher eyesalve concentrations.
paras.zh: 最后，研究小组向金黄色葡萄球菌和其他两种病原体的培养物中加入浓度不断增加的眼药水或常用抗生素，以观察耐药性发展的速度。两周后，尽管接触的传统抗生素的量是一开始阻碍微生物生长的八到十六倍，但微生物仍然经常繁殖。相比之下，他们只能忍受稍高的眼药浓度。

paras.en: Harrison says she’s not expecting people to whip up their own batches of eyesalve to treat infections. “It would be really impractical to do that, and also potentially really unreliable and dangerous because it’s going to be so variable.”
paras.zh: 哈里森说，她并不指望人们自己制作一批眼药水来治疗感染。 “这样做确实不切实际，而且可能非常不可靠和危险，因为它会变得如此多变。”

paras.en: Instead, she says, researchers could recapitulate the eyesalve’s multipronged attack in a clinically suitable way with a lab-made cocktail containing a handful of the potion’s active ingredients. “Somewhere in there, there’s this combination of molecules that’s responsible for most of this effect — so, can we find out what they are?”
paras.zh: 相反，她说，研究人员可以用一种实验室制造的含有少量药水活性成分的鸡尾酒，以临床上合适的方式重现眼药水的多管齐下的作用。 “在那里的某个地方，有这种分子组合造成了大部分这种效应——那么，我们能找出它们是什么吗？”

articles.title: Exhaling may speed up reaction times
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: A sprinter’s first task is to react to the starting pistol. Now, a button-clicking experiment suggests that how quickly people respond to a cue may depend in part on whether they’re breathing in or out.
paras.zh: 短跑运动员的首要任务是对发令枪做出反应。现在，一项点击按钮的实验表明，人们对提示的反应速度可能部分取决于他们是吸气还是呼气。

paras.en: Volunteers’ reaction times were faster when they exhaled or held their breath compared with when they inhaled, researchers report September 28 in iScience.
paras.zh: 研究人员 9 月 28 日在《iScience》杂志上报告称，与吸气时相比，志愿者呼气或屏住呼吸时的反应速度更快。

paras.en: Ken Paller and Erika Yamazaki, then both cognitive neuroscientists at Northwestern University, made their discovery while studying breathing patterns to find treatments for sleep apnea. Yamazaki graduated from her PhD earlier this year.
paras.zh: 肯·帕勒（Ken Paller）和埃里卡·山崎（Erika Yamazaki）当时都是西北大学的认知神经科学家，他们在研究呼吸模式以寻找睡眠呼吸暂停的治疗方法时发现了这一点。山崎今年早些时候从博士学位毕业。

paras.en: Paller and Yamazaki determined how sleepy 35 volunteers were with a simple reaction-time test. The volunteers were tasked with clicking a button when an on-screen red square turned yellow.
paras.zh: Paller 和 Yamazaki 通过简单的反应时间测试确定了 35 名志愿者的困倦程度。志愿者的任务是当屏幕上的红色方块变成黄色时点击按钮。

paras.en: Yamazaki realized that, because the volunteers’ breathing was recorded through short tubes in the nose throughout the task, the researchers could also check whether inhaling or exhaling influenced reaction times.
paras.zh: 山崎意识到，由于在整个任务过程中志愿者的呼吸都是通过鼻子里的短管记录的，因此研究人员还可以检查吸气或呼气是否影响反应时间。

paras.en: Reaction times were, on average, 41 milliseconds faster during exhalation than during inhalation. This finding held regardless of how sleepy or alert the volunteers were.
paras.zh: 呼气时的反应时间比吸气时平均快 41 毫秒。无论志愿者有多困或多警觉，这一发现都成立。

paras.en: That might not sound like a huge difference, but Noah Lyles won the 2024 Olympic men’s 100-meter final by five thousandths of a second. Those 41 milliseconds would have made the difference between Lyles winning and finishing fourth.
paras.zh: 这听起来可能不是一个巨大的差异，但诺亚·莱尔斯 (Noah Lyles) 以千分之五秒的优势赢得了 2024 年奥运会男子 100 米决赛。这 41 毫秒将决定莱尔斯能否获胜和获得第四名。

paras.en: But the relationship between breath and brain appears to be complex. A 2016 study found that reaction times were faster during inhalation than exhalation in tests of recall and facial recognition. But these tasks differed from the hair-trigger change Paller and Yamazaki studied. Those tasks required more cognitive processing, Paller says, because they required the participants to judge whether, for example, a face look fearful or surprised, rather than waiting for a simple cue. “That may or may not have the same relationship with respiration.”
paras.zh: 但呼吸和大脑之间的关系似乎很复杂。 2016 年的一项研究发现，在回忆和面部识别测试中，吸气时的反应时间比呼气时更快。但这些任务与帕勒和山崎研究的一触即发的变化不同。帕勒说，这些任务需要更多的认知处理，因为它们要求参与者判断一张脸是否看起来害怕或惊讶，而不是等待一个简单的提示。 “这可能与呼吸有相同的关系，也可能没有。”

paras.en: The mechanism behind these findings isn’t clear, although Paller points to studies, like the one from 2016, that suggest our breath is synced to the ebb and flow of our brain waves.
paras.zh: 这些发现背后的机制尚不清楚，尽管帕勒指出，2016 年的一项研究表明，我们的呼吸与脑电波的潮起潮落是同步的。

paras.en: In a race decided by thousandths of a second, every factor matters, even a single breath.
paras.zh: 在千分之一秒决定胜负的比赛中，每一个因素都很重要，甚至是一次呼吸。

articles.title: 40 Patients Were Infected by a Hospital's Water Supply Across 6 Years
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: For seven years, a renowned British hospital has grappled with a serious bacterial outbreak in its water supply that, according to a coroner's inquest and a new scientific paper, was linked to two deaths and 38 other cases of infection.
paras.zh: 七年来，一家著名的英国医院一直在努力应对其供水系统中严重的细菌爆发问题，根据验尸官的调查和一篇新的科学论文，该细菌爆发与 2 例死亡和其他 38 例感染病例有关。

paras.en: The new paper, led by members of the UK Health Security Agency and the Royal Papworth Hospital's medical director, offers new detail into the outbreak. It is published in the journal Clinical Infectious Diseases.
paras.zh: 这份由英国健康安全局成员和皇家帕普沃斯医院医疗主任领导的新论文提供了有关疫情的新细节。它发表在《临床传染病》杂志上。

paras.en: In 2025, the BBC reported that two women died after developing infections that, a coroner's inquest heard, likely came from the water supply of the hospital where they were receiving lung transplants.
paras.zh: 2025 年，BBC 报道称，两名妇女在感染后死亡，验尸官调查得知，这些感染可能来自她们接受肺移植的医院的供水系统。

paras.en: The inquest also heard that a third patient died, but did not determine whether this was connected to the outbreak.
paras.zh: 调查还得知第三名患者死亡，但没有确定这是否与疫情爆发有关。

paras.en: Both women contracted the bacteria Mycobacterium abscessus following double lung transplants at the then-newly relocated Royal Papworth Hospital in Cambridge.
paras.zh: 两名妇女在当时新搬迁的剑桥皇家帕普沃斯医院进行双肺移植后感染了脓肿分枝杆菌。

paras.en: The women each received treatment for non-tuberculosis mycobacterial pulmonary disease, but died within a year after M. abscessus was first detected in their bodies.
paras.zh: 这些女性均接受了非结核分枝杆菌肺部疾病的治疗，但在她们体内首次检测到脓肿分枝杆菌后一年内死亡。

paras.en: The coroner's inquest concluded that for both women, the M. abscessus infection contributed to their death.
paras.zh: 验尸官的调查得出的结论是，对于这两名妇女来说，脓肿分枝杆菌感染导致了她们的死亡。

paras.en: M. abscessus is a common contaminant that usually only causes problems when it can enter the skin or soft tissues via a wound, or when a person's immune system is weakened – as is the case in transplant patients.
paras.zh: 脓肿分枝杆菌是一种常见的污染物，通常只有在通过伤口进入皮肤或软组织，或者当人的免疫系统减弱时（移植患者的情况）才会引起问题。

paras.en: It's also multi-drug resistant, which makes it difficult to treat.
paras.zh: 它还具有多重耐药性，这使得治疗变得困难。

paras.en: A specialist heart and lung hospital like Royal Papworth, which offers heart and lung transplants, respiratory support, and cystic fibrosis treatment, is perhaps one of the worst places for an outbreak of this bacterium to occur.
paras.zh: 像皇家帕普沃斯这样提供心肺移植、呼吸支持和囊性纤维化治疗的专业心肺医院可能是这种细菌爆发最严重的地方之一。

paras.en: A total of 40 cases of M. abscessus infection have now been linked to the hospital's outbreak, between May 2019 and June 2025.
paras.zh: 2019 年 5 月至 2025 年 6 月期间，共有 40 例脓肿分枝杆菌感染病例与该医院的疫情爆发有关。

paras.en: Eleven of these cases occurred in lung transplant recipients; 11 in cystic fibrosis patients; 14 in patients with non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis; and 4 in other patient groups.
paras.zh: 其中 11 例发生在肺移植受者身上；囊性纤维化患者为11； 14.非囊性纤维化支气管扩张患者；其他患者组中有 4 名。

paras.en: "Infections can take a long time to present, sometimes many years," explains Royal Papworth medical director, Dr Ian Smith.
paras.zh: “感染可能需要很长时间才能出现，有时甚至很多年，”皇家帕普沃斯医疗主任 Ian Smith 博士解释道。

paras.en: "People can acquire an infection and get symptoms straight away, some may not get symptoms until many years later, and some may never get any symptoms at all."
paras.zh: “人们可能会受到感染并立即出现症状，有些人可能要多年后才会出现症状，有些人可能永远不会出现任何症状。”

paras.en: Following the first detections, the hospital undertook environmental sampling, which revealed the outbreak stemmed from the new building's water system.
paras.zh: 首次检测后，医院进行了环境采样，结果显示疫情源于新大楼的供水系统。

paras.en: There was no sign of the bacterium on any swabbed surfaces or medical equipment tested.
paras.zh: 在测试的任何拭子表面或医疗设备上都没有细菌的迹象。

paras.en: By October 2021, the hospital had rolled out a number of control measures, which included installing filters on patient room showers and basin taps, warning vulnerable patients about the risks and offering safety advice prior to admission, and providing them with bottled water during their stay.
paras.zh: 到 2021 年 10 月，医院已推出多项控制措施，包括在病房淋浴间和面盆水龙头上安装过滤器、向弱势患者发出风险警告并在入院前提供安全建议，以及在住院期间为他们提供瓶装水。

paras.en: These measures reduced the incidence of infections, but did not eliminate them entirely.
paras.zh: 这些措施减少了感染发生率，但并没有完全消除感染。

paras.en: "The outbreak strain had persisted and disseminated throughout the hospital, despite extensive control measures taken, with positive results obtained from four different floors," the paper's authors report.
paras.zh: 该论文的作者报告说：“尽管采取了广泛的控制措施，但疫情菌株仍在整个医院持续传播，四个不同楼层都取得了积极的结果。”

paras.en: The hospital also installed a hydrogen peroxide dosing plant and a UV treatment unit in the hope of killing the bacteria in the incoming water supply, but these interventions were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 医院还安装了过氧化氢加药装置和紫外线处理装置，希望杀死供水中的细菌，但这些干预措施并不成功。

paras.en: Between 2022 and 2025, the UK Health Security Agency undertook another round of environmental sampling.
paras.zh: 2022年至2025年间，英国卫生安全局进行了另一轮环境采样。

paras.en: They swabbed and took water samples from drains, showers, toilets and taps around the hospital; they even sampled the air above toilets post-flush.
paras.zh: 他们从医院周围的排水沟、淋浴间、厕所和水龙头中擦拭并采集了水样；他们甚至在冲水后对马桶上方的空气进行了采样。

paras.en: They found the point-of-use filters that the hospital had installed on taps were effective, with no mycobacterium to be found in samples from the filtered water – but patients were still at risk from drain traps and the toilets.
paras.zh: 他们发现医院安装在水龙头上的使用点过滤器很有效，过滤后的水样本中没有发现分枝杆菌，但患者仍然面临排水弯管和厕所的风险。

paras.en: "Following extensive control measures, including point-of-use filters and biocide treatment, incidence fell from 12.8 to 2.2 cases per year," the paper's authors write.
paras.zh: 该论文的作者写道：“采取了广泛的控制措施，包括使用点过滤器和杀菌剂处理，发病率从每年 12.8 例下降到 2.2 例。”

paras.en: "No further case has been identified since June 2025, coinciding with a review of enhanced flushing."
paras.zh: “自 2025 年 6 月以来，没有发现更多病例，同时也对加强冲洗进行了审查。”

paras.en: Dr Smith says current and future patients of Royal Papworth Hospital are now safe from Mycobacterium abscessus, with ongoing vigilance, surveillance, and patient and staff education.
paras.zh: 史密斯博士表示，通过持续的警惕、监测以及对患者和工作人员的教育，皇家帕普沃斯医院当前和未来的患者现在不会感染脓肿分枝杆菌。

paras.en: Solicitor Jatinder Paul said patients were admitted to "this world-renowned hospital… in the hope of a better life", the BBC reported.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，律师贾廷德·保罗 (Jatinder Paul) 表示，患者被送往“这家世界知名的医院……是为了过上更好的生活”。

paras.en: "The events that unfolded have been devastating for them and their families," Paul said.
paras.zh: 保罗说：“所发生的事件对他们和他们的家人来说是毁灭性的。”

paras.en: "We send our heartfelt condolences to those patients and families affected," Dr Smith said.
paras.zh: 史密斯博士说：“我们向受影响的患者和家庭表示衷心的哀悼。”

paras.en: "As has been acknowledged throughout this journey, we followed national guidance in place at the time for the testing and management of water safety and took immediate and robust action once the situation was identified."
paras.zh: “正如我们在整个过程中所承认的那样，我们遵循了当时的国家指导方针进行水安全测试和管理，并在发现情况后立即采取了强有力的行动。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Clinical Infectious Diseases.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《临床传染病》杂志上。

articles.title: It Turns Out, Sharks Can Hear Way Better Than We Thought
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: It's helpful to know how well the senses of underwater predators are working – both to better understand the ecology and biology of marine life, and to get out of their way should you come into contact with them.
paras.zh: 了解水下掠食者的感官运作情况非常有帮助，既可以更好地了解海洋生物的生态和生物学，也可以在您接触到它们时避开它们。

paras.en: How well sharks can hear has been something of a mystery until now, mainly because it's difficult to measure in a controlled way.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，鲨鱼的听觉能力一直是个谜，主要是因为很难以受控的方式进行测量。

paras.en: Hearing is crucial though, especially underwater, for locating prey, avoiding predators, and finding potential mates.
paras.zh: 不过，听力对于定位猎物、躲避捕食者和寻找潜在的配偶至关重要，尤其是在水下。

paras.en: In a new study published in Integrative Organismal Biology, researchers from Florida Atlantic University have demonstrated that blacktip sharks (Carcharhinus limbatus) can hear sounds from as far away as 74 meters (243 feet).
paras.zh: 在《综合有机生物学》上发表的一项新研究中，佛罗里达大西洋大学的研究人员证明，黑鳍真鲨（Carcharhinuslimbatus）可以听到远达 74 米（243 英尺）的声音。

paras.en: That's well beyond the limit of what's known as near-field sound, which has a more direct impact on water particles. At that range, we're talking about far-field sound, where pressure creates more subtle particle movement.
paras.zh: 这远远超出了所谓的近场声音的极限，近场声音对水颗粒有更直接的影响。在这个范围内，我们谈论的是远场声音，其中压力会产生更微妙的粒子运动。

paras.en: "What makes this finding particularly interesting is that the sharks were responding to sounds beyond the acoustic near field, where the sound behaves differently than it does close to the source," says zoologist Stephen Kajiura.
paras.zh: 动物学家斯蒂芬·梶浦说：“这一发现特别有趣的是，鲨鱼对声学近场之外的声音做出了反应，其中声音的表现与接近声源的情况不同。”

paras.en: "This suggests that they are detecting the particle motion associated with sound even at considerable distances from the source – something we have not previously been able to demonstrate in free-swimming sharks."
paras.zh: “这表明，即使在距离声源很远的地方，它们也能检测到与声音相关的粒子运动——这是我们以前无法在自由游动的鲨鱼身上证明的。”

paras.en: The researchers used a drone and a boat off the coast of southeast Florida for their experiments: Pulsing, low-frequency sounds were played from near the team's boat, with two underwater mics used to measure how they traveled through the water.
paras.zh: 研究人员在佛罗里达州东南部海岸附近使用一架无人机和一艘船进行实验：在团队的船附近播放脉冲低频声音，并使用两个水下麦克风来测量它们在水中的移动方式。

paras.en: A drone flying 40–50 meters above the scene recorded how the sharks moved in relation to the sounds. Three test sounds were used at three different pitches, with a control sound beyond the hearing range of the sharks.
paras.zh: 一架在现场上方 40 至 50 米处飞行的无人机记录了鲨鱼的移动与声音的关系。使用三种不同音高的三种测试声音，其中控制声音超出了鲨鱼的听力范围。

paras.en: This species was chosen in part because it's known for congregating regularly every winter at a specific spot along the coast, in waters shallow and clear enough for drones to capture their activities.
paras.zh: 选择这个物种的部分原因是它每年冬天都会定期聚集在沿海的特定地点，水域浅且清澈，足以让无人机捕捉到它们的活动。

paras.en: "Their abundance and accessibility made it possible for us to observe them from above without disturbing their natural behavior, while also presenting controlled underwater sounds," says Kajiura.
paras.zh: “它们的丰富性和可及性使我们能够从上方观察它们，而不干扰它们的自然行为，同时还呈现受控的水下声音，”梶浦说。

paras.en: The sharks ignored the control sounds as expected but responded to the test sounds between 71.1 and 87 percent of the time, depending on frequency. The farthest response from a single shark was 74 meters, while 118 of the 165 total responses came from what would be considered the far field.
paras.zh: 鲨鱼按照预期忽略了控制声音，但在 71.1% 到 87% 的时间内对测试声音做出了反应，具体取决于频率。单个鲨鱼的最远响应为 74 米，而 165 个响应中的 118 个来自被视为远场的区域。

paras.en: For all three frequencies, sharks responded to sounds from as far as 62 meters away.
paras.zh: 对于所有三个频率，鲨鱼都能对 62 米外的声音做出反应。

paras.en: Each response also involved a sharp turn away from the source of the sound, suggesting the sharks knew where it was coming from.
paras.zh: 每一次反应都涉及从声音来源处急剧转身，这表明鲨鱼知道声音来自哪里。

paras.en: "The ocean is an acoustic environment, and sharks are clearly tuned into it in ways we are only beginning to understand," says Kajiura.
paras.zh: “海洋是一个声学环境，鲨鱼显然以我们刚刚开始了解的方式适应了它，”梶浦说。

paras.en: "Being able to detect and respond to sounds from hundreds of feet away gives these predators an important source of information about their surroundings. The next question is how their sensory system allows them to pick up and interpret these distant sounds."
paras.zh: “能够探测到数百英尺外的声音并做出反应，为这些捕食者提供了有关周围环境的重要信息来源。下一个问题是它们的感觉系统如何让它们拾取并解释这些远处的声音。”

paras.en: Sharks lack the gas-filled swim bladder that many bony fish use to hear, which translates pressure into vibration, so something else must be going on here. The researchers suggest that C. limbatus are instead somehow detecting water particle movements.
paras.zh: 鲨鱼缺乏许多硬骨鱼用来听觉的充满气体的鱼鳔，这种鱼鳔可以将压力转化为振动，所以这里肯定发生了其他事情。研究人员认为，C.limbatus 正在以某种方式检测水粒子的运动。

paras.en: That can be investigated in future studies. For now, scientists have a much better idea of the hearing capabilities of sharks, observed out in a real setting.
paras.zh: 这可以在未来的研究中进行调查。目前，通过在真实环境中观察，科学家们对鲨鱼的听力能力有了更好的了解。

paras.en: "Trying to do hearing experiments in a tank results in the sound bouncing off the walls, which causes complex and confusing signals – it is like being in a house of mirrors," says biologist Caroline Sullivan.
paras.zh: 生物学家卡罗琳·沙利文说：“尝试在水箱中进行听力实验会导致声音从墙壁反弹，从而产生复杂且令人困惑的信号——就像在镜子的房子里一样。”

paras.en: "This is why it is so important to do these types of experiments in the ocean with wild sharks to get a natural response."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么在海洋中用野生鲨鱼进行此类实验以获得自然反应如此重要。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Integrative Organismal Biology.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《综合有机生物学》上。

articles.title: Physicists just saw quarks make waves in the Big Bang’s primordial soup

paras.en: Physicists just saw quarks make waves in the Big Bangâs primordial soup
paras.zh: 物理学家刚刚看到夸克在大爆炸的原始汤中掀起波澜

paras.en: Scientists have watched speeding quarks create ripples in primordial matter, revealing just how liquid-like the early universe really was.
paras.zh: 科学家们观察到超速夸克在原始物质中产生涟漪，揭示了早期宇宙到底有多像液体。

paras.en: - Physicists at CERNâs Large Hadron Collider have captured the clearest evidence yet that quark-gluon plasma, the scorching-hot matter that filled the newborn universe, behaves like a true liquid. By tracking individual quarks as they blasted through the plasma, researchers saw them leave behind ripples, splashes, and swirling wakes much like a duck moving through water. The finding suggests this primordial âsoupâ is so dense that it can slow speeding quarks and respond collectively as a fluid.
paras.zh: - 欧洲核子研究中心大型强子对撞机的物理学家已经捕获了迄今为止最清晰的证据，证明夸克-胶子等离子体（充满新生宇宙的灼热物质）的行为就像真正的液体。通过追踪单个夸克穿过等离子体的过程，研究人员发现它们留下了涟漪、飞溅和漩涡尾迹，就像鸭子在水中移动一样。这一发现表明，这种原始“汤”的密度如此之大，以至于它可以减慢加速夸克的速度，并以流体的形式集体反应。

paras.en: In the universe's earliest moments, temperatures reached trillions of degrees, creating an intensely hot mixture of quarks and gluons. These elementary particles raced around at nearly the speed of light in a state of matter known as quark-gluon plasma (QGP). This primordial material existed for only a few millionths of a second before cooling rapidly, allowing quarks and gluons to combine into protons, neutrons, and other particles found throughout the universe today.
paras.zh: 在宇宙最初的时刻，温度达到数万亿度，产生了夸克和胶子的极热混合物。这些基本粒子以接近光速的速度运动，形成一种称为夸克胶子等离子体（QGP）的物质状态。这种原始物质只存在了百万分之几秒，然后迅速冷却，使夸克和胶子结合成质子、中子和当今在宇宙中发现的其他粒子。

paras.en: At CERN's Large Hadron Collider in Switzerland, physicists are recreating quark-gluon plasma to investigate the ingredients that filled the young universe. By colliding heavy ions at nearly the speed of light, researchers can briefly separate quarks and gluons and produce tiny amounts of the same kind of matter that existed during the universe's first microseconds.
paras.zh: 在瑞士欧洲核子研究组织的大型强子对撞机上，物理学家正在重建夸克-胶子等离子体，以研究年轻宇宙中的成分。通过以接近光速的速度碰撞重离子，研究人员可以短暂分离夸克和胶子，并产生微量的宇宙最初几微秒内存在的同类物质。

paras.en: A CERN team led by MIT physicists has now found clear evidence that quarks generate wakes as they travel through this plasma, much like a duck creating ripples as it moves across water. The observations provide the first direct evidence that quark-gluon plasma responds to fast-moving particles as a unified fluid, producing waves, splashes, and swirling motion instead of simply behaving as a collection of independently scattering particles.
paras.zh: 由麻省理工学院物理学家领导的欧洲核子研究中心团队现在发现了明确的证据，表明夸克在穿过等离子体时会产生尾流，就像鸭子在水面上移动时产生涟漪一样。这些观察结果提供了第一个直接证据，证明夸克-胶子等离子体作为统一流体对快速移动的粒子做出反应，产生波浪、飞溅和旋转运动，而不是简单地表现为独立散射粒子的集合。

paras.en: "It has been a long debate in our field, on whether the plasma should respond to a quark," says Yen-Jie Lee, professor of physics at MIT. "Now we see the plasma is incredibly dense, such that it is able to slow down a quark, and produces splashes and swirls like a liquid. So quark-gluon plasma really is a primordial soup."
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院物理学教授 Yen-Jie Lee 表示：“关于等离子体是否应该对夸克做出反应，在我们的领域一直存在长期争论。” “现在我们看到等离子体非常密集，因此它能够减慢夸克的速度，并像液体一样产生飞溅和漩涡。所以夸克-胶子等离子体确实是一种原始汤。”

paras.en: Lee and his colleagues developed a new method for detecting these quark wakes. They plan to use the technique on additional particle collision data to search for more examples and study them in greater detail.
paras.zh: 李和他的同事开发了一种检测这些夸克尾迹的新方法。他们计划在额外的粒子碰撞数据上使用该技术来搜索更多示例并进行更详细的研究。

paras.en: By measuring how large the wakes become, how quickly they travel, how far they extend, and how long they take to fade, scientists may be able to determine important properties of quark-gluon plasma. Those measurements could also offer clues about how the plasma behaved during the first microseconds after the universe began.
paras.zh: 通过测量尾流的大小、行进速度、延伸距离以及消失时间，科学家或许能够确定夸克-胶子等离子体的重要特性。这些测量结果还可以提供有关宇宙开始后最初几微秒内等离子体如何表现的线索。

paras.en: "Studying how quark wakes bounce back and forth will give us new insights on the quark-gluon plasma's properties," Lee says. "With this experiment, we are taking a snapshot of this primordial quark soup."
paras.zh: “研究夸克尾流如何来回反弹将为我们提供关于夸克-胶子等离子体特性的新见解，”李说。 “通过这个实验，我们正在拍摄这种原始夸克汤的快照。”

paras.en: The study's co-authors are members of the CMS Collaboration, a worldwide group of particle physicists who conduct and analyze experiments using the Compact Muon Solenoid (CMS), one of the general-purpose particle detectors at CERN's Large Hadron Collider. Researchers used the CMS experiment to identify signs of quark wakes in this study. The open-access findings appear in Physics Letters B.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者是 CMS Collaboration 的成员，CMS Collaboration 是一个由粒子物理学家组成的全球组织，他们使用紧凑型 Muon 螺线管 (CMS) 进行和分析实验，CMS 是 CERN 大型强子对撞机的通用粒子探测器之一。研究人员在这项研究中使用 CMS 实验来识别夸克尾迹的迹象。开放获取的发现发表在《Physics Letters B》上。

paras.en: Quark-gluon plasma is thought to have been the first liquid in the universe. It was also the hottest liquid ever known, reaching temperatures of several trillion degrees Celsius during its brief existence.
paras.zh: 夸克-胶子等离子体被认为是宇宙中第一种液体。它也是迄今为止已知的最热的液体，在其短暂存在期间温度达到数万亿摄氏度。

paras.en: Scientists have also described QGP as a near-"perfect" liquid. In this unusual state, individual quarks and gluons appear to move together as an exceptionally smooth fluid with almost no friction.
paras.zh: 科学家还将 QGP 描述为一种近乎“完美”的液体。在这种不寻常的状态下，单个夸克和胶子似乎像异常光滑的流体一样一起移动，几乎没有摩擦。

paras.en: This understanding comes from numerous experiments and theoretical studies. One influential model was developed by Krishna Rajagopal, the William A. M. Burden Professor of Physics at MIT, and his collaborators. Known as the hybrid model, it predicts that quark-gluon plasma should react like a fluid when energetic particles travel through it.
paras.zh: 这种认识来自大量的实验和理论研究。麻省理工学院威廉·A·M·伯登 (William A. M. Burden) 物理学教授克里希纳·拉贾戈帕尔 (Krishna Rajagopal) 及其合作者开发了一种有影响力的模型。它被称为混合模型，它预测当高能粒子穿过夸克-胶子等离子体时，夸克-胶子等离子体应该像流体一样反应。

paras.en: According to the model, a fast-moving jet of quarks should disturb the surrounding plasma and leave a wake behind, causing the material to ripple and splash.
paras.zh: 根据该模型，快速移动的夸克射流会扰乱周围的等离子体并留下尾迹，导致材料产生波纹和飞溅。

paras.en: Physicists have spent years searching for evidence of these wakes at the Large Hadron Collider and other high-energy particle accelerators. In these experiments, heavy ions such as lead are accelerated to nearly the speed of light and smashed together. The collisions briefly create tiny droplets of primordial matter that usually survive for less than a quadrillionth of a second.
paras.zh: 物理学家花了数年时间在大型强子对撞机和其他高能粒子加速器中寻找这些尾流的证据。在这些实验中，铅等重离子被加速到接近光速并粉碎在一起。碰撞会短暂地产生微小的原始物质液滴，这些液滴通常存活时间不到万亿分之一秒。

paras.en: Researchers must effectively capture a snapshot of that fleeting moment and use the resulting particle patterns to reconstruct the properties of the quark-gluon plasma.
paras.zh: 研究人员必须有效地捕捉那一瞬间的快照，并利用由此产生的粒子模式来重建夸克-胶子等离子体的特性。

paras.en: Previous searches for quark wakes often focused on pairs consisting of a quark and an "antiquark." Antiquarks are counterparts to quarks whose certain properties have the same magnitude but opposite signs.
paras.zh: 以前对夸克尾迹的搜索通常集中在由夸克和“反夸克”组成的对上。反夸克是夸克的对应物，其某些性质具有相同的大小但符号相反。

paras.en: When a quark moves rapidly through the plasma, an antiquark may be produced traveling at the same speed in the opposite direction. Scientists therefore searched for quark and antiquark pairs, expecting both particles to produce detectable wakes in the surrounding plasma.
paras.zh: 当夸克快速穿过等离子体时，可能会产生以相同速度沿相反方向传播的反夸克。因此，科学家们寻找夸克和反夸克对，期望这两种粒子在周围的等离子体中产生可检测到的尾流。

paras.en: "When you have two quarks produced, the problem is that, when the two quarks go in opposite directions, the one quark overshadows the wake of the second quark," Lee says.
paras.zh: “当产生两个夸克时，问题在于，当两个夸克朝相反方向运动时，第一个夸克会掩盖第二个夸克的尾迹，”李说。

paras.en: Lee and his colleagues realized that the wake from a single quark would be much easier to identify if there were no second quark creating an overlapping disturbance.
paras.zh: 李和他的同事意识到，如果没有第二个夸克产生重叠扰动，那么单个夸克的尾流将更容易识别。

paras.en: "We have figured out a new technique that allows us to see the effects of a single quark in the QGP, through a different pair of particles," Lee says.
paras.zh: “我们已经找到了一种新技术，可以让我们通过一对不同的粒子来观察 QGP 中单个夸克的影响，”Lee 说。

paras.en: Instead of searching for quark and antiquark pairs after lead ion collisions, the researchers looked for events in which one quark traveled through the plasma in nearly the opposite direction from a "Z boson."
paras.zh: 研究人员没有在铅离子碰撞后寻找夸克和反夸克对，而是寻找一个夸克以与“Z玻色子”几乎相反的方向穿过等离子体的事件。

paras.en: A Z boson is a neutral elementary particle associated with the weak force. It interacts very little with the surrounding plasma, making it useful as a clean reference point. Z bosons also appear at a distinctive energy, which makes them relatively easy for physicists to identify.
paras.zh: Z玻色子是一种与弱力相关的中性基本粒子。它与周围等离子体的相互作用非常小，因此可以用作干净的参考点。 Z 玻色子也以独特的能量出现，这使得物理学家相对容易识别它们。

paras.en: "In this soup of quark-gluon plasma, there are numerous quarks and gluons passing by and colliding with each other," Lee explains. "Sometimes when we are lucky, one of these collisions creates a Z boson and a quark, with high momentum."
paras.zh: “在夸克-胶子等离子体汤中，有许多夸克和胶子经过并相互碰撞，”李解释道。 “有时，当我们幸运时，其中一次碰撞会产生具有高动量的 Z 玻色子和夸克。”

paras.en: When such a collision occurs, the quark and Z boson should fly away from each other in opposite directions. The quark can disturb the plasma and produce a wake, while the Z boson should pass through without significantly affecting the material around it.
paras.zh: 当这种碰撞发生时，夸克和Z玻色子应该以相反的方向远离彼此。夸克可以扰乱等离子体并产生尾流，而 Z 玻色子应该可以穿过而不会对其周围的材料产生重大影响。

paras.en: That means any ripples appearing in the plasma on the quark's side can be attributed to the quark itself.
paras.zh: 这意味着夸克一侧等离子体中出现的任何波纹都可以归因于夸克本身。

paras.en: Working with Professor Yi Chen's group at Vanderbilt University, the researchers realized they could use Z bosons as a "tag" for locating and measuring wakes created by individual quarks.
paras.zh: 研究人员与范德比尔特大学陈一教授的团队合作，意识到他们可以使用 Z 玻色子作为“标签”来定位和测量单个夸克产生的尾流。

paras.en: Wakes Found Among Billions of Collisions
paras.zh: 在数十亿次碰撞中发现尾迹

paras.en: The team analyzed data from heavy-ion collisions at the Large Hadron Collider. Among 13 billion collisions, they identified roughly 2,000 events in which a Z boson was produced.
paras.zh: 该团队分析了大型强子对撞机重离子碰撞的数据。在 130 亿次碰撞中，他们确定了大约 2000 次产生 Z 玻色子的事件。

paras.en: For each of those events, the researchers mapped how energy was distributed throughout the short-lived quark-gluon plasma. They repeatedly found fluid-like patterns of splashes and swirling motion in the direction opposite the Z boson.
paras.zh: 对于每一个事件，研究人员都绘制了能量在短命夸克-胶子等离子体中的分布情况。他们反复发现了与 Z 玻色子相反的方向上类似流体的飞溅图案和旋转运动。

paras.en: Because the Z boson itself barely interacts with the plasma, the researchers could attribute these wake patterns directly to individual quarks traveling through the material.
paras.zh: 由于 Z 玻色子本身几乎不与等离子体相互作用，因此研究人员可以将这些尾流模式直接归因于穿过材料的单个夸克。

paras.en: The observed wakes also matched predictions from Rajagopal's hybrid model. The results indicate that quark-gluon plasma really does respond collectively like a liquid when energetic particles pass through it.
paras.zh: 观察到的尾流也与拉贾戈帕尔混合模型的预测相符。结果表明，当高能粒子穿过夸克-胶子等离子体时，它确实会像液体一样集体响应。

paras.en: "This is something that many of us have argued must be there for a good many years, and that many experiments have looked for," says Rajagopal, who was not directly involved with the new study.
paras.zh: “我们许多人都认为，这种现象一定已经存在很多年了，而且许多实验都在寻找这一点，”拉贾戈帕尔说，他没有直接参与这项新研究。

paras.en: "We've gained the first direct evidence that the quark indeed drags more plasma with it as it travels," Lee adds. "This will enable us to study the properties and behavior of this exotic fluid in unprecedented detail."
paras.zh: “我们获得了第一个直接证据，表明夸克在传播时确实会拖曳更多的等离子体，”李补充道。 “这将使我们能够以前所未有的细节研究这种奇异流体的特性和行为。”

paras.en: This work was supported, in part, by the U.S. Department of Energy.
paras.zh: 这项工作得到了美国能源部的部分支持。

articles.title: Scientists say this simple habit could strengthen your marriage

paras.en: Scientists say this simple habit could strengthen your marriage
paras.zh: 科学家称这个简单的习惯可以巩固你的婚姻

paras.en: Working out together, even with a simple walk, may help couples communicate better, handle conflict more peacefully, and strengthen their marriage.
paras.zh: 一起锻炼，即使是简单的散步，也可以帮助夫妻更好地沟通，更和平地处理冲突，并巩固他们的婚姻。

paras.en: - Couples who exercise together report better communication, healthier conflict resolution, and lower marital stress than those who work out alone. Even something as simple as taking a walk together may create valuable opportunities to talk, listen, and feel more connected.
paras.zh: - 一起锻炼的夫妻比单独锻炼的夫妻有更好的沟通、更健康的冲突解决方式以及更低的婚姻压力。即使是像一起散步这样简单的事情也可能创造宝贵的交谈、倾听和感觉更紧密联系的机会。

paras.en: Exercise is well known for supporting physical fitness and mental well being. New research from BYU suggests it may also offer benefits for marriage, particularly when spouses are active together.
paras.zh: 众所周知，锻炼可以支持身体健康和心理健康。杨百翰大学的新研究表明，它也可能为婚姻带来好处，特别是当配偶在一起活跃时。

paras.en: The study, recently published in Family Relations, found that couples who exercised together reported better communication, more effective conflict resolution and less marital stress than couples who did not share physical activity.
paras.zh: 这项研究最近发表在《家庭关系》杂志上，发现一起锻炼的夫妻比不一起锻炼的夫妻沟通更好，解决冲突更有效，婚姻压力也更小。

paras.en: The research was led by BYU School of Family Life professor Jeremy Yorgason with co-author Ashlyn Hiatt Mildenhall, who first became involved in the project as an undergraduate researcher at BYU.
paras.zh: 这项研究由杨百翰大学家庭生活学院教授 Jeremy Yorgason 和合著者 Ashlyn Hiatt Mildenhall 领导，后者首次参与该项目时还是杨百翰大学的本科生研究员。

paras.en: "Our findings suggest that conjoint exercise facilitates, in a small but significant way, the ability to resolve conflict peacefully," Yorgason said. "People reported more positive outcomes in communication and conflict resolution when they exercised together."
paras.zh: 约加森说：“我们的研究结果表明，联合演习以小而重要的方式促进了和平解决冲突的能力。” “人们在一起锻炼时表示，在沟通和解决冲突方面取得了更积极的成果。”

paras.en: Exercising Together Shows Stronger Relationship Benefits
paras.zh: 一起锻炼对人际关系有更大的好处

paras.en: To investigate the connection between exercise and marriage, researchers examined survey responses from nearly 1,700 young married couples enrolled in the nationally representative Couple Relationships and Transition Experiences (CREATE) study. The BYU project has tracked newly married couples throughout the United States for more than a decade.
paras.zh: 为了调查运动与婚姻之间的联系，研究人员检查了参与全国代表性夫妻关系和过渡经历 (CREATE) 研究的近 1,700 对年轻已婚夫妇的调查回复。十多年来，杨百翰大学项目一直在追踪美国各地的新婚夫妇。

paras.en: The researchers looked at both individual exercise and physical activity done together as a couple. They then compared those habits with three measures of relationship health: communication, conflict resolution and marital stress.
paras.zh: 研究人员观察了个人锻炼和夫妻一起进行的体育活动。然后，他们将这些习惯与衡量关系健康程度的三项指标进行了比较：沟通、冲突解决和婚姻压力。

paras.en: Both individual exercise and shared exercise were associated with healthier marriages. However, physical activity done together consistently showed stronger links to positive relationship outcomes than working out separately.
paras.zh: 个人锻炼和共同锻炼都与更健康的婚姻有关。然而，与单独锻炼相比，一起进行的体育活动始终显示出与积极关系结果的联系更强。

paras.en: "About 60% of husbands and wives in the sample said they exercised, but only about a third exercised together," Yorgason said. "That means about half the people who exercise are not exercising with their spouse. While the impact is not necessarily large, it is very consistent, which gives me confidence that it is influencing relationships in some meaningful way."
paras.zh: “样本中约 60% 的丈夫和妻子表示他们锻炼过，但只有约三分之一的人一起锻炼过，”约加森说。 “这意味着大约一半的锻炼者没有与配偶一起锻炼。虽然影响不一定很大，但效果非常一致，这让我相信它正在以某种有意义的方式影响人际关系。”

paras.en: Why Shared Exercise May Help Couples Connect
paras.zh: 为什么共同锻炼可以帮助夫妻建立联系

paras.en: Previous research has shown that spending leisure time together can benefit couples. This study narrowed the focus specifically to shared physical activity.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，一起度过休闲时光对夫妻有益。这项研究将重点缩小到共同的身体活动上。

paras.en: Researchers suggest that exercising together may naturally create more opportunities for conversation and positive interactions. Repeated moments of connection like these could help strengthen a relationship over time.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，一起锻炼自然可以创造更多对话和积极互动的机会。随着时间的推移，重复这样的联系时刻可以帮助加强关系。

paras.en: "Out of all three outcomes, exercise had the biggest impact on communication," Mildenhall said. "That's why it was interesting that walking was the number one reported exercise. It naturally provides opportunities to communicate."
paras.zh: “在所有三个结果中，锻炼对沟通的影响最大，”米尔登霍尔说。 “这就是为什么有趣的是，步行是报告中排名第一的运动。它自然提供了交流的机会。”

paras.en: Walking was the most common form of shared exercise reported by couples in the study. That finding suggests spouses may not need costly gym memberships or elaborate home workout equipment to experience the potential relationship benefits of being active together.
paras.zh: 散步是研究中夫妇报告的最常见的共同运动形式。这一发现表明，配偶可能不需要昂贵的健身房会员资格或精致的家庭健身器材来体验一起活跃对关系的潜在好处。

paras.en: Couples who exercised together also reported better listening and stronger feelings that their spouse heard and supported them. According to Yorgason, those interactions may help explain why shared physical activity was associated with healthier communication and better conflict resolution.
paras.zh: 一起锻炼的夫妻还表示，他们的配偶倾听和支持他们的声音更好，感觉更强烈。约加森认为，这些互动可能有助于解释为什么共同的身体活动与更健康的沟通和更好的冲突解决有关。

paras.en: The researchers emphasize that exercising together is not a solution for every relationship difficulty. For young couples, particularly those raising children, finding time for shared physical activity may require deliberate planning.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，一起锻炼并不能解决所有关系问题。对于年轻夫妇，尤其是那些抚养孩子的夫妇来说，寻找时间进行共同的体育活动可能需要深思熟虑的计划。

paras.en: Still, the researchers say conjoint exercise can be one of several healthy habits that give couples regular opportunities to connect. Amid the competing demands of school, daily life and parenting, even something as simple as walking together may create valuable time for conversation and connection.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究人员表示，联合运动可能是为夫妻提供定期交流机会的几种健康习惯之一。在学校、日常生活和育儿的相互竞争的需求中，即使是像一起散步这样简单的事情也可以创造宝贵的交谈和联系时间。

paras.en: Materials provided by Brigham Young University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由杨百翰大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Ashlyn Mildenhall, Matthew L. NÃºÃ±ez, Jeremy Yorgason. Conjoint Exercise among young married couples: Exploring associations with couple conflict, conflict resolution, and communication. Family Relations, 2026; DOI: 10.1111/fare.70260
paras.zh: - 阿什琳·米尔登霍尔、马修·L·努涅斯、杰里米·约加森。年轻夫妇的联合练习：探索与夫妻冲突、冲突解决和沟通的关联。家庭关系，2026； DOI：10.1111/票价.70260

articles.title: What happens in the brain when cannabis makes you anxious?

paras.en: What happens in the brain when cannabis makes you anxious?
paras.zh: 当大麻让你焦虑时，大脑会发生什么？

paras.en: Scientists have pinpointed brain cells that may explain why cannabis can suddenly turn a calm experience into intense anxiety.
paras.zh: 科学家们已经查明了脑细胞，这或许可以解释为什么大麻会突然将平静的经历变成强烈的焦虑。

paras.en: - Cannabinoids may intensify anxiety by removing a natural brake on specific neurons in the brainâs fear center, particularly during stressful situations. In mice, shutting down those neurons sharply reduced cannabinoid-related anxious behavior.
paras.zh: - 大麻素可能会通过消除大脑恐惧中心特定神经元的自然制动来加剧焦虑，特别是在有压力的情况下。在小鼠中，关闭这些神经元可大幅减少与大麻素相关的焦虑行为。

paras.en: Northwestern scientists have identified, for the first time, a specific group of neurons -- cells in the brain -- that appear to contribute to anxiety caused by cannabinoid drugs, particularly when those drugs are combined with stressful conditions. Cannabinoids are a category of substances that includes THC, the main psychoactive ingredient in cannabis.
paras.zh: 西北大学的科学家首次发现了一组特定的神经元（大脑中的细胞），它们似乎会导致大麻素药物引起的焦虑，特别是当这些药物与压力条件相结合时。大麻素是一类物质，其中包括大麻中主要的精神活性成分四氢大麻酚 (THC)。

paras.en: To investigate how cannabinoids influence fear and anxiety, researchers exposed mice to a threatening smell derived from fox urine. Before encountering the odor, the animals were given either a placebo or a synthetic cannabinoid drug.
paras.zh: 为了研究大麻素如何影响恐惧和焦虑，研究人员让小鼠接触来自狐狸尿液的威胁气味。在遇到这种气味之前，给这些动物服用安慰剂或合成大麻素药物。

paras.en: Mice that received the cannabinoid froze more frequently and spent less time exploring the predator scent. Researchers traced these anxiety related behaviors to increased activity in a small population of brain cells known as somatostatin neurons. These neurons are located in the central amygdala, an area of the brain involved in processing fear and stress.
paras.zh: 接受大麻素的小鼠更频繁地僵住，并且花更少的时间探索捕食者的气味。研究人员将这些与焦虑相关的行为归因于一小群被称为生长抑素神经元的脑细胞活动的增加。这些神经元位于杏仁核中央，这是大脑中负责处理恐惧和压力的区域。

paras.en: When the researchers genetically silenced the somatostatin neurons, the mice that received the cannabinoid became less likely to avoid the predator odor. The result suggested that these cells play an important role in producing the anxious response.
paras.zh: 当研究人员从基因上沉默生长抑素神经元时，接受大麻素的小鼠变得不太可能避开捕食者的气味。结果表明这些细胞在产生焦虑反应中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: "The results of this study could explain why a good trip can turn bad pretty quickly if people consume too much cannabis or the situation they are in turns stressful or scary," said study senior author Dr. Sachin Patel, chair of psychiatry and behavioral sciences at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、西北大学范伯格医学院精神病学和行为科学系主任萨钦·帕特尔博士说：“这项研究的结果可以解释为什么如果人们吸食太多大麻，或者他们的处境变得紧张或可怕，一次美好的旅行很快就会变得糟糕。”

paras.en: The study was published on Oct. 2 in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 该研究于 10 月 2 日发表在《自然通讯》杂志上。

paras.en: Patel and his colleagues gave mice several different doses of the synthetic cannabinoid and measured their reactions to the predator odor. The researchers recorded how much time the animals spent near the scent and whether they responded by freezing or fleeing.
paras.zh: 帕特尔和他的同事给老鼠注射了几种不同剂量的合成大麻素，并测量了它们对捕食者气味的反应。研究人员记录了动物在气味附近停留的时间以及它们的反应是冻结还是逃跑。

paras.en: At the same time, the team monitored activity inside the brain by implanting a small microscope into the mice's brain.
paras.zh: 与此同时，研究小组通过将小型显微镜植入小鼠大脑来监测大脑内部的活动。

paras.en: Researchers also studied brain tissue to determine how cannabinoids changed communication between neurons. Their experiments showed that the drug weakened a natural brain mechanism that normally acts as a "brake" on somatostatin neurons. With that restraint reduced, the neurons became more active.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了脑组织，以确定大麻素如何改变神经元之间的通讯。他们的实验表明，这种药物削弱了通常对生长抑素神经元起“刹车”作用的自然大脑机制。随着这种限制的减少，神经元变得更加活跃。

paras.en: "Higher doses of cannabinoids and environmental stress worked together to synergistically release the 'brake' on the central amygdala, which in turn drove excessive anxiety," Patel explained.
paras.zh: “较高剂量的大麻素和环境压力共同作用，协同释放中央杏仁核的‘刹车’，进而导致过度焦虑，”帕特尔解释道。

paras.en: Cannabis use in the U.S. has steadily increased in recent years. At the same time, emergency department visits involving adverse effects from the drug have also risen.
paras.zh: 近年来，美国的大麻使用量稳步增加。与此同时，涉及药物不良反应的急诊就诊人数也有所增加。

paras.en: Previous studies have found an association between cannabis use and a higher long term risk of anxiety. Anxiety and mood disorders are also on the rise globally.
paras.zh: 先前的研究发现大麻的使用与较高的长期焦虑风险之间存在关联。全球范围内，焦虑和情绪障碍也在增加。

paras.en: "Understanding how cannabis affects brain function to generate its psychoactive effects could ultimately reveal new ways to counteract negative consequences should they arise in some people," Patel said.
paras.zh: 帕特尔说：“了解大麻如何影响大脑功能以产生其精神作用，最终可能会揭示新的方法来抵消某些人身上出现的负面后果。”

paras.en: The researchers believe the findings may also have relevance beyond cannabis related side effects. Patel said the same neurons could potentially represent a broader target for understanding or reducing anxiety.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些发现可能还具有超越大麻相关副作用的相关性。帕特尔说，相同的神经元可能代表理解或减少焦虑的更广泛目标。

paras.en: "Suppressing the activity of somatostatin neurons in the central amygdala could represent a final pathway for reducing anxiety symptoms, not just in the context of cannabis side effects," he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“抑制中央杏仁核中生长抑素神经元的活动可能是减少焦虑症状的最终途径，而不仅仅是在大麻副作用的情况下。”

paras.en: Other Northwestern co-authors are Farhana Yasmin, Saptarnab Naskar, Danyal Zaidi, Isaac Kandil, Michelle Kwon and Dr. Luis Rosas-Vidal.
paras.zh: 西北大学的其他合著者包括 Farhana Yasmin、Saptarnab Naskar、Danyal Zaidi、Isaac Kandil、Michelle Kwon 和 Luis Rosas-Vidal 博士。

paras.en: The study is titled, "Cannabinoid Modulation of Central Amygdala Population Dynamics During Threat Investigation." It was supported by the National Institutes of Health (grants MH100785 and K08 MH126166) and the Brain & Behavior Research Foundation's Young Investigator Awards.
paras.zh: 该研究的标题是“威胁调查期间大麻素对中央杏仁核种群动态的调节”。它得到了美国国立卫生研究院（授予 MH100785 和 K08 MH126166）和大脑与行为研究基金会青年研究者奖的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by Northwestern University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由西北大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.zh: - Farhana Yasmin、Saptarnab Naskar、Danyal Zaidi、Isaac Kandil、Michelle Kwon、Luis E. Rosas-Vidal、Sachin Patel。威胁调查期间大麻素对中央杏仁核种群动态的调节。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41467-026-77957-4

articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间公司正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

paras.en: Chief of Marketing and Strategic Communications, Quantum Space

paras.zh: 本新闻稿包含的某些陈述并非历史事实，但可能被视为《1933 年证券法》修订案（“证券法”）第 27(a) 条和《1934 年证券交易法》修订案第 21(e) 条含义内的“前瞻性陈述”。前瞻性陈述通常附有“相信”、“可能”、“将”、“估计”、“继续”、“预期”、“打算”、“预期”、“应该”、“会”、“计划”、“预测”、“潜力”、“似乎”、“寻求”、“未来”、“展望”等词语或这些术语的否定词或其变体或预测或指示未来事件的类似术语或表达。或趋势或不是历史事件的陈述。这些前瞻性陈述包括但不限于有关未来事件的陈述、Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI（“Inflection Point”）、Quantum Space 及其其他方之间拟议的业务合并（“业务合并”）、业务合并后合并后公司（“新 Quantum Space”）的估计或预期未来结果和收益，包括以下内容的可能性和能力： 量子空间和拐点成功完成业务合并、新量子空间的未来机会以及其他非历史事实的陈述。这些陈述基于拐点和/或量子空间管理层的当前预期，并非对实际业绩的预测。这些前瞻性陈述仅供说明之用，无意作为且不得被任何投资者视为保证、保证、预测或事实或概率的明确陈述。实际事件和情况很难或不可能预测，并且会与假设有所不同。许多实际事件和情况超出了拐点和量子空间的控制范围。这些陈述受到有关 Quantum Space 业务和业务合并的许多风险和不确定性的影响，实际结果可能存在重大差异。这些风险和不确定性包括但不限于：发生可能导致终止与业务相关的任何最终协议的任何事件、变化或其他情况 组合;在宣布企业合并及任何相关最终协议后，可能针对 Inflection Point、Quantum Space、合并后的公司或其他方提起的任何法律诉讼的结果；由于未能获得股东批准、未能获得完成业务合并的融资或其他交割条件而无法完成业务合并；根据适用的法律或法规，或作为获得企业合并监管部门批准的条件，可能需要或适当地对企业合并的拟议结构进行变更；新量子空间在业务合并完成后满足证券交易所上市标准的能力；由于业务合并的宣布和完成而导致业务合并扰乱量子空间当前计划和运营的风险； Quantum Space 无法成功完成其旗舰车辆 Ranger 的开发，该车辆目前正在开发中，迄今为止尚未制造、运营或销售，也无法满足 Quantum Space 的要求 设计标准，包括其预期燃料容量、具有可加油和模块化架构以及长达 15 年的使用寿命；新量子空间认识到业务合并的预期收益的能力，该收益可能会受到竞争等因素的影响，新量子空间发展和管理增长的能力，维持与客户和供应商的关系以及保留其管理层和关键员工的能力；与企业合并相关的成本；适用法律或法规的变更； Quantum Space 或合并后的公司可能受到其他经济、业务和/或竞争因素不利影响的可能性； Inflection Point 股东提出的赎回请求金额；量子空间卫星系统安全性能不理想或量子空间设施发生安全事件；卫星市场未能实现量子空间预期的增长潜力；任何延迟发射、发射失败、量子空间卫星未能到达计划轨道位置以及与卫星发射相关的成本大幅增加；处理， 在量子空间运营中生产和处置潜在爆炸性和可燃性高能材料以及其他危险化学品； Quantum Space 的产品无法按预期方式运行或其产品存在缺陷；与 Quantum Space 客户签订的合同的交易对手风险以及 Quantum Space 的主承包商未能维持与交易对手的关系并履行其合同义务；未能成功抵御其他政府合同投标人的抗议；与 Quantum Space 开展业务的各个政府实体的资金水平发生变化；以及已向美国证券交易委员会（“SEC”）提交或即将提交的拐点和/或量子空间文件中讨论的其他风险和不确定性。上述风险因素列表并不详尽。可能存在拐点和量子空间目前不知道的或拐点和量子空间目前认为无关紧要的其他风险，这些风险也可能导致实际结果与前瞻性陈述中包含的结果不同。此外， 前瞻性陈述提供了拐点和量子空间对未来事件的预期、计划或预测以及截至本新闻稿发布之日的观点。拐点和量子空间预计后续事件和发展将导致他们的评估发生变化。然而，虽然拐点和量子空间可能选择在未来更新这些前瞻性陈述，但拐点和量子空间明确表示不承担任何这样做的义务。这些前瞻性陈述不应被视为代表 Inflection Point 或 Quantum Space 在本新闻稿发布后任何日期的评估。因此，不应过度依赖前瞻性陈述。本文中的任何内容均不应被视为任何人表示本文中提出的前瞻性陈述将会实现或此类前瞻性陈述的结果将会实现。
