paras.en: "Against all odds, Christa Pike is conscious, speaking, and continues to receive critical medical care," attorneys for Pike said in a statement. "Despite the severe damage she endured to her arms, she is still handcuffed and shackled to the bed. Her recovery is medically unprecedented."
paras.zh: 派克的律师在一份声明中表示：“尽管困难重重，克里斯塔·派克仍然神志清醒，能说话，并继续接受紧急医疗护理。” “尽管她的手臂受到严重伤害，但她仍然戴着手铐并被铐在床上。她的康复在医学上是前所未有的。”

paras.en: Her lawyers said they are grateful for the first responders and the medical team at the hospital "who treated Christa like a human and have provided exceptional care to her."
paras.zh: 她的律师表示，他们感谢医院的急救人员和医疗团队，“他们像对待人一样对待克里斯塔，并为她提供了特殊的护理。”

paras.en: As recently as Sunday, her attorneys said Pike had remained unconscious and on a ventilator since the failed execution attempt.
paras.zh: 就在周日，她的律师表示，自执行死刑失败以来，派克一直处于昏迷状态，并依靠呼吸机。

paras.en: Dr. Joel Zivot, a professor of anesthesiology and surgery in Atlanta who consulted as an expert for Pike's legal team, said the development "bodes well for a good recovery." But he added that it could be weeks or months before anyone knows exactly what her recovery might look like or whether her competency could be restored to a level that might enable the state to try to execute her again.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大麻醉学和外科教授乔尔·齐沃特博士作为派克法律团队的专家提供咨询，他表示，这一进展“预示着良好的康复”。但他补充说，可能需要几周或几个月的时间，才有人确切地知道她的康复情况，或者她的能力是否可以恢复到可以让国家再次尝试处决她的水平。

paras.en: - Tennessee prisons chief to resign after failed execution of Christa Pike, governor says
paras.zh: -田纳西州州长表示，克​​里斯塔·派克处决失败后，田纳西州监狱长将辞职

paras.en: - Christa Pike on ventilator after surviving Tennessee execution attempt, lawyer says
paras.zh: - 律师称，克里斯塔·派克在田纳西州行刑未遂后使用呼吸机

paras.en: "She's still in the ICU," he said. "She has recovered to a certain degree that she's able to be off a ventilator and able to speak, but in no way would I announce her free of further serious risk. There's still a lot of bad things that can happen here, even when everyone is doing their job well."
paras.zh: “她还在重症监护室，”他说。 “她已经恢复到一定程度，可以脱离呼吸机并能够说话，但我绝不会宣布她没有进一步严重的风险。即使每个人都做得很好，这里仍然可能发生很多不好的事情。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Tennessee Department of Correction said she could provide no information other than that Pike remained hospitalized Tuesday.
paras.zh: 田纳西州惩教署发言人表示，除了派克周二仍在医院接受治疗外，她无法提供任何信息。

paras.en: Pike's attorneys are set to go to court Wednesday as they seek to learn more about what happened in the failed lethal injection.
paras.zh: 派克的律师定于周三出庭，寻求更多地了解注射死刑失败事件中发生的情况。

paras.en: The attorneys are seeking a court order requiring the Tennessee Department of Correction to preserve evidence, including drug lot numbers, records and other information from the Sept. 30 attempted execution. Chancery Court Judge I'Ashea Myles scheduled a Wednesday morning status conference in the case.
paras.zh: 律师们正在寻求法庭命令，要求田纳西州惩教部保存证据，包括毒品批号、记录和 9 月 30 日试图执行死刑的其他信息。衡平法院法官 I'Ashea Myles 安排周三上午召开此案的情况会议。

paras.en: Pike's attorneys said in their Tuesday statement that they continue to ask Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee to commute Pike's sentence to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在周二的声明中表示，他们继续要求田纳西州州长比尔·李将派克的刑期减刑为终身监禁，且不得假释。

paras.en: Lee halted further executions following Pike's hospitalization and ordered a "comprehensive, third-party review to determine exactly what occurred." U.S. Sen. Marsha Blackburn, the state's Republican candidate to replace him, called on the state to explore other methods of execution to ensure it can continue carrying out capital punishment.
paras.zh: 派克住院后，李停止了进一步的处决，并下令进行“全面的第三方审查，以确定究竟发生了什么”。该州接替他的共和党候选人、美国参议员玛莎·布莱克本呼吁该州探索其他处决方法，以确保能够继续执行死刑。

paras.en: In addition to questions about competency — whether Pike can understand why she would be put to death — Pike has strong arguments that it would be cruel and unusual for the state to try to execute her again, said Deborah Denno, a Fordham Law professor who has studied execution methods for 36 years.
paras.zh: 研究了处决方法 36 年的福特汉姆法学教授黛博拉·丹诺 (Deborah Denno) 表示，除了有关能力的问题——派克是否能理解为什么她会被处决——派克还有强有力的论据，认为国家再次尝试处决她将是残酷和不寻常的。

paras.en: It could also violate the prohibition on double jeopardy, trying or punishing someone twice for the same offence, Denno said.
paras.zh: 丹诺说，这还可能违反双重危险的禁令，即因同一罪行对某人进行两次审判或惩罚。

paras.en: In other recent cases, states have been allowed to try again after failing to establish a suitable intravenous line, she said, but Pike is the first person to survive after the lethal drug was actually administered.
paras.zh: 她说，在最近的其他案例中，各州在未能建立合适的静脉注射管线后被允许再次尝试，但派克是在实际注射致命药物后第一个幸存的人。

paras.en: "They carried out every aspect of the execution," Denno said. "She didn't die, but every process they intended, they did it."
paras.zh: “他们执行了处决的各个方面，”丹诺说。 “她没有死，但他们想要的每一个过程，他们都做到了。”

paras.en: Seattle University law Prof. Michael Russo, who handled capital cases as a public defender in Los Angeles, called the failed execution horrible, but said he doubted whether the U.S. Supreme Court would stop the state from trying again on double-jeopardy grounds, should it decide to do so.
paras.zh: 西雅图大学法学教授迈克尔·拉索(Michael Russo)在洛杉矶担任公设辩护律师，负责处理死刑案件，他称这次失败的执行是可怕的，但他表示，如果美国最高法院决定这样做，他是否会阻止该州以双重危险为由再次尝试。

paras.en: "There's nobody else in the history of the death penalty in this country who has gone through what she's been through," Russo said. But, he added, "I think what this Supreme Court would say is, her sentence was to die — to be executed — not to suffer an attempt at execution."
paras.zh: 拉索说：“在这个国家的死刑历史上，没有人经历过她所经历的事情。”但是，他补充道，“我认为最高法院会说的是，她的判决是死刑——被处决——而不是遭受处决企图。”

articles.title: Fruit of the Loom, Hanes investigated over potential toxic chemicals in children's underwear
articles.author: Jonathan Stempel

paras.en: Fruit of the Loom, Hanes investigated over potential toxic chemicals in children's underwear
paras.zh: Fruit of the Loom、Hanes 调查儿童内衣中潜在有毒化学物质

paras.en: Canadian company Gildan Activewear owns Hanes, says it will co-operate with investigation
paras.zh: Hanes 旗下的加拿大公司 Gildan Activewear 表示将配合调查

paras.en: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿周二对 Fruit of the Loom 和 Hanes 是否在生产儿童内衣时使用有毒化学物质展开调查。

paras.en: Paxton said he sent civil investigative demands to Fruit of the Loom, which is owned by Berkshire Hathaway, and Hanes, which is owned by Canadian company Gildan Activewear, citing the chemicals' potential effects on children's health.
paras.zh: 帕克斯顿表示，他向伯克希尔哈撒韦公司旗下的 Fruit of the Loom 和加拿大公司 Gildan Activewear 旗下的 Hanes 发出了民事调查要求，理由是这些化学物质对儿童健康有潜在影响。

paras.en: He did not accuse either company of wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 他没有指控任何一家公司有不当行为。

paras.en: Fruit of the Loom and Berkshire did not immediately respond to requests from Reuters for comment.
paras.zh: Fruit of the Loom 和伯克希尔没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。

paras.en: Montreal-based Gildan said it will co-operate with the investigation, and maintains strict manufacturing and sourcing standards to comply with industry guidelines related to harmful chemicals.
paras.zh: 总部位于蒙特利尔的 Gildan 表示将配合调查，并维持严格的制造和采购标准，以遵守与有害化学品相关的行业准则。

paras.en: "We remain committed to providing safe, high-quality products for consumers," it said in a statement to Reuters.
paras.zh: 该公司在给路透社的一份声明中表示：“我们仍然致力于为消费者提供安全、优质的产品。”

paras.en: Gildan merged with Massachusetts-based HanesBrands Inc. last year in a $2.2-billion US deal.
paras.zh: Gildan 去年在美国以 22 亿美元的交易与总部位于马萨诸塞州的 HanesBrands Inc. 合并。

paras.en: Paxton said clothing manufacturers have turned increasingly to synthetic materials such as polyester, rayon and spandex to meet consumer demand for lower-priced products.
paras.zh: 帕克斯顿表示，服装制造商越来越多地转向使用聚酯、人造丝和氨纶等合成材料，以满足消费者对低价产品的需求。

paras.en: He said research shows that synthetic fabrics can shed microplastics, while chemicals including bisphenols, fluorine, parabens, phthalates and so-called "forever chemicals" used in textile manufacturing have been associated with cancer, hormone disruption, infertility and other health concerns.
paras.zh: 他说，研究表明，合成纤维会脱落微塑料，而纺织品制造中使用的双酚、氟、对羟基苯甲酸酯、邻苯二甲酸盐等化学物质以及所谓的“永久化学物质”与癌症、激素紊乱、不孕症和其他健康问题有关。

paras.en: "Forever chemicals" are also known as PFAS, short for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
paras.zh: “永久化学品”也称为 PFAS，是全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质的缩写。

paras.en: - Texas attorney general launches investigation into Lululemon's potential use of certain chemicals
paras.zh: - 德克萨斯州总检察长对 Lululemon 可能使用某些化学品的情况展开调查

paras.en: - New bans target PFAS in clothing. Here's how to avoid exposure (2025)
paras.zh: - 新禁令针对服装中的 PFAS。以下是避免暴露的方法 (2025)

paras.en: "We must protect our children who cannot yet protect themselves," Paxton said in a news release.
paras.zh: 帕克斯顿在一份新闻稿中说：“我们必须保护我们还无法保护自己的孩子。”

paras.en: "This includes making sure that the necessities parents rely on are free from toxic chemicals and do not harm the health of kids."
paras.zh: “这包括确保父母所依赖的必需品不含有毒化学物质，并且不会损害孩子的健康。”

paras.en: The attorney general announced a similar probe in April into whether Vancouver-based Lululemon Athletica activewear contained "forever chemicals," which do not break down easily in nature.
paras.zh: 总检察长在四月份宣布了一项类似的调查，调查温哥华的 Lululemon Athletica 运动服是否含有“永久化学物质”，这些化学物质在自然界中不易分解。

paras.en: Paxton, a Republican, is running for a U.S. Senate seat against Democrat James Talarico and trailing in most polls.
paras.zh: 共和党人帕克斯顿正在竞选美国参议院席位，对手是民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科，但在大多数民意调查中都落后。

paras.en: The race is among the country's most closely watched in the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 这场竞选是该国 11 月 3 日中期选举中最受关注的竞选之一。

articles.title: Suspected pneumonic plague in Siberia: What we know about the disease

paras.en: - There are three forms of plague, all caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis.
paras.zh: - 鼠疫有三种形式，均由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起。

paras.en: - The three forms of plague are bubonic, septicemic and pneumonic.
paras.zh: - 鼠疫的三种形式是鼠疫、败血症和肺炎。

paras.en: - Bubonic plague is the most common form, it does not spread from person to person. If untreated, the bacteria can move through the body and bloodstream, causing septicemic plague, which causes internal bleeding and organ failure.
paras.zh: - 黑死病是最常见的形式，它不会在人与人之间传播。如果不及时治疗，细菌会在身体和血液中移动，引起败血性鼠疫，从而导致内出血和器官衰竭。

paras.en: - If the the bacteria reach the lungs, they cause pneumonic plague. Pneumonic plague is highly contagious as it can pass from person to person through the air, via coughing, for example.
paras.zh: - 如果细菌到达肺部，就会引起肺鼠疫。肺鼠疫具有高度传染性，因为它可以通过空气在人与人之间传播，例如通过咳嗽。

paras.en: - If untreated, bubonic plague kills between 30-60% of patients. The septicemic and pneumonic forms are always fatal without treatment.
paras.zh: - 如果不及时治疗，黑死病会导致 30-60% 的患者死亡。如果不进行治疗，败血症和肺炎形式总是致命的。

paras.en: Speculation over the death in a Russian plague laboratory
paras.zh: 对俄罗斯鼠疫实验室死亡事件的猜测

paras.en: Following the death of a Russian laboratory worker, there is speculation about an outbreak of pneumonic plague, a highly contagious bacterial infection of the lungs. Russia denies there is a broader risk to the community.
paras.zh: 一名俄罗斯实验室工作人员死亡后，有人猜测可能爆发了肺鼠疫，这是一种高度传染性的肺部细菌感染。俄罗斯否认社会面临更广泛的风险。

paras.en: Russian officials have said the laboratory worker's death was not caused by a plague pathogen. The 28-year-old died of "pneumonia of unknown origin," according to Russia's Interfax news agency, citing Rospotrebnadzor, Russia's disease-control agency. According to that agency, samples taken from the woman showed no microorganisms "related to her professional activities." This contradicts earlier information.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员表示，该实验室工作人员的死亡并非由鼠疫病原体引起。据俄罗斯国际文传电讯社援引俄罗斯疾病控制机构 Rospotrebnadzor 的报道，这名 28 岁的男子死于“不明原因肺炎”。据该机构称，从该妇女身上采集的样本显示没有“与她的职业活动相关”的微生物。这与之前的信息相矛盾。

paras.en: Local media had previously reported that the woman, who worked at an institute dedicated to fighting plague, had dropped a test tube.
paras.zh: 当地媒体此前曾报道称，这名在一家致力于抗击鼠疫的研究所工作的妇女不慎掉落了一根试管。

paras.en: She reportedly died on Friday, October 2, 2026, at the district hospital in Shelekhov, a town near Irkutsk in Siberia.
paras.zh: 据报道，她于 2026 年 10 月 2 日星期五在西伯利亚伊尔库茨克附近小镇谢列霍夫的地区医院去世。

paras.en: According to official Russian figures, two hospitals and a children's clinic were placed under quarantine. Local reports said staff at the institute were being quarantined at their workplace. The US news site Axios has reported that around 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under observation. There were no further reported infections.
paras.zh: 根据俄罗斯官方数据，两家医院和一家儿童诊所已被隔离。当地报道称，该研究所的工作人员正在工作场所接受隔离。美国新闻网站 Axios 报道称，大约 200 名与该女子有过接触的人已接受观察。没有进一步报告感染情况。

paras.en: Even so, distrust of how Russia handles information persists. On one of DW's Russian-language social media channels, a user wrote: "It wouldn't surprise me if this turns into a disaster now, both in terms of the spread and the quarantine measures."
paras.zh: 即便如此，人们对俄罗斯处理信息方式的不信任依然存在。在德国之声的一个俄语社交媒体频道上，一位用户写道：“如果现在这变成一场灾难，无论是在传播还是在隔离措施方面，我都不会感到惊讶。”

paras.en: Pneumonic plague: a fast-moving lung infection
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫：一种快速传播的肺部感染

paras.en: All that is known for certain, at time of writing and first publication (October 5, 2026), is that pneumonic plague is highly contagious.
paras.zh: 在撰写本文和首次发表时（2026 年 10 月 5 日），可以肯定的是，肺鼠疫具有高度传染性。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague is a form of plague that infects the lungs. Like every form of the disease, it is caused by Yersinia pestis, a bacterium usually found in small mammals, such as rodents and in the fleas that feed on them.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫是一种感染肺部的鼠疫。与其他疾病一样，它是由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的，这种细菌通常存在于小型哺乳动物（例如啮齿动物）和以它们为食的跳蚤中。

paras.en: The World Health Organization describes the pneumonic form as the most virulent type of plague.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织将肺鼠疫描述为毒性最强的鼠疫类型。

paras.en: Its incubation period can be as short as 24 hours, and it is the only form that passes easily from person to person through respiratory particles released when a sick patient coughs. This is why, according to the WHO, it can trigger severe epidemics.
paras.zh: 它的潜伏期可短至 24 小时，并且是唯一一种可以通过病人咳嗽时释放的呼吸道颗粒轻松在人与人之间传播的病毒。根据世界卫生组织的说法，这就是为什么它会引发严重的流行病。

paras.en: Symptoms appear quickly: high fever, headache and weakness, followed by a rapidly worsening pneumonia with shortness of breath, chest pain and a cough that often brings up blood.
paras.zh: 症状出现得很快：高烧、头痛和虚弱，随后肺炎迅速恶化，伴有呼吸短促、胸痛和咳嗽，经常带血。

paras.en: A person can catch pneumonic plague by breathing in the bacteria directly, or by developing it when bubonic and/or septicemic plague go untreated and spread to the lungs.
paras.zh: 一个人可以通过直接吸入细菌来感染肺鼠疫，或者在腺鼠疫和/或败血性鼠疫未经治疗并扩散到肺部时感染肺鼠疫。

paras.en: What is the difference between bubonic and pneumonic plague?
paras.zh: 腺鼠疫和肺鼠疫有什么区别？

paras.en: Pneumonic plague is not a separate disease. It is one of three forms of plague: bubonic, septicemic and pneumonic.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫不是一种单独的疾病。它是鼠疫的三种形式之一：腺鼠疫、败血症和肺炎。

paras.en: What sets them apart is where the infection settles in the body, and that shapes how the disease spreads and how deadly it is.
paras.zh: 它们的不同之处在于感染在体内的停留位置，这决定了疾病的传播方式及其致命程度。

paras.en: Bubonic plague is the most common form and the one most people think of when they hear the word "plague." It usually follows a flea bite. The bacteria travel to the nearest lymph node, which swells into a painful lump known as a bubo. According to the WHO, it rarely spreads between people.
paras.zh: 黑死病是最常见的形式，也是大多数人听到“鼠疫”一词时想到的一种形式。通常是在跳蚤叮咬后发生的。细菌传播到最近的淋巴结，淋巴结肿大成疼痛的肿块，称为腹股沟淋巴结炎。据世界卫生组织称，它很少在人与人之间传播。

paras.en: If bubonic plague goes untreated, the bacteria can move further through the body. If they spread into the bloodstream, the disease can become septicemic plague, which causes bleeding under the skin, tissue death in the fingers and toes, and organ failure. If the bacteria reach the lungs, the illness becomes pneumonic plague, the form that can pass from person to person through the air. Both septicemic and pneumonic plague can also develop directly, without a bubo appearing first.
paras.zh: 如果黑死病得不到治疗，细菌就会在体内进一步传播。如果它们扩散到血液中，这种疾病可能会变成败血性鼠疫，导致皮下出血、手指和脚趾组织死亡以及器官衰竭。如果细菌到达肺部，疾病就会变成肺鼠疫，这种形式可以通过空气在人与人之间传播。败血性鼠疫和肺鼠疫也可以直接发展，而不首先出现腹股沟淋巴结炎。

paras.en: Left untreated, bubonic plague kills between 30-60% of patients. The septicemic and pneumonic forms are always fatal without treatment.
paras.zh: 如果不及时治疗，黑死病会导致 30-60% 的患者死亡。如果不进行治疗，败血症和肺炎形式总是致命的。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague treatment: antibiotics within the first 24 hours
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫治疗：24 小时内使用抗生素

paras.en: Pneumonic plague is curable, but only if treatment starts quickly. The WHO warns that without treatment it can kill within 18 to 24 hours of the first symptoms.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫是可以治愈的，但前提是迅速开始治疗。世界卫生组织警告说，如果不进行治疗，它可能会在首次出现症状后 18 至 24 小时内致人死亡。

paras.en: Common antibiotics can cure the infection, and recovery rates are high when patients are treated within about a day of falling ill.
paras.zh: 普通抗生素可以治愈感染，患者在发病后一天左右接受治疗，康复率很高。

paras.en: Speed is what decides the outcome. Doctors are advised not to wait for laboratory confirmation and to start antibiotics as soon as plague is suspected, according to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).
paras.zh: 速度决定结果。美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 表示，建议医生不要等待实验室确认，一旦怀疑鼠疫，就应立即开始使用抗生素。

paras.en: The drugs themselves are not rare or specialized. They are standard, widely used antibiotics, and patients usually need a course of up to two weeks. To stop the infection spreading, patients are kept in isolation, and wearing masks helps protect those around them, the WHO says.
paras.zh: 这些药物本身并不罕见或特殊。它们是广泛使用的标准抗生素，患者通常需要长达两周的疗程。世界卫生组织表示，为了阻止感染传播，患者被隔离，戴口罩有助于保护周围的人。

paras.en: Preventive antibiotics and isolation for close contacts
paras.zh: 预防性抗生素和密切接触者隔离

paras.en: People close to a patient are treated as well, even if they have no symptoms. Both the WHO and the CDC recommend a seven-day course of preventive antibiotics for close contacts of anyone with pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 与患者关系密切的人也会接受治疗，即使他们没有任何症状。世界卫生组织和疾病预防控制中心都建议与肺鼠疫患者有密切接触的人接受为期 7 天的预防性抗生素治疗。

paras.en: The WHO does not recommend a plague vaccine for the public. It reserves vaccination for high-risk groups, such as laboratory staff who work with the bacterium and health workers.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织不建议公众接种鼠疫疫苗。它为高危人群保留疫苗接种，例如与细菌相关的实验室工作人员和卫生工作者。

articles.title: What China's new military foothold in Laos means for Southeast Asia

paras.en: China has opened a new military training and logistics facility in Laos, extending Beijing's security presence deeper into mainland Southeast Asia and potentially giving the Chinese air force its first dedicated foothold overseas.
paras.zh: 中国在老挝开设了一个新的军事训练和后勤设施，将北京的安全存在延伸到东南亚大陆更深处，并有可能为中国空军提供第一个海外专门立足点。

paras.en: The China-Laos Joint Support and Training Center at Ban Keun Airport, north of the capital Vientiane, formally began operations late last month alongside the new China-Laos Friendship Aviation Academy.
paras.zh: 位于首都万象以北班根机场的中老联合保障培训中心于上月底与新的中老友谊航空学院一起正式投入运营。

paras.en: Beijing says the center will primarily help train Lao air force pilots and will be jointly maintained and operated by the two countries.
paras.zh: 北京表示，该中心将主要帮助培训老挝空军飞行员，并将由两国共同维护和运营。

paras.en: The opening adds to China's still relatively small network of overseas military facilities.
paras.zh: 此次开放扩大了中国仍相对较小的海外军事设施网络。

paras.en: Beijing established its first foreign military base in Djibouti in the Horn of Africa in 2017. A Chinese-funded expansion of Cambodia's Ream Naval Base was formally inaugurated last year, giving Chinese forces access to a facility strategically positioned near the South China Sea.
paras.zh: 北京于2017年在非洲之角的吉布提建立了第一个外国军事基地。中国出资扩建的柬埔寨云朗海军基地于去年正式落成，使中国军队能够进入南中国海附近的一个战略性设施。

paras.en: Laos and Cambodia are widely regarded as China's closest political partners in Southeast Asia, and military cooperation with both has expanded substantially in recent years.
paras.zh: 老挝和柬埔寨被广泛认为是中国在东南亚最亲密的政治伙伴，近年来与两国的军事合作大幅扩大。

paras.en: "The two institutions … are not directed against any third party and aim to help further deepen practical cooperation between the two militaries and contribute to maintaining peace and stability in the region," said the Chinese Defense Ministry in a public statement.
paras.zh: 中国国防部在一份公开声明中表示：“这两个机构……不针对任何第三方，旨在帮助进一步深化两军务实合作，为维护地区和平与稳定作出贡献。”

paras.en: Could Ban Keun become a permanent Chinese base?
paras.zh: 班根能否成为中国的永久基地？

paras.en: The facility's infrastructure gives Beijing the option of expanding its military use in the future, Hunter Marston, director of the Southeast Asia Program at Australia's Lowy Institute, told DW.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚洛伊研究所东南亚项目主任亨特·马斯顿告诉德国之声，该设施的基础设施为北京提供了未来扩大军事用途的选择。

paras.en: "The focus may well be on joint training, but it has the potential to become a more permanent base. Should Beijing choose to use it as such, it has ample political leverage over Vientiane to demand exclusive access in the future," he added.
paras.zh: “重点很可能是联合训练，但它有潜力成为一个更永久的基地。如果北京选择这样使用它，它对万象有足够的政治影响力，可以要求未来独家进入，”他补充道。

paras.en: Laos has become heavily dependent on Chinese investment and financing during the past two decades. Critics have frequently accused Beijing of engaging in "debt-trap diplomacy."
paras.zh: 过去二十年来，老挝严重依赖中国的投融资。批评者经常指责北京进行“债务陷阱外交”。

paras.en: The International Monetary Fund estimates Laos' public debt at around 81% of GDP last year, with China by far the largest bilateral creditor.
paras.zh: 国际货币基金组织估计，老挝去年的公共债务约占国内生产总值的 81%，而中国是迄今为止最大的双边债权人。

paras.en: In 2020, China's state-owned China Southern Power Grid acquired a reported 90% stake in Electricite du Laos Transmission Company, which operates much of Laos' electricity transmission network.
paras.zh: 据报道，2020年，中国国有的中国南方电网收购了老挝电力传输公司90%的股权，该公司运营着老挝的大部分输电网络。

paras.en: A more durable Chinese military presence in Laos would also add another dimension to the strategic competition between Beijing and Washington in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 中国在老挝的更持久的军事存在也将为北京和华盛顿之间在东南亚的战略竞争增添另一个层面。

paras.en: The United States still enjoys far more extensive military access across the wider Indo-Pacific, particularly through alliances with the Philippines, Japan and Australia.
paras.zh: 美国仍然在更广阔的印度太平洋地区享有更广泛的军事准入，特别是通过与菲律宾、日本和澳大利亚的联盟。

paras.en: Beijing has historically lacked comparable overseas facilities. But Ban Keun, alongside Ream, could gradually reduce that disadvantage by giving the Chinese military additional locations from which to train, maintain equipment and potentially preposition supplies.
paras.zh: 北京历来缺乏可比的海外设施。但班根和令可以通过为中国军队提供更多的训练、维护装备和潜在的预置补给的地点来逐步减少这一劣势。

paras.en: It is a particularly ominous development for Vietnam, Euan Graham, a senior fellow at the Australian Strategic Policy Institute, told DW.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚战略政策研究所高级研究员尤安·格雷厄姆告诉德国之声，这对越南来说是一个特别不祥的发展。

paras.en: Hanoi and Beijing retain close party-to-party and economic relations, but they remain rivals in the South China Sea, where their competing territorial claims have repeatedly generated tensions.
paras.zh: 河内和北京保持着密切的党际和经济关系，但它们仍然是南海的竞争对手，两国在南海的领土主张一再引发紧张局势。

paras.en: Vietnam has also traditionally viewed Laos and Cambodia as strategically important buffers along its western flank and has worked for decades to maintain considerable political and military influence in both countries.
paras.zh: 越南历来也将老挝和柬埔寨视为其西翼的重要战略缓冲区，并数十年来一直致力于在这两个国家保持相当大的政治和军事影响力。

paras.en: "Hanoi has always perceived the Indochinese peninsula as within its sphere of influence, offering a buffer against external aggressors, especially given Vietnam's narrow midriff," said Graham. "Now, it faces an alarming possibility of strategic encirclement by China. The new air base in Laos will certainly complicate Vietnam's defense planning."
paras.zh: 格雷厄姆说：“河内一直认为印度支那半岛在其势力范围内，为抵御外部侵略者提供了缓冲，特别是考虑到越南的中腹部狭窄。” “现在，它面临着中国战略包围的惊人可能性。老挝的新空军基地肯定会让越南的国防规划变得复杂化。”

paras.en: Strategic importance should not be overstated
paras.zh: 战略重要性不应被夸大

paras.en: Other analysts caution, however, that geography places clear limits on Ban Keun's military value.
paras.zh: 然而，其他分析人士警告说，地理位置对班根的军事价值造成了明显的限制。

paras.en: Collin Koh, a senior fellow at the S. Rajaratnam School of International Studies at Singapore's Nanyang Technological University, told DW that China could gradually expand its presence at the facility.
paras.zh: 新加坡南洋理工大学拉惹勒南国际研究学院高级研究员科林·许(Collin Koh)告诉德国之声，中国可以逐步扩大在该设施的存在。

paras.en: Beijing could deploy more personnel, particularly advisers and instructors, as well as trainer aircraft and eventually more advanced aircraft, while also using the site to preposition equipment and supplies, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，北京可以部署更多人员，特别是顾问和教官，以及教练机，最终部署更先进的飞机，同时还利用该地点预先部署设备和物资。

paras.en: But the "operational usefulness for the PLA's projection of military power in Southeast Asia is constrained by the landlocked nature of Laos."
paras.zh: 但“解放军在东南亚投射军事力量的作战效能受到老挝地处内陆的限制。”

paras.en: Unlike Ream, Ban Keun provides no sea access, while Chinese military aircraft already operate from substantially larger and better-equipped bases in southern China.
paras.zh: 与云朗不同的是，班根没有出海通道，而中国军用飞机已经在中国南部更大、装备更精良的基地运营。

paras.en: While Vietnam will closely monitor Ban Keun for its potential role in any future South China Sea conflict, the site's geography doesn't give the Chinese military a significant operational advantage, said Koh.
paras.zh: 高说，虽然越南将密切监视班根岛在未来任何南海冲突中的潜在作用，但该地点的地理位置并不能给中国军队带来显着的作战优势。

paras.en: Simon Creak, an associate professor at Singapore's National Institute of Education and a historian of Laos, noted that Vientiane has maintained a policy of non-alignment since adopting its current foreign policy in 1986.
paras.zh: 新加坡国家教育学院副教授、老挝历史学家西蒙·克里克指出，万象自1986年采取现行外交政策以来一直坚持不结盟政策。

paras.en: "It has not had similar joint facilities in the past despite boasting close political and military relations with Vietnam, as well as China and Russia … and any mention of foreign bases in Laos typically recalls the CIA's bases during the Indochina Wars," Creak said.
paras.zh: 克里克说：“尽管它与越南、中国和俄罗斯有着密切的政治和军事关系，但过去并没有类似的联合设施……任何提到老挝的外国基地通常都会让人想起印度支那战争期间中央情报局的基地。”

paras.en: Still, he believes it's "highly unlikely" that Laos will adjust its formal foreign policy settings or its longstanding effort to balance relations with Vietnam, Thailand and China.
paras.zh: 不过，他认为老挝“极不可能”调整其正式的外交政策设置或长期以来平衡与越南、泰国和中国关系的努力。

articles.title: Fact check: Misleading claims spark plague fears in Russia

paras.en: Dozens of people were reportedly placed under observation after a laboratory worker at a Russian institute dedicated to studying plague and other infectious diseases died of severe pneumonia.
paras.zh: 据报道，俄罗斯一家致力于研究鼠疫和其他传染病的研究所的一名实验室工作人员死于严重肺炎，数十人受到观察。

paras.en: The case quickly became the subject of intense speculation on social media. Posts have ranged from expressions of fear and comparisons with the COVID-19 pandemic to claims about the laboratory incident that have not been substantiated.
paras.zh: 此案很快成为社交媒体上激烈猜测的话题。帖子内容多种多样，从表达恐惧、与 COVID-19 大流行进行比较，到有关未经证实的实验室事件的说法。

paras.en: DW Fact Check has examined several of the claims circulating online.
paras.zh: 德国之声事实核查中心已经审查了网上流传的一些说法。

paras.en: Alleged plague lab accident in Irkutsk remains unproven
paras.zh: 据称伊尔库茨克鼠疫实验室事故尚未得到证实

paras.en: Claim: "For those who don't get it: in Irkutsk, a lab technician broke a flask containing the plague virus and became infected with the disease, dying a few days later," a user posted on X in Russian. "This happened on September 25, and by October 2, she was already dead. In the meantime, she had infected several hundred people." The post, which included a photo of the alleged laboratory worker, garnered over 320,000 views.
paras.zh: 声称：“对于那些不明白的人来说：在伊尔库茨克，一名实验室技术人员打破了装有鼠疫病毒的烧瓶，并感染了这种疾病，几天后死亡，”一位用户在 X 上用俄语发帖。 “这件事发生在9月25日，到10月2日，她已经死了。与此同时，她已经感染了数百人。”该帖子包含一张被指控的实验室工作人员的照片，获得了超过 32 万次浏览。

paras.en: There is no independent evidence confirming that a leak of the plague pathogen occurred at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute of Siberia and Far East.
paras.zh: 没有独立证据证实西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所发生鼠疫病原体泄漏。

paras.en: On the contrary, Russia's public health authority, Rospotrebnadzor, said that two commissions investigating biosafety procedures at the institute found "no evidence of an accident involving pathogenic microorganisms." The Russian news agency TASS, citing Rospotrebnadzor, also reported that tests on the deceased employee detected no microorganisms linked to her professional activity.
paras.zh: 相反，俄罗斯公共卫生部门 Rospotrebnadzor 表示，调查该研究所生物安全程序的两个委员会“没有发现涉及病原微生物的事故的证据”。俄罗斯通讯社塔斯社援引俄罗斯联邦通讯社报道称，对已故员工的检测未发现与她的职业活动有关的微生物。

paras.en: Some social media users have tried to debunk the claim about a broken test tube, pointing to safety standards in high-containment laboratories, where the use of glassware may be restricted or completely banned to reduce the risk of accidents.
paras.zh: 一些社交媒体用户试图揭穿有关试管破裂的说法，指出高密闭实验室的安全标准，可能会限制或完全禁止使用玻璃器皿，以降低事故风险。

paras.en: The Irkutsk institute does work with highly pathogenic microorganisms, including strains classified in Russia's highest pathogenicity groups, such as Yersinia pestis, the bacterium that causes plague.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克研究所确实研究高致病性微生物，包括俄罗斯最高致病性组的菌株，例如引起鼠疫的鼠疫耶尔森氏菌。

paras.en: However, DW could not independently verify the formally designated biosafety level of the institute's laboratories. Biosafety level, or BSL, is an international classification describing the containment measures required when handling dangerous pathogens, with BSL-4 reserved for the most hazardous agents.
paras.zh: 然而，德国之声无法独立核实该研究所实验室正式指定的生物安全级别。生物安全级别 (BSL) 是一种国际分类，描述处理危险病原体时所需的遏制措施，其中 BSL-4 保留用于最危险的病原体。

paras.en: DW asked the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute to comment on the alleged incident and its laboratory safety procedures but had received no response by the time of publication.
paras.zh: 德国之声要求伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所就所称事件及其实验室安全程序发表评论，但截至发稿时尚未收到任何回应。

paras.en: WHO website update unrelated to the Russian case
paras.zh: 世卫组织网站更新与俄罗斯病例无关

paras.en: Claim: "The WHO appears to have updated its fact sheet on plague the same day the Irkutsk lab worker presented at hospital, with (probably) the plague." This claim appeared in a number of posts on X, each reaching thousands of users.
paras.zh: 声称：“世界卫生组织似乎在伊尔库茨克实验室工作人员因（可能）鼠疫入院的同一天更新了有关鼠疫的情况说明书。”这一说法出现在 X 上的多个帖子中，每个帖子都有数千名用户。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) updated its plague fact sheet on the same day the Russian laboratory worker was hospitalized, but no evidence links the two events.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）在俄罗斯实验室工作人员住院的同一天更新了鼠疫情况说明书，但没有证据表明这两起事件有关。

paras.en: According to media reports, the laboratory worker may have been exposed to Yersinia pestis around September 25. Four days later, on September 29, she was hospitalized in Shelekhov with severe respiratory symptoms.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，该实验室工作人员可能在9月25日左右接触过鼠疫耶尔森菌。四天后，即9月29日，她因严重呼吸道症状在谢列霍夫住院。

paras.en: The WHO updated its plague fact sheet on September 29, the same day it published a news release on global trends in cholera, meningitis and plague. The update was part of a broader WHO publication cycle on infectious disease.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织于 9 月 29 日更新了鼠疫情况说明书，同一天还发布了有关霍乱、脑膜炎和鼠疫全球趋势的新闻稿。此次更新是世卫组织关于传染病的更广泛出版周期的一部分。

paras.en: The release reported global surveillance data covering 2019 to 2025 and said the findings were published in the latest edition of the Weekly Epidemiological Record, which was released on September 25.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿报告了2019年至2025年的全球监测数据，并称调查结果发表在9月25日发布的最新版《流行病学记录周报》中。

paras.en: The timing therefore appears coincidental. The previous version of the WHO's plague fact sheet, accessible as an archived page, was dated July 7, 2022.
paras.zh: 因此，时间显得很巧合。世界卫生组织鼠疫情况说明书的上一版本（可通过存档页面访问）日期为 2022 年 7 月 7 日。

paras.en: The social media account sharing the claim also changed its name in October to one that suggests it is reporting live from Irkutsk. Its profile describes itself as providing "sourced updates on the Irkutsk lab leak" and "latest news as it breaks live." However, the account's profile indicates that it was created in May and is based in Australia.
paras.zh: 分享这一说法的社交媒体账户也在 10 月份更名为一个表明它正在伊尔库茨克进行现场报道的账户。它的简介将自己描述为提供“伊尔库茨克实验室泄漏的最新消息”和“实时发布的最新消息”。然而，该帐户的个人资料表明它是在五月份创建的，并且位于澳大利亚。

paras.en: Such accounts can emerge quickly during breaking news events, presenting themselves as local or specialist sources while sharing unverified information.
paras.zh: 此类帐户可以在突发新闻事件期间迅速出现，将自己呈现为本地或专业来源，同时共享未经验证的信息。

paras.en: Old video falsely linked to current plague claims in Russia
paras.zh: 旧视频错误地与俄罗斯当前的鼠疫说法相关

paras.en: Claim: As news of the plague spreads, some old videos are being repurposed, adding to the disinformation. In one such video posted on X, a user claimed that the plague has also spread to other parts of Russia. The caption in Russian reads, "The plague marches across Russia. God has heard our prayers!"
paras.zh: 主张：随着瘟疫消息的传播，一些旧视频被重新利用，增加了虚假信息。在 X 上发布的一段此类视频中，一名用户声称瘟疫也已蔓延到俄罗斯其他地区。俄语说明文字写道：“瘟疫席卷俄罗斯。上帝听到了我们的祈祷！”

paras.en: The video is old and unrelated to the current developments in Irkutsk. A reverse image search reveals that the video was initially posted on August 31 this year, claiming that it showed the Russian republic of Kabardino-Balkaria, a tourist destination around 6,000 kilometers (3,700 miiles)from Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 该视频是旧视频，与伊尔库茨克当前的事态发展无关。反向图像搜索显示，该视频最初发布于今年 8 月 31 日，声称该视频显示的是俄罗斯卡巴尔达-巴尔卡尔共和国，这是距离伊尔库茨克约 6,000 公里（3,700 英里）的旅游目的地。

paras.en: The old video has been viewed more than 1.7 million times on Instagram. The same video was also posted on Telegram. The Russian news agency TASS reported on August 31 that the plague pathogen had been detected in local squirrels and that the area had been closed to tourists.
paras.zh: 这段旧视频在 Instagram 上的观看次数已超过 170 万次。同样的视频也发布在 Telegram 上。俄罗斯塔斯社8月31日报道称，当地松鼠体内检测到鼠疫病原体，该地区已对游客关闭。

paras.en: In the video, a person can be heard saying, "It's at the turnoff from the paved road toward Serebryany Istochnik" in Russian. Serebryany Istochnik, or Silver Spring, is a spring located in the Dzhily-Su area in Kabardino-Balkaria.
paras.zh: 在视频中，可以听到一个人用俄语说：“这是在通往 Serebryany Istochnik 的铺砌道路的岔路口处”。 Serebryany Istochnik 或称银泉，是位于卡巴尔达-巴尔卡尔州 Dzhily-Su 地区的一个泉水。

paras.en: The situation in the Irkutsk region is still being investigated, but there are no confirmed reports of a plague outbreak in Russia. Health authorities have introduced precautionary measures following the death of the laboratory worker, while tests are reportedly being carried out.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克地区的情况仍在调查中，但目前还没有俄罗斯爆发鼠疫的确诊报告。实验室工作人员死亡后，卫生当局采取了预防措施，据报道测试正在进行中。

articles.title: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia launches ‘massive’ attack on Ukraine

paras.en: At least two people have been killed in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv as Moscow said it launched a “massive strike” across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯对基辅的导弹袭击造成至少两人死亡，莫斯科表示对乌克兰发动了“大规模袭击”。

paras.en: Kyiv’s mayor Vitali Klitschko said two people were killed in the densely populated Darnytskyi neighbourhood in a fire caused by the overnight attack.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，夜间袭击引发的火灾在人口稠密的达尔尼茨基街区造成两人死亡。

paras.en: “Two people were rescued while the fire was being extinguished,” he wrote on Telegram on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “在扑灭大火时，有两人获救，”他周三在 Telegram 上写道。

paras.en: “The bodies of two people who had been killed were found.”
paras.zh: “发现了两名遇难者的尸体。”

paras.en: Russia’s Ministry of Defence said its forces had carried out a “massive strike” on targets in Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯军队对基辅和乌克兰其他地区的目标进行了“大规模打击”。

paras.en: The ministry said Russian forces hit port facilities in the Odesa region, as well as sea vessels used in the interests of Ukrainian armed forces.
paras.zh: 该部表示，俄罗斯军队袭击了敖德萨地区的港口设施，以及为乌克兰武装部队利益而使用的海上船只。

paras.en: Kyiv has come under relentless bombardment in recent weeks, with Russian air attacks on energy infrastructure, rail and road transport, including the bridges that connect the city over the Dnipro River.
paras.zh: 最近几周，基辅遭受了无情的轰炸，俄罗斯对能源基础设施、铁路和公路运输进行了空袭，其中包括第聂伯河上连接该市的桥梁。

paras.en: Air raid sirens have sounded almost constantly day and night, urging residents to take cover in basements, shelters and subway stations.
paras.zh: 空袭警报几乎日夜不停地响起，敦促居民躲进地下室、避难所和地铁站。

articles.title: Has Russia’s fuel crisis given Iranian oil an opening in Central Asia?

paras.en: Countries in Central Asia have begun buying oil from Iran as the Russian fuel supplies they have long depended on run dry amid Ukraine’s mounting attacks on Russian energy infrastructure to degrade Moscow’s war effort.
paras.zh: 中亚国家已开始从伊朗购买石油，因为乌克兰对俄罗斯能源基础设施的攻击越来越多，以削弱莫斯科的战争努力，而这些国家长期依赖的俄罗斯燃料供应已经枯竭。

paras.en: In August, Tajikistan announced it was receiving oil and petroleum products from Iran as Dushanbe faces uncertainty over its fuel supply from Russia. Tehran also agreed to establish a joint refinery in Kyrgyzstan in August, and supply the country with crude oil.
paras.zh: 八月，塔吉克斯坦宣布从伊朗接收石油和石油产品，因为杜尚别面临俄罗斯燃料供应的不确定性。德黑兰8月还同意在吉尔吉斯斯坦建立联合炼油厂，并向该国供应原油。

paras.en: Moscow has been facing fuel shortages due to Ukrainian drone strikes on its refineries as Russia’s war on its neighbour continues to rage.
paras.zh: 由于俄罗斯与其邻国的战争继续激烈，乌克兰无人机袭击了莫斯科的炼油厂，莫斯科一直面临燃料短缺的问题。

paras.en: Can the Russian fuel crisis give Iran a new oil opening in Central Asia?
paras.zh: 俄罗斯燃料危机能否为伊朗在中亚开辟新的石油出口？

paras.en: Which Central Asian countries have been affected by Russia’s fuel crisis?
paras.zh: 哪些中亚国家受到俄罗斯燃油危机的影响？

paras.en: Ukraine’s offensive against Russian energy infrastructure has caused panic across Central Asian countries like Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan, which are dependent on Moscow for oil and petroleum products.
paras.zh: 乌克兰对俄罗斯能源基础设施的进攻引起了塔吉克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦等中亚国家的恐慌，这些国家的石油和石油产品依赖莫斯科。

paras.en: Tajikistan has traditionally sourced up to 80 percent of its petroleum products from Russia. Kyrgyzstan also relies on petroleum product imports, sourcing more than 90 percent of its petrol from Russia.
paras.zh: 塔吉克斯坦传统上 80% 的石油产品来自俄罗斯。吉尔吉斯斯坦还依赖石油产品进口，90%以上的汽油从俄罗斯采购。

paras.en: “They’ve been hurt the most,” Galiya Ibragimova, a Moldova-based expert on Central Asia with Carnegie Politika, which has its headquarters in Berlin, told Al Jazeera in an interview in August.
paras.zh: “他们受到的伤害最深，”总部位于柏林的卡内基政治研究所驻摩尔多瓦的中亚问题专家加利亚·伊布拉吉莫娃在八月份接受半岛电视台采访时告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Kyrgyzstan is a member of the Eurasian Economic Union, the free trade bloc of five former Soviet nations dominated by Russia and the Kremlin’s political decisions.
paras.zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦是欧亚经济联盟的成员，该联盟是由五个前苏联国家组成的自由贸易集团，由俄罗斯和克里姆林宫的政治决定主导。

paras.en: Tajikistan is not a member of the group, but it bought discounted Russian fuel as “payment for political loyalty, not because [Russian President Vladimir] Putin is so kind”, Ibragimova added.
paras.zh: 伊布拉吉莫娃补充说，塔吉克斯坦不是该组织的成员，但它购买了打折的俄罗斯燃料，作为“政治忠诚的报酬，而不是因为[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京如此仁慈”。

paras.en: Kazakhstan, meanwhile, boasts three giant, Soviet-era oil refineries. Still, fuel prices in the country have increased by 15.6 percent this year, the UlusMedia website reported on July 10.
paras.zh: 与此同时，哈萨克斯坦拥有三座苏联时代的巨型炼油厂。尽管如此，据 UlusMedia 网站 7 月 10 日报道，今年该国的燃油价格上涨了 15.6%。

paras.en: Uzbekistan, on the other hand, is less dependent on Russian energy, with domestic production capable of reaching 100,000 tonnes of petroleum products per month, satisfying most of the country’s needs. But due to the increase in oil demand from its regional neighbours, Uzbekistan has also been forced to diversify its imports and has begun striking deals with countries like Georgia and Iraq.
paras.zh: 另一方面，乌兹别克斯坦对俄罗斯能源的依赖程度较低，国内石油产品产量每月可达10万吨，可以满足该国的大部分需求。但由于地区邻国石油需求的增加，乌兹别克斯坦也被迫实现进口多元化，并开始与格鲁吉亚和伊拉克等国达成交易。

paras.en: Russia has been facing a severe fuel deficit as Kyiv’s drone strikes – launched in an effort to degrade Moscow’s ability to maintain its ongoing invasion of Ukraine – have knocked out an estimated quarter to half of its total oil refining capacity.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯一直面临着严重的燃料短缺，因为基辅的无人机袭击（旨在削弱莫斯科持续入侵乌克兰的能力）估计摧毁了其炼油总能力的四分之一到一半。

paras.en: To tackle the problem, Russia has imposed fuel rationing. Sales are often limited to about 20-30 litres (about 5-8 US gallons) per vehicle, and drivers must pump fuel strictly into vehicle tanks. Filling jerry cans is largely prohibited.
paras.zh: 为了解决这个问题，俄罗斯实行了燃油配给。每辆车的销售量通常限制在约 20-30 升（约 5-8 美制加仑），并且驾驶员必须严格将燃油泵入车辆油箱。基本上禁止向油桶灌装。

paras.en: Earlier, the government banned petrol and jet fuel exports. Officials are now weighing a ban on diesel exports, too. Authorities have loosened fuel-quality regulations, temporarily allowing lower-grade fuel for the domestic market.
paras.zh: 早些时候，政府禁止汽油和航空燃油出口。官员们现在也在考虑禁止柴油出口。当局放松了燃油质量监管，暂时允许国内市场使用低等级燃油。

paras.en: A state of emergency has also been declared in Russian-occupied Crimea, which Moscow annexed from Ukraine in 2014. A Russian-owned oil firm in India, Nayara Energy, has reportedly sold petroleum to Russia.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯占领的克里米亚也宣布进入紧急状态，莫斯科于 2014 年从乌克兰吞并克里米亚。据报道，俄罗斯在印度拥有的石油公司 Nayara Energy 已向俄罗斯出售石油。

paras.en: While Russian President Putin acknowledges the crisis, he appears reluctant to end the war on Ukraine and insists the situation is under control.
paras.zh: 尽管俄罗斯总统普京承认存在危机，但他似乎不愿结束对乌克兰的战争，并坚称局势已得到控制。

paras.en: “These attacks on our facilities certainly create problems – that is obvious. We are currently seeing a certain shortage, though I would say it is not critical,” he said earlier this year.
paras.zh: “这些对我们设施的攻击肯定会造成问题——这是显而易见的。我们目前看到了一定程度的短缺，尽管我认为这并不重要，”他今年早些时候表示。

paras.en: “First and foremost, we have to rapidly and significantly increase production of air defence systems that are most in demand. We must also continue to improve them… Repairs at refineries must be completed more quickly.”
paras.zh: “首先也是最重要的是，我们必须迅速大幅增加最需要的防空系统的产量。我们还必须继续改进它们……炼油厂的维修必须更快地完成。”

paras.en: Amid Russian fuel shortages, Central Asian countries like Tajikistan have begun striking deals with Iran.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯燃料短缺的情况下，塔吉克斯坦等中亚国家已开始与伊朗达成协议。

paras.en: In August, Tajikistan’s Energy and Water Resources Ministry told the Asia-Plus news agency that the country is receiving oil and petroleum products from Iran. The ministry has not disclosed the route used to transport the products, but Tajikistan expects to receive 2.55 million tonnes of oil and petroleum products from Iran.
paras.zh: 八月，塔吉克斯坦能源和水资源部告诉亚洲通讯社，该国正在从伊朗接收石油和石油产品。该部尚未透露用于运输产品的路线，但塔吉克斯坦预计将从伊朗接收255万吨石油和石油产品。

paras.en: Besides Tajikistan, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian welcomed a proposal from Kyrgyzstan in August to establish a joint refinery in the Central Asian country, according to a report by Iran’s Tasnim news agency,
paras.zh: 据伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社报道，除塔吉克斯坦外，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 对吉尔吉斯斯坦八月份提出的在这个中亚国家建立联合炼油厂的提议表示欢迎。

paras.en: Under the agreement, Pezeshkian said, “The crude oil needed by the refinery can be supplied by Iran, and the products can be divided between the two sides.”
paras.zh: 根据协议，佩泽什基安表示，“炼油厂所需的原油可由伊朗提供，产品可在双方之间分配。”

paras.en: Will exporting oil to Central Asian countries help Iran?
paras.zh: 向中亚国家出口石油对伊朗有帮助吗？

paras.en: The United States and Israel’s war on Iran has affected Tehran’s oil revenues. Data released by the government-administered Statistical Center of Iran in September showed that gross domestic product (GDP) shrank by 10.1 percent year-on-year between March 21 and June 20, the first quarter of the Persian calendar.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列对伊朗的战争影响了德黑兰的石油收入。伊朗政府统计中心9月公布的数据显示，波斯历第一季度3月21日至6月20日期间，国内生产总值(GDP)同比萎缩10.1%。

paras.en: Tehran’s ability to sell crude has also been dramatically curtailed by the US naval blockade of Iran’s ports, imposed for most of the war, which began in late February.
paras.zh: 德黑兰销售原油的能力也因美国对伊朗港口的海上封锁而大幅削弱，这场封锁在二月下旬开始的战争的大部分时间里都实行。

paras.en: Iranian crude and condensate loadings collapsed from about two million barrels per day (bpd) in March to roughly 740,000bpd in July and just 220,000-255,000bpd in August, according to estimates from Kpler and Vortexa.
paras.zh: 根据 Kpler 和 Vortexa 的估计，伊朗原油和凝析油装载量从 3 月份的约 200 万桶/日锐减至 7 月份的约 74 万桶/日，8 月份仅为 22 万至 255,000 桶/日。

paras.en: TankerTrackers.com told the Reuters news agency in September that 29 tankers, carrying 36.11 million barrels of crude, were trapped in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Vortexa estimated that total Iranian crude afloat had fallen from 135 million barrels at the end of July to 107 million barrels by late August.
paras.zh: TankerTrackers.com 9月份告诉路透社，29艘载有3611万桶原油的油轮被困在霍尔木兹海峡。与此同时，Vortexa估计伊朗原油运输总量已从7月底的1.35亿桶下降至8月底的1.07亿桶。

paras.en: Amid these challenges, Iran has been scrambling to find new countries to trade oil with. Russian fuel shortages have opened up new opportunities for Iran in Central Asia, at least in the short term, according to analysts.
paras.zh: 面对这些挑战，伊朗一直在努力寻找新的石油贸易对象。分析人士称，俄罗斯燃料短缺为伊朗在中亚地区带来了新的机遇，至少在短期内如此。

paras.en: How does Iranian oil reach Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan?
paras.zh: 伊朗石油如何到达塔吉克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦？

paras.en: Iran does not share a border with either country.
paras.zh: 伊朗与任何一个国家都不接壤。

paras.en: To get to Tajikistan, Iranian “oil and refined products have to cross Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan by rail”, said Frederic Schneider, a nonresident senior fellow at the Middle East Council on Global Affairs.
paras.zh: 中东全球事务委员会非常驻高级研究员弗雷德里克·施奈德表示，为了到达塔吉克斯坦，伊朗“石油和成品油必须通过铁路穿越土库曼斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦”。

paras.en: To get to Kyrgyzstan, Iranian oil would also need to pass through Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan.
paras.zh: 伊朗石油要想到达吉尔吉斯斯坦，还需要经过土库曼斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦。

paras.en: Is trading oil with Iran logistically sustainable for Central Asia?
paras.zh: 对于中亚来说，与伊朗进行石油贸易在物流上是否可持续？

paras.en: “This opportunity [for Iran] depends on Ukraine continuing to hit Russian refineries, which seems unlikely, both given the waning of Ukraine’s strike capability and the US government’s demand to stop the attacks as they put too much strain on global oil markets,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 他告诉半岛电视台：“（伊朗）的这个机会取决于乌克兰继续袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，这似乎不太可能，既考虑到乌克兰打击能力的减弱，又考虑到美国政府要求停止袭击，因为袭击给全球石油市场带来了太大压力。”

paras.en: He noted that US President Donald Trump has pressed his Ukrainian counterpart, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, repeatedly in September for an “energy truce” with Russia, since diesel prices have become a political problem for Trump ahead of the November midterm elections in the US.
paras.zh: 他指出，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在 9 月份多次向乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基施压，要求与俄罗斯达成“能源休战”，因为在美国 11 月中期选举之前，柴油价格已成为特朗普的一个政治问题。

paras.en: “Those truces have so far collapsed within hours, but the direction is clear. Once the strikes stop, or once Russia repairs its plants, Russian fuel will come back to Central Asia duty-free under Eurasian Economic Union arrangements, and Iran will struggle to compete on price,” he said.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，这些休战协议在数小时内就破裂了，但方向是明确的。一旦罢工停止，或者一旦俄罗斯修复其工厂，俄罗斯燃料将根据欧亚经济联盟的安排免税返回中亚，而伊朗将难以在价格上竞争，”他说。

paras.en: Logistics also favour Russia with respect to importing oil to countries like Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，在向塔吉克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦等国进口石油方面，物流也有利于俄罗斯。

paras.en: Unlike Iran, Russia shares a border with both.
paras.zh: 与伊朗不同的是，俄罗斯与伊朗两国都有边界。

paras.en: “Tajikistan’s own request [for oil] would need around 51,000 rail tank cars, and its main refinery at Dangara has never operated commercially at scale. Russia, by contrast, has decades’ worth of logistics infrastructure, pipelines, rail links, and supply contracts into the region,” Schneider said.
paras.zh: “塔吉克斯坦自己的[石油]需求将需要大约51,000辆铁路油罐车，而其位于丹加拉的主要炼油厂从未大规模商业运营。相比之下，俄罗斯在该地区拥有价值数十年的物流基础设施、管道、铁路连接和供应合同，”施奈德说。

paras.en: Is Central Asia a big enough market to compensate for Iran’s Hormuz losses?
paras.zh: 中亚市场是否足够大，足以弥补伊朗霍尔木兹海峡的损失？

paras.en: Tajikistan’s total demand, Schneider said, was about 50,000bpd.
paras.zh: 施奈德表示，塔吉克斯坦的总需求约为每日 5 万桶。

paras.en: That is a drop in the ocean compared with the 1.7 million bpd Iran exported by sea a year ago. China reported $9.96bn in two-way trade with Iran in 2025, a figure that does not include some $31.2bn in Iranian oil shipments, according to the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission.
paras.zh: 与一年前伊朗海运每天 170 万桶相比，这只是沧海一粟。据美中经济与安全审查委员会称，中国报告称，2025年与伊朗的双向贸易额为99.6亿美元，这一数字不包括约312亿美元的伊朗石油运输。

paras.en: “This suggests that Central Asia can be a useful outlet for Iranian diesel and gasoline, but it cannot replace the Chinese market,” Schneider said.
paras.zh: “这表明中亚可以成为伊朗柴油和汽油的有用出口，但它无法取代中国市场，”施奈德说。

paras.en: For Tehran, Central Asia’s importance depends on how the US-Israel war on Iran develops, he said, adding that Tehran also needs to stay on good terms with Russia, with which it has a deep strategic partnership.
paras.zh: 他说，对德黑兰来说，中亚的重要性取决于美以对伊朗的战争如何发展，并补充说德黑兰还需要与俄罗斯保持良好关系，因为它与俄罗斯有着深厚的战略伙伴关系。

paras.en: “Iran cannot afford to be seen as poaching Russian customers too aggressively, so it will present itself as a stopgap supplier, which, again, limits how much it can earn there,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“伊朗不能被视为过于激进地挖走俄罗斯客户，因此它将把自己表现为一个权宜之计的供应商，这再次限制了它在俄罗斯的收入。”

paras.en: What other risks does Central Asia face in buying Iranian oil?
paras.zh: 中亚购买伊朗石油还面临哪些风险？

paras.en: Schneider warned that Central Asian nations could be hit with Washington’s secondary sanctions on Iran.
paras.zh: 施奈德警告说，中亚国家可能会因华盛顿对伊朗的二级制裁而受到打击。

paras.en: “Legally, US secondary sanctions apply to any foreign company or bank that conducts a significant transaction in Iranian petroleum, wherever it is based, and the Treasury expanded the list of sanctionable conduct in August. A Treasury official has already warned publicly that anyone in this trade ‘incurs that risk themselves’,” he noted.
paras.zh: “从法律上讲，美国的二级制裁适用于在伊朗石油方面进行重大交易的任何外国公司或银行，无论其总部位于何处，而且财政部在 8 月份扩大了可制裁行为的清单。财政部官员已经公开警告说，从事这项贸易的任何人都会‘自己承担风险’，”他指出。

paras.en: But Schneider said that, politically, the US sanctioning Central Asian governments is unlikely.
paras.zh: 但施奈德表示，从政治角度看，美国不太可能制裁中亚各国政府。

paras.en: “Central Asia is the arena of a new ‘Great Game’ between Russia, China and the United States, and Washington is courting the region harder than at any point since the 1990s, chiefly for its critical minerals. Kazakhstan alone holds about half of the minerals the US classifies as critical, including uranium and tungsten,” he said.
paras.zh: “中亚是俄罗斯、中国和美国之间新‘伟大博弈’的舞台，华盛顿比 20 世纪 90 年代以来的任何时候都更加努力地讨好该地区，主要是因为其关键矿产。仅哈萨克斯坦就拥有美国归类为关键矿产的约一半，其中包括铀和钨，”他说。

paras.en: “Sanctioning a Central Asian government for buying fuel from Iran would push them straight back into closer ties to Russia and China,” he noted.
paras.zh: 他指出：“制裁从伊朗购买燃料的中亚政府将直接促使他们重新与俄罗斯和中国建立更密切的关系。”

paras.en: “What I would expect instead are targeted designations of individual traders, rail and logistics operators and smaller banks, combined with quiet pressure on the region’s correspondent banks. That alone is enough to raise the cost and slow the trade, but will come at the price of these countries redoubling their efforts to decouple economically and financially from the US.”
paras.zh: “我所期望的是针对个体贸易商、铁路和物流运营商以及小型银行的指定，同时对该地区的代理银行施加安静的压力。仅此一项就足以提高成本并减缓贸易，但代价是这些国家加倍努力在经济和金融上与美国脱钩。”

articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis attack Aden airport; Saudi forces down missile near Riyadh

paras.en: Two Houthi missiles target Yemen’s Aden International Airport
paras.zh: 两枚胡塞武装导弹袭击也门亚丁国际机场

paras.en: Yemen’s internationally recognised government has accused the Houthis of firing ballistic missiles and drones at the main international airport under its control, as Saudi Arabia said it had intercepted another missile north of its capital, Riyadh.
paras.zh: 国际公认的也门政府指责胡塞武装在其控制下的主要国际机场发射弹道导弹和无人机，而沙特阿拉伯则表示在其首都利雅得以北拦截了另一枚导弹。

paras.en: In a statement on Wednesday, the Ministry of Transport said the Houthis targeted the runway and passenger terminal at the airport with at least two ballistic missiles and several drones.
paras.zh: 交通运输部在周三的一份声明中表示，胡塞武装用至少两枚弹道导弹和几架无人机袭击了机场跑道和航站楼。

paras.en: “One of the missiles landed near the runway minutes before the Yemeni flight from Cairo was to land,” it said. “We cancelled the landing of the incoming flight from Cairo [in Egypt] and diverted its route to Jeddah [in Saudi Arabia] to protect the passengers.”
paras.zh: 声明称：“其中一枚导弹在从开罗起飞的也门航班降落前几分钟降落在跑道附近。” “我们取消了从（埃及）开罗起飞的进港航班的降落，并将其航线改道至（沙特阿拉伯）吉达，以保护乘客。”

paras.en: The ministry also said it evacuated the airport terminal and removed two planes from the tarmac during the attacks.
paras.zh: 该部还表示，袭击期间已疏散机场航站楼，并从停机坪上移走两架飞机。

paras.en: It added, “This incident could easily have turned a civilian flight into a horrific humanitarian disaster, claiming the lives of dozens of innocent people in an instant.”
paras.zh: 声明补充道，“这一事件很容易将一架民用航班变成一场可怕的人道主义灾难，瞬间夺走数十名无辜者的生命。”

paras.en: Aden airport is the main international gateway for parts of Yemen outside Houthi control in the city that has been the seat of the government since the takeover of the capital, Sanaa, by the Iran-supported group in 2014.
paras.zh: 亚丁机场是胡塞武装控制之外的也门部分地区的主要国际门户，自 2014 年伊朗支持的组织接管首都萨那以来，该市一直是政府所在地。

paras.en: The Houthis said in a statement they targeted “Saudi military supplies” arriving at the Badr camp near the airport with ballistic missiles. Saudi Arabia backs Yemen’s government.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在一份声明中表示，他们用弹道导弹瞄准抵达机场附近巴德尔营地的“沙特军事物资”。沙特阿拉伯支持也门政府。

paras.en: Separately, the Saudi-led military coalition fighting in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile, launched by the Houthis, north of Riyadh.
paras.zh: 另外，沙特领导的在也门作战的军事联盟表示，他们拦截并摧毁了利雅得北部胡塞武装发射的一枚弹道导弹。

paras.en: In a social media post, Major-General Turki al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Saudi-led coalition, said it was tracking the launch platform used in the attack via an intelligence system over Sanaa, and promised to destroy it.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联军发言人图尔基·马利基少将在社交媒体帖子中表示，他们正在通过萨那上空的情报系统追踪袭击中使用的发射平台，并承诺摧毁它。

paras.en: The Houthis said in statements on Tuesday and overnight into Wednesday that they had targeted Saudi international airports in Riyadh and Abha.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在周二和周三夜间发表的声明中表示，他们的目标是利雅得和艾卜哈的沙特国际机场。

paras.en: The intensified fighting in Yemen comes amid mounting regional tensions set off by the US-Israel war on Iran. The Saudi-backed government forces launched a counteroffensive against the Houthis to retake the Red Sea port of Mocha and areas around the Bab al-Mandeb strait.
paras.zh: 也门的战斗加剧之际，美国和以色列对伊朗的战争引发了地区紧张局势加剧。沙特支持的政府军对胡塞武装发动反攻，夺回红海港口摩卡和曼德海峡周边地区。

paras.en: Fighting has concentrated in the southwestern province of Taiz.
paras.zh: 战斗集​​中在西南部的塔伊兹省。

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s Yousef Mawry, reporting from Sanaa, described “all-out battles to take over the ground, the highlands and the mountains east of Bab al-Mandeb”.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者尤瑟夫·莫里从萨那报道，描述了“为夺取曼德门以东的土地、高地和山脉而进行的全面战斗”。

paras.en: “It’s a battle to take over the strategic western part of Taiz, and whoever controls the wider vicinity will overlook the region and have dominant military control,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是一场夺取塔伊兹西部战略地区的战斗，谁控制了更广泛的周边地区，谁就将俯瞰该地区并拥有主导的军事控制权。”

paras.en: “For the Yemeni government to take control of Mocha and the strategic bases and locations along the Red Sea coast, it first has to drive the Houthis off the mountains east of Mocha.”
paras.zh: “也门政府要控制摩卡以及红海沿岸的战略基地和地点，首先必须将胡塞武装赶出摩卡以东的山区。”

paras.en: Pakistan and Turkiye on Monday agreed to activate “deterrence measures” under their mutual defence pact with Saudi Arabia and rapidly deploy forces to the Gulf kingdom to counter Houthi attacks.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦和土耳其周一同意根据与沙特阿拉伯的共同防御协议启动“威慑措施”，并迅速向这个海湾王国部署部队，以反击胡塞武装的袭击。

articles.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
paras.zh: 弗朗西斯·哈尔岑 (Francis Halzen) 因对太空高能中微子的研究而获得诺贝尔物理学奖

paras.en: STOCKHOLM — Francis Halzen won the Nobel Prize in physics on Tuesday for his contributions to the IceCube Neutrino Observatory and his discovery of high-energy neutrinos of astrophysical origin.
paras.zh: 斯德哥尔摩——周二，弗朗西斯·哈尔岑 (Francis Halzen) 因其对冰立方中微子观测站的贡献以及对天体物理起源的高能中微子的发现而获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

paras.en: "Francis Halzen has led an international team of researchers and engineers who have provided us with a fantastic instrument. His tenacity and scientific vision has paved the way for a new kind of astronomy," Mark Pearce, chair of the Nobel Committee for Physics, said in a news release.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔物理学委员会主席马克·皮尔斯在一份新闻稿中表示：“弗朗西斯·哈尔岑领导了一支由研究人员和工程师组成的国际团队，他们为我们提供了出色的仪器。他的坚韧和科学远见为新型天文学铺平了道路。”

paras.en: Halzen spoke to the committee by phone from Italy on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 哈尔岑周二在意大利通过电话与委员会进行了交谈。

paras.en: "It was a great surprise and I obviously didn't expect it," he said.
paras.zh: “这是一个很大的惊喜，我显然没有想到，”他说。

paras.en: Halzen said it was predicted before that he would win the Nobel Prize but the announcement still made him feel "strange."
paras.zh: 哈尔岑表示，之前就有人预测他将获得诺贝尔奖，但这个消息仍然让他感到“奇怪”。

paras.en: Born in Belgium, the 82-year-old scientist is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the U.S. Efforts by The Associated Press to reach him were not immediately successful.
paras.zh: 这位 82 岁的科学家出生于比利时，隶属于美国威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校。美联社联系他的努力并未立即成功。

paras.en: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory is a research facility located at the South Pole in Antarctica, according to its website, and the University of Wisconsin–Madison is its lead institution.
paras.zh: 据其网站称，冰立方中微子观测站是位于南极洲南极的一个研究设施，威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校是其领导机构。

paras.en: Neutrinos are tiny cosmic particles with a mind-bogglingly small mass. Yet they are everywhere: they spew from stars like the sun and trillions zip through our bodies every second.
paras.zh: 中微子是微小的宇宙粒子，质量小得令人难以置信。然而它们无处不在：它们从像太阳一样的恒星中喷出，每秒有数万亿的粒子穿过我们的身体。

paras.en: Scientists can't glimpse the mysterious ghost particles zooming around on their own. Instead, they measure what happens when the tiny particles collide with other bits of matter, producing flashes of light or charged particles.
paras.zh: 科学家们无法看到这些神秘的幽灵粒子自行四处乱窜。相反，他们测量微小粒子与其他物质碰撞时发生的情况，产生闪光或带电粒子。

paras.en: Halzen studied a rare gang of neutrinos that scientists consider messengers from the cosmos, offering clues to how the universe evolved.
paras.zh: 哈尔岑研究了一组罕见的中微子，科学家认为它们是来自宇宙的信使，为宇宙如何演化提供了线索。

paras.en: His research into capturing neutrinos at the South Pole dates back to the 1980s.
paras.zh: 他在南极捕获中微子的研究可以追溯到 20 世纪 80 年代。

paras.en: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the award in Stockholm.
paras.zh: 瑞典皇家科学院在斯德哥尔摩宣布了该奖项。

paras.en: The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), whether for an individual, a small group of laureates or an organization.
paras.zh: 今年的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），无论是个人、一小群获奖者还是一个组织。

paras.en: Last year, three scientists won the Nobel Prize in physics for research on the strange behavior of subatomic particles called quantum tunneling that enabled the ultra-sensitive measurements achieved by MRI machines and laid the groundwork for better cellphones and faster computers.
paras.zh: 去年，三名科学家因研究亚原子粒子的奇怪行为（称为量子隧道效应）而获得诺贝尔物理学奖，量子隧道效应使 MRI 机器实现了超灵敏测量，并为更好的手机和更快的计算机奠定了基础。

paras.en: The announcements of this year's prizes began Monday with the Nobel Prize in medicine being awarded to three scientists whose work led to a tool that uses light to help unravel how the brain works.
paras.zh: 今年的奖项公布于周一开始，诺贝尔医学奖被授予三名科学家，他们的工作成果是开发出一种利用光来帮助揭示大脑工作原理的工具。

paras.en: This week's awards continue Wednesday with the chemistry prize and literature on Thursday. After Friday's peace prize is awarded, the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences will be announced on Monday.
paras.zh: 本周的奖项将于周三继续，化学奖和文学奖将于周四颁发。周五和平奖颁发后，诺贝尔经济学纪念奖将于周一揭晓。

paras.en: The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), whether for an individual, a small group of laureates or an organization.
paras.zh: 今年的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），无论是个人、一小群获奖者还是一个组织。

articles.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
articles.author: Majd Al-Waheidi

paras.en: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
paras.zh: 6 个关键州的选民可以告诉我们有关 2026 年中期选举的哪些信息

paras.en: Four weeks from now, the midterm elections will help decide the balance of power in Congress. And ahead of Election Day, Morning Edition will be traveling to six states with some of the most competitive races to hear what voters say is shaping their decisions.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，中期选举将有助于决定国会的权力平衡。在选举日之前，《早间版》将前往六个州进行一些竞争最激烈的竞选，以了解选民的意见如何影响他们的决定。

paras.en: We already have some clues about where voters stand. The latest NPR/PBS News/Marist poll found registered voters favor Democrats for Congress over Republicans by 12 percentage points. President Trump is also very much on voters' minds, with 45% saying their vote for Congress is a vote against him, compared with about a quarter who say they are voting to support him.
paras.zh: 我们已经掌握了一些关于选民立场的线索。最新的 NPR/PBS News/Marist 民意调查发现，登记选民对国会议员的支持率比共和党高出 12 个百分点。特朗普总统也深受选民的关注，45% 的人表示，他们对国会的投票就是对他的反对，而大约四分之一的人表示，他们投票支持他。

paras.en: Across the political divide, one concern keeps rising to the top: the cost of living and what it means for people's economic futures.
paras.zh: 在政治分歧中，有一个问题不断上升：生活成本及其对人们经济未来的影响。

paras.en: But this year, some of the forces driving those costs are coming from far beyond voters' own communities. The war with Iran is affecting prices at the gas pump. Tariffs imposed in Washington are reaching the checkout counter. Foreign policy, economic policy and household costs are becoming harder to separate.
paras.zh: 但今年，推动这些成本的一些力量远远超出了选民所在社区的范围。与伊朗的战争正在影响加油站的价格。华盛顿征收的关税即将到达收银台。外交政策、经济政策和家庭成本变得越来越难以分开。

paras.en: Republicans and Democrats are both campaigning on promises to make everyday life more affordable. But voters are weighing more than their bills. Immigration and the rapid growth of massive data centers are also part of the conversation. So is the voting process itself, including new restrictions that are raising questions about how ballots will be cast, secured and counted.
paras.zh: 共和党和民主党都在竞选时承诺让日常生活变得更加实惠。但选民权衡的不仅仅是他们的账单。移民和大型数据中心的快速增长也是讨论的一部分。投票过程本身也是如此，包括新的限制，这些限制引发了人们对如何投票、确保和计票的疑问。

paras.en: And in several of these states, another question hangs over the races: What do voters want from their own parties, and do old political loyalties still hold? Those are some of the questions that Morning Edition will take on the road, using the six states as a window into an electorate that is changing.
paras.zh: 在其中几个州，另一个问题悬而未决：选民想从自己的政党得到什么，旧的政治忠诚是否仍然存在？这些是《晨报》将在路上提出的一些问题，以这六个州为窗口，了解正在发生变化的选民。

paras.en: Steve Inskeep is reporting from North Carolina and Georgia, two closely watched Southern states. North Carolina has an open Senate seat and newly redrawn congressional districts. Georgia has competitive races for Senate and governor after several elections in which voters have backed candidates from both parties.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普从北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州这两个受到密切关注的南方州进行报道。北卡罗来纳州拥有一个空缺的参议院席位和新重新划分的国会选区。佐治亚州在多次选举后展开了参议院和州长竞选，选民都支持两党候选人。

paras.en: "I am watching and listening for people who feel this election is personal," Inskeep said.
paras.zh: 因斯基普说：“我正在观察和倾听那些认为这次选举是针对个人的人。”

paras.en: He wants to hear from people who feel directly affected by the Trump administration's changes to immigration, government, education, taxes, foreign policy and the economy.
paras.zh: 他希望听到那些感到特朗普政府在移民、政府、教育、税收、外交政策和经济方面的改革直接受到影响的人们的意见。

paras.en: "Trump is not on the ballot but has urged voters to act as if he is, and given the consequential acts of his administration, voters are likely to respond as if he is," Inskeep said.
paras.zh: 因斯基普说：“特朗普没有参加投票，但他敦促选民像他参加投票一样行事，考虑到他的政府采取的后续行动，选民可能会做出像他参加投票一样的反应。”

paras.en: Michel Martin is headed to Ohio and Michigan, where some of the biggest questions are about political change in the Midwest. Ohio has competitive races for governor and Senate against a backdrop of economic anxiety. In Springfield, Martin will also look at how the end of temporary protected status for Haitians is affecting a community where Haitian immigrants make up a significant share of the population — and whether disagreements over immigration are changing how voters see their own parties.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·马丁将前往俄亥俄州和密歇根州，那里最大的问题是中西部的政治变革。在经济焦虑的背景下，俄亥俄州州长和参议院的竞选竞争激烈。在斯普林菲尔德，马丁还将研究海地人临时保护身份的终止如何影响海地移民在人口中占很大比例的社区，以及移民问题上的分歧是否正在改变选民对自己政党的看法。

paras.en: Michigan offers a different set of tests. Trump won the state narrowly in 2024, when anger over the Biden administration's handling of the war in Gaza was a major issue for some voters, particularly in Michigan's Arab American communities. The state also saw a sharp increase in young-voter turnout. This year, an open Senate seat and a governor's race offer another chance to see whether those shifts are carrying into the midterms — and what role younger and Black voters are playing in the Democratic coalition.
paras.zh: 密歇根州提供了一套不同的测试。特朗普在 2024 年以微弱优势赢得了该州，当时对拜登政府处理加沙战争的愤怒成为一些选民的主要问题，尤其是密歇根州的阿拉伯裔美国人社区。该州年轻选民的投票率也急剧增加。今年，参议院席位的空缺和州长竞选提供了另一个机会，看看这些转变是否会延续到中期选举，以及年轻选民和黑人选民在民主党联盟中扮演什么角色。

paras.en: Martin calls Ohio and Michigan "two big consequential states that have always told us a lot about where the rest of the country is, and is going."
paras.zh: 马丁称俄亥俄州和密歇根州为“两个重要的州，它们总是告诉我们很多关于该国其他地区的现状和发展方向。”

paras.en: In Michigan, she will be asking what is driving voters after the state has chosen both Democrats and Republicans in key races.
paras.zh: 在密歇根州，她将询问该州在关键竞选中同时选出民主党人和共和党人后，是什么在推动选民。

paras.en: "Are they mad? Sad? Or just exhausted? We hope to find out," Martin said.
paras.zh: “他们生气了吗？悲伤？还是只是精疲力尽？我们希望找出答案，”马丁说。

paras.en: Leila Fadel is reporting from Maine, where a Senate race could help determine control of the chamber. Republican Sen. Susan Collins is seeking another term against Democrat Troy Jackson. Immigration and trade are also part of the political conversation there.
paras.zh: 莱拉·法德尔从缅因州报道，参议院竞选可能有助于确定参议院​​的控制权。共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯正在寻求连任，以对抗民主党特洛伊·杰克逊。移民和贸易也是那里政治对话的一部分。

paras.en: "I want to know what drives voters and how much party loyalty still plays a role," Fadel said. "Are their votes up for grabs? Or are they locked in along party lines?"
paras.zh: 法德尔说：“我想知道是什么在推动选民，以及政党忠诚度在多大程度上仍然发挥着作用。” “他们的选票是可供争夺的吗？还是他们被锁定在党派界限内？”

paras.en: Maine's long border with Canada also gives the trade war a different dimension, as tariffs and tensions over cross-border trade affect businesses and communities with close economic ties to Canada. The state has also been affected by the Trump administration's immigration crackdown. Fadel said she will be asking voters what they want from their candidates — and whether the party delivering that message matters.
paras.zh: 缅因州与加拿大的漫长边境也给贸易战带来了不同的层面，因为关税和跨境贸易紧张局势影响了与加拿大有密切经济联系的企业和社区。该州也受到特朗普政府移民镇压的影响。法德尔表示，她将询问选民对候选人的期望，以及传达这一信息的政党是否重要。

paras.en: A Martínez is heading to Texas, where Republicans are testing whether recent gains among Latino voters will hold. The state's U.S. Senate race has also put Texas in the national fight over control of the chamber.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯将前往德克萨斯州，那里的共和党人正在测试最近在拉丁裔选民中取得的进展是否会持续下去。该州的美国参议院竞选也让德克萨斯州陷入了全国性的参议院控制权之争。

paras.en: Republicans redrew five congressional districts to favor the Republican Party in the midterms, including three with more Latino voters. Martínez said that this makes the party's strategy around Latino voters one of the questions he wants to examine.
paras.zh: 共和党人重新划分了五个国会选区，以在中期选举中支持共和党，其中三个选区拥有更多拉丁裔选民。马丁内斯说，这使得该党围绕拉丁裔选民的策略成为他想要研究的问题之一。

paras.en: "What's behind the Texas GOP's big bet on Latino voters, and will it help Republicans keep control of the U.S. Senate?"
paras.zh: “德克萨斯州共和党对拉丁裔选民的大赌注背后是什么？这会帮助共和党保持对美国参议院的控制吗？”

paras.en: Over the next four weeks, Morning Edition will report from races and electorates across the U.S., asking many of the same questions: What matters to voters now, what has changed and where is the country headed next?
paras.zh: 在接下来的四个星期内，早间版将报道美国各地的竞选和选民，询问许多相同的问题：现在对选民来说什么最重要，发生了什么变化以及国家下一步将走向何方？

articles.title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，民主党在中期选举中具有优势。并且，派拉蒙与华纳兄弟的合并即将完成

paras.en: In four weeks, Election Day will be here, and a series of new polls show Democrats have a decided advantage in the midterms. They are favored to win the House with a narrow majority. Democrats need 218 seats for a majority, and the Cook Political Report forecasts a net gain of five to 15 seats, which would give them between 220 and 230 seats in January. The Senate has shifted more dramatically. Six seats have moved toward the Democrats' direction since June, according to Cook's ratings. Initially seen as a long shot for Democrats, the Senate is now within reach. These projections come as President Trump's approval rating is low.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，选举日就到了，一系列新的民意调查显示民主党在中期选举中拥有明显的优势。他们有望以微弱多数赢得众议院。民主党需要 218 个席位才能获得多数席位，库克政治报告预测净增加 5 至 15 个席位，这将使他们在 1 月份获得 220 至 230 个席位。参议院的转变更为剧烈。根据库克的支持率，自 6 月份以来，已有 6 个席位向民主党方向倾斜。最初被认为对民主党来说希望渺茫，但现在参议院已经触手可及。这些预测是在特朗普总统的支持率较低之际做出的。

paras.en: - 🎧 Polls are just one factor to consider for the midterms, NPR's Domenico Montanaro tells Up First. He notes that people should consider the importance of history, the national environment, political structure and money as factors as well. And people still have to vote in the elections, but even so, the momentum seems to be shifting toward Democrats, particularly in the Senate. Democratic gains in the House are uncertain, as the party's unpopularity and the fact that 25 of the 31 targeted districts are in areas Trump won in 2024 could make it hard to tip the scales in their favor, Montanaro says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 民意调查只是中期选举需要考虑的因素之一，NPR 的多梅尼科·蒙塔纳罗 (Domenico Montanaro) 告诉 Up First。他指出，人们还应该考虑历史、国家环境、政治结构和金钱等因素的重要性。人们仍然必须在选举中投票，但即便如此，势头似乎正在转向民主党，尤其是在参议院。蒙塔纳罗表示，民主党在众议院的进展存在不确定性，因为该党不受欢迎，而且 31 个目标选区中有 25 个位于特朗普在 2024 年获胜的地区，这可能导致局势很难向对他们有利的方向倾斜。

paras.en: - ➡️ If you haven't registered to vote yet, it isn't too late. Here's what you need to know about registration in your state.
paras.zh: - ➡️如果您还没有登记投票，现在还不算太晚。以下是您需要了解的有关在您所在州注册的信息。

paras.en: - ➡️ Find the latest election news from NPR and your local station on the NPR app.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在 NPR 应用程序上查找 NPR 和您当地电台的最新选举新闻。

paras.en: A new era in Hollywood is set to arrive today as David Ellison's long-anticipated $111 billion merger with Paramount-Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery is expected to close. Despite facing months of public protests, the deal has cleared legal and regulatory challenges in the U.S. and Europe. The media conglomerate Skydance unites two film studios, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Pictures, both more than 100 years old.
paras.zh: 随着大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 期待已久的与派拉蒙·斯凯丹斯 (Paramount-Skydance) 和华纳兄弟探索频道 (Warner Bros. Discovery) 的 1,110 亿美元合并预计即将结束，好莱坞的一个新时代即将到来。尽管面临数月的公众抗议，该交易还是清除了美国和欧洲的法律和监管挑战。媒体集团 Skydance 联合了派拉蒙影业和华纳兄弟影业这两家拥有 100 多年历史的电影制片厂。

paras.en: - 🎧 Ellison defended the merger against critics concerned about him having too much media power, NPR's Mandalit del Barco says. As part of a settlement to move the deal forward, Ellison agreed to produce 30 films a year with the combined studios, but critics remain skeptical. Concerns also linger about CNN's future, given that Ellison is an ally of Trump. To address these worries, Ellison promised to establish an independent oversight board to protect CNN from political interference. People who don't agree with the deal predict that viewers may soon see an increase in cost for streaming services and they could have fewer choices, according to del Barco.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的曼达利特·德尔·巴科 (Mandalit del Barco) 表示，埃里森为合并进行了辩护，反对批评者担心他拥有过多的媒体权力。作为推进交易的和解协议的一部分，埃里森同意与合并后的工作室每年制作 30 部电影，但批评者仍然持怀疑态度。鉴于埃里森是特朗普的盟友，人们对 CNN 未来的担忧也挥之不去。为了解决这些担忧，埃里森承诺建立一个独立的监督委员会，以保护 CNN 免受政治干预。德尔巴科表示，不同意该协议的人预计，观众可能很快就会看到流媒体服务的成本增加，而且他们的选择可能会减少。

paras.en: Catherine Sweeney from NPR network station WPLN was one of seven media witnesses to observe Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike, the first woman to face the death penalty in the state in nearly 200 years. Each witness sensed that the lethal injection might not proceed smoothly. Pike's attorneys had requested the Tennessee Supreme Court to allow hanging instead due to concerns that her platelet disorder and small veins would make the injection painful and ineffective. Sweeney describes what she saw and heard throughout that day.
paras.zh: NPR 网络电台 WPLN 的凯瑟琳·斯威尼 (Catherine Sweeney) 是田纳西州对克里斯塔·派克 (Christa Pike) 处决失败的七名媒体目击者之一。克里斯塔·派克是该州近 200 年来第一位面临死刑的女性。每个目击者都感觉到注射死刑可能不会顺利进行。派克的律师请求田纳西州最高法院允许绞刑，因为担心她的血小板紊乱和小静脉会导致注射疼痛且无效。斯威尼描述了她这一天的所见所闻。

paras.en: Russian authorities are urging people to remain calm after a worker at an infectious diseases institute in Siberia died from a mysterious illness, raising speculation about a potential plague outbreak. Last Tuesday, a 28-year-old female lab worker at the anti-plague Research Institute in Irkutsk fell ill and died two days later. Questions remain over the cause of her death. Here's what we do and don't know.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚一家传染病研究所的一名工作人员死于一种神秘疾病，引发了人们对可能爆发鼠疫的猜测，俄罗斯当局敦促人们保持冷静。上周二，伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名28岁的女性实验室工作人员患病，两天后死亡。关于她的死因仍然存在疑问。这是我们所做的和不知道的。

paras.en: by Majd Al-Waheidi, Morning Edition and Up First digital editor
paras.zh: 作者：Majd Al-Waheidi，Morning Edition 和 Up First 数字编辑

paras.en: Four weeks from now, the midterm election will help decide the balance of power in Congress. And ahead of Election Day, Morning Edition will be traveling to six states with some of the most competitive races to hear what voters say is shaping their decisions.
paras.zh: 四个星期后，中期选举将有助于决定国会的权力平衡。在选举日之前，《早间版》将前往六个州进行一些竞争最激烈的竞选，以了解选民的意见如何影响他们的决定。

paras.en: Steve Inskeep is reporting from North Carolina and Georgia. Michel Martin is headed to Ohio and Michigan. Leila Fadel is reporting from Maine. And A Martínez is heading to Texas.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普从北卡罗来纳州和佐治亚州报道。米歇尔·马丁将前往俄亥俄州和密歇根州。莱拉·法德尔从缅因州报道。马丁内斯正前往德克萨斯州。

paras.en: Across the political divide, one concern keeps rising to the top: the cost of living and what it means for people's economic futures.
paras.zh: 在政治分歧中，有一个问题不断上升：生活成本及其对人们经济未来的影响。

paras.en: But voters are weighing more than their bills. Immigration and the rapid growth of massive data centers are also part of the conversation. So is the voting process itself, including new restrictions that are raising questions about how ballots will be cast, secured and counted.
paras.zh: 但选民权衡的不仅仅是他们的账单。移民和大型数据中心的快速增长也是讨论的一部分。投票过程本身也是如此，包括新的限制，这些限制引发了人们对如何投票、确保和计票的疑问。

paras.en: Over the next four weeks, Morning Edition will report from different races and electorates across the country, asking many of the same questions: What matters to voters now, what has changed and where is the country headed next?
paras.zh: 在接下来的四个星期内，《早间版》将报道全国各地不同种族和选民的情况，并提出许多相同的问题：现在对选民来说什么最重要，发生了什么变化以及国家下一步将走向何方？

paras.en: So what will our hosts be listening for when Morning Edition hits the road? We asked them. Here are four things on their minds:
paras.zh: 那么，当早间版上线时，我们的主持人会收听什么内容呢？我们问他们。他们的想法有以下四点：

paras.en: Steve Inskeep: "I am watching and listening for people who feel this election is personal. By which I mean that, beyond their general opinion of the state of the country, they feel they were directly affected by the events of the past two years — the Trump administration's dramatic moves to reshape immigration, government, education, science, research, the military, emergency management, taxes, foreign policy and the economy at large.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·英斯基普：“我正在观察和倾听那些认为这次选举是针对个人的人。我的意思是，除了他们对国家状况的总体看法之外，他们认为自己受到过去两年事件的直接影响——特朗普政府重塑移民、政府、教育、科学、研究、军事、应急管理、税收、外交政策和整个经济的重大举措。

paras.en: Michel Martin: "Ohio is also a key location for the Trump administration's mass deportation campaign, as well as a leading industrial and logistics hub, a place where we should be able to see how the administration's economic policies are playing out. Trump isn't on the ballot, but his policies are. So let's see how that's going.
paras.zh: 米歇尔·马丁：“俄亥俄州也是特朗普政府大规模驱逐行动的关键地点，也是领先的工业和物流中心，在这里我们应该能够看到政府的经济政策如何发挥作用。特朗普没有在选票上，但他的政策却在。所以让我们看看情况如何。

paras.en: "Michigan was once considered a big part of the Democrats' 'Blue Wall,' but in recent years has chosen both Democrats and Republicans in key races. And the Democratic base has had beef with the national party. So what's driving voters? Are they mad? Sad? Or just exhausted? We hope to find out."
paras.zh: “密歇根州曾经被认为是民主党‘蓝墙’的重要组成部分，但近年来在关键竞选中同时选择了民主党和共和党。民主党基地与国家党之间存在矛盾。那么是什么驱使选民呢？他们是生气了吗？悲伤？还是只是精疲力尽？我们希望找出答案。”

paras.en: Leila Fadel: "The path to controlling the Senate in part runs through Maine, and that's why we're reporting in the state before the midterm elections. I want to know what drives voters, and how much party loyalty still plays a role. Are their votes up for grabs? Or are they locked in along party lines?"
paras.zh: 莱拉·法德尔：“控制参议院的道路部分经过缅因州，这就是我们在中期选举前在该州进行报道的原因。我想知道是什么驱动了选民，以及政党忠诚度仍然发挥着作用。他们的选票是可以争夺的吗？还是按照党派路线锁定？”

paras.en: "This is a state that's seen some of the worst of the immigration crackdown; a man was killed by ICE. It has one of the longest borders with Canada, and so the trade war hits differently. The Democratic candidate Troy Jackson is facing incumbent Susan Collins, who has won her state five times before. So, we'll be asking what people want from their candidate and if it matters which party that resonating message comes from."
paras.zh: “这个州经历了最严重的移民镇压；一名男子被 ICE 杀害。该州与加拿大有最长的边境之一，因此贸易战的打击有所不同。民主党候选人特洛伊·杰克逊面对的是现任议员苏珊·柯林斯，她之前曾五次赢得该州。因此，我们将询问人们希望从他们的候选人那里得到什么，以及产生共鸣的信息来自哪个政党是否重要。”

paras.en: A Martínez: "Texas Republicans gerrymandered five congressional districts to favor the GOP in the upcoming midterms. In three of them, the new maps created more Latino voters."
paras.zh: A 马丁内斯：“德克萨斯州共和党人在即将到来的中期选举中对五个国会选区进行不公正划分，以支持共和党。在其中三个选区中，新地图创造了更多的拉丁裔选民。”

paras.en: "What's behind the Texas GOP's big bet on Latino voters, and will it help Republicans keep control of the U.S. Senate?"
paras.zh: “德克萨斯州共和党对拉丁裔选民的大赌注背后是什么？这会帮助共和党保持对美国参议院的控制吗？”

paras.en: A new NPR series is taking readers and listeners to breakfast tables around the world. In Munich, Germany, a Bavarian breakfast typically consists of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel, all washed down with beer. Demetrios Kyriakides, who spent a year researching Bavarian breakfast joints in Munich, says the ambiance of Gemütlichkeit, which describes conviviality, is just as important as the food. A meal is often accompanied by brass oom-pah-pah music. This feast is usually finished before the church bells ring at midday, signaling that all good things must come to an end. Check out these photos of breakfast in Munich.
paras.zh: NPR 的新系列节目将带领读者和听众来到世界各地的早餐桌上。在德国慕尼黑，巴伐利亚早餐通常包括煮小牛肉香肠、甜芥末和一个巨大的椒盐卷饼，所有这些都与啤酒一起饮用。 Demetrios Kyriakides 花了一年时间研究慕尼黑的巴伐利亚早餐店，他表示，描述欢乐的 Gemütlichkeit 的氛围与食物一样重要。进餐时常常伴随着铜管乐。这个节日通常在中午教堂钟声敲响之前结束，这意味着所有美好的事情都必须结束。看看这些慕尼黑早餐的照片。

paras.en: - Under artistic director Robert Garland, Dance Theatre of Harlem is embarking on a new era by reviving its landmark 1982 production of Firebird for an international tour.
paras.zh: - 在艺术总监罗伯特·加兰 (Robert Garland) 的领导下，哈莱姆舞蹈剧院 (Dance Theatre of Harlem) 正在开启一个新时代，恢复其 1982 年里程碑式的作品《火鸟》(Firebird) 进行国际巡演。

paras.en: - Biologists at the University of Massachusetts Amherst have found what may potentially be the world's loudest birds, and they all live in Brazil. (via WBUR)
paras.zh: - 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的生物学家发现了可能是世界上声音最大的鸟类，它们都生活在巴西。 （通过 WBUR）

paras.en: - Scientist Olivia Sanderfoot wants to establish a new field called "smoke ecology," which studies the effects of wildfire smoke on wildlife and seeks ways to mitigate its impacts.
paras.zh: - 科学家奥利维亚·桑德福特希望建立一个名为“烟雾生态学”的新领域，该领域研究野火烟雾对野生动物的影响，并寻求减轻其影响的方法。
