paras.en: As someone who was directly affected by the drug phenomenon — I caught my first felony drug case in the late 1980s — every great filmmaker in America should have a crack movie or show under their belt if they take it seriously and understand that these stories reshaped and still define all of America and pop culture today. I knew the tone, the lightness, the humor, the love, the Black joy was a flip side to the coin of crack, of murder, millionaires made overnight and then lost and addiction and all that. They always went hand in hand together. Since none of our lead characters are actually pursuing crime, it made it easier to work into those pockets and show the flip side of the same coin.
paras.zh: 作为一个直接受到毒品现象影响的人——我在 20 世纪 80 年代末抓获了第一起毒品重罪案件——每一位美国伟大的电影制片人都应该拥有一部出色的电影或电视剧，如果他们认真对待并理解这些故事重塑并仍然定义着整个美国和当今的流行文化。我知道这种语气、轻松、幽默、爱、黑人的欢乐是毒品、谋杀、一夜暴富、然后迷失的百万富翁和所有这些的反面。他们总是携手并进。由于我们的主角都没有真正追求犯罪，所以更容易进入这些口袋并展示同一枚硬币的反面。

paras.en: At the time that we’re talking, three episodes have aired. What sort of feedback have you encountered? What’s the reaction to the show that you’ve caught wind of?
paras.zh: 在我们谈话时，三集已经播出。您遇到过什么样的反馈？您听说过的这部剧有何反应？

paras.en: The shit I care about, which is the community, and I’m still tapped in; it’s off the charts, and for me, nothing else matters. I don’t read reviews. What I will do is go to every single reaction channel I can, because those reactors are people from our community who love this kind of material and talk to people like them. That shit has been off the fucking charts, and I’m not scared to say it. I think the culture saw official people was behind us, felt it and embraced it in a way that’s gonna make this thing a force to be reckoned with. And, of course, let me first shout out the foundation to all of this is the original Snowfall fans. If we lose them, we’re fucked, and we didn’t. But overall, I can tell you the response to this shit is nuts, and ain’t no one called to tell me that, and they don’t have to, because I go out into the world. I can see it. I’ve done everything from Falcon and the Winter Soldier to Empire to Bel-Air. I know what the fuck a hit feels like. This motherfucker is a hit.
paras.zh: 我关心的就是社区，而我仍然参与其中；这太不可思议了，对我来说，其他一切都不重要。我不看评论。我要做的就是尽可能地进入每一个反应渠道，因为这些反应者是来自我们社区的人，他们喜欢这种材料并与像他们这样的人交谈。这件事已经超出了他妈的记录，而且我并不害怕说出来。我认为这种文化看到了官方人士在我们身后，感受到了它并以某种方式拥抱它，这将使这件事成为一股不可忽视的力量。当然，首先让我大声说出这一切的基础是最初的《Snowfall》粉丝。如果我们失去了它们，我们就完蛋了，但我们没有。但总的来说，我可以告诉你，人们对这件事的反应是疯狂的，没有人打电话告诉我这一点，他们也没有必要这样做，因为我走向了外面的世界。我能看到它。从《猎鹰与冬兵》到《帝国》再到《贝莱尔》，我什么都拍过。我知道被击中是什么感觉。这个混蛋很受欢迎。

paras.en: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga airs Tuesday nights at 9 p.m. on FX and Hulu.
paras.zh: 《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》每周二晚上 9 点播出。在 FX 和 Hulu 上。

articles.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build

paras.en: The Reserve Bank of India on Wednesday raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, joining several major central banks in tightening monetary policy to arrest accelerating inflation.
paras.zh: 印度储备银行周三自 2023 年以来首次加息，与几家主要央行一起收紧货币政策，以遏制通胀加速。

paras.en: The central bank increased the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to a 1-year high of 5.50%, in line with expectations of economists polled by Reuters.
paras.zh: 央行将基准回购利率上调25个基点至1年高点5.50%，与路透社调查的经济学家预期一致。

paras.en: India's economic growth has been strong despite global challenges, Sanjay Malhotra, RBI governor, said in his address on Wednesday, while adding that "inflation and its outlook are not benign, as they were last year."
paras.zh: 印度央行行长桑贾伊·马尔霍特拉在周三的讲话中表示，尽管面临全球挑战，印度经济增长依然强劲，同时补充道，“通胀及其前景并不像去年那样良性”。

paras.en: The monetary policy committee decided to change the policy stance "to calibrated tightening," Malhotra said.
paras.zh: 马尔霍特拉表示，货币政策委员会决定改变政策立场，“调整紧缩政策”。

paras.en: The hike comes as retail inflation in India has been on the rise for 10 straight months, touching 4.8% in August, higher than the RBI's medium-term target of 4%. The central bank expects India's core inflation to be at 4.4% for the financial year ending March 2027 and headline inflation at 5.2%.
paras.zh: 此次加息之际，印度零售通胀已连续 10 个月上升，8 月份触及 4.8%，高于印度央行 4% 的中期目标。央行预计，截至 2027 年 3 月的财政年度，印度核心通胀率为 4.4%，总体通胀率为 5.2%。

paras.en: "Given the current conditions, rate cuts are off the table in the near term, and policy action ahead can only be a rate hike or a pause," Malhotra said. HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.
paras.zh: 马尔霍特拉表示：“鉴于目前的情况，短期内不可能降息，未来的政策行动只能是加息或暂停。”汇丰银行和高盛预计印度央行也将在 12 月加息。

paras.en: The markets need to see a "credible" hike from India's central bank that shows its ability to raise rates again to contain inflation, HSBC said in a report on Monday. If the RBI's rate hike is "perceived as dovish at a time" when inflation is rising and likely to persist, it would hurt India's appeal among global investors, the report said.
paras.zh: 汇丰银行周一在一份报告中表示，市场需要看到印度央行“可信”的加息，以显示其再次加息以遏制通胀的能力。报告称，如果印度央行的加息“在通胀上升并可能持续下去之际被视为鸽派”，那么这将损害印度在全球投资者中的吸引力。

paras.en: The RBI raised India's economic growth estimated by 40 basis points to at 7.1% on the back of resilient economic activity even as it flagged that protracted geopolitical tensions, trade frictions, tightening of financial conditions and elevated international commodity prices would likely to weigh on growth.
paras.zh: 由于经济活动富有弹性，印度央行将印度经济增长预期上调 40 个基点至 7.1%，尽管印度央行表示，长期的地缘政治紧张局势、贸易摩擦、金融状况收紧和国际大宗商品价格上涨可能会拖累经济增长。

paras.en: India, which remains the world's fastest-growing major economy, is among the countries most vulnerable to the supply disruptions caused by the Iran war. The South Asian country meets nearly 85% of its fuel needs via imports, with the Strait of Hormuz being a key supply route before the war.
paras.zh: 印度仍然是世界上增长最快的主要经济体，也是最容易受到伊朗战争造成的供应中断影响的国家之一。这个南亚国家近85%的燃料需求通过进口满足，霍尔木兹海峡是战前的重要供应路线。

paras.en: India is also facing the risk of El Niño this year. As per the World Bank, India had its fourth-driest June-August period since 1960, and it could lead to higher food prices.
paras.zh: 印度今年也面临厄尔尼诺现象的风险。根据世界银行的数据，印度经历了自 1960 年以来第四个最干旱的 6 月至 8 月期间，这可能导致粮食价格上涨。

paras.en: The World Bank expects India's economic growth to slow to 7.1% in the financial year ending March 2027 as compared to 7.8% in the previous year, it said in a report on Tuesday. The report said the country's economic growth held up "better than expected despite trade and geopolitical uncertainties," but will moderate over the next few quarters.
paras.zh: 世界银行周二在一份报告中表示，预计印度截至 2027 年 3 月的财年经济增速将放缓至 7.1%，而上一年为 7.8%。报告称，尽管贸易和地缘政治存在不确定性，但该国经济增长“好于预期”，但未来几个季度将放缓。

paras.en: During the June quarter, India reported a better-than-expected economic expansion of 7.8%, even as growth cooled for many major economies such as the U.S., China and Japan due to adverse trade conditions, geopolitical uncertainties and high energy prices.
paras.zh: 尽管美国、中国和日本等许多主要经济体因贸易条件不利、地缘政治不确定性和能源价格高企而导致经济增长放缓，但印度第二季度经济增速仍好于预期，达 7.8%。

paras.en: Last month, the U.S. Fed raised interest rates for the first time in more than three years and indicated another hike could follow, while the Bank of Japan raised interest rates to a 31-year high as global energy prices push inflation higher. The South Korean and European central banks have also raised interest rates in the last two months.
paras.zh: 上个月，美联储三年多来首次加息，并表示可能会再次加息，而随着全球能源价格推高通胀，日本央行将利率提高至 31 年来的高点。韩国和欧洲央行在过去两个月也加息。

paras.en: Yields on the benchmark 10-year government bond were up 5 basis point to 7.243%, while the Nifty 50 stock index was down 0.7% after the decision.
paras.zh: 决定后，基准 10 年期政府债券收益率上升 5 个基点至 7.243%，而 Nifty 50 股指下跌 0.7%。

articles.title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now

paras.en: SINGAPORE — An unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade poses the biggest risk to markets, according to Singapore's state-owned investment giant Temasek.
paras.zh: 新加坡——新加坡国有投资巨头淡马锡表示，人工智能贸易的放松给市场带来了最大的风险。

paras.en: "We don't see that as imminent, but will you have bumps in 2027? Yeah, possibly yes," Rohit Sipahimalani, Temasek's chief investment officer, said at the Milken Institute Asia Summit in Singapore.
paras.zh: 淡马锡首席投资官罗希特·西帕希马拉尼 (Rohit Sipahimalani) 在新加坡举行的米尔肯研究所亚洲峰会上表示：“我们认为这不会迫在眉睫，但 2027 年会遇到坎坷吗？是的，可能是的。”

paras.en: AI has been one of the key forces keeping U.S. stocks near record highs even as Treasury yields have surged, Sipahimalani said, pointing to the earnings strength of major companies tied to the technology.
paras.zh: 西帕希马拉尼表示，尽管美国国债收益率飙升，人工智能仍然是让美国股市保持在历史高位附近的关键力量之一，并指出与该技术相关的大公司的盈利实力。

paras.en: The S&P 500 has remained around record territory despite the rise in borrowing costs, supported by "AI and the earnings momentum around the key players," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，尽管借贷成本上升，但在“人工智能和主要参与者的盈利势头”的支持下，标准普尔 500 指数仍保持在创纪录水平附近。

paras.en: But the strength at the index level masks weakness beneath the surface. Sipahimalani noted that roughly half the stocks in the Russell 3000 were at least 20% below their June highs, highlighting the degree to which the market's resilience has depended on a small group of winners.
paras.zh: 但指数层面的强势掩盖了表面之下的疲软。 Sipahimalani 指出，罗素 3000 指数中大约一半的股票比 6 月份高点至少低 20%，这突显了市场的弹性在多大程度上依赖于一小群赢家。

paras.en: A reversal in the AI trade could be triggered by several factors, he said, including safety concerns that lead to tighter regulation or signs that customers are failing to generate sufficient returns from their spending on the technology.
paras.zh: 他表示，人工智能贸易的逆转可能是由多种因素引发的，包括导致监管收紧的安全担忧，或者有迹象表明客户无法从技术支出中获得足够的回报。

paras.en: Temasek, however, remains bullish on AI over the longer term and has continued to increase investments into the sector. About half of the investment firm's AI exposure is currently in publicly traded assets, a proportion it would ideally increase to around 70% to 75%, Sipahimalani said.
paras.zh: 然而，淡马锡仍看好人工智能的长期发展，并继续增加对该行业的投资。 Sipahimalani 表示，该投资公司目前约有一半的人工智能投资属于公开交易资产，理想情况下该比例将增加到 70% 至 75% 左右。

paras.en: That would give Temasek greater ability to adjust its investments as the industry evolves, compared with private assets that can be harder to exit quickly.
paras.zh: 与难以快速退出的私人资产相比，这将使淡马锡更有能力随着行业的发展调整其投资。

paras.en: "One of the things we recognize is that AI is such a fast-changing environment that things could change quite easily, and you have to be able to pivot," he said.
paras.zh: “我们认识到的一件事是，人工智能是一个快速变化的环境，事情很容易发生变化，而且你必须能够进行调整，”他说。

paras.en: Temasek has invested in private AI model developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic, but "the size of exposure there would be different compared to some of the other areas where we have more flexibility" Sipahimalani said.
paras.zh: 淡马锡已经投资了 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等私人人工智能模型开发商，但“与我们拥有更大灵活性的其他一些领域相比，这些领域的投资规模会有所不同”，Sipahimalani 表示。

articles.title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery

paras.en: Oil rose Wednesday as attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi Arabia raised concerns over crude flows from the Middle East even as supplies have been recovering.
paras.zh: 油价周三上涨，因为也门伊朗支持的胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击引发了人们对来自中东的原油流动的担忧，尽管供应一直在恢复。

paras.en: Futures for international benchmark Brent crude for December delivery gained 0.93% at $101.52 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures for November advanced 0.81% at $90.16 per barrel.
paras.zh: 12 月交割的国际基准布伦特原油期货上涨 0.93%，至每桶 101.52 美元。 11 月份美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 0.81%，至每桶 90.16 美元。

paras.en: Oil pumped through the East-West Pipeline had reached 5.8 million barrels as of Tuesday morning, according to Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman.
paras.zh: 据沙特能源大臣阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·萨勒曼亲王称，截至周二上午，通过东西管道输送的石油已达到 580 万桶。

paras.en: However, concerns that there may be further supply disruptions in the Middle East weighed on sentiment. The Saudi aviation authority reportedly said Tuesday that the country's airports in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks, amid growing hostilities between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis and the kingdom.
paras.zh: 然而，对中东可能出现进一步供应中断的担忧打压了市场情绪。据报道，沙特航空管理局周二表示，在也门伊朗支持的胡塞武装与沙特之间的敌对行动日益加剧之际，该国吉赞和纳季兰机场成为两起袭击目标。

paras.en: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders, as it threatens to disrupt the fragile rebound in oil exports through the crucial waterway.
paras.zh: 伊朗加大对途经霍尔木兹海峡油轮的攻击力度，也引发了贸易商对石油供应的新担忧，因为这可能会破坏这条重要水道石油出口的脆弱反弹。

paras.en: Naeem Aslam, chief investment officer of Zaye Capital Markets, said Tuesday that oil remains "caught between improving physical supply and persistent geopolitical risk."
paras.zh: Zaye Capital Markets 首席投资官纳伊姆·阿斯拉姆 (Naeem Aslam) 周二表示，石油仍然“陷入实物供应改善和持续地缘政治风险之间”。

paras.en: "The sustained ability of the Houthis in Yemen to target oil facilities hundreds of kilometers from the border keeps the risks of a renewed large-scale crude supply disruption present and high, and these risks could worsen if the Houthis feel the need to apply more pressure as a result of losing more territory," said Samer Hasn, senior market analyst at forex trading platform XS.com.
paras.zh: 外汇交易平台 XS.com 高级市场分析师 Samer Hasn 表示：“也门胡塞武装持续以距边境数百公里外的石油设施为目标，这使得原油供应再次出现大规模中断的风险仍然很高，如果胡塞武装认为需要因失去更多领土而施加更大压力，这些风险可能会进一步恶化。”

articles.title: Should you be ‘poop maxxing,’ or ‘fiber maxxing’? Experts explain what’s healthy

paras.en: The eyes may be the “window to the soul,” but the gut is the window to our health. Our stools contain a wealth of information—about our nutrient balance, our metabolism and even warning signs of disease.
paras.zh: 眼睛可能是“灵魂的窗户”，但肠道才是我们健康的窗户。我们的粪便含有丰富的信息——关于我们的营养平衡、新陈代谢，甚至疾病的警告信号。

paras.en: Gut fanatics on social media have jumped in on the promise of poo. Known as “poop maxxing,” or more politely, “fiber maxxing,” there is a swell of enthusiasm for high-fiber foods, regular bowel movements and the quest for a healthy gut.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的肠道狂热分子纷纷加入到粪便的承诺中。人们对高纤维食物、规律排便和对健康肠道的追求越来越热衷，这被称为“大便最大化”，或者更礼貌地称为“纤维最大化”。

paras.en: Put bluntly, unless you have specific symptoms (more on these in a moment), there is no reason to obsess over your excrement. But there is some truth to these trends, microbiome experts say.
paras.zh: 坦率地说，除非您有特定的症状（稍后会详细介绍），否则没有理由沉迷于您的排泄物。但微生物组专家表示，这些趋势有一定道理。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “I think that poop maxxing and fiber maxxing are some of the more legitimate health trends that I’ve heard about,” says Bill Sullivan, a microbiologist at Indiana University.
paras.zh: 印第安纳大学微生物学家比尔·沙利文 (Bill Sullivan) 表示：“我认为，大便最大化和纤维最大化是我听说过的一些更合理的健康趋势。”

paras.en: The reason why has to do with the power of fiber, he says. A person’s recommended daily fiber intake depends on age and sex, but the U.S. Department of Agriculture has historically recommended ranges from 22 to 34 grams for adults.
paras.zh: 他说，原因与纤维的力量有关。一个人的建议每日纤维摄入量取决于年龄和性别，但美国农业部历来建议成人摄入量为 22 至 34 克。

paras.en: “There is sound evidence that if you increase the amount of fiber up to the recommended levels—you don’t need to go beyond that—you are going to gain a lot of physical and mental health benefits, no question,” Sullivan says.
paras.zh: 沙利文说：“有充分的证据表明，如果将纤维含量增加到推荐水平（无需超出该水平），毫无疑问，您将获得许多身心健康益处。”

paras.en: Here’s everything you need to know to help maximize your gut health.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的一切，以帮助您最大限度地保持肠道健康。

paras.en: What does poop have to do with my health?
paras.zh: 大便与我的健康有什么关系？

paras.en: The gut is “the biggest endocrine organ you have in your body,” says Justin O’Sullivan, a professor of genomics at the University of Auckland in New Zealand. The gut also contains at least 100 million neurons—earning it the nickname “second brain” for its likely role in influencing our mood. “Sometimes we just don’t realize how core to us it is in many ways,” O’Sullivan says.
paras.zh: 新西兰奥克兰大学基因组学教授贾斯汀·奥沙利文说，肠道是“体内最大的内分泌器官”。肠道还含有至少 1 亿个神经元，因其可能在影响我们的情绪方面发挥着重要作用，因此被称为“第二大脑”。 “有时我们只是没有意识到它在很多方面对我们来说有多核心，”奥沙利文说。

paras.en: Our gut is “loaded” with trillions of bacteria, fungi and viruses that together support and influence our physical—and mental—well-being, Sullivan says. Bacteria produce vitamins and short-chain fatty acids that serve as “a potent anti-inflammatory,” as well as the hormone serotonin, which helps regulate appetite, he adds.
paras.zh: 沙利文说，我们的肠道“装载”着数万亿细菌、真菌和病毒，它们共同支持和影响我们的身心健康。他补充说，细菌产生维生素和短链脂肪酸，可作为“有效的抗炎剂”，以及血清素激素，有助于调节食欲。

paras.en: Bacteria are also responsible for the mucus barrier along your gastrointestinal tract that prevents toxins from leeching into the bloodstream, Sullivan says.
paras.zh: 沙利文说，细菌还负责胃肠道粘液屏障，防止毒素渗入血液。

paras.en: Research even suggests gut health may shape aging, Sullivan says. Long-lived healthy adults tend to have microbiomes that are richer in bacterial diversity than those of their chronological peers, with the former having gut bacteria that look more like those of younger, healthier adults. The reason why is a mystery—scientists are still working to untangle whether a healthy gut drives longevity or is a by-product of it.
paras.zh: 沙利文说，研究甚至表明肠道健康可能会影响衰老。长寿的健康成年人往往比同龄人拥有更丰富的细菌多样性，前者的肠道细菌看起来更像更年轻、更健康的成年人。其原因仍然是个谜——科学家们仍在努力弄清楚健康的肠道是否能促进长寿，还是它的副产品。

paras.en: One way to find out how the gut shapes health is to conduct clinical trials involving fecal transplants. In one study involving teens with obesity, for instance, O’Sullivan and his colleagues found that participants who ingested fecal transplant capsules loaded with healthy gut bacteria had better metabolic health years later than those who didn’t. O’Sullivan is also researching how the microbiome may support gut function in people with autism and aid in the treatment of anorexia nervosa.
paras.zh: 了解肠道如何影响健康的一种方法是进行粪便移植的临床试验。例如，在一项涉及肥胖青少年的研究中，奥沙利文和他的同事发现，摄入含有健康肠道细菌的粪便移植胶囊的参与者在数年后比那些没有摄入的参与者具有更好的代谢健康状况。奥沙利文还在研究微生物组如何支持自闭症患者的肠道功能并帮助治疗神经性厌食症。

paras.en: It’s not totally clear how your microbiome influences your overall health, Sullivan says. A combination of genetics and environment shape this relationship. But, he adds, “if you’re eating a healthy diet of real foods that are rich in fiber, if you’re getting sufficient exercise [and] a good night’s sleep and engaging in stress reduction to the best of your ability, you’re doing the very things that are going to cultivate a healthy microbiome.”
paras.zh: 沙利文说，目前尚不完全清楚您的微生物组如何影响您的整体健康。遗传和环境的结合塑造了这种关系。但是，他补充道，“如果你吃的是富含纤维的健康饮食，如果你进行了足够的锻炼和良好的睡眠，并尽你所能地减轻压力，那么你所做的事情正是能够培养健康的微生物组的。”

paras.en: The Bristol stool chart—a tool doctors use to assess your poop’s consistency—can also offer a guide to indicate “whether you’re on track with things,” Sullivan says, but there’s no reason to fixate on your feces during each trip to the bathroom.
paras.zh: 沙利文说，布里斯托尔大便图表（医生用来评估便便稠度的工具）也可以提供指导，表明“你是否在正常情况下”，但没有理由在每次去洗手间时都关注你的粪便。

paras.en: In general, poop that comes out consistently “really hard and cracked” or like “little, tiny balls,” is not ideal, O’Sullivan says, because it may indicate constipation. The same is true on the opposite end of the spectrum—you don’t want stools that are like liquid. Somewhere in the middle, with a consistency he describes as “like peanut butter,” is best.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文说，一般来说，持续“非常硬且破裂”或像“小球”的大便并不理想，因为这可能表明便秘。相反的情况也是如此——你不想要像液体一样的粪便。处于中间的某个位置，他将其描述为“像花生酱”的稠度是最好的。

paras.en: It’s also worth noting that some variation in your stools’ color and texture is normal, but if you see blood in the toilet, “that is definitely worthy of seeking medical attention,” Sullivan says. Red blood may be a sign of hemorrhoids, diverticulosis (small pouches in the colon), and more, while black or tarry feces can be a sign of internal bleeding in the colon, small intestine or stomach—and is linked to cancer, ulcers and inflammation.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，大便的颜色和质地有些变化是正常的，但如果你在厕所里看到血，“这绝对值得就医，”沙利文说。红血可能是痔疮、憩室病（结肠中的小袋）等疾病的征兆，而黑色或柏油样粪便可能是结肠、小肠或胃内出血的征兆，并且与癌症、溃疡和炎症有关。

paras.en: What foods should I eat to get more fiber?
paras.zh: 我应该吃什么食物才能获得更多纤维？

paras.en: Whether or not you are fiber maxxing consciously, if you’re interested in boosting your gut heath, your best bet is to “eat the rainbow,” Sullivan says. “Eat a wide variety of different foods, as many as your taste buds will allow.”
paras.zh: 沙利文说，无论您是否有意识地进行纤维最大化，如果您有兴趣增强肠道健康，最好的选择就是“吃彩虹”。 “吃各种各样不同的食物，只要你的味蕾允许的话。”

paras.en: “The diversity feeds your microbiome,” O’Sullivan adds. Building gut diversity takes time, but “having fiber, having plant material, having nuts, seeds, protein—all of those things feed your biome.”
paras.zh: “多样性可以滋养你的微生物群，”奥沙利文补充道。建立肠道多样性需要时间，但“有纤维、有植物材料、有坚果、种子、蛋白质——所有这些东西都可以滋养你的生物群落。”

paras.en: Both soluble and insoluble fiber are important for gut health. Soluble fiber helps form that essential, slimy gut barrier and “mops up” cholesterol from the body, Sullivan says. Insoluble fiber keeps you regular, helps prevent hemorrhoids and feeds anti-inflammatory bacteria species in the gut.
paras.zh: 可溶性和不溶性纤维对肠道健康都很重要。沙利文说，可溶性纤维有助于形成重要的粘性肠道屏障，并“清除”体内的胆固醇。不溶性纤维可以让您保持规律，有助于预防痔疮并为肠道内的抗炎细菌提供营养。

paras.en: But both experts have a warning: be careful not to overload your body with too much fiber, because that can cause cramping and diarrhea. “I would recommend a slow and steady change,” Sullivan says.
paras.zh: 但两位专家都警告说：小心不要让身体摄入过多纤维，因为这会导致痉挛和腹泻。 “我建议缓慢而稳定地改变，”沙利文说。

articles.title: These Super Mario levels are mathematically unsolvable

paras.en: During my childhood, I spent a lot of time in the backseat of a car during school holidays as my parents drove my brother and me to visit relatives in France. That meant killing time for eight to 10 hours in the cramped car. So I was thrilled when I got my first Game Boy and the game Super Mario Land to go with it.
paras.zh: 在我的童年时期，学校放假期间，我花了很多时间在汽车后座上，因为我的父母开车送我和弟弟去法国探亲。这意味着要在狭窄的车里消磨八到十个小时的时间。因此，当我得到我的第一个 Game Boy 和与之配套的游戏《超级马里奥乐园》时，我感到非常兴奋。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: As the oldest Game Boy game in the Super Mario series, its main difficulty lay in the fact that you couldn’t save your progress and always had to start from the beginning after turning the game off. It took a lot of time and patience to work your way to the final level, defeat the boss and rescue Princess Daisy. I had plenty of that time on long car journeys, and I can say with some pride that Super Mario Land is one of the few games I’ve played through from beginning to end multiple times.
paras.zh: 作为《超级马里奥》系列中最古老的 Game Boy 游戏，它的主要困难在于你无法保存进度，并且总是在关闭游戏后从头开始。你需要花费大量的时间和耐心才能到达最终关卡，击败老板并营救黛西公主。我在长途汽车旅行中度过了很多时间，我可以自豪地说，《超级马里奥乐园》是我从头到尾多次玩过的少数游戏之一。

paras.en: But I must admit that on some days the game seemed unsolvable to me, which was definitely because of my lack of skill. So I was surprised when I recently stumbled across a mathematical research preprint from 2024 with the promising title “You Can’t Solve These Super Mario Bros. Levels: Undecidable Mario Games.” In it, five Massachusetts Institute of Technology researchers prove that many newer games in the Super Mario series are mathematically maximally complex and therefore contain unsolvable problems.
paras.zh: 但我必须承认，有时这个游戏对我来说似乎无法解决，这绝对是因为我缺乏技巧。因此，当我最近偶然发现 2024 年的数学研究预印本，其标题很有前途的“你无法解决这些超级马里奥兄弟关卡：不可判定的马里奥游戏”时，我感到很惊讶。其中，五名麻省理工学院的研究人员证明，《超级马里奥》系列中的许多新游戏在数学上极其复杂，因此包含无法解决的问题。

paras.en: A branch of theoretical computer science—some might even classify it as mathematics—deals with the complexity of problems. It involves assessing how computationally expensive it is to develop a solution and categorizing problems accordingly. This allows us to determine which tasks are potentially solvable by a computer—or indeed, by any computer at all.
paras.zh: 理论计算机科学的一个分支——有些人甚至可能将其归类为数学——处理问题的复杂性。它涉及评估开发解决方案的计算成本并相应地对问题进行分类。这使我们能够确定哪些任务可以由计算机解决，或者实际上可以由任何计算机解决。

paras.en: An example of a “simple” problem is whether two points in a network are connected. While finding a solution becomes more computationally expensive as the network grows, the number of computational steps will scale at most polynomially with the network size (that is, the network size raised to the power of a constant) and not exponentially (meaning a constant would be raised to the power of the network size). For such problems, experts have introduced the complexity class “P.”
paras.zh: “简单”问题的一个例子是网络中的两个点是否相连。虽然随着网络的增长，寻找解决方案的计算成本变得越来越高，但计算步骤的数量最多将随网络大小呈多项式缩放（即，网络大小提高到常数的幂），而不是指数级（意味着常数将提高到网络大小的幂）。针对此类问题，专家引入了复杂度等级“P”。

paras.en: But some tasks are significantly more difficult to solve. The effort required increases exponentially with the size of the problem; this is the case, for example, with finding the optimal route when given a series of parameters, as in the mathematical puzzle the traveling salesman problem. Even though such problems are complex, they can be checked for correctness relatively quickly. These types of problems therefore fall into a different problem class, which is called “NP.”
paras.zh: 但有些任务要解决起来要困难得多。所需的工作量随着问题的规模呈指数级增长；例如，在给定一系列参数时寻找最佳路线就是这种情况，就像数学难题中的旅行商问题一样。尽管此类问题很复杂，但可以相对较快地检查它们的正确性。因此，这些类型的问题属于不同的问题类别，称为“NP”。

paras.en: And then there are the problems that have no solution, such as, for example, the halting problem: back in 1937, mathematician Alan Turing proved that there can be no algorithm that can universally determine whether a computer program will halt or continue running indefinitely. Such problems are algorithmically unsolvable. A computational procedure with a finite number of steps is insufficient to solve them. And as the experts at M.I.T. demonstrated in 2024, some Super Mario games fall into this unsolvable class.
paras.zh: 还有一些无法解决的问题，例如停止问题：早在 1937 年，数学家艾伦·图灵就证明，没有一种算法可以普遍确定计算机程序是否会无限期地停止或继续运行。此类问题在算法上是无法解决的。具有有限步骤数的计算过程不足以解决这些问题。作为麻省理工学院的专家。 2024 年的情况表明，一些《超级马里奥》游戏就属于这一无法解决的类别。

paras.en: Counting Monsters and Playing Super Mario
paras.zh: 数怪物和玩超级马里奥

paras.en: To prove that a problem belongs to a particular problem class, experts use the principle of reduction. This involves reducing one problem to another. For example, if it can be shown that the solution to a question about a Super Mario game would solve the halting problem, then Super Mario is at least as complex as the halting problem itself.
paras.zh: 为了证明一个问题属于特定的问题类别，专家使用归约原理。这涉及将一个问题简化为另一个问题。例如，如果可以证明有关超级马里奥游戏的问题的解决方案可以解决停止问题，那么超级马里奥至少与停止问题本身一样复杂。

paras.en: And that’s exactly what the researchers did. They focused on the question of whether a level in a Super Mario game is solvable—meaning that it can, in principle, be solved by trying all finite sequences of inputs—and equated this with the halting problem.
paras.zh: 这正是研究人员所做的。他们重点关注超级马里奥游戏中的某个关卡是否可解的问题（这意味着原则上可以通过尝试所有有限的输入序列来解决该关卡）并将其等同于停止问题。

paras.en: The team used a simplified version of the halting problem for this purpose. As it turns out, this problem can be formulated even for very simple computer models, so-called counting machines. These are theoretical models of computers that can only execute a handful of instructions: increase a counter by one, decrease it by one, halt, and, if the counter is zero, jump to another instruction. Even a rudimentary machine with these capabilities leads to the halting problem.
paras.zh: 为此，团队使用了暂停问题的简化版本。事实证明，这个问题甚至可以用非常简单的计算机模型（即所谓的计数机）来表述。这些是只能执行少量指令的计算机的理论模型：将计数器加一，减一，停止，如果计数器为零，则跳转到另一条指令。即使是具有这些功能的基本机器也会导致停机问题。

paras.en: As the researchers demonstrated, a counting machine along these lines can be implemented in some games of the Super Mario series. This allows the question of whether the machine will eventually stop to be reframed as: Can the player reach the goal in this level?
paras.zh: 正如研究人员所证明的那样，类似的计数机可以在《超级马里奥》系列的某些游戏中实现。这使得机器最终是否会停止的问题被重新定义为：玩家能否在这个关卡中达到目标？

paras.en: The researchers encoded a counter value based on the number of enemy characters in the game. First, they theoretically modified the games under consideration so that they had no time limit and the total number of enemies was no longer restricted. The team broke down Mario’s possible path through a level into individual sections, each corresponding to a calculation instruction of the counting machine. For example, the counter is “incremented,” or increased, meaning an enemy spawns when Mario traverses a specific path. This corresponds to the increment function. Other paths, however, decrease the number of enemies (decrement), and still other areas can open a passage when there are no more enemies (jump-if-zero). If, at some point, the path to the goal opens for Mario in this way, the simulated computer model has entered a halt state.
paras.zh: 研究人员根据游戏中敌人角色的数量编码了一个计数器值。首先，他们从理论上修改了正在考虑的游戏，使其没有时间限制，也不再限制敌人的总数。该团队将马里奥通过关卡的可能路径分解为各个部分，每个部分都对应于计数机的计算指令。例如，计数器“递增”或增加，这意味着当马里奥穿过特定路径时会产生敌人。这对应于增量函数。然而，其他路径会减少敌人的数量（递减），并且当没有更多敌人时，还有其他区域可以打开通道（如果为零则跳转）。如果在某个时刻，马里奥以这种方式打开了通往目标的道路，那么模拟计算机模型就会进入停止状态。

paras.en: To find out if there’s always a way for Mario to reach the goal, one would have to determine whether the corresponding counting machine comes to a halt. Because the halting problem is generally undecidable, however, this also applies to the solvability of a Super Mario level.
paras.zh: 为了查明马里奥是否总有办法达到目标，我们必须确定相应的计数机是否停止运转。然而，由于停止问题通常是不可判定的，因此这也适用于超级马里奥关卡的可解决性。

paras.en: The team has explicitly applied this proof idea to several Super Mario games, including those in the New Super Mario Bros. series, whose first installment was released in 2006, and the Super Mario Maker games released around 10 years later, in all their variations. “We don’t know how to prove that a game is fun,” one of the authors, Erik Demaine, told New Scientist. “But we can prove that it’s hard and that maybe gives some insight into why it’s fun.” Because Super Mario is maximally complex, it could be one of the most fun games ever by this criterion.
paras.zh: 该团队已明确地将这一证明想法应用于多款《超级马里奥》游戏，包括 2006 年发布第一部的《新超级马里奥兄弟》系列游戏，以及大约 10 年后发布的《超级马里奥制造》游戏的所有变体。 “我们不知道如何证明游戏有趣，”作者之一埃里克·德梅因 (Erik Demaine) 告诉《新科学家》。 “但我们可以证明这很困难，这也许能让我们深入了解它为何有趣。”由于《超级马里奥》极其复杂，因此按照这个标准，它可能是有史以来最有趣的游戏之一。

paras.en: For me, that was definitely the case on long car journeys—even if the version of Super Mario that I played is not among the most complex games.
paras.zh: 对我来说，长途汽车旅行绝对是这样——即使我玩的《超级马里奥》版本不是最复杂的游戏之一。

paras.en: This article originally appeared in Spektrum der Wissenschaft and was reproduced with permission. It was translated from the original German version with the assistance of artificial intelligence and reviewed by our editors.
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于 Spektrum der Wissenschaft 并经许可转载。它是在人工智能的帮助下从德语原文翻译而来，并由我们的编辑审阅。

articles.title: OpenAI unleashes hundreds more math results upon a field already in shock

paras.en: The floodgates are open. Right on the heels of OpenAI’s new large language model producing the biggest math breakthrough in two decades, the company just released no less than 372 results from the same model. Each resolves or makes substantial progress on a major open question in mathematics or theoretical computer science, the company says.
paras.zh: 闸门已打开。就在 OpenAI 的新大型语言模型取得二十年来最大的数学突破之后，该公司刚刚发布了同一模型的不少于 372 个结果。该公司表示，每个人都解决了数学或理论计算机科学中的一个重大开放问题或取得了实质性进展。

paras.en: OpenAI revealed the results in a GitHub repository at 6 P.M. EDT. The deluge will take mathematicians months to parse through and understand—including to determine whether the proofs contain novel and important ideas or are mostly mash-ups of existing techniques. But many of the results have already been verified in Lean—a programming language that validates a proof’s logic—and are therefore all but certain to be correct.
paras.zh: OpenAI 于下午 6 点在 GitHub 存储库中公布了结果。美东时间。数学家需要花费数月的时间来解析和理解大量的证据，包括确定证明是否包含新颖且重要的想法，或者主要是现有技术的混搭。但许多结果已经在精益（一种验证证明逻辑的编程语言）中得到了验证，因此几乎肯定是正确的。

paras.en: Among the results claimed are a solution to the four-dimensional Kakeya conjecture, improvements on some of the world’s most important computer algorithms, and actual progress toward math’s scariest problem, the Riemann hypothesis.
paras.zh: 所声称的成果包括四维挂谷猜想的解决方案、世界上一些最重要的计算机算法的改进，以及数学最可怕的问题黎曼假设的实际进展。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A spokesperson for OpenAI told Scientific American that the new model—which the company has not released to the public—produced almost every one of the results in response to a single prompt handed to a single AI agent. This would be a striking difference from OpenAI’s earlier blockbuster solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, which was produced through the collective efforts of a 10,000-strong agentic swarm that cost millions of dollars in computing power. If true, it would mean that unprecedented mathematical power could soon be accessible to anyone. But OpenAI’s reputation, among mathematicians, for bold claims and little transparency is causing considerable skepticism.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的一位发言人告诉《科学美国人》，该公司尚未向公众发布的新模型几乎根据交给单个人工智能代理的单个提示生成了所有结果。这与 OpenAI 早期针对纳维-斯托克斯问题的重磅解决方案存在显着差异，该解决方案是通过 10,000 名强大代理群的集体努力产生的，耗费了数百万美元的计算能力。如果这是真的，这将意味着任何人都将很快获得前所未有的数学能力。但 OpenAI 在数学家中因其大胆的主张和缺乏透明度而享有盛誉，这引起了相当大的怀疑。

paras.en: “Until and unless they release the model and people can replicate their results, I think you should treat any claims about one-shotting problems with a single agent as unverified,” says Andrew Sutherland, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. “We should ask for receipts.” (The OpenAI spokesperson also told Scientific American that some results might have taken multiple attempts.)
paras.zh: 麻省理工学院数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰 (Andrew Sutherland) 表示：“除非他们发布模型并且人们可以复制他们的结果，否则我认为你应该将任何有关单一智能体的一次性问题的说法视为未经验证。” “我们应该索要收据。” （OpenAI 发言人还告诉《科学美国人》，有些结果可能需要多次尝试。）

paras.en: OpenAI’s handling of the Navier-Stokes solution’s release has proved so controversial that, on September 21, the company announced it was assembling an independent advisory group of mathematicians to provide recommendations on responsibly publishing AI-generated results. The recommendations that the group developed call for a company that releases such results to make public the model, exact prompt and compute time behind each one. In spite of the group’s recommendations, though, OpenAI is choosing only to reveal the average compute time for a problem, with some additional statistics—and no prompts.
paras.zh: 事实证明，OpenAI 对 Navier-Stokes 解决方案发布的处理方式颇具争议，以至于该公司于 9 月 21 日宣布，正在组建一个由数学家组成的独立咨询小组，就负责任地发布人工智能生成的结果提供建议。该小组制定的建议要求一家发布此类结果的公司公开模型、每个结果背后的确切提示和计算时间。尽管有该小组的建议，OpenAI 还是选择仅揭示问题的平均计算时间，并提供一些额外的统计数据，并且没有任何提示。

paras.en: The OpenAI spokesperson told Scientific American that the team is taking the advisory group’s guidelines seriously and doing its best to comply but added that the company is not bound by these recommendations.
paras.zh: OpenAI 发言人告诉《科学美国人》，该团队正在认真对待咨询小组的指导方针，并尽力遵守，但补充说该公司不受这些建议的约束。

paras.en: The recommendations are particularly critical of AI companies using “proprietary internal models” that aren’t broadly accessible to mathematicians. OpenAI told Scientific American that the company is working to release the model as quickly and responsibly as possible.
paras.zh: 这些建议对使用数学家无法广泛访问的“专有内部模型”的人工智能公司尤其批评。 OpenAI 告诉《科学美国人》，该公司正在努力尽快、负责任地发布该模型。

paras.en: As the Navier-Stokes dispute unfolded, comments from OpenAI personnel led some mathematicians to believe the company’s model had produced additional results but that it was hesitating to publicize them. This raises a vital question: Is it more harmful to unload heaps of unexplained proofs on the community or withhold them entirely?
paras.zh: 随着纳维-斯托克斯争端的展开，OpenAI 人员的评论让一些数学家相信该公司的模型已经产生了额外的结果，但它正在犹豫是否要公开这些结果。这就提出了一个至关重要的问题：将大量无法解释的证据抛在社区上或完全保留它们哪个更有害？

paras.en: “If we want to know the answers to these math questions, I see no reason why we should ask the company to keep them secret from us,” says Daniel Litt, a mathematician at the University of Toronto. “To me, it’s going to be a good thing for mathematics.”
paras.zh: 多伦多大学数学家丹尼尔·利特 (Daniel Litt) 表示：“如果我们想知道这些数学问题的答案，我认为我们没有理由要求公司对我们保密。” “对我来说，这对数学来说是一件好事。”

paras.en: On the other hand, the famed mathematician Terence Tao has vocally criticized OpenAI and other “frontier” AI labs for the “insane” pace of their AI-generated results.
paras.zh: 另一方面，著名数学家陶哲轩公开批评 OpenAI 和其他“前沿”人工智能实验室的人工智能生成结果的“疯狂”速度。

paras.en: Such results may even be coming too fast for the labs themselves—the OpenAI spokesperson told Scientific American that many of the company’s newly released results are not yet understood by its own mathematicians. Still, they don’t plan on slowing down. The company wants to put as powerful a tool as possible in mathematicians’ hands.
paras.zh: 对于实验室本身来说，这样的结果可能来得太快了——OpenAI 发言人告诉《科学美国人》，该公司新发布的许多结果尚未被其自己的数学家理解。尽管如此，他们并不打算放慢脚步。该公司希望为数学家提供尽可能强大的工具。

paras.en: Moreover, OpenAI maintains that it can’t slow down because these math problems are an indispensable test to show that their AI really is getting smarter.
paras.zh: 此外，OpenAI 坚称它不能放慢速度，因为这些数学问题是必不可少的测试，可以表明他们的 AI 确实变得越来越聪明。

paras.en: But for the practitioners who see mathematical truth as an end rather than a means, the consequences of this race are becoming harder and harder to predict.
paras.zh: 但对于那些将数学真理视为目的而不是手段的从业者来说，这场竞赛的后果变得越来越难以预测。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (10/6/26): This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（10/6/26）：这是一个突发新闻报道，将会更新。

articles.title: Are hypernovas real?
articles.author: Mara Johnson-Groh

paras.en: Chemical traces in some oddball stars hinted at the existence of hypernovas — a type of hyper-energetic supernova. But new mathematical models are questioning the hype on hypernovas.
paras.zh: 一些奇怪恒星中的化学痕迹暗示了超新星的存在——一种高能超新星。但新的数学模型正在质疑超新星的炒作。

paras.en: Models of how elements mix across generations of stars suggests the parentage of stars attributed to hypernova events might have been standard supernovas and other relatively common cataclysmic stellar events instead, researchers report in the September Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society.
paras.zh: 研究人员在《皇家天文学会月刊》上报告称，元素如何在各代恒星中混合的模型表明，超新星事件造成的恒星可能是标准超新星和其他相对常见的灾难性恒星事件。

paras.en: “The evidence for [hypernovas] is now very seriously challenged,” says astrophysicist Ralph Schönrich of University College London, who worked on the new study with astrophysicist Anmol Aggarwal, also of University College London.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院的天体物理学家拉尔夫·舍恩里奇（Ralph Schönrich）表示：“（超新星）的证据现在受到了非常严重的挑战。”他与同样来自伦敦大学学院的天体物理学家安莫尔·阿加瓦尔（Anmol Aggarwal）一起进行了这项新研究。

paras.en: Not everyone is fully convinced of the change in the stars’ proposed origins, including astronomer Anna Frebel of Massachusetts Institute of Technology, who thinks both supernovas and hypernovas remain plausible candidates as the stars’ parents. Frebel notes, however, that the findings are a good reminder for astronomers to be careful about claiming uniqueness.
paras.zh: 并不是所有人都完全相信恒星起源的变化，包括麻省理工学院的天文学家安娜·弗雷贝尔（Anna Frebel），她认为超新星和超新星仍然是恒星父母的合理候选者。然而，弗雷贝尔指出，这些发现很好地提醒天文学家在声称独特性时要小心。

paras.en: Astronomers look for clues to a star’s origins in the elements it contains. When an earlier star dies, it releases elements into space, sometimes in a supernova explosion. That material mixes with gas that may eventually form new stars. Different kinds of explosions leave different chemical patterns, so the relative amounts of elements in a star can help astronomers work out what happened before it formed.
paras.zh: 天文学家从恒星所含的元素中寻找恒星起源的线索。当较早的恒星死亡时，它会将元素释放到太空中，有时会发生超新星爆炸。这种物质与气体混合，最终可能形成新的恒星。不同类型的爆炸会留下不同的化学模式，因此恒星中元素的相对含量可以帮助天文学家弄清楚它形成之前发生的情况。

paras.en: But tracing a star’s origins this way depends on knowing how elements from an earlier explosion spread through space. Models have often treated a supernova’s expelled material as though it mixes evenly with the gas that forms new stars. The new research accounts for observations and computer models that have shown that these explosions can spread elements asymmetrically. For example, a clump of a supernova’s oxygen might go preferentially in one direction and nickel another. While the ejected elements get mixed with other dust and gases in interstellar space, the overabundance in some areas isn’t likely to average out, especially in the earliest generations of stars, which have fewer heavy elements, Schönrich says. As a result, two stars forming on opposite sides of a supernova site could have different compositions.
paras.zh: 但以这种方式追踪恒星的起源取决于了解早期爆炸中的元素如何在太空中传播。模型通常将超新星排出的物质视为与形成新恒星的气体均匀混合。新的研究解释了观察结果和计算机模型，这些模型表明这些爆炸可以不对称地扩散元素。例如，一团超新星的氧可能会优先流向一个方向，而镍则可能会优先流向另一个方向。舍恩里奇说，虽然喷射出的元素与星际空间中的其他尘埃和气体混合，但某些区域的过量元素不太可能达到平均水平，尤其是在最早几代恒星中，这些恒星的重元素较少。因此，在超新星地点相对两侧形成的两颗恒星可能具有不同的成分。

paras.en: This isn’t surprising for astrophysicist Adam Burrows of Princeton University, who studies supernovas and was not involved in the research. Burrows says that the idea of irregular mixing from these events is well known among supernova researchers but not well shared with astronomers who study the evolution of galaxies and generations of stars. “They’re taking seriously what we have seen for a long time,” Burrows says.
paras.zh: 对于普林斯顿大学的天体物理学家亚当·伯罗斯来说，这并不奇怪，他研究超新星，但没有参与这项研究。伯罗斯说，这些事件造成的不规则混合的想法在超新星研究人员中是众所周知的，但研究星系演化和恒星世代的天文学家却不太认同。 “他们正在认真对待我们长期以来所看到的情况，”伯罗斯说。

paras.en: Accounting for this uneven spread of materials, the researchers created a mathematical model to see if the element ratios produced from lopsided explosions could match the mix seen in some unusual stars in the Milky Way’s halo, the galaxy’s outer sphere of stars that contains a lot of old stars that are low in heavy elements. Previously, researchers thought the ratios of elements in these stars couldn’t have formed by regular events alone and proposed hypernovas as their source. But the researchers found their model matched the observed element ratios as well as or better than the hypernova model.
paras.zh: 考虑到材料的这种不均匀分布，研究人员创建了一个数学模型，看看不平衡爆炸产生的元素比例是否可以与银河系光环中一些不寻常恒星中看到的混合相匹配，银河系的恒星外层球体包含许多重元素含量较低的老恒星。此前，研究人员认为这些恒星中的元素比例不可能仅由常规事件形成，并提出超新星作为其来源。但研究人员发现他们的模型与观察到的元素比例的匹配程度与超新星模型一样好，甚至更好。

paras.en: “A good fit tells us that a particular enrichment scenario is possible, but it does not necessarily tell us that it is the only scenario,” Frebel says. While ordinary supernovas may explain these stars’ chemistry, she says, the new models don’t rule out hypernovas.
paras.zh: “良好的拟合告诉我们，特定的富集场景是可能的，但它并不一定告诉我们这是唯一的场景，”弗雷贝尔说。她说，虽然普通的超新星可以解释这些恒星的化学反应，但新模型并不排除超新星的存在。

paras.en: Regardless of where these oddball stars came from, astronomers agree the results show that more studies on supernovas and gas mixing are needed.
paras.zh: 无论这些奇怪的恒星来自哪里，天文学家都同意研究结果表明需要对超新星和气体混合进行更多研究。

articles.title: Young Yosemite toads survive winter, then emerge with a deadly fungus
articles.author: Erin Garcia de Jesús

paras.en: A toad’s winter refuge could be a biohazard.
paras.zh: 蟾蜍的冬季避难所可能是一个生物危害。

paras.en: Some young Yosemite toads emerge from their first winter underground infected with the deadly chytrid fungus Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis, or Bd, researchers report September 23 in Functional Ecology. Although the fungus typically spreads through water, the finding points to an unexpectedly risky period as toads wait out harsh winters in burrows beneath feet of snow.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 23 日在《功能生态学》杂志上报道，一些年轻的约塞米蒂蟾蜍在地下度过的第一个冬天就感染了致命的壶菌 Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis（Bd）。尽管真菌通常通过水传播，但这一发现表明，蟾蜍在雪脚下的洞穴中等待严冬的到来，这是一个意想不到的危险时期。

paras.en: Bd has hit amphibian populations hard. The fungus attacks amphibians’ skin, preventing electrolytes and fluids from entering the body, and often leads to heart failure. Infections, which can kill the frogs, are responsible for declines in at least 500 species and 90 possible extinctions, according to a 2019 estimate.
paras.zh: Bd 严重打击了两栖动物种群。这种真菌会攻击两栖动物的皮肤，阻止电解质和液体进入体内，并常常导致心力衰竭。根据 2019 年的估计，感染可以杀死青蛙，导致至少 500 种青蛙数量减少，并可能导致 90 种青蛙灭绝。

paras.en: The disease is one reason why Yosemite toads (Anaxyrus canorus) are listed as threatened under the U.S. Endangered Species Act. The toads live in California’s Sierra Nevada mountains, where the toads spend most of their time on dry land. Mature adults breed in shallow pools of water. But high-elevation living also means they spend roughly half the year underground during brumation, a hibernation-like state for reptiles and amphibians.
paras.zh: 这种疾病是优胜美地蟾蜍（Anaxyrus canorus）被《美国濒危物种法》列为受威胁物种的原因之一。这些蟾蜍生活在加利福尼亚州的内华达山脉，在那里，蟾蜍大部分时间都在干燥的土地上度过。成熟的成虫在浅水池中繁殖。但高海拔生活也意味着它们在冬眠期间大约有半年时间在地下度过，对于爬行动物和两栖动物来说，这是一种类似冬眠的状态。

paras.en: How a water-loving fungus sticks around even after toads spend a long, cold winter underground is a mystery, says David Daversa, an ecologist at UCLA. “It’s a waterborne pathogen; how does that happen?”
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的生态学家戴维·达维萨 (David Daversa) 表示，即使蟾蜍在地下度过了漫长而寒冷的冬天，喜水真菌如何仍然存在，仍然是一个谜。 “这是一种水传播的病原体；这是怎么发生的？”

paras.en: To find out, Daversa and colleagues trekked to Yosemite National Park. The team captured Yosemite toads of all ages — including the youngest toads both before they went into their burrows and after they emerged — and swabbed their skin to test for Bd.
paras.zh: 为了找到答案，达维萨和同事长途跋涉来到优胜美地国家公园。研究小组捕获了各个年龄段的优胜美地蟾蜍，包括在​​进入洞穴之前和出来之后最年轻的蟾蜍，并擦拭它们的皮肤以测试 Bd。

paras.en: Surprisingly, the fungus was more prevalent in juvenile toads after their first winter than in adults breeding in the water. An average of roughly 23 percent of juveniles tested positive for Bd before their first brumation. In the spring, more than 90 percent of those young toads emerged from their burrows with sometimes severe infections. Less than half of breeding adults tested positive.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，在第一个冬天之后，这种真菌在幼年蟾蜍中比在水中繁殖的成年蟾蜍中更普遍。平均大约 23% 的青少年在第一次爆发前 Bd 检测呈阳性。春天，超过 90% 的幼蟾蜍从洞穴中出来，有时会出现严重感染。不到一半的繁殖成虫检测呈阳性。

paras.en: Daversa says it’s unclear why the fungus thrives underground. It’s possible that young toads burrow with undetectable infections that grow over time, or that the fungus spreads when many toads burrow together.
paras.zh: 达维萨说，目前还不清楚为什么这种真菌在地下繁衍生息。年轻的蟾蜍挖洞时可能会携带无法检测到的感染，这些感染会随着时间的推移而增长，或者当许多蟾蜍一起挖洞时真菌就会传播。

paras.en: Also unknown is whether other brumating amphibians face similar risks during the winter. Still, the findings have already had some practical implications. A reintroduction program with the San Francisco Zoo and U.S. National Park Service that aims to boost Yosemite toad populations now focuses on releasing mature toads that are past those first Bd-vulnerable years.
paras.zh: 同样未知的是其他易怒的两栖动物在冬季是否面临类似的风险。尽管如此，研究结果已经产生了一些实际意义。旧金山动物园和美国国家公园管理局共同开展了一项放归计划，旨在增加优胜美地蟾蜍的数量，目前重点是释放已经过了 Bd 易感期的成熟蟾蜍。

paras.en: By thinking beyond the water, Daversa says, perhaps conservationists “could nip chytrid in the bud in these early life stages when it seems to proliferate most.”
paras.zh: 达维萨说，通过超越水的思维，也许自然资源保护主义者“可以在壶菌似乎繁殖最快的生命早期阶段将其消灭在萌芽状态。”

articles.title: An extinct crocodilian was found among rocks that built the Great Sphinx
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: The Great Sphinx of Giza isn’t the only ancient, stony visage in the area missing its nose.
paras.zh: 吉萨大狮身人面像并不是该地区唯一一座没有鼻子的古老石像。

paras.en: A fossil crocodilian discovered in the same 45-million-year-old limestone that ancient Egyptians used to build the Sphinx is also missing the tip of its snout. But the broken specimen is intact enough to be reclassified as a new branch of the gavial family tree, which may help uncover these mysterious animals’ evolutionary history, researchers report October 7 in Royal Society Open Science.
paras.zh: 在古埃及人用来建造狮身人面像的同一块 4500 万年前的石灰岩中发现的鳄鱼化石也缺失了鼻子。但研究人员 10 月 7 日在英国皇家学会开放科学杂志上报告称，破碎的标本足够完整，可以被重新分类为鳄类家族树的一个新分支，这可能有助于揭示这些神秘动物的进化历史。

paras.en: Most living crocodilians are in either the crocodile or alligator families. But there are also two species of gavial living in tropical Asia. These are huge, critically endangered, fish-eating crocodilians with long, slender snouts full of needlelike teeth. Fossils of extinct gavials have been found around the world. In 1927, German researchers reported a gavial skull fossil collected from hills near Cairo. The fossil was identified as an extinct species of Tomistoma, a genus found today only as a single species in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 大多数现存的鳄鱼属于鳄鱼科或短吻鳄科。但也有两种鳄鱼生活在热带亚洲。这些是巨大的、极度濒危的、以鱼为食的鳄鱼，它们的鼻子又长又细，长满了针状的牙齿。世界各地都发现了已灭绝的鳄鱼化石。 1927年，德国研究人员报道了从开罗附近的山上采集到的鳄类头骨化石。该化石被鉴定为已灭绝的 Tomistoma 物种，该属如今仅在东南亚作为单一物种发现。

paras.en: But more recent evolutionary studies including this fossil suggested this classification didn’t fit. In 2023, while working on a doctoral degree at University College London, paleontologist Paul Burke went to Germany to study the fossil in detail. Burke and his colleagues made careful measurements of the skull, using 3-D X-ray methods to measure the insides of the brain and nasal cavities.
paras.zh: 但最近的进化研究（包括这块化石）表明这种分类并不合适。 2023年，古生物学家保罗·伯克在伦敦大学学院攻读博士学位期间，前往德国详细研究这块化石。伯克和他的同事对头骨进行了仔细的测量，使用 3D X 射线方法测量大脑和鼻腔的内部。

paras.en: “As we’ve advanced in the last 100 years, we’ve got so many new methodologies we could implement to figure out what kind of species this fossil is,” says Burke, currently at the Sweden Museum of Natural History in Stockholm.
paras.zh: “随着我们在过去 100 年中取得的进步，我们已经有了很多新的方法可以用来弄清楚这块化石是什么物种，”目前在斯德哥尔摩瑞典自然历史博物馆工作的伯克说。

paras.en: The team compared the measurements to those taken of living and fossil gavials and found that this purported Egyptian Tomistoma was actually an undescribed gavial genus. The researchers named it Herugavialis cairensis, referencing the Egyptian god Heru (or Horus), who has been associated with the Great Sphinx. Coincidentally, the Herugavialis skull is missing the end of its snout — something it shares with the noseless statue.
paras.zh: 研究小组将测量结果与现存的和化石的鳄鱼进行了比较，发现这种所谓的埃及托米斯托马实际上是一种未被描述的鳄鱼属。研究人员将其命名为 Herugavialis cairensis，参考与大狮身人面像有关的埃及神赫鲁（或荷鲁斯）。巧合的是，赫鲁维亚利斯头骨缺少鼻子末端——这是它与无鼻子雕像共有的部分。

paras.en: “So many species are found from the same [geologic] formation,” Burke says, including fish, sharks and mammals. “But this is the first one with the name associated with the Sphinx.”
paras.zh: “在同一[地质]构造中发现了如此多的物种，”伯克说，包括鱼类、鲨鱼和哺乳动物。 “但这是第一个与狮身人面像相关的名字。”

paras.en: Today, gavials are only found in freshwater environments. But tens of millions of years ago, the reptiles also inhabited nearshore saltwater environments. Herugavialis appears to have been a coastal predator back when the ancient Tethys Ocean covered northern Egypt.
paras.zh: 如今，鳄鱼只生活在淡水环境中。但数千万年前，爬行动物也栖息在近岸咸水环境中。当古特提斯洋覆盖埃及北部时，Herugavialis 似乎是一种沿海掠食者。

paras.en: Khalafallah Salih, a paleontologist at Al Neelain University in Khartoum, Sudan, says the finding supports the idea that the evolution of gavials and their relatives in Africa was much more complex than researchers thought. Herugavialis doesn’t appear closely related to other known gavial-type crocodilians in Africa or the Mediterranean, he says. It appears to have branched off from the lineage early in its evolution.
paras.zh: 苏丹喀土穆阿尔尼兰大学的古生物学家 Khalafallah Salih 表示，这一发现支持了这样一种观点，即非洲的长吻鳄及其近亲的进化比研究人员想象的要复杂得多。他说，Herugavialis 似乎与非洲或地中海其他已知的鳄类鳄鱼没有密切关系。它似乎在进化的早期就从该谱系中分支出来。

paras.en: Burke notes that gavials barely breach the public consciousness compared to alligators and crocodiles.
paras.zh: 伯克指出，与短吻鳄和鳄鱼相比，长吻鳄几乎没有打破公众的意识。

paras.en: “They’re still alive today and they’re endangered,” he says. “So, we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: “它们今天仍然活着，而且濒临灭绝，”他说。 “所以，我们应该了解它们以及它们悠久的历史。”

articles.title: Scientists Find Major Flaws in The Research Behind Collagen Supplements
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Seeing fine lines or wrinkles in the mirror is a stark reminder that your body is growing older, even if you still feel young on the inside.
paras.zh: 在镜子中看到细纹或皱纹是一个鲜明的提醒，表明您的身体正在变老，即使您内心仍然感觉年轻。

paras.en: A loss of collagen contributes to some of the first outward signs of aging, and it usually begins in a person's 20s.
paras.zh: 胶原蛋白的流失会导致一些最初的外在衰老迹象，通常在人 20 多岁时就开始出现。

paras.en: But guzzling collagen peptides in powders and drinks may do little to reverse that trend – despite what companies, celebrities, and influencers might claim.
paras.zh: 但在粉末和饮料中大量摄入胶原蛋白肽可能对扭转这一趋势无济于事——尽管公司、名人和影响者可能会声称这一点。

paras.en: A fresh appraisal of the evidence suggests that the popularity of collagen supplements is outpacing the rigor of the underlying science.
paras.zh: 对证据的最新评估表明，胶原蛋白补充剂的受欢迎程度超过了基础科学的严谨性。

paras.en: The article is published in the Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology, authored by biostatistician David Robert Grimes from Trinity College Dublin in Ireland and UK-based dermatologist Anjali Mahto.
paras.zh: 这篇文章发表在《美容皮肤病学杂志》上，作者是爱尔兰都柏林三一学院的生物统计学家 David Robert Grimes 和英国皮肤科医生 Anjali Mahto。

paras.en: It explains why the research on collagen supplements for skin aging is full of cracks.
paras.zh: 这就解释了为什么补充胶原蛋白对抗皮肤老化的研究充满裂痕。

paras.en: When Grimes and Mahto reviewed two meta-analyses published in 2021 and 2023, they found errors, including confused statistical measures.
paras.zh: 当 Grimes 和 Mahto 审查 2021 年和 2023 年发表的两项荟萃分析时，他们发现了错误，包括混乱的统计指标。

paras.en: One meta-analysis even reported a nonsignificant finding as significant.
paras.zh: 一项荟萃分析甚至将一项不显着的发现报告为显着的。

paras.en: When Grimes and Mahto corrected this data, they found no significant relationship between collagen dose and improvements in hydration or elasticity.
paras.zh: 当格莱姆斯和马赫托纠正这一数据时，他们发现胶原蛋白剂量与水合或弹性改善之间没有显着关系。

paras.en: "Despite the growing popularity of hydrolyzed collagen supplements as an intervention for skin aging, the current clinical evidence base remains methodologically fragile, inconsistent, and prone to bias," conclude Grimes and Mahto.
paras.zh: Grimes 和 Mahto 总结道：“尽管水解胶原蛋白补充剂作为皮肤衰老干预措施越来越受欢迎，但目前的临床证据基础在方法上仍然脆弱、不一致，而且容易出现偏见。”

paras.en: "Collagen may yet have a role in dermatology," they argue, "but at present, its promotion as a validated anti-aging intervention is premature and not scientifically defensible."
paras.zh: 他们认为：“胶原蛋白可能在皮肤病学中发挥作用，但目前将其作为一种经过验证的抗衰老干预措施进行推广还为时过早，而且在科学上也站不住脚。”

paras.en: Today, it seems that boosting skin collagen is the promise of practically every anti-aging skin product on the market, and recently, oral forms of collagen have become bestsellers as ways to maintain skin health.
paras.zh: 如今，增加皮肤胶原蛋白似乎是市场上几乎所有抗衰老皮肤产品的承诺，最近，口服胶原蛋白作为保持皮肤健康的方法已成为畅销品。

paras.en: Young influencers online, like Kylie Jenner and Hailey Bieber, are increasingly sprinkling collagen into their 'get ready with me videos', and their viewers are paying attention.
paras.zh: 凯莉·詹纳 (Kylie Jenner) 和海莉·比伯 (Hailey Bieber) 等年轻的网络影响者越来越多地将胶原蛋白加入到他们的“跟我一起准备”视频中，而他们的观众也正在关注。

paras.en: Dermatologists like Mahto say they are increasingly faced with patients who are using or inquiring about collagen supplements for skin health.
paras.zh: 马赫托等皮肤科医生表示，他们越来越多地遇到使用或咨询胶原蛋白补充剂来保持皮肤健康的患者。

paras.en: But evidence that they work is scarce and contentious.
paras.zh: 但证明它们有效的证据很少，而且存在争议。

paras.en: A recent review found that collagen supplements are linked to some improvements in skin elasticity and hydration, and greater improvements were reported with longer use.
paras.zh: 最近的一项评论发现，胶原蛋白补充剂与皮肤弹性和水合作用的一些改善有关，并且据报告，使用时间越长，改善效果越大。

paras.en: "At face value, such results suggest that collagen nutraceuticals may indeed counteract some aspects of skin aging," write Grimes and Mahto.
paras.zh: “从表面上看，这样的结果表明胶原蛋白保健品确实可以抵消皮肤老化的某些方面，”格莱姆斯和马赫托写道。

paras.en: "However, there are substantial methodological concerns that temper these optimistic conclusions."
paras.zh: “然而，存在大量的方法论问题，影响了这些乐观的结论。”

paras.en: For instance, an overwhelming number of studies included in these meta-analyses were industry-funded or involved authors with commercial ties to collagen manufacturers.
paras.zh: 例如，这些荟萃分析中包含的绝大多数研究都是由行业资助或涉及与胶原蛋白制造商有商业关系的作者。

paras.en: What's more, many trials were small and varied widely in the populations they studied (young versus old), the daily collagen dose, and how long participants continued treatment.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，许多试验规模较小，并且在研究人群（年轻人与老年人）、每日胶原蛋白剂量以及参与者持续治疗的时间方面存在很大差异。

paras.en: That weakens the comparisons that can be drawn between these studies in major reviews.
paras.zh: 这削弱了主要评论中这些研究之间可以进行的比较。

paras.en: For instance, in one meta-analysis reviewed by Grimes and Mahto, collagen doses ranged from 0.3 to 10 grams per day. That's more than a 30-fold difference.
paras.zh: 例如，在 Grimes 和 Mahto 审查的一项荟萃​​分析中，胶原蛋白的剂量范围为每天 0.3 至 10 克。这相差超过30倍。

paras.en: Not to mention the fact that some past trials combined collagen supplements with other bioactive ingredients.
paras.zh: 更不用说过去的一些试验将胶原蛋白补充剂与其他生物活性成分结合起来。

paras.en: "The inclusion of other potentially active agents alongside collagen may themselves affect aspects like skin hydration, elasticity, or appearance either positively or negatively," explain Grimes and Mahto.
paras.zh: Grimes 和 Mahto 解释说：“除了胶原蛋白之外，其他潜在活性剂的加入本身也可能对皮肤水合作用、弹性或外观等方面产生积极或消极的影响。”

paras.en: "Previous meta-analyses and investigations have made little effort to account for this methodological limitation, rendering it even more difficult to attribute observed effects specifically to hydrolyzed collagen."
paras.zh: “之前的荟萃分析和调查几乎没有努力解释这种方法学的局限性，这使得将观察到的效应专门归因于水解胶原蛋白变得更加困难。”

paras.en: Hydrolyzed collagen is a version that is broken down into peptides. This makes it easier to dissolve and possibly digest, but how much of that material actually makes it back into the skin for an extra plumping effect?
paras.zh: 水解胶原蛋白是一种被分解成肽的形式。这使得它更容易溶解并可能被消化，但有多少物质实际上会回到皮肤中以获得额外的丰盈效果？

paras.en: Some animal studies suggest some does, but research in humans is lacking.
paras.zh: 一些动物研究表明确实如此，但缺乏对人类的研究。

paras.en: Randomized trials can hint at an underlying effect, but most of the ones conducted so far lasted only 8 to 12 weeks. There's also a chance that the placebo formulation used by some was not deceptive enough.
paras.zh: 随机试验可以暗示潜在的影响，但迄今为止进行的大多数试验仅持续 8 至 12 周。也有可能一些人使用的安慰剂配方没有足够的欺骗性。

paras.en: Collagen has a distinct taste and mouthfeel, and if participants could tell the difference, it would undermine the placebo control.
paras.zh: 胶原蛋白具有独特的味道和口感，如果参与者能够分辨出差异，就会破坏安慰剂对照。

paras.en: Given all of these complications, Grimes and Mahto argue that collagen supplements should not be integrated into routine care until more rigorous trials suggest otherwise.
paras.zh: 考虑到所有这些并发症，格莱姆斯和马赫托认为，在更严格的试验表明情况并非如此之前，不应将胶原蛋白补充剂纳入常规护理中。

paras.en: "Until such evidence emerges, oral collagen supplementation should not be promoted or recommended within dermatological practice," they conclude.
paras.zh: 他们总结道：“在出现此类证据之前，不应在皮肤病学实践中提倡或推荐口服胶原蛋白补充剂。”

paras.en: "National societies such as the British Association of Dermatologists (BAD), European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (EADV), and relevant regulatory bodies should consider issuing guidance advising clinicians against endorsing collagen supplements for skin aging in the absence of high-quality, independent evidence."
paras.zh: “英国皮肤科医师协会 (BAD)、欧洲皮肤病学和性病学会 (EADV) 等国家学会以及相关监管机构应考虑发布指南，建议临床医生在缺乏高质量独立证据的情况下，不要认可胶原蛋白补充剂来治疗皮肤老化。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《美容皮肤病学杂志》上。

articles.title: Common Antidepressants Could Have an Unexpected Role in Cancer Survival
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Things that once brought pleasure lose their appeal. Getting out of bed, talking to friends, or finishing everyday tasks becomes harder. For someone living with depression, treatment can offer a way back into daily life.
paras.zh: 曾经带来快乐的事物失去了吸引力。起床、与朋友交谈或完成日常任务变得更加困难。对于患有抑郁症的人来说，治疗可以提供一种恢复日常生活的方法。

paras.en: People undergoing cancer treatment can also experience depression or anxiety, taking medication for their mental health alongside drugs aimed at their tumors. Researchers are now investigating an unexpected connection between those treatments.
paras.zh: 接受癌症治疗的人也会经历抑郁或焦虑，除了服用针对肿瘤的药物外，还需要服用促进心理健康的药物。研究人员现在正在调查这些治疗之间的意想不到的联系。

paras.en: A new analysis found that patients taking common antidepressants had fewer deaths recorded over two years after beginning immunotherapy, a treatment that helps the immune system attack cancer.
paras.zh: 一项新的分析发现，服用普通抗抑郁药的患者在开始免疫疗法（一种帮助免疫系统攻击癌症的疗法）后两年内死亡人数较少。

paras.en: "The simplest way to put it is that SSRIs may release a second brake on immunity that sits right next to the one checkpoint inhibitors release," oncologist Cho-Hao Lee of Tri-Service General Hospital and National Defense Medical University in Taiwan told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 台湾三军总医院和国防医科大学的肿瘤学家 Cho-Hao Lee 告诉 ScienceAlert：“最简单的说法是，SSRIs 可能会在释放一种检查点抑制剂之后释放第二种免疫抑制。”

paras.en: SSRIs, short for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, block the reuptake of serotonin, a chemical messenger. The group includes fluoxetine, sertraline, and escitalopram.
paras.zh: SSRIs 是选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂的缩写，可阻止化学信使血清素的再摄取。该组包括氟西汀、舍曲林和艾司西酞普兰。

paras.en: To investigate their potential connection with cancer outcomes, researchers examined medical records of adults with depression or anxiety and solid tumors, excluding blood cancers.
paras.zh: 为了调查它们与癌症结果的潜在联系，研究人员检查了患有抑郁症或焦虑症的成年人以及实体瘤（不包括血癌）的病历。

paras.en: All were beginning treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors. These immunotherapy drugs block signals that can stop immune cells from attacking tumors.
paras.zh: 所有人都开始接受免疫检查点抑制剂治疗。这些免疫治疗药物阻断可以阻止免疫细胞攻击肿瘤的信号。

paras.en: Led by physician Po-Huang Chen of Tri-Service General Hospital and National Defense Medical University, the research identified eligible patients through the TriNetX electronic health record network who began immunotherapy between 2015 and 2025.
paras.zh: 该研究由三军总医院和国防医科大学的陈宝黄医生领导，通过TriNetX电子健康记录网络识别出2015年至2025年间开始免疫治疗的符合条件的患者。

paras.en: In the study, 1,567 SSRI users were matched with 1,567 people taking benzodiazepines, medications prescribed for problems including anxiety and insomnia. Matching covered 49 baseline characteristics, including demographics, tumor characteristics, other illnesses, medications, and laboratory results.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，1,567 名 SSRI 使用者与 1,567 名服用苯二氮卓类药物的人进行了匹配，苯二氮卓类药物是治疗焦虑和失眠等问题的药物。匹配涵盖 49 项基线特征，包括人口统计、肿瘤特征、其他疾病、药物和实验室结果。

paras.en: The aim was to compare patients who were as similar as possible. The main comparison therefore involved two psychiatric medication groups, rather than antidepressant users versus people taking no psychiatric medication.
paras.zh: 目的是比较尽可能相似的患者。因此，主要比较涉及两个精神科药物组，而不是抗抑郁药物使用者与未服用精神科药物的人。

paras.en: Within the two-year outcome window, 368 patients in the SSRI group died, compared with 539 in the benzodiazepine group: 23.5 percent versus 34.4 percent.
paras.zh: 在两年的结果窗口内，SSRI 组有 368 名患者死亡，而苯二氮卓类药物组有 539 名患者死亡：死亡人数分别为 23.5% 和 34.4%。

paras.en: An analysis accounting for when deaths occurred associated SSRI use with approximately a 37 percent lower hazard of death. That describes a lower relative rate of death during follow-up, rather than patients living 37 percent longer.
paras.zh: 一项针对死亡发生时间的分析表明，使用 SSRI 可使死亡风险降低约 37%。这描述的是随访期间相对死亡率较低，而不是患者寿命延长了 37%。

paras.en: All five SSRIs that could be examined individually were associated with lower mortality. Compared with matched patients taking neither medication class, SSRI users had approximately a 25 percent lower hazard of death.
paras.zh: 可以单独检查的所有五种 SSRI 都与较低的死亡率相关。与不服用任何药物类别的匹配患者相比，SSRI 使用者的死亡风险大约降低 25%。

paras.en: A possible explanation lies in serotonin's effects beyond the brain. Cancer-fighting T cells also respond to this chemical messenger.
paras.zh: 一个可能的解释是血清素的作用超出了大脑。抗癌 T 细胞也会对这种化学信使做出反应。

paras.en: A 2025 study published in Cell identified the serotonin transporter, the protein SSRIs block, as a brake on these immune cells in mice. Blocking it strengthened antitumor immunity.
paras.zh: 2025 年发表在《Cell》上的一项研究发现，血清素转运蛋白（SSRIs 阻断蛋白）可以抑制小鼠体内的这些免疫细胞。阻断它可以增强抗肿瘤免疫力。

paras.en: Combining an SSRI with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy, which releases another immune brake, improved tumor control. The new research investigates whether those laboratory findings might have a counterpart in patients.
paras.zh: 将 SSRI 与抗 PD-1 免疫疗法相结合，释放另一种免疫制动器，改善肿瘤控制。这项新研究调查了这些实验室结果是否可能在患者身上找到对应的结果。

paras.en: The team separately analyzed 8,272 tumor samples from The Cancer Genome Atlas. Across 13 of 20 cancer types, higher expression of the gene encoding the serotonin transporter correlated with lower scores for T-cell inflammation.
paras.zh: 该团队分别分析了癌症基因组图谱中的 8,272 个肿瘤样本。在 20 种癌症类型中的 13 种中，编码血清素转运蛋白的基因的较高表达与 T 细胞炎症的较低评分相关。

paras.en: However, these samples came from different patients than the cohort whose survival records the study assessed.
paras.zh: 然而，这些样本来自与研究评估的生存记录的队列不同的患者。

paras.en: The findings support the proposed mechanism without showing that antidepressants changed conditions inside human tumors. Whether antidepressant doses alter serotonin levels or T-cell behavior within patients' tumors remains unknown.
paras.zh: 研究结果支持了所提出的机制，但没有表明抗抑郁药改变了人类肿瘤内部的状况。抗抑郁药剂量是否会改变患者肿瘤内的血清素水平或 T 细胞行为仍不清楚。

paras.en: Medical records also revealed a difference in thyroid problems. Thyroid dysfunction was recorded in 31.6 percent of SSRI users, compared with 26.7 percent of benzodiazepine users. Hepatitis, pneumonitis, and colitis did not differ significantly.
paras.zh: 医疗记录还揭示了甲状腺问题的差异。 31.6% 的 SSRI 使用者出现甲状腺功能障碍，而苯二氮卓类药物使用者的这一比例为 26.7%。肝炎、肺炎和结肠炎没有显着差异。

paras.en: Diagnosis codes could not establish whether every thyroid event was immune-related, leaving another question for future research.
paras.zh: 诊断代码无法确定每个甲状腺事件是否都与免疫相关，这为未来的研究留下了另一个问题。

paras.en: One major limitation was missing information about patients' ability to carry out everyday activities, an important predictor of cancer survival.
paras.zh: 一个主要的限制是缺少有关患者进行日常活动的能力的信息，这是癌症生存的重要预测因素。

paras.en: Benzodiazepines can also be prescribed for acute anxiety or insomnia when cancer is worsening. Their users might therefore have been more seriously ill despite appearing similar in the recorded characteristics.
paras.zh: 当癌症恶化时，苯二氮卓类药物也可以用于治疗急性焦虑或失眠。因此，尽管记录的特征看起来相似，但他们的用户可能病得更严重。

paras.en: SSRI prescriptions could likewise reflect more comprehensive psychological and medical care rather than a direct effect on tumors. Lee acknowledges that these differences could explain a meaningful part of the association.
paras.zh: SSRI 处方同样可以反映更全面的心理和医疗护理，而不是对肿瘤的直接影响。李承认，这些差异可以解释该协会的一个有意义的部分。

paras.en: "Only a randomized trial can settle how much is cause and how much is confounding," he says.
paras.zh: “只有随机试验才能确定有多少是原因，有多少是混杂因素，”他说。

paras.en: Patients were not randomly assigned to either medication in this study, so the findings cannot establish that antidepressants extend life.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，患者没有被随机分配接受任何一种药物治疗，因此研究结果不能证明抗抑郁药可以延长寿命。

paras.en: Future trials would need to assess survival, cancer progression, and side effects, while tumor samples collected before and after treatment could reveal changes in immune activity.
paras.zh: 未来的试验需要评估生存率、癌症进展和副作用，而治疗前后收集的肿瘤样本可以揭示免疫活性的变化。

paras.en: Researchers would also need to establish which drug, dose, and treatment duration might help. Including patients without depression or anxiety could help separate psychiatric treatment effects from potential anticancer effects.
paras.zh: 研究人员还需要确定哪种药物、剂量和治疗持续时间可能有帮助。纳入没有抑郁或焦虑的患者可能有助于区分精神治疗效果和潜在的抗癌效果。

paras.en: For patients, Lee's message is clear: "This is not a reason to start an SSRI to 'boost' immunotherapy, or to stop a benzodiazepine on your own."
paras.zh: 对于患者来说，Lee 的信息很明确：“这不是开始使用 SSRI 来‘增强’免疫治疗或自行停止服用苯二氮卓类药物的理由。”

paras.en: The research has been published in PLOS Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在 PLOS Medicine 上。

articles.title: A Russian Lab Worker's Death Has Sparked Plague Fears. We Asked Experts What's Actually Going On.
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A broken test tube is an unsettling image: shattered glass, spilled liquid, a dangerous bacterium suddenly outside its container.
paras.zh: 破碎的试管是一幅令人不安的画面：破碎的玻璃、溢出的液体、危险的细菌突然出现在容器外。

paras.en: But in a laboratory designed to handle infectious organisms, that should not be where the protection ends.
paras.zh: 但在设计用于处理传染性生物体的实验室中，这不应该是保护的终点。

paras.en: The death of a worker at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute has prompted speculation about a laboratory accident involving the bacterium that causes plague. Some reports describe a broken test tube.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名工作人员的死亡引发了人们对涉及引起鼠疫的细菌的实验室事故的猜测。一些报告描述了破损的试管。

paras.en: Russian authorities described her illness as pneumonia of unknown cause and denied a connection to pathogens handled at work. On 6 October, they reported that no plague cases had been detected among her contacts, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局将她的病情描述为不明原因肺炎，并否认与工作中处理的病原体有关。据路透社报道，10 月 6 日，他们报告称，在她的接触者中没有发现鼠疫病例。

paras.en: Neither plague as the cause of death nor the alleged laboratory accident has been independently established in the publicly available evidence.
paras.zh: 在公开的证据中，鼠疫作为死亡原因和所谓的实验室事故都没有被独立证实。

paras.en: The concern reflects how quickly pneumonic plague can become life-threatening if untreated.
paras.zh: 这种担忧反映出，如果不及时治疗，肺鼠疫会很快危及生命。

paras.en: "It is such a rapid and fatal infection that can kill within 24 hours," Brendan Wren, a professor at the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, tells ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 伦敦卫生与热带医学院教授布伦丹·雷恩 (Brendan Wren) 告诉《ScienceAlert》：“这是一种快速且致命的感染，可在 24 小时内致人死亡。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization says early antibiotics can be effective. Wren cautions that treatment may come too late once the infection has taken hold. That describes the disease's potential severity, not a confirmed diagnosis in this worker.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，早期使用抗生素可能有效。雷恩警告说，一旦感染发生，治疗可能就太晚了。这描述了该疾病的潜在严重程度，而不是这名工人的确诊结果。

paras.en: For investigators, a reported breakage is simply the beginning of an inquiry.
paras.zh: 对于调查人员来说，报告的破损仅仅是调查的开始。

paras.en: "In a high containment lab, a tube breakage is an incident, not necessarily an exposure," Zania Stamataki, an associate professor of viral immunology and academic lead for Containment Level 3 laboratories at the University of Birmingham in the UK, tells ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 英国伯明翰大学病毒免疫学副教授兼三级遏制实验室学术负责人扎尼亚·斯塔马塔基 (Zania Stamataki) 告诉《ScienceAlert》：“在高密闭实验室中，管道破裂是一个事件，而不一定是一次暴露。”

paras.en: Open work with live pathogens takes place inside a biological safety cabinet. Air is drawn away from the operator and filtered. If a tube breaks inside a functioning cabinet, that barrier should prevent infectious aerosols from reaching the worker.
paras.zh: 活病原体的开放工作在生物安全柜内进行。空气被抽离操作员并被过滤。如果管道在功能柜内破裂，该屏障应防止传染性气溶胶接触到工人。

paras.en: Samples moving to other equipment travel inside sealed secondary containers. A broken tube should therefore leave its contents inside another protective enclosure.
paras.zh: 转移到其他设备的样品在密封的辅助容器内移动。因此，破损的管子应将其内容物留在另一个保护外壳内。

paras.en: The cabinet sits in a sealed room maintained at negative pressure. Training, written procedures and protective clothing provide additional layers.
paras.zh: 该柜位于保持负压的密封房间内。培训、书面程序和防护服提供了额外的保护层。

paras.en: "Think of it as nested boxes rather than a single barrier," Stamataki explains.
paras.zh: “将其视为嵌套的盒子而不是单个屏障，”斯塔马塔基解释道。

paras.en: "Laboratory-acquired infections are rare because several of these layers have to fail together."
paras.zh: “实验室获得性感染很少见，因为其中几个层必须同时失效。”

paras.en: These safeguards describe high-containment work generally, and aren't specific to the conditions at the Russian institute.
paras.zh: 这些保障措施概括地描述了高遏制工作，而不是针对俄罗斯研究所的具体情况。

paras.en: Investigators would need to determine where an incident occurred, what the container held, whether the material was infectious, and whether the event could have generated particles capable of being inhaled.
paras.zh: 调查人员需要确定事件发生的地点、容器中装有什么、材料是否具有传染性，以及事件是否会产生能够被吸入的颗粒。

paras.en: Cabinet and ventilation records, maintenance checks and compliance with written procedures would also matter.
paras.zh: 橱柜和通风记录、维护检查以及遵守书面程序也很重要。

paras.en: The most important evidence, however, would come from the patient.
paras.zh: 然而，最重要的证据来自患者。

paras.en: Stamataki says an organism isolated from the worker could be sequenced and compared with specific strains held at the laboratory.
paras.zh: 斯塔马塔基说，可以对从该工人身上分离出的微生物进行测序，并与实验室保存的特定菌株进行比较。

paras.en: "Without that genomic link you have a coincidence in time rather than a demonstrated causal chain," she says.
paras.zh: “如果没有基因组联系，你就会发现时间上的巧合，而不是经过证实的因果链，”她说。

paras.en: Such a match would need to be assessed alongside the circumstances of possible exposure. The institute also handles infectious agents other than plague.
paras.zh: 这样的匹配需要与可能暴露的情况一起进行评估。该研究所还处理鼠疫以外的传染源。

paras.en: There is a historical reason laboratory ventilation failures attract attention.
paras.zh: 实验室通风故障引起关注是有历史原因的。

paras.en: In 1979, an anthrax outbreak struck Sverdlovsk, now Yekaterinburg, in the Soviet Union. A 1994 investigation published in Science found victims concentrated along a narrow zone downwind of a military microbiology facility, supporting an airborne release of anthrax spores.
paras.zh: 1979年，苏联的斯维尔德洛夫斯克（现叶卡捷琳堡）爆发了炭疽病。 1994 年《科学》杂志发表的一项调查发现，受害者集中在军事微生物设施顺风的狭窄区域，这支持了炭疽孢子在空气中的释放。

paras.en: A 2016 mBio paper describes compromised safety air filters during maintenance, citing local sources. ScienceAlert previously covered the genetic investigation of that outbreak.
paras.zh: 2016 年 mBio 的一篇论文引用当地消息来源，描述了维护过程中安全空气过滤器受损的情况。 ScienceAlert 此前曾报道过那次疫情的基因调查。

paras.en: That involved a different pathogen, facility and historical setting. It illustrates the consequences of failed containment, but supplies no evidence about Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 这涉及不同的病原体、设施和历史背景。它说明了遏制失败的后果，但没有提供有关伊尔库茨克的证据。

paras.en: The monitoring of approximately 200 contacts presents another detail that can easily be misunderstood.
paras.zh: 对大约 200 名接触者的监控提供了另一个很容易被误解的细节。

paras.en: That figure reflects how a precautionary protocol is written.
paras.zh: 该数字反映了预防协议的编写方式。

paras.en: "It is triggered by suspicion and caution, and should not be interpreted as an estimate of how many people are infected," Stamataki says.
paras.zh: 斯塔马塔基说：“它是由怀疑和谨慎引发的，不应被解释为对有多少人被感染的估计。”

paras.en: Negative contact tests cannot establish the original patient's diagnosis. The absence of secondary cases could fit pneumonic plague isolated early and managed effectively, she explains. It could also fit an illness that was never plague.
paras.zh: 阴性接触测试无法确定原始患者的诊断。她解释说，没有继发病例可能适合早期隔离并有效管理的肺鼠疫。它也可能适合一种从来不是瘟疫的疾病。

paras.en: Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, a bacterium that remains a public health concern despite its long evolutionary history. Its pneumonic form affects the lungs and can spread through respiratory particles.
paras.zh: 鼠疫是由鼠疫耶尔森菌引起的，这种细菌尽管具有悠久的进化历史，但仍然是一个公共卫生问题。其肺炎形式影响肺部并可通过呼吸道颗粒传播。

paras.en: "Pneumonic plague is transmitted by the respiratory route but is not particularly transmissible and certainly not as transmissible as the respiratory SARS virus," Wren says.
paras.zh: 雷恩说：“肺鼠疫通过呼吸道传播，但传播性并不特别强，当然也不像呼吸道 SARS 病毒那么容易传播。”

paras.en: Laboratories study plague to understand the disease and develop diagnostics, treatments and vaccines. Their purpose does not establish the source of an unexplained illness.
paras.zh: 实验室研究鼠疫是为了了解这种疾病并开发诊断方法、治疗方法和疫苗。他们的目的并没有确定不明原因疾病的根源。

paras.en: For Irkutsk, the investigation must return to the patient, laboratory records and evidence connecting them.
paras.zh: 对于伊尔库茨克来说，调查必须回到患者、实验室记录和相关证据。

articles.title: Animals may have evolved 200 million years earlier than we thought

paras.en: Animals may have evolved 200 million years earlier than we thought
paras.zh: 动物的进化可能比我们想象的早2亿年

paras.en: - New research suggests animals could have evolved as early as 800 to 700 million years ago, roughly 200 million years earlier than some previous estimates. If so, the first animals may have lived before or during Snowball Earth, leaving behind little trace because their soft bodies were rarely preserved.
paras.zh: - 新的研究表明，动物可能早在 800 至 7 亿年前就已经进化，比之前的一些估计早了大约 2 亿年。如果是这样，第一批动物可能生活在雪球地球之前或期间，但由于它们柔软的身体很少被保存下来，所以留下的痕迹很少。

paras.en: New research suggests animals may have evolved up to 200 million years before they first appear clearly in the fossil record, challenging a key assumption scientists have used to estimate when animal life began.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，动物在首次清晰地出现在化石记录中之前可能已经进化了长达 2 亿年，这对科学家用来估计动物生命何时开始的一个关键假设提出了挑战。

paras.en: A study led by the University of Oxford suggests the earliest animals may have existed hundreds of millions of years before the first unmistakable animal fossils appear. The findings, published Oct. 2 in Science Advances, indicate that animals could have originated deep in the Neoproterozoic Era, possibly before some of the most severe ice ages in Earth's history.
paras.zh: 牛津大学领导的一项研究表明，最早的动物可能在第一个明确的动物化石出现之前就已经存在了数亿年。 10 月 2 日发表在《科学进展》上的研究结果表明，动物可能起源于新元古代时期，可能早于地球历史上一些最严重的冰河时代。

paras.en: The research could reshape scientists' understanding of a major evolutionary puzzle. Animals seem to appear relatively abruptly in the fossil record shortly before the Cambrian Period (539 to 487 million years ago), even though other lines of evidence have long suggested their evolutionary story began much earlier.
paras.zh: 这项研究可能会重塑科学家对重大进化难题的理解。动物在寒武纪（距今 539 至 4.87 亿年前）之前不久的化石记录中似乎相对突然地出现，尽管其他证据早已表明它们的进化故事开始得更早。

paras.en: At the center of the new study is a question about how researchers have used ancient fossil deposits to place a maximum age on the origin of animals.
paras.zh: 这项新研究的核心问题是研究人员如何利用古代化石沉积物来确定动物起源的最大年龄。

paras.en: One important site is the Weng'an Biota in China, a roughly 590 million year old fossil deposit preserved in rocks of Ediacaran age. The site contains microscopic organisms preserved in exceptional detail, but none can be definitively identified as animals.
paras.zh: 其中一个重要地点是中国的瓮安生物群，这是一个保存在埃迪卡拉纪岩石中的大约 5.9 亿年前的化石矿床。该遗址包含保存得非常详细的微生物，但没有一个可以明确识别为动物。

paras.en: Because of this absence, scientists have previously argued that animals likely evolved after the Weng'an Biota formed. The reasoning was that if animals had already existed at the time, such an unusually well-preserved fossil deposit should have captured evidence of them.
paras.zh: 由于这种缺失，科学家此前认为动物很可能是在瓮安生物群形成后进化的。理由是，如果当时已经存在动物，那么如此保存异常完好的化石沉积物应该已经捕获了它们的证据。

paras.en: The new research calls that assumption into question.
paras.zh: 新的研究对这一假设提出了质疑。

paras.en: The international team, which included scientists from the University of California Berkeley, ETH Zürich, and Yale University, conducted an extensive study of exceptionally preserved microfossils from the Kheseen Biota in Mongolia.
paras.zh: 这个国际团队包括来自加州大学伯克利分校、苏黎世联邦理工学院和耶鲁大学的科学家，对蒙古赫赛恩生物群中保存完好的微化石进行了广泛的研究。

paras.en: The Kheseen Biota is more than 40 million years younger than Weng'an, although the two fossil assemblages share some species. Importantly, animals are already known from other locations around the world by the time the Kheseen Biota formed, including sites in Namibia and South China.
paras.zh: 凯辛生物群比瓮安生物群年轻超过 4000 万年，尽管这两个化石群有一些物种相同。重要的是，在赫辛生物群形成时，世界各地的动物都已经为人所知，包括纳米比亚和华南地区。

paras.en: Researchers examined more than 140 samples, including material collected from previously undocumented locations, using scanning electron microscopy. Their analysis revealed exquisitely preserved new microfossil species, including acritarchs (tiny spherical organisms with spines and branching projections), along with embryo-like fossils containing internal cells.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用扫描电子显微镜检查了 140 多个样本，其中包括从以前未记录的地点收集的材料。他们的分析揭示了保存完好的新微化石物种，包括acritarchs（具有刺和分支突起的微小球形生物），以及含有内部细胞的胚胎状化石。

paras.en: Despite the remarkable preservation, none of the fossils can confidently be identified as an animal.
paras.zh: 尽管保存完好，但没有一个化石可以自信地被鉴定为动物。

paras.en: Senior author Associate Professor Ross Anderson (Museum of Natural History, Oxford University) said: "The Kheseen Biota breaks the argument that the exceptional microfossils of Weng'an mean we would have seen animal fossils in the assemblage had they existed at the time. The Kheseen microfossils are just as well-preserved, yet animals continue to be absent - despite the fact we know at that point they existed."
paras.zh: 资深作者、牛津大学自然历史博物馆副教授罗斯·​​安德森 (Ross Anderson) 表示：“凯辛生物群打破了这样的论点：瓮安独特的微化石意味着，如果它们当时存在的话，我们就会在该组合中看到动物化石。凯辛微化石保存得同样完好，但动物仍然缺席——尽管我们当时知道它们存在。”
