paras.en: This suggests animals may have occupied environments different from those represented in the Kheseen deposits, or that the chemical conditions responsible for fossilization there were not suitable for preserving animal remains.
paras.zh: 这表明动物生活的环境可能与赫辛沉积物不同，或者那里导致化石形成的化学条件不适合保存动物遗骸。

paras.en: A potentially hidden history of animal life
paras.zh: 动物生命中潜在的隐藏历史

paras.en: Because animals were already present when the Kheseen Biota formed but still do not appear in its fossil record, the researchers argue that the absence of animals from Weng'an cannot automatically be taken as proof that animals had not yet evolved 590 million years ago.
paras.zh: 由于动物在赫森生物群形成时就已经存在，但仍未出现在其化石记录中，研究人员认为，瓮安没有动物并不能自动证明动物在5.9亿年前尚未进化。

paras.en: Instead, the team examined much older fossil deposits dating from about 850 to 730 million years ago. These included the Svanbergfjellet Formation (Norway), Bitter Springs Group (Australia) and Chuar Group (Arizona, USA) -- all fossil rich deposits considered capable of preserving animals, although no confirmed animal fossils have yet been found in them.
paras.zh: 相反，该团队检查了大约 850 至 7.3 亿年前的更古老的化石沉积物。其中包括 Svanbergfjellet 地层（挪威）、Bitter Springs 群（澳大利亚）和 Chuar 群（美国亚利桑那州）——所有化石丰富的矿床都被认为能够保存动物，尽管尚未在其中发现证实的动物化石。

paras.en: These sites have previously been used to define maximum possible ages for the origin of animal life.
paras.zh: 这些地点以前曾被用来定义动物生命起源的最大可能年龄。

paras.en: Using those older geological constraints, the researchers carried out molecular clock analysis. This technique compares genetic differences among living species and combines them with fossil dates and estimated rates of evolutionary change to calculate when common ancestors may have lived.
paras.zh: 利用这些古老的地质限制，研究人员进行了分子钟分析。该技术比较现存物种之间的遗传差异，并将其与化石日期和估计的进化变化率结合起来，以计算共同祖先可能生活的时间。

paras.en: When the researchers used these older deposits rather than the younger Ediacaran Weng'an site as constraints, the estimated origin of animals moved backward by about 200 million years. The new range places the possible emergence of animals between 800 and 700 million years ago.
paras.zh: 当研究人员使用这些较古老的沉积物而不是较年轻的埃迪卡拉纪瓮安遗址作为约束时，动物起源的估计向后移动了约2亿年。新的范围将动物的出现时间确定在 800 至 7 亿年前之间。

paras.en: Other evidence already hints that animals could have a much deeper evolutionary history than their body fossils indicate.
paras.zh: 其他证据已经暗示，动物的进化历史可能比它们的身体化石所显示的要深刻得多。

paras.en: Chemical fossils, also known as biomarkers, preserved in ancient rocks contain evidence consistent with sponges living at least 650 million years ago. That would place them tens of millions of years before the oldest definitive macroscopic animal fossils.
paras.zh: 保存在古代岩石中的化学化石（也称为生物标记）包含与至少 6.5 亿年前的海绵一致的证据。这将使它们比最古老的、明确的宏观动物化石早几千万年。

paras.en: The earliest animals would likely have been small and soft-bodied. Without shells, bones or other hard structures, they would have been far less likely to survive the fossilization process than many later animals.
paras.zh: 最早的动物可能体型较小，身体软弱。如果没有壳、骨头或其他坚硬的结构，它们在石化过程中幸存下来的可能性比许多后来的动物要小得多。

paras.en: Their chances of being preserved would also have depended heavily on where they lived and on a rare combination of chemical conditions after death.
paras.zh: 它们被保存的机会在很大程度上取决于它们居住的地方以及死后化学条件的罕见组合。

paras.en: Did animals exist before Snowball Earth?
paras.zh: 雪球地球之前动物存在吗？

paras.en: If animals originated between 800 and 700 million years ago, the timing raises an extraordinary possibility. Animal life may already have existed before Earth entered some of the most extreme ice ages in its history, or animals may even have emerged during that harsh period.
paras.zh: 如果动物起源于 800 至 7 亿年前，那么这个时间就有了一种非凡的可能性。在地球进入其历史上一些最极端的冰河时期之前，动物生命可能就已经存在了，或者动物甚至可能在那个严酷的时期出现。

paras.en: The Cryogenian Period began around 720 million years ago, when massive glaciers expanded across the planet during episodes commonly called Snowball Earth.
paras.zh: 成冰期开始于大约 7.2 亿年前，当时巨大的冰川在地球上扩张，形成了通常被称为“雪球地球”的时期。

paras.en: The new findings reopen questions about whether the environmental conditions associated with Snowball Earth influenced the origin and early evolution of animal life.
paras.zh: 新的发现重新提出了关于与雪球地球相关的环境条件是否影响动物生命的起源和早期进化的问题。

paras.en: First author, PhD student Orin Lole Durbin (University of Oxford undergraduate at the time of the study, now at Virginia Tech) said: "Pre-Ediacaran animal body fossils still elude us, and this analysis does not prove that animals existed 800 million years ago. However, our new fossil evidence from Mongolia undermines one of the main arguments for restricting animal origins to the Ediacaran interval. Meanwhile, our molecular-clock analyses show how much further back their evolutionary history could extend."
paras.zh: 第一作者、博士生 Orin Lole Durbin（当时是牛津大学本科生，现就职于弗吉尼亚理工大学）说：“我们仍然无法找到前埃迪卡拉纪的动物尸体化石，而且这项分析并不能证明动物存在于 8 亿年前。然而，我们来自蒙古的新化石证据推翻了将动物起源限制在埃迪卡拉纪时期的主要论据之一。同时，我们的分子钟分析表明它们的进化历史可以追溯到多远。”

paras.en: The researchers say future studies should examine fossil deposits from a wider range of locations, environments, and preservation conditions in the search for evidence of early animals.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，未来的研究应该检查更广泛的地点、环境和保存条件的化石沉积物，以寻找早期动物的证据。

paras.en: That search should also combine every available line of evidence, including animal body fossils, traces of animal activity, and chemical biomarkers.
paras.zh: 这项搜索还应该结合所有可用的证据，包括动物尸体化石、动物活动痕迹和化学生物标记。

paras.en: Professor Anderson added: "Until that evidence becomes available, the precise birth date of the animal kingdom remains uncertain."
paras.zh: 安德森教授补充道：“在证据出现之前，动物王国的确切诞生日期仍然不确定。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Oxford. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由牛津大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Orin M. Lole Durbin, Eliel S.C. Anttila, Derek E.G. Briggs, Francis A. Macdonald, Ross P. Anderson. Re-evaluating molecular clock maximum age calibrations revives pre-Ediacaran divergence estimates for animals. Science Advances, 2026; 12 (40) DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aeg6289
paras.zh: - Orin M. Lole Durbin、Eliel S.C. Anttila、Derek E.G.布里格斯、弗朗西斯·A·麦克唐纳、罗斯·P·安德森。重新评估分子钟最大年龄校准恢复了前埃迪卡拉动物的分歧估计。科学进展，2026； 12 (40) DOI：10.1126/sciadv.aeg6289

articles.title: Humans may not be as hardwired for violence as we thought

paras.en: Humans may not be as hardwired for violence as we thought
paras.zh: 人类可能并不像我们想象的那样天生就有暴力倾向

paras.en: - A study comparing 100 primate species, including humans, suggests that everyday aggression and lethal violence did not evolve as part of the same simple behavioral spectrum. Species that frequently fight or show mild aggression are not necessarily more likely to kill rivals, while extreme acts such as infanticide and lethal attacks appear to follow their own evolutionary patterns.
paras.zh: - 一项对包括人类在内的 100 种灵长类动物进行比较的研究表明，日常攻击和致命暴力并不是作为同一简单行为谱的一部分而进化的。经常打斗或表现出轻微攻击性的物种并不一定更有可能杀死对手，而杀婴和致命攻击等极端行为似乎遵循它们自己的进化模式。

paras.en: New research from the University of Lincoln, UK, is questioning a long standing idea about the evolutionary roots of human violence. The findings suggest that everyday aggression does not necessarily build toward deadly conflict.
paras.zh: 英国林肯大学的一项新研究对人类暴力进化根源的长期观点提出了质疑。研究结果表明，日常的攻击行为并不一定会导致致命的冲突。

paras.en: Published in the international journal Evolution Letters, the study indicates that mild aggression and lethal violence may have developed through different evolutionary processes. That distinction adds a new layer to the long-running debate over whether violence is an inherent part of human nature.
paras.zh: 这项发表在国际期刊《进化快报》上的研究表明，轻度攻击性和致命暴力可能是通过不同的进化过程发展起来的。这种区别为关于暴力是否是人性的固有部分的长期争论增添了新的层面。

paras.en: The work was led by Professor Bonaventura Majolo of the University of Lincoln, alongside Dr. Samantha Wakes and Professor Marcello Ruta.
paras.zh: 这项工作由林肯大学的 Bonaventura Majolo 教授、Samantha Wakes 博士和 Marcello Ruta 教授领导。

paras.en: Many theories about the origins of violence treat aggression as one broad behavioral characteristic. Under that view, species that frequently engage in everyday fights or disputes might also be expected to show higher levels of lethal violence.
paras.zh: 许多关于暴力起源的理论将攻击性视为一种广泛的行为特征。根据这种观点，经常参与日常打斗或纠纷的物种也可能会表现出更高水平的致命暴力。

paras.en: The new research suggests that this assumption may be too simple.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，这个假设可能过于简单。

paras.en: The team examined patterns of aggression across 100 primate species, including humans. Their analysis showed that species with high levels of mild aggression were not necessarily more likely to kill competitors.
paras.zh: 研究小组研究了包括人类在内的 100 种灵长类动物的攻击行为模式。他们的分析表明，具有高度轻度攻击性的物种并不一定更有可能杀死竞争对手。

paras.en: Instead, deadly behaviors such as killing adult rivals or infanticide appeared to follow their own evolutionary patterns, largely separate from routine conflict.
paras.zh: 相反，杀死成年竞争对手或杀婴等致命行为似乎遵循自己的进化模式，很大程度上与常规冲突无关。

paras.en: Mild Conflict and Lethal Violence Follow Different Paths
paras.zh: 轻度冲突和致命暴力遵循不同的路径

paras.en: The results challenge the idea that violence can be explained as a straightforward evolutionary inheritance.
paras.zh: 这些结果挑战了暴力可以被解释为直接的进化遗传的观点。

paras.en: Rather than forming a single scale that runs from minor disputes to lethal attacks, different types of aggression may arise under different social and evolutionary pressures.
paras.zh: 不同类型的攻击可能会在不同的社会和进化压力下出现，而不是形成从小争议到致命攻击的单一规模。

paras.en: That suggests the link between everyday aggression and extreme violence could be much weaker than some previous theories have proposed.
paras.zh: 这表明日常攻击与极端暴力之间的联系可能比之前的一些理论所提出的要弱得多。

paras.en: Bonaventura Majolo, Professor of Social Evolution, said: "Understanding the evolutionary roots of violence is important not only for biology but also for how we think about human behavior.
paras.zh: 社会进化论教授博纳文图拉·马约洛（Bonaventura Majolo）表示：“了解暴力的进化根源不仅对于生物学很重要，对于我们如何看待人类行为也很重要。

paras.en: "Our study shows that the evolution of aggression follows more complex patterns than what earlier models proposed, that it is biologically inaccurate to rank species on the basis of their general propensity for aggression and that we need a more nuanced approach when discussing whether humans are inherently violent."
paras.zh: “我们的研究表明，攻击性的进化遵循比早期模型提出的更复杂的模式，根据物种的一般攻击倾向对物种进行排名在生物学上是不准确的，并且在讨论人类是否天生暴力时，我们需要采取更细致的方法。”

paras.en: The researchers compared five different forms of aggression, ranging from ordinary conflicts to lethal attacks, using a large dataset spanning many primate species.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用涵盖许多灵长类动物的大型数据集比较了五种不同形式的攻击行为，从普通冲突到致命攻击。

paras.en: They found that different types of lethal aggression were moderately associated with one another. However, those forms of deadly violence showed little connection with mild aggression.
paras.zh: 他们发现不同类型的致命攻击彼此之间存在一定程度的关联。然而，这些形式的致命暴力与轻度侵略几乎没有关系。

paras.en: That pattern suggests that the biological and evolutionary mechanisms behind lethal violence are distinct from those that drive everyday conflict.
paras.zh: 这种模式表明，致命暴力背后的生物和进化机制与驱动日常冲突的机制不同。

paras.en: The findings add new evidence to a longstanding debate in anthropology and evolutionary biology over what shapes human violence. Researchers have long questioned whether violent behavior is rooted mainly in deep evolutionary history or is more strongly influenced by social and cultural forces.
paras.zh: 这些发现为人类学和进化生物学领域关于人类暴力的形成因素的长期争论提供了新的证据。研究人员长期以来一直质疑暴力行为是否主要植根于深层的进化历史，或者更强烈地受到社会和文化力量的影响。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Lincoln. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由林肯大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Bonaventura Majolo, Samantha J Wakes, Marcello Ruta. Origins of violence: evolutionary decoupling between mild and lethal conspecific aggression in primates. Evolution Letters, 2026; 10 (2): 207 DOI: 10.1093/evlett/qrag002
paras.zh: - 博纳文图拉·马约洛、萨曼莎·J·韦克斯、马塞洛·鲁塔。暴力的起源：灵长类动物温和和致命的同种攻击之间的进化脱钩。进化快报，2026； 10（2）：207 DOI：10.1093/evlett/qrag002

articles.title: A new way to fight gum disease without wiping out good bacteria

paras.en: A new way to fight gum disease without wiping out good bacteria
paras.zh: 一种在不消灭有益细菌的情况下对抗牙龈疾病的新方法

paras.en: - Scientists discovered that disrupting the chemical messages bacteria use to communicate can push dental plaque toward a healthier microbial balance. The approach could lead to new treatments for gum disease that control harmful bacteria without destroying beneficial species.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，破坏细菌用来交流的化学信息可以推动牙菌斑走向更健康的微生物平衡。这种方法可能会带来治疗牙龈疾病的新疗法，在不破坏有益物种的情况下控制有害细菌。

paras.en: Bacteria are remarkably good at adapting. That ability helps them survive changing conditions, but it can also create problems when harmful species become resistant to antibiotics and disinfectants.
paras.zh: 细菌非常善于适应。这种能力帮助它们在不断变化的条件下生存，但当有害物种对抗生素和消毒剂产生抗药性时，它也会产生问题。

paras.en: At the same time, bacteria are not simply enemies to eliminate. Many species play important roles in human health, including the hundreds of different microbes that live in the mouth. That raises an intriguing possibility: instead of trying to kill bacteria, could scientists influence how they behave and encourage healthier microbial communities?
paras.zh: 与此同时，细菌不仅仅是需要消灭的敌人。许多物种在人类健康中发挥着重要作用，包括生活在口腔中的数百种不同微生物。这就提出了一个有趣的可能性：科学家可以不试图杀死细菌，而是影响它们的行为并鼓励更健康的微生物群落吗？

paras.en: Research published in 2025 in npj Biofilms and Microbiomes suggests that may be possible. Scientists studying dental plaque found that interfering with the chemical signals bacteria use to communicate can change which species thrive, potentially shifting the community toward bacteria associated with better oral health.
paras.zh: 2025 年在 npj Biofilms and Microbiomes 上发表的研究表明这是可能的。研究牙菌斑的科学家发现，干扰细菌用来交流的化学信号可以改变物种的繁盛，从而有可能使菌群转向与改善口腔健康相关的细菌。

paras.en: The human mouth is home to roughly 700 species of bacteria. These microbes do not simply grow alongside one another. Many exchange chemical signals through a process called quorum sensing.
paras.zh: 人类口腔中栖息着大约 700 种细菌。这些微生物并不是简单地相互生长。许多通过称为群体感应的过程交换化学信号。

paras.en: Quorum sensing allows bacteria to detect how many neighboring cells are present and coordinate group behaviors. Some oral bacteria communicate using molecules known as N-acyl homoserine lactones (AHLs).
paras.zh: 群体感应使细菌能够检测存在多少邻近细胞并协调群体行为。一些口腔细菌使用 N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯 (AHL) 分子进行交流。

paras.en: Researchers from the College of Biological Sciences and the School of Dentistry examined how these signals shape dental plaque. Their goal was to determine whether bacterial communication could be manipulated to help maintain a healthier oral microbiome.
paras.zh: 生物科学学院和牙科学院的研究人员研究了这些信号如何塑造牙菌斑。他们的目标是确定是否可以操纵细菌通讯来帮助维持更健康的口腔微生物组。

paras.en: The oral microbiome refers to the community of microorganisms living in the mouth. When that community becomes unbalanced, potentially harmful bacteria can become more dominant and contribute to conditions such as periodontal disease.
paras.zh: 口腔微生物组是指生活在口腔中的微生物群落。当该群落变得不平衡时，潜在的有害细菌可能会变得更加占主导地位，并导致牙周病等疾病。

paras.en: The researchers found that bacteria within dental plaque produced AHL signals in aerobic environments (such as above the gumline), where oxygen is available.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，牙菌斑内的细菌在有氧的有氧环境（例如牙龈线上方）中产生 AHL 信号。

paras.en: Those chemical messages could also be detected by bacteria living in anaerobic environments (beneath the gumline), where oxygen levels are much lower.
paras.zh: 这些化学信息也可以被生活在厌氧环境（牙龈线下方）的细菌检测到，那里的氧气含量要低得多。

paras.en: This connection was important because conditions below the gumline can favor bacteria associated with periodontal disease.
paras.zh: 这种联系很重要，因为牙龈线以下的条件可能有利于与牙周病相关的细菌。

paras.en: The team also used specialized enzymes called lactonases to remove AHL signals. Lactonases break down these communication molecules, effectively interfering with the bacterial conversation.
paras.zh: 该团队还使用称为内酯酶的特殊酶来消除 AHL 信号。内酯酶分解这些通讯分子，有效地干扰细菌的对话。

paras.en: When researchers disrupted AHL signaling, the dental plaque community shifted toward species more strongly associated with oral health.
paras.zh: 当研究人员破坏 AHL 信号传导时，牙菌斑群落转向与口腔健康密切相关的物种。

paras.en: Their findings suggest that carefully chosen enzymes might someday be used to alter the makeup of dental plaque and help maintain a healthier balance of microorganisms.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，精心挑选的酶有一天可能会被用来改变牙菌斑的构成，并有助于维持微生物的健康平衡。

paras.en: "Dental plaque develops in a sequence, much like a forest ecosystem," said Mikael Elias, associate professor in the College of Biological Sciences and senior author of the study. "Pioneer species like Streptococcus and Actinomyces are the initial settlers in simple communities -- they're generally harmless and associated with good oral health. Increasingly diverse late colonizers include the 'red complex' bacteria like Porphyromonas gingivalis, which are strongly linked to periodontal disease. By disrupting the chemical signals bacteria use to communicate, one could manipulate the plaque community to remain or return to its health-associated stage."
paras.zh: “牙菌斑是按顺序发展的，就像森林生态系统一样，”生物科学学院副教授、该研究的资深作者米凯尔·埃利亚斯（Mikael Elias）说。 “像链球菌和放线菌这样的先驱物种是简单群落中的最初定居者——它们通常是无害的，并且与良好的口腔健康有关。越来越多样化的晚期殖民者包括像牙龈卟啉单胞菌这样的‘红色复合体’细菌，它们与牙周病密切相关。通过破坏细菌用来交流的化学信号，人们可以操纵牙菌斑群落保持或返回到与健康相关的阶段。”

paras.en: In other words, dental plaque changes over time rather than appearing all at once. Early communities may contain relatively harmless bacteria, while more complex communities can eventually include species strongly associated with gum disease.
paras.zh: 换句话说，牙菌斑会随着时间的推移而变化，而不是一下子全部出现。早期的群落可能含有相对无害的细菌，而更复杂的群落最终可能包括与牙龈疾病密切相关的物种。

paras.en: The researchers hope that interfering with bacterial communication could make it possible to guide plaque toward an earlier, healthier state rather than attempting to eliminate the entire microbial population.
paras.zh: 研究人员希望，干扰细菌通讯能够引导牙菌斑进入更早、更健康的状态，而不是试图消灭整个微生物群。

paras.en: Oxygen Changes How Bacterial Signals Behave
paras.zh: 氧气改变细菌信号的行为方式

paras.en: One of the most important findings was that the effects of bacterial communication depended heavily on oxygen levels.
paras.zh: 最重要的发现之一是细菌通讯的影响很大程度上取决于氧气水平。

paras.en: "What's particularly striking is how oxygen availability changes everything," said lead author Rakesh Sikdar. "When we blocked AHL signaling in aerobic conditions, we saw more health-associated bacteria. But when we added AHLs under anaerobic conditions, we promoted the growth of disease-associated late colonizers. Quorum sensing may play very different roles above and below the gumline, which has major implications for how we approach treatment of periodontal diseases."
paras.zh: “特别引人注目的是氧气供应如何改变一切，”主要作者拉克什·西克达尔（Rakesh Sikdar）说。 “当我们在有氧条件下阻断 AHL 信号传导时，我们看到了更多与健康相关的细菌。但是当我们在厌氧条件下添加 AHL 时，我们促进了与疾病相关的晚期定植菌的生长。群体感应可能在牙龈线上方和下方发挥非常不同的作用，这对我们如何治疗牙周病具有重大影响。”

paras.en: That difference suggests that the same chemical signals can influence microbial communities in very different ways depending on where they occur in the mouth.
paras.zh: 这种差异表明，相同的化学信号可以以非常不同的方式影响微生物群落，具体取决于它们在口腔中发生的位置。

paras.en: Above the gumline, where oxygen is more plentiful, disrupting AHL signaling favored bacteria linked with better oral health. Beneath the gumline, adding those signals encouraged later colonizing species associated with disease.
paras.zh: 牙龈线上方氧气更充足，破坏 AHL 信号有利于与更好的口腔健康相关的细菌。在牙龈线下方，添加这些信号会鼓励后来与疾病相关的物种定殖。

paras.en: A Different Strategy for Preventing Gum Disease
paras.zh: 预防牙龈疾病的不同策略

paras.en: The researchers now want to investigate how bacterial communication varies throughout the mouth and among people at different stages of periodontal disease.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在想要研究细菌传播在整个口腔以及牙周病不同阶段的人之间是如何变化的。

paras.en: Rather than broadly attacking oral bacteria with antimicrobial treatments, the long term goal is to find ways to influence the balance of the microbial community itself.
paras.zh: 长期目标不是通过抗菌治疗广泛攻击口腔细菌，而是找到影响微生物群落本身平衡的方法。

paras.en: "Understanding how bacterial communities communicate and organize themselves may ultimately give us new tools to prevent periodontal disease -- not by waging war on all oral bacteria, but by strategically maintaining a healthy microbial balance," said Elias.
paras.zh: 埃利亚斯说：“了解细菌群落如何沟通和组织自身可能最终为我们提供预防牙周病的新工具——不是通过对所有口腔细菌发动战争，而是通过战略性地维持健康的微生物平衡。”

paras.en: The approach could eventually have implications beyond dentistry. Similar microbial imbalances, often called microbiome dysbiosis, occur elsewhere in the body and have been associated with a range of health problems, including certain types of cancer.
paras.zh: 这种方法最终可能会产生牙科以外的影响。类似的微生物失衡，通常称为微生物组失调，发生在身体的其他部位，并与一系列健康问题有关，包括某些类型的癌症。

paras.en: Researchers hope that learning how to manipulate bacterial communication could eventually provide a foundation for therapies designed to steer microbial communities toward healthier states rather than simply destroying them.
paras.zh: 研究人员希望，学习如何操纵细菌通讯最终可以为旨在引导微生物群落走向更健康状态而不是简单地破坏它们的疗法奠定基础。

paras.en: The research was funded by the National Institutes of Health.
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院资助。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Minnesota, Twin Cities. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由明尼苏达大学双城分校提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Rakesh Sikdar, Mai V. Beauclaire, Mark C. Herzberg, Bruno P. Lima, Mikael H. Elias. N-acyl homoserine lactone signaling modulates bacterial community associated with human dental plaque. npj Biofilms and Microbiomes, 2025; 11 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41522-025-00846-z
paras.zh: - Rakesh Sikdar、Mai V. Beauclaire、Mark C. Herzberg、Bruno P. Lima、Mikael H. Elias。 N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯信号传导调节与人类牙菌斑相关的细菌群落。 npj 生物膜和微生物组，2025； 11 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41522-025-00846-z

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Expands Leadership Structure to Support Next Phase of Growth
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: DURANGO, Colo., Sept. 28, 2026 – Agile Space Industries today announced that Jason Wright will join the company as President in early October, strengthening Agile’s operational leadership as the company continues its rapid growth as a supplier of in-space chemical propulsion products and services. Chris Pearson continues his role as Agile’s Chief Executive Officer.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州杜兰戈，2026 年 9 月 28 日 – Agile Space Industries 今天宣布 Jason Wright 将于 10 月初加入公司担任总裁，随着该公司作为太空化学推进产品和服务供应商的持续快速发展，将加强 Agile 的运营领导力。 Chris Pearson 继续担任 Agile 首席执行官。

paras.en: Since 2022, Agile has experienced significant growth, with the company expected to reach approximately five times its 2022 revenue by the end of 2026. Today, Agile employs more than 165 people and operates across Colorado, Pennsylvania, Oklahoma, and Washington state. Growth has been driven primarily by increasing demand for the company’s monopropellant and bipropellant engines and propellant tanks, along with integrated propulsion subsystems and expanding propulsion testing services.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，Agile 经历了显着增长，预计到 2026 年底，该公司的收入将达到 2022 年收入的约五倍。如今，Agile 拥有超过 165 名员工，业务遍及科罗拉多州、宾夕法尼亚州、俄克拉荷马州和华盛顿州。增长主要是由于对该公司的单组元推进剂和双组元推进剂发动机和推进剂罐的需求不断增长，以及集成推进子系统和不断扩大的推进测试服务推动的。

paras.en: As President, Wright will lead the day-to-day management of Agile’s business, with responsibility for operations across the company’s locations and delivery of current product and service contracts. He will also oversee near-term sales, marketing, and business development efforts supporting Agile’s existing products and programs.
paras.zh: 作为总裁，赖特将领导敏捷业务的日常管理，负责公司各地点的运营以及当前产品和服务合同的交付。他还将监督支持敏捷现有产品和计划的近期销售、营销和业务开发工作。

paras.en: “Agile has built tremendous momentum, and the opportunity in front of us continues to grow,” Pearson said. “Jason brings exactly the kind of propulsion, operational and program leadership experience we need as we focus on execution at greater scale for our customers. His experience leading complex propulsion operations and overseeing delivery for blue-chip space customers will be invaluable as we continue building out the company.”
paras.zh: “敏捷已经建立了巨大的势头，我们面前的机会继续增长，”皮尔森说。 “杰森带来的正是我们所需要的推进、运营和项目领导经验，因为我们专注于为客户提供更大规模的执行。随着我们继续发展公司，他领导复杂推进操作和监督蓝筹太空客户交付的经验将非常宝贵。”

paras.en: Wright brings more than 25 years of space industry experience spanning propulsion engineering, manufacturing, testing, operations, and program management. He previously served as a Lockheed Martin subject matter expert for monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters and dual-mode propulsion systems and held leadership positions in propulsion engineering, manufacturing, and testing. His experience also includes serving as operations director for a propulsion manufacturing center and managing programs with more than $100 million in profit-and-loss responsibility.
paras.zh: Wright 拥有超过 25 年的航天工业经验，涉及推进工程、制造、测试、运营和项目管理。他此前曾担任洛克希德·马丁公司的单组元推进剂和双组元推进剂推进器以及双模式推进系统主题专家，并在推进工程、制造和测试领域担任领导职务。他的经验还包括担任推进制造中心的运营总监以及管理损益超过 1 亿美元的项目。

paras.en: Throughout his career, Wright has supported programs and customers across the civil, defense, intelligence, and commercial space sectors, including NASA, the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Navy, U.S. Space Force, DARPA, the intelligence community, and commercial satellite operators.
paras.zh: 在他的整个职业生涯中，赖特一直为民用、国防、情报和商业航天领域的项目和客户提供支持，包括 NASA、美国空军、美国海军、美国太空军、DARPA、情报界和商业卫星运营商。

paras.en: “Agile’s innovative approach comes at an important time for the US and space industry at large, as increased launch availability creates new missions and growing demand for in-space propulsion,” Wright said. “My focus will be on driving operational excellence, meeting our commitments to customers and ensuring we can continue to respond rapidly to evolving propulsion needs as Agile grows.”
paras.zh: 赖特说：“敏捷的创新方法对美国和整个航天工业来说是一个重要时刻，因为发射可用性的增加创造了新的任务，并且对太空推进的需求不断增长。” “我的重点将是推动卓越运营，履行我们对客户的承诺，并确保我们能够随着敏捷的发展继续快速响应不断变化的推进需求。”

paras.en: With Wright overseeing day-to-day operations and near-term execution, Pearson will continue to lead Agile’s long-term strategy, board and investor relations, strategic business development, and technical direction.
paras.zh: 赖特负责监督日常运营和近期执行，皮尔逊将继续领导敏捷的长期战略、董事会和投资者关系、战略业务开发和技术方向。

paras.en: Wright’s appointment reflects Agile’s continued investment in the leadership and operational capabilities needed to support its next phase of growth and meet increasing demand for advanced in-space propulsion solutions.
paras.zh: 赖特的任命反映了敏捷公司对支持下一阶段增长和满足对先进太空推进解决方案日益增长的需求所需的领导力和运营能力的持续投资。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to the high-rate production of flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate delivery. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到飞行硬件的高速生产，Agile 汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速交付。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Space is everyone’s business: Economist Enterprise’s 4th annual Space Economy Summit returns to Orlando
articles.author: Economist Enterprise

paras.en: ORLANDO, FL — September 28th, 2026 — Space is rapidly becoming a practical business tool for industries far beyond aerospace, as satellite intelligence, resilient connectivity and other space-enabled technologies create new opportunities for growth, resilience and security on Earth.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州奥兰多 — 2026 年 9 月 28 日 — 随着卫星智能、弹性连接和其他太空技术为地球的增长、弹性和安全创造了新的机会，太空正在迅速成为航空航天以外行业的实用商业工具。

paras.en: Economist Enterprise’s 4th annual Space Economy Summit, taking place October 28–29, 2026, at the University of Central Florida in Orlando, will bring together senior leaders from government, space, investment and industries including telecommunications, agriculture, healthcare, mining, retail, finance and manufacturing.
paras.zh: 《经济学人》杂志第四届年度太空经济​​峰会将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日至 29 日在奥兰多中佛罗里达大学举行，来自政府、太空、投资和电信、农业、医疗保健、采矿、零售、金融和制造业等行业的高级领导人将齐聚一堂。

paras.en: The summit will examine how innovation in orbit can deliver measurable commercial and strategic value across the wider economy.
paras.zh: 峰会将探讨轨道创新如何在更广泛的经济领域带来可衡量的商业和战略价值。

paras.en: Bringing space-enabled technology to the industries that need it
paras.zh: 将太空技术引入有需要的行业

paras.en: The summit’s speaker line-up reflects the growing importance of space technology beyond the traditional aerospace sector.
paras.zh: 此次峰会的演讲嘉宾阵容反映了空间技术在传统航空航天领域之外日益增长的重要性。

paras.en: Speakers include Taylor Jordan, Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Environmental Observation and Prediction at NOAA and Director of the Office of Space Commerce; Gillian Bussey, Deputy Chief Science Officer at the US Space Force; Martine Rothblatt, Founder, Chairperson and Chief Executive of United Therapeutics; Srini Kalapala, Senior Vice-President and Chief Network Officer, Wireless, at Verizon; Feroz Sheikh, Group Chief Information and Digital Officer at Syngenta; and Jayesh Bhayani, Executive Vice-President and Senior Director of Technology at Tesco.
paras.zh: 演讲者包括美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 负责环境观测和预测的助理商务部长兼太空商务办公室主任泰勒·乔丹 (Taylor Jordan)； Gillian Bussey，美国太空军副首席科学官； Martine Rothblatt，联合治疗公司创始人、董事长兼首席执行官； Srini Kalapala，Verizon 无线高级副总裁兼首席网络官； Feroz Sheikh，先正达集团首席信息和数字官；以及 Tesco 执行副总裁兼高级技术总监 Jayesh Bhayani。

paras.en: The programme also features leaders from the Federal Communications Commission, United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs, NASA, the International Space Station National Laboratory, Citi, BNY Mellon, Rio Tinto, Ford Motor Company and other organisations across the space and commercial ecosystem.
paras.zh: 该计划还邀请了来自美国联邦通信委员会、联合国外层空间事务办公室、美国宇航局、国际空间站国家实验室、花旗银行、纽约梅隆银行、力拓、福特汽车公司以及太空和商业生态系统中其他组织的领导人。

paras.en: Together, these perspectives will explore how space-enabled technologies can address challenges on Earth, from resilient communications and climate intelligence to supply-chain visibility, agricultural productivity, infrastructure monitoring and new approaches to healthcare and manufacturing.
paras.zh: 这些观点将共同探讨太空技术如何应对地球上的挑战，从弹性通信和气候情报到供应链可视性、农业生产力、基础设施监控以及医疗保健和制造的新方法。

paras.en: From promising pilots to commercial adoption
paras.zh: 从有希望的试点到商业采用

paras.en: As space technology becomes increasingly accessible, the summit will focus on the practical questions that determine whether innovation translates into commercial value.
paras.zh: 随着太空技术变得越来越容易获得，峰会将重点讨论决定创新是否转化为商业价值的实际问题。

paras.en: Discussions will examine customer demand, integration with legacy systems, procurement pathways, resilient supply chains and business models capable of delivering value beyond pilot projects.
paras.zh: 讨论将审查客户需求、与遗留系统的集成、采购途径、弹性供应链以及能够提供试点项目之外的价值的商业模式。

paras.en: The programme will also explore the next phase of the space economy, including direct-to-device connectivity, positioning, navigation and timing resilience, defence demand, commercial space stations, orbital computing, microgravity manufacturing and renewed interest in lunar exploration.
paras.zh: 该计划还将探索太空经济的下一阶段，包括直接到设备的连接、定位、导航和授时弹性、国防需求、商业空间站、轨道计算、微重力制造以及对月球探索的新兴趣。

paras.en: Commercial opportunity and strategic risk
paras.zh: 商业机会和战略风险

paras.en: The growing importance of space-enabled technology is accompanied by questions about regulation, geopolitical competition, orbital congestion, defence dependency, sustainability and commercial viability.
paras.zh: 太空技术的重要性与日俱增，同时也伴随着监管、地缘政治竞争、轨道拥堵、国防依赖、可持续性和商业可行性等问题。

paras.en: The summit will bring together policymakers, investors, space companies and end users to examine how governments and businesses can develop resilient, trusted and commercially sustainable space capabilities.
paras.zh: 此次峰会将汇集政策制定者、投资者、航天公司和最终用户，探讨政府和企业如何发展有弹性、值得信赖和商业可持续的航天能力。

paras.en: Alongside the main programme, the Space Economy Leaders Club will provide an invitation-only forum for 50 senior decision-makers with the influence, capital and operational responsibility to shape the future of the global space economy.
paras.zh: 除了主要活动外，太空经济领袖俱乐部还将为 50 名具有塑造全球太空经济未来影响力、资本和运营责任的高级决策者提供仅限邀请的论坛。

paras.en: The club will bring together chief executives, agency leaders, investors, policymakers, commercial space pioneers and strategic end users of space-enabled technologies for candid discussion and peer exchange.
paras.zh: 该俱乐部将汇集首席执行官、机构领导人、投资者、政策制定者、商业航天先驱和航天技术的战略最终用户，进行坦诚的讨论和同行交流。

paras.en: At the heart of America’s space ecosystem
paras.zh: 位于美国太空生态系统的核心

paras.en: Hosted at the University of Central Florida in Orlando, the summit is positioned within one of the United States’ most important commercial space corridors, connecting academic research, industry innovation and the wider Florida space economy.
paras.zh: 该峰会在奥兰多的中佛罗里达大学举办，位于美国最重要的商业太空走廊之一，将学术研究、行业创新和更广泛的佛罗里达太空经济联系起来。

paras.en: The Space Economy Summit will take place on October 28–29, 2026.
paras.zh: 太空经济峰会将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日至 29 日举行。

paras.en: For more information and to register: https://econint.co/SpaceNews
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息并注册：https://econint.co/SpaceNews

articles.title: Deposition Sciences, Inc. Expands Sunshade® Tape Offering with New 12″ × 30″ Format
articles.author: Deposition Sciences, Inc

paras.en: Santa Rosa, CA — October 2026 — Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI), a leader in advanced thin film coatings, proudly announces the introduction of a new 12″ × 30″ format for its Sunshade® Tape thermal control material. This expanded size provides engineers and designers with greater flexibility for integrating thermal protection into larger aerospace and industrial systems.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣罗莎 — 2026 年 10 月 — 先进薄膜涂层领域的领导者 Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI) 自豪地宣布为其 Sunshade® Tape 热控制材料推出新的 12" × 30" 格式。这种扩大的尺寸为工程师和设计人员提供了更大的灵活性，可以将热保护集成到更大的航空航天和工业系统中。

paras.en: Sunshade® Tape is engineered for solar reflectance, thermal stability, and durability in extreme environments. Its lightweight, flexible design reduces energy demands while safeguarding sensitive components from heat exposure. The new format ensures easier application across broader surfaces, enhancing mission reliability and equipment performance.
paras.zh: Sunshade® 胶带专为极端环境下的太阳反射率、热稳定性和耐用性而设计。其轻质、灵活的设计降低了能源需求，同时保护敏感部件免受热暴露。新格式确保更轻松地在更广泛的表面上应用，从而提高任务可靠性和设备性能。

paras.en: “Our customers asked for more versatility, and we delivered,” said Justin Mosier, Sr. Mgr Space Materials at DSI. “The new 12″ × 30″ format makes Sunshade® Tape even more adaptable to complex thermal control challenges.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户要求更多的多功能性，我们满足了，”DSI 空间材料高级经理 Justin Mosier 说道。 “新的 12 英寸 × 30 英寸规格使 Sunshade® 胶带更能适应复杂的热控制挑战。”

paras.en: For more information about Sunshade® Tape and its applications, visit Deposition Sciences, Inc. at https://www.depsci.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Sunshade® Tape 及其应用的更多信息，请访问 Deposition Sciences, Inc.，网址为 https://www.depsci.com。

articles.title: October 2026 Satellite Puzzler

paras.en: Every month, NASA Earth Observatory features a puzzling satellite image. The October 2026 puzzler appears above.
paras.zh: 每个月，美国宇航局地球观测站都会发布令人费解的卫星图像。 2026 年 10 月的谜题出现在上方。

paras.en: Identify the location shown in this satellite image. Share what clues you see, where you think it is, and what makes this place interesting or unique to you.
paras.zh: 识别该卫星图像中显示的位置。分享您看到的线索、您认为它在哪里以及是什么让这个地方对您来说有趣或独特。

paras.en: Submit your response using this form and select “Puzzler Answer” as the topic. Please include your preferred name or alias.
paras.zh: 使用此表格提交您的回答，并选择“谜题答案”作为主题。请注明您的首选姓名或别名。

paras.en: You can keep it simple and just guess the location. Want to impress us? Tell us which satellite and instrument captured the image, which spectral bands were used, or point out a subtle detail about the geology or history of the area. If something catches your eye, or if this is your home or means something to you, we’d love to hear about it.
paras.zh: 您可以保持简单，只需猜测位置即可。想要给我们留下深刻印象吗？告诉我们哪颗卫星和仪器捕获了图像，使用了哪些光谱带，或者指出有关该地区地质或历史的微妙细节。如果有什么东西引起了您的注意，或者如果这是您的家或对您来说意味着什么，我们很乐意听到。

paras.en: We can’t offer prize money or a trip to space to see Earth like satellites and astronauts do. But we can offer something almost as rewarding: puzzler bragging rights.
paras.zh: 我们无法像卫星和宇航员那样提供奖金或太空之旅来观察地球。但我们可以提供几乎同样有价值的东西：益智游戏吹牛的权利。

paras.en: About a week after the challenge, we’ll post the answer at the top of this page, along with a link to an Earth Observatory Image of the Day story that explains the image in more detail. We’ll recognize the first person who correctly guesses the location, and we may also highlight readers who share especially thoughtful or interesting answers. By submitting a response, you acknowledge that your comments may be edited, excerpted, and published on this page.
paras.zh: 挑战结束后大约一周，我们将在本页顶部发布答案，以及地球观测站每日图像故事的链接，该故事更详细地解释了该图像。我们将识别第一个正确猜测位置的人，并且我们还可能会突出显示分享特别深思熟虑或有趣答案的读者。提交回复即表示您承认您的评论可能会被编辑、摘录并发布在此页面上。

paras.en: Until then, zoom in, look closely, and enjoy the challenge. See you at the reveal!
paras.zh: 在那之前，请放大，仔细观察，并享受挑战。揭晓时见！

articles.title: NASA to Cover Northrop Grumman CRS-24 Spacecraft Departure
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: After delivering more than 11,000 pounds of supplies, science experiments, and other cargo to the International Space Station for NASA, Northrop Grumman’s Cygnus XL spacecraft is scheduled to depart Friday, Oct. 9, as part of the company’s Commercial Resupply Services-24 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-24.
paras.zh: 在为 NASA 向国际空间站运送了超过 11,000 磅的物资、科学实验和其他货物后，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的 Cygnus XL 航天器计划于 10 月 9 日星期五出发，作为该公司商业补给服务 24 任务（或诺斯罗普·格鲁曼 CRS-24）的一部分。

paras.en: Watch NASA’s live coverage of undocking and departure beginning at 12:30 p.m. EDT through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online:
paras.zh: 观看 NASA 从中午 12:30 开始的脱离对接和离开现场直播。通过各种平台进行 EDT。了解在哪里在线观看：

paras.en: Flight controllers on the ground will send commands for the space station’s Canadarm2 robotic arm to detach the Cygnus XL spacecraft from the Unity module’s Earth-facing port and maneuver it into position for release at 12:45 p.m. NASA astronaut Luke Delaney will monitor the operation from aboard the orbital complex.
paras.zh: 地面飞行控制器将向空间站的 Canadaarm2 机械臂发送命令，将 Cygnus XL 航天器从 Unity 模块面向地球的端口分离，并将其操纵到位，以便于中午 12:45 释放。美国宇航局宇航员卢克·德莱尼将在轨道综合体上监视运行情况。

paras.en: Loaded with thousands of pounds of disposal items and other unneeded cargo, Cygnus XL will deorbit Sunday, Oct. 11, for a destructive re-entry into Earth’s atmosphere, where it will safely burn up. NASA will not provide coverage of the spacecraft’s deorbit.
paras.zh: 天鹅座 XL 装载着数千磅的处理物品和其他不需要的货物，将于 10 月 11 日星期日脱离轨道，以破坏性方式重新进入地球大气层，并在那里安全燃烧。美国宇航局不会提供航天器脱轨的报道。

paras.en: The resupply spacecraft launched on April 11 on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.
paras.zh: 这艘补给飞船于 4 月 11 日由 SpaceX 猎鹰 9 号火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场发射升空。

paras.en: Learn more about this NASA commercial resupply mission at:
paras.zh: 了解有关 NASA 商业补给任务的更多信息：

paras.en: joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov / james.j.russell@nasa.gov
paras.zh: joshua.a.finch@nasa.gov / james.j.russell@nasa.gov

articles.title: Arctic Sea Ice Shrinks to Its 2026 Minimum

paras.en: This story is an update to the Arctic sea ice feature in our World of Change series, which tracks long-term change on Earth's surface through satellite imagery.
paras.zh: 这个故事是我们的“变化​​世界”系列中北极海冰专题的更新，该系列通过卫星图像跟踪地球表面的长期变化。

paras.en: A layer of frozen seawater caps the Arctic Ocean. This sea ice grows through the long polar winter, usually peaking in March, then melts through the summer to its annual low in September. It is a natural fluctuation that has persisted for millennia. But satellite records show the ice now covers less of the Arctic Ocean at its annual maximum and minimum than it did a few decades ago.
paras.zh: 北冰洋上覆盖着一层冰冻海水。这些海冰在漫长的极地冬季生长，通常在三月达到顶峰，然后在夏季融化，在九月达到年度最低点。这是一种持续了数千年的自然波动。但卫星记录显示，与几十年前相比，现在北冰洋在年度最大值和最小值时所覆盖的面积有所减少。

paras.en: Sea ice in 2026 reached its annual minimum extent on September 12 (above), when it covered an estimated 4.6 million square kilometers (1.78 million square miles), according to NASA and the National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC). That ties 2008, 2010, and 2025 for the 10th-lowest minimum in the satellite record.
paras.zh: 根据 NASA 和国家冰雪数据中心 (NSIDC) 的数据，2026 年海冰在 9 月 12 日（上图）达到了年度最小范围，当时海冰覆盖面积估计为 460 万平方公里（178 万平方英里）。这与 2008 年、2010 年和 2025 年并列，是卫星记录中第十低的最低值。

paras.en: The maps below pair each September since 1990 (left), around the ice's annual minimum, with the following March (right), near its annual maximum, through March 2026.
paras.zh: 下面的地图将自 1990 年以来的每年 9 月（左）和随后的 3 月（右）配对，在冰层年度最小值附近，直到 2026 年 3 月，接近年度最大值。

paras.en: Scientists have used satellites to observe the annual growth and retreat of Arctic sea ice continuously since late 1978. While sea ice extent has declined overall during that time, the downward trend steepened in the 2000s and set off a run of record and near-record lows. Each of the past 20 summers, from 2007 through 2026, ranks among the 20 lowest minimum extents in the satellite record. The lowest occurred in September 2012.
paras.zh: 自 1978 年底以来，科学家们利用卫星连续观测北极海冰的每年增长和消退。虽然海冰范围在此期间总体有所下降，但下降趋势在 2000 年代更加陡峭，并创下了一系列历史新低和接近历史低点。从 2007 年到 2026 年，过去 20 个夏天的每个夏天都位列卫星记录中最低范围的 20 个之内。最低值出现在 2012 年 9 月。

paras.en: More recently, the September sea ice extent has been relatively steady. Weather can make a big difference in how much ice melts from one summer to the next. For example, over the past decade, increased cloud cover has prevented sunlight from accelerating the melt, according to NASA scientists. Despite this recent plateau, the summer minimum remains well below the long-term average.
paras.zh: 最近，九月海冰范围相对稳定。天气会对一个夏天和下一个夏天的冰融化量产生很大影响。例如，根据美国宇航局科学家的说法，在过去的十年中，云层的增加阻止了阳光加速融化。尽管最近出现了平台期，但夏季最低值仍远低于长期平均水平。

paras.en: Across the Arctic, the ice that remains is younger and thinner. Observations show a decline in multiyear ice—that which survives at least one melt season—leaving an Arctic dominated by thinner first-year ice. Winter ice is also shrinking. The March 2026 maximum statistically tied the 2025 maximum for the lowest in the satellite record.
paras.zh: 在整个北极，残留的冰层更年轻、更薄。观测显示，多年冰（至少在一个融化季节中幸存下来的冰）减少了，使得北极以更薄的第一年冰为主。冬季冰层也在缩小。从统计数据来看，2026 年 3 月的最高值与 2025 年的最高值并列卫星记录的最低值。

paras.en: Cycles of natural variability such as the Arctic Oscillation are known to play a role in Arctic sea ice extent, but the decline observed throughout the satellite record cannot be explained by natural variability alone. Natural variability and rising global temperatures have worked together to melt greater amounts of Arctic sea ice. Scientists have projected an essentially ice-free Arctic could occur at least once before the middle of the 21st century.
paras.zh: 已知北极涛动等自然变率周期在北极海冰范围中发挥着作用，但整个卫星记录中观察到的下降不能仅用自然变率来解释。自然变化和全球气温上升共同作用，融化了更多的北极海冰。科学家预测，在 21 世纪中叶之前，北极可能至少出现一次基本无冰的情况。

paras.en: To determine sea ice extent, scientists rely on satellites with passive microwave sensors that measure the microwave energy Earth naturally emits. Sea ice emits more of this energy than open water, so it stands out in microwave images. Because microwaves pass through clouds, the satellites can observe sea ice regularly, regardless of weather.
paras.zh: 为了确定海冰的范围，科学家依靠带有无源微波传感器的卫星来测量地球自然发射的微波能量。海冰比开放水域释放更多的能量，因此它在微波图像中脱颖而出。由于微波穿过云层，因此无论天气如何，卫星都可以定期观测海冰。

paras.en: The record began in 1978 with data collected by NASA’s Nimbus-7, followed by Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP) satellites starting in 1987 and NASA’s Aqua satellite between 2002 and 2011. Starting in 2025, scientists began using observations from the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency’s GCOM-W satellite. The white circle at the center of each image is the “pole hole,” north of which satellite sensors have historically been unable to collect data. The sea ice estimates assume that this hole is ice-filled.
paras.zh: 该记录始于 1978 年，由 NASA 的 Nimbus-7 收集数据，随后是 1987 年开始的国防气象卫星计划 (DMSP) 卫星以及 2002 年至 2011 年间 NASA 的 Aqua 卫星收集的数据。从 2025 年开始，科学家开始使用日本宇宙航空研究开发机构的 GCOM-W 卫星的观测数据。每张图像中心的白色圆圈是“极洞”，其以北的卫星传感器历来无法收集数据。海冰估计假设这个洞充满了冰。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Michala Garrison, using data from the National Snow and Ice Data Center.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局地球观测站的图像由米查拉·加里森 (Michala Garrison) 使用国家冰雪数据中心的数据拍摄。

paras.en: - IPCC (2021) Summary for Policymakers. In: Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis. Contribution of Working Group I to the Sixth Assessment Report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change. Accessed October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: - IPCC (2021) 决策者摘要。见：2021 年气候变化：物理科学基础。第一工作组对政府间气候变化专门委员会第六次评估报告的贡献。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 6 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earthdata (2026, October) Sea Ice. Accessed October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球数据（2026 年 10 月）海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 6 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Observatory (2026, October 6) World of Change: Arctic Sea Ice. Accessed October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球观测站（2026 年，10 月 6 日）变化的世界：北极海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 6 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Observatory (2016, September 16) Sea Ice. Accessed October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球观测站（2016 年 9 月 16 日）海冰。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 6 日。

paras.en: - NASA Earth Science (2026, September 23) Arctic Sea Ice Reaches 2026 Annual Minimum Extent. Accessed October 6, 2026.
paras.zh: - NASA 地球科学（2026 年，9 月 23 日）北极海冰达到 2026 年年度最小范围。访问日期：2026 年 10 月 6 日。

articles.title: When streets become pharmacies: Booming illicit markets in Central Africa

paras.en: When streets become pharmacies: Booming illicit markets in Central Africa
paras.zh: 当街道变成药店：中部非洲蓬勃发展的非法市场

paras.en: Antibiotics, malaria treatments, painkillers, opioids. More than 250 tonnes of medical products were seized over six years in Central Africa. Behind those numbers is an illicit market that thrives not simply despite the region’s fragile health systems, but in part because of them.
paras.zh: 抗生素、疟疾治疗、止痛药、阿片类药物。六年来，中部非洲查获了 250 多吨医疗产品。这些数字的背后是一个非法市场的蓬勃发展，这不仅是因为该地区的卫生系统脆弱，而且部分原因在于卫生系统。

paras.en: When medicines are scarce, unaffordable or simply too far away, illicit sellers have proved adept at filling the void.
paras.zh: 当药品稀缺、价格昂贵或距离太远时，非法卖家就很擅长填补这一空白。

paras.en: That is the dynamic described in a new report released Tuesday by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC). The illicit trade extends far beyond falsified drugs. It includes genuine medicines diverted from legitimate supply chains, unapproved products and drugs smuggled across borders.
paras.zh: 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室（UNODC）周二发布的一份新报告描述了这一动态。非法贸易远远超出了假药范围。它包括从合法供应链转移的正品药品、未经批准的产品和跨境走私的药品。

paras.en: From 2020 through 2025, authorities seized 251 tonnes of medical products in Cameroon, Republic of Congo, Gabon, Central African Republic and Chad. Annual seizures rose from about five tonnes in 2020 to nearly 116 tonnes in 2024, before exceeding 97 tonnes in 2025.
paras.zh: 2020年至2025年，当局在喀麦隆、刚果共和国、加蓬、中非共和国和乍得查获了251吨医疗产品。年缉获量从 2020 年的约 5 吨增加到 2024 年的近 116 吨，2025 年将超过 97 吨。

paras.en: The United Nations cautioned against interpreting the increase as a straightforward measure of the trade’s growth. Larger seizures can reflect both greater trafficking and more aggressive enforcement, and the available data vary considerably among countries and from year to year.
paras.zh: 联合国警告不要将这一增长解读为贸易增长的直接衡量标准。缉获量的增加可以反映出贩运量的增加和执法力度的加大，而且不同国家和每年的可用数据差异很大。

paras.en: Still, the scale is striking. Cameroon accounted for nearly all of the seizures recorded in 2025, with 96 tonnes intercepted, compared with just 2.5 tonnes five years earlier. The products intercepted across the region range from antibiotics, antimalarial and anti-inflammatory drugs to painkillers and such psychoactive substances as tramadol and pregabalin.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，规模仍然惊人。喀麦隆几乎占据了 2025 年记录的全部缉获量，截获了 96 吨，而五年前仅为 2.5 吨。该地区截获的产品包括抗生素、抗疟药、抗炎药、止痛药以及曲马多和普瑞巴林等精神活性物质。

paras.en: “The report outlines a multimodal trafficking system that uses maritime, riverine, air and road routes and involves a broad range of actors,” said Sylvie Bertrand, UNODC’s regional representative for West and Central Africa.
paras.zh: 毒品和犯罪问题办公室西非和中非区域代表西尔维·贝特朗表示：“报告概述了一个多式联运贩运系统，该系统利用海上、河流、空中和公路路线，涉及广泛的参与者。”

paras.en: But the report, produced with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa (CEMAC), suggests that the roots of the trade are partly beyond the reach of law enforcement.
paras.zh: 但这份由世界卫生组织（WHO）和中部非洲经济货币共同体（CEMAC）共同编写的报告表明，这种贸易的根源部分超出了执法部门的管辖范围。

paras.en: Malaria, tuberculosis and HIV remain widespread across the region, while public health systems often struggle to provide treatment. In 2023, the WHO’s universal health-coverage index placed all six countries in the Central African economic bloc among the world’s poorest performers. Chad scored just 26 out of 100, compared with a global average of 71.
paras.zh: 疟疾、结核病和艾滋病毒在该地区仍然普遍存在，而公共卫生系统往往难以提供治疗。 2023年，世界卫生组织的全民健康覆盖指数将中非经济集团的所有六个国家列为世界上表现最差的国家。乍得的得分仅为 26 分（满分 100 分），而全球平均分为 71 分。

paras.en: Distance and cost compound the problem. In the Central African Republic and Chad, more than half the population lived at least two hours from a public hospital providing emergency care, according to data cited in the report. In Chad, a prefilled insulin syringe cost the equivalent of nearly 16 days’ wages for the lowest-paid government employee.
paras.zh: 距离和成本使问题变得更加复杂。报告引用的数据显示，在中非共和国和乍得，超过一半的人口居住在距离提供紧急护理的公立医院至少两小时路程的地方。在乍得，一个预充式胰岛素注射器的花费相当于收入最低的政府雇员近 16 天的工资。

paras.en: Under those circumstances, buying medicine on the street can become less an alternative to the formal health system than a necessity. Consumers in the Central African Republic told researchers that informal sellers allowed them to “buy one or two tablets for about 100 CFA francs” – roughly 20 cents – rather than “buy the medicines in a box of 12 [at a pharmacy]”.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，在街上买药可能不再是正规医疗系统的替代品，而是一种必需品。中非共和国的消费者告诉研究人员，非正式卖家允许他们“以大约 100 非洲法郎”（大约 20 美分）购买一两片药片，而不是“[在药店]购买一盒 12 片的药物”。

paras.en: The result is a marketplace where legitimate, falsified and substandard medicines can be difficult to distinguish.
paras.zh: 结果是市场上的合法药品、假药和不合格药品难以区分。

paras.en: From 2013 to 2025, WHO’s surveillance system recorded incidents involving 228 medical products in the Central African economic bloc. Of those, 71 per cent were classified as falsified and 11 per cent as substandard. Perhaps more troubling, a third of the incidents were detected in regulated supply chains, suggesting that buying medicine from an authorised outlet does not eliminate the risk.
paras.zh: 2013年至2025年，世卫组织监测系统记录了中非经济区涉及228种医疗产品的事件。其中，71% 被归类为伪造，11% 被归类为不合格。也许更令人不安的是，三分之一的事件是在受监管的供应链中发现的，这表明从授权商店购买药品并不能消除风险。

paras.en: In April 2025, the WHO reported falsified batches of amoxicillin in Cameroon and the Central African Republic that did not contain the active ingredient listed on their labels. In September 2026, Cameroonian authorities seized thousands of cartons in Yaoundé containing, among other things, counterfeit medicines, packaging materials used to repackage drugs and psychotropic substances.
paras.zh: 2025 年 4 月，世卫组织报告喀麦隆和中非共和国发现了一批伪造的阿莫西林，其标签上未列出活性成分。 2026 年 9 月，喀麦隆当局在雅温得查获了数千个纸箱，其中包括假药、用于重新包装药物和精神药物的包装材料。

paras.en: The trafficking routes largely follow the arteries of legitimate regional commerce. The ports of Apapa in Nigeria and Douala in Cameroon, along with river ports in Brazzaville and Bangui, were identified as major entry points. Authorities also seized 7.3 tonnes of medical products at airports across the region from 2020 through 2025.
paras.zh: 贩运路线主要沿着合法的区域商业动脉。尼日利亚的阿帕帕港和喀麦隆的杜阿拉港以及布拉柴维尔和班吉的河港被确定为主要入境点。 2020 年至 2025 年，当局还在该地区的机场查获了 7.3 吨医疗产品。

paras.en: The criminal networks behind the trade are equally varied. They include clandestine manufacturers, wholesalers, informal vendors, couriers, health care workers, corrupt public officials and online sellers.
paras.zh: 交易背后的犯罪网络同样多种多样。他们包括秘密制造商、批发商、非正规商贩、快递员、医护人员、腐败公职人员和网上卖家。

paras.en: Armed groups have also found ways to profit, according to the report, by looting health facilities, reselling medicines or collecting “taxes” from convoys crossing territory under their control.
paras.zh: 报告称，武装团体还找到了牟利的方法，包括抢劫医疗设施、倒卖药品或向穿越其控制领土的车队收取“税”。

paras.en: For patients, the consequences can be dire. Medicines containing the wrong ingredients or incorrect doses can cause poisoning, treatment failure and death. They can also contribute to antimicrobial resistance, allowing bacteria and other pathogens to evolve in ways that make existing medicines less effective.
paras.zh: 对于患者来说，后果可能是可怕的。含有错误成分或错误剂量的药物可能会导致中毒、治疗失败和死亡。它们还可能导致抗菌素耐药性，使细菌和其他病原体以降低现有药物疗效的方式进化。

paras.en: The illicit market is responding to a demand the formal health system has failed to meet
paras.zh: 非法市场正在满足正规卫生系统未能满足的需求

paras.en: In 2023, 12 children in Cameroon died after taking a pediatric syrup containing contaminated ingredients, according to UNODC.
paras.zh: 据毒品和犯罪问题办公室称，2023 年，喀麦隆有 12 名儿童在服用含有受污染成分的儿科糖浆后死亡。

paras.en: Yet, the same weaknesses that expose patients to illicit medicines also complicate efforts to stamp out the trade.
paras.zh: 然而，让患者接触非法药物的同样弱点也使取缔非法药物的努力变得更加复杂。

paras.en: “No State can tackle this transnational challenge alone,” said Ms. Bertrand, the agency’s regional representative.
paras.zh: “没有一个国家能够单独应对这一跨国挑战，”该机构的区域代表伯特兰女士说。

paras.en: The report calls for countries to harmonise their laws, strengthen controls and improve cross-border cooperation. But, it also argues for expanding access to safe and affordable medicines, for the illicit market is responding to a demand the formal health system has failed to meet.
paras.zh: 报告呼吁各国协调法律、加强管控并改善跨境合作。但是，它也主张扩大获得安全和负担得起的药物的机会，因为非法市场正在满足正规卫生系统未能满足的需求。

paras.en: Cutting off illegal supplies without addressing the shortages, high prices and distances that drive patients toward them risks leaving the market for illicit medicines largely intact.
paras.zh: 如果不解决药品短缺、价格高昂和患者就医的距离问题，就切断非法药品供应，这可能会导致非法药品市场基本完好无损。

articles.title: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues

paras.en: Djibouti faces ‘overlapping emergencies’ as Yemen’s refugee exodus continues
paras.zh: 随着也门难民继续逃亡，吉布提面临“重叠的紧急情况”

paras.en: Djibouti is facing “overlapping emergencies” as refugees fleeing the conflict in Yemen arrive on its shores while migrants continue to travel in the opposite direction, the UN migration agency (IOM) warned on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构（IOM）周二警告说，吉布提正面临“重叠的紧急情况”，逃离也门冲突的难民抵达吉布提海岸，而移民则继续朝相反方向迁移。

paras.en: More than 3,700 refugees have reached the Horn of Africa nation in the past three weeks after a dangerous crossing of the Red Sea, said Alexandre Coissac, head of IOM’s mission in the country, briefing journalists in Geneva by video link.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织驻该国代表团团长亚历山大·科瓦萨克 (Alexandre Coissac) 在日内瓦通过视频连线向记者介绍情况时表示，过去三周内，超过 3,700 名难民在危险穿越红海后抵达这个非洲之角国家。

paras.en: At the same time, IOM has recorded more than 20,000 journeys made from Ethiopia since 10 September, as migrants on the east African route continue to head for Yemen, in the hopes of finding work in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 与此同时，自 9 月 10 日以来，国际移民组织记录了超过 20,000 趟从埃塞俄比亚出发的旅程，东非航线上的移民继续前往也门，希望在海湾地区找到工作。

paras.en: Another 539 Ethiopian migrants have arrived from Yemen on their way home.
paras.zh: 另有 539 名埃塞俄比亚移民从也门抵达回国途中。

paras.en: “Djibouti is therefore confronting movement in both directions: people fleeing Yemen are arriving as refugees, migrants continue travelling towards Yemen, and other migrants are returning,” Mr. Coissac said.
paras.zh: “因此，吉布提面临着双向流动：逃离也门的人们作为难民抵达，移民继续前往也门，而其他移民正在返回，”科瓦萨克先生说。

paras.en: Between 20 and 30 September, more than 3,000 stranded migrants were observed along migratory routes in Djibouti, facing dehydration, exhaustion and shortages of food and water.
paras.zh: 9 月 20 日至 30 日期间，超过 3,000 名移民被困在吉布提的迁徙路线上，他们面临脱水、精疲力竭以及食物和水短缺的问题。

paras.en: Mr. Coissac said IOM had received reports of migrants dying in the desert near the border with Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 科伊萨克表示，国际移民组织收到了有关移民在埃塞俄比亚边境附近的沙漠中死亡的报告。

paras.en: The agency is providing food and water and helping those who request assisted voluntary return – but migrants are increasingly using secondary routes, making them harder to reach.
paras.zh: 该机构正在提供食物和水，并帮助那些要求协助自愿返回的人，但移民越来越多地使用次要路线，这使得他们更难到达。

paras.en: He said most migrants bound for Yemen were unaware of the grave situation as fighting between Government and Houthi forces intensifies, and that many aim to reach Saudi Arabia and other Gulf States.
paras.zh: 他说，随着政府和胡塞武装之间的战斗加剧，大多数前往也门的移民都没有意识到局势的严重性，许多人的目标是前往沙特阿拉伯和其他海湾国家。

paras.en: The Djiboutian authorities have responded rapidly, he said, but the scale and complexity of needs are stretching resources. He called for more support for new arrivals, migrants in distress and the host communities in Obock.
paras.zh: 他说，吉布提当局反应迅速，但需求的规模和复杂性正在耗尽资源。他呼吁为新移民、陷入困境的移民和奥博克的收容社区提供更多支持。

paras.en: “The country is now responding to people moving in different directions, for different reasons, but often facing the same immediate reality: they need safety, protection and basic assistance,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“国家现在正在应对因不同原因而走向不同方向的人们，但往往面临同样的直接现实：他们需要安全、保护和基本援助。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, news outlets on Tuesday reported that Yemen’s Saudi-backed Government forces say they have re-taken control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, at the mouth of the Red Sea, after launching a major offensive against the Iran-backed Houthis who control much of Yemen, including the capital.
paras.zh: 与此同时，新闻媒体周二报道称，沙特支持的也门政府军表示，在对控制也门大部分地区（包括首都）的伊朗支持的胡塞武装发动大规模攻势后，他们已重新控制了红海口的曼德海峡。

articles.title: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach

paras.en: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach
paras.zh: 从干旱到洪水：“超级”厄尔尼诺现象的影响范围不断扩大

paras.en: Across Papua New Guinea, water sources are drying up, crops are failing and food prices are rising months before the worst agricultural impacts are expected. Behind those warning signs is an El Niño whose Pacific Ocean temperatures have already surpassed the equivalent measurements during the historic 1997 and 2015 events – part of an unfolding climate pattern being dubbed a “Super El Niño” by some climate watchers.
paras.zh: 在巴布亚新几内亚各地，水源正在枯竭，庄稼歉收，粮食价格在预计最严重的农业影响出现之前几个月就在上涨。这些警告信号的背后是厄尔尼诺现象，其太平洋温度已经超过了 1997 年和 2015 年历史性事件期间的同等测量值，这是正在展开的气候模式的一部分，被一些气候观察家称为“超级厄尔尼诺现象”。

paras.en: More than 347 million children in nearly 100 countries and territories are expected to experience unusually wet or dry conditions between October and December 2026 due to El Niño, increasing the risk of extreme floods and droughts with potentially devastating consequences, according to latest UNICEF data.
paras.zh: 根据联合国儿童基金会的最新数据，由于厄尔尼诺现象，预计 2026 年 10 月至 12 月期间，近 100 个国家和地区的超过 3.47 亿儿童将经历异常潮湿或干燥的情况，从而增加极端洪水和干旱的风险，并可能造成灾难性后果。

paras.en: Here are highlights of the risks facing children:
paras.zh: 以下是儿童面临的风险的要点：

paras.en: - As extreme weather events become more widespread, youngsters could face increased risks of family separation, violence, exploitation and child marriage
paras.zh: - 随着极端天气事件变得更加普遍，青少年可能面临更大的家庭离散、暴力、剥削和童婚的风险

paras.en: - Colombia, Fiji, Papua New Guinea and the Philippines are among those expected to experience drier conditions that could likely to lead to drought and water scarcity, increasing displacement and worsening acute malnutrition
paras.zh: - 哥伦比亚、斐济、巴布亚新几内亚和菲律宾等国预计将经历更加干旱的天气，这可能导致干旱和缺水、流离失所人数增加和急性营养不良恶化

paras.en: - In the Greater Horn of Africa, wetter-than-normal conditions could trigger flash flooding, spread water-borne diseases and disrupt schooling
paras.zh: - 在大非洲之角，比正常情况更潮湿的天气可能会引发山洪、传播水传播疾病并扰乱学校教育

paras.en: - In crisis and conflict-affected countries such as Afghanistan and Chad, El Niño can be a direct threat to survival, worsening hunger and malnutrition among already vulnerable children
paras.zh: - 在阿富汗和乍得等受危机和冲突影响的国家，厄尔尼诺现象可能对生存构成直接威胁，加剧本已脆弱儿童的饥饿和营养不良

paras.en: - Every $1 invested in disaster risk reduction and prevention can save up to $15 in recovery costs, yet less than one per cent of humanitarian funding currently goes to anticipatory action
paras.zh: - 在减少和预防灾害风险方面每投资 1 美元，最多可节省 15 美元的恢复成本，但目前用于预防性行动的人道主义资金不足 1%

paras.en: The 2026-2027 El Niño is forecast to become one of the strongest on record, threatening to intensify drought, floods and other weather extremes across countries already grappling with food insecurity, displacement and economic pressures.
paras.zh: 预计 2026 年至 2027 年的厄尔尼诺现象将成为有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象之一，有可能加剧本已面临粮食不安全、流离失所和经济压力的国家的干旱、洪水和其他极端天气情况。

paras.en: El Niño can shift rainfall patterns thousands of kilometres from the tropical Pacific, leaving some regions facing drought and water shortages while others contend with heavier rains, flooding and heightened disease risks.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象可以使降雨模式偏离热带太平洋数千公里，导致一些地区面临干旱和缺水，而另一些地区则面临大雨、洪水和疾病风险增加的问题。

paras.en: More than 347 million children in nearly 100 countries and territories could be exposed to unusually dry or wet conditions between October and December because of El Niño, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) warns in a new analysis.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 在一份新分析中警告称，由于厄尔尼诺现象，近 100 个国家和地区的超过 3.47 亿儿童可能在 10 月至 12 月期间面临异常干燥或潮湿的环境。

paras.en: “For children, El Niño is far more than a weather pattern. It can mean increased displacement, malnutrition, water shortages and disease outbreaks,” said UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell. “Children are also at risk of schools closing, while families could experience added financial hardship.”
paras.zh: “对于儿童来说，厄尔尼诺现象不仅仅是一种天气模式。它可能意味着流离失所、营养不良、水资源短缺和疾病爆发的增加，”联合国儿童基金会执行主任凯瑟琳·拉塞尔说。 “儿童还面临学校关闭的风险，而家庭可能会遇到更多的经济困难。”

paras.en: Already, 1.1 billion children – nearly half of the world’s children – are already exposed to at least three overlapping climate-related hazards such as drought, extreme heat or floods.
paras.zh: 目前，11 亿儿童（近世界儿童的一半）已经面临至少三种与气候相关的重叠灾害，例如干旱、酷热或洪水。

paras.en: In Papua New Guinea, impact is already here
paras.zh: 在巴布亚新几内亚，影响已经显现

paras.en: Some of those consequences are already visible in Papua New Guinea, a mountainous Pacific island nation where remote terrain and difficult logistics have complicated responses to previous droughts. El Niño conditions have been present since mid-2026 and are forecast to peak between October and December.
paras.zh: 其中一些后果在巴布亚新几内亚已经显现出来。巴布亚新几内亚是一个多山的太平洋岛国，该国地形偏远，物流困难，使得应对之前的干旱变得更加复杂。厄尔尼诺现象自 2026 年中期以来一直存在，预计在 10 月至 12 月期间达到顶峰。

paras.en: In September, the Niño 3.4 index – a measure of sea-surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific used to track El Niño – surpassed those recorded during every previous El Niño event, including 1997 and 2015.
paras.zh: 9月，尼诺3.4指数——用于追踪厄尔尼诺现象的热带太平洋海面温度的衡量标准——超过了之前历次厄尔尼诺事件（包括1997年和2015年）记录的指数。

paras.en: The Government, which declared the event in June, has established a dedicated task force and approved a $112 million supplementary budget.
paras.zh: 政府于 6 月宣布举办这一活动，并成立了专门工作组并批准了 1.12 亿美元的补充预算。

paras.en: Some 1.2 million people are estimated to require direct food relief, with water shortages, crop losses, dwindling food reserves and higher prices already reported. Schools are being disrupted and concerns are growing over health, nutrition and bushfires.
paras.zh: 据报道，水资源短缺、农作物减产、粮食储备减少和价格上涨，估计约有 120 万人需要直接粮食救济。学校受到干扰，人们对健康、营养和丛林大火的担忧日益加剧。

paras.en: The largest impacts on agriculture and food security are expected from November.
paras.zh: 预计从 11 月份起，农业和粮食安全将受到最大影响。

paras.en: What dries out one part of the world can bring deluges to another.
paras.zh: 世界某一地区的干旱可能会给另一地区带来洪水。

paras.en: Across the Greater Horn of Africa, wetter-than-normal conditions could raise the risk of river and flash flooding, increase the spread of waterborne diseases and disrupt schooling.
paras.zh: 在整个大非洲之角，比正常情况更潮湿的天气可能会增加河流和山洪爆发的风险，增加水传播疾病的传播并扰乱学校教育。

paras.en: In the wider region – including Yemen, Sudan and Afghanistan – children living amid conflict and displacement face particularly acute risks because El Niño can magnify existing hunger, malnutrition and difficulties accessing essential services.
paras.zh: 在更广泛的地区——包括也门、苏丹和阿富汗——生活在冲突和流离失所中的儿童面临着特别严重的风险，因为厄尔尼诺现象会加剧现有的饥饿、营养不良和获得基本服务的困难。

paras.en: For governments, the forecasts offer something disasters often do not: time.
paras.zh: 对于政府来说，预测提供了灾难通常无法提供的东西：时间。

paras.en: Asia and the Pacific is expected to bear a particularly large share of the exposure, with some 190 million children – more than half of the global total identified by UNICEF – living in areas forecast to experience unusually wet or dry conditions between October and December.
paras.zh: 亚太地区预计将承受特别大的风险，约有 1.9 亿儿童（超过联合国儿童基金会确定的全球儿童总数的一半）生活在预计 10 月至 12 月期间将经历异常潮湿或干燥天气的地区。

paras.en: The World Food Programme (WFP) is urging countries across the region to strengthen social protection systems that can rapidly expand when droughts, floods or economic shocks threaten household food security.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）敦促该地区各国加强社会保障体系，以便在干旱、洪水或经济冲击威胁家庭粮食安全时迅速扩大社会保障体系。

paras.en: “A flood, drought, or sudden economic shock can wipe out a family’s progress in a matter of days,” said Samir Wanmali, WFP Regional Director for Asia and the Pacific. “Social protection systems that are inclusive, nutrition-sensitive and ready to expand during a crisis can prevent a temporary shock from becoming a lasting setback.”
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署亚太区域主任萨米尔·万马利表示：“洪水、干旱或突然的经济冲击可能会在几天内毁掉一个家庭的进步。” “具有包容性、对营养敏感并准备在危机期间扩大的社会保护体系可以防止暂时的冲击变成持久的挫折。”

paras.en: The urgency is sharpened by lessons from earlier El Niño episodes.
paras.zh: 早期厄尔尼诺现象的教训加剧了这一紧迫性。

paras.en: In analysis published in May, the UN Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) pointed to the 2015-16 event as a warning of how climate extremes can cascade through economies and societies.
paras.zh: 在 5 月发布的分析中，联合国亚洲及太平洋经济社会委员会 (ESCAP) 指出 2015-16 年的事件是对极端气候如何在经济和社会中蔓延的警告。

paras.en: More than 70 per cent of Southeast Asia’s land area experienced drought during that episode, exposing more than 200 million people to severe drought at its peak.
paras.zh: 在那次事件中，东南亚70%以上的陆地面积经历了干旱，最严重时使2亿多人遭受严重干旱。

paras.en: The pressures this time are unfolding against tighter government finances, elevated debt and persistent economic uncertainty and supply chain worries, potentially reducing the ability of governments and households to absorb another shock.
paras.zh: 这次的压力来自政府财政紧缩、债务增加、持续的经济不确定性和供应链担忧，可能会降低政府和家庭承受另一次冲击的能力。

paras.en: Meanwhile, climate change is raising the baseline risk. Higher temperatures accelerate the loss of moisture from soil and vegetation, potentially intensifying drought when rainfall falls short.
paras.zh: 与此同时，气候变化正在提高基线风险。气温升高会加速土壤和植被水分的流失，当降雨量不足时，可能会加剧干旱。

paras.en: For governments, that means preparing for extremes in both directions – from failing rains, water shortages and crop losses to intense rainfall, flooding and landslides. The challenge is to turn forecasts into decisions before harvests fail, reservoirs run low or floods force families from their homes.
paras.zh: 对于政府来说，这意味着要为两个方向的极端情况做好准备——从降雨不足、水资源短缺和农作物损失到强降雨、洪水和山体滑坡。面临的挑战是在收成歉收、水库水位下降或洪水迫使家庭逃离家园之前将预测转化为决策。

paras.en: That will be the focus of a regional El Niño exchange beginning on next week in Bangkok, bringing governments, meteorological experts, UN agencies and frontline practitioners together to compare emerging impacts and lessons from previous crises.
paras.zh: 这将是下周在曼谷开始的区域厄尔尼诺交流的重点，各国政府、气象专家、联合国机构和一线从业人员将齐聚一堂，比较新出现的影响和以往危机的教训。

paras.en: For Papua New Guinea, however, the warning period is already giving way to impact.
paras.zh: 然而，对于巴布亚新几内亚来说，警告期已经让位于影响。

paras.en: Water shortages, damaged crops and rising prices offer an early glimpse of what an exceptional El Niño could mean far beyond the warming waters of the Pacific.
paras.zh: 水资源短缺、农作物受损和价格上涨让人们初步了解了异常的厄尔尼诺现象在太平洋变暖的水域之外可能意味着什么。

articles.title: Should 'cracking kid' Bamber be awarded England call-up?

paras.en: Ethan Bamber for England? Should Warwickshire seamer be considered for spot in Test cricket bowling attack?
paras.zh: 伊桑·班伯代表英格兰队？沃里克郡缝合器是否应该被考虑参加测试板球保龄球进攻？

paras.en: Ethan Bamber took 69 wickets at an average below 20 as Warwickshire won the County Championship in 2026; Michael Atherton says of Bamber: "He's somebody who wants to get absolutely the most out of every little bit of talent he's got"; Chris Woakes calls Jofra Archer leader of Test attack
paras.zh: 伊森·班伯 (Ethan Bamber) 拿下 69 个三柱门，平均得分低于 20 个，帮助沃里克郡赢得 2026 年郡锦标赛；迈克尔·阿瑟顿 (Michael Atherton) 评价班伯 (Bamber)：“他绝对想充分利用自己所拥有的每一点天赋”；克里斯·沃克斯 (Chris Woakes) 称 Jofra Archer 为测试攻击的领导者

paras.en: Should England add Ethan Bamber to their battery of seam bowlers in Test cricket?
paras.zh: 英格兰是否应该将伊森·班伯（Ethan Bamber）加入到他们的板球测试赛中的接缝投球手阵容中？

paras.en: The Warwickshire star, 27, was the leading County Championship wicket-taker in the country in 2026, with his 69 scalps at an average of 19.39 helping the Bears to the Division One title.
paras.zh: 这位 27 岁的沃里克郡球星是 2026 年全国郡锦标赛三柱门的领先者，他以 69 次头皮得分，平均得分为 19.39 帮助熊队夺得一级冠军。

paras.en: Bamber is an Ollie Robinson figure as opposed to a Jofra Archer one, relying on skill and nagging accuracy rather than pace and hostility.
paras.zh: 班伯是奥利·罗宾逊式的人物，而不是乔弗拉·阿切尔式的人物，他依靠的是技巧和烦人的准确性，而不是速度和敌意。

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream no contract with NOW
paras.zh: - 最新的天空体育交易或与 NOW 签订无合同

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: - Latest England cricket news, views and match reports
paras.zh: - 最新的英格兰板球新闻、观点和比赛报道

paras.en: But with it now in vogue for wicketkeepers to stand up close to the stumps to seamers wobbling the ball, perhaps Bamber has a chance of a maiden international call-up?
paras.zh: 但现在流行让守门员站在靠近树桩的地方让接球手晃动球，也许班伯有机会首次入选国家队？

paras.en: Bamber for England? 'Never say never...'
paras.zh: 班伯代表英格兰队？ '永不说永不...'

paras.en: Sky Sports' Michael Atherton said on the England prospects of the former Middlesex man, who has 308 scalps in 89 first-class matches at an average below 27: "A few years ago, you'd have said no - a bowler of 78, 80 miles an hour, wobbling it about.
paras.zh: 天空体育的迈克尔·阿瑟顿在谈到这位前米德尔塞克斯球员的英格兰前景时表示，他在 89 场一流比赛中打出了 308 次头皮，平均得分低于 27 分：“几年前，你可能会说不——一个时速 78 英里、时速 80 英里、摇摇晃晃的投球手。

paras.en: "But now everybody's keen on the wobble seam and the wicketkeeper standing up. So never say never. I wouldn't imagine so but I see him as a very, very good county bowler.
paras.zh: “但现在每个人都热衷于摆动接缝和站起来的守门员。所以永远不要说永远。我不会这么想，但我认为他是一个非常非常好的县投球手。

paras.en: "England have got Ollie Robinson there at the moment and they'll always have one of those fellas in the mix, won't they?
paras.zh: “英格兰现在有奥利·罗宾逊，他们总会有这样的人之一，不是吗？

paras.en: "Whether it's Robinson or Sam Cook, who seems to be kind of Robinson's understudy at the moment, so you could see Bamber maybe in that role.
paras.zh: “无论是罗宾逊还是萨姆·库克，他目前似乎是罗宾逊的替补，所以你可以看到班伯可能扮演这个角色。

paras.en: "He's a cracking kid and somebody who wants to get absolutely the most out of every little bit of talent that he's got.
paras.zh: “他是一个出色的孩子，并且绝对希望充分利用他所拥有的每一点天赋。

paras.en: "He moved to Warwickshire with ambitions to go to a club that's challenging for things and is making the most of what he's got."
paras.zh: “他搬到沃里克郡的野心是去一家充满挑战的俱乐部，并充分利用他所拥有的一切。”

paras.en: Bamber brushed off the likelihood of international honours while speaking to Cricinfo at the recent Professional Cricketers' Association awards in London, saying: "If that ship was ever in the harbour, it's definitely sailed now.
paras.zh: 班伯最近在伦敦举行的职业板球运动员协会颁奖典礼上接受 Cricinfo 采访时，对获得国际荣誉的可能性不屑一顾，他说：“如果那艘船曾经停泊在港口，那么它现在肯定已经航行了。

paras.en: "What I'm thinking of is how I can contribute next year for Warwickshire, and try to help us continue to be successful moving forward. That's really what makes me a bit nervous and excited."
paras.zh: “我想到的是明年如何为沃里克郡做出贡献，并努力帮助我们继续成功前进。这确实让我有点紧张和兴奋。”

paras.en: 'Archer at peak of his powers - now the leader of the attack'
paras.zh: “弓箭手正处于力量巅峰——现在是进攻的领导者”

paras.en: England's attack starred during the 3-0 rout of Pakistan this summer, with Robinson bagging 21 wickets at an average below nine and Archer 12 at 26.66.
paras.zh: 英格兰队在今年夏天 3-0 击败巴基斯坦的比赛中表现出色，罗宾逊攻入 21 个三柱门，平均得分低于 9 个，阿切尔则攻入 12 个三柱门，平均得分为 26.66。

paras.en: Gus Atkinson and Josh Tongue also played their part, while Cook, Sonny Baker and Matthew Fisher are back-up options.
paras.zh: 格斯·阿特金森和乔什·汤格也发挥了作用，而库克、桑尼·贝克和马修·费舍尔则是替补。

paras.en: The quicks will return to red-ball cricket from December 17, live on Sky Sports, for a three-Test series in South Africa - Stephen Fleming's first assignment as head coach.
paras.zh: 快队将从 12 月 17 日起重返红球板球比赛，天空体育直播，在南非进行三场测试系列赛，这是史蒂芬·弗莱明作为主教练的第一次任务。

paras.en: Former England seamer Chris Woakes, speaking at the launch of the ECB's 'Cricket for Teachers' initiative, told Sky Sports News: "The bowling attack looks great, plenty of depth.
paras.zh: 前英格兰队球员克里斯·沃克斯在欧洲央行“教师板球”倡议启动仪式上发表讲话时告诉天空体育新闻：“保龄球进攻看起来很棒，有足够的深度。

paras.en: "Robinson has come back in and done fantastically well - South Africa will be a different challenge but he has the skills to succeed.
paras.zh: “罗宾逊已经回归并表现出色——南非将是一个不同的挑战，但他有能力取得成功。

paras.en: "The beauty of Jofra is that he has played a lot of cricket over the last few years and stayed injury-free - he looks as fit as ever and is kind of the leader of the attack now.
paras.zh: “乔弗拉的美妙之处在于，他在过去几年里打了很多板球并且没有受伤——他看起来和以前一样健康，现在是进攻的领导者。

paras.en: "He has matured a lot as a bowler and a person. He is at the peak of his powers and wants to be playing his best Test cricket.
paras.zh: “作为一名投球手和一个人，他已经成熟了很多。他正处于能力的顶峰，希望打出最好的板球测试赛。
