paras.en: The magistrate agreed to re-mention the case if other charges were laid.
paras.zh: 如果提出其他指控，治安法官同意重新提起此案。

paras.en: Kirstyn Nicholson, a Legal Aid solicitor representing Ullah, did not apply for bail and sought an adjournment.
paras.zh: 代表乌拉的法律援助律师克丝汀·尼科尔森没有申请保释，并寻求休庭。

paras.en: Ullah was remanded in custody until the matter returns to court on 26 October.
paras.zh: Ullah 被还押候审，直至案件于 10 月 26 日返回法庭。

articles.title: Detective breaks down in court as she recalls finding Beau Lamarre-Condon’s alleged murder victims
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: A detective has broken down in court while describing the moment she found the bodies of two men allegedly murdered by former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon.
paras.zh: 一名侦探在法庭上描述她发现据称被前警官博·拉马尔·康登谋杀的两名男子尸体的那一刻时，情绪崩溃了。

paras.en: Jesse Baird, 26, and his new boyfriend Luke Davies, 29, were shot dead in a Sydney terrace in February 2024.
paras.zh: 2024 年 2 月，26 岁的杰西·贝尔德 (Jesse Baird) 和 29 岁的新男友卢克·戴维斯 (Luke Davies) 在悉尼露台被枪杀。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon, Baird’s ex and a then-police officer, has pleaded not guilty to murder, arguing the men died in two separate violent struggles after he entered the home disguised as a food delivery rider.
paras.zh: 贝尔德的前任、当时的警官拉马尔-康登（Lamarre-Condon）对谋杀罪不认罪，称在他伪装成送餐员进入家中后，这些人在两次不同的暴力冲突中死亡。

paras.en: His subsequent efforts to dispose of their bodies at Bungonia – 200km south of Sydney – were indicative of his panic about the unexpected deaths, his lawyer has said.
paras.zh: 他的律师表示，他随后在悉尼以南 200 公里的 Bungonia 处理尸体的努力表明了他对意外死亡的恐慌。

paras.en: A detective who co-ordinated a search of Cella Farm, where Lamarre-Condon allegedly tried unsuccessfully to sink the bodies in a dam, told the alleged murderer’s trial how she eventually found the remains of the two slain men eight days after the shooting.
paras.zh: 一名负责协调对塞拉农场的搜查的侦探，据称拉马尔-康登曾试图将尸体沉入水坝，但未成功。该侦探告诉对涉嫌凶手的审判，她最终是如何在枪击事件发生八天后找到两名被杀男子的遗体的。

paras.en: Detective Senior Constable Christine Abela had been involved in searching the farm before she was diverted to a Greek monastery about 20km away on 27 February.
paras.zh: 高级侦探克里斯蒂娜·阿贝拉 (Christine Abela) 参与了对农场的搜查，随后于 2 月 27 日被转移到约 20 公里外的一座希腊修道院。

paras.en: “There was a strong smell as soon as I got out of the car,” she told a NSW supreme court jury on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “我一下车就闻到了一股浓烈的气味，”她周三告诉新南威尔士州最高法院陪审团。

paras.en: The detective became emotional as prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC took her through her memories of the odour becoming stronger as she approached two blue and silver surfboard bags.
paras.zh: 当检察官布雷特·哈特菲尔德 SC 向她回忆起当她走近两个蓝色和银色的冲浪板包时，气味变得更强烈时，侦探变得情绪化。

paras.en: The bags were covered with sticks, branches and stones, the detective said.
paras.zh: 侦探说，袋子里装满了棍棒、树枝和石头。

paras.en: At Cella Farm, crime scene officers discovered a padlock had been cut, the jury heard.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，在塞拉农场，犯罪现场警官发现一把挂锁被剪断。

paras.en: Prosecutors allege the lock was cut with an angle grinder Lamarre-Condon had asked his friend to buy on the drive from Sydney.
paras.zh: 检察官称，这把锁是用角磨机切割的，拉马尔-康登让他的朋友在从悉尼开车过来的路上购买了角磨机。

paras.en: Concrete blocks and gym weights were found at the edge of a dam on the farm, the jury was told.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，在农场大坝边缘发现了混凝土块和健身重物。

paras.en: The prosecution alleges Lamarre-Condon became infatuated with Baird after they broke off contact in November 2023, resolving to murder him.
paras.zh: 检方指控拉马尔-康登在 2023 年 11 月与贝尔德断绝联系后迷恋贝尔德，并决心谋杀他。

paras.en: However, Lamarre-Condon’s close friend Nicole Harvell told the court on Wednesday she could not remember any conversation with the ex-officer about Baird after the pair broke up for the final time.
paras.zh: 然而，拉马尔-康登的密友妮可·哈维尔周三告诉法庭，在两人最后一次分手后，她不记得与这位前警官有过任何关于贝尔德的谈话。

paras.en: That was despite her being in almost daily contact with the now-31-year-old.
paras.zh: 尽管她几乎每天都与这位现年 31 岁的年轻人保持联系，但情况还是如此。

paras.en: Senior Constable Harvell recalled trying to contact her friend when she saw media reports that he was under suspicion for the two men’s deaths.
paras.zh: 高级警官哈维尔回忆说，当她看到媒体报道称他的朋友因这两人的死亡而受到怀疑时，她试图联系她的朋友。

paras.en: “Fuck Beau, are you ok?” she texted to Lamarre-Condon’s phone.
paras.zh: “操，博，你还好吗？”她给拉马尔-康登的手机发短信。

paras.en: The sworn officer maintained under cross-examination the accused killer had months earlier told her about enlisting his mother to help him lie to Baird.
paras.zh: 宣誓就职的警官在盘问中坚称，被告凶手几个月前曾告诉她，他的母亲帮助他向贝尔德撒谎。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon posted an Instagram story with a bunch of flowers and the caption: “When he’s in Melbourne but still sends you these.”
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登 (Lamarre-Condon) 在 Instagram 上发布了一条带有一束鲜花的故事，并配文：“当他在墨尔本但仍然会向您发送这些花时。”

paras.en: But publication was restricted to select friends that did not include Baird.
paras.zh: 但出版仅限于贝尔德以外的精选朋友。

paras.en: The photo was designed to imply Baird sent flowers to the accused, despite the pair not being in a relationship at the time, Harvell said.
paras.zh: 哈维尔说，这张照片的目的是暗示贝尔德向被告送花，尽管两人当时并没有恋爱关系。

paras.en: When Baird discovered the ruse, Lamarre-Condon spent $160 on a bouquet identical to the photo to lie to Baird, the officer’s friend said.
paras.zh: 该警官的朋友说，当贝尔德发现这个诡计时，拉马尔-康登花了 160 美元购买了一束与照片一模一样的花束，以对贝尔德撒谎。

paras.en: Lamarre-Condon then sent a photo to Baird showing his mother with the fresh bouquet.
paras.zh: 拉马尔-康登随后向贝尔德发送了一张照片，照片中他的母亲拿着新鲜的花束。

paras.en: The bouquet had a handwritten note to imply his mother had been the intended recipient and they were from her partner, who was in Melbourne, the jury heard.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，花束上有一张手写的便条，暗示他的母亲是预定的接收者，而这些花束是来自她在墨尔本的伴侣。

paras.en: “I recall the accused telling me his mother had written that note,” Harvell said.
paras.zh: “我记得被告告诉我那张纸条是他母亲写的，”哈维尔说。

articles.title: Pornhub returns to Australia but only for adults with Apple devices

paras.en: Pornhub has returned to Australia, eight months after it went dark due to age verification laws, but only adults with Apple devices will be able to access the site.
paras.zh: Pornhub 因年龄验证法而关闭八个月后，现已重返澳大利亚，但只有拥有 Apple 设备的成年人才能访问该网站。

paras.en: On Wednesday, parent company Aylo said it was restoring access for "eligible adult users in Australia" who have "confirmed their age through Apple's Australian age-verification process".
paras.zh: 周三，母公司 Aylo 表示，正在恢复“澳大利亚合格成年用户”的访问权限，这些用户“通过苹果的澳大利亚年龄验证流程确认了自己的年龄”。

paras.en: The world's biggest porn site left the Australian market in March, saying new laws requiring users to prove they were over 18 would not protect children and "instead creates harms relating to data privacy" and exposure to content on non-compliant platforms.
paras.zh: 全球最大的色情网站于 3 月份退出澳大利亚市场，称要求用户证明自己已年满 18 岁的新法律不会保护儿童，“反而会造成与数据隐私相关的伤害”以及在不合规平台上接触内容的情况。

paras.en: Apple recently introduced new age checks in Australia, following a rollout in the UK.
paras.zh: 苹果继在英国推出新的年龄检查后，最近在澳大利亚推出了新的年龄检查。

paras.en: In March, Australia introduced stricter laws requiring users to prove they were over 18 in order to access adult content such as porn, R-rated video games and sexually explicit AI chatbots.
paras.zh: 今年 3 月，澳大利亚出台了更严格的法律，要求用户证明自己已年满 18 岁才能访问成人内容，例如色情、R 级视频游戏和露骨的人工智能聊天机器人。

paras.en: The country's online safety regulator said the changes would protect children from harmful content and platforms would be fined for breaches.
paras.zh: 该国的在线安全监管机构表示，这些变化将保护儿童免受有害内容的侵害，平台将因违规行为而被罚款。

paras.en: Critics said there would be issues with data privacy and users finding ways to trick age-verification technologies such as facial recognition, digital IDs and credit card details.
paras.zh: 批评者表示，数据隐私和用户会想方设法欺骗年龄验证技术，例如面部识别、数字身份证和信用卡详细信息，这会存在问题。

paras.en: Aylo said it was returning to Australia as Apple has "set a benchmark" by setting default child safety features on all devices unless owners confirmed they are adults.
paras.zh: Aylo 表示，苹果将重返澳大利亚，因为苹果已经“设定了基准”，在所有设备上设置默认的儿童安全功能，除非用户确认自己是成年人。

paras.en: This, in effect, makes "every phone or tablet kid-safe as a starting point," it said.
paras.zh: 它说，这实际上使“每部手机或平板电脑都以儿童安全为出发点”。

paras.en: "For years, Aylo has advocated for device-based age verification as the most effective and privacy-protecting approach to help prevent minors from accessing age-inappropriate content online," said Aylo's vice-president of brand and community Alex Kekesi.
paras.zh: Aylo 品牌和社区副总裁 Alex Kekesi 表示：“多年来，Aylo 一直倡导基于设备的年龄验证，将其视为最有效和保护隐私的方法，以帮助防止未成年人在线访问不适合年龄的内容。”

paras.en: Australians with Apple devices that have been "age-verified" will be "served a standard adult users experience", she said.
paras.zh: 她说，拥有经过“年龄验证”的苹果设备的澳大利亚人将“获得标准的成人用户体验”。

paras.en: Apple users can prove they are over 18 using a credit card, their passport, a driver's license or a government-issued ID.
paras.zh: Apple 用户可以使用信用卡、护照、驾照或政府颁发的身份证件证明自己已年满 18 岁。

paras.en: Kekesi added that having devices with child safety features as a default meant adults don't have to "surrender unnecessary personal information to multiple apps and websites".
paras.zh: Kekesi 补充说，默认具有儿童安全功能的设备意味着成年人不必“向多个应用程序和网站提交不必要的个人信息”。

paras.en: It also limits the usefulness of virtual private networks (VPNs) to circumvent age-verification technologies, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，这还限制了虚拟专用网络（VPN）规避年龄验证技术的实用性。

paras.en: VPNs are commonly used to trick a site into thinking a user is logging on from another country, giving the user access to the site.
paras.zh: VPN 通常用于欺骗网站，让其认为用户正在从另一个国家/地区登录，从而使用户能够访问该网站。

articles.title: The Republican candidates walking a Trump tightrope

paras.en: As US President Donald Trump hits the campaign trail in the final sprint to the midterm elections, he is launching an emphatic defence of America's economic performance, trying - as he often does - to bend reality to his will.
paras.zh: 当美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在中期选举的最后冲刺中开始竞选活动时，他正在大力捍卫美国的经济表现，并试图——正如他经常做的那样——让现实屈服于他的意愿。

paras.en: "We have the best economic numbers of any president in the history of our country, and yet people don't know about it because the press won't talk about it," he said last week.
paras.zh: 他上周表示：“我们拥有我国历史上最好的经济数据，但人们却不知道，因为媒体不会谈论它。”

paras.en: While some economic indicators, including roaring stock market indexes and low US poverty rates, are indeed historic, the overall picture is not nearly as rosy.
paras.zh: 尽管一些经济指标，包括飙升的股市指数和美国较低的贫困率，确实具有历史意义，但总体情况并不那么乐观。

paras.en: Trump is often dismissive of concerns about aï¬ordability and the high cost of living in the US, describing them as "fake" and a Democrat-inspired "hoax".
paras.zh: 特朗普经常对美国的负担能力和高生活成本的担忧不屑一顾，称它们是“假的”和受民主党启发的“骗局”。

paras.en: The American public, however, sees it differently - and some key economic indicators provide ample evidence for their discontent. Inflation remains high at 3.4%, outpacing wage growth. The average cost of petrol has soared to $4.37 (Â£3.30) a gallon and beef prices are at a record high.
paras.zh: 然而，美国公众却有不同的看法——一些关键经济指标为他们的不满提供了充分的证据。通货膨胀率仍处于 3.4% 的高位，超过了工资增长。汽油的平均成本已飙升至每加仑 4.37 美元（3.30 英镑），牛肉价格也创历史新高。

paras.en: According to a YouGov survey, 63% of respondents believe the economy is "getting worse". An AP/NORC poll released last week found just 17% of adult Americans approve of the president's handling of cost-of-living issues, while 26% approve of his handling of the economy overall.
paras.zh: 根据 YouGov 的调查，63% 的受访者认为经济正在“变得更糟”。美联社/NORC 上周公布的一项民意调查显示，只有 17% 的美国成年成年人赞同总统对生活成本问题的处理方式，而 26% 的人赞同他对整体经济的处理方式。

paras.en: Those polls also suggest that many of Trump's policies, including tariffs, aggressive immigration enforcement and the ongoing conflict with Iran, are widely unpopular.
paras.zh: 这些民意调查还表明，特朗普的许多政策，包括关税、激进的移民执法以及与伊朗持续的冲突，都普遍不受欢迎。

paras.en: "We ask our voters their motivation to turn out, and what we find is cost of living, cost of living, cost of living," said Avery James, the director of communications at the Republican-aligned polling company Echelon Insights. "That's the top issue."
paras.zh: 与共和党结盟的民意调查公司 Echelon Insights 的通讯总监艾弗里·詹姆斯 (Avery James) 表示：“我们询问选民投票的动机，我们发现的是生活成本、生活成本、生活成本。” “这是最重要的问题。”

paras.en: That has left Republicans running for office in the Congressional elections on 3 November with an agonising choice - should they be distancing themselves from Trump?
paras.zh: 这让参加 11 月 3 日国会选举的共和党人面临着一个痛苦的选择——他们是否应该与特朗普保持距离？

paras.en: Their fear is that by echoing his sunny outlook they risk losing a number of electoral races that are currently projected to be very tight. But they also know that being seen to break with the president on the state of the economy is far from consequence free.
paras.zh: 他们担心，如果效仿他的乐观前景，他们可能会输掉一些目前预计会非常激烈的选举。但他们也知道，在经济状况问题上与总统决裂绝非没有后果。

paras.en: There are few Republican politicians as loyal to the president as Floridian House Congressman Byron Donalds. And there are few US states as traditionally hospitable to Republicans as Florida.
paras.zh: 很少有共和党政治家像佛罗里达州众议院议员拜伦·唐纳德那样忠于总统。美国很少有州像佛罗里达州那样传统上对共和党人热情好客。

paras.en: But even in the president's adopted home, which he carried in each of his three elections and which hasn't had a Democratic governor since 1999, candidates like Donalds are finding themselves having to adapt their pro-Republican messaging to acknowledge economic concerns.
paras.zh: 但即使是在总统的第二故乡——他在三届选举中都获得了胜利，并且自 1999 年以来就没有民主党州长了——像唐纳德这样的候选人也发现自己必须调整自己的亲共和党信息，以承认对经济的担忧。

paras.en: Donalds - who stood by Trump as he fought his way back to power after his 2020 election defeat and took a prominent role in his 2024 election campaign - is now running for governor of Florida, with Trump's encouragement and enthusiastic endorsement.
paras.zh: 唐纳德在特朗普 2020 年大选失利后重新掌权时一直支持特朗普，并在 2024 年竞选活动中发挥了重要作用。在特朗普的鼓励和热情支持下，唐纳德现在正在竞选佛罗里达州州长。

paras.en: When I saw him at a Hispanic church in Kissimmee, he was preaching to the proverbial choir - but pitching his message with a nod to the fact that for many money is currently tight.
paras.zh: 当我在基西米的一座西班牙裔教堂见到他时，他正在向众所周知的唱诗班布道，但在传达他的信息时，他承认目前对许多人来说资金紧张。

paras.en: "We're the best state in America," he said before acknowledging: "But success has gotten expensive."
paras.zh: “我们是美国最好的州，”他在承认之前说道，“但成功的代价却很高。”

paras.en: He ticked through a laundry list of Florida constituents â retirees, teachers, emergency workers, restaurant staff and local government employees, flagging that they need to be able to "make ends meet".
paras.zh: 他列出了佛罗里达州选民的详细名单——退休人员、教师、紧急救援人员、餐馆工作人员和地方政府雇员，并指出他们需要能够“维持收支平衡”。

paras.en: In his stump speech, Donalds didn't mention Trump at all. He leaned heavily into stories of his own financial hardship during his younger years, of living paycheque to paycheque and waiting tables at the traditional southern style restaurant chain Cracker Barrel.
paras.zh: 唐纳德在他的巡回演讲中根本没有提到特朗普。他非常喜欢讲述自己年轻时经济困难的故事，靠工资过活，在传统的南方风格连锁餐厅 Cracker Barrel 里当服务员。

paras.en: When he invited audience questions, there were the usual cultural hot-button topics, like the perceived threat of Sharia law in America, transgender athletes in women's sports and youth crime in public spaces.
paras.zh: 当他邀请观众提问时，有一些常见的文化热点话题，比如美国伊斯兰教法的威胁、女子体育中的变性运动员以及公共场所的青少年犯罪。

paras.en: But his supporters also wanted to talk about the high cost of housing - insurance, taxes, mortgage rates and home-owner fees - and healthcare worker shortages.
paras.zh: 但他的支持者还想谈论高昂的住房成本——保险、税收、抵押贷款利率和房主费用——以及医护人员短缺。

paras.en: Trump may have mocked the term affordability, but Donalds â who is criss-crossing the state on an "affordability tour" â isn't the only Republican candidate talking about high prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普可能嘲笑了“负担能力”这个词，但正在全国各地进行“负担能力之旅”的唐纳德并不是唯一一个谈论高房价的共和党候选人。

paras.en: It was a similar track at a campaign event in a Tampa seafood market the next day, when Bryan Avila, who is running for lieutenant governor on the same ticket as Donalds, took questions on energy prices and data centre construction.
paras.zh: 第二天在坦帕海鲜市场举行的竞选活动中也出现了类似的情况，当时与唐纳德同票竞选副州长的布莱恩·阿维拉(Bryan Avila)回答了有关能源价格和数据中心建设的问题。

paras.en: "Everything is going up in prices, from food to even books for people going to college," said John Carroll, who serves on a Florida county housing commission. "It's a challenge no matter which party is in power, but here in Florida it's been Republican for so long."
paras.zh: “一切东西的价格都在上涨，从食物到上大学的书本，”佛罗里达州住房委员会的约翰·卡罗尔说。 “无论哪个政党执政，这都是一个挑战，但在佛罗里达州，长期以来一直是共和党执政。”

paras.en: Meanwhile in Texas, Governor Greg Abbott last month went to Texarkana to host a "rural affordability roundtable".
paras.zh: 与此同时，德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特上个月前往特克萨卡纳举办了一次“农村负担能力圆桌会议”。

paras.en: "We must lower costs for Texans in every corner of our state, and with my affordability agenda we will help make Texas the most affordable state in America."
paras.zh: “我们必须降低德克萨斯州每个角落的成本，通过我的负担能力议程，我们将帮助德克萨斯州成为美国最负担得起的州。”

paras.en: And in Iowa, Ashley Hinson, a Republican congresswoman running for Senate, unveiled her own "affordability agenda".
paras.zh: 在爱荷华州，竞选参议员的共和党女议员阿什利·辛森(Ashley Hinson)公布了她自己的“负担能力议程”。

paras.en: "Iowans are paying the price for Washington's failures, and they deserve real relief that actually lowers costs," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“爱荷华州正在为华盛顿的失败付出代价，他们应该得到真正的救济，从而真正降低成本。”

paras.en: Hinson also recently called for the president to quickly end the Iran war â a sentiment echoed by Republican Senate candidates in Ohio and Michigan. Two of Hinson's Iowa colleagues in the House of Representatives went so far as to vote for a Democratic-backed measure to curtail Trump's war powers in Iran.
paras.zh: 辛森最近还呼吁总统迅速结束伊朗战争——俄亥俄州和密歇根州的共和党参议员候选人也表达了同样的观点。辛森在爱荷华州的两名众议院同事甚至投票支持民主党支持的一项措施，以限制特朗普在伊朗的战争权力。

paras.en: For the past two years it has been Republicans who control the levers of power in the nation's capital â from the White House to both chambers of Congress. Inevitably, that makes for a challenging rhetorical pirouette among Republican candidates this time round when it comes to touching on Trump's less popular policies.
paras.zh: 过去两年来，共和党控制着美国首都的权力杠杆——从白宫到国会参众两院。不可避免地，这一次共和党候选人在谈到特朗普不太受欢迎的政策时，会在言辞上出现挑战性的旋转。

paras.en: Even Donalds has faced allegations that he is trying to open daylight between himself and Trump. The media was awash in reports recently that he had removed most prominent mentions of Trump from his campaign website.
paras.zh: 就连唐纳德也面临着他试图在自己和特朗普之间拨开阳光的指控。最近媒体充斥着有关他从竞选网站上删除了最显着提及特朗普的报道。

paras.en: It was a story Donalds quickly denied â and one that prompted an angry response from the president himself.
paras.zh: 唐纳德斯很快否认了这一消息，并引发了总统本人的愤怒回应。

paras.en: "Another Fake Story is that a very close friend of mine, a man I endorsed very early, Byron Donalds, is taking me off his website and campaign materials," Trump posted on his Truth Social website. "If Florida thought the story that Byron 'dropped' me was true, he would lose the election, and that would be a terrible thing because he's going to be a fantastic governor!"
paras.zh: 特朗普在他的真相社交网站上发帖称：“另一个虚假故事是，我的一位非常亲密的朋友，我很早就支持的拜伦·唐纳德兹，正在将我从他的网站和竞选材料中删除。” “如果佛罗里达州认为拜伦‘抛弃’我的故事是真的，他就会输掉选举，那将是一件可怕的事情，因为他将成为一名出色的州长！”

paras.en: Donalds did say, however, that when it comes to addressing how to tackle high prices, Trump shouldn't be a factor.
paras.zh: 然而，唐纳德确实表示，在解决如何应对高物价问题时，特朗普不应该成为一个因素。

paras.en: "That's not even about President Trump," he told reporters after the website story broke. "I'm the one asking for the votes for the people of Florida to be their governor."
paras.zh: “这甚至与特朗普总统无关，”他在网站报道曝光后告诉记者。 “我是那个要求佛罗里达州人民投票担任州长的人。”

paras.en: While Donalds and Trump remain tight, the same cannot be said for Republican candidates who have gone farther in their criticism.
paras.zh: 尽管唐纳德和特朗普关系仍然紧张，但对于批评得更进一步的共和党候选人来说，情况却并非如此。

paras.en: Congresswoman Maria Salazar aired a television spot in which she bluntly said Trump's immigration crackdown had "gone too far". Trump reposted a handful of messages on Truth Social accusing the Cuban-American Salazar of betrayal and calling for her to drop out, while other potential candidates had been on the receiving end of his anger during the primaries.
paras.zh: 国会女议员玛丽亚·萨拉查在电视节目中直言特朗普的移民镇压“太过分了”。特朗普在“真相社会”上转发了一些信息，指责古巴裔美国人萨拉查背叛并呼吁她退出，而其他潜在候选人在初选期间一直受到他的愤怒。

paras.en: According to Marc Short, a Republican strategist and former chief of staff to Donald Trump's first vice-president, Mike Pence, it's hard not to see Trump's move as a warning directed at any other Republicans who might consider a public break with him. But he adds that Trump's ire isn't the only reason Republican candidates should approach this strategy with caution.
paras.zh: 共和党策略师、唐纳德·特朗普第一副总统迈克·彭斯的前幕僚长马克·肖特表示，很难不将特朗普的举动视为对任何其他可能考虑与他公开决裂的共和党人的警告。但他补充说，特朗普的愤怒并不是共和党候选人应谨慎对待这一策略的唯一原因。

paras.en: "It's almost disingenuous now to try to create separation," he says. "I think for voters it looks opportunistic."
paras.zh: “现在试图制造分离几乎是不诚实的，”他说。 “我认为对于选民来说，这看起来是机会主义的。”

paras.en: Candidates like Salazar, who have stuck with Trump for years, have little choice but to rise and fall with the president's fortunes, he said. Republicans who have built their own brand and identities â like Senator Susan Collins in Maine â can more convincingly draw distinctions between themselves and the president.
paras.zh: 他说，像萨拉查这样多年来一直支持特朗普的候选人别无选择，只能随着总统的命运而起伏。建立了自己的品牌和身份的共和党人——比如缅因州参议员苏珊·柯林斯——可以更有说服力地区分自己和总统。

paras.en: The fact that so many people are downbeat about the economy, combined with the fact that the Republicans have been in power in Washington suggests that Republican candidates are facing difficult headwinds in November's elections. "I think they're hurricane force right now," said Short.
paras.zh: 如此多的人对经济持悲观态度，再加上共和党在华盛顿掌权，这表明共和党候选人在 11 月的选举中面临着艰难的阻力。 “我认为他们现在是飓风力量，”肖特说。

paras.en: It is, however, far from a lost cause for Republicans going into these midterms. Many polls show battleground congressional and state races in a dead heat. And while Democratic candidates' hopes are buoyed by so many people feeling the economy is not working for them, a majority of voters still have a negative view of the Democratic Party as a whole.
paras.zh: 然而，对于进入中期选举的共和党人来说，这还远非失败的原因。许多民意调查显示，国会和各州的竞选战场正处于白热化状态。尽管民主党候选人的希望因许多人感到经济不适合他们而受到提振，但大多数选民仍然对整个民主党持负面看法。

paras.en: "I think Republicans are closing out on the fact that they've delivered on a bunch of things, but we need to do more," said Alex DeGrasse, a Republican campaign consultant with close ties to the party's congressional leadership. His recommendation for the Republican electoral message was simple and pointed: "If you elect the Democrats, they'll destroy everything. Democrats had a chance to run the country, and by every objective economic metric, they did a worse job."
paras.zh: 与该党国会领导层关系密切的共和党竞选顾问亚历克斯·德格拉斯(Alex DeGrasse)表示：“我认为共和党人已经结束了他们已经完成了很多事情的事实，但我们需要做更多的事情。”他对共和党选举信息的建议简单而尖锐：“如果你选择民主党，他们会摧毁一切。民主党本来有机会管理这个国家，但从每一个客观的经济指标来看，他们都做得更糟。”

paras.en: He added that right now in the White House, Republicans aren't panicking, they're focusing on executing their strategy.
paras.zh: 他补充说，目前在白宫，共和党人并不恐慌，他们正在专注于执行他们的战略。

paras.en: In Florida's governor race, the Republican messaging contrasts the "Florida dream" of economic growth that Republicans say they delivered versus what they say is the hardship and depravity of Democratic-run states like Illinois, California and New York. Florida's population is booming, and many of the new arrivals are conservatives who lived in - and grew tired of - more liberal states in the north and west. But even this pitch often came with a nod to the current economic difficulties.
paras.zh: 在佛罗里达州州长竞选中，共和党传递的信息将共和党人所说的经济增长的“佛罗里达梦”与他们所说的伊利诺伊州、加利福尼亚州和纽约州等民主党管理的州的艰难和堕落进行了对比。佛罗里达州的人口正在蓬勃发展，许多新来者都是保守派，他们生活在北部和西部更加自由的州，并对这些州感到厌倦。但即便如此，这种宣传也常常伴随着对当前经济困难的认可。

paras.en: "For the past 26 years, we have been living in a Florida dream, and a lot of people don't realise the amount of work that has been done in this state," Avila said in Kissimmee last week.
paras.zh: 阿维拉上周在基西米表示：“过去 26 年里，我们一直生活在佛罗里达州的梦想中，很多人没有意识到这个州所做的工作量。”

paras.en: According to James, from the Republican-aligned polling firm, the key for conservative candidates is to take subjects on which they are relatively strong, like crime, taxes and immigration, and link them to affordability issues that Americans say they care about most.
paras.zh: 与共和党结盟的民意调查公司的詹姆斯表示，保守派候选人的关键是选择他们相对较强的主题，例如犯罪、税收和移民，并将它们与美国人表示最关心的负担能力问题联系起来。

paras.en: "Republicans are certainly looking to tell those independents that you might not be happy with everything, but we have delivered on these issues," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“共和党人当然希望告诉那些独立人士，你们可能不会对一切都感到满意，但我们已经解决了这些问题。”

paras.en: With Republicans pouring money into advertising in battleground states, often outpacing their Democratic opponents by significant margins, there's still the possibility that the situation will improve in the final month of the midterm campaign.
paras.zh: 由于共和党人在战场州投入大量资金进行广告宣传，往往大幅领先民主党对手，因此情况仍有可能在中期竞选的最后一个月有所改善。

paras.en: That hasn't stopped the Republican faithful from being nervous about their side's chances, though â and what some see as a lack of enthusiasm on the right.
paras.zh: 但这并没有阻止共和党的忠实信徒对自己一方的机会感到紧张，而且有些人认为右翼缺乏热情。

paras.en: "Campaigns are won at the end by momentum," said Joseph Robinson, an engineer who attended the Avila fish-market event in Tampa. "But the momentum has been slow. It's not really like, 'Hey, I'm going to go run out there and vote right now.'"
paras.zh: 参加坦帕阿维拉鱼市活动的工程师约瑟夫·罗宾逊 (Joseph Robinson) 表示：“最终，战役的胜利是靠动力。” “但势头一直很缓慢。这并不是说，‘嘿，我现在就跑去投票。’”

paras.en: Trump, for his part, is inevitably upbeat. Last month, he travelled to Tennessee for a college football game, where the crowd of more than 100,000 greeted him with cheers. The next day, it was a golf tournament in Illinois and another welcoming crowd. This weekend, he's going to another football game - in Alabama.
paras.zh: 就特朗普而言，他不可避免地感到乐观。上个月，他前往田纳西州观看一场大学橄榄球比赛，现场有超过 10 万观众用欢呼声迎接他。第二天，伊利诺伊州举行了一场高尔夫锦标赛，人群热情欢迎。这个周末，他将前往阿拉巴马州观看另一场橄榄球比赛。

paras.en: He is hitting the campaign trail, but frequently in states that mostly return Republican candidates â Texas, Oklahoma and Nebraska.
paras.zh: 他正在参加竞选活动，但经常是在大多数共和党候选人回归的州——德克萨斯州、俄克拉荷马州和内布拉斯加州。

paras.en: However, in classic Trump style, he is saying and doing things that could complicate the careful balancing act many Republicans are trying to strike.
paras.zh: 然而，以典型的特朗普风格，他的言行可能会使许多共和党人试图实现的谨慎平衡行为变得复杂化。

paras.en: He has repeatedly dismissed claims that high costs are a problem for many voters, with his latest explanation being that their discomfort is due to a "very bad job" on the part of his administration in explaining how good things really are.
paras.zh: 他一再否认高成本对许多选民来说是一个问题的说法，他最新的解释是，他们的不安是由于他的政府在解释事情到底有多美好方面“做得非常糟糕”。

paras.en: "The only thing we're doing badly at is public relations," he said in Texas last week. "In other words, we're doing a phenomenal job."
paras.zh: “我们唯一做得不好的事情是公共关系，”他上周在德克萨斯州表示。 “换句话来说，我们做得非常出色。”

paras.en: Several times over the past few months he's insisted that voters imagine his name is "on the ballot", but at other times he has said he doesn't care about the midterms and that this isn't his election to fight.
paras.zh: 在过去的几个月里，他多次坚持让选民想象他的名字“在选票上”，但有时他又表示他并不关心中期选举，这不是他要战斗的选举。

paras.en: If Republicans struggle, he said, it is not a reflection on how Americans view him.
paras.zh: 他说，如果共和党人陷入困境，这并不反映美国人如何看待他。

paras.en: "A lot of them are very angry at Republicans, to be honest with you," Trump said in August. "They're angry at Republicans, but they're not angry at me."
paras.zh: “老实说，他们中的很多人对共和党人非常愤怒，”特朗普八月份表示。 “他们对共和党人感到愤怒，但他们并不对我感到愤怒。”

paras.en: But if Republicans get punished at the ballot box in November, whether they run with the president or away from him, Trump will bear the brunt of the consequences - in the form of a hostile Congress with legislative and oversight powers - for the last two years of his presidency.
paras.zh: 但如果共和党人在 11 月份的投票箱中受到惩罚，无论他们是与总统一起竞选还是远离总统，特朗普都将在他总统任期的最后两年中首当其冲——以拥有立法和监督权力的敌对国会的形式出现。

articles.title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild

paras.en: Roosting birds now coo among the ceiling tiles in the deserted dining room of Kibbutz Nir Oz, once the bustling heart of a close-knit, 400-strong Israeli community which was devastated by the Hamas-led attacks on 7 October 2023.
paras.zh: 尼尔奥兹基布兹 (Kibbutz Nir ​​Oz) 荒废的餐厅里，栖息的鸟儿现在在天花板瓷砖间咕咕叫。 这里曾经是一个由 400 人组成的紧密团结的以色列社区的繁华中心，该社区在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击中遭到摧毁。

paras.en: "We used to come and see each other, eat together. There were lots of activities here, also holidays to celebrate," remembers Dalit Ram Aharon, who is showing me around with her husband, Achi.
paras.zh: “我们过去经常见面，一起吃饭。这里有很多活动，还有值得庆祝的节日，”达利特·拉姆·阿哈伦 (Dalit Ram Aharon) 回忆道，她带着她的丈夫阿奇 (Achi) 带着我四处参观。

paras.en: By the glass entrance doors, dotted with bullet holes, there is a shocking reminder of what happened to the missing residents.
paras.zh: 布满弹孔的玻璃大门令人震惊地提醒着失踪居民的遭遇。

paras.en: The postboxes for each household bear stickers put there after the attacks three years ago: red indicates those killed, and black those taken hostage. "That's one out of four of us: murdered or kidnapped," Dalit says. "Including children and babies."
paras.zh: 每户人家的邮箱上都贴有三年前袭击后贴的贴纸：红色表示遇难者，黑色表示被劫为人质。 “这是我们四分之一的人：被谋杀或绑架，”达利特说。 “包括儿童和婴儿。”

paras.en: As Israel marks the third anniversary of its deadliest-ever day, this is another painful time of reflection for residents of the kibbutz, which sits just a mile (1.6km) from the Gaza border and was one of the worst-hit places.
paras.zh: 在以色列迎来有史以来最致命的一天的三周年之际，这对基布兹的居民来说又是一个痛苦的反思时刻，基布兹距离加沙边境仅一英里（1.6公里），是受灾最严重的地方之一。

paras.en: Time stands still at the nearby burnt-out house of the Siman Tov family, where a wind chime dangles by the door. A picture shows Tamar and Yonatan with their three children, twin girls Shahar and Arbel, five, and their two-year-old son, Omer.
paras.zh: 附近西曼·托夫一家被烧毁的房子里，时间静止了，门边挂着风铃。照片显示塔玛和尤纳坦与他们的三个孩子，五岁的双胞胎女儿沙哈尔和阿贝尔，以及他们两岁的儿子奥马尔。

paras.en: The parents were shot through the door of their bomb shelter - designed to protect from rockets launched from Gaza, not gunfire.
paras.zh: 父母被射穿防空洞的门——防空洞的设计目的是防御从加沙发射的火箭，而不是枪声。

paras.en: Dalit, who survived with Achi and their three children by hiding in their own shelter for nearly 12 hours that day, recalls the last social media messages sent by Tamar to her neighbours.
paras.zh: 达利特当天与阿奇和他们的三个孩子在自己的避难所里躲了近 12 个小时，幸免于难，她回忆起塔玛发给邻居的最后一条社交媒体消息。

paras.en: "On that day in the morning, she wrote in the woman's group, at the beginning, 'Is everyone fine?' Then, at another point, she wrote, 'They are shooting us.' And after that she wrote with a lot of mistakes, 'We are very injured,'" Dalit tells me.
paras.zh: “那天早上，她在女子群里，一开始就写道，‘大家还好吗？’然后，在另一处，她写道：“他们正在向我们开枪。”之后她写了很多错误，‘我们很受伤，’”达利特告诉我。

paras.en: "From what we understand, they torched the house and the children died from suffocation, so all the family was killed."
paras.zh: “据我们了解，他们烧毁了房子，孩子们窒息而死，所以一家人都被杀了。”

paras.en: An estimated 500 Palestinians, led by Hamas's elite Nukhba force fighters, but including civilian looters, some of them children, joined the assault on the unsuspecting Nir Oz.
paras.zh: 估计有 500 名巴勒斯坦人在哈马斯精锐努赫巴部队战士的带领下，加入了对毫无戒心的尼尔·奥兹的袭击，其中包括平民抢劫者，其中一些是儿童。

paras.en: Forty-one Nir Oz residents and foreign workers were killed, along with six people who had fled to the kibbutz from a party nearby.
paras.zh: 41 名尼尔奥兹居民和外国工人被杀，还有 6 名从附近聚会逃到基布兹的人。

paras.en: Seventy-six people from the kibbutz were kidnapped to Gaza, including nine bodies, with 14 hostages taken alive and killed in captivity. The last living hostages from Nir Oz were returned to Israel on 13 October 2025 and the remains of the last deceased hostage, Amiram Cooper, were brought back two weeks later.
paras.zh: 基布兹的 76 人被绑架到加沙，其中包括 9 具尸体，14 名人质在囚禁期间被活活杀害。尼尔·奥兹号最后一名活着的人质于 2025 年 10 月 13 日被带回以色列，最后一名已故人质阿米拉姆·库珀的遗体于两周后被带回以色列。

paras.en: As we walk through the greenery, it is eerily quiet bar bird song and the mewing of hungry, stray cats. Dozens of fire-damaged homes, which were simple, one-storey buildings in Nir Oz, have now been torn down, leaving just rows of the reinforced concrete safe rooms, which failed to keep people safe.
paras.zh: 当我们穿过绿地时，酒吧里的鸟鸣声出奇地安静，还有饥饿的流浪猫的喵喵声。尼尔奥兹的数十栋被大火烧毁的房屋原本是简陋的单层建筑，现在已被拆除，只留下一排排钢筋混凝土安全室，无法保证人们的安全。

paras.en: The Aharons want some damaged houses to be left as evidence of what took place. "We really support that," Achi says. "People should see what happened, should see the destruction, the pure hatred that happened here."
paras.zh: 阿哈龙夫妇希望留下一些受损的房屋作为所发生事件的证据。 “我们真的支持这一点，”阿奇说。 “人们应该看到发生了什么，应该看到这里发生的破坏和纯粹的仇恨。”

paras.en: The couple point out where a teacher, Maya Goren, was killed while in the kindergarten and the makeshift memorials where three of the seven members of the kibbutz security team were killed after battling Hamas gunmen.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇指出，一位名叫玛雅·戈伦 (Maya Goren) 的老师在幼儿园被杀，还提到了临时纪念碑，基布兹安全小组的七名成员中的三人在与哈马斯枪手作战后被杀。

paras.en: The findings of the Israeli Defense Forces investigation into what happened at Nir Oz underscored how the army - left in a state of disarray by the unprecedented simultaneous assault on more than 20 communities and multiple military posts - completely failed to come to the rescue here.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军对尼尔奥兹事件的调查结果突显了，由于对 20 多个社区和多个军事哨所的前所未有的同时袭击，军队陷入了混乱状态，因此完全未能前来救援。

paras.en: On 7 October, the first soldiers arrived in the kibbutz some 40 minutes after the last Palestinian attackers left. Nearly every household experienced killing, violence, including sexual assaults and rape, looting and kidnapping.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日，在最后一批巴勒斯坦袭击者离开后约 40 分钟，第一批士兵抵达基布兹。几乎每个家庭都经历过杀戮、暴力，包括性侵犯、强奸、抢劫和绑架。

paras.en: Dalit pauses to show me a tree planted long ago by her parents, who were co-founders of the kibbutz, known for its farming and peace activists. They survived the 7 October attacks physically unharmed but died just months afterwards.
paras.zh: 达利特停下来给我看了一棵她父母很久以前种下的树，他们是基布兹的联合创始人，以农业和和平活动家而闻名。他们在 10 月 7 日的袭击中幸存下来，身体没有受伤，但几个月后就去世了。

paras.en: Next door is the small home of Shiri Bibas, the mother of ginger-haired boys Ariel, four, and nine-month-old, Kfir. The three, snatched from their home, became symbols of the Gaza hostage crisis.
paras.zh: 隔壁是 Shiri Bibas 的小家，她是四岁姜黄色头发男孩 Ariel 和九个月大 Kfir 的母亲。这三人从家中被绑架，成为加沙人质危机的象征。

paras.en: "This is the hardest house for me because Shiri was a very, very good friend of mine," Dalit confides. "She was like a sister. We even got pregnant together - me with my daughter and her with Ariel. They became best friends also. We used to laugh that they were going to marry."
paras.zh: “这对我来说是最难的房子，因为 Shiri 是我非常非常好的朋友，”达利特坦言。 “她就像一个姐妹。我们甚至一起怀孕了——我和我的女儿，她和爱丽儿。他们也成了最好的朋友。我们常常笑说他们要结婚了。”

paras.en: "Shiri was very, very funny. She was a happy person - a mother," Dalit says. "She lived a simple life. She never did anything to anyone."
paras.zh: “Shiri 非常非常有趣。她是一个快乐的人 - 一个母亲，”达利特说。 “她过着简单的生活。她从未对任何人做过任何事。”

paras.en: While Shiri's husband, Yarden, was released alive by Hamas in a Gaza ceasefire deal in February 2025, she and her sons - held by a different armed group - were killed.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月，希里的丈夫亚登 (Yarden) 在加沙停火协议中被哈​​马斯活捉，但她和她的儿子们被另一个武装组织关押，却被杀害。

paras.en: Hamas blamed an air strike early in the Gaza war for their deaths, but Israeli forensic experts, who examined the bodies after they were returned later that February, said they were murdered by their captives and their bodies mutilated.
paras.zh: 哈马斯将他们的死亡归咎于加沙战争初期的一次空袭，但以色列法医专家在二月晚些时候送回尸体后对尸体进行了检查，称他们是被俘虏谋杀的，尸体被肢解。

paras.en: Many of the bereaved from Nir Oz, including Yarden Bibas, have moved away for good. However, with 20 houses renovated or rebuilt, a few former hostages have come back to live here.
paras.zh: 许多尼尔·奥兹的死者，包括亚登·比巴斯，都已经永远搬走了。然而，随着20栋房屋的翻新或重建，一些前人质又回到这里居住。

paras.en: They include Gadi Moses, another kibbutz co-founder, and the oldest living male hostage released during the Gaza war, and Yair Horn, who stops to chat with the Aharons as he passes in a golf buggy. Dalit and Achi are determined to return too.
paras.zh: 其中包括加迪·摩西（Gadi Moses），他是基布兹的另一位联合创始人，也是加沙战争期间获释的最年长的男性人质；还有亚伊尔·霍恩（Yair Horn），他在开着高尔夫球车经过时停下来与阿哈龙一家聊天。达利特和阿奇也决心回归。

paras.en: "We'll come back for the memory of Shiri and for the people that didn't have the chance to live here, and for the memory of my parents, and to continue our roots, and for my children, because this is our home," Dalit says.
paras.zh: 达利特说：“我们会回来纪念希里，为了那些没有机会住在这里的人们，为了纪念我的父母，为了延续我们的根，为了我的孩子们，因为这是我们的家。”

paras.en: However, she, Achi and their children - currently displaced and living in an apartment in a town further north - face a two-year wait for Nir Oz to reopen fully.
paras.zh: 然而，她、阿奇和他们的孩子目前流离失所，住在更北的一个小镇的一套公寓里，他们需要等待两年才能完全重新开放。

paras.en: "Terrorists penetrated 97% of the households and burned down almost 50%," says Emi Palmor, director of the rebuilding project. "Now it's the only place in Israel that has to be completely demolished and completely replanned."
paras.zh: “恐怖分子侵入了 97% 的家庭，烧毁了近 50% 的房屋，”重建项目主任埃米·帕尔莫 (Emi Palmor) 说。 “现在它是以色列唯一需要完全拆除和重新规划的地方。”

paras.en: She says that it is a difficult balance to redesign the kibbutz so that it feels like home but does not cause new trauma to those who return.
paras.zh: 她说，重新设计基布兹，使其感觉像家一样，但又不会给返回的人造成新的创伤，这是一个困难的平衡。

paras.en: "It's a huge debate â a very painful debate," Emi says. "Some people say, 'If I come back here, I want the entire area to look serene. I don't have to be reminded because I remember every day the people I lost.' Other people say, 'There is such denial â if we will take down the last houses, who will ever believe?'"
paras.zh: “这是一场巨大的辩论——一场非常痛苦的辩论，”艾米说。 “有些人说，‘如果我回到这里，我希望整个地区看起来很平静。我不需要别人提醒，因为我每天都会记得我失去的人。’其他人说，‘有这样的否认——如果我们拆除最后的房子，谁会相信呢？’”

paras.en: About 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage after an estimated 6,000 Palestinians streamed across the Gaza border during the attacks on southern Israel on 7 October 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月 7 日，以色列南部发生袭击，估计有 6,000 名巴勒斯坦人越过加沙边境，造成约 1,200 人死亡，251 人被扣为人质。

paras.en: The ensuing war between Israel and Hamas has killed more than 74,200 people in Gaza, according to the Hamas-run health ministry, whose overall figures are seen as accurate by the UN.
paras.zh: 据哈马斯管理的卫生部称，以色列和哈马斯之间随后发生的战争已造成加沙超过 74,200 人死亡，联合国认为该部门的总体数字是准确的。

paras.en: Despite the US-brokered ceasefire deal which brought the last hostages home a year ago, violence has continued, including near-daily Israeli attacks on Gaza. Nearly all of Gaza's 2.1 million population has been displaced and much of the territory is in ruins. US President Donald Trump's peace plan is at an impasse.
paras.zh: 尽管一年前在美国斡旋下达成停火协议，最后一批人质得以回家，但暴力事件仍在继续，包括以色列几乎每天都对加沙发动袭击。加沙 210 万人口几乎全部流离失所，大部分领土已成为废墟。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的和平计划陷入僵局。

paras.en: For Israelis, there are outstanding questions over accountability for the failure of Israel's security forces to have prevented the 7 October attacks. People from Nir Oz favour a comprehensive state commission of inquiry and still have major security concerns.
paras.zh: 对于以色列人来说，以色列安全部队未能阻止 10 月 7 日袭击的责任问题仍悬而未决。尼尔奥兹人赞成成立全面的国家调查委员会，但仍然存在重大安全问题。

paras.en: Survivors, including the Aharons, suffer from post-traumatic stress. Dalit recalls how her eldest son, Uri, turned nine on 7 October 2023 - when they spent the day hiding in their bomb shelter. "He told me, 'Mum, I don't want to die on my birthday,'" she says. "You know people don't understand that we still live this horrible day."
paras.zh: 包括阿哈龙夫妇在内的幸存者都承受着创伤后压力。达利特 (Dalit) 回忆起她的大儿子乌里 (Uri) 在 2023 年 10 月 7 日满九岁的日子，当时他们躲在防空洞里度过了一天。 “他告诉我，‘妈妈，我不想在生日那天死去，’”她说。 “你知道人们不明白我们仍然生活在这个可怕的日子。”

paras.en: This anniversary of the attacks is the first with no hostages remaining in Gaza. "It's a very big relief," Dalit says. Achi sees that now is the time to focus on personal healing.
paras.zh: 今年的袭击周年纪念日是加沙地带首次没有人质。 “这是一个很大的缓解，”达利特说。阿奇认为现在是专注于个人治疗的时候了。

paras.en: "Until the hostages came back, it was the only thing on our mind," he says. "Now you have the time to concentrate on yourself, on what you lost, what you need. Now it's our recovery or some kind of recovery as much as we can."
paras.zh: “在人质回来之前，这是我们脑子里唯一的事情，”他说。 “现在你有时间专注于自己，专注于你失去的东西，你需要什么。现在是我们的恢复或尽可能的某种恢复。”

articles.title: Hayley Williams Reunites With Zedd to Perform ‘Stay the Night’ for First Time in 12 Years
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Hayley Williams brought a familiar face — and a fan-favorite hit — back to the stage on Monday night (Oct. 5).
paras.zh: 海莉·威廉姆斯 (Hayley Williams) 于周一晚上（10 月 5 日）将一张熟悉的面孔和一首深受粉丝喜爱的热门歌曲带回舞台。

paras.en: During her Hollywood Bowl show in Los Angeles, the Paramore frontwoman surprised the crowd by welcoming Zedd to the stage for a live performance of their 2012 collaboration, “Stay the Night.” It had been 12 years since Williams and the electronic hitmaker performed the song together live.
paras.zh: 在洛杉矶的好莱坞露天剧场 (Hollywood Bowl) 演出中，Paramore 主唱欢迎 Zedd 登台现场表演他们 2012 年合作的歌曲《Stay the Night》，令观众大吃一惊。威廉姆斯和这位电子热门制作人一起现场表演这首歌已经过去了 12 年。

paras.en: Fan-captured footage from the show shows Zedd taking his place behind the piano while Williams delivered the song’s vocals. The duo had a stripped-back approach for the performance, trading the polished EDM production for a more raw interpretation of “Stay the Night,” putting Williams’ vocals front and center.
paras.zh: 粉丝们从节目中捕捉到的镜头显示，当威廉姆斯演唱这首歌时，佐德坐在钢琴后面。两人的表演采取了一种简约的方式，将精致的 EDM 制作换成了对“Stay the Night”的更原始的诠释，将威廉姆斯的声音放在了最前面和中心位置。

paras.en: Released in 2012, “Stay the Night” paired Williams with Zedd during the DJ and producer’s early run of crossover pop hits. The collaboration went on to top Billboard‘s Dance Club Songs and Dance Airplay charts in 2013.
paras.zh: 2012 年发行的《Stay the Night》让 Williams 与 Zedd 搭档，在这位 DJ 兼制作人早期推出跨界流行歌曲期间。此次合作在 2013 年登上了公告牌舞蹈俱乐部歌曲和舞蹈播放排行榜的榜首。

paras.en: For Zedd, “Stay the Night” was monumental. The track followed his breakthrough album Clarity, whose title track — featuring Foxes — became a major Billboard Hot 100 hit when it peaked at No. 8, and earned Zedd his first Grammy Award, winning best dance recording at the 2014 ceremony.
paras.zh: 对于 Zedd 来说，“Stay the Night”具有里程碑意义。这首歌曲是继他的突破性专辑《Clarity》之后推出的，该专辑的主打歌（与 Foxes 合作）在 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜上名列第八，成为热门单曲，并为 Zedd 赢得了他的第一个格莱美奖，并在 2014 年颁奖典礼上获得了最佳舞曲唱片奖。

paras.en: Williams has been tossing in plenty of throwbacks throughout The Hayley Williams Show tour, which launched in September. During her Sept. 17 concert at Forest Hills Stadium in Queens, New York, she brought out opener Rico Nasty for a rendition of B.o.B‘s “Airplanes,” which reached No. 2 on the Hot 100.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯在 9 月份推出的海莉·威廉姆斯秀 (Hayley Williams Show) 巡演中融入了大量复古元素。 9 月 17 日，在纽约皇后区森林山体育场 (Forest Hills Stadium) 举行的音乐会上，她带来了开场曲 Rico Nasty，演绎了 B.o.B 的《Airplanes》，该歌曲在 Hot 100 排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: The singer is currently nearing the end of her Los Angeles run, with her second and final Hollywood Bowl show scheduled for Tuesday (Oct. 6). She will then take The Hayley Williams Show to South America in November before continuing the tour across Australia and Europe in 2027.
paras.zh: 这位歌手目前在洛杉矶的演出已接近尾声，她的第二场也是最后一场好莱坞碗演出定于周二（10 月 6 日）举行。随后，她将于 11 月将海莉·威廉姆斯秀 (The Hayley Williams Show) 带到南美洲，然后于 2027 年继续在澳大利亚和欧洲巡演。

articles.title: Max Martin’s Hot 100 No. 1s as a Songwriter, From ‘…Baby One More Time’ to ‘Patient Zero’
articles.author: Gary Trust

paras.en: Max Martin first hit the Billboard Hot 100 dated Oct. 28, 1995, as cowriter of Backstreet Boys’ first hit, “We’ve Got It Goin’ On,” a foretelling title for both the boy band and Martin.
paras.zh: 马克斯·马丁 (Max Martin) 于 1995 年 10 月 28 日首次登上 Billboard Hot 100，作为后街男孩 (Backstreet Boys) 首支单曲《We've Got It Goin’ On》的联合编剧，该歌曲对男孩乐队和马丁来说都是一个预言性的标题。

paras.en: The group would go on to massive success, and Martin, too. The Swedish songwriter and producer’s history includes an astounding 28 No. 1 hits as a writer on the Hot 100, a run that began in January 1999 with Britney Spears’ debut smash, “…Baby One More Time” (a title that would also prove prophetic). Among his other triumphs, he cowrote and coproduced the No. 1 hit on the Hot 100’s Greatest of All Time Songs retrospective, as announced in 2021: The Weeknd’s “Blinding Lights.”
paras.zh: 该乐队将继续取得巨大成功，马丁也是如此。这位瑞典歌曲作家兼制作人的历史包括作为作家在 Hot 100 中夺得 28 首单曲第一名，这一记录始于 1999 年 1 月布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 的首张热门单曲“……Baby One More Time”（这个标题也被证明是预言性的）。在他的其他成就中，他共同创作并制作了 2021 年热门 100 首最伟大歌曲回顾展上排名第一的热门单曲：The Weeknd 的“Blinding Lights”。

paras.en: When Martin first reached the Hot 100 as a writer, Taylor Swift was 5 years old. In 2012, their cowrite, also with Shellback, “We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together,” became her first leader on the list. As of October 2026, the trio has landed seven No. 1 compositions, through Swift’s “Patient Zero,” her 16th chart-topping song overall. The three worked on all of her 2025 LP The Life of a Showgirl during her The Eras Tour. “When I was on tour in Stockholm, I had Max Martin come out to the show, and I was talking to him, and I was like, ‘I just feel like we could knock it out of the park if we went back in,’” she shared on Instagram upon announcing the album.
paras.zh: 当马丁首次以作家身份跻身热门 100 强时，泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 年仅 5 岁。 2012 年，他们与谢尔巴克 (Shellback) 共同撰写的《我们再也回不来了》(We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together) 成为她在该名单上的第一位领先者。截至 2026 年 10 月，三人组合已凭借斯威夫特的《零号病人》夺得七首冠军作品，这是她第 16 首登上排行榜冠军的歌曲。三人在她的 The Eras 巡演期间参与了她 2025 年的全部唱片《The Life of a Showgirl》的创作。 “当我在斯德哥尔摩巡演时，我让马克斯·马丁来看演出，我和他交谈，我当时想，‘我只是觉得如果我们回去的话我们可以把它从公园里拿出来，’”她在 Instagram 上宣布这张专辑时分享道。

paras.en: “I essentially said to him, ‘I want to be as proud of it as an album as I am of The Eras Tour,’” Swift mused. “And he was like, ‘Do you understand what kind of pressure that is?’ I know the pressure I’m putting on this record by saying that, but I don’t care because I love it that much. It just comes from the most infectiously joyful, wild, dramatic place I was in in my life.”
paras.zh: “我基本上对他说，‘我想为这张专辑感到自豪，就像我为 The Eras Tour 感到自豪一样，’”斯威夫特沉思道。 “他说，‘你明白那是什么压力吗？’我知道我这样说给这张唱片带来的压力，但我不在乎，因为我非常喜欢它。它只是来自我一生中最具感染力的快乐、狂野、戏剧性的地方。”

paras.en: From Britney Spears to Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande and more pop stars in between, browse the gallery below of Max Martin’s catalog of melodic Hot 100 No. 1 hits that he’s achieved as a songwriter.
paras.zh: 从布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 到泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)、爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 以及更多流行歌星，请浏览下面的画廊，其中收录了马克斯·马丁 (Max Martin) 作为词曲作者取得的 100 首热门歌曲中旋律优美的歌曲。

articles.title: The Songwriters & Producers With the Most Billboard Hot 100 No. 1s
articles.author: Gary Trust

paras.en: Among recording artists, The Beatles boast the most No. 1 singles in the Billboard Hot 100’s history: 20. Mariah Carey ranks second, and paces all soloists, with 19 leaders.
paras.zh: 在唱片艺术家中，披头士乐队拥有 Billboard Hot 100 历史上排名第一的单曲数量最多：20 首。玛丽亚·凯莉 (Mariah Carey) 排名第二，领先于所有独唱歌手，有 19 首领先。

paras.en: Who has the most No. 1s among songwriters and producers?
paras.zh: 词曲作者和制作人中谁拥有最多第一名？

paras.en: Paul McCartney, with 32, and John Lennon (26), of The Beatles, rank first and third, respectively, for having written the most Hot 100 No. 1s, thanks to their respective group and solo outputs, with Max Martin in second place with 31, from Britney Spears’ “…Baby One More Time” in 1999 through, most recently, Taylor Swift’s “Patient Zero.”
paras.zh: 披头士乐队成员保罗·麦卡特尼 (32 岁) 和约翰·列侬 (26 岁) 凭借各自的团体和独奏作品创作了最热门 100 首单曲，分别排名第一和第三，马克斯·马丁 (Max Martin) 以 31 首歌曲位居第二，包括 1999 年布兰妮·斯皮尔斯 (Britney Spears) 的《…Baby One More Time》和最近泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 的《零号病人》(Patient Zero)。

paras.en: Max Martin, meanwhile, has passed George Martin for the most Hot 100 No. 1s among producers: 29. As with his writing history, the former’s No. 1 run as a producer stretches from “…Baby One More Time” through “Hate That I Made You Love Me.” The latter, notably, produced 19 of The Beatles’ 20 No. 1s. The lone Fab Four No. 1 that he didn’t produce? Their last, 1970’s “The Long and Winding Road,” on which Phil Spector took the reins. His other four leaders as a producer are America’s “Sister Golden Hair” (1975), McCartney and Stevie Wonder’s “Ebony and Ivory” (1982), McCartney and Michael Jackson’s “Say, Say, Say” (1983-84) and Elton John’s “Candle in the Wind 1997” (1997-98).
paras.zh: 与此同时，马克斯·马丁 (Max Martin) 已经超越乔治·马丁 (George Martin)，成为最热门 100 名制作人中的第一名：29 名。正如他的写作历史一样，马克斯·马丁 (Max Martin) 作为制作人的第一名从《……再次宝贝》(Baby One More Time) 一直延伸到《讨厌我让你爱我》(Hate That I Made You Love Me)。值得注意的是，披头士乐队 20 首第一名中的 19 首是由后者制作的。唯一不是他制作的披头四第一？他们的最后一部作品是 1970 年的《漫长而曲折的道路》，由菲尔·斯佩克特 (Phil Spector) 执导。他作为制片人的另外四位领军人物是美国的《金发姐妹》（1975年）、麦卡特尼和史蒂维·旺德的《乌木与象牙》（1982年）、麦卡特尼和迈克尔·杰克逊的《说，说，说》（1983-84）和艾尔顿·约翰的《风中烛光1997》（1997-98）。

paras.en: Here is an updated look at the songwriters and producers with the most Hot 100 No. 1s all-time, through the chart dated Oct. 10, 2026 (compiled via Billboard charts department research and Fred Bronson’s invaluable The Billboard Book of Number One Hits).
paras.zh: 以下是通过日期为 2026 年 10 月 10 日的排行榜（通过 Billboard 排行榜部门研究和 Fred Bronson 宝贵的《公告牌热门歌曲排行榜》编制），对历史上获得最多热门 100 首单曲冠军的歌曲作者和制作人的最新了解。

paras.en: As for other talents on the lists above, Mariah Carey’s count climbed to 18 Hot 100 No. 1s as a writer and 15 as a producer, and 19 as an artist, thanks to her 25-years-in-the-making present received when “All I Want for Christmas Is You” reached No. 1 in December 2019. (Carey’s only No. 1 that she didn’t author? Her 1992 cover of the Jackson 5’s “I’ll Be There.”)
paras.zh: 至于上述名单上的其他才华横溢的人，玛丽亚·凯莉 (Mariah Carey) 作为作家的排名攀升至 18 位，作为制片人的排名上升到 15 位，作为艺术家的排名上升到 19 位，这要归功于她 25 年来精心制作的礼物，当《All I Want for Christmas Is You》在 2019 年 12 月登上第一名时，她收到了这份礼物。（凯莉唯一一个不是她创作的排名第一？她 1992 年的封面） Jackson 5 的“I'll Be There”。）

paras.en: Barry Gibb’s totals include the Bee Gees’ nine Hot 100 No. 1s, seven of which Albhy Galuten and Karl Richardson also produced. Gibb, Galuten and Richardson also coproduced all three of Andy Gibb’s leaders.
paras.zh: 巴里·吉布 (Barry Gibb) 的总成绩包括比吉斯 (Bee Gees) 的九项热门百强第一名，其中七项是阿尔比·加鲁滕 (Albhy Galuten) 和卡尔·理查森 (Karl Richardson) 制作的。吉布、加鲁滕和理查森还共同制作了安迪·吉布的三位主角。

paras.en: James “Jimmy Jam” Harris III and Terry Lewis guided the sound of pop/R&B beginning in the ’80s, having cowritten and coproduced 14 Hot 100 No. 1s, including nine recorded by Janet Jackson. They also coproduced George Michael’s 1988 leader “Monkey” and Usher’s 2001 topper “U Remind Me,” giving them 16 total No. 1s as producers, and cowrote Carey’s 1996 leader “Always Be My Baby,” making for 15 No. 1s for them as writers.
paras.zh: James“Jimmy Jam”Harris III 和 Terry Lewis 从 80 年代开始引导流行/R&B 音乐，共同创作并制作了 14 首热门 100 首单曲，其中 9 首是由珍妮·杰克逊录制的。他们还联合制作了乔治·迈克尔 1988 年的主唱《Monkey》和亚瑟小子 2001 年的热门歌曲《U Remind Me》，这让他们在制作人方面获得了 16 次排名第一的成绩，并与凯里 1996 年合作创作了主唱《Always Be My Baby》，在编剧方面获得了 15 次排名第一的成绩。

paras.en: Brian Holland and Lamont Dozier, along with Eddie Holland (13 Hot 100 No. 1s as a writer), made their influential mark on Motown, thanks in large part to the threesome having written (and Brian Holland and Dozier having produced) the first 10 of The Supremes’ 12 total No. 1s in the ’60s.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·霍兰德 (Brian Holland) 和拉蒙特·多齐尔 (Lamont Dozier) 以及艾迪·霍兰德 (Eddie Holland)（作为编剧，曾 13 次登上热门 100 首歌曲）在摩城留下了颇具影响力的印记，这在很大程度上要归功于这三人在 60 年代为至尊乐队 (The Supremes) 12 首歌曲中的前 10 首歌曲进行了创作（布莱恩·霍兰德 (Brian Holland) 和多齐尔制作了制作人）。

paras.en: Also, a special mention of Steve Sholes, who, while not on the rankings above, produced 10 No. 1s by Elvis Presley on Hot 100 predecessor charts in 1956-58 and six of the King’s seven Hot 100 leaders following the survey’s inception.
paras.zh: 另外，要特别提及史蒂夫·肖尔斯 (Steve Sholes)，虽然他没有出现在上述排名中，但他在 1956-58 年的 Hot 100 前辈排行榜上创造了 10 个猫王 (Elvis Presley) 的第一名，并且在调查开始后，他在 King 的七个 Hot 100 排行榜中占据了六位。

articles.title: ‘Spartacus’ Creator Steven S. DeKnight, Batman Exec Producer Michael E. Uslan Team for Oni Adventure Comic ‘Dr. Syn’ (Exclusive)
articles.author: Borys Kit

paras.en: An obscure adventure hero is getting new attention thanks to Steven S. DeKnight, the creator of Starz’s Spartacus shows, and Michael E. Uslan, the longtime executive producer of the Batman movies.
paras.zh: 感谢 Starz 的《斯巴达克斯》剧集的创作者史蒂文·S·德奈特 (Steven S. DeKnight) 和蝙蝠侠电影的长期执行制片人迈克尔·E·乌斯兰 (Michael E. Uslan)，这位默默无闻的冒险英雄正在受到新的关注。

paras.en: The two have teamed up with Oni Press for Dr. Syn, a four-issue miniseries based on the pirate adventure hero created by Russell Thorndike that appeared in a series of popular books and plays in the early part of the 20th century.
paras.zh: 两人与 Oni Press 合作制作了《Syn 博士》，这是一部四期迷你剧，改编自拉塞尔·桑代克 (Russell Thorndike) 创作的海盗冒险英雄，该英雄出现在 20 世纪早期的一系列流行书籍和戏剧中。

paras.en: The duo are co-writing the title. Sebastián Cabrol (EC’s Catacomb of Torment) serves as the artist for the series which will debut January 2027.
paras.zh: 两人正在共同撰写标题。 Sebastián Cabrol（EC 的《折磨地下墓穴》）担任该系列的艺术家，该系列将于 2027 年 1 月首播。

paras.en: “From film to comic books and back again, I’ve been fortunate enough to have had a hand in shaping many of the iconic characters that first fueled my fascination with heroes, crime fighters, and vigilantes,” said Uslan in a statement. “But even as I was bearing the torch to bring Batman to the big screen as a major film franchise or taking up writing duties on characters like Archie or The Spirit, there was always one more legend itching away in the back of mind: Dr. Syn, the proto-pulp avenger first created by author Russell Thorndike more than a century ago.
paras.zh: “从电影到漫画书，再回来，我很幸运能够参与塑造许多标志性角色，这些角色最初激发了我对英雄、犯罪斗士和治安维持者的迷恋，”乌斯兰在一份声明中说。 “但即使当我高举火炬，将蝙蝠侠作为一部主要的电影系列搬上大银幕，或者承担起阿奇或神灵等角色的编剧职责时，我的脑海中总是浮现出另一个传奇人物：辛博士，一个由作家拉塞尔·桑代克在一个多世纪前首次创造的原始低俗复仇者。

paras.en: He continued, “Fortunately, the immensely talented Steven S. DeKnight shared my fascination, and, together with the brilliant Sebastián Cabrol, we’ve hatched a fierce new vision for a character that could be best described as ‘America’s first dark knight.’”
paras.zh: 他继续说道，“幸运的是，才华横溢的史蒂文·S·德奈特和我一样着迷，并且与才华横溢的塞巴斯蒂安·卡布罗尔一起，我们为这个角色构思了一个激烈的新愿景，这个角色可以最好地描述为‘美国第一位黑暗骑士’。”

paras.en: In the Thorndike stories, Syn was a vicar at by day and a smuggler known as the Scarecrow (mask included) by night, leading a double identity to help his parish at the turn of the 18th century. His dark past includes being a pirate, and in the tales he leads a crew on horseback that use phosphorous to give the illusion of supernatural.
paras.zh: 在桑代克的故事中，辛白天是一名牧师，晚上则是一名被称为“稻草人”（包括面具）的走私犯，他以双重身份在 18 世纪初帮助他的教区。他的黑暗过去包括成为一名海盗，在故事中，他带领一群骑在马背上的船员使用磷来制造超自然的幻觉。

paras.en: In the new telling, which adds some revisionist history to the proceedings and is set in 1775, Syn is a reverend doctor waging an insurgency against King George III. When he is captured, he is sent to the British Empire’s most inhospitable outpost — the American penal colony known as “Georgia.”
paras.zh: 在新的故事情节中添加了一些修正主义历史，故事背景设定在 1775 年，辛是一位受人尊敬的医生，对国王乔治三世发动叛乱。当他被捕后，他被送往大英帝国最荒凉的前哨基地——被称为“乔治亚”的美国流放地。

paras.en: With a mismatched team of allies fueled by the same burning vengeance for justice at his side, England’s most dangerous revolutionary has a chance to bring the empire down in an inferno of roaring flames, per Oni’s description of the book, with the backwater collection of pestilence-ridden colonies called America providing the spark.
paras.zh: 根据奥尼对这本书的描述，英格兰最危险的革命者有一支不匹配的盟友队伍，他们怀着同样强烈的正义复仇心，有机会将帝国推向熊熊烈火的地狱，而被称为美国的瘟疫肆虐的殖民地的死水群提供了火花。

paras.en: “The story of Syn couldn’t be more of a rollicking, historical tale of action and adventure. It’s also shockingly timely,” stated DeKnight, who is also known for showrunning the first season of Netflix’s Marvel show, Daredevil. “An aggrieved citizen fighting back against a mad tyrant and his oppressive government running roughshod over the common man? The echoes of this resonant throughout the ages and the vibrations from such are more relevant than ever. But that never overtakes the core of Syn, which in its bones is a thrilling homage to the serial adventures of yesteryear, chuck full of edge-of-your-seat daring heroics, narrow escapes, romance, swordplay, and everything else that makes this genre so incredibly entertaining.”
paras.zh: “Syn 的故事是一个充满动作和冒险的欢快历史故事。它也非常及时，”DeKnight 说道，他也因 Netflix 漫威剧集《夜魔侠》第一季的节目主持而闻名。 “一个愤愤不平的公民反抗一个疯狂的暴君和他对普通人粗暴的压迫政府？这种在各个时代引起共鸣的回声和由此产生的震动比以往任何时候都更加相关。但这永远不会超越《Syn》的核心，它的骨子里是对过去的连环冒险的激动人心的致敬，充满了令人兴奋的大胆英雄事迹、九死一生、浪漫、剑术以及构成这一类型的一切非常有趣。”

paras.en: The creators are describing the title as Inglourious Bastards, Quentin Tarantino’s down in the dirt revisionist World War Two movie, meets V for Vendetta, Alan Moore and David Lloyd’s anti-fascist British tale of rebellion.
paras.zh: 创作者将片名描述为《无耻混蛋》，昆汀·塔伦蒂诺在肮脏的修正主义第二次世界大战电影中遇到了《V字仇杀队》、艾伦·摩尔和大卫·劳埃德的反法西斯英国叛乱故事。

paras.en: “It’s not just a modern refresh of the novel,” explained Oni president and publisher Hunter Gorinson. “It takes the kernel of this character – a British freedom fighter against the monarchy – and then puts it through a proto-superhero lens. What Michael and Steven, and now Sebastián, are doing is taking the character and Tarantinoing him. There’s a lot of threads to pull on and they intend to pull on all them.”
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是小说的现代更新，”奥尼总裁兼出版商亨特戈林森解释道。 “它选取了这个角色的核心——一个反对君主制的英国自由斗士——然后将其置于原始超级英雄的镜头中。迈克尔和史蒂文，以及现在的塞巴斯蒂安，正在做的就是抓住这个角色，并用塔伦蒂诺来塑造他。有很多线索需要拉动，他们打算把它们全部拉动。”

paras.en: Syn first appeared in Doctor Syn: A Tale of the Romney Marsh in 1915 and his adventures continued across six more novels, all serving up tales that could be read in the same era as stories of such characters as Tarzan. The character could be shaded as having been an early prototype for pulp heroes such as The Shadow and even later, Batman.
paras.zh: 辛于 1915 年首次出现在《辛医生：罗姆尼沼泽的故事》中，他的冒险经历在另外六本小说中继续，所有的故事都可以与泰山等人物的故事在同一时代阅读。这个角色可以被视为低俗英雄的早期原型，例如影子，甚至后来的蝙蝠侠。

paras.en: Thorndike’s stories inspired stage plays in the 1920s and 1930s, segueing to film adaptations, including the 1963’s Disney feature film The Scarecrow of Romney Marsh. There was even a comic book series published by Dell Comics in that era.
paras.zh: 桑代克的故事为 1920 年代和 1930 年代的舞台剧提供了灵感，随后被改编成电影，包括 1963 年的迪士尼故事片《罗姆尼沼泽的稻草人》。那个时代甚至还有戴尔漫画出版的漫画系列。

paras.en: Oni will be giving a preview of the book at New York Comic Con later this week with Uslan set to join the company’s panel Oct. 9. Other panelists include creators George Northy (Yuletide), Oliver Mertz (A Ghost Arm Made of Angry Ghosts), Ryan O’Sullivan (Judge Dredd / Biker Mice from Mars), and Dave Baker (Halloween Boy) and Oni Press editors Karl Bollers and Bess Pallares.
paras.zh: Oni 将于本周晚些时候在纽约动漫展上预览该书，Uslan 将于 10 月 9 日加入该公司的小组。其他小组成员包括创作者 George Northy（圣诞节）、Oliver Mertz（愤怒的鬼魂制成的幽灵手臂）、Ryan O’Sullivan（《特警判官》/《来自火星的摩托老鼠》）和 Dave Baker（万圣节男孩）以及 Oni Press 编辑 Karl Bollers 和 Bess Pallares。

articles.title: Peacock’s ‘The Good Daughter’ Trailer: Rose Byrne, Meghann Fahy Attempt to Solve Small-Town Murder in Suspenseful Thriller Series
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: “There‘s more to the story than what you‘re hearing,“ Brendan Gleeson warns in the trailer for Peacock‘s upcoming mystery series The Good Daughter.
paras.zh: “这个故事的意义远不止你所听到的，”布莱丹·格里森在孔雀即将推出的悬疑剧《好女儿》的预告片中警告道。

paras.en: In the trailer, released Tuesday, stars Meghann Fahy and Rose Byrne star as sisters working to solve a murder mystery. The show also tells an “emotional story about love, family and resilience.“
paras.zh: 在周二发布的预告片中，梅根·费伊和罗丝·拜恩饰演姐妹俩，致力于解开谋杀之谜。该剧还讲述了一个“关于爱、家庭和坚韧的情感故事。”

paras.en: The synopsis reads: “Sisters Charlotte (Fahy) and Samantha (Byrne) Quinn have spent the last 20 years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte — now a lawyer like her father — is the first witness on the scene. As the case unfolds and twists through painful memories and buried secrets, what emerges is not just a story of survival, but of enduring ties between a father and his daughters and the complex bond between sisters.“
paras.zh: 剧情简介如下：“夏洛特（法伊饰）和萨曼莎（伯恩）奎因姐妹在过去的 20 年里一直在努力拼凑因一夜暴力而支离破碎的生活。当另一场袭击使派克维尔小镇四分五裂时，夏洛特——现在和她父亲一样是一名律师——是现场的第一个目击者。随着案件在痛苦的记忆和埋藏的秘密中展开和曲折，出现的不仅仅是一个生存的故事，而且是一个关于两个人之间持久联系的故事。父亲和他的女儿们以及姐妹之间复杂的纽带。”

paras.en: The Good Daughter is adapted from Karin Slaughter‘s bestselling novel. For the series, the author is also the showrunner, writer and executive producer.
paras.zh: 《好女儿》改编自卡琳·斯劳特的畅销小说。对于该系列，作者也是剧集主管、编剧和执行制片人。

paras.en: “The Good Daughter is a story of love, family and the unbreakable bond between two resilient, funny, difficult sisters. It’s thrilling to watch Charlie and Sam brought to life by two extraordinarily talented women. Rose and Meghann perfectly captured the sister relationship — all the history, heartache and joy — wrapped inside this puzzle of a mystery,“ Slaugther said in a statement.
paras.zh: “《好女儿》是一个关于爱情、家庭以及两个坚韧、有趣、难相处的姐妹之间牢不可破的纽带的故事。看到查理和萨姆被两位才华横溢的女性赋予生命真是令人兴奋。罗丝和梅根完美地捕捉了姐妹关系——所有的历史、心痛和欢乐——包裹在这个神秘的谜题中，”斯劳瑟在一份声明中说。

paras.en: In the trailer, Fahy and Byrne are seen joining forces to solve a murder mystery in their small town with a teen pinpointed as the prime suspect.
paras.zh: 在预告片中，法伊和伯恩联手解决小镇上的谋杀案，一名青少年被确定为主要嫌疑人。

paras.en: “When you keep a secret, it can turn you into a person you don’t want to be,“ Fahy says in the trailer that teases there‘s more to Charlotte and Sam‘s past than they may admit.
paras.zh: “当你保守秘密时，它会把你变成一个你不想成为的人，”费希在预告片中说道，预告片中调侃夏洛特和山姆的过去比他们承认的要多。

paras.en: Bruna Papandrea, Steve Hutensky and Casey Haver for Made Up Stories and Byrne also exec produce with additional exec producer Steph Green directing.

paras.en: The series, produced by Made Up Stories in partnership with global film and TV studio Fifth Season, also stars Olivia Williams, Harper Steele, Michael Dorman, Audrey Grace Marshall and Drew Cheek.

articles.title: DePaul’s Alumni Vision Fund Is Helping Filmmakers Take the Next Step
articles.author: Gabi Schwartz

paras.en: When was the last time your alma mater gave you a call?
paras.zh: 你的母校最后一次给你打电话是什么时候？

paras.en: Odds are the university was looking for a generous donation or help with a fundraiser. But what if instead of asking you for money, the roles were reversed?
paras.zh: 该大学很可能正在寻求慷慨的捐款或筹款活动的帮助。但如果不是向你要钱，而是角色互换呢？

paras.en: DePaul University’s School of Cinematic Arts decided to turn that universal alumni experience on its head by asking a simple question: What can DePaul do for its graduates that isn’t transactional?
paras.zh: 德保罗大学电影艺术学院决定通过提出一个简单的问题来彻底改变这种普遍的校友体验：德保罗大学能为毕业生做哪些非交易性的事情？

paras.en: The answer came in January 2026 with the launch of the inaugural Alumni Vision Fund, a program designed to help alumni transform ambitious ideas into professionally executed proof-of-concept films. The Fund extends the resources, relationships and support of film school beyond graduation, giving alumni selected by a faculty committee continued access to an ecosystem that can be difficult to replicate independently.
paras.zh: 答案在 2026 年 1 月推出，首届校友愿景基金启动，该计划旨在帮助校友将雄心勃勃的想法转化为专业执行的概念验证电影。该基金将电影学院的资源、关系和支持延伸到毕业后，让由教员委员会选出的校友继续进入一个难以独立复制的生态系统。

paras.en: For associate professor Daniel Klein, also the director of industry engagement for the School of Cinematic Arts, the message he says they wanted to send to alumni of all ages was clear.
paras.zh: 对于副教授丹尼尔·克莱因（Daniel Klein）来说，他也是电影艺术学院的行业参与总监，他说他们想向各个年龄段的校友传达的信息很明确。

paras.en: “You might’ve graduated a year ago or ten years ago, but we’ve still got your back.” Klein said. “We’re still here to support you. Your success is our success.”
paras.zh: “你可能一年前或十年前就毕业了，但我们仍然会支持你。”克莱恩说道。 “我们仍然在这里支持你。你的成功就是我们的成功。”

paras.en: For many filmmakers, there’s a significant gap to overcome after graduation. They know how to make something—and they likely have plenty of ideas and scripts at the ready—but having the resources to actually bring a project to life is a different story. The result is work that can struggle to find an audience as emerging filmmakers search for the resources, opportunities and relationships needed to move their projects forward.
paras.zh: 对于许多电影制作人来说，毕业后有一个巨大的差距需要克服。他们知道如何制作一些东西——而且他们可能已经准备好了大量的想法和脚本——但拥有资源来真正将项目变为现实则是另一回事了。其结果是，当新兴电影制片人寻找推动项目前进所需的资源、机会和关系时，作品可能很难找到观众。

paras.en: That’s where the Alumni Vision Fund comes in. The program, open exclusively to School of Cinematic Arts alumni, provides recipients with a production support package valued at approximately $100,000, including soundstage access at DePaul Cinespace Studios, professional cameras, grip and lighting equipment, additional production resources, and a cash grant to support production needs.
paras.zh: 这就是校友愿景基金的用武之地。该计划专门向电影艺术学院校友开放，为获奖者提供价值约 100,000 美元的制作支持包，包括 DePaul Cinespace Studios 的摄影棚使用权、专业摄像机、握把和照明设备、额外的制作资源以及支持制作需求的现金补助。

paras.en: Recipients ultimately walk away with a professionally produced proof-of-concept short film designed to help move a larger project forward. Rather than relying on a script alone, filmmakers can use the finished proof to demonstrate their vision to potential investors, producers and talent, pursue grants, and build momentum through festivals. And unlike a traditional investment, DePaul isn’t asking for a piece of what comes next. The filmmakers retain complete ownership of their work.
paras.zh: 获奖者最终会获得一部专业制作的概念验证短片，旨在帮助推动更大的项目向前发展。电影制作人可以利用完成的样片向潜在投资者、制片人和人才展示他们的愿景，寻求资助，并通过电影节积聚动力，而不是仅仅依赖剧本。与传统投资不同的是，德保罗并不要求分一杯羹。电影制片人保留对其作品的完全所有权。

paras.en: After receiving 40 complete applications, it was clear there was significant demand among DePaul alumni for this type of post-graduate support. Initially, the fund was only meant to support one alumni filmmaker, but the quality of the finalists convinced DePaul to expand the inaugural fund from one recipient to two: George Ellzey Jr. and Johanna Unden.
paras.zh: 在收到 40 份完整的申请后，德保罗校友显然对此类研究生支持有很大的需求。最初，该基金只是为了支持一位校友电影制片人，但决赛入围者的质量说服了德保罗将首届基金的受益人从一名扩大到两名：小乔治·埃尔泽和约翰娜·温登。

paras.en: After graduating in 2023, Ellzey Jr. directed the short film Closed Mouths, which was made for essentially $0 through favors, donated resources and community support. When the Alumni Vision Fund entered the picture in 2026, it allowed Ellzey Jr. to return to Human Noise, a deferred project he had first conceived in 2021. Not only did the fund help accelerate the timeline of the project, but having access to DePaul’s resources allowed Ellzey Jr. to take Human Noise to the next level creatively—particularly when it came to the setting.
paras.zh: 2023 年毕业后，小埃尔泽执导了短片《闭嘴》，该片通过恩惠、资源捐赠和社区支持制作成本基本为 0 美元。当校友愿景基金于 2026 年进入时，小埃尔泽得以重返《人类噪音》，这是他在 2021 年首次构想的一个推迟项目。该基金不仅有助于加快项目的进度，而且利用德保罗的资源也让小埃尔泽能够创造性地将《人类噪音》提升到一个新的水平，尤其是在场景方面。

paras.en: “To try to find a location in Chicago that wouldn’t charge us an arm and a leg was a feat,” Ellzey Jr. said. “And so to have access to the Cinespace stage where not only we can control the space but then customize it was extremely, extremely helpful.”
paras.zh: “试图在芝加哥找到一个不收取我们一胳膊和一条腿费用的地点是一项壮举，”小埃尔泽说。 “因此，能够进入 Cinespace 舞台，我们不仅可以控制空间，还可以对其进行定制，这非常非常有帮助。”

paras.en: The characters in Human Noise have achieved a bit of wealth and influence, Ellzey Jr. emphasized, and he said that the support from DePaul allowed him to create a setting that matched that narrative scale, which otherwise would have been impossible. The increased ambition extended beyond the set itself, with the production growing to roughly 100 cast and crew.
paras.zh: 小埃尔泽强调，《人类噪音》中的角色已经获得了一些财富和影响力，他说德保罗的支持使他能够创造出与叙事规模相匹配的背景，否则这是不可能的。不断增长的野心超出了片场本身，制作人员已增至约 100 名演员和工作人员。

paras.en: “It really felt like this is a step forward towards something mainstream as opposed to just independent,” Ellzey Jr. said. “Now with the grant, the door has opened up for more opportunity.”
paras.zh: “我真的感觉这是向主流迈出了一步，而不仅仅是独立，”小埃尔泽说。 “现在有了这笔拨款，更多机会的大门已经打开。”

paras.en: Johanna Unden’s proof-of-concept short, Cecelia, will support the development of her planned full-length feature, American Spirit. Without the fund, Unden estimated the short likely would have taken another year or two to make. DePaul’s equipment access allowed her to direct more of her limited production budget toward the people making the film.
paras.zh: 约翰娜·温登 (Johanna Unden) 的概念验证短片《塞西莉亚》(Cecelia) 将支持她计划的长片《美国精神》的开发。温登估计，如果没有这笔基金，做空可能还需要一两年的时间。德保罗的设备使用权使她能够将有限的制作预算更多地用于电影制作人员。

paras.en: “Being able to use the equipment free of charge and have access to all of that was a big reason we were able to pay our cast and crew reasonable rates, which was also a big thing for me,” Unden said. “We all deserve to get paid in this industry. It’s nice when you can work on stuff with people that you love and also get paid for it.”
paras.zh: “能够免费使用这些设备并获得所有这些是我们能够向演员和工作人员支付合理费用的一个重要原因，这对我来说也是一件大事，”温登说。 “我们都应该在这个行业获得报酬。当你可以与你爱的人一起工作并为此获得报酬时，这真是太好了。”

paras.en: Beyond the tangible resources, the fund offered another commodity that’s hard to come by for emerging filmmakers: validation.
paras.zh: 除了有形资源之外，该基金还提供了另一种新兴电影制片人难以获得的商品：验证。

paras.en: “I left thinking I would never work with DePaul in that sense again,” Unden said. “Knowing that this story and myself are something that they think is worth investing in and supporting, it makes me really confident and grateful to have had those relationships.”
paras.zh: “我离开时以为我再也不会在这个意义上与德保罗合作了，”温登说。 “知道这个故事和我自己是他们认为值得投资和支持的东西，这让我对拥有这些关系感到非常自信和感激。”

paras.en: Ellzey Jr. is already seeing the benefits of the Alumni Vision Fund, as Human Noise has received interest from two potential investors as well as additional grant possibilities, making production on the feature-length version one step closer. For Unden, Cecelia is in the midst of post-production, with hopes of submitting to festivals next spring.
paras.zh: 小埃尔泽已经看到了校友愿景基金的好处，《人类噪音》已经收到了两位潜在投资者的兴趣以及额外的资助可能性，使长篇版本的制作又近了一步。对于《Unden》，塞西莉亚正在进行后期制作，希望能参加明年春天的电影节。

paras.en: “If in any way this proof-of-concept can push me in that direction or get me in the room,” Unden said, “then I think that will have been a measure of success.”
paras.zh: “如果这个概念验证能以任何方式推动我朝那个方向发展，或者让我进入房间，”温登说，“那么我认为这将是成功的衡量标准。”

paras.en: As for the Alumni Vision Fund, it’s something of a proof-of-concept itself. The inaugural cycle demonstrated exactly what the School of Cinematic Arts is capable of providing for its alumni, while offering lessons to inform future iterations of the program.
paras.zh: 至于校友愿景基金，它本身就是一个概念验证。首届周期准确地展示了电影艺术学院能够为其校友提供什么，同时提供课程以指导该项目的未来迭代。

paras.en: “Regardless of what happens with these two short films, it’s already a win,” Klein said. “We’re building a film program the likes of which we would want to attend. And we’re creating the support that we wish we would have gotten.”
paras.zh: “无论这两部短片发生什么，它都已经是一场胜利，”克莱因说。 “我们正在制定一个我们想要参加的电影计划。我们正在创造我们希望得到的支持。”

articles.title: Best student loans for nursing school

paras.en: Federal student loans are an important source of funding for nursing school, but they may not cover the full cost. That's especially relevant for graduate and professional nursing students following federal loan changes that took effect July 1, 2026. New borrowing limits are now in place, and most new graduate and professional students can no longer use Grad PLUS Loans to borrow up to the full cost of attendance.
paras.zh: 联邦学生贷款是护士学校的重要资金来源，但它们可能无法支付全部费用。这对于 2026 年 7 月 1 日生效的联邦贷款变更后的研究生和专业护理学生尤其重要。新的借款限额现已到位，大多数新的研究生和专业学生不能再使用研究生加贷款来借款至全额出勤费用。

paras.en: For eligible professional students, federal Direct Unsubsidized Loans are generally capped at $50,000 per year and $200,000 in aggregate, although certain health-professions programs have additional rules and exceptions. If your nursing program costs more than your available federal aid, you may need another way to cover the remaining balance.
paras.zh: 对于符合条件的专业学生，联邦直接无补贴贷款的上限通常为每年 50,000 美元，总计 200,000 美元，尽管某些健康专业项目有额外的规则和例外。如果您的护理计划的费用超过您可用的联邦援助，您可能需要其他方式来支付剩余余额。

paras.en: That's where private student loans come in. Private lenders can provide additional funding when federal loans and other resources don't cover your total education costs. However, private loans generally don't offer the same federal protections and benefits, so it's important to compare rates, fees, repayment terms and borrower protections before taking one out.
paras.zh: 这就是私人学生贷款的用武之地。当联邦贷款和其他资源无法支付您的总教育费用时，私人贷款机构可以提供额外资金。然而，私人贷款通常不提供相同的联邦保护和福利，因此在贷款之前比较利率、费用、还款条件和借款人保护非常重要。

paras.en: Below, we rounded up some of the best private student loans for nursing school. Note that eligibility may depend on your specific nursing program and school. You can read our methodology below.
paras.zh: 下面，我们收集了一些适合护士学校的最佳私人学生贷款。请注意，资格可能取决于您的具体护理项目和学校。您可以阅读下面我们的方法。
