articles.title: The world’s loudest bird could drown out a rock concert
articles.author: Elie Dolgin

paras.en: The bare-throated bellbird is loud. Very, very loud.
paras.zh: 裸喉钟鸟的声音很大。非常非常大声。

paras.en: The explosive, metallic mating call of the snow-white male — a stout bird with a broad bill and distinctive blue-green throat patch — can top 130 decibels, louder than a jackhammer or a front-row seat at a Counting Crows concert.
paras.zh: 雪白的雄鸟——一种粗壮的鸟，有着宽阔的喙和独特的蓝绿色喉咙斑——发出爆炸性的、金属般的求偶叫声，声音可达130分贝，比手提钻或数乌鸦音乐会前排座位的声音还要大。

paras.en: That makes this South American forest dweller a contender for the title of world’s loudest bird. And now researchers think they know how it and other avian loudmouths produce such eardrum-rattling vocalizations.
paras.zh: 这使得这种南美森林居民成为世界上声音最大的鸟类称号的有力竞争者。现在研究人员认为他们知道它和其他鸟类大嘴鸟是如何发出这种震耳欲聋的声音的。

paras.en: Bigger bodies and, especially, wider beaks help these feathered screamers belt it out, behavioral ecologists João Menezes and Jeff Podos of the University of Massachusetts Amherst report September 29 in Evolution.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的行为生态学家 João Menezes 和 Jeff Podos 于 9 月 29 日在《进化论》杂志上报道称，更大的身体，尤其是更宽的喙有助于这些长有羽毛的尖叫鸟将其表达出来。

paras.en: But what pushed some birds to evolve such volume in the first place remains a mystery. The researchers looked at mating behavior, habitat density and flight ability, but found no explanation that consistently held across species. “We weren’t able to find an overarching pattern that applies to birds in general,” Menezes says.
paras.zh: 但最初是什么促使一些鸟类进化出如此大的体积仍然是一个谜。研究人员观察了交配行为、栖息地密度和飞行能力，但没有发现在不同物种之间一致成立的解释。 “我们无法找到适用于一般鸟类的总体模式，”梅内塞斯说。

paras.en: The quest to understand these sonic extremes dates back to 2019. That is when Podos and a colleague crowned the white bellbird (Procnias albus), an Amazonian cousin of the bare-throated bellbird (P. nudicollis), as a record-setting vocal powerhouse. Its 125-decibel calls were the loudest bird calls ever measured at the time.
paras.zh: 对这些声音极端现象的探索可以追溯到 2019 年。当时，波多斯和一位同事将白钟鸟 (Procnias albus)（裸喉钟鸟 (P. nudicollis) 的亚马逊近亲）评为创纪录的声音强者。它的叫声高达 125 分贝，是当时测量到的最响亮的鸟叫声。

paras.en: Beyond the attention-grabbing number, the finding raised a broader question: What makes some birds so extraordinarily loud?
paras.zh: 除了引人注目的数字之外，这一发现还提出了一个更广泛的问题：是什么让一些鸟类的声音如此之大？

paras.en: The honk of a Canada goose, for example, can reach chainsaw volume (100 decibels), while the chatter of a starling rarely rises above a dishwasher-level hum (70 decibels) — and ornithologists have surprisingly little understanding of why. Although scientists have spent decades cataloging the timing and frequency of birdsong, hoping to decode what birds are saying, the sheer loudness of bird voices has gone largely unexplored.
paras.zh: 例如，加拿大鹅的叫声可以达到电锯音量（100 分贝），而椋鸟的叫声很少会超过洗碗机级别的嗡嗡声（70 分贝）——令人惊讶的是，鸟类学家对其中的原因知之甚少。尽管科学家们花了几十年的时间对鸟鸣的时间和频率进行分类，希望能够解码鸟类所说的内容，但鸟类声音的响度在很大程度上还没有被探索过。

paras.en: To get a read on the racket, Podos lugged a high-grade sound meter, the kind used to monitor noise levels in industrial workplaces, and a laser rangefinder into the woods, swamps and open fields around his home in western Massachusetts. He measured the calls of whatever birds he could find — warblers, sparrows, robins and more.
paras.zh: 为了了解球拍情况，波多斯将一台高级声级计（用于监测工业工作场所噪音水平的那种）和一台激光测距仪拖进了他位于马萨诸塞州西部的家周围的树林、沼泽和开阔的田野。他测量了他能找到的所有鸟类的叫声——莺、麻雀、知更鸟等等。

paras.en: After logging a few dozen species, he enlisted Menezes, a then-grad student who at the time had recently joined his lab, to help turn the collection into a broader evolutionary analysis. Menezes measured bird vocalizations across his home country of Brazil, from the Atlantic Forest near São Paulo to the mountains surrounding Rio de Janeiro and beyond. He captured everything from the soft chirps of the dusky-throated hermit hummingbird to the piercing yelps of the red-legged seriema, a shaggy type of grassland bird.
paras.zh: 在记录了几十个物种后，他聘请了当时刚加入他实验室的研究生梅内塞斯来帮助将这些收集品转化为更广泛的进化分析。梅内塞斯测量了他的祖国巴西各地的鸟类发声，从圣保罗附近的大西洋森林到里约热内卢周围的山脉及更远的地方。他捕捉到了一切，从暗喉隐士蜂鸟的柔和鸣叫到红腿鸫（一种毛茸茸的草原鸟类）的刺耳叫声。

paras.en: All told, he and Podos compiled vocal volume data on 123 species, creating what they say is the largest such dataset to date.
paras.zh: 总而言之，他和 Podos 收集了 123 个物种的发声量数据，创建了他们所说的迄今为止最大的此类数据集。

paras.en: The heftier the bird, the louder its call tended to be, and the same went for birds with broader beaks — a connection between anatomy and acoustic performance that biophysicist Gabriel Mindlin from the University of Buenos Aires in Argentina finds “sensible and plausible.”
paras.zh: 鸟越重，它的叫声往往越大，对于喙部较宽的鸟来说也是如此——阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯大学的生物物理学家加布里埃尔·明德林认为，解剖学和声学性能之间的联系“合理且合理”。

paras.en: “Larger birds have the potential to generate greater respiratory pressures and flows, while morphological features such as beak opening can affect how efficiently acoustic energy radiates,” says Mindlin, who studies birdsong but was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: “较大的鸟类有可能产生更大的呼吸压力和流量，而喙张开等形态特征会影响声能的辐射效率，”研究鸟鸣但未参与这项工作的明德林说。

paras.en: Why evolution cranked up the volume on these avian megaphones, though, is a puzzle that remains, for now, unhatched.
paras.zh: 然而，为什么进化会提高这些鸟类扩音器的音量，目前仍然是一个尚未解开的谜团。

articles.title: ‘A Mother’s Brain’ explores the neuroscience of motherhood
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: When it comes to new motherhood, the baby typically takes center stage, garnering most of people’s attention. But in a refreshing twist, neuroscientist Susana Carmona shifts the spotlight to the mom. In the opening pages of A Mother’s Brain, Carmona cheerfully tells us, “here, we’ll hardly discuss babies at all.” Mothers are her protagonists.
paras.zh: 当谈到新妈妈时，婴儿通常占据中心舞台，吸引大多数人的注意力。但令人耳目一新的是，神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳将焦点转移到了母亲身上。在《母亲的大脑》的开头几页中，卡莫纳愉快地告诉我们，“在这里，我们几乎不会讨论婴儿。”母亲是她的主角。

paras.en: What follows is a captivating, passionate and well-grounded journey through the fascinating process of “matrescence.” A word coined to echo “adolescence,” another time of seismic changes, matrescence includes the intense reorganization a woman’s brain undergoes as she becomes a mom. So far, early studies have revealed a sculpting of brain circuits (and Carmona is quick to point out that less can be more), heightened social instincts and perhaps even a boost of resilience during old age.
paras.zh: 接下来是一段引人入胜、充满激情且基础扎实的旅程，穿越令人着迷的“成熟期”过程。这个词是为了呼应“青春期”，即另一个发生巨大变化的时期，女性期包括女性在成为母亲后大脑所经历的剧烈重组。到目前为止，早期研究已经揭示了大脑回路的塑造（卡莫纳很快指出，少即是多）、社交本能的增强，甚至可能会增强老年时的适应力。

paras.en: This mom found the book to be a treasure trove of motherly delights. Scientific concepts are woven with social and cultural strands, from the poignant to the weird to the profound. Certain passages in the book allowed me the pleasure of relistening to the song “The Mother” by Brandi Carlile, in which she sings, “Welcome to the end of being alone inside your mind.” A Mother’s Brain also kindly pointed me to the viral video, “Mother Rat Saves Baby from Snake.”
paras.zh: 这位妈妈发现这本书是母爱的宝库。科学概念与社会和文化脉络交织在一起，从深刻到怪异到深刻。书中的某些段落让我有幸重听布兰迪·卡莱尔的歌曲《母亲》，她在歌中唱道：“欢迎来到你内心孤独的终结。” 《妈妈的大脑》还好心地向我推荐了一段火爆的视频：“鼠妈妈从蛇手中拯救了婴儿。”

paras.en: As one of the foremost scientists studying matrescence, Carmona is an authoritative guide through the latest research, of which there is a dismayingly small amount. Still, the book covers scientific ground including hormones, evolution and brain networks. History, social constructs and the pressures of modern life come into the story, too.
paras.zh: 作为研究基质形成的最重要的科学家之一，卡莫纳是最新研究的权威指南，但这些研究的数量少得令人沮丧。尽管如此，这本书涵盖了科学领域，包括激素、进化和大脑网络。历史、社会结构和现代生活的压力也出现在故事​​中。

paras.en: If you prefer a light read, Carmona will occasionally warn you when a section is scientifically dense. Then she will invite you along anyway. “But if you do like hormones — well, we’re going to have fun,” Carmona writes at the beginning of a chapter. And it was fun. I was shocked to learn, for instance, just how massive the hormonal upheaval during pregnancy is. The amount of estrogen that floods a woman’s body, including her brain, during the 40 weeks of pregnancy is more than that of the amount that would otherwise accumulate over her entire fertile life, which lasts 35 years on average.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢轻松阅读，卡莫纳偶尔会在某个部分的科学密度很高时向您发出警告。然后她无论如何都会邀请你一起去。 “但如果你确实喜欢荷尔蒙——好吧，我们会玩得很开心，”卡莫纳在章节开头写道。这很有趣。例如，当我得知怀孕期间荷尔蒙的波动有多大时，我感到震惊。在怀孕 40 周期间，女性体内（包括大脑）所分泌的雌激素数量，超过了她整个生育期（平均持续 35 年）所积累的雌激素量。

paras.en: Along the way, Carmona thoughtfully addresses scientific puzzlers such as this: Mothers often report feeling less mentally sharp, yet laboratory studies show almost no neurological decline. Attributed to “mommy brain” or “momnesia,” mental slips might be due to a lack of sleep, or a shifting of attention, or even just an expectation.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，卡莫纳深思熟虑地解决了诸如此类的科学难题：母亲们经常报告感觉精神不那么敏锐，但实验室研究显示几乎没有神经功能下降。被认为是“妈妈脑”或“记忆症”的精神失误可能是由于睡眠不足、注意力转移、甚至只是一种期望造成的。

paras.en: This pervasive, negative stereotype of “mommy brain” can then build on itself, getting stronger as women buy into the incorrect idea that motherhood leaves them dumber. If a woman expects her memory to get worse, she’ll see signs of it in even normal mistakes. “I have watched brilliant women grow so insecure about their intelligence on becoming mothers that they abandon the projects that were once vital to them,” Carmona writes. Assumptions about their diminished brainpower can lead women to pull back from valuable parts of their lives. “It matters — a lot — how we talk to ourselves about these things.”
paras.zh: 这种普遍存在的、消极的“妈妈脑”刻板印象会不断增强，随着女性接受“母性会让她们变得更笨”的错误观念，这种刻板印象会变得更加强烈。如果一个女人预计自己的记忆力会变差，那么即使是正常的错误，她也会看到这种迹象。卡莫纳写道：“我看到才华横溢的女性在成为母亲后对自己的智力变得如此不自信，以至于放弃了曾经对她们至关重要的项目。”对女性脑力下降的假设可能会导致女性放弃生活中有价值的部分。 “我们如何与自己谈论这些事情很重要。”

paras.en: As a mother herself, Carmona brings her experiences into the narrative. It couldn’t be any other way. “Motherhood is lived,” she writes. “It happens in your gut, your identity, your core.”
paras.zh: 作为一名母亲，卡莫纳将她的经历融入到叙述中。不可能有其他方式。 “母性是活生生的，”她写道。 “它发生在你的直觉、你的身份、你的核心。”

paras.en: At its heart, this book is a love letter to moms, who have been invisible to the scientific gaze for too long. It’s time to write a new tale of matrescence, Carmona argues. “A story that recognizes mothers as the essence of the human species, the carriers of knowledge about how we create bonds — and, through them, society and culture.”
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，这本书是一封写给妈妈们的情书，她们已经在科学的视线中消失太久了。卡莫纳认为，是时候写一个新的女性成长故事了。 “这个故事承认母亲是人类的本质，是我们如何建立联系的知识载体，并通过母亲建立社会和文化。”

paras.en: By putting the intense and wild changes of motherhood into words, Carmona offers us a powerful and necessary story.
paras.zh: 通过用语言表达母性的强烈而疯狂的变化，卡莫纳为我们提供了一个有力而必要的故事。

paras.en: Buy A Mother’s Brain from Bookshop.org. Science News is a Bookshop.org affiliate and will earn a commission on purchases made from links in this article.
paras.zh: 从 Bookshop.org 购买《母亲的大脑》。 《科学新闻》是 Bookshop.org 的附属机构，通过本文中的链接进行购买将赚取佣金。

articles.title: Scientists Find a Hidden Network of Tiny Channels The Brain May Use to Flush Out Toxic Alzheimer's Proteins
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: You read a sentence, remember a familiar face, then turn to another thought. Behind all of that activity, your brain also has a housekeeping problem: what to do with proteins that can become harmful when they accumulate.
paras.zh: 你读了一个句子，记住了一张熟悉的面孔，然后转向另一个想法。在所有这些活动的背后，你的大脑还面临着一个管理问题：如何处理积累后可能变得有害的蛋白质。

paras.en: Those proteins need an exit. But tracing their journey out of the brain has proved surprisingly difficult.
paras.zh: 这些蛋白质需要一个出口。但事实证明，追踪它们离开大脑的旅程却出奇地困难。

paras.en: Now, researchers at University College London have identified a previously undocumented network of tiny channels that could fill in part of the map.
paras.zh: 现在，伦敦大学学院的研究人员发现了一个以前未记录的微小通道网络，可以填充部分地图。

paras.en: The study is a preprint that has not undergone peer review, and the channels' function in living humans remains to be established.
paras.zh: 这项研究是预印本，尚未经过同行评审，该通道在活人中的功能仍有待确定。

paras.en: "The pathways by which toxic proteins are removed from the brain are poorly understood," neuroscientist David Attwell told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 神经科学家大卫·阿特韦尔 (David Attwell) 告诉 ScienceAlert：“人们对从大脑中清除有毒蛋白质的途径知之甚少。”

paras.en: This knowledge gap is a problem for researching Alzheimer's disease, which involves the accumulation of amyloid beta and abnormal tau proteins. Understanding why they build up requires investigating both their production and their removal.
paras.zh: 这种知识差距是研究阿尔茨海默病的一个问题，该病涉及β淀粉样蛋白和异常tau蛋白的积累。了解它们堆积的原因需要调查它们的产生和清除。

paras.en: Scientists have proposed different routes out. One follows the walls of arterioles, small vessels supplying brain tissue with blood. Another follows the spaces around venules, small vessels that carry blood away, and features in explanations of the glymphatic system.
paras.zh: 科学家们提出了不同的出路。其中一根沿着小动脉壁，小动脉是为脑组织提供血液的小血管。另一个是围绕小静脉周围的空间，将血液带走的小血管，以及类淋巴系统的解释中的特征。

paras.en: Earlier research has explored fluid movement along the brain's blood vessels. The new study identifies a specific cellular structure that may help explain how proteins travel through two proposed exit routes.
paras.zh: 早期的研究探索了沿着大脑血管的液体运动。这项新研究确定了一种特定的细胞结构，可能有助于解释蛋白质如何通过两条拟议的退出路线移动。

paras.en: "We have now shown that, in both these locations, proteins are in fact removed through tiny tubes that appear to be similar to the tubes present in lymph nodes outside the brain (e.g. in the armpit or neck)," Attwell explained.
paras.zh: 阿特韦尔解释说：“我们现在已经证明，在这两个位置，蛋白质实际上是通过微小的管子去除的，这些管子似乎与大脑外部淋巴结（例如腋窝或颈部）中存在的管子相似。”

paras.en: The channels measure approximately 2 micrometers across and form an interconnected mesh. They extend along blood vessels into the membranes covering the brain and along nerves leaving it.
paras.zh: 这些通道的直径约为 2 微米，形成互连的网格。它们沿着血管延伸到覆盖大脑的膜，并沿着神经离开大脑。

paras.en: The findings suggest they are formed by fibroblastic reticular cells. Related cells build networks that carry fluid and dissolved substances through lymph nodes.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明它们是由成纤维细胞网状细胞形成的。相关细胞构建网络，通过淋巴结携带液体和溶解物质。

paras.en: To follow what moved through the channels, the researchers made tau and amyloid beta visible using fluorescent labels.
paras.zh: 为了追踪通道中的移动情况，研究人员使用荧光标记使 tau 蛋白和β淀粉样蛋白可见。

paras.en: In mouse experiments, the labeled proteins built up inside the channels as they moved. In some experiments, tracers reached channels at the upper surface within 7.5 minutes of administration.
paras.zh: 在小鼠实验中，标记的蛋白质随着它们的移动而在通道内堆积。在一些实验中，示踪剂在给药后 7.5 分钟内到达上表面的通道。

paras.en: Tau traveled through both arteriole walls and channels around venules. Measurements suggested roughly similar amounts passed through each route, supporting the possibility that they belong to a shared network.
paras.zh: Tau 蛋白穿过小动脉壁和小静脉周围的通道。测量结果表明，每条路线的流量大致相似，这支持了它们属于共享网络的可能性。

paras.en: Other clearance mechanisms may operate alongside it. Some proteins can be broken down within brain tissue or pass across blood vessel cells into the bloodstream.
paras.zh: 其他清除机制可能会与其同时运作。一些蛋白质可以在脑组织内分解或穿过血管细胞进入血液。

paras.en: The researchers also investigated whether the network handled proteins produced inside the brain, rather than only substances introduced during experiments.
paras.zh: 研究人员还调查了该网络是否处理大脑内部产生的蛋白质，而不仅仅是实验期间引入的物质。

paras.en: In mice modeling aspects of Alzheimer's disease, they found the animals' own amyloid beta within the channels. This supports a role in transporting naturally produced proteins, although it does not establish how much ultimately exits through the network.
paras.zh: 在模拟阿尔茨海默病的小鼠中，他们在通道内发现了动物自身的β淀粉样蛋白。这支持了运输自然产生的蛋白质的作用，尽管它没有确定最终有多少通过网络排出。

paras.en: The human findings came from five patients undergoing surgery for brain tumors. The team examined living tissue removed during their operations that would otherwise have been discarded.
paras.zh: 人体研究结果来自五名接受脑肿瘤手术的患者。研究小组检查了手术期间取出的活体组织，否则这些活体组织将被丢弃。

paras.en: When fluorescently labeled tau and amyloid beta were applied to the human tissue, the proteins concentrated in channels resembling those in mice. Their dimensions were similar, too.
paras.zh: 当荧光标记的 tau 蛋白和 β 淀粉样蛋白应用于人体组织时，蛋白质集中在与小鼠类似的通道中。它们的尺寸也相似。

paras.en: But tissue maintained outside the body cannot reveal the complete clearance process inside a living person.
paras.zh: 但体外保存的组织无法揭示活人体内完整的清除过程。

paras.en: "In the future it will be important to demonstrate that these tubes function in the same way in living humans," Attwell said.
paras.zh: 阿特韦尔说：“将来，重要的是要证明这些管子在活人体内以同样的方式发挥作用。”

paras.en: Another mystery concerns what drives the movement. The researchers do not yet know precisely how proteins enter the channels or how fluid travels through them so quickly. Pulsing blood vessels might contribute, but the pumping mechanism remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 另一个谜团是驱动这一运动的因素。研究人员尚不清楚蛋白质如何进入通道或液体如何如此快速地穿过通道。脉动的血管可能有所贡献，但泵送机制仍未解决。

paras.en: Understanding that mechanism could help researchers investigate whether impaired transport contributes to disease, and whether changing the flow would make a difference.
paras.zh: 了解这一机制可以帮助研究人员调查运输受损是否会导致疾病，以及改变流动是否会产生影响。

paras.en: "We also need to know whether a slowing of this pumping contributes to initiating Alzheimer's disease, and whether therapeutically speeding the pumping could help treat the disease," Attwell said.
paras.zh: 阿特韦尔说：“我们还需要知道这种泵送减慢是否会导致阿尔茨海默氏病的发生，以及治疗性加速泵送是否有助于治疗这种疾病。”

paras.en: The study did not test a treatment or demonstrate improvements in memory. Those possibilities require further research.
paras.zh: 该研究没有测试治疗方法或证明记忆力有所改善。这些可能性需要进一步研究。

paras.en: For now, scientists have a newly identified structure to investigate. Following proteins through these tiny channels could help answer a much larger question: when potentially harmful substances accumulate in the brain, where does their journey out go wrong?
paras.zh: 目前，科学家们有一个新发现的结构需要研究。通过这些微小的通道追踪蛋白质可以帮助回答一个更大的问题：当潜在的有害物质在大脑中积聚时，它们的旅程会在哪里出错？

paras.en: A preprint of the study is available on bioRxiv.
paras.zh: 该研究的预印本可在 bioRxiv 上找到。

articles.title: A 40-Year Assumption About High-Temperature Superconductors Just Fell Apart
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Superconducting materials can carry electricity with zero heat loss, which is potentially revolutionary for power grids, computer systems, and more – and which makes them of great interest to scientists.
paras.zh: 超导材料可以在零热损失的情况下传输电力，这对于电网、计算机系统等来说可能是革命性的，这使得它们引起了科学家的极大兴趣。

paras.en: To use them widely and practically, however, we need to know more about how superconductors work, and get them operating at normal temperatures and pressures.
paras.zh: 然而，为了广泛和实际地使用它们，我们需要更多地了解超导体的工作原理，并让它们在常温常压下工作。

paras.en: Even superconductors classed as 'high temperature' need to be cooled to well below freezing to behave properly.
paras.zh: 即使是被归类为“高温”的超导体也需要冷却到远低于冰点才能正常工作。

paras.en: Researchers from the University of Warwick in the UK and the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility in France have now published a study in Physical Review Letters that overturns a 40-year-old assumption about a group of high-temperature superconductors called cuprates (copper-based ceramics).
paras.zh: 英国华威大学和法国欧洲同步辐射设施的研究人员现已在《物理评论快报》上发表了一项研究，推翻了 40 年来关于一组称为铜酸盐（铜基陶瓷）的高温超导体的假设。

paras.en: Since their discovery in 1986, cuprates have been thought to have a uniform crystal structure internally.
paras.zh: 自 1986 年被发现以来，铜酸盐一直被认为内部具有均匀的晶体结构。

paras.en: This latest research suggests they're actually made up of a patchwork of different structures.
paras.zh: 这项最新研究表明，它们实际上是由不同结构拼凑而成的。

paras.en: "For forty years, the working assumption has been that these materials are the same all the way through, and nearly all the theory is built on that picture," says chemist Mark Senn, from the University of Warwick.
paras.zh: 华威大学的化学家马克·森 (Mark Senn) 表示：“四十年来，人们一直认为这些材料始终是相同的，几乎所有的理论都是建立在这种情况之上的。”

paras.en: To make the discovery, the researchers used a technique called 3D X-ray diffraction (3DXRD), which can pick out crystal structures throughout a material's interior by measuring the strain at different points.
paras.zh: 为了实现这一发现，研究人员使用了一种称为 3D X 射线衍射 (3DXRD) 的技术，该技术可以通过测量不同点的应变来找出整个材料内部的晶体结构。

paras.en: The material analyzed was a type of cuprate known as LESCO (lanthanum-europium-strontium copper oxide), which was tested at temperatures between 300 kelvin (26.9 °C / 80.3 °F) and 100 kelvin (-173.2 °C / -279.7 °F).
paras.zh: 分析的材料是一种称为 LESCO（镧-铕-锶铜氧化物）的铜酸盐，在 300 开尔文 (26.9 °C / 80.3 °F) 和 100 开尔文 (-173.2 °C / -279.7 °F) 之间的温度下进行测试。

paras.en: It's the first time that the interior of a cuprate has been examined to this depth and detail, and the scan turned up a surprise: two different atomic arrangements, separated by boundaries much wider than is typical for materials like this.
paras.zh: 这是第一次对铜酸盐的内部进行如此深度和细节的检查，扫描结果令人惊讶：两种不同的原子排列，其边界比此类材料的典型边界宽得多。

paras.en: "The crystal is fundamentally patchworked and textured, with unusually wide boundary regions that likely work against superconductivity rather than just sitting alongside it," says Senn.
paras.zh: Senn 说：“这种晶体从根本上来说是拼凑而成的，具有纹理，具有异常宽的边界区域，这可能会阻碍超导性，而不是仅仅坐在它旁边。”

paras.en: The discovery gives scientists a much better understanding of the superconducting qualities of LESCO, and quite possibly other cuprates. What was previously assumed about these materials was actually an oversimplification.
paras.zh: 这一发现让科学家们对 LESCO 以及很可能其他铜氧化物的超导特性有了更好的了解。之前对这些材料的假设实际上过于简单化了。

paras.en: Electron movement is crucial for carrying electricity through a material, and the structures and boundaries identified in this research could affect how electrons pair up and arrange themselves into patterns – something which can be analyzed in future studies.
paras.zh: 电子运动对于通过材料传输电力至关重要，这项研究中确定的结构和边界可能会影响电子如何配对并排列成图案——这可以在未来的研究中进行分析。

paras.en: "This might explain why some materials perform better than others and means some existing bulk measurements will need to be reinterpreted and future theoretical models built that incorporate this structural complexity," says Senn.
paras.zh: Senn 说：“这可能解释了为什么某些材料的性能比其他材料更好，并且意味着需要重新解释一些现有的体积测量，并建立包含这种结构复杂性的未来理论模型。”

paras.en: Next, the researchers want to use the same technique to look inside other materials, including other cuprates, to see how their internal structures shape their behavior.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员希望使用相同的技术来观察其他材料（包括其他铜酸盐）的内部，以了解它们的内部结构如何塑造其行为。

paras.en: The discovery shows we've still got a lot to learn about superconductors, even those that were first identified four decades ago.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，关于超导体，我们还有很多东西需要了解，即使是那些四十年前首次发现的超导体。

paras.en: Already this year we've seen researchers set new temperature records for superconductors, break the conventional rules of these materials, and identify new superconducting states.
paras.zh: 今年，我们已经看到研究人员创造了超导体的新温度记录，打破了这些材料的传统规则，并确定了新的超导状态。

paras.en: It all gets us closer to being able to use superconductivity outside of the lab and very specialist use cases (such as MRI scanners).
paras.zh: 这一切都让我们更接近能够在实验室外和非常专业的用例（例如 MRI 扫描仪）中使用超导性。

paras.en: One question that needs further investigation is whether scientists should treat these superconductors as single materials going forward – or whether the different structures and large boundaries found inside LESCO mean it makes more sense to think of superconductors like this as several materials in one.
paras.zh: 需要进一步研究的一个问题是，科学家是否应该将这些超导体视为未来的单一材料，或者 LESCO 内部发现的不同结构和大边界是否意味着将这样的超导体视为多种材料合而为一更有意义。

paras.en: "New experimental techniques, such as scanning 3DXRD demonstrated here, will be instrumental in capturing the high-resolution structural data necessary to confront this challenge, enabling a more nuanced understanding of complex materials," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“新的实验技术，例如这里演示的扫描 3DXRD，将有助于捕获应对这一挑战所需的高分辨率结构数据，从而能够更细致地了解复杂材料。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《物理评论快报》上。

articles.title: The Dead Sea Is Creating Its Own Extreme Climate as It Dies
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Imagine following the retreating shoreline of the Dead Sea. As the water withdraws, ground once submerged comes into view. But beneath the remaining water lies a puzzle: why is this shrinking lake also getting warmer?
paras.zh: 想象一下，沿着死海后退的海岸线。随着水退去，曾经被淹没的地面映入眼帘。但在剩余的水下隐藏着一个谜题：为什么这个不断缩小的湖泊也会变暖？

paras.en: With Jordan to the east and Israel and the West Bank to the west, the Dead Sea is an exceptionally salty lake.
paras.zh: 死海东临约旦，西临以色列和约旦河西岸，是一个异常咸的湖。

paras.en: Hotter air is an obvious suspect. Yet a new study suggests part of the explanation lies within the lake itself: water loss can contribute to warming, and that warming can sustain further evaporation and water loss – a feedback loop between shrinking and heating.
paras.zh: 较热的空气是明显的嫌疑人。然而，一项新的研究表明，部分解释在于湖泊本身：水流失可能导致变暖，而变暖又可以维持进一步的蒸发和水流失——这​​是收缩和加热之间的反馈循环。

paras.en: The mechanism could explain how ancient seas produced vast salt deposits without requiring the surrounding climate to have been exceptionally hot and dry.
paras.zh: 该机制可以解释古代海洋如何在不需要周围气候异常炎热和干燥的情况下产生大量盐沉积物。

paras.en: Led by Emmanuel Guillerm of Germany's GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences and Binghamton University in the US, the team built a model linking water loss, salt concentration and heat exchange.
paras.zh: 由德国 GFZ 亥姆霍兹地球科学中心和美国宾厄姆顿大学的 Emmanuel Guillerm 领导的团队建立了一个将水损失、盐浓度和热交换联系起来的模型。

paras.en: The Dead Sea provides a natural laboratory. Human diversion of incoming water has contributed to falling lake levels and salt precipitation.
paras.zh: 死海提供了一个天然的实验室。人类对入水的改道导致了湖泊水位下降和盐分降水。

paras.en: Between 1979 and 2019, its level dropped by about 34 metres. Over that period, its deep waters warmed by 2.8°C, while its upper layer warmed by about 1.7°C.
paras.zh: 1979年至2019年间，其水位下降了约34米。在此期间，其深水温度升高了 2.8°C，而上层温度则升高了约 1.7°C。

paras.en: Calibrated using 2012–2015 measurements, the model reproduced the observed 1979–2019 warming trend and seasonal temperature patterns.
paras.zh: 该模型使用 2012-2015 年的测量值进行校准，再现了观察到的 1979-2019 年变暖趋势和季节性温度模式。

paras.en: Next, the team tested the two influences separately: keeping air temperature constant in one simulation and lake level constant in another.
paras.zh: 接下来，该团队分别测试了这两种影响：在一个模拟中保持气温恒定，在另一个模拟中保持湖水位恒定。

paras.en: By the 2010s, rising air temperatures contributed about 1.3°C to deep-water warming in these simulations. Declining water levels contributed about 1.5°C.
paras.zh: 到 2010 年代，在这些模拟中，气温上升导致深水变暖约 1.3°C。水位下降导致温度下降约 1.5°C。

paras.en: Evaporation carries heat away, cooling the remaining water, much as evaporating sweat cools our bodies.
paras.zh: 蒸发带走热量，冷却剩余的水，就像蒸发汗水冷却我们的身体一样。

paras.en: Dissolved salts change that process. They reduce water's tendency to evaporate at a given temperature. As water disappears and the brine becomes more concentrated, evaporative cooling weakens.
paras.zh: 溶解的盐改变了这个过程。它们减少了水在给定温度下蒸发的趋势。随着水的消失和盐水变得更加浓缩，蒸发冷却减弱。

paras.en: The remaining water can therefore become warmer. When it is warmer than the air above it, the temperature difference can sustain evaporation despite the high salt concentration.
paras.zh: 因此，剩余的水会变得更热。当它比上面的空气温暖时，尽管盐浓度很高，但温差可以维持蒸发。

paras.en: "This part of water warming is thus due to water diversion, and adds on top of water warming due to anthropogenic air warming," Guillerm tells ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 吉勒姆告诉 ScienceAlert：“因此，这部分水变暖是由于水转移造成的，并且是人为空气变暖导致的水变暖的一部分。”

paras.en: Heat also moves downwards. In summer, warmer, saltier water overlies cooler, slightly fresher water. Because heat diffuses faster than salt, sinking streams can transport heat and salt into the deeper layer through a process called salt fingering.
paras.zh: 热量也向下移动。夏季，较温暖、较咸的水覆盖在较冷、较新鲜的水之上。由于热量比盐扩散得更快，下沉的溪流可以通过称为盐指作用的过程将热量和盐输送到更深的层中。

paras.en: Winter mixing provides another route for atmospheric warming to reach the depths.
paras.zh: 冬季混合为大气变暖提供了另一条到达深处的途径。

paras.en: The researchers then explored the future under two warming scenarios, assuming all inflows stop, industrial extraction ceases, and the lake continues mixing once a year.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后探讨了两种变暖情景下的未来，假设所有流入停止，工业开采停止，湖泊每年继续混合一次。

paras.en: Under those conditions, the study projects roughly 85 metres of water-level decline by 2100 and around 5–8°C of water warming, depending on greenhouse gas emissions.
paras.zh: 在这些条件下，该研究预计到 2100 年，水位将下降约 85 米，水温将升高约 5-8°C，具体取决于温室气体排放量。

paras.en: Excluding inflow tends to overestimate decline and warming; excluding industrial extraction tends to underestimate water loss. Guillerm thinks these effects balance, noting no break in simulated decline at the 2019 transition to projections. Groundwater inflow remains uncertain.
paras.zh: 排除流入量往往会高估下降和变暖；排除工业开采往往会低估水损失。 Guillerm 认为这些影响是平衡的，并指出 2019 年过渡到预测时模拟下降没有中断。地下水流入量仍不确定。

paras.en: The simulations prescribe future air warming while keeping humidity, wind and incoming sunlight at repeating historical seasonal patterns.
paras.zh: 模拟预测了未来的空气变暖，同时保持湿度、风和入射阳光重复历史季节模式。

paras.en: In longer simulations, increasing brine concentration sustained warming even after imposed air warming stopped.
paras.zh: 在较长时间的模拟中，即使在强制空气变暖停止后，盐水浓度的增加也会持续变暖。

paras.en: Restoring historical freshwater inflow would stop lake-level decline, Guillerm says.
paras.zh: 吉勒姆说，恢复历史淡水流入将阻止湖水位下降。

paras.en: "Warming due to increasing salinity would stop," he explains.
paras.zh: “由于盐度增加而导致的变暖将会停止，”他解释道。

paras.en: He says a dilute surface layer would insulate deeper waters from atmospheric warming, which would continue at the surface.
paras.zh: 他说，稀释的表层可以使更深的水域免受大气变暖的影响，而大气变暖将在地表继续下去。

paras.en: The team then asked what would happen in a much larger basin: an eastern Mediterranean completely disconnected from the ocean.
paras.zh: 研究小组随后询问在一个更大的盆地中会发生什么：东地中海与海洋完全分离。

paras.en: The experiment assumed complete isolation; whether this occurred during the Mediterranean's ancient loss of water remains debated.
paras.zh: 实验假设完全隔离；这是否发生在地中海古代失水期间仍然存在争议。

paras.en: "Our work does not provide the solution," Guillerm says.
paras.zh: “我们的工作并没有提供解决方案，”吉勒姆说。

paras.en: The simulation began with a surface 400 metres below sea level and brine already concentrated enough for rock salt to crystallise.
paras.zh: 模拟从海平面以下 400 米的地表开始，盐水已经浓缩到足以使岩盐结晶。

paras.en: Over roughly 8,000 years, simulated water temperatures rose by around 20°C, while the water level fell by 2.5 kilometres.
paras.zh: 大约 8000 年来，模拟水温上升了约 20°C，而水位下降了 2.5 公里。

paras.en: Descending to lower elevations exposed the surface to warmer air. Salt concentration and changes within the water layers also contributed.
paras.zh: 下降到较低的海拔使地表暴露在更温暖的空气中。盐浓度和水层内的变化也起到了一定作用。

paras.en: Highly soluble potassium-bearing salts formed in the simulation despite an assumed relative humidity of 65 percent.
paras.zh: 尽管假设相对湿度为 65%，但在模拟中仍形成了高度可溶的含钾盐。

paras.en: These minerals and unusually warm ancient brines are often interpreted as evidence of exceptionally hot or dry conditions. The model suggests isolation and shrinkage can produce them under less extreme regional climates.
paras.zh: 这些矿物质和异常温暖的古代盐水通常被解释为异常炎热或干燥条件的证据。该模型表明，隔离和收缩可以在不太极端的区域气候下产生它们。

paras.en: Tiny brine pockets trapped in salt crystals preserve clues to past water temperatures. Warming through successive layers might record a sea's progressive shrinkage.
paras.zh: 盐晶体中的微小盐水袋保留了过去水温的线索。连续各层的变暖可能会记录海洋的逐渐收缩。

paras.en: The researchers propose using those temperature changes to investigate how far ancient seas fell as they dwindled.
paras.zh: 研究人员建议利用这些温度变化来研究古代海洋在缩小时下降了多远。

paras.en: The research has been published in Geophysical Research Letters.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《地球物理研究快报》上。

articles.title: Archaeologists may have finally solved a 100-year-old Florida mystery

paras.en: Archaeologists may have finally solved a 100-year-old Florida mystery
paras.zh: 考古学家可能终于解开了佛罗里达州 100 年前的谜团

paras.en: - Ancient pottery from Tampa Bay appears to have been made by migrant craftspeople who brought specialized Mississippian pottery-making knowledge hundreds of miles south. Remarkably, they even incorporated crushed fragments of older homeland pottery into new vessels, preserving a physical link to their past across generations.
paras.zh: - 坦帕湾的古代陶器似乎是由移民工匠制作的，他们将专业的密西西比陶器制作知识带到了以南数百英里的地方。值得注意的是，他们甚至将古老祖国陶器的碎片融入新容器中，保留了几代人与过去的物理联系。

paras.en: About a century ago, archaeologists excavating pottery fragments around Tampa Bay encountered something puzzling. Some of the pieces carried decorations that looked strikingly similar to pottery found hundreds of miles farther north. On appearance alone, the fragments seemed connected to the Mississippian culture, which emerged more than 1,000 years ago and reshaped social, economic and political life across much of southeastern North America.
paras.zh: 大约一个世纪前，考古学家在坦帕湾周围挖掘陶器碎片时遇到了一些令人费解的事情。其中一些作品的装饰看起来与北边数百英里处发现的陶器惊人地相似。仅从外观上看，这些碎片似乎与密西西比文化有关，这种文化出现于 1000 多年前，重塑了北美东南部大部分地区的社会、经济和政治生活。

paras.en: For decades, however, maps of the Mississippian world generally left out peninsular Florida. The Tampa Bay pottery suggested that the region's relationship with that culture may have been more complicated.
paras.zh: 然而，几十年来，密西西比世界的地图通常忽略了佛罗里达半岛。坦帕湾陶器表明该地区与该文化的关系可能更为复杂。

paras.en: "It's been this open debate for a century," said Neill Wallis, curator of Florida archaeology, bioarchaeology and the Ceramic Technology Laboratory at the Florida Museum of Natural History. "Tampa Bay sites had some Mississippian-like traits such as platform mound-village complexes and iconography, but lacked others, like maize agriculture and shell-tempered pottery. The Mississippian-looking pottery has always begged the question: How did this stuff wind up in Tampa Bay?"
paras.zh: 佛罗里达自然历史博物馆佛罗里达考古学、生物考古学和陶瓷技术实验室馆长尼尔·沃利斯说：“这种公开辩论已经持续了一个世纪。” “坦帕湾遗址具有一些类似密西西比人的特征，例如平台土丘村庄综合体和图像，但缺乏其他特征，例如玉米农业和贝壳陶器。这些看起来像密西西比人的陶器总是引出一个问题：这些东西是如何最终出现在坦帕湾的？”

paras.en: Mississippian pottery could provide some of the strongest evidence linking Tampa Bay communities with the broader culture. But decorative similarities alone could not reveal where the vessels had actually been made. Lacking the necessary technology and expertise to answer that question, museum curators stored the mysterious fragments while competing explanations remained unresolved.
paras.zh: 密西西比陶器可以提供一些将坦帕湾社区与更广泛的文化联系起来的最有力的证据。但仅凭装饰上的相似性并不能揭示这些器皿的实际制造地。由于缺乏必要的技术和专业知识来回答这个问题，博物馆馆长储存了这些神秘的碎片，而相互竞争的解释仍未得到解决。

paras.en: Researchers at the Florida Museum have now conducted a study aimed at determining where the pottery came from and who made it.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达博物馆的研究人员现在进行了一项研究，旨在确定这些陶器的来源和制造者。

paras.en: "We were curious to find out if these vessels were imported from the heartland by trade, if they were local imitations of Mississippian motifs, or, as we ultimately found, if they were made by migrants who had made their way into communities in Tampa Bay to take up shop and residency there," said Trevor Duke, who began conducting the research for his doctoral dissertation at the University of Florida. In the years since, Duke and his colleagues have expanded on the initial scope of his dissertation to compile more evidence from a larger collection of samples.
paras.zh: “我们很想知道这些船只是否是通过贸易从中心地带进口的，它们是否是密西西比图案的本地仿制品，或者，正如我们最终发现的那样，它们是否是由进入坦帕湾社区并在那里开店和居住的移民制造的，”特雷弗·杜克(Trevor Duke)说，他在佛罗里达大学开始为他的博士论文进行这项研究。从那以后的几年里，杜克和他的同事们扩大了他论文的最初范围，从更多的样本中收集了更多的证据。

paras.en: By examining details of pottery production that are almost invisible from the surface, the researchers traced the decorated vessels to a small community of skilled craftspeople who likely traveled hundreds of miles from the Mississippian heartland before settling in Tampa Bay. Compared with the plain molded pottery widely used in the area, the decorated vessels were made with different clay, tempering materials, and production methods. Those differences suggest the migrants possessed specialized expertise and access to resources unavailable to many local residents.
paras.zh: 通过检查从表面几乎看不见的陶器生产细节，研究人员将这些装饰器皿追溯到一个由熟练工匠组成的小社区，他们可能从密西西比中心地带迁移了数百英里，然后定居在坦帕湾。与该地区广泛使用的素模陶器相比，装饰器皿的粘土、淬火材料和制作方法有所不同。这些差异表明，移民拥有许多当地居民无法获得的专业知识和资源。

paras.en: Mississippian Culture Spreads Across the Southeast
paras.zh: 密西西比文化遍布东南部

paras.en: Around 1000 A.D., a new cultural system developed in the Mississippi River Valley and spread across large parts of what are now the Midwest and eastern United States. In its core regions, Indigenous communities became organized into political hierarchies, with powerful chiefdoms exerting influence over surrounding settlements. Large areas were planted with maize, while enormous quantities of earth were moved to construct mounds topped by temples and residences for leaders.
paras.zh: 公元 1000 年左右，一种新的文化体系在密西西比河流域发展起来，并传播到现在美国中西部和东部的大部分地区。在其核心地区，原住民社区被组织成政治等级制度，强大的酋长管辖区对周围的定居点施加影响。大面积种植玉米，同时移走大量泥土建造土丘，土丘顶部建有寺庙和领导人住所。

paras.en: Tampa Bay lay far outside those major northern centers.
paras.zh: 坦帕湾距离那些主要的北部中心很远。

paras.en: The regional culture that occupied Tampa Bay and nearby areas during this period is known as Safety Harbor. Like Mississippian societies, Safety Harbor communities formed smaller chiefdoms and constructed flat-topped mounds. The region's largest settlement was home to the Tocobaga, while smaller Mocoso, Pohoy, and Uzita chiefdoms were scattered nearby.
paras.zh: 这一时期占领坦帕湾及附近地区的地区文化被称为安全港。与密西西比社会一样，安全港社区形成了较小的酋长管辖地并建造了平顶土丘。该地区最大的定居点是托科巴加人的所在地，而较小的莫科索、波霍伊和乌齐塔酋长国则分散在附近。

paras.en: Yet important differences remained. None of these groups accumulated the same level of political power seen in the major Mississippian centers farther north. Tampa Bay communities also never adopted the extensive maize agriculture associated with Mississippian society, relying instead on fishing and other marine resources.
paras.zh: 但重要的差异仍然存在。这些群体中没有一个积累了与更北的密西西比主要中心相同水平的政治权力。坦帕湾社区也从未采用与密西西比社会相关的粗放玉米农业，而是依赖渔业和其他海洋资源。

paras.en: Because of this mixture of similarities and differences, archaeologists have long struggled to determine how closely Tampa Bay was connected to the Mississippian heartland. The discovery of pottery decorated in Mississippian styles only deepened the mystery.
paras.zh: 由于这种相似性和差异性的混合，考古学家长期以来一直在努力确定坦帕湾与密西西比腹地的联系有多紧密。密西西比风格装饰陶器的发现只会加深这个谜团。

paras.en: To investigate, Duke and other Florida Museum archaeologists assembled 58 plain and decorated pottery fragments from Tampa Bay. Both kinds of vessels were likely used for preparing and serving food, although the decorated pieces may have been reserved for special events.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，杜克和佛罗里达博物馆的其他考古学家从坦帕湾收集了 58 块素色和装饰的陶器碎片。两种器皿都可能用于准备和盛放食物，尽管装饰件可能是为特殊活动而保留的。

paras.en: Mississippian potters of the period commonly mixed crushed freshwater shell or fragments of older pottery, known as grog, into their clay. They also built vessels by stacking coils of clay rather than molding them.
paras.zh: 这一时期的密西西比陶艺家通常将压碎的淡水贝壳或旧陶器的碎片（称为熟料）混合到粘土中。他们还通过堆叠粘土卷而不是模制来建造容器。

paras.en: Those manufacturing details offered researchers a way to distinguish genuine Mississippian traditions from local copies. If the decorated Tampa Bay vessels had been imported or produced by potters trained in Mississippian methods, the fragments should preserve evidence of these techniques. If local potters had simply copied the decorative appearance, the underlying construction would instead reflect familiar Tampa Bay practices such as sand tempering.
paras.zh: 这些制造细节为研究人员提供了一种区分真正的密西西比传统与当地复制品的方法。如果坦帕湾的装饰器皿是进口的或由接受过密西西比方法培训的陶工制作的，那么这些碎片应该保留这些技术的证据。如果当地陶工只是简单地复制装饰外观，那么底层的结构就会反映出坦帕湾常见的做法，例如沙回火。

paras.en: The researchers first used neutron activation analysis to measure the chemical composition of the pottery. They compared those results with raw clay deposits from the Tampa Bay area.
paras.zh: 研究人员首先使用中子活化分析来测量陶器的化学成分。他们将这些结果与坦帕湾地区的原始粘土沉积物进行了比较。

paras.en: The chemistry matched, showing that the vessels had been produced locally. That finding ruled out the possibility that finished pottery had been manufactured in the Mississippian heartland and transported south through trade. It did not, however, eliminate the possibility that Tampa Bay potters had copied northern designs.
paras.zh: 化学成分相符，表明这些容器是本地生产的。这一发现排除了成品陶器是在密西西比中心地带制造并通过贸易运往南方的可能性。然而，这并没有消除坦帕湾陶工抄袭北方设计的可能性。

paras.en: The team then examined thin slices of the fragments under a microscope using a technique called petrography. Researchers polish a section of pottery until it is roughly half the width of a human hair, allowing light from a polarizing microscope to pass through it. Tiny grains, cracks and empty spaces can then reveal how the clay was prepared and what materials were mixed into it.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组使用岩相学技术在显微镜下检查了碎片的薄片。研究人员将一段陶器抛光至大约人类头发宽度的一半，让偏光显微镜发出的光线穿过它。微小的颗粒、裂缝和空隙可以揭示粘土是如何制备的以及其中混合了哪些材料。

paras.en: "Looking at the section under a microscope, you can identify the minerals in it based on their color and shape. From that, we can figure out what was added to it. It's a sort of fingerprint of the people who made it," Wallis said.
paras.zh: “在显微镜下观察切片，你可以根据颜色和形状识别其中的矿物质。从中，我们可以找出其中添加了什么。这是制造它的人的指纹，”沃利斯说。

paras.en: That microscopic examination produced some of the study's most revealing evidence.
paras.zh: 那次显微镜检查产生了该研究中一些最具启发性的证据。

paras.en: Several decorated fragments contained grog, the crushed pottery temper associated with some Mississippian traditions. Adding grog improves the durability of a vessel and helps it tolerate the intense heat of firing and cooking.
paras.zh: 一些装饰碎片含有烈酒，这是与密西西比州一些传统相关的压碎陶器脾气。添加熟料可提高容器的耐用性，并有助于其耐受烧制和烹饪的高温。

paras.en: "This grog tempering is not something that we saw previously or in the plain samples in Tampa Bay," Duke said. "But up in the Tallahassee Hills, where the nearest massive Mississippian mound center is located, it's common in all vessels. It's the plain-Jane tempering technique there."
paras.zh: “这种熟料回火不是我们以前看到的，也不是在坦帕湾的普通样品中看到的，”杜克说。 “但在塔拉哈西山，最近的大型密西西比土丘中心所在的地方，它在所有容器中都很常见。这是那里的简单简式回火技术。”

paras.en: The connection extended beyond manufacturing technique.
paras.zh: 这种联系超出了制造技术的范围。

paras.en: The Tallahassee Hills lie roughly 200 miles north of Tampa Bay. Inside the grog used in the decorated vessels, researchers found mica, a reflective silicate mineral that is common in the Florida Panhandle but unusual in peninsular Florida. Although the surrounding clay in the vessels came from Tampa Bay, some of the crushed material mixed into it appears to have originated farther north in the Mississippian heartland.
paras.zh: 塔拉哈西山 (Tallahassee Hills) 位于坦帕湾以北约 200 英里处。在装饰器皿中使用的熟料中，研究人员发现了云母，这是一种反射性硅酸盐矿物，在佛罗里达狭长地带很常见，但在佛罗里达半岛并不常见。尽管容器中周围的粘土来自坦帕湾，但混入其中的一些粉碎材料似乎起源于更北的密西西比中心地带。

paras.en: Grog appeared in 80% of the decorated pottery analyzed, but researchers did not find it in a single piece of plain pottery. Most of the plain vessels instead contained dry clay fragments or sand, materials that had been used in local pottery traditions for about 3,000 years.
paras.zh: 在所分析的装饰陶器中，80% 都含有烈酒，但研究人员并未在一块素色陶器中发现它。大多数普通器皿都装有干燥的粘土碎片或沙子，这些材料在当地陶器传统中已使用了大约 3,000 年。

paras.en: Other differences reinforced the distinction. The decorated vessels were constructed using the Mississippian technique of coiling clay and followed more consistent clay recipes, suggesting a higher degree of specialized knowledge. Plain vessels, in contrast, were molded. That simpler technique became increasingly common as the region's population grew and could be learned quickly by people without advanced pottery experience.
paras.zh: 其他差异强化了这种区别。这些装饰器皿是使用密西西比卷曲粘土技术建造的，并遵循更一致的粘土配方，表明专业知识程度更高。相比之下，普通容器是模制的。随着该地区人口的增长，这种更简单的技术变得越来越普遍，没有高级制陶经验的人也可以很快学会。

paras.en: Migrants May Have Carried Pieces of Home
paras.zh: 移民可能携带了一些家居用品

paras.en: Together, the evidence points toward potters who migrated from the Mississippian heartland and brought both their technical knowledge and materials with them.
paras.zh: 总而言之，所有证据都表明陶艺家是从密西西比腹地迁移过来的，并带来了他们的技术知识和材料。

paras.en: As these craftspeople traveled south from northern Florida, they may have carried pieces of older pottery made from clay found in their homeland. Once they reached Tampa Bay, those vessels could have been crushed, ground into small fragments, and mixed into newly gathered local clay.
paras.zh: 当这些工匠从佛罗里达州北部向南旅行时，他们可能携带了用在家乡发现的粘土制成的旧陶器。一旦他们到达坦帕湾，这些船只可能会被压碎，磨成小碎片，并混合到新收集的当地粘土中。

paras.en: The practice may have carried cultural meaning as well as practical benefits.
paras.zh: 这种做法可能具有文化意义和实际效益。

paras.en: The migrants appear to have specifically selected decorated pottery from their homeland for use as grog. Every grog tempered vessel examined by the researchers contained what is known as multigenerational grog, in which one fragment of grog contains an even older piece of grog inside it. In effect, pottery from one generation had been incorporated into the pottery of the next.
paras.zh: 这些移民似乎专门从家乡挑选了装饰陶器来用作烈酒。研究人员检查的每一个熟料回火容器中都含有所谓的多代熟料，其中一块熟料中含有一块更古老的熟料。实际上，一代人的陶器已经融入了下一代的陶器中。

paras.en: "It's sort of like Russian nesting dolls because you have grog within grog within grog. You can trace this back several generations of pots," Wallis said. "And they're not using vessels from just anywhere. They're crushing up the same decorated vessels that include pieces of decorated pottery from before."
paras.zh: “这有点像俄罗斯的嵌套娃娃，因为你的酒里有酒。你可以追溯到几代的罐子里，”沃利斯说。 “而且他们使用的器皿并不是来自任何地方。他们正在粉碎同样的装饰器皿，其中包括以前的装饰陶器。”

paras.en: These embedded fragments were tiny physical pieces of the migrants' homeland that continued to be incorporated into vessels made generations later in Tampa Bay.
paras.zh: 这些嵌入的碎片是移民家园的微小实体碎片，继续被纳入坦帕湾几代人制造的船只中。

paras.en: Their pottery expertise and their connection to Mississippian traditions may also have helped the newcomers establish a valuable role in their adopted community. Skills that were ordinary in their homeland could have become highly specialized and desirable once they moved south.
paras.zh: 他们的陶艺专业知识以及与密西西比传统的联系也可能帮助新移民在他们所接受的社区中发挥重要作用。一旦他们南迁，在家乡普通的技能可能会变得高度专业化和令人向往。

paras.en: "Migrant communities often had to figure out their own niche in a new place," said Andrea Torvinen, collections manager of the Ceramic Technology Lab and Florida Archaeology at the Florida Museum. "What would have made these migrants stand out? How would they have established a role in this new area? Bringing a specialized knowledge of pottery production seems to have been one way they could do so."
paras.zh: “移民社区常常必须在新的地方找到自己的定位，”佛罗里达博物馆陶瓷技术实验室和佛罗里达考古学收藏经理安德里亚·托维宁 (Andrea Torvinen) 说。 “是什么让这些移民脱颖而出？他们如何在这个新领域发挥作用？带来陶器生产的专业知识似乎是他们实现这一目标的一种方式。”

paras.en: Evidence suggests those skills were highly valued. The advanced techniques appear almost entirely in decorated pottery, while everyday plain vessels continued to be made with simpler local methods. Decorated pots were also produced using higher quality clay, suggesting that the migrant potters were allowed access to scarce, superior materials for their work.
paras.zh: 有证据表明这些技能受到高度重视。先进的技术几乎完全出现在装饰陶器中，而日常的普通器皿则继续采用更简单的当地方法制作。装饰花盆也使用更高质量的粘土制作，这表明移民陶工可以使用稀有的优质材料来完成他们的工作。

paras.en: How Specialized Pottery Skills Stayed Exclusive
paras.zh: 专业陶艺技能如何保持独特

paras.en: The divide between decorated and plain pottery continued for centuries, raising another question: Why did local residents not simply learn the migrants' more advanced techniques?
paras.zh: 装饰陶器和素陶之间的分歧持续了几个世纪，这引发了另一个问题：为什么当地居民不简单地学习移民更先进的技术？

paras.en: The researchers suggest that the knowledge remained concentrated within a small group of craftspeople who worked closely together. Whether intentionally guarded or simply transmitted within tight social networks, the techniques were not widely shared.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，知识仍然集中在一小群密切合作的工匠手中。无论是有意保护还是只是在紧密的社交网络中传播，这些技术都没有得到广泛共享。

paras.en: "The group of potters making the decorated vessels likely had some kind of special status that they maintained through this secretive practice, even if it wasn't a secret in the sense that no one knew about it," Wallis said. "In fact, for secrets like this, you do have to broadcast some of the details so that people know there is a secret."
paras.zh: 沃利斯说：“制作装饰器皿的陶工群体很可能拥有某种特殊地位，他们通过这种秘密做法维持了这种地位，即使这并不是一个无人知晓的秘密。” “事实上，对于这样的秘密，你确实必须广播一些细节，以便人们知道有一个秘密。”

paras.en: High quality decorated vessels would likely have circulated widely and been prized throughout the community. But many of the features that made them distinctive, including grog tempering, coiled construction and carefully standardized clay preparation, were hidden inside the finished pottery and therefore difficult to copy.
paras.zh: 高品质的装饰器皿可能会广泛流通并在整个社区受到珍视。但许多使它们与众不同的特征，包括熟料回火、卷绕结构和精心标准化的粘土制备，都隐藏在成品陶器中，因此难以复制。

paras.en: Without direct access to the small circle of migrant potters who knew these methods, Tampa Bay residents would have had little opportunity to learn them.
paras.zh: 如果不能直接接触了解这些方法的移民陶工小圈子，坦帕湾居民就几乎没有机会学习它们。

paras.en: "People with specialized skills have direct relationships with the people learning from them. That's how we see knowledge passed down. When it's the way your mentor has always done it, that's how you're going to do it," Torvinen said. "And in this case, there could have been a more meaningful reason behind it. By tying the homeland pottery into this enchainment, they're bringing those pots with them into the next generation."
paras.zh: “拥有专业技能的人与向他们学习的人有着直接的关系。这就是我们如何看待知识的传承。当你的导师一直这样做时，你也会这样做，”托维宁说。 “在这种情况下，背后可能有更有意义的原因。通过将祖国的陶器绑在这个束缚中，他们将这些陶器带到了下一代。”

paras.en: The study was published in American Antiquity.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《美国古代》杂志上。

paras.en: Materials provided by Florida Museum of Natural History. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由佛罗里达自然历史博物馆提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - C. Trevor Duke, Andrea Torvinen, Neill J. Wallis. Secret Recipes: Potting Knowledge and Migration in Mississippian (ca. AD 1000â1600) Tampa Bay, Florida, USA. American Antiquity, 2026; 1 DOI: 10.1017/aaq.2026.10227
paras.zh: - C. Trevor Duke、Andrea Torvinen、Neill J. Wallis。秘密食谱：密西西比人（约公元 1000 年至 1600 年）美国佛罗里达州坦帕湾的盆栽知识和移民。美国古代，2026； 1 DOI：10.1017/aaq.2026.10227

articles.title: Goodbye joint replacements? Stanford scientists found a way to regrow cartilage and stop arthritis

paras.en: Goodbye joint replacements? Stanford scientists found a way to regrow cartilage and stop arthritis
paras.zh: 再见关节置换术？斯坦福大学的科学家找到了一种再生软骨并阻止关节炎的方法

paras.en: Scientists have found a way to rejuvenate existing cartilage cells, regrow damaged knee cartilage, and potentially open a path toward treating arthritis without joint replacement.
paras.zh: 科学家们找到了一种方法，可以使现有的软骨细胞恢复活力，使受损的膝关节软骨重新生长，并有可能开辟一条无需关节置换即可治疗关节炎的道路。

paras.en: - Scientists have found a surprising way to regrow damaged knee cartilage by blocking a protein that becomes more abundant with age. In old mice, the treatment restored naturally lost cartilage and also helped prevent osteoarthritis after ACL-like knee injuries, while human cartilage taken from knee replacement patients began producing new, functional joint cartilage after exposure to the same inhibitor.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了一种令人惊讶的方法，通过阻断一种随着年龄增长而变得更加丰富的蛋白质，从而使受损的膝关节软骨再生。在年老小鼠中，这种治疗恢复了自然丢失的软骨，还有助于预防 ACL 样膝关节损伤后的骨关节炎，而取自膝关节置换患者的人类软骨在接触相同的抑制剂后开始产生新的、有功能的关节软骨。

paras.en: Scientists have identified a way to restore cartilage in aging knee joints, at least in mice, by blocking a protein whose levels rise with age. The approach not only reversed naturally occurring cartilage loss in older animals, but also protected mice from developing arthritis after knee injuries similar to ACL tears in people.
paras.zh: 科学家们已经找到了一种方法，通过阻断一种随着年龄增长而水平升高的蛋白质，从而恢复老化膝关节的软骨，至少在小鼠中是这样。这种方法不仅逆转了老年动物自然发生的软骨损失，而且还保护小鼠在膝盖受伤后不会患上关节炎，类似于人类的前交叉韧带撕裂。

paras.en: The findings also showed promise in human tissue. Cartilage samples collected during knee replacement surgeries responded to the treatment by beginning to produce new, functional cartilage.
paras.zh: 这些发现在人体组织中也显示出了前景。膝关节置换手术期间收集的软骨样本对治疗产生反应，开始产生新的功能性软骨。

paras.en: Together, the results suggest that cartilage damaged by aging or arthritis may be more capable of repair than previously thought. If the strategy ultimately works in people, researchers believe it could potentially lead to an oral medicine or injection that regenerates cartilage and reduces the need for knee or hip replacement surgery.
paras.zh: 总之，这些结果表明，因衰老或关节炎而受损的软骨可能比以前认为的更有能力修复。如果该策略最终对人类有效，研究人员相信它可能会导致口服药物或注射药物再生软骨并减少膝关节或髋关节置换手术的需要。

paras.en: Targeting the damage behind osteoarthritis
paras.zh: 针对骨关节炎背后的损伤

paras.en: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease in which cartilage gradually breaks down, leaving joints painful, swollen and increasingly difficult to move. It affects about one in five adults in the United States and is estimated to account for roughly $65 billion in direct health care costs each year.
paras.zh: 骨关节炎是一种退行性关节疾病，软骨逐渐分解，导致关节疼痛、肿胀且越来越难以活动。它影响着美国约五分之一的成年人，估计每年约占直接医疗保健费用 650 亿美元。

paras.en: Current treatments mainly focus on controlling pain and other symptoms. Once the disease becomes severe, replacing the damaged joint surgically may be the only remaining option. There is currently no drug that can reliably slow or reverse osteoarthritis itself.
paras.zh: 目前的治疗主要集中在控制疼痛和其他症状。一旦病情变得严重，手术更换受损关节可能是唯一的选择。目前还没有药物可以可靠地减缓或逆转骨关节炎本身。

paras.en: The Stanford Medicine-led study instead focused on a protein called 15-PGDH. The researchers have described it as a gerozyme, a term for enzymes that become more abundant with age and contribute to the gradual loss of tissue function.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学医学院主导的研究重点关注了一种名为 15-PGDH 的蛋白质。研究人员将其描述为“Gerozyme”，这是一个术语，指随着年龄的增长而变得更加丰富并导致组织功能逐渐丧失的酶。

paras.en: Previous work by the same group showed that 15-PGDH acts as an important regulator of aging in multiple tissues. Blocking the protein with a small molecule increased muscle mass and endurance in old mice. Doing the opposite, increasing 15-PGDH in young animals, caused their muscles to shrink and weaken. The protein has also been linked to the regeneration of bone, nerve and blood cells.
paras.zh: 该小组之前的工作表明，15-PGDH 在多种组织中起着重要的衰老调节作用。用小分子阻断蛋白质可以增加老年小鼠的肌肉质量和耐力。相反，增加幼年动物体内的 15-PGDH，会导致它们的肌肉萎缩和衰弱。这种蛋白质还与骨骼、神经和血细胞的再生有关。

paras.en: In many of those tissues, healing depends on tissue-specific stem cells multiplying and developing into specialized cells. Cartilage turned out to behave differently. Instead of relying on stem cells, existing cartilage cells called chondrocytes changed their patterns of gene activity and shifted toward a more youthful state.
paras.zh: 在许多这样的组织中，愈合取决于组织特异性干细胞的增殖并发育成专门的细胞。软骨的行为却有所不同。现有的软骨细胞（称为软骨细胞）不再依赖干细胞，而是改变了其基因活动模式并转向更年轻的状态。

paras.en: "This is a new way of regenerating adult tissue, and it has significant clinical promise for treating arthritis due to aging or injury," said Helen Blau, PhD, professor of microbiology and immunology. "We were looking for stem cells, but they are clearly not involved. It's very exciting."
paras.zh: 微生物学和免疫学教授 Helen Blau 博士说：“这是一种再生成人组织的新方法，对于治疗因衰老或损伤引起的关节炎具有重要的临床前景。” “我们一直在寻找干细胞，但它们显然没有参与其中。这非常令人兴奋。”

paras.en: Blau, who directs the Baxter Laboratory for Stem Cell Biology and is the Donald E. and Delia B. Baxter Foundation Professor, and Nidhi Bhutani, PhD, associate professor of orthopaedic surgery, are the senior authors of the research, which was published in Science. Instructor of orthopedic surgery Mamta Singla, PhD, and former postdoctoral scholar Yu Xin (Will) Wang, PhD, are the lead authors of the study. Wang is now an assistant professor at the Sanford Burnham Institute in San Diego.
paras.zh: 布劳是巴克斯特干细胞生物学实验室的负责人，也是唐纳德·E·巴克斯特和迪莉娅·B·巴克斯特基金会的教授，他和骨科副教授尼迪·布塔尼博士是这项研究的高级作者，该研究发表在《科学》杂志上。骨科导师 Mamta Singla 博士和前博士后学者 Yu Xin (Will) Wang 博士是该研究的主要作者。王现在是圣地亚哥桑福德伯纳姆研究所的助理教授。

paras.en: "Millions of people suffer from joint pain and swelling as they age," Bhutani said. "It is a huge unmet medical need. Until now, there has been no drug that directly treats the cause of cartilage loss. But this gerozyme inhibitor causes a dramatic regeneration of cartilage beyond that reported in response to any other drug or intervention."
paras.zh: “随着年龄的增长，数百万人患有关节疼痛和肿胀，”布塔尼说。 “这是一个巨大的未满足的医疗需求。到目前为止，还没有药物可以直接治疗软骨损失的原因。但这种gerozyme抑制剂引起的软骨再生速度超出了任何其他药物或干预措施所报道的速度。”

paras.en: Cartilage is not all the same. The human body contains three major types, each designed for a different job.
paras.zh: 软骨并不完全相同。人体包含三种主要类型，每种类型都有不同的功能。

paras.en: Elastic cartilage is soft and flexible and helps form structures such as the outer ear. Fibrocartilage is tougher and better suited to absorbing force, including in areas between the vertebrae of the spine. Hyaline cartilage is smooth and slippery, allowing bones to move against one another with very little friction in joints such as the ankles, hips, shoulders and parts of the knee.
paras.zh: 弹性软骨柔软而有弹性，有助于形成外耳等结构。纤维软骨更坚韧，更适合吸收力，包括脊柱椎骨之间的区域。透明软骨光滑且光滑，使骨骼能够相互移动，而脚踝、臀部、肩膀和部分膝盖等关节的摩擦力很小。

paras.en: In joints, hyaline cartilage is also known as articular cartilage. It is the type most commonly damaged by osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 在关节中，透明软骨也称为关节软骨。它是最常受到骨关节炎损害的类型。

paras.en: Osteoarthritis can develop as joints experience stress from aging, injury or obesity. Chondrocytes begin producing inflammatory molecules while also breaking down collagen, a structural protein that gives cartilage much of its strength.
paras.zh: 当关节因衰老、受伤或肥胖而承受压力时，就会出现骨关节炎。软骨细胞开始产生炎症分子，同时分解胶原蛋白，胶原蛋白是一种赋予软骨大部分强度的结构蛋白。

paras.en: As collagen disappears, cartilage becomes thinner and softer. Inflammation adds swelling and pain, creating the familiar symptoms of osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 随着胶原蛋白的消失，软骨变得更薄、更软。炎症会加剧肿胀和疼痛，从而产生常见的骨关节炎症状。

paras.en: The problem is that articular cartilage normally has very little ability to repair itself. Researchers have identified possible stem or progenitor cells capable of forming cartilage in bone, but efforts to find similar cell populations within articular cartilage itself have not been successful.
paras.zh: 问题是关节软骨通常具有很少的自我修复能力。研究人员已经确定了能够在骨骼中形成软骨的可能干细胞或祖细胞，但在关节软骨本身内寻找类似细胞群的努力尚未成功。

paras.en: Earlier research from Blau's laboratory found that a molecule called prostaglandin E2 is important for the function of muscle stem cells. The protein 15-PGDH breaks down prostaglandin E2.
paras.zh: Blau 实验室的早期研究发现，一种名为前列腺素 E2 的分子对于肌肉干细胞的功能非常重要。蛋白质 15-PGDH 分解前列腺素 E2。

paras.en: Blocking 15-PGDH, or otherwise raising levels of prostaglandin E2, has been shown to support regeneration in damaged muscle, nerve, bone, colon, liver and blood cells in young mice.
paras.zh: 阻断 15-PGDH 或以其他方式提高前列腺素 E2 水平已被证明可以支持年轻小鼠受损肌肉、神经、骨骼、结肠、肝脏和血细胞的再生。

paras.en: That raised an important question for Blau, Bhutani and their colleagues: Could the same biological pathway contribute to the deterioration of cartilage as animals age or recover from injury?
paras.zh: 这给布劳、布塔尼和他们的同事提出了一个重要的问题：随着动物衰老或从受伤中恢复，相同的生物途径是否会导致软骨退化？

paras.en: The researchers compared 15-PGDH levels in knee cartilage from young and old mice. They found that the amount of the gerozyme roughly doubled with age.
paras.zh: 研究人员比较了年轻和年老小鼠膝关节软骨中 15-PGDH 的水平。他们发现，随着年龄的增长，Gerozyme 的数量大约增加了一倍。

paras.en: They then gave older animals a small molecule drug designed to inhibit 15-PGDH. In one experiment, the drug was injected into the abdomen so it could have effects throughout the body. In another, it was delivered directly into the knee joint.
paras.zh: 然后，他们给老年动物注射了一种旨在抑制 15-PGDH 的小分子药物。在一项实验中，这种药物被注射到腹部，这样它就可以对全身产生影响。在另一种情况下，它被直接输送到膝关节中。

paras.en: Both approaches produced striking results.
paras.zh: 这两种方法都产生了惊人的结果。

paras.en: Cartilage in the knees of older animals had been noticeably thinner and less functional than cartilage in young mice. After treatment, however, it became thicker across the surface of the joint.
paras.zh: 年长动物膝盖的软骨明显比年轻小鼠的软骨更薄，功能也更差。然而，经过治疗后，关节表面的厚度变得更厚。

paras.en: Importantly, the cells were making hyaline cartilage, the smooth articular cartilage needed for healthy joint movement, rather than the less suitable fibrocartilage.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这些细胞正在制造透明软骨，即健康关节运动所需的光滑关节软骨，而不是不太合适的纤维软骨。

paras.en: "Cartilage regeneration to such an extent in aged mice took us by surprise," Bhutani said. "The effect was remarkable."
paras.zh: “老年小鼠的软骨再生达到如此程度让我们感到惊讶，”布塔尼说。 “效果显着。”

paras.en: The researchers also tested whether the treatment could help after traumatic knee injuries.
paras.zh: 研究人员还测试了这种治疗方法是否对膝盖外伤后有帮助。

paras.en: ACL tears are particularly common in sports such as soccer, basketball and skiing, where athletes frequently pivot, stop abruptly or jump. Surgery can repair the torn ligament, but fixing the immediate injury does not necessarily prevent long-term joint damage.
paras.zh: 前十字韧带撕裂在足球、篮球和滑雪等运动中尤其常见，这些运动中运动员经常转动、突然停止或跳跃。手术可以修复撕裂的韧带，但修复直接损伤并不一定能防止长期的关节损伤。

paras.en: About 50% of people who experience these injuries go on to develop osteoarthritis in the affected joint within approximately 15 years.
paras.zh: 大约 50% 经历过这些损伤的人会在大约 15 年内在受影响的关节中继续发展为骨关节炎。

paras.en: In the mouse experiments, researchers administered the gerozyme inhibitor twice a week for four weeks after injury. The treatment dramatically reduced the likelihood that the animals would develop osteoarthritis.
paras.zh: 在小鼠实验中，研究人员在受伤后每周两次施用 Gerozyme 抑制剂，持续四个星期。这种治疗极大地降低了动物患骨关节炎的可能性。

paras.en: Mice that received a control drug had 15-PGDH levels twice those of animals whose knees had not been injured, and they developed osteoarthritis within four weeks.
paras.zh: 接受对照药物的小鼠的 15-PGDH 水平是膝盖未受伤动物的两倍，并且它们在 4 周内出现骨关节炎。

paras.en: The treated mice also moved more normally and placed more weight on the paw attached to the injured leg than untreated animals did.
paras.zh: 与未经治疗的小鼠相比，接受治疗的小鼠的活动也更加正常，并且在连接受伤腿的爪子上施加了更多的重量。

paras.en: "Interestingly, prostaglandin E2 has been implicated in inflammation and pain," Blau said. "But this research shows that, at normal biological levels, small increases in prostaglandin E2 can promote regeneration."
paras.zh: “有趣的是，前列腺素 E2 与炎症和疼痛有关，”Blau 说。 “但这项研究表明，在正常生物水平下，前列腺素 E2 的小幅增加可以促进再生。”

paras.en: To understand what was happening inside the joint, the researchers took a closer look at chondrocytes from young and old mice.
paras.zh: 为了了解关节内部发生的情况，研究人员仔细观察了年轻和年老小鼠的软骨细胞。

paras.en: Older cartilage cells showed more activity in genes associated with inflammation and with the unwanted conversion of hyaline cartilage into bone. At the same time, genes involved in normal cartilage development were less active.
paras.zh: 较老的软骨细胞在与炎症和透明软骨转化为骨骼相关的基因中表现出更多的活性。与此同时，参与正常软骨发育的基因活性较低。

paras.en: One population of old chondrocytes that produced 15-PGDH and expressed genes associated with cartilage degradation dropped from 8% of cells to 3%.
paras.zh: 一组产生 15-PGDH 并表达与软骨退化相关基因的老软骨细胞从细胞的 8% 下降到 3%。

paras.en: A second population, which did not produce 15-PGDH but expressed genes linked to fibrocartilage formation, fell from 16% to 8%.
paras.zh: 第二个群体不产生 15-PGDH，但表达与纤维软骨形成相关的基因，其比例从 16% 下降到 8%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a third group moved sharply in the opposite direction. These cells did not produce 15-PGDH and expressed genes involved in forming hyaline cartilage and maintaining the extracellular matrix needed for healthy cartilage function. Their share increased from 22% to 42%.
paras.zh: 与此同时，第三组人急剧朝相反方向移动。这些细胞不产生 15-PGDH，并表达参与形成透明软骨和维持健康软骨功能所需的细胞外基质的基因。他们的份额从 22% 增加到 42%。

paras.en: The extracellular matrix is the network of proteins and other molecules that surrounds cells and gives tissues their structure. In cartilage, it is especially important because it helps the tissue withstand pressure while maintaining the smooth surface joints need for movement.
paras.zh: 细胞外基质是围绕细胞并赋予组织结构的蛋白质和其他分子的网络。对于软骨来说，它尤其重要，因为它有助于组织承受压力，同时保持关节运动所需的光滑表面。

paras.en: Overall, the treatment appeared to push cartilage toward a younger biological state without recruiting stem or progenitor cells.
paras.zh: 总体而言，这种治疗似乎可以将软骨推向更年轻的生物状态，而无需招募干细胞或祖细胞。

paras.en: The researchers then examined cartilage taken from people with osteoarthritis who were undergoing total knee replacement surgery.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后检查了从接受全膝关节置换手术的骨关节炎患者身上取出的软骨。

paras.en: After one week of treatment with the 15-PGDH inhibitor, the human tissue contained fewer chondrocytes expressing 15-PGDH. Activity in genes associated with cartilage degradation and fibrocartilage also declined compared with untreated tissue.
paras.zh: 用 15-PGDH 抑制剂治疗一周后，人体组织中表达 15-PGDH 的软骨细胞减少。与未经处理的组织相比，与软骨退化和纤维软骨相关的基因活性也有所下降。

paras.en: Most notably, the samples began regenerating articular cartilage.
paras.zh: 最值得注意的是，样本开始再生关节软骨。

paras.en: "The mechanism is quite striking and really shifted our perspective about how tissue regeneration can occur," Bhutani said. "It's clear that a large pool of already existing cells in cartilage are changing their gene expression patterns. And by targeting these cells for regeneration, we may have an opportunity to have a bigger overall impact clinically."
paras.zh: “这个机制非常引人注目，确实改变了我们对组织再生如何发生的看法，”布塔尼说。 “很明显，软骨中现有的大量细胞正在改变它们的基因表达模式。通过靶向这些细胞进行再生，我们可能有机会在临床上产生更大的整体影响。”

paras.en: The findings do not yet establish that the treatment can regrow cartilage or prevent osteoarthritis in people. The mouse results and experiments on human tissue represent important early evidence, but clinical trials specifically testing cartilage regeneration will be needed to determine whether the approach is safe and effective for patients.
paras.zh: 研究结果尚未证实该治疗可以使人的软骨再生或预防骨关节炎。小鼠结果和人体组织实验代表了重要的早期证据，但需要专门测试软骨再生的临床试验来确定该方法对患者是否安全有效。

paras.en: An oral 15-PGDH inhibitor has already reached clinical testing for a different age related problem: muscle weakness.
paras.zh: 一种口服 15-PGDH 抑制剂已经针对不同的年龄相关问题进行了临床测试：肌肉无力。

paras.en: Blau added, "Phase 1 clinical trials of a 15-PGDH inhibitor for muscle weakness have shown that it is safe and active in healthy volunteers. Our hope is that a similar trial will be launched soon to test its effect in cartilage regeneration. We are very excited about this potential breakthrough. Imagine regrowing existing cartilage and avoiding joint replacement."
paras.zh: Blau 补充道：“针对肌肉无力的 15-PGDH 抑制剂的一期临床试验表明，它在健康志愿者中是安全且有效的。我们希望很快就会启动类似的试验，以测试其在软骨再生方面的效果。我们对这一潜在突破感到非常兴奋。想象一下，重新生长现有的软骨并避免关节置换。”

paras.en: Researchers from the Sanford Burnham Prebys Medical Discovery Institute contributed to the work.
paras.zh: 桑福德伯纳姆普雷比斯医学发现研究所的研究人员对这项工作做出了贡献。

paras.en: The study was funded by the National Institutes of Health (grants R01AR070864, R01AR077530, R01AG069858 and R00NS120278), the Baxter Foundation for Stem Cell Biology, the Li Ka Shing Foundation, the Stanford Cardiovascular Institute, the Milky Way Research Foundation, the Canadian Institutes of Health Research, a Stanford Translational Research and Applied Medicine Pilot grant, a GlaxoSmithKline Sir James Black Postdoctoral Fellowship, and a Stanford Dean's Postdoctoral Fellowship.
paras.zh: 该研究由美国国立卫生研究院（拨款R01AR070864、R01AR077530、R01AG069858和R00NS120278）、巴克斯特干细胞生物学基金会、李嘉诚基金会、斯坦福心血管研究所、银河研究基金会、加拿大卫生研究院、斯坦福转化研究和应用医学试点拨款、葛兰素史克詹姆斯·布莱克爵士博士后奖学金和斯坦福大学院长博士后奖学金。

paras.en: Blau, Bhutani and other coauthors are inventors on patent applications held by Stanford University involving 15-PGDH inhibition for cartilage and tissue rejuvenation. Those applications are licensed to Epirium Bio. Blau is a cofounder of Myoforte/Epirium and holds equity and stock options in the company.
paras.zh: Blau、Bhutani 和其他合著者是斯坦福大学持有的涉及 15-PGDH 抑制软骨和组织再生的专利申请的发明人。这些应用程序已授权给 Epirium Bio。 Blau 是 Myoforte/Epirium 的联合创始人，持有该公司的股权和股票期权。

paras.en: Materials provided by Stanford Medicine. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由斯坦福大学医学院提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Mamta Singla, Yu Xin Wang, Elena Monti, Yudhishtar Bedi, Pranay Agarwal, Shiqi Su, Sara Ancel, Maiko Hermsmeier, Nitya Devisetti, Akshay Pandey, Mohsen Afshar Bakooshli, Adelaida R. Palla, Stuart Goodman, Helen M. Blau, Nidhi Bhutani. Inhibition of 15-hydroxy prostaglandin dehydrogenase promotes cartilage regeneration. Science, 2026; 391 (6789): 1053 DOI: 10.1126/science.adx6649

articles.title: Colorectal cancer is rising in young people and often found too late

paras.en: Colorectal cancer is rising in young people and often found too late
paras.zh: 结直肠癌在年轻人中呈上升趋势，但发现时往往为时已晚

paras.en: Colorectal cancer is striking some young people with aggressive, advanced disease, prompting researchers to warn that key symptoms should not be ignored.
paras.zh: 结直肠癌正在侵袭一些患有侵袭性晚期疾病的年轻人，促使研究人员警告说，不应忽视关键症状。

paras.en: - Colorectal cancer in young people is often diagnosed at an advanced stage, with researchers finding most patients age 21 or younger already had Stage III or IV disease. Because symptoms like rectal bleeding, weight loss, abdominal pain, and bowel changes may be overlooked, researchers are calling for greater vigilance.
paras.zh: - 年轻人的结直肠癌通常在晚期被诊断出来，研究人员发现大多数 21 岁或以下的患者已经患有 III 期或 IV 期疾病。由于直肠出血、体重减轻、腹痛和肠道变化等症状可能被忽视，研究人员呼吁提高警惕。

paras.en: New research suggests that advanced colorectal cancer is becoming more common in young patients, raising concerns that warning signs may be missed or recognized too late. The findings were presented at the American Academy of Pediatrics 2026 National Conference & Exhibition Oct. 2-6, 2026, at the San Diego Convention Center.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明，晚期结直肠癌在年轻患者中越来越常见，这引发了人们对警告信号可能被错过或识别得太晚的担忧。研究结果于 2026 年 10 月 2 日至 6 日在圣地亚哥会议中心举行的美国儿科学会 2026 年全国会议暨展览会上公布。

paras.en: The study, "Clinical Presentation and Epidemiology of Pediatric and Adolescent Colorectal Carcinoma: A Pediatric Surgical Oncology Research Collaborative Study," reviewed the medical records of 84 patients age 21 or younger who were diagnosed with colorectal cancer between 2012 and 2023.
paras.zh: 这项名为“儿童和青少年结直肠癌的临床表现和流行病学：儿童外科肿瘤学研究合作研究”的研究回顾了 2012 年至 2023 年间被诊断患有结直肠癌的 84 名 21 岁或以下患者的医疗记录。

paras.en: Only 20% of the patients had a first- or second-degree family history of colorectal cancer. Despite that, most had aggressive disease that had already progressed to Stage III or IV by the time it was diagnosed.
paras.zh: 只有20%的患者有一级或二级结直肠癌家族史。尽管如此，大多数人患有侵袭性疾病，在诊断时已经进展到第三期或第四期。

paras.en: The researchers say the findings add to growing concern about colorectal cancer appearing more often in young people and frequently being detected at an advanced stage.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这些发现加剧了人们对结肠直肠癌更常见于年轻人且经常在晚期被发现的担忧。

paras.en: Possible warning signs include lower back pain, abdominal pain, changes in bowel habits, weight loss, and rectal bleeding. Because colorectal cancer remains uncommon in younger patients, these symptoms may not immediately raise suspicion and can sometimes be overlooked.
paras.zh: 可能的警告信号包括腰痛、腹痛、排便习惯改变、体重减轻和直肠出血。由于结直肠癌在年轻患者中仍然不常见，因此这些症状可能不会立即引起怀疑，有时可能会被忽视。

paras.en: "Colorectal cancer is, unfortunately, becoming more common in adolescents and young adults and represents a different disease than colorectal cancer diagnosed in older adults," said study author and pediatric surgery research fellow Erica Arnold, MD. "When diagnosed, it is often aggressive, presenting with late-stage disease and associated with high rates of disease relapse and mortality."
paras.zh: 研究作者、小儿外科研究员埃里卡·阿诺德医学博士说：“不幸的是，结直肠癌在青少年和年轻人中变得越来越常见，并且与老年人中诊断出的结直肠癌是一种不同的疾病。” “确诊后，它通常具有侵袭性，表现为晚期疾病，并且与疾病复发率和死亡率较高有关。”

paras.en: Delayed Diagnosis Can Have Serious Consequences
paras.zh: 延迟诊断可能会产生严重后果

paras.en: Researchers found that delays in diagnosis, combined with aggressive tumor behavior, can contribute to poor long-term outcomes.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，诊断延迟加上肿瘤的侵袭性行为可能会导致长期结果不佳。

paras.en: More than one-third of the patients in the study later developed recurrent disease. Nearly half died as a result of their diagnosis.
paras.zh: 研究中超过三分之一的患者后来出现了复发性疾病。近一半的人因诊断而死亡。

paras.en: The authors say symptoms such as unexplained weight loss and rectal bleeding should be taken seriously when they occur in younger patients. As cancers typically associated with adults continue to appear at younger ages, they also stress the importance of coordinating care between pediatric and adult medical teams and developing treatment plans tailored to these patients.
paras.zh: 作者表示，当年轻患者出现不明原因的体重减轻和直肠出血等症状时，应认真对待。由于通常与成人相关的癌症继续出现在较年轻的年龄，因此他们还强调协调儿科和成人医疗团队之间的护理以及制定适合这些患者的治疗计划的重要性。

paras.en: Materials provided by American Academy of Pediatrics. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由美国儿科学会提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: NASA’s Curiosity Rover Catches Stunning Martian Dawn
articles.author: Stephen Carney

paras.en: A newly released panorama captured by NASA’s Curiosity rover offers the most detailed view yet of distant, wind-carved Martian cliffs, highlighting features the mission’s scientists have long been waiting to see up close. The scene was snapped at 8:30 a.m. local Mars time, showing striking blue hues in the foreground as bright morning light illuminates crags known as yardangs on the horizon.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局好奇号火星车拍摄的最新发布的全景图提供了迄今为止最详细的遥远的风蚀火星悬崖视图，突出了该任务的科学家们长期以来一直等待近距离观察的特征。这一场景是在火星当地时间上午 8 点 30 分拍摄的，明亮的晨光照亮了地平线上被称为雅丹的峭壁，前景呈现出醒目的蓝色调。

paras.en: The panorama was captured by Curiosity’s Mastcam on Aug. 11, the 4,982nd Martian day, or sol, of the mission, and comprises six individual images that were stitched together after being sent to Earth. Unlike most of Curiosity’s Mastcam images, this one was processed without white balancing, preserving the early morning appearance.
paras.zh: 这张全景图是好奇号的桅杆摄像机于 8 月 11 日（即任务的第 4,982 个火星日）拍摄的，由六张单独的图像组成，这些图像在发送到地球后拼接在一起。与好奇号的大多数桅杆摄像头图像不同，这张图像没有经过白平衡处理，保留了清晨的外观。

paras.en: The yardang layer extends roughly 10 miles (16 kilometers) across the northwestern reaches of Mount Sharp, a 3-mile-tall (5-kilometer-tall) mountain that Curiosity has been ascending since 2014. In fact, the rover recently passed another milestone in its ascent, reaching 0.6 miles (1 kilometer) of elevation — the most ever climbed on Mars. As it draws ever-closer to the yardangs, mission scientists expect to get even more amazing imagery — and, they hope, answers to how these cliffs were created.
paras.zh: 雅丹层在夏普山西北延伸约 10 英里（16 公里），好奇号自 2014 年以来一直在攀登这座 3 英里（5 公里）高的山峰。事实上，火星车最近在其上升过程中跨越了另一个里程碑，达到了 0.6 英里（1 公里）的海拔——这是火星上攀登过的最高海拔。随着它越来越接近雅丹，任务科学家期望获得更令人惊叹的图像，并且他们希望能够解答这些悬崖是如何形成的。

paras.en: Mount Sharp is made up of layers, each recording a distinct period of Mars’ history. By studying them, scientists have been able to learn more about lakes and streams that covered this part of the Red Planet billions of years ago. Eventually, the water dried up and left salty minerals behind. After new material stopped settling on the mountain, some of it may have been stripped away by wind, giving rise to the yardangs.
paras.zh: 夏普山由多层组成，每一层都记录了火星历史的一个独特时期。通过研究它们，科学家们能够更多地了解数十亿年前覆盖这片红色星球的湖泊和溪流。最终，水干了，留下了咸味矿物质。当新物质停止在山上沉积后，其中一些可能被风吹走了，形成了雅丹。

paras.en: “The yardang layer looks out of place. It’s the wrong color, the layers tilt at an odd angle, and it almost appears plastered on,” said Ashwin Vasavada, Curiosity project scientist of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. “But that’s what makes it exciting to reach. No one is sure exactly what created this layer, but one idea is it may be ash deposited by ancient volcanic eruptions.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室好奇号项目科学家阿什温·瓦萨瓦达 (Ashwin Vasavada) 表示：“雅丹层看起来格格不入。它的颜色不对，各层以奇怪的角度倾斜，而且几乎看起来像抹了灰。” “但这就是到达它令人兴奋的原因。没有人确切知道是什么创造了这一层，但一个想法是它可能是古代火山喷发沉积的火山灰。”

paras.en: Curiosity is in the second year of its fifth extended mission, which started with an exploration of the spiderweb-like boxwork ridges. The rover will spend most of the next year or so driving through layers enriched with sulfates and carbonates, both signs of ancient drying on the surface. Sometime in 2027, scientists hope to reach the base of the yardangs, where Curiosity will be able to use its robotic arm to collect one-of-a-kind data on these mysterious features.
paras.zh: 好奇号已进入第五次扩展任务的第二年，这次任务首先是探索蜘蛛网状的箱形山脊。火星车将在明年左右的大部分时间里行驶穿过富含硫酸盐和碳酸盐的地层，这都是地表古老干燥的迹象。 2027 年的某个时候，科学家们希望到达雅丹的底部，好奇号将能够在那里使用其机械臂收集有关这些神秘特征的独一无二的数据。

paras.en: Curiosity was built by NASA JPL, which is managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California. NASA JPL leads the mission on behalf of the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington as part of its Mars Exploration Program portfolio. Malin Space Science Systems in San Diego built and operates Mastcam.
paras.zh: 好奇号由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室建造，由加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳市的加州理工学院管理。 NASA 喷气推进实验室代表该机构位于华盛顿的科学任务理事会领导这项任务，作为其火星探索计划组合的一部分。圣地亚哥的马林空间科学系统公司建造并运营桅杆摄像机。

paras.en: Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室，加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳
