paras.en: “My concern is not that press freedom has disappeared,” he said. “It is that several of these pressures … are accumulating at the same time.”
paras.zh: “我担心的不是新闻自由已经消失，”他说。 “这些压力中的几个……正在同时累积。”

paras.en: Pedro Cárdenas, of the press freedom and human rights organisation Article 19, expressed concern about the clause in the new bill. “It empowers law enforcement officers to seize any vehicle, article or document deemed likely to be of substantial value. We find this clause particularly problematic because it is vague and opens up to discussion what is substantial value or not,” he said.
paras.zh: 新闻自由和人权组织 Article 19 的佩德罗·卡德纳斯 (Pedro Cárdenas) 对新法案中的条款表示担忧。 “它授权执法人员扣押任何被认为可能具有重大价值的车辆、物品或文件。我们发现这一条款特别有问题，因为它含糊不清，并引发了讨论什么是具有重大价值或没有什么价值，”他说。

paras.en: He added that it “might directly counter” existing international human rights laws.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这“可能直接违背”现有的国际人权法。

paras.en: The office of the prime minister did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 总理办公室没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: Stuart Young, Trinidad and Tobago’s former prime minister, labelled the bill “unconstitutional and very dangerous”, adding that it “breaches fundamental and entrenched constitutional rights” and was passed “without a required constitutional majority in highly questionable circumstances”.
paras.zh: 特立尼达和多巴哥前总理斯图尔特·杨称该法案“违宪且非常危险”，并补充说它“违反了基本且根深蒂固的宪法权利”，并且“在高度可疑的情况下没有获得所需的宪法多数”而获得通过。

paras.en: He said the government’s past use of emergency powers – including detaining citizens without charge – showed “the real likelihood of abuse” under the new legislation.
paras.zh: 他表示，政府过去使用紧急权力的行为——包括未经指控而拘留公民——表明新立法下“确实存在滥用权力的可能性”。

articles.title: Google told to halt work on datacentres in Finland over environmental concerns
articles.author: Miranda Bryant Nordic correspondent

paras.en: Google has been ordered to temporarily stop work on two datacentres in Finland after failing to do the necessary environmental impact assessments on its construction sites.
paras.zh: 由于未能对其建筑工地进行必要的环境影响评估，谷歌已被命令暂时停止在芬兰的两个数据中心的工作。

paras.en: The planned datacentres in Muhos and Kajanni are part of a 13bn euro project across multiple sites in northern Finland by the technology company amid huge demand for space to house online infrastructure.
paras.zh: 计划在Muhos和Kajanni建造的数据中心是该技术公司在芬兰北部多个地点的一个130亿欧元项目的一部分，该项目对容纳在线基础设施的空间有着巨大的需求。

paras.en: It comes after it emerged that Tuike Finland Oy, the company representing Google, had felled 330-hectares (815 acres) of forest in Muhos without completing an environmental impact assessment.
paras.zh: 代表谷歌的Tuike Finland Oy公司在Muhos砍伐了330公顷（ 815英亩）的森林，但没有完成环境影响评估。

paras.en: In Kajaani, the company has reportedly been logging across just under 200 hectares (494 acres) of land.
paras.zh: 据报道，该公司在Kajaani的伐木面积不到200公顷（ 494英亩）。

paras.en: The Finnish Union for Nature Conservation said the sites had been reduced to “sand”, blaming the oversights on the “overheated” market for new datacentres.
paras.zh: 芬兰自然保护联盟(Finnish Union for Nature Conservation)表示，这些遗址已被沦为“沙子” ，并将疏忽归咎于新数据中心的“过热”市场。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the Finnish Licensing and Supervision Authority (LVV) said it had issued a notice to the company to “immediately suspend” – by 23 October at the latest – “preparatory measures that significantly change the environment” of the two sites until the environmental impact assessment had been completed. Google has until next Wednesday to submit a written explanation.
paras.zh: 周二，芬兰许可和监管局（ LVV ）表示，它已向该公司发出通知，要求“立即暂停” –最迟在10月23日之前–两个地点的“显着改变环境的准备措施” ，直到环境影响评估完成。谷歌必须在下周三前提交书面解释。

paras.en: The environmental impact assessment (EIA) is ongoing and expected to be completed later this year. But Google has gone ahead with “extensive preparatory measures”, including removing trees, stripping topsoil and constructing site roads, LVV said.
paras.zh: 环境影响评估（ EIA ）正在进行中，预计将于今年晚些时候完成。但LVV表示，谷歌已经采取了“广泛的准备措施” ，包括清除树木、剥去表层土壤和建设工地道路。

paras.en: Tommi Muilu, head of the environmental department at LVV, said: “In our opinion, the measures in question will change the environment and cause impacts, the identification and assessment of which are among the key objectives of the EIA procedure.”
paras.zh: LVV环境部门负责人Tommi Muilu说： “我们认为，这些措施将改变环境并造成影响，识别和评估这些措施是EIA程序的关键目标之一。”

paras.en: If Google does not comply, LVV said it would consider enforcement proceedings and a fine.
paras.zh: 如果谷歌不遵守， LVV表示将考虑执行程序和罚款。

paras.en: In response, Google said in a statement “we understand the concerns” and admitted that it had “fallen short of our own high standards”.
paras.zh: 作为回应，谷歌在一份声明中表示“我们理解这些担忧” ，并承认它“没有达到我们自己的高标准”。

paras.en: The company added: “We will study the LVV’s findings and follow their guidance. We acted in good faith under the Forestry Act, ran nature surveys and put in place measures to protect high-value areas. As we continue our long-term work in the region, we are advancing our landscaping and biodiversity plans, which include tree planting across 130 hectares (321 acres) at Muhos.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充道：“我们将研究 LVV 的调查结果并遵循他们的指导。我们真诚地根据《林业法》行事，开展自然调查并采取措施保护高价值地区。随着我们继续在该地区开展长期工作，我们正在推进我们的景观美化和生物多样性计划，其中包括在穆霍斯 130 公顷（321 英亩）的土地上植树。”

paras.en: Tapani Veistola, chief operating officer at the Finnish Union for Nature Conservation, said the malpractice across two sites appears to be a “systemic problem”. The site at Muhos, he said, is “not a forest any more. It is a sand area.”
paras.zh: 芬兰自然保护联盟首席运营官塔帕尼·韦斯托拉表示，两个地点的不当行为似乎是一个“系统性问题”。他说，穆霍斯的遗址“不再是森林。这是一片沙地。”

paras.en: One of the reasons behind it, he said, is the enormous demand to build datacentres in Finland, which is leading companies to work as fast as possible and overwhelming small municipalities.
paras.zh: 他说，其背后的原因之一是在芬兰建立数据中心的巨大需求，这导致公司以尽可能快的速度开展工作，并压倒了小城市。

paras.en: “The main reason behind everything is the overheated market situation that makes companies speed up processes so much. Also a lack of expertise in municipalities.”
paras.zh: “一切背后的主要原因是过热的市场形势使得公司大大加快了流程。此外，市政当局也缺乏专业知识。”

articles.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego

paras.en: Donald Trump's remark that Iran could "take out" Los Angeles and San Diego has sparked fierce backlash from California politicians - and a strongly worded rebuttal from the White House.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）关于伊朗可以“淘汰”洛杉矶和圣地亚哥的言论引发了加利福尼亚政界人士的强烈反对-以及白宫的强烈反驳。

paras.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom condemned the comment - made by Trump at a campaign rally in Nebraska - as "deranged and dangerous," while LA Mayor Karen Bass described them as threats and an attempt to "encourage attacks on American lives".
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州州长加文·纽森（ Gavin Newsom ）谴责特朗普在内布拉斯加州举行的竞选集会上发表的言论是“疯狂和危险的” ，而洛杉矶市长卡伦·巴斯（ Karen Bass ）则将其描述为威胁和企图“鼓励袭击美国人的生命”。

paras.en: According to the White House, however, Trump was saying that American cities would have been threatened by Iran had he not launched a war there earlier this year.
paras.zh: 然而，根据白宫的说法，特朗普表示，如果他今年早些时候没有在那里发动战争，美国城市将受到伊朗的威胁。

paras.en: Both LA and San Diego house major US military installations including Navy ports and Air Force bases.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶和圣地亚哥都有主要的美国军事设施，包括海军港口和空军基地。

paras.en: Trump, while speaking on Monday in Nebraska about the Iran conflict, said: "It's a small price to pay for keeping the world safe, keeping our country safe. They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles, let them take out San Diego."
paras.zh: 特朗普周一在内布拉斯加州就伊朗冲突发表讲话时说： “为了保持世界安全，保持我们国家的安全，这是一个很小的代价。他们可以摧毁一座城市。让他们干掉洛杉矶，让他们干掉圣地亚哥。”

paras.en: There were cheers from sections of the audience as the comments about the two Californian cities were made.
paras.zh: 随着对加利福尼亚两个城市的评论，部分观众欢呼起来。

paras.en: The morning after Trump's statement, Governor Newsom announced that the "dangerous - if not treasonous" statement had prompted him to direct California's State Threat Assessment Center to "monitor the situation in the event that foreign actors interpret the remarks as an invitation" to target California.
paras.zh: 特朗普发表声明后的第二天早上，纽森州长宣布， “危险-如果不是叛国”的声明促使他指示加利福尼亚州威胁评估中心“在外国演员将这些言论解释为邀请的情况下监控情况”针对加利福尼亚州。

paras.en: The agency is designed to detect and prevent security threats in the state.
paras.zh: 该机构旨在检测和预防该州的安全威胁。

paras.en: San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria wrote that the city was not collateral damage in a post on X, while demanding Trump keep it out of his "reckless war talk".
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥市长托德·格洛里亚（ Todd Gloria ）在X的帖子中写道，这座城市不是附带损害，同时要求特朗普将其排除在“鲁莽的战争谈话”之外。

paras.en: Trump is yet to respond to the statements made by California's leaders.
paras.zh: 特朗普尚未回应加州领导人的声明。

paras.en: In a post on X, White House Communications Director Stephen Cheung described the "media freakout" over Trump's comments as "not rooted in reality".
paras.zh: 在X上的一篇文章中，白宫通讯总监斯蒂芬·张（ Stephen Cheung ）将对特朗普言论的“媒体恐慌”描述为“不植根于现实”。

paras.en: "He was clearly stating US cities would have been threatened if a nuclear Iran hadn't been stopped," Cheung wrote. "America is safer because of the President. Iran has no nuclear, no navy, no air force, and no money".
paras.zh: “他明确表示，如果不阻止核伊朗，美国城市将受到威胁，”张写道。“因为总统，美国更安全。伊朗没有核武器，没有海军，没有空军，也没有资金。”

paras.en: The president and other administration officials often claim that disrupting Iran's nuclear programme was essential for US national security, and that any issues that have stemmed from the conflict were necessary.
paras.zh: 总统和其他政府官员经常声称，扰乱伊朗的核计划对美国国家安全至关重要，冲突引发的任何问题都是必要的。

paras.en: A separate X post, from the official White House rapid response account, described journalists from the Los Angeles Times reporting on the comments as "buffoons" and again pushed back on the characterisation of the comments by Newsom and others.
paras.zh: 来自白宫官方快速反应账户的另一篇X帖子将《洛杉矶时报》报道这些评论的记者描述为“小丑” ，并再次推翻了对纽森等人评论的描述。

paras.en: "He was saying the US is fighting to STOP Iran from having the ability to take out LA and San Diego with a nuclear weapon â which they would if they had the chance," the account added.
paras.zh: “他说美国正在努力阻止伊朗有能力用核武器摧毁洛杉矶和圣地亚哥-如果他们有机会的话，他们会这样做，”该帐户补充说。

paras.en: San Diego, located 17 miles (27km) from the border with Mexico, is the eighth largest city in the US and is home to Naval Base San Diego, the home port of the US Navy's Pacific Fleet, and Naval Amphibious Base Coronado - the main training centre Navy Seals on the West Coast.
paras.zh: 圣地亚哥距离墨西哥边境17英里（ 27公里） ，是美国第八大城市，是美国海军太平洋舰队的母港圣地亚哥海军基地和西海岸海军海豹突击队主要训练中心科罗纳多海军两栖基地的所在地。

paras.en: It is also where Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton is located, a base which 70,000 service members and civilians work at.
paras.zh: 这里也是彭德尔顿海军陆战队大本营的所在地，这里有7万名军人和平民。

paras.en: Located approximately 120 miles (193 KM) north of San Diego, Los Angeles is the second most populous city in the US.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶位于圣地亚哥以北约120英里（ 193公里）处，是美国人口第二多的城市。

paras.en: It is home to the space system command headquarters of the US Space Force, as well as the Los Angeles Air Force Base.
paras.zh: 这里是美国太空军太空系统指挥部以及洛杉矶空军基地的所在地。

paras.en: This not the first time the US president and California governor, who may run for president in 2028, have publicly clashed.
paras.zh: 这并不是美国总统和可能在2028年竞选总统的加利福尼亚州州长第一次公开发生冲突。

paras.en: Last year Trump described him as incompetent, saying he had failed to adequately respond after some of the Los Angeles anti-immigration enforcement protests turned violent.
paras.zh: 去年，特朗普称他无能为力，称在洛杉矶的一些反移民执法抗议活动变得暴力之后，他未能做出充分回应。

paras.en: Newsom accused Trump of a "brazen abuse of power" after military personnel were deployed to secure federal buildings during those protests.
paras.zh: 纽森指责特朗普在这些抗议活动期间部署军事人员保护联邦建筑物后“公然滥用权力”。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Trump mocked Newsom's dyslexia, saying presidents should not have learning disabilities, which led to criticism from dyslexia charities.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，特朗普嘲笑纽森的阅读障碍，称总统不应该有学习障碍，这引起了阅读障碍慈善机构的批评。

articles.title: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity

paras.en: Canada's Parti QuÃ©bÃ©cois (PQ) is projected to have won enough seats in Quebec's provincial election to form a minority government, though the separatists will need other parties' support to achieve their aims - such as a new public vote on independence.
paras.zh: 加拿大的Québécois党（ PQ ）预计将在魁北克省选举中赢得足够的席位，以组建少数派政府，尽管分离主义者将需要其他政党的支持来实现他们的目标，例如就独立问题进行新的公众投票。

paras.en: It marks the first time the PQ has been in power since 2014, with Paul St-Pierre Plamondon set to become the province's new leader.
paras.zh: 这标志着PQ自2014年以来首次执政， Paul St-Pierre Plamondon将成为该省的新领导人。

paras.en: In his victory speech, St-Pierre Plamondon again raised his independence plans but vowed to be "the premier of everyone in Quebec".
paras.zh: 在他的胜利演讲中，圣皮埃尔·普拉蒙东再次提出了他的独立计划，但发誓要成为“魁北克每个人的总理”。

paras.en: The result could prove a fresh test for Prime Minister Mark Carney, also setting up confrontations with QuÃ©bec over issues like immigration and the monarchy.
paras.zh: 这一结果可能会对首相马克·卡尼(Mark Carney)构成新的考验，也会引发与Québec在移民和君主制等问题上的对抗。

paras.en: In its effort to achieve independence, the PQ has pledged to hold a referendum on separating from the rest of Canada.
paras.zh: 为了实现独立，巴勒斯坦民族权力机构已承诺就与加拿大其他地区分离举行公投。

paras.en: The majority French-speaking province has held other votes on this, in 1980 and 1995. On both occasions, the independence movement was defeated. Polls indicate only about 30% of Quebecers back such a move this time.
paras.zh: 大多数讲法语的省份在1980年和1995年对此进行了其他投票。在这两次事件中，独立运动都被击败。民意调查显示，这次只有约30%的魁北克人支持这一举措。

paras.en: St-Pierre Plamondon has previously said the vote would occur after President Donald Trump is out of office south of the border in the United States, explaining that would require "conditions that allow for an informed and serene debate". The US and Canada are in a trade war as a result of Trump's programme of tariffs.
paras.zh: St-Pierre Plamondon此前曾表示，投票将在唐纳德特朗普总统在美国边境以南离职后进行，并解释说这将需要“允许进行知情和平静辩论的条件”。由于特朗普的关税计划，美国和加拿大正处于贸易战中。

paras.en: In his victory speech after Monday's election results, St-Pierre Plamondon said of the potential referendum: "Our national destiny will be achieved one day."
paras.zh: 在周一选举结果后的胜利演讲中，圣皮埃尔·普拉蒙登（ St-Pierre Plamondon ）谈到了可能的公投： “我们的国家命运总有一天会实现。”

paras.en: Carney told reporters on Tuesday that he spoke with Quebec's new premier-designate and congratulated him on his win.
paras.zh: 卡尼周二告诉记者，他与魁北克新任候任总理进行了交谈，并祝贺他获胜。

paras.en: Asked about the prospect of a referendum, the prime minister said he is focused on current challenges facing Canada, not those "a few years down the road".
paras.zh: 当被问及公投的前景时，总理表示，他关注的是加拿大目前面临的挑战，而不是“未来几年”的挑战。

paras.en: The PQ leader will need to secure the support of rival parties to get the vote he wants, potentially from QuÃ©bec Solidaire, a left-leaning sovereigntist party that won nine seats.
paras.zh: PQ领导人将需要获得竞争对手的支持才能获得他想要的选票，可能来自左倾的主权主义政党Québ Solidaire ，赢得了9个席位。

paras.en: Quebec Liberal Leader Charles Milliard said his party, which won 40 seats, is prepared to support the PQ on a number of issues, but "there is no way we will collaborate on a potential referendum".
paras.zh: 魁北克自由党领袖查尔斯·米利亚德（ Charles Milliard ）表示，他的政党赢得了40个席位，准备在一些问题上支持PQ ，但“我们不可能就潜在的公投进行合作”。

paras.en: Despite winning the most amount of seats of any party, the PQ's share of the popular vote is only 28%.
paras.zh: 尽管赢得了所有政党中最多的席位，但PQ在民众投票中的份额仅为28%。

paras.en: With most votes counted on Tuesday morning, the party was set to win fewer than the 64 seats needed to command a majority in the province's assembly, according to projections from Canadian media.
paras.zh: 根据加拿大媒体的预测，由于周二上午计票最多，该党赢得的席位将少于在该省议会中获得多数席位所需的64个席位。

paras.en: The Liberals - the provincial party with links to Carney's federal Liberals - are projected to have increased their number of seats in the assembly, as have the Conservatives.
paras.zh: 自由党-与卡尼的联邦自由党有联系的省级政党-预计将增加其在议会中的席位数量，保守党也是如此。

paras.en: All parties benefited from the collapse of the Coalition Avenir QuÃ©bec (CAQ), which was previously the province's governing party but is not projected to have won a single seat this time.
paras.zh: 所有政党都受益于联盟AvenirQuéb （ CAQ ）的崩溃，该联盟以前是该省的执政党，但预计这次不会赢得一个席位。

paras.en: Carney may now find himself managing dual unity crises in different parts of the country, depending on the outcome of a vote in Alberta on whether to have a referendum of its own.
paras.zh: 卡尼现在可能会发现自己正在管理全国不同地区的双重团结危机，这取决于艾伯塔省是否举行公投的投票结果。

paras.en: Trump is due to leave office in just over two years, meaning that if Plamondon is able to enact his pledge, a third vote on independence would likely be scheduled for 2029 or 2030.
paras.zh: 特朗普将在两年多后离任，这意味着如果普拉蒙登能够兑现他的承诺，第三次独立公投可能会安排在2029年或2030年。

paras.en: Separate from the issue of independence, Plamondon has made it clear he is willing to fight Ottawa if it is seen as overstepping matters of provincial interest.
paras.zh: 除了独立问题之外， Plamondon还明确表示，如果渥太华被视为超越省级利益的问题，他愿意与之作战。

paras.en: He suggested during the campaign that he was going to pressure Ottawa, external on issues like immigration, vowing to fight any increases mandated by the Carney government.
paras.zh: 他在竞选期间表示，他将在移民等问题上向渥太华施加压力，并发誓要反对卡尼政府强制要求的任何加薪。

paras.en: He also pledged to "abolish the monarchy in Quebec" and reroute money spent on its institutions to social services instead.
paras.zh: 他还承诺“废除魁北克的君主制” ，并将用于其机构的资金转用于社会服务。

paras.en: "We are going to do what we have to do to get the monarchy out of Quebec, repatriate those funds, and send them to social causes," he told reporters in late September.
paras.zh: “我们将做我们必须做的事情，让魁北克脱离君主制，汇回这些资金，并将其送往社会事业，”他在9月底告诉记者。

paras.en: For example, Plamondon suggested defunding Quebec's lieutenant-governor's office - responsible for representing King Charles III in the province - saying he would instead spend that money to tackle homelessness.
paras.zh: 例如， Plamondon建议取消魁北克省副省长办公室的资金，该办公室负责在该省代表国王查理三世，并表示他将把这笔钱用于解决无家可归问题。

paras.en: Plamondon was among the Quebec lawmakers who refused to pledge allegiance to the King in 2022, paving the way for a provincial law that now makes the oath of allegiance optional.
paras.zh: Plamondon是魁北克立法者之一，他们在2022年拒绝宣誓效忠国王，为现在可以选择宣誓效忠的省级法律铺平了道路。

paras.en: His plan to withdraw financial support for the lieutenant-governor's office is likely to face significant legal challenges, given the monarchy's central role in Canada's constitution.
paras.zh: 鉴于君主制在加拿大宪法中的核心作用，他撤销对副总督办公室的财政支持的计划可能会面临重大的法律挑战。

paras.en: Such a move would also put future Quebec laws in doubt, as one of the key roles of the lieutenant-governor is to give royal assent to new legislation.
paras.zh: 此举也将使未来的魁北克法律受到质疑，因为副总督的关键角色之一是皇室批准新的立法。

paras.en: Pressed about these hurdles, Plamondon told reporters that he was ready for a legal battle with the federal government.
paras.zh: 在被问及这些障碍时， Plamondon告诉记者，他已准备好与联邦政府进行法律斗争。

paras.en: Monday's result is in part due to public fatigue with the previous CAQ government.
paras.zh: 周一的结果部分是由于公众对前CAQ政府的厌倦。

paras.en: The party made the issue of safeguarding Quebec's identity and language central to its eight years in office, but its long-time leader, FranÃ§ois Legault, eventually lost significant support among voters.
paras.zh: 该党将维护魁北克的身份和语言作为其八年执政的核心问题，但其长期领导人Franóois Legault最终失去了选民的显著支持。

paras.en: Efforts to revive the party by replacing Legault with a new leader, outgoing Premier Christine FrÃ©chette, were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 试图用即将卸任的总理克里斯蒂娜·弗雷切特（ Christine Fréchette ）取代莱戈（ Legault ）来重振党的努力没有成功。

paras.en: FrÃ©chette conceded her own re-election race in Trois-RiviÃ¨res shortly before 22:00 local time. She said in a speech that she would work with St-Pierre Plamondon on the transition.
paras.zh: FrÃ © chette在当地时间22:00前不久在Trois-RiviÃ ¨ res承认了自己的连任竞选。她在一次演讲中表示，她将与St-Pierre Plamondon合作进行过渡。

paras.en: "Governing Quebec is the greatest honour I have ever had," she said. "I have Quebec tattooed on my heart."
paras.zh: “治理魁北克是我有史以来最大的荣誉，”她说。“我的心上有魁北克纹身。”

paras.en: The Quebec Liberal Party secured the second-most seats, while the Quebec Conservative Party gained seats.
paras.zh: 魁北克自由党获得第二大席位，而魁北克保守党获得席位。

paras.en: Prime Minister Carney remains popular in Quebec, though support for him had recently dipped, external as US President Donald Trump imposed new tariffs on Canada in August, following a breakdown in trade talks.
paras.zh: 卡尼总理在魁北克仍然很受欢迎，尽管最近对他的支持有所下降，因为美国总统唐纳德特朗普在贸易谈判破裂后于8月对加拿大征收新关税。

paras.en: Quebec is among the hardest hit by the latest US tariffs, with experts at global forecasting firm Oxford Economics projecting a C$2bn blow for the province.
paras.zh: 魁北克省是受美国最新关税影响最严重的省份之一，全球预测公司牛津经济研究院的专家预计，该省将受到20亿加元的打击。

articles.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments

paras.en: A lawyer for one of the seven men accused of participating in a Cornell University gang rape has called for the special prosecutor on the case to recuse herself over past public comments.
paras.zh: 被指控参与康奈尔大学轮奸的七名男子之一的律师呼吁此案的特别检察官回避过去的公开评论。

paras.en: The lawyer had said a social media post from New York Attorney General Letitia James throws into question her investigation's "integrity and independence".
paras.zh: 这位律师曾表示，纽约总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯（ Letitia James ）在社交媒体上发帖，质疑她的调查的“诚信和独立性”。

paras.en: In the 28 September post, James wrote that "what this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable" and told survivors that "we stand with you".
paras.zh: 在9月28日的帖子中，詹姆斯写道， “这位年轻女子被迫忍受的是可怕和不可接受的” ，并告诉幸存者“我们与你们站在一起”。

paras.en: The university's administration is under fire over its alleged mishandling of the October 2024 incident and, according to US media, now faces a no-confidence vote by Cornell faculty.
paras.zh: 据美国媒体报道，该大学的管理部门因涉嫌对2024年10月事件的处理不当而受到抨击，现在面临康奈尔大学教师的不信任投票。

paras.en: The university's Faculty Senate, a governing body comprised of professors and other academic staff, will vote on a resolution of no confidence next week, according to reports. Cornell is an Ivy League university, alongside Harvard and Yale, and its faculty includes Nobel laureates and other distinguished researchers.
paras.zh: 据报道，该大学的教师参议院是一个由教授和其他学术人员组成的管理机构，下周将就一项不信任决议进行投票。康奈尔大学是一所常春藤盟校，与哈佛大学和耶鲁大学并列，其教师包括诺贝尔奖获得者和其他杰出研究人员。

paras.en: A majority no-confidence vote would be a largely symbolic gesture, signalling the broader faculty's discontent and applying pressure on university leadership to act.
paras.zh: 大多数不信任投票在很大程度上是一种象征性的姿态，表明了更广泛的教师的不满情绪，并对大学领导层施加压力，要求他们采取行动。

paras.en: Cornell University announced on Tuesday that it was hiring Sally Yates, a former deputy attorney general, to lead an independent review of the university's practices and procedures on sexual assault and related conduct.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学周二宣布，它将聘请前副检察长莎莉·耶茨（ Sally Yates ）领导对该校性侵犯和相关行为的做法和程序进行独立审查。

paras.en: "Yates and her team will conduct a detailed review of the University's response to the allegations involving Jane Doe", the university said in a statement, "including whether Cornell followed its policies and procedures in responding to the matter".
paras.zh: 该大学在一份声明中说： “耶茨和她的团队将对大学对涉及无名氏的指控的回应进行详细审查，包括康奈尔大学在回应此事时是否遵循其政策和程序。”

paras.en: Allegations made in a lawsuit against seven men and the university have rocked the campus in New York state, with hundreds of students and faculty members gathering there on Monday in protest, and sparked anger across the country.
paras.zh: 在针对七名男子和大学的诉讼中提出的指控震惊了纽约州的校园，周一有数百名学生和教职员工聚集在那里抗议，并引发了全国各地的愤怒。

paras.en: New York Governor Kathy Hochul last week appointed James as a special prosecutor to investigate the case and how law enforcement and the university initially responded to the allegations made by a woman identified in the lawsuit as Jane Doe.
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍丘尔（ Kathy Hochul ）上周任命詹姆斯（ James ）为特别检察官，负责调查此案，以及执法部门和大学最初如何回应诉讼中被确认为无名女子的指控。

paras.en: Jane Doe has accused the university of failing to protect her, after she was allegedly drugged and raped by the men for several hours at a fraternity party.
paras.zh: 简·多伊（ Jane Doe ）指责该大学未能保护她，因为据称她在一个兄弟会派对上被男人下药并强奸了几个小时。

paras.en: Days before she was appointed special prosecutor, James wrote on X: "What this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable.
paras.zh: 在她被任命为特别检察官的前几天，詹姆斯在X上写道： “这位年轻女子被迫忍受的是可怕和不可接受的。

paras.en: "I'm holding her in my heart and in my prayers," she continued. "To her, and to all survivors: you're not alone. We stand with you."
paras.zh: “我把她抱在心里，在祈祷中，”她继续说。“对她，对所有幸存者：你并不孤单。我们与您站在一起。”

paras.en: The lawyer for one of the seven accused said these remarks were disqualifying.
paras.zh: 七名被告之一的律师说，这些言论是不合格的。

paras.en: In a statement sent to the BBC's US media partner, CBS News, the lawyer said her comments conflict with the need for "independently evaluating the evidence".
paras.zh: 在向英国广播公司的美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（ CBS News ）发送的一份声明中，这位律师表示，她的言论与“独立评估证据”的必要性相冲突。

paras.en: "This is not an accusation that Attorney General James is corrupt, acting in bad faith or incapable of performing her duties professionally," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明说： “这不是指控司法部长詹姆斯腐败，恶意行事或无法专业地履行职责。”

paras.en: "Nor am I suggesting that a court has determined that she is legally disqualified. The point is much narrower: an avoidable question now hangs over this investigation, and voluntary recusal would remove it."
paras.zh: “我也不建议法院确定她在法律上被取消资格。问题要狭隘得多：这个调查现在笼罩着一个可以避免的问题，自愿回避会消除它。”

paras.en: Governor Hochul and James were questioned about impartiality concerns during a news conference, and Hochul said James would "follow the facts".
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会上，州长霍丘尔和詹姆斯受到了有关公正性问题的质疑，霍丘尔表示，詹姆斯将“遵循事实”。

paras.en: "She'll examine the evidence and go wherever it leads, and if the evidence supports charges, she will pursue them," Hochul said.
paras.zh: Hochul说： “她将检查证据并前往任何地方，如果证据支持指控，她将追究这些指控。”

articles.title: Jimmy Barnes to Headline 2027 Red Hot Summer Tour With All-Australian Lineup
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Jimmy Barnes will headline the 2027 Red Hot Summer Tour, leading an all-Australian lineup across eight outdoor shows early next year.
paras.zh: 吉米·巴恩斯 (Jimmy Barnes) 将在明年初带领全澳大利亚阵容参加 8 场户外演出，成为 2027 Red Hot Summer 巡演的主角。

paras.en: The run brings together Barnes with Jon Stevens, who performs his Noiseworks & INXS Collection, alongside Birds of Tokyo, Eskimo Joe, Baby Animals, Chocolate Starfish and Sarah McLeod — the latter appearing in a new rock duo with drummer Mick Skelton. The tour opens Jan. 9 with a Sounds By The River show at Mannum Golf Club in South Australia before rolling through Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland and Tasmania, wrapping March 6 at Gateway Lakes in Wodonga.
paras.zh: 这次演出汇集了 Barnes 和 Jon Stevens，后者表演了他的 Noiseworks & INXS Collection，另外还有 Birds of Tokyo、Eskimo Joe、Baby Animals、Chocolate Starfish 和 Sarah McLeod（后者与鼓手 Mick Skelton 组成了新的摇滚二人组）。巡演于 1 月 9 日在南澳大利亚州曼纳姆高尔夫俱乐部 (Mannum Golf Club) 举行的 Sounds By The River 演出拉开帷幕，然后途经维多利亚州、新南威尔士州、昆士兰州和塔斯马尼亚州，并于 3 月 6 日在沃东加的 Gateway Lakes 结束巡演。

paras.en: Barnes remains one of the most successful artists in Australian music history, with 22 No. 1 albums on the ARIA chart — more than any other local act — across a career spanning more than four decades as a solo performer and as the frontman of Cold Chisel. He is a two-time ARIA Hall of Fame inductee, honored both with Cold Chisel and as a solo artist. He returned to No. 1 in June 2025 with his 21st solo studio album Defiant, and recently marked the 40th anniversary of his landmark 1985 album For the Working Class Man.
paras.zh: 巴恩斯仍然是澳大利亚音乐史上最成功的艺术家之一，在四十多年的独奏表演者和 Cold Chisel 主唱的职业生涯中，他拥有 22 张 ARIA 排行榜第一名的专辑，比任何其他本地艺人都多。他曾两次入选 ARIA 名人堂，并以冷凿奖和独奏艺术家身份荣获此殊荣。 2025 年 6 月，他凭借第 21 张个人录音室专辑《Defiant》重返排行榜第一，最近还庆祝了他 1985 年里程碑式的专辑《For the Working Class Man》发行 40 周年。

paras.en: Several acts on the bill are marking milestones of their own. Baby Animals — led by Suze DeMarchi and Dave Leslie — celebrate 35 years since their eight-times-platinum self-titled debut, home to “Rush You” and “Early Warning,” while Eskimo Joe approach three decades together. Stevens’ set draws on hits from both Noiseworks and INXS, including “Take Me Back,” “Touch,” “New Sensation” and “Never Tear Us Apart.”
paras.zh: 该法案中的几项法案本身就具有里程碑意义。由苏兹·德马奇 (Suze DeMarchi) 和戴夫·莱斯利 (Dave Leslie) 领军的《动物宝宝》 (Baby Animals) 庆祝其八白金同名首张专辑诞生 35 周年，其中包括《Rush You》和《Early warning》，而《爱斯基摩乔》 (Eskimo Joe) 也一起走过了 35 周年。 Stevens 的专辑借鉴了 Noiseworks 和 INXS 的热门歌曲，包括“Take Me Back”、“Touch”、“New Sensation”和“Never Tear Us Apart”。

paras.en: Tickets go on sale Friday, Oct. 9 at 12 p.m. local time, following Telstra and promoter presales earlier in the week.
paras.zh: 门票于 10 月 9 日星期五中午 12 点开始发售。当地时间，继本周早些时候澳洲电信和促销员预售后。

articles.title: 2026 ARIA Awards Hosts Announced Ahead of 40th-Anniversary Ceremony
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Comedians Melanie Bracewell and Tim McDonald will host the 2026 ARIA Awards, Australia’s biggest night in music, organizers have announced.
paras.zh: 组织者宣布，喜剧演员梅兰妮·布雷斯韦尔 (Melanie Bracewell) 和蒂姆·麦克唐纳 (Tim McDonald) 将主持 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼，这是澳大利亚最大的音乐之夜。

paras.en: The pair — co-hosts of Network 10’s The Cheap Seats — will lead the milestone 40th annual ceremony at Sydney’s Hordern Pavilion on Wednesday, Nov. 18. The duo have fronted the comedy panel show together since 2021, winning the Logie Award for most outstanding entertainment program in 2023, and organizers called them a “natural fit” to helm the anniversary edition.
paras.zh: 这对搭档是 Network 10 节目《The Cheap Seats》的联合主持人，将于 11 月 18 日星期三在悉尼 Hordern Pavilion 主持具有里程碑意义的第 40 届年度颁奖典礼。自 2021 年以来，两人一直共同主持喜剧小组节目，并赢得了 2023 年最杰出娱乐节目洛吉奖，组织者称他们“天生适合”主持周年纪念活动。

paras.en: Both leaned into the comedic register in accepting the gig. “Thrilled to host the ARIAs with my friend and colleague Tim McDonald,” Bracewell said. “Hoping they didn’t book us for experience. The last awards ceremony I hosted was a raffle for a meat tray.”
paras.zh: 两人在接受演出时都倾向于喜剧。 “很高兴能与我的朋友兼同事蒂姆·麦克唐纳一起举办 ARIA，”布雷斯韦尔说。 “希望他们不是为了体验而预订我们的。我主持的上一次颁奖典礼是肉盘抽奖活动。”

paras.en: McDonald added: “Australian music is the best in the world, so we are so excited and honoured to be hosting! I can’t wait to celebrate this music milestone — 40 years of the ARIA Awards, and 24 years since I failed the recorder in grade three.” Triple j presenter and DJ Latifa Tee will also join the hosting team before moving to red-carpet duties alongside Network 10’s Georgie Tunny and Angela Bishop.
paras.zh: McDonald 补充道：“澳大利亚音乐是世界上最好的，所以我们很兴奋也很荣幸能够成为主办方！我迫不及待地想庆祝这个音乐里程碑——ARIA 奖 40 周年，也是我三年级竖笛不及格以来的 24 年。” Triple j 主持人兼 DJ Latifa Tee 也将加入主持团队，然后与 Network 10 的 Georgie Tunny 和 Angela Bishop 一起走上红地毯。

paras.en: The announcement follows the reveal of this year’s nominations, led by Genesis Owusu and Tame Impala with eight nods apiece. The two will go head-to-head in several of the night’s biggest categories, including Album of the Year and Best Solo Artist, as well as Best Alternative Release — a category returning to the ARIAs for the first time since 2016. Ecca Vandal follows with seven nominations, while Baker Boy, BOY SODA, G Flip, Miss Kaninna and Ninajirachi each earned five, and Troye Sivan, DMA’S and Dom Dolla are up for four each.
paras.zh: 今年的提名公布后，Genesis Owusu 和 Tame Impala 分别获得八项提名。两人将在当晚几个最重要的类别中展开激烈角逐，包括年度专辑和最佳独唱艺人，以及最佳另类发行专辑——该类别自 2016 年以来首次重返 ARIA。Ecca Vandal 获得七项提名，而 Baker Boy、BOY SODA、G Flip、Miss Kaninna 和 Ninajirachi 各获得五项提名，Troye Sivan、DMA’S 和 Dom Dolla 各获得四项提名。

paras.en: Winners will be crowned across 29 categories on the night, with the public voting for Best Australian Live Act, Song of the Year, Best Video and Most Popular International Artist. The ceremony also caps a year in which ARIA marked its 40th anniversary with a standalone Hall of Fame event in June, inducting Gurrumul, Jenny Morris, Kate Ceberano, Spiderbait, The Living End, and Vika & Linda.
paras.zh: 当晚，公众将投票选出最佳澳大利亚现场表演、年度歌曲、最佳视频和最受欢迎国际艺术家，最终选出 29 个类别的获奖者。此次颁奖典礼还为 ARIA 成立 40 周年画上了圆满的句号，并于 6 月举办了一场独立的名人堂活动，Gurrumul、Jenny Morris、Kate Ceberano、Spiderbait、The Living End 以及 Vika & Linda 入选。

paras.en: The 2026 ARIA Awards will stream live on Paramount+ from 5 p.m. AEDT on Nov. 18 before airing on Network 10, with red-carpet coverage hosted by Bishop, Tunny and Tee.
paras.zh: 2026 年 ARIA 颁奖典礼将于美国东部时间下午 5 点在 Paramount+ 上进行直播。美国东部时间 11 月 18 日播出，随后在 Network 10 播出，由 Bishop、Tunny 和 Tee 主持红地毯报道。

articles.title: Adam Levine Is Floored by a Black Sabbath Cover on ‘The Voice’
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: A striking cover of a Black Sabbath classic won over Adam Levine on the latest episode of The Voice.
paras.zh: 在最新一集的《好声音》中，亚当·莱文 (Adam Levine) 对黑色安息日经典作品的引人注目的翻唱赢得了观众的青睐。

paras.en: During Monday’s (Oct. 5) Season 30 Blind Auditions, 25-year-old Dakota Cohen performed “Changes” — the melancholy piano ballad originally released on Black Sabbath’s 1972 album Vol. 4 and later sung by frontman Ozzy Osbourne. It took most of the song, but Levine and fellow coach Riley Green both turned their chairs by the end, with Queen Latifah calling the performance “astounding” and “insane” and Green praising it as the “perfect song choice.”
paras.zh: 在周一（10 月 5 日）第 30 季盲选期间，25 岁​​的达科塔·科恩 (Dakota Cohen) 表演了“Changes”——这首忧郁的钢琴民谣最初发行于 Black Sabbath 1972 年的专辑《Vol. 1》中。 4，后来由主唱奥兹·奥斯本演唱。这占据了整首歌的大部分时间，但莱文和他的教练莱利·格林在最后都转过身来，奎因·拉蒂法称这场表演“令人震惊”和“疯狂”，格林称赞它是“完美的歌曲选择”。

paras.en: Levine, who noted he had pressed his button first, made an aggressive pitch. “The song choice for me says so much,” he said. “That’s instantly something out of the gate; before I even heard you sing a note, I want you on my team.”
paras.zh: 莱文注意到他先按下了按钮，因此做出了咄咄逼人的发言。 “这首歌的选择对我来说意义重大，”他说。 “这立刻就发生了；在我听到你唱一个音符之前，我希望你加入我的团队。”

paras.en: He compared Cohen’s voice to Miley Cyrus and told her, “I just love what you’re out here doing, and I do believe this is your home.” Cohen ultimately chose Team Adam — a decision helped along, she revealed, by a chance encounter years earlier, when Levine gave her a thumbs-up after hearing her sing Maroon 5’s “Sunday Morning” at a restaurant.
paras.zh: 他将科恩的声音与麦莉·赛勒斯进行了比较，并告诉她：“我喜欢你在这里所做的事情，我相信这是你的家。”科恩最终选择了 Adam 团队——她透露，几年前的一次偶然相遇，当莱文在一家餐厅听到她唱 Maroon 5 的《Sunday Morning》后向她竖起大拇指时，她透露，这个决定对她很有帮助。

paras.en: The audition landed with added weight given the song’s history. Originally sung by Ozzy Osbourne on Black Sabbath’s 1972 album Vol. 4, “Changes” found new life in 2003 when Osbourne re-recorded it as a duet with his daughter Kelly Osbourne, topping the U.K. singles chart.
paras.zh: 考虑到这首歌的历史，试镜的分量更加重。最初由 Ozzy Osbourne 在 Black Sabbath 1972 年专辑 Vol. 1 中演唱。 4、2003年，奥斯本与女儿凯利·奥斯本以二重唱形式重新录制了《Changes》，并登上了英国单曲排行榜的榜首。

paras.en: Osbourne died in July 2025 at age 76, weeks after Black Sabbath’s farewell concert; in the wake of his death, “Changes” debuted at No. 42 on Billboard’s Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart, making a primetime cover of one of his most tender vocals newly poignant.
paras.zh: 奥斯本于 2025 年 7 月去世，享年 76 岁，也就是黑色安息日告别音乐会几周后；在他去世后，《Changes》首次亮相就在公告牌热门摇滚和另类歌曲排行榜上排名第 42 位，使他最温柔的声音之一在黄金时段的翻唱变得更加令人心酸。

paras.en: The Voice is currently in its milestone 30th season, with Clarkson, Levine, Queen Latifah and Riley Green serving as coaches. The show airs Mondays and Tuesdays at 8 p.m. ET on NBC, streaming next day on Peacock.
paras.zh: 《好声音》目前已进入具有里程碑意义的第 30 个赛季，由克拉克森、莱文、奎恩·拉蒂法和莱利·格林担任教练。该节目每周一和周二晚上 8 点播出。 ET 在 NBC 播出，次日在 Peacock 播出。

articles.title: ‘Small Prophets’ Review: Mackenzie Crook’s Droll Apple TV Comedy Features Pearce Quigley in One of the Year’s Best Performances
articles.author: Daniel Fienberg

paras.en: From HBO Latino’s Like Water for Chocolate to Netflix’s One Hundred Years of Solitude to Amazon’s The House of the Spirits, Spanish-language magical realism is having its television moment. But the genre has proven difficult for Anglophone shows to crack.
paras.zh: 从 HBO Latino 的《巧克力之水》到 Netflix 的《一百年的孤独》，再到亚马逊的《灵魂之家》，西班牙语魔幻现实主义正在电视上崭露头角。但事实证明，这种类型对于英语节目来说很难破解。

paras.en: Look no further than Apple TV, on a creative hot streak for several years in a variety of tones and topics, but a graveyard of less-than-successful stabs at magical realism or magical realism-adjacent programming, with titles ranging from The Big Door Prize to Government Cheese to High Desert to The Changeling.
paras.zh: Apple TV 就是最好的例子，多年来，它在各种基调和主题上一直保持着创意热潮，但却是魔幻现实主义或魔幻现实主义相关节目的不成功尝试的坟墓，标题从大门奖到政府奶酪到高沙漠到换生灵。

paras.en: Cast: Pearce Quigley, Lauren Patel, Michael Palin, Mackenzie Crook, Paul Kaye, John Pointing, Shola Adewusi
paras.zh: 主演: 皮尔斯·奎格利 / 劳伦·帕特尔 / 迈克尔·帕林 / 麦肯兹·克鲁克 / 保罗·凯 / 约翰·波因廷 / 绍拉·阿德乌斯

paras.en: Depending on whether you apply the classification to Widow’s Bay — if you accept that curses are magical, it surely counts — Apple TV’s first magical realist triumph isn’t an Apple TV original at all, but rather the BBC Two acquisition Small Prophets, premiering on the streamer this week.
paras.zh: 取决于你是否将这种分类应用于寡妇湾——如果你承认诅咒是神奇的，那肯定很重要——Apple TV 的第一部魔幻现实主义胜利根本不是 Apple TV 原创，而是 BBC 二台收购的《小先知》，本周在流媒体上首播。

paras.en: I would also argue that Small Prophets may be the finest show to hit Apple this year, though that superlative would also probably depend on your feelings about Widow’s Bay.
paras.zh: 我还认为，《小先知》可能是今年苹果公司推出的最好的节目，尽管这个最高级的节目也可能取决于你对寡妇湾的感受。

paras.en: Written, directed and co-starring Mackenzie Crook and sure to appeal to fans of Crook’s similarly droll, ultimately more grounded comedy Detectorists, Small Prophets is sad and funny and whimsical, an unlikely piece of alchemy that comes together as simultaneously wild and understatedly humane.
paras.zh: 《小先知》由麦肯齐·克鲁克编剧、导演和联合主演，肯定会吸引克鲁克同样滑稽、最终更接地气的喜剧《侦探》的粉丝，《小先知》悲伤、有趣、异想天开，是一种不可思议的炼金术，同时融合了狂野和低调的人性。

paras.en: It’s a low-key show, but one that succeeds in countless ways that could have easily gone astray and turned silly or twee, carried in no small part by a beautiful starring performance from Pearce Quigley and a breakout turn from co-star Lauren Patel.
paras.zh: 这是一部低调的剧，但却在无数方面取得了成功，很容易就会误入歧途，变得愚蠢或矫情，这在很大程度上得益于皮尔斯·奎格利的精彩主演表演和联合主演劳伦·帕特尔的突破性转变。

paras.en: Quigley, a prolific character actor most recently seen memorably as Gospel John on Netflix’s The Gentlemen, plays Michael Sleep, a Manchester-area man sleepwalking through an unremarkable life.
paras.zh: 奎格利是一位多产的角色演员，最近在 Netflix 的《绅士们》中饰演福音约翰，令人印象深刻。他饰演迈克尔·斯普利普，一个曼彻斯特地区的男人，梦游着平凡的生活。

paras.en: Michael has a day-to-day routine that includes bickering with his nosy neighbor (Jon Pointing’s Clive) about the maintenance on his cul de sac home, bickering with his boss (Crook’s Gordon) at a home goods chain store, and visiting with his father (Michael Palin‘s Brian) at his retirement home. Otherwise, he’s generally alone.
paras.zh: 迈克尔的日常生活包括与爱管闲事的邻居（乔恩·波因廷饰演的克莱夫饰）就他死胡同里的家的维护问题争吵，在一家家居用品连锁店与他的老板（克鲁克饰演的戈登饰）争吵，以及拜访他的父亲（迈克尔·佩林饰演的布莱恩饰）的退休之家。否则，他通常都是孤独一人。

paras.en: It hasn’t always been like this for Michael. Seven years earlier, his long-term girlfriend Clea stepped out on Christmas Eve and her car was found at a nearby bridge. She, however, was never found, leaving Michael with a house — her house, not his — full of boxes, an untouched living room still decorated for Christmas, and some big questions.
paras.zh: 对于迈克尔来说，情况并不总是这样。七年前，他交往多年的女友克莉在圣诞节前夕外出，她的车在附近的一座桥上被发现。然而，她从未被发现，给迈克尔留下了一座房子——她的房子，不是他的——装满了盒子，一间未动过的客厅仍然为圣诞节装饰，还有一些大问题。

paras.en: Sensing that his son is trapped in limbo, Brian brings up the homunculi, tiny humanoid creatures who, when raised in jars, are capable of answering any question and even predicting the future. Michael always thought that the homunculi were a quirky bedtime story, but Brian insists that his notebooks contain the recipe for generating and nurturing homunculi.
paras.zh: 布莱恩意识到他的儿子被困在地狱边缘，于是他带出了小矮人，这些微小的人形生物，当它们在罐子里长大时，能够回答任何问题，甚至预测未来。迈克尔一直认为小人是一个古怪的睡前故事，但布莱恩坚持认为他的笔记本包含生成和培育小人的配方。

paras.en: Michael begins the involved homunculi-producing process, wholly unconvinced that his aging father still has his wits about him. But Michael is out of other ideas, at a literal and metaphorical dead-end. He gets an assist from Kacey (Patel), an unmotivated young co-worker whose limited amount of curiosity is piqued by Michael’s commitment to antisocial behavior.
paras.zh: 迈克尔开始了复杂的人造人生产过程，完全不相信他年迈的父亲仍然对他有智慧。但迈克尔没有其他想法，处于字面意义上和隐喻意义上的死胡同。他得到了凯西（帕特尔饰）的帮助，凯西是一位没有动力的年轻同事，迈克尔的反社会行为激起了他有限的好奇心。

paras.en: The clock may be ticking, because Clea’s brother (Paul Kaye’s Roy) is determined to finally sell her house, all while suspicious strangers are poking around with their own questions about Clea.
paras.zh: 时间可能正在流逝，因为克莉亚的兄弟（保罗·凯饰演的罗伊饰）决心最终卖掉她的房子，而可疑的陌生人却在四处询问有关克莉亚的问题。

paras.en: Leaving the homunculi out of the equation, which you cannot do, Small Prophets is a show in which oddities abound, mostly unremarked upon at the fringes of the mundane. There are the local kids who may have staged a daylight armed car robbery; the cheery, constantly gardening neighbor (Shola Adewusi’s Olive) ever poisoning the imaginary pests that probably aren’t attacking her plastic plants; the sullen teen in a hoodie perpetually circling the cul de sac on his bicycle; the maniacally giggling co-worker (Ed Kear’s Brigham) fixated on Michael. It’s a collection of eccentrics and eccentricities that’s always threatening to tip over into outlandishly or unsustainably weird, but never does.
paras.zh: 把小矮人排除在外（这是你做不到的），《小先知》是一部充满奇怪之处的节目，大部分都在平凡的边缘未被注意到。当地的孩子可能在光天化日之下策划了武装汽车抢劫案；性格开朗、经常从事园艺工作的邻居（Shola Adewusi 饰演的 Olive 饰）经常给想象中的害虫下毒，而这些害虫可能不会攻击她的塑料植物；穿着连帽衫、闷闷不乐的少年骑着自行车不停地绕着死胡同转；疯狂咯咯笑的同事（艾德·基尔饰演的布里格姆）专注于迈克尔。它是一群怪人和怪人​​的集合，总是有可能变得古怪或不可持续的怪异，但从来没有发生过。

paras.en: Much of that sense of muted control is attributable to Crook, who might still be best known for wiry supporting turns in The Office and Game of Thrones before he established himself as a tremendous television creator and director. I was constantly aware of the subtle and unpretentious details filling the periphery of every frame, curiosities and anomalies that, treated with a heavier hand, could have descended into something more overtly oddball or bizarre. Instead, as was the case with Detectorists, Crook maintains admirable restraint, right up until the end of the season — a second season has already been ordered — when things come together in well-earned chaos.
paras.zh: 这种无声控制感在很大程度上要归功于克鲁克，在他成为一名伟大的电视创作者和导演之前，他可能仍然以《办公室》和《权力的游戏》中的瘦弱配角而闻名。我不断地意识到每一帧的边缘都充满了微妙而朴实的细节、好奇心和异常现象，如果用更大的手来处理，可能会演变成更明显的奇怪或怪异的东西。相反，就像《侦探们》的情况一样，克鲁克保持着令人钦佩的克制，直到本季结束——第二季已经被预订了——那时事情在应得的混乱中聚集在一起。

paras.en: Crook knows that if anybody in the show acknowledged how abnormal the unfolding events were/are, Small Prophets would likely collapse into a wacky heap, so it’s all treated as very ordinary, even when the circumstances are anything but.
paras.zh: 克鲁克知道，如果节目中的任何人承认正在发生的事件有多么反常，《小先知》很可能会崩溃成一堆古怪的东西，所以这一切都被视为非常正常，即使情况并非如此。

paras.en: Quigley’s own sense of economy is a perfect match.
paras.zh: 奎格利自己的节约意识是完美的匹配。

paras.en: Michael is a sarcastic grouch, unwilling to suffer the various fools in his life. But however many things the character says that are objectively funny, Quigley never acts like he’s delivering punchlines. He’s simply someone who has dedicated all of his patience to his father — who is flirting with dementia — and a mystery he has resigned himself to never solve, with none left for anybody else. Quigley looks like a mad prophet, which is central to his terrifying guest role in The Gentlemen, but Michael is melancholic, not mad. It’s a special performance from an actor who has never received this sort of spotlight before.
paras.zh: 迈克尔是一个爱挖苦人、爱发牢骚的人，不愿意忍受生活中各种各样的傻瓜。但无论这个角色说的很多话客观上很有趣，奎格利的表现从来都不像是在说笑点。他只是把所有的耐心都奉献给了患有痴呆症的父亲，而他也甘心永远不会解开这个谜团，没有留给其他人任何答案。奎格利看起来像一个疯狂的先知，这是他在《绅士》中客串的可怕角色的核心，但迈克尔是忧郁的，而不是疯狂的。这是一位以前从未受到过如此关注的演员的特殊表演。

paras.en: Despite the demographic gaps between them, Patel makes Kacey into a plausibly simpatico foil for Michael. Crook leaves many holes in Kacey’s backstory — perhaps too many — though it’s easy enough to understand that she recognizes a lonely kindred spirit in Michael. They forge a friendship that is, like everything else in the show, unforced and increasingly sweet without even a trace of anything sketchy or saccharine.
paras.zh: 尽管他们之间存在人口差距，帕特尔还是让凯西成为了迈克尔的和蔼可亲的陪衬。克鲁克在凯西的背景故事中留下了许多漏洞——也许太多了——尽管很容易理解她在迈克尔身上认识到了孤独的志同道合的精神。他们建立了一种友谊，就像剧中的其他一切一样，不做作，而且越来越甜蜜，甚至没有任何粗略或糖精的痕迹。

paras.en: It’s a great supporting ensemble, one in which even the outsized performances — Adewusi is aggressively endearing, while Kear starts broad and adjusts his volume as he goes — are never designed to steal scenes. Heaven knows Palin could steal a scene from almost any actor in circulation, but his matter-of-fact approach to all of Brian’s strangeness suggests a man whose imagination was once boundless, forced by age into a life that’s become all too contained.
paras.zh: 这是一个很棒的配角组合，其中即使是超大型的表演——阿杜乌斯非常讨人喜欢，而基尔则开始广泛并随着他的动作调整音量——从来都不是为了抢镜头而设计的。天知道佩林可以从几乎所有流通的演员那里窃取一个场景，但他对布莱恩所有奇怪之处的实事求是的态度表明，这个人的想象力曾经是无限的，但由于年龄的原因，他的生活变得过于压抑。

paras.en: Across six half-hour episodes, Small Prophets escalates in ways that are always believable and never predictable. The audience isn’t being asked to solve the mystery of Clea’s disappearance — just to invest in Michael’s circumstances as the puzzlements and peculiarities mount. It isn’t a show filled with big laughs or swells of emotion, though I laughed hard a few times and got choked up here and there. But it’s one that produces a smile of amused recognition early on, without ever letting up.
paras.zh: 在六个半小时的剧集中，《小先知》以始终可信且不可预测的方式升级。观众并没有被要求解开克莉失踪的谜团——只是随着困惑和奇特现象的增加而关注迈克尔的处境。这不是一部充满欢声笑语或情感膨胀的节目，尽管我有几次笑得很厉害，并且时不时地哽咽。但它一开始就产生了一种有趣的认可微笑，而且从未停止过。

paras.en: Despite the story’s scale and the show’s title, the profits it offers viewers willing to buy into its idiosyncrasies are anything but small.
paras.zh: 尽管故事的规模和节目的标题不同，但它为愿意购买其特质的观众带来的利润却一点也不小。

articles.title: How Andrew Garfield Combined Crowdsourcing and a Classic Acting Technique to Understand Sam Altman
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: Andrew Garfield doesn’t look exactly like Sam Altman.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·加菲尔德（Andrew Garfield）看起来并不完全像萨姆·奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）。

paras.en: But the Oscar-nominated actor found a way to try to capture the essence of the OpenAI CEO he portrays in Luca Guadagnino‘s Artificial.
paras.zh: 但这位奥斯卡提名演员找到了一种方法，试图捕捉他在卢卡·瓜达尼诺 (Luca Guadagnino) 的《人工智能》(Artificial) 中扮演的 OpenAI 首席执行官的本质。

paras.en: An attempt to use prosthetics to better resemble Altman was unsuccessful (“totally ridiculous,” according to Guadagnino), so much so that Garfield laughed as he recalled how badly that experiment went when reminded of it by The Hollywood Reporter on the red carpet ahead of Artificial‘s world premiere at the 2026 New York FIlm Festival.
paras.zh: 使用假肢来更好地模仿奥特曼的尝试没有成功（据瓜达尼诺称，“完全荒谬”），以至于加菲猫在 2026 年纽约电影节《人工》全球首映前的红地毯上回忆起这项实验的糟糕结果时，他笑了起来。

paras.en: Instead, ironically for the tech-forward film, Garfield relied on a classic acting technique and human conversations (an analog version of crowdsourcing).
paras.zh: 相反，具有讽刺意味的是，对于这部科技前沿的电影来说，加菲猫依赖于经典的表演技巧和人类对话（众包的模拟版本）。

paras.en: “When you’re first learning about acting, one of the techniques, Stanislavski, is you go through the play and you see what this person says about other characters. You see what other characters say about him,” Garfield told THR. “So I tried to speak to as many people as possible who know Sam or who have experiences and interactions with Sam to glean more of an objective, moral side, looking in point of view. Everyone is an unreliable narrator. I felt like I needed to absorb as much as possible, put it in the cauldron, put it in the pot, put it on simmer and then [use] my own instincts and interpretation and point of view, because any other actor would have played it differently. I know that I needed to play it in the way that I wanted to play it.”
paras.zh: “斯坦尼斯拉夫斯基，当你第一次学习表演时，技巧之一就是你看一遍剧本，看看这个人如何评价其他角色。你看看其他角色如何评价他，”加菲尔德告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “所以我尝试与尽可能多认识山姆或与山姆有过经历和互动的人交谈，以收集更多客观、道德的一面，从不同的角度看待问题。每个人都是不可靠的叙述者。我觉得我需要尽可能多地吸收，把它放在大锅里，放在锅里，用文火煮，然后[使用]我自己的直觉、解释和观点，因为任何其他演员都会以不同的方式扮演它。我知道我需要扮演以我想要的方式演奏。”

paras.en: Artificial tells the story about both the origins of OpenAI and the rise of the artificial intelligence phenomenon, including the Silicon Valley figures at the forefront of the technology. Garfield, like his fellow castmembers in the film, looked to interviews and videos of his real-life counterpart, with Anora breakout Yura Borisov, who plays OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever, also taking a surprisingly ethereal approach.
paras.zh: 《Artificial》讲述了 OpenAI 的起源和人工智能现象的兴起，包括处于技术前沿的硅谷人物。加菲猫和电影中的其他演员一样，查阅了现实生活中对手的采访和视频，而饰演 OpenAI 联合创始人伊利亚·苏茨克韦尔 (Ilya Sutskever) 的 Anora 突破者尤拉·鲍里索夫 (Yura Borisov) 也采取了令人惊讶的空灵态度。

paras.en: “I hit a wall, and it was a couple of days before we started to shoot,” Borisov explained of his preparations. “We have the same birthdays (Dec. 8), and I imagined, ‘OK maybe we have some spiritual connection because of this, and I can just relax and create my own character inspired by him.'”
paras.zh: “我碰壁了，几天后我们才开始拍摄，”鲍里索夫解释了他的准备工作。 “我们有相同的生日（12 月 8 日），我想，‘好吧，也许我们因此有一些精神上的联系，我可以放松下来，在他的启发下创造我自己的角色。’”

paras.en: Not Suitable for Work alum Will Angus plays former OpenAI researcher turned Anthropic co-founder Dario Amodei and relished playing the exec at a time when he was somewhat under the radar.
paras.zh: 《不适合工作》演员威尔·安格斯 (Will Angus) 饰演前 OpenAI 研究员、后来成为 Anthropic 联合创始人的达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei)，他很喜欢在自己不太受关注的时候扮演这位高管。

paras.en: “When we were shooting the movie, [Amodei] definitely wasn’t as in the zeitgeist as he is now, so it was very cool to learn about it from the ground floor,” Angus told THR. “We treated him well. … He really had this anxiety to make sure that AI was morally aligned with humanity so I kind of enjoyed being in that role.”
paras.zh: “当我们拍摄这部电影时，[阿莫迪]绝对不像现在这样符合时代精神，所以从底层了解它非常酷，”安格斯告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我们对他很好……他真的很焦虑，希望确保人工智能在道德上与人类保持一致，所以我有点喜欢扮演这个角色。”

paras.en: Amodei has pushed for federal safety regulations around the technology and, just last month, called for an industrywide slowdown of AI development to give safety measures time to catch up.
paras.zh: 阿莫代推动了有关该技术的联邦安全法规，并在上个月呼吁全行业放慢人工智能的发展速度，以便让安全措施有时间跟上。

paras.en: When asked if he believes Amodei’s AI safety concerns, Angus was cautiously optimistic.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否相信 Amodei 的人工智能安全担忧时，Angus 持谨慎乐观的态度。

paras.en: “I hope he’s doing the best he can to make sure AI’s aligned with human goals,” he said. “I don’t know. I hope so.”
paras.zh: “我希望他尽最大努力确保人工智能与人类目标保持一致，”他说。 “我不知道。我希望如此。”

paras.en: Neon, which acquired Artificial after Amazon MGM Studios abruptly dropped the nearly completed film in June, plans a Christmas Day release for the movie, which was written by Saturday Night Live alum Simon Rich and also stars Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk, Monica Barbaro as OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, Cooper Hoffman, Mark Rylance, Will Price, Chris O’Dowd, Billie Lourd, Zosia Mamet, Jason Schwartzman, Cooper Koch, Thaddea Graham, Nicholas Hamilton and Angus Imrie.
paras.zh: 在亚马逊米高梅影业于 6 月突然放弃了《Artificial》这部即将完成的电影后，Neon 收购了《Artificial》，并计划在圣诞节上映这部电影，该电影由《周六夜现场》的编剧西蒙·里奇 (Simon Rich) 编剧，演员包括艾克·巴里霍尔茨 (Ike Barinholtz) 饰演埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)、莫妮卡·巴巴罗 (Monica Barbaro) 饰演 OpenAI 首席技术官米拉·穆拉蒂 (Mira Murati)、库珀·霍夫曼 (Cooper Hoffman)、马克·里朗斯 (Mark Rylance)、威尔·普莱斯 (Will Price)、克里斯·奥多德 (Chris O’Dowd)、比莉·洛德 (Billie Lourd)、佐莎·马梅特 (Zosia Mamet)、詹森·舒瓦兹曼 (Jason Schwartzman)、库珀·科赫 (Cooper Koch)、塔迪·格雷厄姆 (Thaddea Graham)、尼古拉斯·汉密尔顿和安格斯·伊姆里。

articles.title: Austin Abrams’ ‘Whalefall’: First Reactions
articles.author: Abid Rahman

paras.en: The first reactions to Brian Duffield‘s survival thriller feature Whalefall have hit social media, and it appears that lead actor Austin Abrams‘ banner year continues, even though the characters he plays continue to suffer in more elaborate and awful ways.
paras.zh: 人们对布莱恩·杜菲尔德（Brian Duffield）的生存惊悚片《鲸落》（Whalefall）的第一反应已经在社交媒体上引起了关注，而主演奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯（Austin Abrams）的辉煌一年似乎仍在继续，尽管他扮演的角色继续以更加复杂和可怕的方式遭受痛苦。

paras.en: 20th Century Studios held screenings for Whalefall over the last week including a gala screening in London. Full critics reviews for the film are embargoed till Oct. 14, with Whalefall hitting theaters on Oct. 16.
paras.zh: 20 世纪影业上周为《Whalefall》进行了放映，其中包括在伦敦举行的盛大放映。影评人对这部电影的完整评论截止日期为 10 月 14 日，《Whalefall》将于 10 月 16 日上映。

paras.en: Fresh off getting his s*** getting wrecked in Resident Evil, Abrams plays another everyman having the worst day ever in Whalefall. The synopsis for the film reads: Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.
paras.zh: 艾布拉姆斯刚刚在《生化危机》中遭遇重创，他在《鲸落》中扮演了另一个普通人，度过了有史以来最糟糕的一天。影片简介：父亲（乔什·布洛林饰）去世后，杰伊·加德纳（奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯饰）前往加利福尼亚州中部海岸潜水寻找他的遗体，却被一头巨大的抹香鲸吞噬。当被困在它的肚子里，氧气只剩下一个小时时，杰伊开始意识到，他父亲传授的来之不易的教训可能是他逃脱的关键。

paras.en: As well as Abrams and Brolin, the cast includes, Elisabeth Shue, John Ortiz, Jane Levy and Emily Rudd. Duffield wrote the script with Daniel Kraus, based on Kraus’ 2023 novel of the same name.
paras.zh: 除艾布拉姆斯和布洛林外，演员阵容还包括伊丽莎白·苏、约翰·奥尔蒂斯、简·利维和艾米丽·路德。达菲尔德与丹尼尔·克劳斯共同创作了剧本，改编自克劳斯 2023 年的同名小说。

paras.en: Duffield’s previous directorial efforts include the acclaimed 2023 sci-fi horror film No One Will Save You (that was criminally released straight to Hulu) and the 2020 black comedy coming-of-age film Spontaneous. He also wrote Jane Got a Gun (2015), Underwater (2020) and Love and Monsters (2020).
paras.zh: 达菲尔德之前的导演作品包括广受好评的 2023 年科幻恐怖片《无人能救你》（该片直接在 Hulu 上犯罪发行）和 2020 年黑色喜剧成长电影《自发》。他还创作了《简拿枪》（2015 年）、《水下》（2020 年）和《爱情与怪物》（2020 年）。

articles.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%

paras.en: The World Bank has raised its growth forecast for the East Asia and Pacific region on the back of artificial intelligence-related exports, while warning that its reliance on the AI boom leaves it vulnerable to a potential global tech spending reversal.
paras.zh: 在人工智能相关出口的支持下，世界银行上调了东亚和太平洋地区的增长预测，同时警告称，该地区对人工智能热潮的依赖使其容易受到全球科技支出潜在逆转的影响。

paras.en: The region includes 23 economies, including China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand.
paras.zh: 该地区包括中国、越南、印度尼西亚、马来西亚和泰国等23个经济体。

paras.en: The EAP economy is expected to expand 4.5% this year, 0.3 percentage point more than the bank projected in April, according to its latest report released Tuesday. Growth is forecast to ease to 4.4% in 2027 and 4.3% in 2028. Vietnam received the biggest forecast upgrade among major economies of the region, up 1.1 percentage point to 7.4%.
paras.zh: 根据该银行周二发布的最新报告，预计今年 EAP 经济将增长 4.5%，比 4 月份的预测高出 0.3 个百分点。预计 2027 年增长率将放缓至 4.4%，2028 年将放缓至 4.3%。越南的预测上调幅度是该地区主要经济体中最大的，上调了 1.1 个百分点，至 7.4%。

paras.en: The region's strength, however, is highly dependent on AI-related manufacturing and exports. Trade growth, excluding AI-related goods, has been "weak or negative," the bank said. Those products accounted for more than half of the export growth in most of the region's economies and more than 70% in Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam.
paras.zh: 然而，该地区的实力高度依赖于人工智能相关的制造和出口。该银行表示，不包括人工智能相关商品的贸易增长一直“疲软或为负”。这些产品占该地区大多数经济体出口增长的一半以上，在马来西亚、菲律宾、泰国和越南占70%以上。

paras.en: China, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam shipped $1.4 trillion of AI-related goods in the 12 months through April, according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，截至 4 月份的 12 个月内，中国、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、泰国和越南运送了 1.4 万亿美元的人工智能相关商品。

paras.en: Official data showed that South Korea's exports grew 83.5% in September to a record $120.9 billion, with chips making up half of those shipments. Reflecting the dominance of semiconductors in the country's market, the World Bank highlighted that just two chipmakers — Samsung and SK Hynix — accounted for 43% of the benchmark Kospi index's value as of end-April.
paras.zh: 官方数据显示，韩国9月份出口增长83.5%，达到创纪录的1209亿美元，其中芯片占出口量的一半。世界银行强调，截至 4 月底，三星和 SK 海力士这两家芯片制造商就占据了基准 Kospi 指数价值的 43%，这反映了半导体在该国市场的主导地位。

paras.en: The AI risk is on the spending side. AI-related capital expenditure has reached about 6% of U.S. GDP, similar to the 2000 peak in information-technology investment, and the current cycle "has risen faster than either previous cycle and is still gaining speed," the bank said.
paras.zh: 人工智能风险在于支出方面。该银行表示，与人工智能相关的资本支出已达到美国 GDP 的 6% 左右，与 2000 年信息技术投资的峰值相似，当前周期“比之前的周期增长得更快，并且仍在加速”。

paras.en: The Bank for International Settlements in its annual economic report in June had warned that the boom's scale and pace bears resemblance to the dot-com frenzy of the 1990s and other "manias."
paras.zh: 国际清算银行在 6 月份的年度经济报告中警告说，繁荣的规模和速度与 20 世纪 90 年代的互联网热潮和其他“狂热”相似。

paras.en: The financing driving the boom is also less transparent. Of the $2.9 trillion in AI capex planned for 2025-2028, $800 billion is expected to come from private credit, the bank said, where AI-related lending rose to 34% of activity in 2025 from an 18% average over the prior five years. Private credit portfolios have experienced markdowns, outflows and defaults this year.
paras.zh: 推动繁荣的融资也不太透明。该银行表示，在 2025 年至 2028 年计划的 2.9 万亿美元人工智能资本支出中，预计有 8000 亿美元来自私人信贷，其中与人工智能相关的贷款从前五年的平均水平 18% 升至 2025 年的 34%。今年私人信贷投资组合经历了降价、资金外流和违约。

paras.en: Private credit markets are "less visible, and have not been tested by a severe downturn," the bank said.
paras.zh: 该银行表示，私人信贷市场“不太明显，并且尚未经受严重衰退的考验”。

paras.en: That said, the AI boom supported by abundant liquidity could slow due to the latest tightening of financial conditions as major central banks raise rates for the first time since 2023, according to the report. The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates last month, its first increase in more than three years, and signaled one more to hike this year.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，报告称，由于主要央行自 2023 年以来首次加息，金融状况最近收紧，由充裕流动性支撑的人工智能繁荣可能会放缓。美联储上个月加息，这是三年多来首次加息，并暗示今年将再次加息。

paras.en: A correction may not necessarily mean a bust for the AI supercycle, but that investment "had run ahead of realized demand," the organization said.
paras.zh: 该组织表示，调整不一定意味着人工智能超级周期的失败，但投资“已经超过了实际需求”。

paras.en: A slowdown by 1 percentage point in U.S. growth cuts other emerging-market growth by an estimated 0.6 percentage point, with the hit to investment about twice as large, the bank said. "A slowdown concentrated in AI would be material for East Asia because of the region's prominence in the AI supply chain."
paras.zh: 该行表示，美国经济增长放缓1个百分点，其他新兴市场经济增长预计将减少0.6个百分点，投资受到的打击大约是其两倍。 “由于东亚地区在人工智能供应链中的突出地位，人工智能领域的放缓对东亚来说意义重大。”

paras.en: Bank funding is the broadest exposure. Foreign-currency-denominated liabilities of banks appeared significant in some countries — 29.2% of GDP in Malaysia, 20.7% in the Philippines.
paras.zh: 银行融资是最广泛的风险敞口。在一些国家，银行的外币计价负债似乎很高——马来西亚占 GDP 的 29.2%，菲律宾占 GDP 的 20.7%。

paras.en: Taiwan's statistics bureau recently raised its 2026 growth forecast to 11% from 9.6% on AI demand, while warning in June that "if the high-tech sector faces headwinds, the negative impact on the local economy could be bigger than expected."
paras.zh: 台湾统计局最近将人工智能需求的 2026 年增长预测从 9.6% 上调至 11%，同时在 6 月份警告称，“如果高科技行业面临逆风，对当地经济的负面影响可能会比预期更大。”

articles.title: How quant funds beat the market by being 'early, contrarian and right'

paras.en: Hedge fund strategies that rely on complex algorithms and machine learning technology to build trades are beating the stock market this year.
paras.zh: 依靠复杂算法和机器学习技术来构建交易的对冲基金策略今年表现优于股市。

paras.en: Trend-following hedge funds — also known as commodity trading advisors, or managed futures strategies — are computer-based funds that use quantitative programs, statistical models and price signals to crunch huge volumes of data and invest across futures markets.
paras.zh: 趋势跟踪对冲基金——也称为商品交易顾问或管理期货策略——是基于计算机的基金，使用定量程序、统计模型和价格信号来处理大量数据并在期货市场进行投资。

paras.en: They aim to identify and trade large and consistent trends — both upward and downward — across equities, bonds, commodities, and currencies, to profit from that ongoing momentum.
paras.zh: 他们的目标是识别和交易股票、债券、大宗商品和货币的大而一致的趋势（无论是向上还是向下），以从持续的势头中获利。

paras.en: Societe Generale's SG CTA Index — the sector's main performance benchmark, which tracks the daily net returns of major strategies including Man Group, PIMCO, AQR and Winton Capital funds — notched a 15.7% return in the nine months to the end of the third quarter. By comparison, the broad-based S&P 500 rose 11.7% over the same nine-month period.
paras.zh: 法国兴业银行的 SG CTA 指数（该行业的主要业绩基准，追踪英仕曼集团、PIMCO、AQR 和 Winton Capital 基金等主要策略的每日净回报率）在截至第三季度末的 9 个月内实现了 15.7% 的回报率。相比之下，基础广泛的标准普尔 500 指数在同一 9 个月内上涨了 11.7%。

paras.en: Industry pros told CNBC how CTAs correctly called September's sudden bond sell-off with shorts against U.S. Treasurys. That added to earlier gains made from bullish dollar positions, as well as pre-Iran war long oil bets.
paras.zh: 行业专业人士告诉 CNBC，CTA 如何正确地判断 9 月份因做空美国国债而突然出现的债券抛售。这增加了早些时候看涨美元头寸以及伊朗战争前的多头石油押注带来的收益。

paras.en: "CTAs are crushing the rest of the hedge fund world this year," said Andrew Beer, managing member at Dynamic Beta Investments. He said the sector was "early, contrarian and right" when it started buying crude oil in January prior to the Iran war, before successfully positioning for rising rates ahead of the global bond market turmoil.
paras.zh: Dynamic Beta Investments 的管理成员安德鲁·比尔 (Andrew Beer) 表示：“商品交易顾问今年正在压垮对冲基金界的其他领域。”他表示，该行业在伊朗战争前的一月份开始购买原油，然后在全球债券市场动荡之前成功地为利率上升做好了定位，这是“早期、逆势且正确的”。

paras.en: "They've nailed the two major themes in the markets: on the one hand, feverish AI-driven optimism about equities and, on the other, panic about oil prices and inflation," Beer told CNBC via email. "Humans are too emotional to time markets. Machines are much better."
paras.zh: 比尔通过电子邮件对 CNBC 表示：“他们抓住了市场的两大主题：一方面是人工智能驱动的对股市的狂热乐观情绪，另一方面是对油价和通胀的恐慌。” “人类太情绪化，无法把握市场的时间。机器要好得多。”

paras.en: Nicolas Gaussel, CEO and CIO of Metori Capital Management, said CTAs have effectively navigated inflationary tensions thanks to their ability to take short positions in fixed income. He added that the negative correlation between stocks and oil was another important feature which helped bolster performance this year.
paras.zh: Metori Capital Management 首席执行官兼首席信息官 Nicolas Gaussel 表示，商品交易顾问能够有效地应对通胀紧张局势，因为它们有能力持有固定收益空头头寸。他补充说，股票和石油之间的负相关性是有助于提振今年业绩的另一个重要特征。

paras.en: This year has been shaped by two important structural themes, Gaussel said: the strong positive correlation between equities and bonds, and a strong negative correlation between energy and both equities and bonds. This has proved an environment for traditional '60/40' portfolios.
paras.zh: 高塞尔表示，今年有两个重要的结构性主题：股票和债券之间的强正相关性，以及能源与股票和债券之间的强负相关性。这已经证明是传统“60/40”投资组合的环境。

paras.en: "For traditional long-only diversified portfolios, the positive correlation between equities and bonds has been particularly challenging. Bond performance has been weak, while bonds have also provided less diversification against equities. By contrast, the ability of CTAs to go short bonds and short-term rates has proved very beneficial," Gaussel added.
paras.zh: “对于传统的多头多元化投资组合来说，股票和债券之间的正相关性尤其具有挑战性。债券表现一直疲软，而债券相对股票的多元化程度也较低。相比之下，事实证明，商品交易顾问做空债券和短期利率的能力非常有利，”高塞尔补充道。

paras.en: "This reminds us that one of the key strengths of CTAs is that they are not dependent on bonds playing their traditional defensive role."
paras.zh: “这提醒我们，CTA 的主要优势之一是它们不依赖于发挥传统防御作用的债券。”

paras.en: Looking ahead, the performance of trend-following funds heading into year-end will likely hinge on energy prices and interest rates, said Yung-Shin Kung, chief investment officer at Mast Investments.
paras.zh: Mast Investments 首席投资官 Yung-Shin Kung 表示，展望未来，趋势跟踪基金进入年底的表现可能取决于能源价格和利率。

paras.en: "If September provides any indication, we're at a point where linkages between the two are now propagating meaningfully into currencies and equity markets as well," he told CNBC via email.
paras.zh: 他通过电子邮件对 CNBC 表示：“如果 9 月份提供了任何迹象，那么我们正处于这样一个时刻，即两者之间的联系正在有意义地传播到货币和股票市场。”

paras.en: "The upshot is that CTAs are generally well positioned to buffer traditional portfolios — but the risk in many CTA books has grown increasingly concentrated."
paras.zh: “结果是，CTA 通常能够很好地缓冲传统投资组合，但许多 CTA 书籍中的风险变得越来越集中。”

articles.title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel-cost spike ahead of midterms

paras.en: President Donald Trump has allowed the use of cheaper red-dyed diesel, typically reserved for farm operations, to be used more broadly in an attempt to bring down record-high fuel costs.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统允许更广泛地使用通常用于农场作业的更便宜的红染柴油，以试图降低创纪录的高燃料成本。

paras.en: Trump signed an executive order Monday evening stateside to temporarily allow truckers and farmers to use red-dyed diesel — which is exempt from highway fuel taxes — and deferred related taxes on the fuel through the end of this year.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一晚上在美国签署了一项行政命令，暂时允许卡车司机和农民使用红染柴油（免除高速公路燃油税），并将相关燃料税推迟到今年年底。

paras.en: The tax-free diesel is typically used by farm equipment, construction machinery, trucks and other off-road vehicles. It is therefore exempt from a 24.4 cent-per-gallon tax applied to diesel fuel sold for highway transportation.
paras.zh: 免税柴油通常用于农用设备、工程机械、卡车和其他越野车辆。因此，用于公路运输的柴油可免征每加仑 24.4 美分的税。

paras.en: Using dyed diesel in vehicles operated on public roads is considered illegal, and could result in fines for tax evasion. But several states this year have relaxed restrictions on the tax-exempt diesel to help Americans cope with surging fuel prices.
paras.zh: 在公共道路上行驶的车辆中使用染色柴油被视为非法，并可能因逃税而被处以罚款。但今年有几个州放宽了对免税柴油的限制，以帮助美国人应对不断上涨的燃油价格。

paras.en: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions triggered by the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran pushed up transportation costs across the country. Americans are spending about $700 million more per day on gas and diesel than they did a year ago, according to Bob McNally, president of Rapidan Energy.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰和伊朗冲突引发的燃料供应中断推高了全国运输成本，9月份美国全国柴油平均价格首次突破每加仑6美元。 Rapidan Energy 总裁鲍勃·麦克纳利 (Bob McNally) 表示，美国人每天在天然气和柴油上的支出比一年前增加了约 7 亿美元。

paras.en: The White House said truckers could save more than $100 per fill-up.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，卡车司机每次加满油可节省 100 多美元。

paras.en: The order also directed the Treasury Secretary, in consultation with the Department of War, to defer collection of the federal excise tax on highway diesel through the end of 2026, without interest or penalties, according to a fact sheet released by the White House. The Treasury is also directed to "explore pathways to eliminate the obligation to pay the deferred taxes" altogether.
paras.zh: 根据白宫发布的情况说明书，该命令还指示财政部长在与战争部协商后，将公路柴油联邦消费税的征收推迟到 2026 年底，且无需支付利息或罚款。财政部还被指示“探索完全消除缴纳递延税款义务的途径”。

paras.en: The Trump administration cited tight global supply tied to the war in Ukraine and a lack of refining capacity as pushing up diesel prices and household costs. The Group of Seven nations also agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude reserves, after pressure from Trump who had floated a ban on U.S. exports of the fuel.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府称，与乌克兰战争有关的全球供应紧张以及炼油能力的缺乏推高了柴油价格和家庭成本。在特朗普提出禁止美国出口燃料的压力下，七国集团还同意释放 1 亿桶柴油和原油储备。

articles.title: Why the creative brain feeds on movement

paras.en: Luke Borsten, age 38, has been backpacking and making music since childhood. Today the Portland, Ore.–based filmmaker and musician often combines the two by writing music on the trail. Likewise, Amanda McCracken, a 48-year-old, Boulder, Colo.–based runner and author, finds movement essential to her writing practice.
paras.zh: Luke Borsten，38 岁，从小就开始背包旅行和创作音乐。如今，这位来自俄勒冈州波特兰的电影制作人和音乐家经常通过在路上创作音乐来将两者结合起来。同样，48 岁的科罗拉多州博尔德市跑步者兼作家阿曼达·麦克拉肯 (Amanda McCracken) 发现运动对她的写作练习至关重要。

paras.en: “There’s something in movement that allows me to better see the things I want to describe,” Borsten says. “There’s an underlying feeling of honesty that creates a through line for writing.”
paras.zh: “运动中的某些东西可以让我更好地看到我想要描述的事物，”博尔斯滕说。 “有一种潜在的诚实感为写作创造了一条贯穿的路线。”

paras.en: Borsten and McCracken are not unique in their habit of combining creativity with movement: from Ludwig van Beethoven to Henry David Thoreau, from Maya Angelou to Joyce Carol Oates, creative people are often in motion. And there’s solid science to back up that approach: consistent movement—especially in nature—helps unlock the words, notes or brushstrokes that make artists’ work.
paras.zh: 博尔斯滕和麦克拉肯将创造力与运动相结合的习惯并不是独一无二的：从路德维希·范·贝多芬到亨利·大卫·梭罗，从玛雅·安吉卢到乔伊斯·卡罗尔·奥茨，富有创造力的人经常处于运动状态。有坚实的科学支持这种方法：一致的运动——尤其是在自然界中——有助于释放艺术家作品中的文字、音符或笔触。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Christian Rominger, a researcher in the department of psychology at the University of Graz in Austria, has spent years studying the link between creativity and movement. In 2022 he led a meta-analysis of 115 effect studies that found a link between motion and creativity. Another 2024 study found that the more movement—in terms of step count—participants engaged in, the greater the creative output they had.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂安·罗明格（Christian Romeger）是奥地利格拉茨大学心理学系的研究员，多年来一直在研究创造力与运动之间的联系。 2022 年，他领导了对 115 项效果研究的荟萃分析，发现运动和创造力之间存在联系。另一项 2024 年的研究发现，参与者参与的运动（以步数计算）越多，他们的创意产出就越大。

paras.en: “The empirical data is growing in this field,” he says. “We’re trying to capture this effect in detail.”
paras.zh: “这个领域的经验数据正在增长，”他说。 “我们正试图详细捕捉这种效应。”

paras.en: David Strayer, a professor of cognition and neural science at the University of Utah, co-authored a 2025 study that investigated how movement in nature influences brain activity. “We took measurements at the trail head, before and after hiking and backpacking trips,” he says. “We found a big boost in creativity after.”
paras.zh: 犹他大学认知和神经科学教授 David Strayer 与人合着了 2025 年的一项研究，调查自然运动如何影响大脑活动。 “我们在远足和背包旅行之前和之后在步道起点进行了测量，”他说。 “之后我们发现创造力有了很大的提升。”

paras.en: Still, scientists have yet to identify exactly why movement seems to spur greater creative thinking. But there are several hypotheses. “We believe that all our multitasking on a daily basis overloads our mental workspace,” Strayer says. “Time moving outside frees up space to create.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，科学家们还没有确切地弄清楚为什么运动似乎能激发更大的创造性思维。但有几个假设。 “我们相信，我们每天的多任务处理会让我们的精神工作空间超负荷，”斯特雷耶说。 “时间移到外面可以腾出空间来创造。”

paras.en: Another working theory is that movement often boosts mood, Rominger says, and that, in turn, allows you to create. “We know that creativity is related to mood,” he says, “but we can’t definitively tie the two together. It may also be that physical activity enhances brain health and therefore creativity. But these are all theories right now.”
paras.zh: 罗明格说，另一个有效的理论是，运动通常会提升情绪，而这反过来又可以让你创造。 “我们知道创造力与情绪有关，”他说，“但我们不能明确地将两者联系在一起。体力活动也可能增强大脑健康，从而增强创造力。但目前这些都是理论。”

paras.en: When McCracken encounters writer’s block, she often takes a run or a swim to get the juices flowing again. She makes notes on her phone or on scraps of paper as ideas start popping up. “There’s something about it that shakes things loose,” McCracken says.
paras.zh: 当麦克拉肯遇到写作障碍时，她经常跑步或游泳来恢​​复精力。当想法开始出现时，她会在手机或纸片上做笔记。 “它有一些东西可以让事情变得松散，”麦克拉肯说。

paras.en: There is no clear optimal dose of movement that is guaranteed to boost creativity, but Strayer says that cognitive benefits appear to begin after about three sessions per week of 30 to 60 minutes of activity. “You start to develop new neurons at that dosage,” he says. “You think more clearly and have the mental space to support creative thinking.”
paras.zh: 目前还没有明确的最佳运动剂量可以保证提高创造力，但 Strayer 表示，每周进行 3 次 30 至 60 分钟的活动后，认知能力似乎就会开始受益。 “在这个剂量下，你开始发育出新的神经元，”他说。 “你的思维更加清晰，并且有足够的心理空间来支持创造性思维。”

paras.en: While the research is still nascent, McCracken is unequivocal. “Some of my best ideas have come during movement,” she says.
paras.zh: 虽然这项研究仍处于起步阶段，但麦克拉肯的态度很明确。 “我的一些最好的想法是在运动中产生的，”她说。

articles.title: Astronomers catch dwarf stars gobbling up their orbiting companions

paras.en: As far as fairytales go, dwarfs can be Bashful, Sleepy, Grumpy or Dopey. But in space, dwarfs might be better called Hungry, according to a pair of studies published Monday in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 就童话故事而言，小矮人可以是害羞的、困倦的、脾气暴躁的或糊涂的。但根据周一发表在《自然天文学》上的两项研究，在太空中，矮星可能更适合被称为“饥饿”。

paras.en: These are dwarf stars, of course. Some dwarf stars are small, dim stars that can be orbited by other dwarf stars or planets. Our own sun is a yellow dwarf star; other types include orange and red dwarfs. White, brown and (if proven to exist) blue dwarfs are the dead remnants of stars or failed stars. Understanding these stars and their remains is key to unlocking the history of galaxies—and planets.
paras.zh: 当然，这些是矮星。一些矮星是小而昏暗的恒星，可以由其他矮星或行星围绕其运行。我们的太阳是一颗黄矮星；其他类型包括橙矮星和红矮星。白矮星、棕矮星和（如果被证明存在的话）蓝矮星是恒星或失败恒星的死亡残余物。了解这些恒星及其遗迹是解开星系和行星历史的关键。

paras.en: In the new research, scientists describe two dwarf stars—one red dwarf and one white dwarf—seemingly acting out: eating the objects that orbit them.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，科学家描述了两颗矮星——一颗红矮星和一颗白矮星——似乎正在做出反应：吃掉围绕它们运行的​​物体。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The observations “seek to understand the effect stars have on the planets that they host,” says Jamie Williams, lead author of one of the studies and a Ph.D. student at the University of Warwick in England.
paras.zh: 其中一项研究的主要作者、该研究的博士杰米·威廉姆斯 (Jamie Williams) 表示，这些观测“旨在了解恒星对其所在行星的影响”。英国华威大学的学生。

paras.en: “The key takeaway is that planets don’t exist in isolation, but their evolution is directly tied to the star they orbit,” he says. “In order to understand the life of planets, we must understand star-planet interactions.”
paras.zh: “关键的一点是，行星并不是孤立存在的，但它们的演化与它们绕轨道运行的恒星直接相关，”他说。 “为了了解行星的生命，我们必须了解恒星与行星的相互作用。”

paras.en: Williams and his colleagues observed a white dwarf that showed some unusual chemical signatures, including zinc, copper and niobium. At the same time, the star’s brightness seemed to dim periodically, suggesting an orbiting planet. Together, the results suggest the planet formed after the star had died and that its atmosphere is now feeding the white dwarf.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯和他的同事观察到一颗白矮星显示出一些不寻常的化学特征，包括锌、铜和铌。与此同时，恒星的亮度似乎周期性变暗，表明存在一颗绕轨道运行的行星。总之，这些结果表明这颗行星是在恒星死亡后形成的，并且它的大气层现在正在为白矮星提供养分。

paras.en: The finding suggests “planetary systems can experience a rebirth,” a phenomenon astronomers haven’t observed in our solar system before, Williams says.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说，这一发现表明“行星系统可以经历重生”，这是天文学家之前在太阳系中从未观察到的现象。

paras.en: The second study also reveals a never-before-seen interaction: a red dwarf slowly and steadily consuming its orbital object, a brown dwarf. Usually, either a star and its companion mind their own business or the star completely and rapidly devours its neighbor. In this system, material seems to be flowing from the brown dwarf to the red dwarf in a process that could continue for millions of years.
paras.zh: 第二项研究还揭示了一种前所未见的相互作用：一颗红矮星缓慢而稳定地吞噬其轨道物体——一颗褐矮星。通常情况下，要么恒星及其伴星各管各的，要么恒星完全而迅速地吞噬它的邻居。在这个系统中，物质似乎从棕矮星流向红矮星，这个过程可能会持续数百万年。

paras.en: The discovery was “a happy accident,” says Aaron Householder, lead author of that study and a graduate student at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Now that the team has observed this, Householder adds, he’s curious what else is out there.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、麻省理工学院的研究生亚伦·豪斯霍尔德（Aaron Householder）表示，这一发现是“一次令人高兴的意外”。 Householder 补充道，现在团队已经观察到了这一点，他很好奇外面还有什么。

paras.en: “We’re excited to see if we can find a star eating a planet or maybe even two planets eating each other—different types of combinations of these objects,” he says.
paras.zh: “我们很高兴看到是否能找到一颗恒星吞噬一颗行星，甚至可能是两颗行星互相吞噬——这些物体的不同类型的组合，”他说。

paras.en: Both studies have implications for our own planet. A second-generation planet could theoretically form after our own sun dies, Williams says. Meanwhile, Householder’s research suggests that rather than make a quick and fiery meal of Earth, the sun might one day nibble away at our atmosphere.
paras.zh: 这两项研究对我们自己的星球都有影响。威廉姆斯说，理论上，第二代行星可能会在我们的太阳死亡后形成。与此同时，豪斯霍尔德的研究表明，太阳有一天可能会蚕食我们的大气层，而不是快速而炽热地吞噬地球。

articles.title: United Arab Emirates to launch spacecraft to probe seven asteroids in 2028

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is expanding its space footprint with plans to launch a probe to the further reaches of the solar system.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）正在扩大其太空足迹，计划向太阳系更深处发射探测器。

paras.en: The MBR Explorer, which is set to launch in March 2028, will visit seven different asteroids in the main asteroid belt, which lies between Mars and Jupiter. The spacecraft, which is designed to be fully autonomous, will first perform a flyby of Venus in mid-2028 and a flyby of Earth in spring 2029 to put it on course to the asteroid belt.
paras.zh: MBR 探索者号定于 2028 年 3 月发射，将访问位于火星和木星之间的主小行星带中的七颗不同的小行星。这艘被设计为完全自主的航天器将首先于 2028 年年中飞越金星，并于 2029 年春季飞越地球，将其送入小行星带。

paras.en: One at the main belt, the spacecraft will visit asteroids 10253 Westerwald, 623 Chimaera, 13294 Rockox—then a flyby of Mars—before visiting 88055 Ghaf, 23871 Ousha and 59980 Moza. The final destination, expected to be reached in 2034, is 269 Justitia, an asteroid in the middle main asteroid belt, some 200 million miles from Earth.
paras.zh: 其中一颗位于主带，航天器将访问小行星 10253 Westerwald、623 Chimaera、13294 Rockox（然后飞越火星），然后访问 88055 Ghaf、23871 Ousha 和 59980 Moza。预计将于 2034 年到达的最终目的地是 269 Justitia，这是一颗位于主小行星带中部的小行星，距离地球约 2 亿英里。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Once there, the MBR Explorer will orbit 269 Justitia for seven months before releasing a lander that will attempt to touch down on the space rock to analyze its composition. The asteroid is believed to have formed in the Kuiper Belt, beyond the orbit of Neptune, and could offer clues as to how water and other organic materials were distributed in the early solar system as the planets began to form.
paras.zh: 一旦到达那里，MBR 探测器将围绕 269 Justitia 运行七个月，然后释放一个着陆器，尝试着陆这颗太空岩石以分析其成分。这颗小行星被认为是在海王星轨道之外的柯伊伯带形成的，可以提供有关当行星开始形成时水和其他有机物质在早期太阳系中如何分布的线索。

paras.en: The UAE is among the nations jockeying to carve out room in the space race between the U.S. and China. In 2020, for example, the country launched a probe that entered orbit around Mars in 2021.
paras.zh: 阿联酋是力争在中美太空竞赛中占据一席之地的国家之一。例如，该国在2020年发射了一颗探测器，并于2021年进入绕火星轨道。

paras.en: The expansion of its space program is also reflective of the country's desire to be less reliant on fossil fuels, which are the UAE’s largest export.
paras.zh: 其太空计划的扩张也反映了该国希望减少对化石燃料的依赖，而化石燃料是阿联酋最大的出口产品。

paras.en: On Sunday royal family member Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum, defense minister and chairman of the UAE’s Supreme Space Council, said on X that the country’s space sector is currently valued at roughly $12 billion and that the country aims to become one of the world’s top 10 space economies by 2031.
paras.zh: 周日，王室成员、国防部长兼阿联酋最高航天委员会主席哈姆丹·本·穆罕默德·阿勒马克图姆在 X 上表示，该国航天部门目前价值约为 120 亿美元，该国的目标是到 2031 年成为世界十大航天经济体之一。

articles.title: Astronomers say they’ve spotted the first miniature quasar pointed at Earth
articles.author: Meghan Bartels

paras.en: Astronomers may have spotted a fun-sized version of one of the brightest and most mysterious cosmic objects. An elusive microblazar, a scaled-down form of the giant, ravenous black holes that haunt the distant universe, seems to have cropped up in our own Milky Way galaxy.
paras.zh: 天文学家可能已经发现了最亮、最神秘的宇宙物体之一的有趣大小的版本。一种难以捉摸的微耀斑，是徘徊在遥远宇宙中的巨大、贪婪的黑洞的缩小版，似乎出现在我们的银河系中。

paras.en: Even more intriguingly, the exotic object may explain the longstanding mystery of how some of the highest-energy particles in the universe came to be, researchers report in a forthcoming paper in Astronomy & Astrophysics.
paras.zh: 更有趣的是，研究人员在《天文学与天体物理学》即将发表的一篇论文中报告说，这个奇异的物体可能解释了宇宙中一些最高能量粒子是如何形成的长期谜团。

paras.en: Blazars are a particular form of quasars, supermassive black holes whose gravity pulls surrounding material into a whirling disk. In this extreme environment, the quasar flings superheated material out in a pair of jets like the axle of a wheel. A blazar is any quasar that points one of its jets approximately toward Earth.
paras.zh: 耀变体是类星体的一种特殊形式，是一种超大质量黑洞，其重力将周围的物质拉入旋转的圆盘中。在这种极端环境中，类星体像轮轴一样将过热的物质以一对射流的形式喷射出来。耀变体是指其喷流大致指向地球的任何类星体。
