paras.en: Astronomers haven’t found quasars or blazars anywhere near Earth, but for nearly 35 years they have hunted for miniature ones in the Milky Way. Such a microquasar consists of a small black hole devouring a large star and sending jets of material spewing out into space. Because they are so much smaller than quasars, material falls into them faster than their massive counterparts.
paras.zh: 天文学家尚未在地球附近发现类星体或耀变体，但近 35 年来他们一直在银河系中寻找微型类星体或耀变体。这样的微类星体由一个小黑洞组成，该黑洞吞噬了一颗大恒星并将物质喷射到太空中。因为它们比类星体小得多，所以物质落入它们的速度比类星体大。

paras.en: “What takes days or weeks to change in a microblazar would take thousands of years in a supermassive blazar,” says astrophysicist Pedro Luque-Escamilla of the University of Jaén in Spain. “It’s a perfect scale model where we can watch a ‘cosmic movie’ in fast-forward.”
paras.zh: 西班牙哈恩大学的天体物理学家佩德罗·卢克·埃斯卡米拉说：“在微耀变体中需要几天或几周才能发生的变化，在超大质量耀变体中则需要数千年的时间。” “这是一个完美的比例模型，我们可以快进地观看一部‘宇宙电影’。”

paras.en: Luque-Escamilla and his colleague Josep Martí have spent two decades hunting for these hyperactive objects in archival telescope data, with little success. “We found many candidates in the past,” Martí says. “They turned out to be extragalactic objects,” full-sized and slower-changing.
paras.zh: 卢克-埃斯卡米拉和他的同事何塞普·马蒂花了二十年的时间在档案望远镜数据中寻找这些异常活跃的天体，但收效甚微。 “我们过去找到了很多候选人，”马蒂说。 “它们原来是河外天体”，尺寸真实且变化缓慢。

paras.en: The pair’s luck changed as they pored over a 1983 catalog produced by a Dutch-American spacecraft and spotted an object referred to as IRAS 18293−0941. When Martí and his colleague cross-referenced this catalog with modern observations by radio telescopes, they saw a small but very bright emission with additional light coming from only one side. That’s “the fingerprint of blazars,” Martí says.
paras.zh: 当他们仔细研究由荷兰-美国航天器制作的 1983 年目录并发现一个名为 IRAS 18293−0941 的物体时，他们的运气发生了变化。当马蒂和他的同事将这个星表与现代射电望远镜的观测结果进行交叉引用时，他们看到了一种微小但非常明亮的发射，并且仅从一侧发出了额外的光。马蒂说，这就是“耀变体的指纹”。

paras.en: The researchers assumed that, like their previous candidates, IRAS 18293−0941 was a full-sized blazar from beyond the Milky Way. But they were intrigued enough to keep investigating. The team ultimately used data from three different observatories on Earth and in space to pinpoint the location as inside our galaxy after all.
paras.zh: 研究人员假设，与之前的候选者一样，IRAS 18293−0941 是来自银河系以外的全尺寸耀变体。但他们对此很感兴趣，继续调查。该团队最终使用了来自地球和太空三个不同天文台的数据来确定该位置毕竟在我们的银河系内部。

paras.en: “The authors took a truly multi-wavelength approach, making use of all different types of astrophysical data from many telescopes,” says astrophysicist Alexandra Tetarenko of the University of Lethbridge in Canada, who was not involved in the new research. “This is not only what distinguishes this work from past claims on other microblazar candidates but also makes it far more convincing.”
paras.zh: “作者采用了真正的多波长方法，利用了来自许多望远镜的所有不同类型的天体物理数据，”加拿大莱斯布里奇大学的天体物理学家亚历山德拉·泰塔伦科（Alexandra Tetarenko）说道，她没有参与这项新研究。 “这不仅是这项工作与过去对其他微火体候选者的主张的区别，而且也使其更具说服力。”

paras.en: The scientists also noticed that IRAS 18293−0941 was quite near a known patch of ultrahigh energy particles — particles with energy 100 times higher than the Large Hadron Collider can create, that scientists have struggled to explain what could juice them up to such extremes.
paras.zh: 科学家们还注意到，IRAS 18293−0941 非常接近一片已知的超高能粒子——能量比大型强子对撞机产生的能量高 100 倍，科学家们一直在努力解释是什么让它们达到如此极端的水平。

paras.en: Martí and his colleagues argue this isn’t a coincidence: the “hotspot” marks where the microblazar’s invisible jet pointing away from Earth slams into a cloud of matter, acting as a massive particle accelerator. The team is already working to gather additional observations of the proposed hotspot.
paras.zh: 马蒂和他的同事认为这并非巧合：“热点”标志着微耀体的不可见射流远离地球撞击物质云，充当了一个巨大的粒子加速器。该团队已经在努力收集对拟议热点的更多观察结果。

paras.en: The hotspot observations, as well as observations of the visible jet, should both give scientists a better understanding of the microblazar’s dramatic capacities, Luque-Escamilla says, as if the universe made a special particle accelerator just for scientists. “It’s like comparing a high-tech human laboratory to a supreme cosmic engine,” he says.
paras.zh: 卢克-埃斯卡米拉说，热点观测以及可见射流观测都应该让科学家更好地了解微耀体的巨大能力，就好像宇宙专门为科学家制造了一个特殊的粒子加速器一样。 “这就像将高科技人类实验室与至高无上的宇宙引擎进行比较，”他说。

articles.title: A ‘phoenix’ planet was born from the ashes of its dead star
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: A dead star’s wreckage may be the birthplace of a new planet.
paras.zh: 一颗死亡恒星的残骸可能是一颗新行星的诞生地。

paras.en: The existence of second-generation planets was predicted theoretically more than 15 years ago. But this “phoenix” world, if confirmed, would be the first actually spotted, scientists report October 5 in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 15 多年前，理论上就预测了第二代行星的存在。但科学家 10 月 5 日在《自然天文学》杂志上报道称，这个“凤凰”世界如果得到证实，将是第一个真正被发现的世界。

paras.en: “A phoenix is reborn from the ashes of its predecessor, and this planet is formed from the ashes of the star,” says astronomer Jamie Williams, of the University of Warwick in Coventry, England.
paras.zh: 英国考文垂华威大学的天文学家杰米·威廉姆斯说：“凤凰从其前身的灰烬中重生，而这颗行星是由恒星的灰烬形成的。”

paras.en: The finding suggests planetary systems can have a second life even after their stars die.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，即使恒星死亡后，行星系统也可以拥有第二次生命。

paras.en: Before this discovery, this planet formation process has been “more like a hypothesis, more like speculation,” says planetary scientist Zifan Lin of Washington University in St. Louis, who was not involved in the new work. “This is the first time we’ve seen evidence for that process.”
paras.zh: 没有参与这项新工作的圣路易斯华盛顿大学行星科学家林子凡说，在这一发现之前，这个行星的形成过程“更像是一个假设，更像是猜测”。 “这是我们第一次看到该过程的证据。”

paras.en: Williams and colleagues found signs of the planet in the atmosphere of a white dwarf called HS 0209+0832. White dwarfs are the small, dense cores left behind after low-mass stars — like our sun — puff up into red giant stars at the end of their lives, ultimately blowing all the outer material away.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯和同事在一颗名为 HS 0209+0832 的白矮星的大气层中发现了这颗行星的迹象。白矮星是低质量恒星（比如我们的太阳）在生命结束时膨胀成红巨星后留下的小而致密的核心，最终将所有外部物质吹走。

paras.en: These stellar corpses are so dense that most chemical elements sink into their centers, leaving them with pristine atmospheres composed of almost entirely hydrogen and helium. But astronomers have found that between a quarter and half of these stars are “polluted” with elements like silicon and iron, which are found in rock.
paras.zh: 这些恒星尸体的密度如此之大，以至于大多数化学元素都会沉入它们的中心，从而使它们拥有几乎完全由氢和氦组成的原始大气。但天文学家发现，这些恒星中有四分之一到一半受到岩石中硅和铁等元素的“污染”。

paras.en: These elements probably come from shattered planets that the star devoured as it expanded. “They can be probes into the interiors of planets,” Lin says. Astronomers have also found whole planets that seem to have survived their stars’ demise and still orbit the remaining white dwarf. Ironically, some astronomers think these dead stars could be prime hunting grounds for signs of extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 这些元素可能来自恒星膨胀时吞噬的破碎行星。 “它们可以探测行星的内部，”林说。天文学家还发现了整颗行星似乎在恒星消亡后幸存下来，并且仍然绕着剩余的白矮星运行。具有讽刺意味的是，一些天文学家认为这些死亡恒星可能是寻找外星生命迹象的主要狩猎场。

paras.en: HS 0209+0832 was a known weirdo. When the Hubble Space Telescope observed it in 1999, astronomers could tell that the white dwarf contained a mysterious mix of chemicals, but they couldn’t identify them. Since then, there have been more detailed studies of how certain atoms would show up in stellar atmospheres, Williams says.
paras.zh: HS 0209+0832 是一个众所周知的怪人。当哈勃太空望远镜在 1999 年观测它时，天文学家可以看出这颗白矮星含有一种神秘的化学物质混合物，但他们无法识别它们。威廉姆斯说，从那时起，人们对某些原子如何在恒星大气中出现进行了更详细的研究。

paras.en: Reanalyzing those observations showed that the white dwarf contains only trace amounts of silicon and almost no iron, Williams and colleagues found. But it does include a ridiculous amount of niobium. This hard, silvery metal, used in jewelry, rocket systems and superconductors, is rare on Earth and had never been seen in a white dwarf.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯和同事发现，重新分析这些观测结果表明，白矮星仅含有微量的硅，几乎不含铁。但它确实含有大量的铌。这种坚硬的银色金属用于珠宝、火箭系统和超导体，在地球上很罕见，而且从未在白矮星中见过。

paras.en: “We’ve never observed anything in the universe that’s this niobium-rich before,” Williams says. “We were quite confused at first.”
paras.zh: “我们以前从未在宇宙中观察到任何富含铌的物质，”威廉姆斯说。 “一开始我们很困惑。”

paras.en: A clue to how it got there came from the element’s origins. Niobium forms in the slow neutron-capture process, or s-process, which mostly occurs in certain red giant stars as they shed their atmospheres and die. Iron nuclei transform into heavier elements in a series of accretion and decay that can take thousands of years.
paras.zh: 关于它是如何到达那里的线索来自该元素的起源。铌是在缓慢的中子俘获过程（即 s 过程）中形成的，该过程主要发生在某些红巨星脱离大气层并死亡时。铁核通过一系列吸积和衰变转变为更重的元素，这可能需要数千年的时间。

paras.en: Material ejected from a dying star could have coalesced into a new planet full of s-process elements, Williams says. Then the resulting white dwarf could slowly sip on the new planet’s atmosphere, leaving a fresh coat of niobium and other s-process elements on the white dwarf’s face.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说，从垂死恒星中喷出的物质可能会凝聚成一颗充满s过程元素的新行星。然后产生的白矮星可以慢慢地吸收新行星的大气层，在白矮星的表面留下一层新鲜的铌和其他s过程元素。

paras.en: To support this idea, the team looked at observations of HS 0209+0832 taken with the TESS space telescope, which hunts exoplanets by observing small changes in the light of their stars as planets orbit. The white dwarf’s brightness changes with a period of about 4.4 days, the team found. That’s too slow to be related to the white dwarf’s own rotation.
paras.zh: 为了支持这个想法，研究小组研究了 TESS 太空望远镜对 HS 0209+0832 的观测结果，该望远镜通过观察行星绕轨道运行时恒星光线的微小变化来寻找系外行星。研究小组发现，白矮星的亮度变化周期约为 4.4 天。这太慢了，与白矮星自身的自转无关。

paras.en: But it could be explained by a gas giant planet orbiting very close to the star, about 4 percent the distance from the Earth to the sun or 6 million kilometers. Williams imagines it as a silvery version of Jupiter.
paras.zh: 但这可以用一颗气态巨行星的轨道距离恒星非常近来解释，大约是地球到太阳距离的 4%，即 600 万公里。威廉姆斯将其想象为银色版本的木星。

paras.en: “We’re not really sure, if it’s not a planet, what it is,” he says. “A planet is the most reasonable explanation.”
paras.zh: “我们不太确定，如果它不是行星，那它是什么，”他说。 “行星是最合理的解释。”

paras.en: Our sun will one day meet the same fate as HS 0209+0832’s predecessor. We don’t know enough about second-generation planets yet to say whether our solar system could end up with one after the sun dies, Williams says. “But I think it’s definitely possible.”
paras.zh: 我们的太阳总有一天会遭遇与 HS 0209+0832 的前身相同的命运。威廉姆斯说，我们对第二代行星的了解还不够，还无法确定太阳系是否会在太阳死亡后出现一颗行星。 “但我认为这绝对是可能的。”

articles.title: Scientists may have seen dark matter. If they did, what exactly is it?
articles.author: Emily Conover

paras.en: If a recent hint of dark matter is real, it would rewrite physics. Scientists are already trying to read the outline of that new story’s plot. And that’s reignited interest in certain theories, including a long-beloved but increasingly sidelined concept called supersymmetry.
paras.zh: 如果最近关于暗物质的暗示是真实的，它将改写物理学。科学家们已经在尝试解读这个新故事情节的轮廓。这重新点燃了人们对某些理论的兴趣，其中包括一个长期受人们喜爱但日益被边缘化的概念，即超对称性。

paras.en: Dark matter is imperceptibly everywhere, an unidentified type of particle pervading the universe but evident based only on its gravitational effects on galaxies and other cosmic entities. On September 1, scientists with the LUX-ZEPLIN, or LZ, collaboration announced they’d seen a signal in their detector that could have been caused by a single particle of dark matter — though it could still be just a blip caused by known physics processes.
paras.zh: 暗物质无处不在，是一种无法识别的粒子，遍布宇宙，但仅根据其对星系和其他宇宙实体的引力效应而显而易见。 9 月 1 日，LUX-ZEPLIN（或 LZ）合作的科学家们宣布，他们在探测器中看到了一个信号，该信号可能是由单个暗物质粒子引起的，尽管它仍然可能只是由已知物理过程引起的一个信号。

paras.en: In the weeks since the detection, dozens of papers have been posted on arXiv.org purporting to explain what LZ saw. Much interest has focused on a theorized type of particle called a higgsino. If the idea is correct, it would be big. “If we discover it, it would be the first discovery of supersymmetry,” says theoretical physicist Harikrishnan Ramani of the University of Delaware in Newark.
paras.zh: 自检测以来的几周内，arXiv.org 上发布了数十篇论文，旨在解释 LZ 所看到的情况。许多兴趣集中在一种称为希格斯诺的理论粒子类型上。如果这个想法是正确的，那就很大了。 “如果我们发现它，这将是超对称性的首次发现，”纽瓦克特拉华大学的理论物理学家哈里克里希南·拉马尼 (Harikrishnan Ramani) 说。

paras.en: Supersymmetry proposes that for each known particle, there exists a heavier counterpart called a superpartner. It’s an idea that could solve multiple physics puzzles at once, so it has attracted a devoted following of physicists.
paras.zh: 超对称性提出，对于每个已知粒子，都存在一个更重的对应粒子，称为超级伙伴。这是一个可以同时解决多个物理难题的想法，因此吸引了物理学家的忠实追随者。

paras.en: One of these hypothetical superpartners, such as the higgsino, could be dark matter. The higgsino is the superpartner of the Higgs boson — a particle discovered in 2012 that explains the origin of mass. “If you asked people in the year 2000, ‘What’s your favorite dark matter candidate?’ probably a lot of people would already have said the higgsino then,” says theoretical physicist Tracy Slatyer of MIT.
paras.zh: 这些假设的超级伙伴之一，例如希格斯诺，可能是暗物质。希格斯诺子是希格斯玻色子的超级伙伴，希格斯玻色子是 2012 年发现的一种粒子，可以解释质量的起源。 “如果你在 2000 年问人们，‘你最喜欢的暗物质候选者是什么？’当时可能很多人都会说希格斯诺，”麻省理工学院的理论物理学家 Tracy Slatyer 说道。

paras.en: In recent years, supersymmetry’s popularity has waned, as particle colliders failed to find evidence for it. But as an explanation for LZ’s dark matter hint, a higgsino seems plausible — at least at first glance. “It comes pretty close to working,” Slatyer says.
paras.zh: 近年来，超对称性的受欢迎程度有所下降，因为粒子对撞机未能找到它的证据。但作为对 LZ 暗物质暗示的解释，希格斯诺似乎是合理的——至少乍一看是这样。 “这已经非常接近工作了，”斯拉蒂尔说。

paras.en: The LZ detector, located at the Sanford Underground Research Facility in Lead, S.D., consists of a large tank of liquid xenon. The detector searches for dark matter speeding through the xenon, crashing into it and sending a xenon atomic nucleus zinging away. That’s expected to be a rare event, since dark matter interacts very weakly with normal matter. In the event LZ found, the nucleus recoiled with particularly high energy. Most types of dark matter would produce low-energy recoils in addition to high-energy ones. But LZ didn’t see any low-energy recoils.
paras.zh: LZ 探测器位于南达科他州利德市的桑福德地下研究设施，由一个大型液氙罐组成。探测器寻找快速穿过氙气的暗物质，撞击氙气原子核并发出轰鸣声。预计这将是一个罕见的事件，因为暗物质与正常物质的相互作用非常微弱。 LZ发现的事件中，原子核以特别高的能量反冲。大多数类型的暗物质除了高能反冲之外还会产生低能反冲。但LZ没有看到任何低能后坐力。

paras.en: If dark matter were a higgsino, that could explain the absence of low-energy events. The higgsino differs from typical dark matter candidates in that it would have two different masses. A collision would happen only if there’s enough energy to bump the higgsino from the lighter to the heavier mass state. That means lower-energy nuclear recoils wouldn’t happen.
paras.zh: 如果暗物质是希格西诺，那就可以解释低能事件的缺失。希格斯诺与典型暗物质候选者的不同之处在于它有两个不同的质量。只有当有足够的能量将希格西诺从较轻的质量状态碰撞到较重的质量状态时，才会发生碰撞。这意味着低能核反冲不会发生。

paras.en: Within a day of LZ’s announcement, several papers on the arXiv put forth the higgsino possibility. “I got pretty excited,” says theoretical physicist Katherine Freese of the University of Texas at Austin, a coauthor of one such paper, which was submitted September 1. “First paper I ever wrote in 24 hours.”
paras.zh: LZ 宣布这一消息的一天之内，arXiv 上的几篇论文就提出了 higgsino 的可能性。 “我非常兴奋，”德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的理论物理学家凯瑟琳·弗里斯 (Katherine Freese) 说道，她是一篇此类论文的合著者，该论文于 9 月 1 日提交。“这是我在 24 小时内写出的第一篇论文。”

paras.en: But further investigation made the higgsino explanation seem less plausible. For example, if higgsinos exist, they would interact in the sun and get trapped there due to its gravitational pull. There, according to the concepts of supersymmetry, they would annihilate one another and produce high-energy particles called neutrinos. Those neutrinos should have been observed by a neutrino detector located at the South Pole, called IceCube, Ramani and a colleague reported September 2 at arXiv.org. But no such neutrinos have been seen.
paras.zh: 但进一步的调查使 higgsino 的解释似乎不太可信。例如，如果希格斯诺子存在，它们会在太阳中相互作用，并由于太阳的引力而被困在那里。在那里，根据超对称的概念，它们会相互湮灭并产生称为中微子的高能粒子。拉马尼和一位同事于 9 月 2 日在 arXiv.org 上报道称，这些中微子应该是由位于南极的中微子探测器 IceCube 观测到的。但还没有看到这样的中微子。

paras.en: And there’s another potential issue. Slatyer and colleagues noticed a plot in an appendix to LZ’s paper that looks at even higher energies. If LZ saw one higgsino at the energy they reported, they’d expect to see even more at these higher energies, the team reported September 3. But LZ didn’t report anything that looked like dark matter at those energies. The LZ detector wasn’t calibrated for those energies, says LZ spokesperson Rick Gaitskell, a physicist at Brown University in Providence, R.I. “We didn’t make any formal claims about detection or even nondetection in that event region,” Gaitskell wrote in a text message. But, if the data are taken seriously, that makes LZ’s event even more difficult to explain with a higgsino.
paras.zh: 还有另一个潜在的问题。 Slatyer 和同事注意到 LZ 论文附录中的一个图表研究了更高的能量。该团队于 9 月 3 日报道称，如果 LZ 在他们报告的能量下看到了一个希格斯诺，他们预计会在这些更高的能量下看到更多的希格斯诺。但 LZ 没有报告任何在这些能量下看起来像暗物质的东西。 LZ 发言人、罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学物理学家 Rick Gaitskell 表示，LZ 探测器并未针对这些能量进行校准。“我们没有就该事件区域的探测甚至未探测到做出任何正式声明，”Gaitskell 在一条短信中写道。但是，如果认真对待这些数据，那么 LZ 的事件就更难用 higgsino 来解释了。

paras.en: Considering all these factors makes the higgsino idea a bit of a stretch. But there’s still a little wiggle room. One possibility is that the higgsino’s mass differs from what theoretical physicists expect it to be, about 1,000 times a proton’s mass. That large mass is chosen to allow higgsinos to explain the amount of dark matter seen in the universe today. So changing it complicates the picture, but could make it align better with what LZ saw.
paras.zh: 考虑到所有这些因素，higgsino 的想法有点牵强。但仍有一点回旋余地。一种可能性是希格斯诺的质量与理论物理学家的预期不同，约为质子质量的 1000 倍。选择如此大的质量是为了让希格西诺能够解释当今宇宙中所看到的暗物质的数量。所以改变它会让图片变得复杂，但可以让它更好地符合LZ所看到的。

paras.en: Additional wiggle room comes from the possible speeds of the dark matter particles in the Milky Way. The particles might reach higher velocities than typically assumed, and that could make the data easier to explain. For a faster higgsino to have shown up in LZ, it would require a larger difference in the two masses of the particle. The resulting bigger energy difference means higgsinos have fewer opportunities to produce neutrinos in the sun, explaining why neutrino experiments haven’t seen those particles.
paras.zh: 额外的回旋空间来自银河系中暗物质粒子的可能速度。粒子可能达到比通常假设的更高的速度，这可以使数据更容易解释。为了在 LZ 中出现更快的希格斯诺，粒子的两个质量之间需要有更大的差异。由此产生的更大的能量差异意味着希格斯中子在太阳中产生中微子的机会更少，这解释了为什么中微子实验没有看到这些粒子。

paras.en: By playing around with those factors, it’s still possible to make the higgsino explanation work, Freese says. Higgsinos with around 2,000 times a proton’s mass could do the trick, Freese and a coauthor report in an October 2 arXiv paper. “Big picture: We love [the] higgsino, and what we’re doing now is putting in the details that we think are important,” she says.
paras.zh: 弗里斯说，通过研究这些因素，希格斯诺的解释仍然有可能成立。 Freese 和一位合著者在 10 月 2 日的 arXiv 论文中报告称，质量约为质子 2000 倍的希格斯诺子可以做到这一点。 “大局观：我们喜欢 higgsino，我们现在正在做的是添加我们认为重要的细节，”她说。

paras.en: But, if it’s not the higgsino, “maybe it’s some other particle with the same basic features,” says theoretical physicist Dan Hooper of the University of Wisconsin–Madison. Such particles wouldn’t be subject to the constraints supersymmetry imposes. For example, if the particles collect in the sun, they wouldn’t necessarily create neutrinos, so it doesn’t matter that IceCube doesn’t see them. Hooper and colleagues investigated the possibilities in a paper submitted September 10 to arXiv.org. And in a September 22 arXiv paper, Hooper and colleagues proposed a version of a different class of dark matter particle that could explain two puzzles in one: LZ’s result and mysterious gamma rays, high-energy light, seen coming from the center of the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 但是，如果它不是希格斯诺，“也许它是具有相同基本特征的其他粒子，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的理论物理学家丹·胡珀说。这样的粒子不会受到超对称性施加的约束。例如，如果粒子在阳光下聚集，它们不一定会产生中微子，所以 IceCube 看不见它们并不重要。 Hooper 和同事在 9 月 10 日提交给 arXiv.org 的一篇论文中研究了这种可能性。在 9 月 22 日的 arXiv 论文中，胡珀和同事提出了一种不同类别的暗物质粒子的版本，它可以同时解释两个谜题：LZ 的结果和神秘的伽马射线，即来自银河系中心的高能光。

paras.en: Other physicists are looking at entirely different ideas, involving hypothesized types of particles such as dark photons. Meanwhile, scientists are eagerly awaiting new results from LZ, to see if additional data hide similar events.
paras.zh: 其他物理学家正在研究完全不同的想法，涉及假设的粒子类型，例如暗光子。与此同时，科学家们正在热切地等待 LZ 的新结果，看看更多的数据是否隐藏了类似的事件。

paras.en: Other dark matter experiments, such as XENONnT at Gran Sasso National Laboratory in Italy, are also taking a look, combing through their existing data to check for high-energy events. LZ’s result “clearly requires a cross-check,” says XENONnT spokesperson Elena Aprile, a physicist at Columbia University.
paras.zh: 其他暗物质实验，例如意大利格兰萨索国家实验室的 XENONnT 实验，也在进行研究，梳理现有数据以检查高能事件。 XENONnT 发言人、哥伦比亚大学物理学家 Elena Aprile 表示，LZ 的结果“显然需要交叉检查”。

paras.en: Even if the result isn’t a slam-dunk for the higgsino — and even though this might not be dark matter at all — scientists are enjoying exploring the possibilities. “I think it’s wrong to throw tantrums over the fact that it’s not the higgsino the way we want it to be,” Ramani says. “Nature might not give us everything we want in one go.”
paras.zh: 即使结果并不是希格西诺的成功——即使这可能根本不是暗物质——科学家们也正在享受探索这种可能性的乐趣。 “我认为，因为希格斯诺不是我们想要的样子而发脾气是错误的，”拉马尼说。 “大自然可能不会一次性给我们想要的一切。”

articles.title: Anesthesia Is 180 Years Old And Still a Mystery. A Study of 6 Animal Brains May Have Found Its Common Thread.
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Every day, thousands of people are put under general anesthesia as a routine part of surgery.
paras.zh: 每天，成千上万的人接受全身麻醉作为手术的常规部分。

paras.en: Ever since the first public demonstration of surgery under general anesthesia in 1846, these drugs have allowed doctors to perform life-saving operations that would otherwise be impossible.
paras.zh: 自从 1846 年首次公开演示全身麻醉下的手术以来，这些药物使医生能够进行本来不可能进行的挽救生命的手术。

paras.en: And yet we still don't fully understand exactly how they send us into oblivion without totally shutting down our brains.
paras.zh: 然而我们仍然不完全理解它们是如何在不完全关闭我们大脑的情况下让我们陷入遗忘状态的。

paras.en: A new study published in Nature Neuroscience brings us a bit closer to understanding the mechanisms that allow general anesthesia drugs to suspend our consciousness temporarily.
paras.zh: 发表在《自然神经科学》上的一项新研究使我们更接近于了解全身麻醉药物暂时中止我们意识的机制。

paras.en: It compares the medicine's effects across a range of animals, from worms to fish to humans.
paras.zh: 它比较了药物对一系列动物的作用，从蠕虫到鱼类再到人类。

paras.en: It seems no living thing is impervious to general anesthesia's effects, not even plants or paramecia.
paras.zh: 似乎没有生物能不受全身麻醉的影响，甚至植物或草履虫也不例外。

paras.en: This suggests there's something universal in the bodies of living things that this class of drugs is acting on.
paras.zh: 这表明这类药物在生物体中存在某种普遍存在的作用。

paras.en: To test that idea, a team led by neuroscientist Andrea Luppi of the University of Oxford examined the neural activity of six vastly different kinds of animals when they were awake versus under general anesthesia.
paras.zh: 为了验证这个想法，由牛津大学神经科学家安德里亚·卢皮 (Andrea Luppi) 领导的一个团队检查了六种截然不同的动物在清醒和全身麻醉下的神经活动。

paras.en: "Focusing on effects that are consistently shared across multiple anesthetics and species allows us to exclude physiological or methodological confounds specific to any one drug, species, or imaging modality, and instead triangulate on potential neural underpinnings of what they share: breakdown of responsiveness to the environment," Luppi and team write.
paras.zh: Luppi 和团队写道：“关注多种麻醉剂和物种之间一致共有的效应，使我们能够排除任何一种药物、物种或成像方式特有的生理或方法学混淆，而是对它们共有的潜在神经基础进行三角测量：对环境的反应能力的崩溃。”

paras.en: Their datasets came from humans, macaques, marmosets, mice, zebrafish, and nematodes (roundworms), which, based on when their last common ancestor lived, represent 700 million years of evolution.
paras.zh: 他们的数据集来自人类、猕猴、狨猴、小鼠、斑马鱼和线虫（蛔虫），根据它们最后一个共同祖先的生活时间，这些数据代表了 7 亿年的进化。

paras.en: The drugs used to induce general anesthesia differed depending on the species, but even still, consistent patterns turned up in their brain activity.
paras.zh: 用于诱导全身麻醉的药物因物种而异，但即使如此，它们的大脑活动也出现了一致的模式。

paras.en: In the mammals, neural activity was measured via fMRI, which uses blood flow to approximate which regions of the brain are active over time.
paras.zh: 在哺乳动物中，神经活动是通过功能磁共振成像来测量的，它利用血流来估计大脑的哪些区域随着时间的推移是活跃的。

paras.en: The zebrafish and nematodes were genetically modified so that their firing neurons literally lit up as calcium rushed in, allowing the scientists to see these animals' neural activity more directly.
paras.zh: 斑马鱼和线虫经过基因改造，当钙涌入时，它们的放电神经元就会发光，从而使科学家能够更直接地观察这些动物的神经活动。

paras.en: "Through this unbiased, data-driven approach, we identified an evolutionarily conserved dynamical profile of anesthesia, indicating that what is common across species and anesthetics is not only the behavioral response to anesthesia (isolation from the environment), but also anesthesia's effect on specific features of neural activity," Luppi and team write.
paras.zh: Luppi 和团队写道：“通过这种公正的、数据驱动的方法，我们确定了麻醉的进化保守动态特征，这表明跨物种和麻醉剂的共同点不仅是对麻醉的行为反应（与环境隔离），而且还包括麻醉对神经活动特定特征的影响。”

paras.en: Across all species, neural activity between brain regions became less coordinated when they were under anesthesia, suggesting these regions were still functioning, but not interacting as much as they would when you're awake.
paras.zh: 在所有物种中，大脑区域之间的神经活动在麻醉状态下变得不太协调，这表明这些区域仍在发挥作用，但互动程度不如清醒时那么多。

paras.en: Neural activity also seemed more chaotic over time, with anesthesia appearing to "induce a breakdown in the relationship between past and future of neural activity," the authors explain.
paras.zh: 作者解释说，随着时间的推移，神经活动似乎也变得更加混乱，麻醉似乎“导致神经活动的过去和未来之间的关系崩溃”。

paras.en: When we're awake, our brain activity tends to follow certain sequences: these predictable patterns fell apart under anesthesia.
paras.zh: 当我们醒着的时候，我们的大脑活动往往遵循一定的顺序：这些可预测的模式在麻醉下就会崩溃。

paras.en: The probability of these key differences in brain activity occurring across all six species just by chance is "vanishingly small," according to anesthesiologists George Mashour and Zirui Huang, who were not involved in the study but wrote an accompanying article in Nature Neuroscience's News and Views.
paras.zh: 麻醉学家 George Mashour 和 Zirui Huang 表示，所有六个物种的大脑活动中这些关键差异只是偶然发生的可能性“非常小”，他们没有参与这项研究，但在《自然神经科学》的新闻和观点上撰写了一篇附带文章。

paras.en: "These findings provide compelling support for a final common pathway of anesthesia: spatiotemporal isolation of local neural activity, in which individual circuits lose their ability to sustain, propagate and integrate information across time and space," Mashour and Huang write.
paras.zh: 马舒尔和黄写道：“这些发现为麻醉的最终共同途径提供了令人信服的支持：局部神经活动的时空隔离，其中各个回路失去了跨时间和空间维持、传播和整合信息的能力。”

paras.en: "During anesthesia, consciousness is disrupted not because the brain 'turns off' but rather because its activity becomes temporally and spatially fragmented."
paras.zh: “在麻醉过程中，意识被破坏不是因为大脑‘关闭’，而是因为它的活动在时间和空间上变得支离破碎。”

paras.en: Since this mechanism of oblivion is shared not only by humans, but by animals as distantly related to us as fish and roundworms, these findings may even have implications for our understanding of animal consciousness more broadly.
paras.zh: 由于这种遗忘机制不仅为人类所共有，而且为与我们关系较远的动物如鱼和蛔虫所共有，这些发现甚至可能对我们更广泛地理解动物意识产生影响。

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Neuroscience.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然神经科学》杂志上。

articles.title: A Pickle Plugged Into an Outlet Glows Like a Tiny Star. Now We Know Why.
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Modern science reveals not only answers but also many intellectually provocative questions.
paras.zh: 现代科学不仅揭示了答案，还揭示了许多智力上具有挑战性的问题。

paras.en: These include essential riddles regarding the origin of life, the cosmological fate of the Universe, and why pickles glow when you plug them into an outlet.
paras.zh: 其中包括有关生命起源、宇宙的宇宙命运以及为什么泡菜插入插座时会发光的基本谜语。

paras.en: It's a popular and shockingly (so don't try it at home) intriguing electrical experiment: when one sticks two forks into a pickle and plugs this elec-pickle system into a power source, one end of the pickle glows.
paras.zh: 这是一种流行且令人震惊（所以不要在家里尝试）有趣的电气实验：当一个人将两把叉子插入泡菜并将该电泡菜系统插入电源时，泡菜的一端会发光。

paras.en: Thanks to some recent elucidation, we may now know why: exploding hydrogen.
paras.zh: 由于最近的一些阐明，我们现在可能知道原因：氢气爆炸。

paras.en: The glowing pickle trick builds on a rich history of public science demonstrations of varying utility, stretching at least 400,000 years into the past, to the earliest known ancient human relatives who created fire-starting sparks with flint and pyrite.
paras.zh: 发光泡菜戏法建立在具有不同用途的公共科学演示的丰富历史之上，至少可以追溯到 40 万年前，最早已知的古代人类亲戚用燧石和黄铁矿产生点火火花。

paras.en: Fast-forwarding to around 2,600 years ago, it's said that Thales of Miletus marveled at observing that rubbing fur and amber imbues them with an attraction toward feathers and bits of straw via static electricity.
paras.zh: 快进到大约 2,600 年前，据说米利都的泰利斯 (Thales) 惊奇地发现，摩擦毛皮和琥珀会通过静电使它们对羽毛和稻草碎片产生吸引力。

paras.en: Some such acts – a sign of their times – have been realized in paint, as by Joseph Wright of Derby, who in 1768 unveiled a cruel scientific exhibition, An Experiment on a Bird in the Air Pump.
paras.zh: 一些这样的行为——他们时代的标志——已经在绘画中得以实现，比如德比的约瑟夫·赖特(Joseph Wright)，他在 1768 年举办了一场残酷的科学展览，《气泵里的鸟的实验》。

paras.en: Such science-popularizing exhibitions became increasingly common as a consequence of the Age of Enlightenment that swept through much of the Western world in the 17th and 18th centuries.
paras.zh: 由于启蒙时代在 17 世纪和 18 世纪席卷了西方世界的大部分地区，此类科普展览变得越来越普遍。

paras.en: Some of the most exciting advances were those that were both mentally and visually intriguing.
paras.zh: 一些最令人兴奋的进步是那些在精神和视觉上都令人着迷的进步。

paras.en: For example, the eye-deceiving phénakisticope was developed in the 1800s to explore illusions but became an early form of animation that fascinated Victorian families.
paras.zh: 例如，欺骗眼睛的幻影剧是在 1800 年代开发的，旨在探索幻觉，但后来成为令维多利亚时代家庭着迷的早期动画形式。

paras.en: Today we have the pickle trick, demonstrated and described at the 2026 Electrostatics Society of America Annual Meeting, held in June, by Joshua Méndez Harper, an electrical engineer at Portland State University.
paras.zh: 今天，我们看到了波特兰州立大学电气工程师约书亚·门德斯·哈珀 (Joshua Méndez Harper) 在 6 月举行的 2026 年美国静电学会年会上演示和描述的泡菜技巧。

paras.en: Curiously interested in unconventional electrical topics, his previous works include strategies for improving brew quality by reducing static charge generation while grinding coffee (hint: add water).
paras.zh: 他对非常规电气主题非常感兴趣，他之前的作品包括通过减少研磨咖啡时产生的静电荷来提高冲泡质量的策略（提示：加水）。

paras.en: The glowing pickle trick has so far vacillated between two competing explanations, facilitated by its liquid brine.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，由于其液态盐水的作用，发光泡菜魔术在两种相互竞争的解释之间摇摆不定。

paras.en: Firstly, the electrical heating applied to the pickle boils its liquid and creates internal gas pockets, simultaneously releasing a sizzling ooze and the metallic, pungent stench of electrified pickle.
paras.zh: 首先，对泡菜进行电加热，使其液体沸腾并产生内部气穴，同时释放出滋滋作响的软泥和带电泡菜的金属刺鼻臭味。

paras.en: (Incidentally, Méndez Harper's experiment was followed by a coffee break, presumably to also air out the room.)
paras.zh: （顺便说一句，门德斯·哈珀的实验之后是喝咖啡休息，大概也是为了让房间通风。）

paras.en: The resultant gas pockets also form an insulation barrier that stops the flow of electricity, cooling the pickle and shrinking the gas pockets, allowing the brine to rush back in toward the electrode – in this case, a fork.
paras.zh: 由此产生的气穴还形成绝缘屏障，阻止电流流动，冷却泡菜并缩小气穴，使盐水流回电极（在本例中为叉子）。

paras.en: "As that water comes back in toward the electrode a little arc crosses between the liquid and the electrode, just as when you reach for a doorknob and you get a zap," Méndez Harper explains.
paras.zh: “当水流回电极时，液体和电极之间会产生一个小弧线，就像当你伸手去拿门把手时会听到一声电击一样，”门德斯·哈珀解释道。

paras.en: "That doesn't explain everything that happens, though," he adds, noting that only one end of the pickle glows.
paras.zh: “但这并不能解释所发生的一切，”他补充道，并指出只有泡菜的一端会发光。

paras.en: The second potential pickle-power explanation involves electrolysis, the molecule-splitting process that may one day help humans colonize the Moon.
paras.zh: 第二种可能的泡菜动力解释涉及电解，这是一种分子分裂过程，有一天可能会帮助人类殖民月球。

paras.en: Within the pickle, electric action splits water into its constituent oxygen and hydrogen gas, the latter of which is especially volatile.
paras.zh: 在泡菜中，电作用将水分解成氧气和氢气，后者特别容易挥发。

paras.en: The glow then originates from tiny hydrogen explosions within the pickle, perhaps facilitated by heat from the electrodes.
paras.zh: 然后，泡菜内微小的氢气爆炸就会产生辉光，这可能是由电极的热量促进的。

paras.en: Méndez Harper clarifies that, as often occurs in science, the answer is a combination of both hypotheses:
paras.zh: 门德斯·哈珀 (Méndez Harper) 澄清说，正如科学中经常出现的那样，答案是两种假设的结合：

paras.en: "There is hydrogen involved, but it's actually not heat that's igniting it – it's the spark. It's just like why you don't light a cigarette at a gas station. You're producing a spark that ignites the gas."
paras.zh: “其中涉及氢气，但实际上点燃它的不是热量，而是火花。这就像你不在加油站点燃香烟一样。你会产生火花来点燃气体。”

paras.en: Additionally, the yellowish-orange glow of the pickle is due to the excitation of sodium atoms, which emit in the part of the electromagnetic spectrum that our eyes perceive as a golden gleam.
paras.zh: 此外，泡菜的黄橙色光芒是由于钠原子的激发而产生的，钠原子发出的电磁波谱部分被我们的眼睛感知为金色的光芒。

paras.en: This same underlying mineral mechanism delights us on a grander, more explosive scale a few times per year because it dictates the color of fireworks.
paras.zh: 同样的潜在矿物机制每年都会以更宏大、更具爆炸性的规模让我们感到高兴，因为它决定了烟花的颜色。

paras.en: "You're exciting sodium ions, which produce that characteristic orange glow," Méndez Harper says, adding an interesting potentiality for future pickle-zapping purposes:
paras.zh: 门德斯·哈珀 (Méndez Harper) 说：“钠离子令人兴奋，它会产生特有的橙色光芒。”他为未来的泡菜攻击目的增添了有趣的潜力：

paras.en: "If you were to pickle something in a different salt, you'd get a color unique to those elements."
paras.zh: “如果你用不同的盐腌制一些东西，你会得到这些元素独特的颜色。”

paras.en: Possibly because that's the side where extra salt water collects, giving us a new idiom in the process, so when someone looks radiant, we can tell them they're "glowing like the salty side of the pickle."
paras.zh: 可能是因为这是额外盐水聚集的一面，在这个过程中给了我们一个新的习语，所以当有人看起来容光焕发时，我们可以告诉他们他们“像泡菜咸的一面一样发光”。

articles.title: Night Owls Are 70% More Likely to Need a Disability Pension, Study Suggests
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: It is 11 pm, and your brain has finally decided to cooperate. The task that felt impossible all afternoon suddenly seems manageable. You want to read, finish something, or follow an idea.
paras.zh: 现在是晚上 11 点，你的大脑终于决定合作了。整个下午感觉不可能完成的任务突然变得可以完成。你想阅读、完成某件事或遵循一个想法。

paras.en: Then the morning alarm rings. That energy has vanished, but the working day is starting anyway.
paras.zh: 然后早上的闹钟就响了。那种能量已经消失了，但工作日还是开始了。

paras.en: For night owls, this clash can feel familiar. A Finnish study suggests their difficulties may extend beyond mornings: evening types were more likely to receive a disability pension years before the usual retirement age.
paras.zh: 对于夜猫子来说，这种冲突可能会感觉很熟悉。芬兰的一项研究表明，他们的困难可能不仅仅限于早晨：夜间类型更有可能在通常退休年龄之前几年领取残疾养老金。

paras.en: Researchers followed 5,679 adults for 12 years. Before adjusting for other factors, evening types had an approximately 70 percent higher rate of receiving a disability pension than morning types, accounting for when pensions were awarded.
paras.zh: 研究人员对 5,679 名成年人进行了长达 12 年的跟踪调查。在调整其他因素之前，考虑到养老金发放时间，晚间型人获得残疾养老金的比例比早间型人高出约 70%。

paras.en: The finding appeared in both men and women, and persisted after accounting for socioeconomic factors, including education and income.
paras.zh: 这一发现出现在男性和女性中，并且在考虑了包括教育和收入在内的社会经济因素后仍然存在。

paras.en: But health emerged as an important part of the explanation.
paras.zh: 但健康成为了解释的一个重要组成部分。

paras.en: "We think that the generally poorer health of evening chronotypes (compared to morning chronotypes) was the most likely explanation of the heightened risk found in our study," first author Tapio Räihä, a life course health researcher at the University of Oulu, told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: 第一作者、奥卢大学生命历程健康研究员塔皮奥·拉伊哈 (Tapio Räihä) 告诉 ScienceAlert：“我们认为，晚上睡眠型（与早晨睡眠型相比）的健康状况普遍较差，是我们研究中发现的风险升高的最可能的解释。”

paras.en: Being a night owl describes more than a habit of staying up for another episode. Our chronotype reflects when we naturally tend to feel alert and sleepy. Some people favor mornings, others evenings, and many fall somewhere in between.
paras.zh: 夜猫子不仅仅指的是熬夜看另一集的习惯。我们的生物钟反映了我们何时会自然地感到警觉和困倦。有些人喜欢早上，有些人喜欢晚上，还有很多人喜欢介于两者之间。

paras.en: This timing has a strong genetic component, although environmental influences also shape its expression.
paras.zh: 尽管环境影响也会影响其表达，但这种时机具有很强的遗传成分。

paras.en: The new research drew on the Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966, a population study following people born in two northern Finnish provinces.
paras.zh: 这项新研究借鉴了 1966 年芬兰北部出生队列研究，这是一项针对芬兰北部两个省份出生人口的人口研究。

paras.en: In 2012, participants aged 46 answered questions about morning tiredness, preferred working times, and whether they considered themselves morning or evening people.
paras.zh: 2012 年，46 岁的参与者回答了有关早晨疲劳、喜欢的工作时间以及他们认为自己是早起型人还是晚上型人的问题。

paras.en: The analysis included 2,597 men and 3,082 women who had not already retired or received a disability pension. Around 10 percent of men and 12 percent of women were classified as evening types.
paras.zh: 该分析包括尚未退休或尚未领取残疾养老金的 2,597 名男性和 3,082 名女性。大约 10% 的男性和 12% 的女性属于夜间型。

paras.en: Researchers linked their responses to national pension records through 2023.
paras.zh: 研究人员将他们的回答与 2023 年之前的国民养老金记录联系起来。

paras.en: In Finland, disability pensions are awarded when health problems substantially reduce long-term working ability despite treatment and rehabilitation. The study included partial and full pensions, whether temporary or permanent.
paras.zh: 在芬兰，当健康问题尽管经过治疗和康复仍严重降低长期工作能力时，才会发放残疾养老金。该研究包括部分和全额养老金，无论是临时的还是永久的。

paras.en: During follow-up, 384 participants received their first disability pension.
paras.zh: 在随访期间，384 名参与者收到了他们的第一笔伤残抚恤金。

paras.en: Among men, that happened to 8.3 percent of evening types, compared with 5 percent of morning types. Among women, the proportions were 12.1 percent and 7.2 percent.
paras.zh: 在男性中，晚上型男性的比例为 8.3%，而早晨型男性的比例为 5%。在女性中，这一比例分别为12.1%和7.2%。

paras.en: Most evening types did not receive a disability pension during follow-up. Only 21 evening-type men received one, leaving considerable uncertainty around the size of their association.
paras.zh: 大多数晚上类型的人在随访期间没有领取伤残抚恤金。只有 21 名夜间型男性收到了一封信，这使得他们的协会规模存在很大的不确定性。

paras.en: At the start, evening types generally reported poorer health, more sleep difficulties, and lower physical activity than morning types.
paras.zh: 一开始，晚上型人通常比早晨型人健康状况更差，睡眠困难更多，体力活动也更少。

paras.en: When researchers accounted for self-rated health, body mass index, smoking, alcohol consumption, and physical activity, the association weakened and became statistically non-significant in both sexes.
paras.zh: 当研究人员考虑到自我评价的健康状况、体重指数、吸烟、饮酒和体力活动时，这种关联减弱，并且在两性中变得不显着。

paras.en: Adjusting separately for working hours and schedules also weakened it. In the model including all measured factors, the estimated difference between evening and morning types was small and statistically non-significant.
paras.zh: 单独调整工作时间和日程安排也削弱了它。在包含所有测量因素的模型中，晚上类型和早晨类型之间的估计差异很小，并且在统计上不显着。

paras.en: That does not settle the explanation. The authors caution that some adjusted factors could be steps along a possible pathway from chronotype to work disability. Accounting for them might therefore remove part of the relationship under investigation.
paras.zh: 这并不能解决问题。作者警告说，一些调整后的因素可能是从时间型到工作残疾的可能途径的步骤。因此，考虑到这些因素可能会消除部分正在调查的关系。

paras.en: "Our study was observational, so we cannot prove cause-and-effect relationship," Räihä said.
paras.zh: “我们的研究是观察性的，因此我们无法证明因果关系，”雷哈说。

paras.en: One possibility is a mismatch between internal rhythms and external demands. Finnish working days commonly begin around 8 am, when evening types may not perform at their best.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是内部节奏与外部需求不匹配。芬兰人的工作日通常在上午 8 点左右开始，此时夜间型员工可能无法发挥最佳状态。

paras.en: More than 70 percent of evening types who reported their schedules nevertheless worked daytime jobs.
paras.zh: 超过 70% 的夜班型人在报告自己的日程安排后仍然从事白天的工作。

paras.en: Asked what might help, Räihä suggested morning outdoor light, dimmer lighting before bed, and limiting screens late at night. Caffeine use and untreated health problems also deserve consideration when addressing sleep difficulties.
paras.zh: 当被问及什么可能有帮助时，莱哈建议早上使用室外光线，睡前调暗灯光，并在深夜限制屏幕的使用。在解决睡眠困难时，咖啡因的使用和未经治疗的健康问题也值得考虑。

paras.en: These suggestions were not tested in this study.
paras.zh: 这些建议未在本研究中进行测试。

paras.en: "If you can choose a job that allows flexibility in schedules, that could also help," he said.
paras.zh: “如果你能选择一份日程安排灵活的工作，那也会有所帮助，”他说。

paras.en: Arranging tasks around periods of greater alertness might be another option. Whether schedule changes reduce disability pension risk, however, remains unknown.
paras.zh: 在高度警觉的时期安排任务可能是另一种选择。然而，时间表的改变是否会降低残疾养老金风险仍然未知。

paras.en: Health, sleep, and working conditions were measured only at the beginning and could have changed. Finland's healthcare and pension system also limit generalization.
paras.zh: 健康、睡眠和工作条件仅在开始时进行测量，并且可能会发生变化。芬兰的医疗保健和养老金制度也限制了普遍化。

paras.en: "Also, the study needs to be replicated in other societies before making broad generalizations," Räihä said.
paras.zh: “此外，在做出广泛的概括之前，这项研究需要在其他社会进行复制，”雷哈说。

paras.en: Räihä said it is likely that evening types who maintain healthy habits and look after their sleep should not need to worry about their potential disability pension risk.
paras.zh: 莱哈表示，保持健康习惯并照顾好睡眠的晚间型人士很可能不需要担心潜在的残疾养老金风险。

paras.en: The findings raise questions about how health and working schedules interact with natural rhythms. They do not predict how an individual night owl's career will end.
paras.zh: 这些发现提出了关于健康和工作时间表如何与自然节律相互作用的问题。他们无法预测一个夜猫子的职业生涯将如何结束。

paras.en: The research has been published in Occupational & Environmental Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《职业与环境医学》上。

articles.title: Don't miss: Watch Saturn shine and Halley’s Comet debris streak across the sky

paras.en: Don't miss: Watch Saturn shine and Halleyâs Comet debris streak across the sky
paras.zh: 不要错过：观看土星的光芒和哈雷彗星碎片划过天空

paras.en: - October skywatchers can see Saturn at opposition, catch meteors from Halleyâs Comet during the Orionid peak, and watch the Moon sweep past the famous Pleiades star cluster. Moonlight may obscure some Orionids, but the best viewing should come before dawn after the Moon sets.
paras.zh: - 十月的天文观测者可以看到冲日的土星，在猎户座流星雨高峰期捕捉哈雷彗星的流星，并观看月球掠过著名的昴宿星团。月光可能会遮挡一些猎户座流星雨，但最佳观赏时间应该是在月亮落下后的黎明之前。

paras.en: October offers several memorable sights for skywatchers, including Saturn at opposition, the Orionid meteor shower, and a close pairing of the Moon and the Pleiades, also known as the Seven Sisters.
paras.zh: 十月为天文观测者提供了一些令人难忘的景象，包括土星冲日、猎户座流星雨，以及月球和昴宿星团（也称为七姐妹星）的紧密配对。

paras.en: - Oct. 4: Saturn reaches opposition, making the ringed planet visible for much of the night
paras.zh: - 10 月 4 日：土星到达冲日位置，使得这颗环状行星在夜间大部分时间都可见

paras.en: - Oct. 6: A thin crescent Moon appears close to bright Jupiter before sunrise
paras.zh: - 10 月 6 日：日出前，一轮细长的新月出现在明亮的木星附近

paras.en: - Oct. 21-22: The Orionid meteor shower peaks; moonlight may interfere, so look before dawn after moonset
paras.zh: - 10月21日至22日：猎户座流星雨达到顶峰；月光可能会干扰，因此请在月落之后黎明前查看

paras.en: - Oct. 27-28: The Moon passes near the Pleiades star cluster, also known as the Seven Sisters
paras.zh: - 10 月 27 日至 28 日：月球经过昴宿星团（也称为七姐妹星团）附近

paras.en: Saturn leads October's celestial lineup, followed later in the month by meteors linked to Halley's Comet and a close encounter between the Moon and one of the best known star clusters in the night sky. Together, these events make October a busy month for anyone looking up after sunset or before dawn.
paras.zh: 土星在十月的天体阵容中处于领先地位，随后是本月晚些时候与哈雷彗星有关的流星以及月球与夜空中最著名的星团之一的近距离接触。这些事件共同使得十月对于日落后或黎明前仰视的人来说是一个忙碌的月份。

paras.en: On October 4th, Saturn reaches opposition, offering one of the best viewing opportunities of the year for the ringed planet.
paras.zh: 10 月 4 日，土星到达冲日，为这颗光环行星提供了一年中最佳的观测机会之一。

paras.en: Opposition occurs when Earth moves between the Sun and Saturn. From our perspective, Saturn then appears on the opposite side of the sky from the Sun. As a result, the planet rises around sunset and remains visible for much of the night.
paras.zh: 当地球在太阳和土星之间运行时，就会发生冲日。从我们的角度来看，土星出现在太阳的另一侧。因此，这颗行星在日落时分升起，并且在夜间的大部分时间里都可见。

paras.en: Saturn is also drawing scientific attention because of unusual activity in its atmosphere. Astronomers have long studied a hexagon shaped jet stream stretching nearly 20,000 miles across the planet's north pole.
paras.zh: 土星也因其大气层的异常活动而引起了科学界的关注。天文学家长期以来一直在研究横跨地球北极近 20,000 英里的六边形急流。

paras.en: More recently, observations from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope revealed a ten sided atmospheric wave surrounding Saturn's south pole. The feature, located in the southern hemisphere, appears to be growing stronger. That gives researchers a rare chance to observe a massive atmospheric structure as it develops.
paras.zh: 最近，美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的观测揭示了土星南极周围存在十边形大气波。这一位于南半球的特征似乎正在变得越来越强。这为研究人员提供了观察巨大大气结构发展过程的难得机会。

paras.en: The Orionid meteor shower reaches its peak during the night of October 21st and into the morning of October 22nd.
paras.zh: 猎户座流星雨在10月21日夜间至10月22日早晨达到顶峰。

paras.en: These meteors come from small pieces of material left behind by Halley's Comet. Although the Orionids appear to originate from the direction of the constellation Orion, individual meteors can flash across any area of the sky.
paras.zh: 这些流星来自哈雷彗星留下的小块物质。尽管猎户座流星雨似乎起源于猎户座方向，但单个流星可以闪过天空的任何区域。

paras.en: Viewing conditions will not be ideal for the entire night this year. A bright waxing gibbous Moon is expected to overpower some of the fainter meteors.
paras.zh: 今年整个晚上的观看条件并不理想。明亮的盈凸月预计将压倒一些较暗的流星。

paras.en: The best opportunity to see the shower may arrive during the few hours before dawn, after the Moon has set. For better viewing, find a dark location away from bright lights, allow your eyes time to adjust, and scan as much of the sky as possible.
paras.zh: 观看流星雨的最佳机会可能是黎明前月亮落下后的几个小时。为了获得更好的观看效果，请找到一个远离强光的黑暗位置，让您的眼睛有时间进行调整，并尽可能多地扫描天空。

paras.en: Another striking sight arrives on the night of October 27th into the 28th, when the Moon passes close to the Pleiades star cluster, also known as the Seven Sisters.
paras.zh: 另一个引人注目的景象出现在 10 月 27 日至 28 日晚上，当时月球靠近昴宿星团（也称为七姐妹星团）。

paras.en: The Pleiades have inspired stories in many ancient cultures. Part of their widespread importance may come from the fact that the cluster can be seen from nearly every part of the world.
paras.zh: 昴宿星团为许多古代文化中的故事提供了灵感。它们的广泛重要性可能部分来自于这样一个事实：世界上几乎每个地方都可以看到这个星团。

paras.en: To find the pairing, look toward the east during the evening as the Moon and the Pleiades rise higher in the sky. To the unaided eye, the cluster looks like a slightly hazy group of 6 to 7 stars.
paras.zh: 为了找到配对，请在晚上向东方看，此时月亮和昴宿星团在天空中升得更高。肉眼看来，这个星团看起来像是一个由 6 到 7 颗恒星组成的略显模糊的星团。

paras.en: No special equipment is required to see the Pleiades, but binoculars or a telescope can reveal the cluster in much greater detail.
paras.zh: 不需要特殊的设备来观看昴宿星团，但双筒望远镜或望远镜可以更详细地揭示该星团。

paras.en: Materials provided by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NASA 喷气推进实验室提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation Could Help New Skills Stick

paras.en: Vagus Nerve Stimulation Could Help New Skills Stick
paras.zh: 迷走神经刺激可以帮助新技能坚持下去

paras.en: Scientists found that stimulating a major body-to-brain nerve after practice may open a hidden window that helps new skills stick.
paras.zh: 科学家发现，练习后刺激身体到大脑的主要神经可能会打开一扇隐藏的窗口，有助于新技能的坚持。

paras.en: - Stimulating the vagus nerve after practice helped mice develop stronger long-term motor learning, revealing a potentially important window when the brain is still locking in a new skill. The effect was linked to rhythmic changes in brain blood vessels, hinting that body-to-brain signals may help prepare the brain for lasting change.
paras.zh: - 练习后刺激迷走神经有助于小鼠发展出更强的长期运动学习能力，这揭示了大脑仍在锁定新技能时的潜在重要窗口。这种效应与脑血管的节律变化有关，暗示身体到大脑的信号可能有助于大脑为持久的变化做好准备。

paras.en: Why do some new skills seem to click almost instantly while others remain frustratingly difficult even after repeated practice? The difference may involve more than talent or effort. It may also depend on whether the brain is in the right condition to turn practice into lasting learning.
paras.zh: 为什么有些新技能似乎几乎立即生效，而另一些技能即使经过反复练习仍然令人沮丧？这种差异可能不仅仅涉及天赋或努力。它还可能取决于大脑是否处于将练习转化为持久学习的正确状态。

paras.en: Learning does not happen independently of the rest of the body. Internal organs constantly send information to the brain through the vagus nerve, one of the nervous system's major communication pathways. Researchers at Tohoku University who study super network brain physiology have now shown in mice that stimulating this nerve after training can strengthen long term motor learning. Their findings point to a previously overlooked role for communication from the body to the brain in helping new skills persist.
paras.zh: 学习不会独立于身体的其他部分而发生。内脏器官不断通过迷走神经向大脑发送信息，迷走神经是神经系统的主要通讯途径之一。研究超级网络大脑生理学的东北大学研究人员现在在小鼠身上证明，训练后刺激该神经可以增强长期运动学习。他们的发现指出了以前被忽视的从身体到大脑的沟通在帮助新技能持续存在方面的作用。

paras.en: The findings were published in iScience on August 25, 2026.
paras.zh: 研究结果于 2026 年 8 月 25 日发表在 iScience 上。

paras.en: The vagus nerve serves as a major information highway between the brain and the body. It carries signals from internal organs to the brain while also transmitting instructions from the brain back to those organs. Scientists can influence this pathway using vagus nerve stimulation (VNS), which is already clinically approved for treating several disorders.
paras.zh: 迷走神经是大脑和身体之间的主要信息高速公路。它将信号从内脏器官传送到大脑，同时还将指令从大脑传送回这些器官。科学家可以使用迷走神经刺激（VNS）来影响这条通路，该疗法已被临床批准用于治疗多种疾病。

paras.en: Earlier research has mainly explored VNS as a form of neuromodulation that changes activity in neurotransmitter systems. The new study suggests there may be another important mechanism involved: rhythmic changes in blood vessels inside the brain.
paras.zh: 早期的研究主要探索 VNS 作为一种神经调节形式，可以改变神经递质系统的活动。这项新研究表明，可能还涉及另一个重要机制：大脑内血管的节律变化。

paras.en: To investigate this possibility, the researchers created a small cuff electrode designed to stay attached to the left cervical vagus nerve in mice. They then tested VNS during horizontal optokinetic response (HOKR) learning, a cerebellum dependent eye movement task that teaches mice to improve their ability to follow moving visual stripes. The response is similar to the automatic eye movements a person makes while standing on a platform and watching a train move past.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种可能性，研究人员创建了一个小型袖带电极，旨在与小鼠的左颈迷走神经保持连接。然后，他们在水平光动反应（HOKR）学习过程中测试了 VNS，这是一种小脑依赖性眼动任务，可以教会小鼠提高跟踪移动视觉条纹的能力。这种反应类似于一个人站在站台上看着火车驶过时所做的自动眼球运动。

paras.en: The Biggest Effect Appeared After Practice
paras.zh: 练习后最大效果显现

paras.en: The researchers applied VNS after each training session rather than during the learning task itself. The stimulation did not immediately improve performance while the mice were training. Instead, the benefits became apparent later.
paras.zh: 研究人员在每次训练后而不是在学习任务期间应用 VNS。当小鼠训练时，刺激并不会立即提高表现。相反，好处后来才变得明显。

paras.en: On following days, mice that received VNS showed stronger long-term learning. This pattern suggests that the stimulation may influence processes that happen after training, when the brain is consolidating what it has learned into more durable memory.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，接受 VNS 的小鼠表现出更强的长期学习能力。这种模式表明，刺激可能会影响训练后发生的过程，此时大脑正在将所学到的知识巩固成更持久的记忆。

paras.en: "The key point is that VNS was delivered only after training," says Professor Ko Matsui. "Our findings suggest that VNS may open a hidden window of opportunity for enhanced learning by making the brain environment more receptive to long-lasting change."
paras.zh: “关键点是 VNS 仅在训练后才进行，”Ko Matsui 教授说。 “我们的研究结果表明，VNS 可能通过使大脑环境更容易接受长期变化，为增强学习打开一扇隐藏的机会之窗。”

paras.en: The team next looked for changes inside the brain that might accompany the improved learning. They measured blood volume activity near the cerebellar flocculus, an area involved in HOKR learning.
paras.zh: 研究小组接下来寻找大脑内部可能伴随学习能力提高的变化。他们测量了小脑绒球附近的血容量活动，该区域涉及 HOKR 学习。

paras.en: Using fiber photometry, the researchers found that a single round of VNS produced a two phase vascular response. Local blood volume briefly decreased before rising after a delay. When VNS was repeated, it created rhythmic oscillations in blood volume.
paras.zh: 利用光纤光度测定法，研究人员发现单轮 VNS 会产生两相血管反应。局部血容量短暂下降，随后延迟上升。当重复进行 VNS 时，会产生血容量的节律性振荡。

paras.en: Those vascular rhythms also appeared to be related to learning. Mice with larger blood volume oscillations generally showed better learning by Day 5, suggesting that changes in the brain's vascular environment could be connected to the longer lasting effects of the stimulation.
paras.zh: 这些血管节律似乎也与学习有关。血容量波动较大的小鼠通常在第 5 天表现出更好的学习能力，这表明大脑血管环境的变化可能与刺激的更持久效果有关。

paras.en: "Our brains may be more strongly influenced by the body than we imagine," says lead author Junyu Chen. "By tuning the brain's metabolic environment, including rhythmic vascular movements, we may eventually unlock capacities that would otherwise remain latent."
paras.zh: “我们的大脑受到身体的影响可能比我们想象的更强烈，”主要作者陈俊宇说。 “通过调整大脑的代谢环境，包括有节奏的血管运动，我们最终可能会释放原本隐藏的能力。”

paras.en: Future research will focus on refining stimulation protocols and determining more precisely how communication between the brain and body supports long term plasticity.
paras.zh: 未来的研究将集中于完善刺激方案，并更准确地确定大脑和身体之间的通信如何支持长期可塑性。

paras.en: By studying this two way communication pathway in greater detail, scientists hope to better understand how learning becomes lasting and how that process might eventually be enhanced.
paras.zh: 通过更详细地研究这种双向沟通途径，科学家们希望更好地了解学习如何变得持久以及该过程最终如何得到加强。

paras.en: Materials provided by Tohoku University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由东北大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Junyu U. Chen, Yoko Ikoma, Ko Matsui. Vagal nerve stimulation induces vascular oscillations and enhances long-term learning. iScience, 2026; 29 (9): 117413 DOI: 10.1016/j.isci.2026.117413
paras.zh: - Junyu U. Chen、Yoko Ikoma、Ko Matsui。迷走神经刺激引起血管振荡并增强长期学习。 i科学，2026； 29（9）：117413 DOI：10.1016/j.isci.2026.117413

articles.title: Scientists reveal what seven days of fasting does to the human body

paras.en: Scientists reveal what seven days of fasting does to the human body
paras.zh: 科学家揭秘7天禁食对人体的影响

paras.en: - Scientists found that prolonged fasting triggers major changes throughout the body, but many of the most interesting effects only appeared after about three days without food. The results suggest fasting may influence health in ways that go beyond weight loss and could eventually inspire treatments that mimic its effects.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，长时间禁食会引发整个身体的重大变化，但许多最有趣的影响只有在大约三天没有进食后才会出现。结果表明，禁食可能会以超出减肥的方式影响健康，并最终可能激发模仿其效果的治疗方法。

paras.en: Going without food for several days does far more than force the body to burn stored fat. Research published in 2024 found that prolonged fasting produces widespread and coordinated biological changes across multiple organs, with some of the most notable effects appearing only after about three days without calories.
paras.zh: 几天不吃东西不仅仅会迫使身体燃烧储存的脂肪。 2024 年发表的研究发现，长期禁食会在多个器官中产生广泛且协调的生物变化，其中一些最显着的影响只有在大约三天没有摄入卡路里后才会出现。

paras.en: The findings, published in Nature Metabolism, offer an unusually detailed look at how the human body responds during an extended fast. Researchers found evidence of biological effects that went beyond weight loss, although many of the potentially health related changes did not become apparent until participants had gone roughly three days without food.
paras.zh: 这项研究结果发表在《自然代谢》杂志上，异常详细地揭示了人体在长时间禁食期间的反应。研究人员发现了超出减肥范围的生物效应的证据，尽管许多潜在的健康相关变化直到参与者大约三天没有进食后才变得明显。

paras.en: Scientists from Queen Mary University of London's Precision Healthcare University Research Institute (PHURI) and the Norwegian School of Sports Sciences conducted the work. By identifying the molecular changes associated with fasting, the researchers hope to provide a foundation for future studies that could eventually lead to treatments capable of reproducing some of fasting's effects.
paras.zh: 来自伦敦玛丽女王大学精准医疗大学研究所 (PHURI) 和挪威运动科学学院的科学家进行了这项工作。通过识别与禁食相关的分子变化，研究人员希望为未来的研究奠定基础，最终可能导致能够重现禁食效果的治疗方法。

paras.en: That could be especially important for people who might benefit from certain biological effects of fasting but cannot safely undergo a prolonged fast or follow fasting mimicking approaches such as ketogenic diets.
paras.zh: 对于那些可能受益于禁食的某些生物效应但无法安全地进行长时间禁食或遵循生酮饮食等模仿禁食方法的人来说，这可能尤其重要。

paras.en: Humans have evolved to tolerate extended periods without food, an ability that was essential during times when meals were unpredictable. Today, millions of people fast for cultural, religious, medical, or weight loss purposes.
paras.zh: 人类已经进化到能够忍受长时间不进食，这种能力在膳食无法预测的时期至关重要。如今，数百万人出于文化、宗教、医疗或减肥的目的而禁食。

paras.en: Fasting also has a long history in medicine. It has been used in various forms to help manage conditions including epilepsy and rheumatoid arthritis.
paras.zh: 禁食在医学上也有着悠久的历史。它已以多种形式用于帮助治疗包括癫痫和类风湿性关节炎在内的疾病。

paras.en: One of the clearest changes during fasting involves the body's energy supply. Under normal conditions, much of the body's readily available energy comes from glucose derived from food. Once that incoming energy disappears, the body gradually begins drawing more heavily on stored fat.
paras.zh: 禁食期间最明显的变化之一涉及身体的能量供应。在正常情况下，身体的大部分可用能量来自食物中的葡萄糖。一旦传入的能量消失，身体就会逐渐开始更多地消耗储存的脂肪。

paras.en: Scientists already understood that basic metabolic shift. What has been much less clear is what prolonged fasting does throughout the rest of the body, including whether it produces biological changes that could be beneficial, harmful, or both (beneficial or adverse).
paras.zh: 科学家们已经了解了基本的代谢转变。目前尚不清楚的是，长期禁食会对身体其他部位产生什么影响，包括它是否会产生有益、有害或两者兼而有之（有益或有害）的生物变化。

paras.en: Modern protein analysis has made it possible to investigate those questions in far greater detail. Proteins carry out an enormous range of jobs in the body, from building tissues to controlling chemical reactions and transmitting signals between cells. Measuring thousands of proteins in the bloodstream can therefore provide a broad picture of how different organs and biological systems are responding.
paras.zh: 现代蛋白质分析使得更详细地研究这些问题成为可能。蛋白质在体内发挥着广泛的作用，从构建组织到控制化学反应和在细胞之间传递信号。因此，测量血液中的数千种蛋白质可以提供不同器官和生物系统如何反应的广泛画面。

paras.en: For the study, researchers followed 12 healthy volunteers who completed a seven-day water-only fast.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，研究人员跟踪了 12 名健康志愿者，他们完成了 7 天的只喝水禁食。

paras.en: Participants were closely monitored each day. The scientists measured changes in about 3,000 proteins in their blood before the fast, throughout the fasting period, and after they began eating again.
paras.zh: 参与者每天都受到密切监控。科学家们测量了禁食前、禁食期间以及再次进食后血液中约 3,000 种蛋白质的变化。

paras.en: The researchers then combined those protein measurements with genetic information from large population studies. This allowed them to investigate which biological pathways were changing during fasting and to predict some of the possible health consequences associated with those changes.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员将这些蛋白质测量结果与来自大规模人群研究的遗传信息结合起来。这使他们能够调查禁食期间哪些生物途径发生了变化，并预测与这些变化相关的一些可能的健康后果。

paras.en: As expected, the body began shifting away from glucose and toward stored fat as a major energy source during the first two or three days without food.
paras.zh: 正如预期的那样，在没有食物的前两三天内，身体开始从葡萄糖转向储存脂肪作为主要能量来源。

paras.en: Participants lost an average of 5.7 kilograms during the fast, with the loss coming from both fat mass and lean mass. Lean mass includes tissues that are not body fat, such as muscle and other water-rich tissues.
paras.zh: 参与者在禁食期间平均减重 5.7 公斤，减重来自脂肪量和瘦肉量。瘦体重包括非身体脂肪的组织，例如肌肉和其他富含水分的组织。

paras.en: Three days after participants resumed eating, their overall weight remained below where it had started. However, most of the lost lean mass had returned, while the reduction in fat mass remained.
paras.zh: 参与者恢复进食三天后，他们的总体体重仍低于开始时的水平。然而，大部分失去的瘦体重又回来了，而脂肪量的减少仍然存在。

paras.en: The most striking finding involved what happened after approximately three days of fasting.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的发现涉及禁食大约三天后发生的事情。

paras.en: At that point, researchers began detecting distinct changes in the levels of proteins throughout the body. The pattern suggested that complete calorie restriction was producing a coordinated whole body response rather than simply altering how the body obtained energy.
paras.zh: 那时，研究人员开始检测全身蛋白质水平的明显变化。该模式表明，完全限制卡路里摄入会产生协调的全身反应，而不是简单地改变身体获取能量的方式。

paras.en: About one third of all the proteins measured changed significantly during the fasting period, with effects linked to all major organs.
paras.zh: 大约三分之一的测量蛋白质在禁食期间发生显着变化，其影响与所有主要器官有关。

paras.en: Many of those changes appeared consistently among the participants. The researchers also detected biological signatures that could not be explained by weight loss alone.
paras.zh: 其中许多变化在参与者中一致出现。研究人员还发现了无法仅用体重减轻来解释的生物特征。

paras.en: One example involved changes in proteins associated with the structural support of neurons in the brain. Neurons are the specialized cells that transmit information throughout the nervous system, and the proteins surrounding and supporting them help maintain their structure and function.
paras.zh: 一个例子涉及与大脑神经元结构支持相关的蛋白质的变化。神经元是在整个神经系统中传递信息的特殊细胞，周围和支持它们的蛋白质有助于维持它们的结构和功能。

paras.en: The results suggest that prolonged fasting may influence a much wider range of biological processes than simply fat metabolism.
paras.zh: 结果表明，长期禁食可能会影响更广泛的生物过程，而不仅仅是脂肪代谢。

paras.en: Potential Benefits Extend Beyond Weight Loss
paras.zh: 潜在的好处不仅仅是减肥

paras.en: Claudia Langenberg, Director of Queen Mary's Precision Health University Research Institute (PHURI), said:
paras.zh: 玛丽女王精准健康大学研究所 (PHURI) 所长 Claudia Langenberg 表示：

paras.en: "For the first time, we're able to see what's happening on a molecular level across the body when we fast. Fasting, when done safely, is an effective weight loss intervention. Popular diets that incorporate fasting - such as intermittent fasting - claim to have health benefits beyond weight loss. Our results provide evidence for the health benefits of fasting beyond weight loss, but these were only visible after three days of total caloric restriction - later than we previously thought."
paras.zh: “这是我们第一次能够看到禁食时身体在分子水平上发生的情况。安全进行的禁食是一种有效的减肥干预措施。结合禁食的流行饮食（例如间歇性禁食）声称除了减肥之外还具有健康益处。我们的研究结果为禁食除了减肥之外的健康益处提供了证据，但这些只有在总热量限制三天后才能显现出来，比我们之前想象的要晚。”

paras.en: The timing is important. Intermittent fasting can involve much shorter periods without food, while this study examined complete calorie restriction lasting several days. The results therefore do not mean that shorter fasting schedules necessarily produce the same effects.
paras.zh: 时机很重要。间歇性禁食可能涉及更短的禁食时间，而这项研究检查了持续几天的完全热量限制。因此，结果并不意味着较短的禁食时间一定会产生相同的效果。

paras.en: Instead, the study helps identify when some of the more substantial molecular responses to prolonged fasting begin to appear.
paras.zh: 相反，这项研究有助于确定何时开始出现对长期禁食的一些更实质性的分子反应。

paras.en: Could Scientists Reproduce Fasting's Effects?
paras.zh: 科学家能重现禁食的效果吗？

paras.en: Understanding why fasting produces particular biological changes could eventually prove more important than fasting itself.
paras.zh: 了解禁食为何会产生特定的生物学变化最终可能比禁食本身更重要。

paras.en: If researchers can determine which molecular pathways are responsible for potentially beneficial effects, it may become possible to develop treatments that activate those pathways without requiring patients to stop eating for several days.
paras.zh: 如果研究人员能够确定哪些分子途径产生潜在的有益作用，就有可能开发出激活这些途径的治疗方法，而无需患者停止进食几天。

paras.en: That possibility could be especially useful for people whose medical conditions make prolonged fasting impractical or unsafe.
paras.zh: 这种可能性对于那些因健康状况而导致长期禁食不切实际或不安全的人尤其有用。

paras.en: Maik Pietzner, Health Data Chair of PHURI and co-lead of the Computational Medicine Group at Berlin Institute of Health at Charité, said:
paras.zh: PHURI 健康数据主席兼柏林夏里特健康研究所计算医学小组联合负责人 Maik Pietzner 表示：

paras.en: "Our findings have provided a basis for some age-old knowledge as to why fasting is used for certain conditions. While fasting may be beneficial for treating some conditions, often times, fasting won't be an option to patients suffering from ill health. We hope that these findings can provide information about why fasting is beneficial in certain cases, which can then be used to develop treatments that patients are able to do."
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果为一些关于为什么在某些情况下禁食的古老知识提供了基础。虽然禁食可能有益于治疗某些疾病，但很多时候，禁食对于健康状况不佳的患者来说并不是一种选择。我们希望这些发现可以提供有关为什么禁食在某些情况下有益的信息，然后可以用于开发患者能够进行的治疗方法。”

paras.en: The study provides a detailed molecular map of how the human body adapts during prolonged fasting. It also highlights a notable threshold: while the switch toward burning stored fat begins within the first few days, many of the broader biological changes associated with fasting become detectable only after about three days without calories.
paras.zh: 该研究提供了人体在长期禁食期间如何适应的详细分子图谱。它还强调了一个值得注意的阈值：虽然在最初几天内就开始燃烧储存的脂肪，但许多与禁食相关的更广泛的生物变化只有在大约三天没有卡路里的情况下才能被检测到。

paras.en: That distinction could help researchers separate the effects of weight loss from the deeper biological responses triggered by extended fasting, while providing new clues about how those responses might someday be reproduced without requiring people to undergo prolonged periods without food.
paras.zh: 这种区别可以帮助研究人员将减肥的影响与长期禁食引发的更深层次的生物反应区分开来，同时提供新的线索，说明这些反应有朝一日如何在不要求人们长时间不进食的情况下重现。

paras.en: Materials provided by Queen Mary University of London. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由伦敦玛丽女王大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。
